review_body:
This is not only based off the quality of their food but the company itself and how much they “care” for the animals their feeding. I don’t want anyone else to go through the hell I went through.

When I first bought this food I absolutely loved it and so did the cats. I bought this brand because the ingredients were very good. Didn’t have brewers rice as the first ingredient or corn, a big plus for me. I ended up recommending this food to a lot of my friends and family for both dogs and cats. Until one day my cats, Bella, threw up. I thought it was weird because neither one of my cats have ever been sick. I kept the cats from going onto my patio in case this was caused by a plant. She was still getting sick and stopped eating altogether so I took her to the vet. The vet prescribed some different food and some meds. She got better and started eating her yummy canned food. Once I switched her back to Wilderness she immediately got sick again. I figured she might just need different food but I didn’t want to throw Wilderness away because it was a new bag. So I gave the other cat Charlotte Wilderness and kept Bella on some new food. Charlotte started throwing up about a week later. That’s when I realized it was the food and stuck them both on the new food. About a month later Bella caught pneumonia and had to stay the night at the ER or she would have died. The vet told me that it was from throwing up the food, she had inhaled some of her vomit which developed into pneumonia.

I decided to contact Wilderness to prevent all this stress and the piling vet bills from happening to other people. I kept the bag of food expecting them to ask for samples. They never asked for samples, took 10 weeks to review my cats files and said it wasn’t their fault. I could not believe they didn’t care about whether their food harmed my cat or not. If they had done a thorough investigation then I would feel differently about this situation. Apparently ittook so long because they have many other people who have submitted the same complaint. Their emails were rude and provided no helpful information. My vet even told me that there were a lot of issues with this food.

I would highly suggest you look around for a different food. It nearly killed my cat and probably took a few years off my life from stress. It’s not worth the $2,000 in vet bills and then to be treated in a rude and unprofessional manner. I am very disappointed in this company.

product_title: Generic Glowing Effect Artificial Fake Jellyfish For Fish Tank Decoration Ornament, Blue
review_headline: Great jellies, but warning about fragility!
review_body:
I bought these jellies as an addition to the aquarium I bought my cats for their birthday (yeah, I know). They LOVE watching the jellies move and even tried to put their paws in the tank to grab them.

PROS: They are lifelike and very pretty to look at. Easy to install with suction cup and fishing line attached.

CONS: Okay, first of all, I would suggest not using these jellies with actual fish in your tank - they will kill your fish if they get tangled up in the line. I wanted a jellyfish tank but without having to buy real ones and deal with the mess of maintaining a tank, so mine swim around in the tank with plastic floating fish.

Secondly, they don't \\"dance\\" around in the tank unless you have the suction cup (with a little tube attached) hooked up to your motor which causes the jelly to expand and move around. To do this - if you have a bubble wall and more than one jelly like I do - you would have to have more than one motor and that's going to look crazy with a ton of tubing in your tank. They do move around a bit with the bubbles from my bubble wall in the back of the tank but because they're positioned up front it's not significant, but their tentacles look cute all stretched out in the water.

Third, you have to be INCREDIBLY CAREFUL with them! The line attached to the suction cup and then to the jelly's body is super, super, super thin and if it breaks from moving the jelly around the tank too much - like mine did - it is going to be HELL to reattach! I have a newfound respect for surgeons now because it literally took me HOURS just to grasp the thin line with my fingers and try to tie it in a bow around the tube on the suction cup - trust me, you will NOT get it into the teeny weeny little nodule on the suction cup it was originally attached to, so go for wrapping the line about five times around the tube instead.

If you want to re-attach the line, do what I did - at least TRY to tie it around the tubeon the suction cup at least twice to secure it. Then, take a hot glue gun and just glue around the tube and wait for it to dry completely, then put it back in the tank and bury that sucker under the gravel. And DON'T fool with it again! I would have just tossed it and ordered more (which I am going to do anyway because they're so cute) BUT it came to me on the slow boat from China and I wouldn't want to wait another month to receive it.

All in all, very worth it, they are adorable and the kitties love them!

product_title: Midwest Critter Nation with Stand
review_headline: Price is worth the time you'll save cleaning it
review_body:
I've had other cages in the past but this is by far the easiest to clean. Most cages have very small doors that are impossible to maneuver around and plastic shelves that clip on that you have to fight with to remove for cleaning. The fact that the double wide doors open up all the way and the shelves aren't clip-ons makes cleaning go a lot faster. I own 2 of the 63" tall Critter Nations (one for male rats, the other for females) and to deep clean both of them it takes about 3 hours. That may sound like a lot of time, but part of that time is just me waiting for their fleece and beds/hammocks to finish drying. When I got my first two rats, I got them an All Living Things Luxury Home for rats and it took me 3 hours to clean, and that's only one cage and it is leagues smaller than the double Critter Nation. Most of that time was spent wrestling with the stupid plastic clip on shelves that never seemed to want to go on or come off and trying to become a professional contortionist to put things in / take things out through the small cage doors.

This cage is also fun/easy to accessorize. Since the shelves have three height adjustments, it gives you a lot of control over where things can go, you can attach hammocks and other things to the bottom of the trays. You can also add additional lava ledges and bird perches for more vertical climbing. I took off one star partially because the double wide doors do make it almost impossible to put lava ledges anywhere but towards the front of the cage, unless you have someone else helping you. Ultimately though it's not a big deal.

As others have said, there's a chance your box will come damaged and the cage itself is a pain to put together. Both of my cages have some slight gaps in places where things just weren't lining up correctly, but the gaps are more cosmetic than anything. They don't affect the stability of the cage and the rats can't get out of them or anything like that. It just looks sort of shoddy. (Another reason I removed one star.)

Overall though, I've been extremely happy with my purchase. I've owned one of these DCNs for close to a year now so I can say with complete certainty that they're built to last.oddy. (Another reason I removed one star.)

His incredibly toxic farts have drastically improved; i.e. they've become non-existent, thanks be to Heaven! He even scampers like a young puppy when he runs and plays! I don't know if this result will happen for every dog (though I hope so) but I'm completely sold. (I ingest plenty of probiotic yogurt but have been inspired to buy probiotic pills for myself!) Lastly, I was surprised my picky dog ate these tablets straight up. No pill pockets were required; I offered it to him as if it was a special training treat. Then again, he was probably starving.  He's gone through the entire bottle so I got the exact same brand but non-chewable this time. It takes a lot less tablets required for his weight and it's cheaper too. Will try sprinkling over his food and see what happens.  -UPDATE-  Love the capsuled version. Lasts longer because less is required for bigger dogs. I just open the capsules and sprinkle into his cold or room-temperature food.  (Heated or warm food seems to kill the potency.) Same great results!  Also my new little rescue has also responded favorably to VetriScience probiotics. She's never had pooping or gas issues but her scratching has noticeably subsided. Thumbs up.

1) Packed water and Java Moss: While the shrimp are well packed and insulated, I never recommend adding water from another's tank into your own tank. 'Shrimp water' can be messy (that is the nature of the growing environment). My recommendation is to place the newly acquired shrimp and water in a separate container. Gradually add your own tank's water to that container, acclimating your newly acquired shrimp. After the acclimation period, seine the shrimp and add to your tank. Throw the water and debris away.
2) German Blue Dwarf Ram Cichlids (also known as Ramirezi Cichlids, Ram Cichlids, Butterfly Cichlids, and a host of Latin names): These Rams are one of the smallest Cichlid species available - You will see from my video that they are not much bigger than Amano shrimp. While I never observed my German Blue Rams hunting the shrimp, they are aggressive when nesting, and have attacked my hand while cleaning around their eggs/young. Caution is advised, and loss of shrimp to nesting Cichlids is never the fault of the breeder.
3) One inch and larger Amano shrimp: Not true. I never observed anything larger than one inch. I hope this is corrected by InvertObsession. Unless this is corrected, one could deduct one star.

review_body:
I bought this product because I have a 6 pound toy poodle service dog. I wanted something that could safely secure him on rides at Disneyland. There are a fair amount of rides that service dogs are allowed to ride with their handlers and I wanted a way to keep him safe on those rides. The quality is great and it is very affordable. I used to have a similar product to help carry my service dog in stores. Since one of his signals to me that I need to rest is to refuse to let me move, I often have to carry him from where he signalled me to where I can sit down. Try leaving your pet in it for small increments of time and slowly increase that time according to your pet's comfort level. Be sure to reward your dog for settling into it. Even if your reward is just love and affection it helps to make this strange experience a happy one. I tested this one out several times on my dog for 5-15 minutes at a time and I could tell he was a little ansy about it. Then I waited till he was absolutely exhausted one evening, but still determined to lie in my lap while I tried to type. He didn't like it at first, but when he realized that he could stay laying against me without being moved constantly he settled right in. He fell asleep and stayed there over an hour without a complaint. review_headline: well, it can suck the shell right off your turtle if your not carful:) keeps tank clean for months!!!
review_body: This has its pros and cons, over all its mostly positive. I have a turtle with a shell that's 8in long by 7in wide x 13in girth that lives in a 150 gal tank. He can eat and poop all he wants and this filter works great!!! WARNING!!! keep the strainer on the intake tube!!! I still have nightmares that it was his poor little head that got caught. I did have to buy extensions pips from a pet shop to turtle-fy the intake and outtake tubing to work for a turtle (since a turtle needs their water line much lower than fish) I had to cut the outtake tube in order to make it work; then used strong twist-ties to hold the pips together. Oh, The parts to this filter is so much cheaper to buy than most! here is the link to the marineland website: [...] (they have parts for all sizes of this filter, this link brings you to the c-530 filter parts) oh, one thing that is a con, is on the c-530 the primmer button does not work. So if you don't have to disconnect the intake and outtake tubing (where air gets into the pips) don't do it! If you end up with air in the pips, there is a trick of one person hitting the priming button while another person cover's the opening to the outtake tub ( if done right, this allows for enough succession to let water in and air out) hope this helps!

product_title: LupinePet Originals 1/2" Dapper Dog Step In Dog Harness
review_body:
My family and I adopted a puppy last November that was a shih tzu mix. He was tiny when we got him, and we had a lot of trouble finding a harness that would fit him. We bought the harnesses at Target and Petco for a extra small dog, but they still didn't fit right.

A friend of ours recommended trying a Lupine harness. I looked into it and liked that there were several different buckles to adjust the fit. I was hopeful we could take this harness and tighten it to fit our tiny puppy but also expand it to keep up with him as he grew. I placed the order in January. It fit much better than any other harness we had tried. True, it was still a little bit big on him even when we adjusted it to its smallest setting. But the design of the harness made it much less likely that our dog would slip out of it as easily as he had some of the other harnesses we tried. It was also relatively easy to put on a squirming puppy.

It is now June. Our puppy has more than doubled in size, and the harness still fits him well. We use it daily, and the harness has been exposed to the brutal chill of a North Dakota winter as well as the wear and tear of being worn by a playful puppy. We have been very happy with the quality and performance of the harness.

I noticed this past weekend that one of the straps was tearing. I contacted Lupine this morning about it. The associates I spoke with were friendly and helpful, and they are sending a replacement harness out to us. The Lupine guarantee works, and there isn't a lot of hoops to jump through to get it.

If you have a puppy or a small dog, I highly recommend this harness and this company. You can rest assured that if anything ever happens to the harness, it can be replaced easily.

product_title: Hill's Science Diet Adult Perfect Weight Dry Cat Food
review_body:
As a Vine reviewer, I have 30 days to review products for Vine. Because of this, I will have to update this review to let you know if my cats maintain or lose weight.

If you have seen my other cat food reviews, you will know I am experimenting with lots of food now. I have two cats, both 12 years old. One is male and the other female. My female is six months older, has had a litter of kittens and tends to be overweight, but at a consistent weight. She also cannot tolerate food with fillers anymore. She has developed a sensitive digestive tract. My male cat is finicky and only like foods like Fancy Feast(kitty fast food)which are now banned from our house. So trying to find a food for both as they age has been a challenge.

In our house we have canned and dry. Canned helps give cats water that they need and in our case, the protein they need. Dry helps with teeth cleaning and maintenance and is kept out all day. It has become more important to give my older cats more protein but too much will force them on an Atkins type diet.

With all of the above said, this dry food seems like the perfect balance between carbs and protein. My male cat adores this and eats this up. It is still unclear how my female cat feels about this.

The jury is still out on how this will manage to keep my two very different cats at their "perfect weight." It has less fillers than most dry cat food, which is a plus. The four stars given is because my cats adapted well to this.

product_title: PetSafe Wall Entry Aluminum Pet Door with Telescoping Tunnel, Taupe and White
review_body: When it says Aluminum I expected the thing to be made of aluminum.  Look at the picture - the only aluminum is the white frame that holds the door flap.  The rest is plastic that is so thin it won't hold its shape.  Careful when you tighten the screws or you'll distort the part that holds the tunnel to the house.  No thought was given to the tunnel as it is not really different enough sizes to slide together without distorting.  I had to add 2-3 screws to each side to keep it from bulging out resulting in the door flap(s) hanging partially open.  Then I put duct tape over it because the screws each created small bulges.  Also, do you want insects crawling in though the gaps in the plastic frame?  Be sure to get thick foam weatherstripping because it warps and doesn't make a firm seal to your house.  Also, when you finally get it installed, look at each corner and there is a big opening directly to the outside and inside that you also better fill.  Either with your weather stripping or better yet, a can of foam crack filler.  you've got 8 corners to address so don't miss them.  I wasn't supplied the locater template to easily transfer the center of the hold to the outside of my wall.  BTW, this thing installs so low that I felt like I was standing on my head to do half of this work. My last complaint is that the gap between the small and medium is too big.  The small is not quite big enough for my dog and the medium is way too big.  I feel like I've compromised the security of my home.  All in all, for the materials, this is a very expensive dog door, but then again, all of them are.

product_title: Vetri-Science Laboratories Glyco-Flex III Bite-Sized Dog Chews
review_body:
My 14 year old Husky has the spirit of a puppy, but between the natural aging process and pulling a ligament in her rear leg a few years ago (she's healed but it's still a bit stiff at times), her body wasn't keeping up. Her Vet prescribed her Rimadyl, but I decided to go the glucosamine route first and see if it helped. I initially bought a different kind, and I'll never know if they worked because my dog wouldn't eat them. I saw the great reviews for these, and I figured it was worth a try.

To be clear, Nikki's case was not extreme. Just mild to moderate arthritis. Sort of slow to get up, wouldn't go up the stairs to the deck (one of her favorite spots), during the end of walks she'd occasionally favor her previously injured leg.

She's been taking these for 3 months (one chew twice a day) and I've seen a HUGE improvement! She is much more spry, runs and jumps around like she used to, stairs are no problem, and I haven't seen her leg bother her for quite some time. A big plus is that she eats them. And she's picky! I don't have to mash them up and disguise them in a treat. She's been wanting to run when we go for walks, and when we aren't out for a walk, she wants to be. I can't keep up with her energy lately, but it's wonderful to see!

product_title: Omega Paw Self-Cleaning Litter Box, Pewter
review_headline: Kind of As Advertised, Not Great
review_body: I have two small cats and I got the large box -- I also have a Petmate hooded large box and keep both boxes going.  For me, I found that you have to have a lot of real estate with this Omega Paw box.  The pictures show that you just have to roll it on its side, but I have to practically roll it completely onto the top in order to get the waste into the pull-out tray.  Then I have to roll it all the way back the other way, almost onto its top, in order for the litter to get back in place.  This means that I need to have a space at least 6+ ft clear to roll it both ways if I don't want to drag it around.  Also, because of the screen, the cats actually have not a lot of room to do their business, so they tend to mess on the plastic and I find that they kick out a lot more litter than they do with the Petmate box which sits right next to it.  That means that I end up taking off the top off the box to clean the mess and pour back the litter they've kicked out.  At that point, I might as well go ahead and scoop out the litter since I have to do it with the Petmate box anyway.  So I'm thinking of taking out the screen assembly and just using it as a hooded litter box.  The box does not have a place for a filter like other large litter boxes I've used so I'm not sure why they advertise that it controls odor.  It may be great for some people but for me it's just meh.

I love it when something actually turns out exactly as advertised. I feel like it happens so rarely. As soon as I pulled this ball out of the shipping box, my malinois pup pounced on it. He's in the middle of teething so he has very little interest in hard rubber balls or tennis balls.

This ball is probably just a bit bigger than the size of his skull, but he can grab onto one of the ridges, or because it's soft enough, wrap his jaw around it and compress it down. He seems to enjoy doing right next to my head again and again, so it squeaks and whistles in my ear. The squeaking isn't bad. It's not like the standard squeaker that comes in every stuffed toy, it's more of a muted whistling sound when the dog compresses the whole ball.

So far, he hasn't been able to puncture it or do any damage to it. It's self satisfying enough that I can take a break from constantly watching or playing with him and just occasionally toss the ball when he brings it over my way.

It's a higher value toy than his holy roller ball. Here's to hoping it'll last longer than a few days!

My Chihuahua has IBS and had stool consisting of blood and mucous. I came upon this product in a blog I was reading and the writer had such great things to say about it I thought "Why not? It can't hurt" Let me say that within 2 days my little girl was no longer having gastric issues and hasn't since.

I sprinkle about 1/4 teaspoon of the enzymes per cup of dog food and she eats it right up. Her tummy is happy and I'm happy! My two other Chihuahuas enjoy it as well. Their stool is consistent and not as smelly as it usually was. And they're also not as 'gassy' as they were before they started.

Highly recommended to anyone who has a pet with IBS or just wants to balance out their intestinal flora. :)

product_title: Marineland LED Light Hood
review_headline: This hood is AWESOME and a GREAT price.
review_body:
I didn't want to spent a lot of money on a hood as I'm no professional at fish keeping and I was upgrading to a bigger tank thanks to a free 30 gallon I received from someone. I was a little nervous that I'd get a crappy item by not spending a lot of money, but this hood is AWESOME. The black part was actually really cheap and flimsy looking when I took it out of the box, but this made it actually less obvious once it was on the tank instead of standing out like some of the more solid hoods do. It does not seem like it will break easily, at least if you keep it on the tank. I love how it fits on using a hinge that snaps onto the tank... it can be raised and lowered easily so you're raising the whole hood instead of just a tiny opening. My prior tank's hood had only a small opening and I always was having to pull the whole hood off to clean the tank or to put fish in. What a pain.

I'm using a canister filter so the size of the opening in the back wasn't a big deal to me; it's a smaller size opening (I think it'd fit most filters fine though) which reviewers complained about, but the hood also has an area that can be easily cut away if you need to expand for a bigger filter. Instructions to put this hood together were a little unnecessarily complicated... it's easier to put together than it sounds when they describe it. I was staring at the instructions wondering if I was doing something wrong because it looked VERY easy/self explanatory to put together (and it was).

The absolute best part of this filter is that it has a switch for ON, OFF, and a NIGHT feature. This looks so AWESOME. I've never had an LED light for a fish tank, but it just looks so gorgeous. Combined with how clear my canister filter is making the water look, I'm really happy we upgraded to a bigger tank and new equipment. I can't link my website via the review, but I'm going to be putting up some pictures on it soon if you'd like to see the hood setup (I wish Amazon still allowed pictures to be posted).

product_title: Nature's Miracle Disposable Litter Box
review_body:
One of my least favorite parts of having cats is the routine emptying out, washing and refilling the litter boxes that should take place at least once a month. I have three litter boxes so it can take a good chunk of my time away.

I was afraid that a disposable box would be too flimsy or that pee would soak through, but that is not the case with these. In fact, one of my cats sits on the edge of the box with all four paws, sticks his bum over the side and pees into the corner. I've never seen any soakage, nor has the edge broken or buckled under his full weight.

When it comes time to replace the litter, I just put this whole thing into a trash bag. No more dumping the litter while holding my breath or breaking my back from washing them out in the tub.

One thing I wanted to note was that even with the Jumbo boxes, the walls aren't super high. One of my cats is a litter flinger, so what I did was place this inside of a large cardboard box and cut down a side for the cats to step in. That way the litter gets flung into the cardboard box and not my carpets.

product_title: Aqueon Versa-Top Hinged Glass Aquarium Tops
review_headline: Great addition to my tank aesthetic appeal!
review_body:
There's nothing more annoying than a huge hunk of cheap black plastic obstructing your total view of a gorgeous aquarium setup. With this Aqueon All Glass canopy, I've achieved an elegant aquarium without paying a fortune.

Inside the well packaged box are two panes of somewhat thick smooth edged glass, a brown pull emblazoned with Aqueon's emblem and an optional plastic guard running the length of the rear glass. Yes, you need to affix the pull to the product...this won't prove difficult or frustrating at all. Also, I strongly recommend integrating the rear plastic guard to prevent the onslaught of splashing water above the glass thereby leaving water deposits. Cutting the rear guard may prove an exercise in patience.

Now comes the the maintenance part. I've noticed within 24hrs a slight film of white residue from dried aquarium water will start to build up atop the glass. Not an issue if you spray the glass with vinegar/water and thoroughly rinse/dry before replacing it. I do this fairly easy routine during each and every weekly water change. Now I've heard that if you allow this build up to go unchecked for too long, then you'll need to use S.O.S pads,Mr. Clean eraser pads, and hot water to effectively expunge the water deposit build up.

I've coupled this glass canopy with a 30" Marineland led light fixture which rests above the top of the aquarium in front of my HOB filter. My only niggling problem is my Penguin 150 protrudes up against my led. So, whenever I lift the glass, I have to slightly and gently pull it forward in order for it to rest against the led fixture during feedings. Afterwards I notice the glass will not return to its original position without a little correction. This has absolutely nothing to do with the product, it's just the nature of my personal setup. I'm merely sharing this as a precaution to anyone with a 29L tank with a HOB.

All in all, I'm not unhappy with this purchase. I fully expected the glass to be somewhat medium maintenance; but then again all aquariums require diligence for optimal results. I will certainly purchase this for my next tank!

product_title: First Alert Bark Genie Automatic Bark Control Device
review_body:

For the most part our animals are spoiled rotten....in fact friends are always commenting that if there is such a thing as reincarnation, they want to come back as one of our pets (dog). The trouble is though, that they love to bark and announce any delivery, any squirrel in the back yard, anyone who has the nerve to walk their dog past the front of our house (in the street), anybody that rings the doorbell.....we even have one dog that runs to the television to bark if he recognizes the music of a commercial that has an animal appearing in it. There is often times LOTS of barking around our house.

Yesterday morning, my wife received a shipment of two of these devices. We have one on the credenza in the living room and one on a high counter in the kitchen. Oddly enough, the three dogs bark, dance and carry on when we're preparing their breakfasts and suppers.

I opened the packages.....put the 9 volt battery in each.....tested each.....then set each on LOW. DAMN!!! Within MINUTES all the boys knew something was going on. They picked up very quickly on the connection between their barking and not barking.

THESE THINGS ARE LIKE A MIRACLE! Our home is so quiet now.....IT IS INCREDIBLE! I don't know what they're charging for these things across the country.....but my wife told me that she paid $39.95 for each of them.....I saw a price someplace on the "net" here that said $172.00......All I know is that our dogs are aware of their behavior now and how it can be controlled. We're going to run these devices for a couple weeks straight.....and then we will turn them off for a day and see if they've been "re-adapted".

Right now though......I'm of, as if my wife, the opinion that these things can't be beat!!

product_title: Queen City Animals 57 mg Nitenpyram Beef Flavored Flea Killing Capsules for Dogs Over 25 Pounds. 14 Count. The Same Active Ingredient As the Major National Brand. (Not for Little Dogs)
review_body:
I have two housecats and feed several strays. Last year fleas were a problem so I started treating my cats with lufeneron and nitenpyram. At least 6 months have passed since I used any kind of flea control, still no fleas! Here's how I did it:

A flea can hatch and grow to adult up to 6 months after the egg was laid. For this reason wiping out your local flea population will take 6 months under ideal conditions. I took the capsules apart and mixed the powder into dry and canned food. I was feeding about 8 cats, so I figured capsules meant for large dogs would work (but first I checked to make sure the ingredients are the same as for cats, only the amount was different). I used lufeneron and nitenpyram twice a month for 6 months; regardless whether I saw any fleas. That way if an egg hatched, the new flea would bite a treated cat and die (nitenpyram). If a pregnant flea bit a cat the eggs would be damaged (lufeneron). After 6 months of treatment there were no fleas or eggs left to repopulate. And the strays were killing fleas wherever they went. Also, flies eating the leftovers died!

review_body: It works and was easy to install in my 2007 subaru forester, but you can't leave it on and easily fold down seats - nearly broke it by doing this. Probably easier to just remove it if you plan to fold the seats down to utilize the cargo space of the vehicle in this manner.

product_title: Best Friends by Sheri 2-in-1 Pet House Sofa in Zoo
review_body:
My dogs really likes these types of pop-up houses. We have bought 3 in the pass and they last for about 4 - 6 months. The liquidation store ran out and did not know when they will be getting more at the time. I decided to buy a better quality one. Less then 1 month the material came apart along the stitching around the door.

Will not order this product again and will stick to cheaper models as they seem to last longer.

product_title: Rocco & Roxie Professional Strength Stain & Odor Eliminator - Enzyme-Powered Pet Odor & Stain Remover for Dog and Cats Urine
review_body: After trying every main brand product on the market with little effect I decided to trust in Amazon community reviews. This stuff is amazing! I bought a black light to assist me in locating the pee stains and in one application they were all removed! After 1 hour black light shows no more stains and my house doesn't smell like a cat lives there. I already purchased more!

product_title: PetSafe Healthy Pet Gravity Dog and Cat Food Station, Stainless Steel Bowl, Holds Dry Dog or Cat Food
review_body: I purchased the PetSafe food dispenser for my two cats just prior to a week long vacation. I love it and so do my cats! Even my husband loves it and makes sure to fill it (2 x a month). I had to stop him recently so I could clean it first, he thinks it's great and likes to be sure the kitties are taken care of! It's sturdy, easy to fill from the top, and easy to clean as well. I also love that I no longer have to rush to fill bowls before I leave for work in the morning, or wonder as I drive away, "Did I give them food?" I highly recommend!

product_title: Reversible Paw Print Pet Bed in Blue & White Synthetic Fur for Dogs & Cats
review_headline: The dogs love it and it's super cute!
review_body: I purchased the 42x27 for my German Shepherds and they love taking naps on it! The blue w/pawprints design is very cute and it's thin enough to fit in most washers and dryers for easy cleaning. I love that it can also be used in a travel crate.

product_title: AquaIllumination Hydra LED Light for Aquarium
review_body: We have two lights above our 240 gallon saltwater tank. We think we will buy two more in the future. The light is exceptional and we will be able to add corals soon. You cannot control the settings without the remote. We currently have ours on a basic timer. When they come on they come on at the highest level which is not ideal. Also you have to order the hanging system otherwise there is no way to install them. I guess this gives you an option, but no sure this was so clear at time of purchase. The light itself is exceptional and added a whole new experience to our tank plus improving the bio activity.

product_title: Channel Weave 6 Pole Set
review_headline: Channel weaves are good beginning training.
review_body: I bought two sets to make 12 channel weaves.  This design works pretty well for a dog starting out, and my retriever learned to power through 12 straight weave poles in about a month from using this set.  The set falls apart too easily once the dog gains power and speed through the poles, and so I ended up using PVC pipe cement to hold together selected joints of the set up.  I would use this set again to train another dog.

product_title: Andis CeramicEdge Carbon-Infused Steel Pet Clipper Blade
review_body: Best blade on the market!!!!!!!!cut great!!!! Love them!!!!!get str8 to business!!!! Best fades I've seen yet!!!! Oster andis. Good blade.

product_title: SmartyKat Organic Catnip
review_body: I recently learned catnip only works on roughly 2/3 cats and this doesn't affect one of my house cats, but the others are just stoned and nipped out on this stuff. I had to hide it in a cabinet because the older outside cat would bite the bag open and roll around in it. Bad kitty.

product_title: Milkotein Dog Treat, Massive Bar
review_headline: Not for hard core chewers I like hoped.
review_body: I had high hopes for this chew. Unfortunately, my Chesapeakes were able to break off big chunks and some of them were pretty sharp. Sigh.

product_title: Hikari Tropical Algae Wafers for Bottom Feeding Herbivorous Fish Food
review_body: Only Algea wafers my pleco of 7 years will eat. He is over a foot long and gobbles it up quick.

product_title: Eagle Pack Natural Pet Food
review_headline: Premium dog food that dogs love to eat
review_body: My dogs--an elderly pug, a lab mix, and a Newfie--love this food. It's a four-star rated premium food, but my dogs don't know that. I've found in the past that they turned their noses up at other premium foods, evidently because the higher end foods don't have a lot of the nasty fillers that make the foods more palatable. The folks who make Eagle Pack must have found a way to make healthy ingredients taste yummy to dogs, because even the Newfie loves it, and he's the fussy one of the crew.

product_title: Vet Classics Stress Away Chew (60 tablets)
review_body: Did not make any noticeable difference in my dog during thunderstorm. She  continued to pant and pace all through the storm which lasted most of the night!

product_title: Fluval C Power Filter
review_body: Ok I have this filter on a 40 gallon tank. I've read the instructions and care. I use it properly and as instructed. Now that I have had this about 3-4 months, I have cleaned it twice because of the "low flow". Now I have to set it to "high" in order for it to filter "normally" when it is on low, it barely trickles out. I do NOT know what and why this is not efficient as it started. It looks nice but as others have reviewed (I agree), it doesn't last long. Only about 4 months of working properly. Again, I do not know what happened. There are no kids in my home to tamper with it, no animals, just me and my hubby (who doesn't mess with the tank). I do not recommend - take your chances. It may work for you but it didn't last long enough for me at all... Looking for a new one that is not a designer...

product_title: Catit Fresh & Clear Drinking Fountain for Cats and Puppies
review_body: After about 3 months the pump died completely. I cleaned the fountain regularly. I tried cleaning the pump out as thoroughly as I could. But it was a goner.

product_title: Plaque Off for Cats - Special Feline Formulation
review_body: Don't buy this product if you want to keep your cats healthy.  There are some serious side effects with this product. I lost a cat due to the use of this product.  Buyer Beware!

product_title: Sentry Good Behavior Stop That! Noise & Pheromone Spray for Dogs
review_headline: It only works on one of my dogs
review_body: I have a golden retriever and a maltipoo. The golden retriever stops dead in her tracks when I use the spray. But, the maltipoo (which is the reason I bought this product to begin with) doesn't even flinch. In fact, she plays with the can when I put it down.

product_title: PetSafe Pet Screen Door
review_headline: My dog uses it every day
review_body: Installation is incredibly easy, and I couldn't be happier. I can now open my sliding glass door just enough for my dog to get through this screen door, but not big enough for any fat burglar to break in (a really skinny burglar should be able to creep in, but someone that small couldn't carry off much).

product_title: Frequent Flyer Dog Fetch Toy Water Dock Hunting Agility Training
review_headline: Best Frisbee Flyer for a dog who eats regular frisbees in minutes
review_body: Our 1 year old German Shepard Asha loves playing Frisbee better than anything EXCEPT destroying Frisbees.  She can literally tear the center out in 5 minutes.  I have tried every brand and version available in stores and on the web.  This one is absolutely the best in terms of durability and flight.  Asha has had hers for longer than I remember and the only damage that she has managed is a quarter size tear in the area of the squeaker but she gave up on getting the squeaker out... it is still in there.  It is the best dog toy on the market today.

product_title: K&H Thermo-Kitty Mat
review_body: My elderly cat loves this mat. It's big enough that both cats can actually share it, as they've done a number of times.

product_title: Aiptasia-X Reef-safe Guaranteed Efficiency, 16.9-Ounce
review_headline: Great for maintenance but not a miracle cure
review_body: Kills aiptasia instantly. Do they stay gone? NO! As a regular maintenance program it works great but don't expect to never see another !

product_title: Hagen Catit Cat Litter Scoop Kitten Cat Toilet Pets Poo
review_body: this is really great for pellet-type litters and I've tried a lot of 'scoops' that don't work unless you're using a clumping litter.

product_title: Dublin Dog KOA Collection Waterproof Dog Collar, 10 Colors Available
review_body: My last collar from this company lasted almost two years. The collar can stay on during grooming.  The material does not absorb water and keeps the area around my dog's neck dry...love it and it looks cry stylish!

product_title: Purina Moist & Meaty Dog Food, Rise & Shine Awaken Bacon & Egg Flavor, 72-Ounce Box, Pack of 6
review_body: My small dog is a picky eater, and he LOVES this stuff! I took a gamble on this flavor, because my dog had previously only had the cheeseburger flavor. The price on this flavor is outstanding , and I will be reordering.

product_title: Road Refresher No Spill Portable Pet Bowl 54-Ounce
review_body: We take the three Whippets on the road in our Jeep. The older water bowel would splash water all over the back. This bowel is perfect, not a drop spilled. Holds a decent amount of water, certainly for a day trip in the car. Pretty ingenious design. I couldn't be happier with the product.

product_title: Nature's Miracle Oval Hooded Litter Box
review_body:
Works well! Contains the litter, my kitty uses it, what's not to like?

The only hard part is finding bags that will fit it.

product_title: KONG Genius Leo Dog Toy, Colors vary
review_body:
I guess I misread the specs. The package says large but for dogs like 30-45 lbs. That's not large. My dogs are pretty intense chewers, 2 black labs. Get the extreme if your dogs are intense chewers like mine.

My dogs loved it the first couple times, but by the third time they didn't waste time trying to fenagle the treats out, they just started tearing it apart.

Good for dogs who are not intense chewers or toy breeds.

product_title: API Panaview Aquarium Kit with LED Lighting and Power Filter, 5-Gallon
review_body:
I am currently exchanging this and hoping for a different outcome compared to the first one.

While I know that this is a low end tank/filter...I was expecting it to last a little longer without becoming filthy. I originally had a 3 gallon tank that had no filter. Yet the water got disgusting in less than a week with this tank that is 2 gallons bigger and has a filter.

I'm realistic and not expecting perfection...or the same quality of someone that had a high price/quality filter. But come on! Less than a week and I HAVE to change it. It wasn't just a little cloudy...it was bad. Even from one day to the next, the difference was astounding. It was getting cloudy (after just 3 days) and I thought I probably had a couple more days (still too short if this had been true)...but then HAD to do it that next day so my poor fish weren't in filth!!!

product_title: Cadet Duck Dog Treats, 2.5-Pounds
review_body: When one narrows the search for "duck jerky made in USA", this product comes up. Amazon should be ashamed of themselves for this marketing manoeuvre. When I bought the product, thinking it was "made in the USA", and peeled the price sticker off, guess what I found? "Made in China." I threw it out rather than take a chance. I have already lost two dogs to contaminated treats, and it is not going to happen again, my dogs loved the duck jerky, too, though that brand was "Waggin'Tails," also made in China. I would not buy this product under any circumstances. I note that some people say their dogs love it -they do, indeed, but two years later, watching your beloved pets die from kidney failure is not worth it. Believe me, I know.

product_title: Fresh News Post Consumer Paper Pellet Cat Litter
review_body: After trying many types of litter over the years, this one is it! No more messy tracking clumping litter. The dust from various clumping litter was causing respiratory problems for us and the cats. The large Fresh News pellets stay in the box and very little is tracked on the floor. Just scoop out the poop and stir the litter around to allow the urine to dry. No odor after almost a week and no dust!

product_title: Dog Waste Poop Bags, 300 Count Blue, by Bark+
review_body: Great product! We had been using old bags from the grocery store but they are so bad for the environment.  These are nice and sturdy, and are environmentally friendly.

product_title: Four Paws Grass Wire Rake Dog Scooper
review_body: I have two dogs that around 25-30 pounds or so, and they make plenty of messes in my back yard.  But cleanup is truly a breeze with this tool.  It's so simple.  Since you don't have the teeth that you see on some scoops. you don't get poop squished between the teeth.  (Sorry if that's TMI.  But it's an important feature for me.)  This scoop just slides right underneath the mess, and I drop it in a 2-gallon bucket that lined with a plastic grocery bag.  I've shown this scooper to a couple of friends, who also wanted it for their dogs.  And the price is definitely right.

product_title: Bergan 88142-P Elevated Double Bowl Feeder, Stainless Steel, .75-Quart
review_headline: Just the right height for our lab
review_body: The Bergan Elevated Feeder is easy to clean and is just the right height for our lab.  I can even set a separate water bowl underneath it for our cat - although I have seen him stand up and drink from the dog's water bowl.

product_title: OurPets Premium DuraPet Dog Bowl
review_body: Easy to clean. Dishwasher safe. Dog can't tear it apart. Stainless steel. My dog's opinion: "bark, arf, woof, woof." Guess she likes it.

product_title: CAT AMAZING - Best Interactive Cat Toy Ever! Treat Maze & Puzzle Feeder for Cats
review_body: The shipping was fast and the packaging adorable. Easy set up and kitties were instantly interested. One kitty stayed interested more than the other who prefers to use it as a seat. Would recommend putting toys inside too. The one who stayed interested has fun pulling her toys back out of the box as well. Would recommend as long as you have a curious and playful cat. Otherwise it may just be used as a fun seat by the lazier types :)

product_title: API Aquaview Corner Aquarium Kit with LED Lighting and Internal Power Filter, 2-1/2 Gallons
review_body:
I'm a fan of this tank for my male betta, but I did leave off the filter for everyday use. I'm glad to have it; one time I needed to filter out plant food that got out of control, so I just scooped out the betta, put on the filter (which was easy to use and assemble), waited for the water to clear, took off the filter, and dropped the betta back in. Happy fish :-)
There's plenty of space for plants, hide-away and for my betta to swim around. He seems bright and happy (which he was not at the pet-store when I bought him), and I enjoy watching him flit about. In my opinion, anything smaller than about 2 gallons is too small for a betta, so this tank is the perfect size. And I really like the little feeding hole at the top
The only possible down-side is that the shape is a little odd, but when I get a second betta, I plan to get another one of these tanks.

product_title: Busy Dog Treats  Busy Bone, Busy Rollhide, Busy Chewnola, Busy Dental, Pack of 12
review_body: My dog loves these chews, and we go through a lot of boxes.  Usually costs at least $4 a box at the store.  Cannot beat this deal!  Getting ready to reorder.

product_title: Tetra HT Submersible Aquarium Heater
review_headline: just plug it in a forget about it!
review_body: Nice heater for small tanks.  Preset heat so you don't have to worry about "boiling" or "freezing" your fish! Would recommend this heater for anyone with a small tropical fish tank.

product_title: PetSafe Bolt Interactive Laser Cat Toy
review_body: This device makes a lot of robotic noise when activated, and this distracts my cats, and irritates me :-)I'm sure there are people and cats that wouldn't blink an eye to the sounds it makes, but was just too loud in our peaceful home. I had to return it for this reason.

product_title: Original KITTY COT "World's BEST Cat Perch"
review_headline: Original Kitty Cot Cat Perch is AWESOME!
review_body: We have 2 kittens and I wanted to give them someplace to lay in the sun and check everything going on outside, so I decided on the Kitty Cot Cat Perch.  Years ago, I had a window perch that wasn't nearly as fancy or functional as this one.  The kittens LOVE it!  They both lay in it together (it's a pretty good size).  It was very easy to install and I haven't had any problems with it, it has remained right where I placed it from day one and those kittens jump to & from it, and wrestle on it, no problems.  It had a very mild "new" smell to it, but it dissapated within the first few days.  It's made with quality material and can be wiped clean very, very easily!!  I would definitely recommend this to anyone looking for a place for their cat (s) to hang out!!

product_title: Catit Design Senses Play Circuit, Original
review_body: This is a cool toy and my cat loves it but he has already lost the ball, he gets so wild that he got one of the covers off and the ball is missing in action ;)  But love it!

product_title: Litter Genie Plus Cat Litter Disposal System with Odor Free Pail System
review_headline: Litter scooping made so, so easy.
review_body:
I was one of those people who HATED scooping cat litter (I mean, who doesn't?) and would sulk to the litter box with my little plastic bags to start cleaning, then proceed to trek it to the garbage can outside so it didn't stink up the whole house.

Cue in the Litter Genie: an inventor's gift to every cat litter scooper hater. This thing makes litter life so much easier. It's a little confusing at first, but once you get the hang of it it's a piece of cake. The air tight compartment holds a decent amount of litter (I have one cat and can scoop about 3-4 times without having to change the bag) and doesn't smell one bit.

I would definitely recommend to anyone.

product_title: ANGELS' Eyes Arctic Blue Whitening Shampoo, 16-Ounce
review_body: I used it one time on both of my tiny dogs and they both itched like crazy for days until I re-washed them in the 5 in 1 Premium Dog Wash I still had left which whitens and conditions.  I threw out this Angels Eyes shampoo immediately.

product_title: Tuffy Desert Creatures Dog Toy
review_body:
This is the longest lasting Tuffy toy we have. We have a German Shepherd with strong jaws, and he loves the Tuffy spider. He tears apart any other brand of toy in minutes, but we have the Tuffy spider for months!

All Tuffy toys last a long time, but I think this one lasts the longest because of its thin legs. They don't have any stuffing in them to come out or much fabric to get punctured, even when he wants me to tug on it while he holds it in his mouth and makes it squeak. For whatever reason, this toy gets the five stars for its longevity and it's one of my GSD's favorite Tuffy toys!

product_title: Coolaroo Elevated Pet Bed Replacement Cover, Green
review_body: Bought the bed frame w/ cover about 6yrs. ago; the dogs(2) enjoyed so much it wore out, so needed this and now they're happy again!

product_title: Rocco & Roxie Gourmet Jerky Dog Treats - Slow Smoked, Delicious, Tender AND Healthy 6" Jerky Sticks - Choose Beef, Chicken or Turkey - 16 oz. Bag …
review_body: I have two dogs that I like to treat every now and then, so I bought these for a special treat  The first time I gave it to them they absolutely loved it and begged me for more.  They actually followed me around hoping to give them more.  Would recommend!

product_title: Bo-Lite 2" X 4 Yards Fiberglass Casting Tape / 5Pk
review_body: Good quality casting tape.  I've also used Altocast brand and this product seems slightly better quality.  This case of 5  2\\" rolls was the plenty to do my short leg cast for a broken ankle.  This tape is clear / white.  Would buy again.

product_title: Ade Advanced Optics Dual Scale 1.0 to 1.070 S.G. Salinity Refractometer for Aquarium & Seawater
review_body:
Easy to use and very accurate
Build quality seems pretty good and over all great value for money
1/3 the price of the ones at the LFS

product_title: Back to Basics Grain-Free Dry Dog Food
review_headline: good, but not best grain free dog food for the money
review_body:
I have a very large, very typical eat-anything-he-can senior citizen Labrador.
We generally feed him organic, grain-free products due to health issues.
I was pleased with the ingredients in this dog food.
The 4 pound bag is only about a weeks worth of food for our dog so it was hard to test it on him. By the time we did the slow intro most of the food was gone.
He had very very soft stools the entire time we fed him this. He ate it but didn't scarf it as he usually does. When presented two bowls of food--this and his usual food, he chose his usual food (for what that's worth).
I will note as a parent that this is a kind of unappealing kibble--pasty pale color doesn't \\"read\\" rich/nutritious (BUT, I don't want them adding coloring or artificial ingredients to make it look better either). I realize dogs don't care much about visual appeal, but my dog isn't the one buying the dog food!
We are used to paying ridiculous prices for dog food but this one comes in at about $2.50/pound for the larger bag. That is pushing our budget envelope. When all is said and done, I'm glad to have received a trial bag, I think it's a solid product, but not the best for the money.
I gave it one star for being made in USA, one for good ingredients, and one because my dog ate it.

product_title: Petnation Port-A-Crate E2 Indoor/Outdoor Pet Home
review_headline: Great Kennel, But be careful when ordering.
review_body: I had two of these.  My dog tore up the first one, so I ordered another one.  However he grew too fast, so I gave it away to the humane society, never used, brand new.  Here is the problem.  The description says for dogs up to 70lbs. That may be true if your dog is square.  I have a standard Poodle, only 50lbs, but quite long in the body.  He does not fit in the 36" crate.  Now he has a 48 " kennel....much better, and certainly more comfortable.  Warning - it greatly depends on your pet's body structure if this crate is the one you need.

product_title: KONG Teddy Bear Dog Toy
review_body: I liked that it didn't have any stuffing, made clean up a lot easier after my dog demolished it.  The toy lasted about an hour for a 55 lb lab that is a heavy chewer.  It gets a 3 because I bought 2 of them and gave one to a friends small dog.  They had theirs for a few months before it was too raggedy to keep.

product_title: Macs & Buddy Fresh Breath Mini Bones, 14-Ounce
review_body: These bones are super tiny. Only about an inch, so be careful if your dog would rather just swallow something that small. My dog really does like them. Her breath is better, but I also just bought a plaque rinse to add to her water.

product_title: KONG Tires Extreme Dog Toy
review_headline: My dog likes this pretty well. She wants to play tug of war ...
review_body: My dog likes this pretty well.  She wants to play tug of war with it and when her teeth grip one side and I hold onto the other...I have to hook my fingers over the hole to have a good enough grip to hold onto it...I worry a bit about her nipping my fingers when she adjusts her grip. So far no major issues, but it might be an issue with children. It would be nice if the whole were a bit larger.  It is a good chew tow and seems to be very durable.

product_title: Yeowww! Catnip Toy, Yellow Banana
review_body: Three bananas, three cats.  Perfect.  Nope.  They all love catnip on their scratchpads. The bananas?  Completely ignored.  They are not impressed.

product_title: Julius-K9 IDC Innova Dog Comfort Blue Belt Harness
review_body: my little dog had a hard time walking in it because the chest strap was slightly big but the girth was just right.  It is strong and lightweight for the summer

product_title: Catit Design Senses Speed Circuit
review_body: I bought this for my cat some month's ago and she never play'd with it,try'd sitting down with her to put her at ease, got her to push the cat toy ball once.So i just left it out for over 6 month's,now she finally play's with it,and dam near roll's her whole body over it.

product_title: Beefeaters Sweet Potato Chips
review_headline: Great natural snacks for my dogs
review_body: We order these treats over and over again, the dogs love them. The treats are always fresh and soft when we receive them. Wish they had smaller pieces as I have little dogs so I need to cut these in half. I do know there are sweet potato fries but those get caught in the back teeth of the tiny dogs mouth so cutting these smaller works great. Will buy again and again

product_title: K9 Immunity Plus for Dogs 30-70 Lbs, Liver & Fish Flavored Chews, 60 Wafers
review_headline: Great immune booster for dogs with Cancer
review_body: Great immune booster for dogs with Cancer. I highly recommend these for dogs with cancer. My dog is almost 15 and he's doing greatI also give my dog  wheatgrass pills (am), plus he's on raw, organic food.

product_title: Catit Cat Litter Pan with Rim, Taupe
review_body: Nice and big, holds in the litter even if your cat is messy.  I have 2 cats and 3 litter boxes, this one is the best.  I'm thinking of getting another of these and getting rid of the other 2 boxes.

product_title: EzyDog Doggy Flotation Device Dog Life Vest Jacket (DFD)
review_headline: Returning it. Worked well as DFD but dog was too uncomfortable
review_body:
We have been taking our two dogs kayaking and boating this season and as much as they love to swim, we got them life jackets so they wouldn't have to work as hard when swimming and as peace of mind in case they fell overboard. Bought this one and the Float Coat and unfortunately we are returning this one and getting two of the other.

Dog is a cattle dog mix and is on the short side length wise. The second strap secured under her belly and she refused to jump, lie down, sit; pretty much anything aside from standing and looking very pitiful and uncomfortable. The position of the handle was also awkward to pull her in the boat. It is too far back and requires too much reaching from the precarious position in a kayak.

It did float great and I felt she was safer in it, but the other life jacket is better from a comfort and ease of use standpoint.

product_title: Solvit Tagalong Pet Bicycle Basket
review_body: My pug/Pomeranian loves to go everywhere with me. He enjoys his new bike basket. We reinforced it with additional zip ties just to be on the safe side. Seems durable for a small dog.

product_title: Litter Robot LRII Automatic Self-Cleaning Litter Box
review_headline: had to get rid of my cats because fiancee was allergic but this was the best thing ever when I had them for a few weeks
review_body:
my fiancee ended up being allergic to these two beautiful savannah cats we had and I had to give them away after a few months. for the first two weeks, I could not stand dealing with the cat litter. for those of you who don't have cats yet, cleaning cat crap/piss is probably one of the top 3 things I hated in this world. imagine cleaning the most sour smelling pungent smell that permeates you through your pores when you are even holding your breath. As you sift through the litterbox for all the cat waste, all this dust comes up and you're absorbing the litter dust in your eyes and breathing it through your mouth (because you don't want to breath through your nose).

this robo litter solves all of these issues. it was a little tricky getting one of the kittens to go inside the litter robo litter at first (he crapped all over the floor) but I ultimately left the old litter box in the same room as the robo littler and move the old littler box closer and closer to the robo littler until I ultimately removed the old litter box.

so then there's the issue about the weight of the kittens. they were too light to trigger the robo litter, but all I would do is arbitrarily check to see if there was any cat waste in the robot litter and if there was any, I would just trigger the robot litter myself. It still beats sifting through the litter box with a rake.

finally, the company is legit. they let me return the litter box and refunded all my money when I had to give up my cats.

product_title: PetSafe Drinkwell Platinum Pet Fountain
review_body: Cat loves it and no longer begs for us to turn on the faucet in the tub.  Need to clean it pretty regularly to keep the slime away, but not a difficult task.

product_title: Exo Terra Snake Cave
review_body: My western hognose snake really loves this cave.  I wish they had an option that was a little smaller, but this one was perfect.  When he began to shed, the moss this cave included was instrumental in allowing him to shed without problems.  I just made sure to keep the moss moist, and the snake would go in often and soak in the humid environment.  He also sits on top to sun himself some of the time.  This was a good purchase.

product_title: Medium Heart Rhinestone Aluminum Dog Tag Clip
review_body:
This is easily the best tag clip I have found so far. I have Rubits of a different style, and then I bought this one to fancy up my chihuahua a bit. I clip it around the entire tiny collar to keep his tags from hanging too low. His previous pink Rubit is still pretty pink after several years of constant wear and beach trips.

I do wish the company would use a higher quality split ring. I think they have been cutting corners because the ring on my two Rubits purchased four years ago are still holding up fine, and the new one has almost fallen off. Fortunately, I prefer to keep all of my dog's tage on a single splt ring, and each individual tags came with its own so I have a small hoard of sturdy replacement rings.

Love the Rubit beyond words, but have to deduct a star because customers need to replace the split ring with a better one.

product_title: Odormute Unscented Deodorizing Powder
review_body:
Twenty five years ago my brother and I were hunting pheasants near Madelia MN when both dogs got sprayed by a skunk. My brother went into town to get some tomato juice but got directed to the couple that made Odor Mute right in town. We mixed up a strong batch and doused the dogs, waited 30 minutes, rinsed and repeat. It was cold out and we rode home with the dogs in the car and the windows rolled up.

The couple passed and the heirs didn't want to take over the business so it was sold to a chemical company. It's still the same great product. My current dog thinks his job is to rid the world of skunks. He kills one and brings it back to me every once in a while. Of course he gets hammered doing this. Odor Mute takes care of the problem.

But wait, there's more.

I had a tenant whose cats peed on the hardwood floor in a corner of the living room. It ran under the baseboard. I booted him and the cats out and treated the area with Odor Mute. It too ran under the baseboard to everywhere the cat pee went. The new tenant had cats and they used the litter box instead of the place the previous cats used.

I can not recommend this enough. Every dog owner should keep a box on hand for that encounter with a skunk. I have had a box in the glove box for years and the heat doesn't seem to degrade it. It's also great for landlords for cleaning up after tenants.

review_headline: Horrible product, made my cat SICK
review_body: To start, the concept of lightweight cat litter is a great idea. The positives stop there! After a few days of using this mess, my 16 yr old cat became deathly sick, with LOTS of blood in her stool, she was vomiting her food back up, and we actually thought she was dying. We didn't think about the cat litter being the problem until over a week of cleaning blood out of carpet, and when we realized she became sick after using this new litter, it clicked. She was acting weird, and kept pawing at the water in her bowl, which she never does... we think it was to try and clean the stuck pebbles off her paws. This stuff is so lightweight, it simply won't fall off! She was ingesting small amounts of the litter and dust. After 1 day of changing back to normal litter (not Tidy Cat, as I'm not giving them another dime of my money), she's healthy again, and acting normal. I'm dumbfounded that this didn't go through any real world testing, and if it did, how did people give this any kind of a good review. I can only think they must live in a dirty single wide trailer doing a review for a free product sample, and don't care that litter is EVERYWHERE. Terrible product. The End.

review_headline: 1000 times better than the plastic cones
review_body: We have a one year old sweet but stubborn pit bull that had a broken back leg, after surgery she was sent home with a huge plastc cone around her head that caught on corners, furniture, walls, etc that jerked her neck back every time.  She struggled to eat and drink with it on and couldnt sleep comfortably and was always trying to pry it off.  We tried the blow up life preservor type that fit her neck but didnt do anything to keep her from being able to reach and chew on the external fixator and pins holding her leg together.  We were frustrated and desperate. I read the description and reviews on the comfy cone and gave it a try.  Its perfect!  Its just big enough to keep her from reaching around and chewing but doesnt get caught on everything.  When it does occasionally get caught it folds back just enough without jerking her neck and springs right back.  Its very durable and padded enough that she has never tried to pry it off and seems to not bother her at all even while sleeping.  She eats and drinks  just fine with it on and it doesnt get her confused like the clear plastic that she can see through.  The velcro is extremely strong and doesnt come off until you take it off.  Did I mention shes a stubborn pit bull, and this thing is holding up great.  It doesnt make noise like the plastic cone, doesnt slide off, its very easy to put on and take off unlike the plastic.  Study the size charts and make sure your using the correct measurements.  Comfy Cone measures the size by the Diameter of the dogs neck, wheras most dog collars are measured by circumference.  Take off your pets collar and restrap it while laying it on a table then measure it across the center then use google to convert inches to centineters and presto, order your comfy cone to the nearest size.

review_body: I have two cats:  a lovely, sweet tempered, 6 year old Russian Blue named Dexter, and a bratty, affectionate, hyper 9 month old teenager named Woochi.  Ever since Woochi came home with me 4 months ago, he's tried to assert dominance over Dexter (the true alpha).  I let them bicker it out until a month ago, when Dexter had a life-threatening health scare and was hospitalized for a week.  He came home in no shape to defend himself.  I asked the vet what to do, since Dexter had a serious road to recovery ahead and I was tired of seeing Woochi pick on him.  My vet recommended Feliway, and I laughed when she said the word pheromones.  I replied, "Pheromones.  Really.  This isn't 1979."  But I was desperate, and Dexter was coming home the next day.  So I ordered this from Amazon, and the bickering came to a halt.  Immediately.  I read tons of Amazon reviews, and for some homes it took a while, and for others it didn't work at all.  When seeing how calm Woochi became, at first I attributed it to maybe he could sense Dexter wasn't feeling well.  But as Dexter recovered, the harmony remained.  Over the past two weeks, I've found them sleeping together in a ball on the sofa when I've come home from work.  Woochi's bratty, annoying behavior was going on for months, to the extent that Dexter stopped sleeping next to me (his usual spot) in bed.  The improvement from Feliway was so fast that I can't pinpoint when it started, exactly.  But both boys are calm, affectionate, playful, balanced, and act more like littermates than rivals now.  The discord in my home wasn't as bad as most, but I needed harmony at a critical time, which Feliway provided.  5 stars for a great product and 1970's hippy trippy science.

review_body:
My cats love Stella and Chewy's. I can't say enough nice things about the product. I feel good giving it to them and they love it.
I suggest buying it from anyone other than this particular third party seller.
It's been a few months since my order-turned-huge-debacle, but since I'm on Amazon looking for the same product again, I thought I'd leave a review to help others avoid the headache that I had.
As an animal lover, a quick google search would have alerted me to their hideous reputation. Beyond their bad customer service and general reputation as bad guys, the allegations (hundreds of them) made about their "puppy business" is enough to turn your stomach. While we may never being able to seek out all the animal-abusers out there, trying to avoid supporting them with our business is an easy first step.
In my case, it wasn't until I encountered what appeared to be the shadiest scam that I happened to find the wealth of complaints about them online. I asked Amazon to look into them and reconsider them as a vendor. I ordered this case of 24 individual 0.8 oz packets and received 1 0.8 oz packet. A single packet for $48.52? It was clearly labelled $1.99 from the store. Thinking this was an easily remedied misunderstanding, I contacted World of Pups to explain. It took ultimately about 20 emails exchanged, 3 phone calls, 2 attempts by Amazon to intercede, but I finally got my refund almost 2 months later. In the course of the most frustrating arguments, via email and phone with these jerks-- I started reading what an entire neighborhood in Brooklyn and countless customers have known for years. They are not good dudes. You're better off finding Stella and Chewy's somewhere else.

product_title: FURminator deShedding Tool for Cats

review_body: All my cats like this cat tower.  I purchased 2, one I stained and it turned out perfectley.  If I could change one thing I would make it 1 or two levels higher, just because my cats like it up high.  Thank you.

product_title: Purina Fancy Feast Grilled Gourmet Variety Pack Wet Cat Food - (24) 3 oz. Cans
review_body: Our cats are 13 years old and are so excited at dinner time when the can of Fancy Feast is opened...they stand at their bowls at the same time every night and meow for their Fancy Feast. Amazon makes its so convenient. We live in the tropical jungle in Hana, Hawaii - about 2 hours each way from town - so shopping is a full day trip. product_title: Precious Cat Ultra Premium Clumping Cat Litter
review_body: I am still trying to figure out how this company is able to create an unscented litter that absorbs odors so well. I have four cats and two litter boxes, but you'd never know it. I only have to clean the litter a couple times a week! GREAT product. I'm a huge fan!

product_title: Oster ECS Hoof Pick
review_body: The hook part of this hoof pick bent out and partially lost its shape after only a few uses.  It's still usable but not as efficient.  Other than that, the handle is comfortable.  My other Oster hoof pick has held up much better for some reason, so I was a bit disappointed.

product_title: New Life Spectrum Freshwater Flakes w/Garlic - 45 g
review_headline: AWESOME FOOD!!! I WILL NEVER FEED ANY OTHER FLAKE FOOD AGAIN!!!
review_body: This food is the BEST that I have ever used. I've had tanks on and off for 15 years and have tired about every flake food there is. I like the fact that it crumbles very easily, since I have a lot of schooling fish with small mouths. New Life website states to feed exclusively for 10 days and you will see a difference. It's been 14 and all I can say is WOW!  I have Cardinal Tetras and others. But the Cardinals are amazing now. Their blue streaks absolutely glow and the red on their bellies is absolutely blood red. I also have Angels. They will come up to the front glass and wait for me to put it in. My fish go after this food like they have not eaten in days. It doesn't matter, I can feed them, then 30 minutes later feed them again and you would think I didn't feed them at all. I have some fish that usually stay near the bottom and wait for the food to drift down. When I feed now a lot of them come to the surface to eat. This stuff is GREAT! I'LL NEVER BUY ANY OTHER BRAND AGAIN!!!

product_title: Bag Balm Ointment, 8 Ounce
review_body: I've suffered from cracked hands most of my adult life assuming it was from working with my hands in the garage. Read about this stuff, Bag Balm, on an automotive forum and thought I would try it out. Viola, no more cracked and bleeding hands!!!!!!

product_title: RC Pet Products Training Martingale Dog Collar
review_headline: Beautiful material, but not true to size
review_body: This collar is put together very nicely, it just is a bit larger than the standard martingale collar due to the length of the chain. I would order this collar again, just a size smaller.

product_title: Alfie Pet by Petoga Couture - Chico Reversible Pet Sling Carrier
review_body: I got this as we have 3 Shih Tzu pups I like to walk.  Our oldest has health issues that make walking a good distance impossible.  I take her for a walk in the park and let her walk as much as she is able and then I scoop her up into this carrier and continue on with our walk.  She still gets to be outside...which she loves...and I still get to walk.  She weighs just over 15 lbs., yet the carrier works well for us.  I carry her to the front and put my hand around her neck to make sure she isn't positioned in a way that stresses her in any way.  When I take the younger pups I still take the carrier and find it's a good place to stash stuff or a tired younger pup if I  need to do so...The fabric is of very good quality...It is sturdy...very well made...Highly recommend.

product_title: Go Pet Club Cat Condo, 67-Inch, Brown
review_body: I love the way this looks, and the houses are great and everything, but our one kitten (very BIG kitten!) jumps from the one tower to this one, and the whole thing almost crashes into the wall every time. We've put wedges under the far end, but they're not helping much. I think it's partly him being so huge, and partly the base of this tower isn't very wide to be holding everything it's holding. The tower we have sitting next to this one is completely stable, and doesn't move at all, and the base is monstrous. I would recommend steering clear of this, unless you have really lightweight cats who aren't quite so flying squirrel-like :)

product_title: Outward Hound Kyjen  2869 Slo-Bowl Slow Feeder Slow Feed Interactive Bloat Stop Dog Bowl, Large, Grey
review_headline: Bowl is great, just a little to deep for my dog.
review_body: Bowl is great, just a little to deep for my dog.  I have a boxer, and the bowl is just a tab bit too deep. review_body: I love it so much! Only down side its a little short. Other then that its pretty amazing. Its so nice that my boyfriend doesn't mind pushing it around the store.

product_title: Small Pet Select 2nd Cutting "Perfect Blend" Timothy Hay Pet Food

Very little hay dust at the bottom. Quick shipping. I love that it is sold through Amazon Prime. I will definitely stick with this hay.

product_title: Coastal Pet Products DCP6310RED 3/8-Inch Nylon Check Choke Collar for Dogs, X-Small, Red
review_body: My chihuahua does not know how to walk on a leash (I'm sure it's my fault for not teaching him right when he was a puppy).  Even though he only weighs 5 lbs, it still gets tiresome when he's pulling with all his strength.  With this collar, his pulling is decreased.  My only complaint is that it doesn't have a snap opening, so every time we use it, we have to readjust it after putting it on him, and it's kind of a pain doing that every time.

review_body: If you're thinking about purchasing this consider it thoroughly. I had to dispose of mine within a few weeks because my dog developed the ability to hop up of it. It's all worked out in the end.

product_title: GREENIES Original TEENIE Dog Dental Chews Dog Treats
review_body: My dogs love them and enjoy their after breakfast treat daily.  I found this box the best value and it comes with 2 pouches to keep them fresh and for easy storage.

product_title: Jolly Pets Tug-n-Toss - Heavy Duty Chew Ball w/ Handle
review_body: It is difficult to find appropriate toys for giant breed dogs, that being said this thing is perfect.  Durable enough to withstand my dog jumping on it, chewing it, whatever.  I don't let him alone with it to chew on- as it's not meant for that sort of thing but he will romp around with it, toss it in the air and roll it around with his nose.  I think next time I will try the one without the handle to give him a different play style as he mostly runas around carrying it by the handle.  Doesn't deflate, bounces - awesome. I haven't had an issue with the handle being destroyed as others have mentioned, but like I said, I don't leave him out alone with it as a chew toy.

product_title: Bergan Gourmet
review_body: Simple but effective... doesn't require any assembly and its worked fine. Only isse is the base for the food comes off easy when you fill it so be careful it doesn't spill out...

product_title: TEMPTATIONS Middles Cat Treats
review_body:
I have tried multiple flavors and they all have the same problem: They are a little too hard.

The cat seems to like these once she gets them cracked open, but I noticed that she used to try to eat them right away, whereas now she lets them sit several hours until they become stale and more brittle. My assumption is that she got sick of fighting to crunch them up (it was a process) and now lets them get to the point where they can be broken more easily. The cat seems to enjoy the flavor and does lick them repeatedly before she lets them \\"simmer\\" but I worry about why she won't eat them right away. She doesn't have this problem with her dry cat food or any other treats I have given her.

PS. She let the cheesy ones sit longer than usual.

UPDATE: I had my cat's teeth checked out and there was nothing wrong with them. However, she was only 6 months old at the time and I figure maybe she was still teething a bit. At any rate, she eats them gladly now, so I added a star to my original review.

review_body: We bought this to put in one of our garden beds in memory of our wonderful dog.  It's a nice weight, and I think it will look great in the garden.

product_title: Dr. Elsey's Cat Attract Cat Litter
review_body: We have two cats and one is getting a little older, and she stopped reliably using the litter box (and chose the floor instead). product_title: KONG Wobbler Treat Dispensing Dog Toy

review_body: Bought for a 3 month old Golden Doodle who inhales his food. It is too difficult for him even when he's really hungry. product_title: Hill's Ideal Balance Slim & Healthy Natural Chicken & Barley Recipe Adult Dry Dog Food
review_headline: Dogs love it and it seems healthy too
review_body: I work in the veterinary field and am pretty picky with what I feed my animals.  Since I usually feed them Hills Science Diet, and this was made by Hills, I thought I'd give it a try.  Once I received it, I compared the ingredients to the normal food and found this to be much easier to understand.  But how would the dogs like it.  I mixed a little into their normal food and let them have it.  They ate it up pretty good so after doing that a couple of times, I decided to try just that food.  I've never seen them eat so fast. product_title: Sofantex Luxury Plush Cratewear Set, 3-Piece
review_body: I love how soft it feels and it fits perfectly. Recommend it to anyone looking to give their pup a comfortable crate environment.
