product_title: Nutramax 225-Mg Denosyl Chewable Tablets for Dogs (Discontinued by Manufacturer), 30 Count
review_body:
my dog was dying from a brain tumor we started these when he was pretty far along. I can not say for sure that they helped at all, but they did not hurt.

the active ingredient SAMe is supposed to help with brain and liver function. The benefit to this product over buying human supplements is that it is dosed correctly. The fact that they are in a chewable flavored tablet could be a plus or a minus depending on your situation. If I had a sick dog with liver disease I would not want to feed him anything with artificial flavorings etc. In that case I would have probably chosen the human supplement and divided it myself and mixed it with a real food treat like beechnut chicken baby food.

the chewable tabs were palatable and he never refused them. The tablets are scored and can be broken with your fingers I broke them into quarters and gave him all of them. He had trouble chewing and swallowing so that is why I divided them.

it was a pain to have to give this on an empty stomach but since it tasted good it was a treat to the dog.

I am not sorry I bought these. I bought them twice and he went through two bottles before he passed.

I hope that this review helps someone else and that the product helps your dog. For all I know it did give us a couple extra weeks, I will never know.

review_headline: No complaints, except that Amazon isn't the cheapest place you can find it...
review_body:
This container works as advertised.

A couple mild complaints that I wasn't misled about so I still gave it a solid rating but a consumer should be made aware of:

- I think my final price on this was $29-30. It's certainly worth that, but I found the exact same container on Groupon less than two weeks later for $22.

- The wheels slide in but don't appear to lock in place. Not a problem since I just keep it on the floor and wheel it anywhere it needs to go, but if you needed to lift it for anything, I assume the wheels would just slide right out.

- Be aware of the size. While the container holds 25 lbs., most bags of dog food are sold in 40 or 50 lb. increments so if you buy in bulk you're still going to be storing some dog food somewhere else.

- I wish that the small containers was on bottom or attached to the top so you could lift it when you opened the bigger lid. You're obviously going to use the 25 lb. container the most, so I have to remove the 10 lb. container off the top everytime I want to scoop food out of the 25 lb. tub. Obviously I could keep the 10 lb. container in another location but the intended point was for these two tubs to work together.

All of that said, this is suitable for what I needed and a good price for what you're getting. I would purchase again.

product_title: PetSafe indigo Fresh Dental Sticks Low-Calorie Oral Care Dog Treat
review_body:
I was a little put off at first at the list of ingredients. Things like blueberries aren't exactly what you would consider a normal part of a canine diet. But the results have been surprisingly effective at dealing with Chewy's bad breath. The ingredients list is almost spartan compared to Greenies and other commercial pet chews.

The only ingredients that sound scary are sodium hexametaphoshate (which is actually just a common preservative found in human foods like frozen desserts, salad dressing, ice cream, and even some toothpastes for the purpose of tartar prevention) and titanium dioxide (used as a pigment in toothpastes and sunblock, among other things). Some research has indicated that titanium dioxide CAN be toxic at very high doses, and as such as raised red flags with some of the whole health websites. However you would really need to feed your dog an entire bag a day for a year to get the kind of dosage that would in fact be potentially toxic.You just aren't going to hit the toxic level with normal feeding. I only mention it in this review because a Google search of the ingredient turns up some alarmist articles on some not-so-scientific "health" sites.

product_title: Anigen Canine Heartworm Antigen Test Kit (10 Tests)
review_body:
I want to revise my review. I've gotten to know the seller a bit since then. First off, I left this before I even gave the seller a chance to respond. The seller was very quick at getting back, and extremely helpful. I realize that we can't expect that every dog will react the same. My dog gets very stressed very easily and maybe if he was not like that, I wouldn't have been so stressed, the whole process might have gone faster and the few drops I did get might have \\"dropped\\" into the vile instead of being smeared into his fur. The seller was extremely quick to mail me out a new and improved kit free of charge with extra anti-coagulant. He explained that the lancet might work better on some dogs than others, but that he was inspired to change the lacet design for a smoother experience. In the meantime, He suggested using a clean tack with several pieces of paper towels folded and pushed onto it to shorten the length just a bit. I will update this review when I try that in the next few days. I will suggest that you prepare yourself. If your dog is nervous or wild, have several more people. One to hold the dog and keep it occupied maybe with peanut butter or something. Someone else to hold the leg your pricking so that if he/she kicks a lot the blood doesn't get smeared and someone to hold the vile that you will be dropping the blood into. I'd try pricking the foot once with the lancet provided, go deep. If you don't get enough blood with that, don't make the mistake I did and continue pricking over and over again!! Just go straight to the tack. Make sure you praise the dog the entire time. I suggest letting the blood drop right from the paw to the vile instead of the dropper, unless you are getting big wet drops. P.S. The seller also donates a portion of his sales to dog shelters. Also, this is a good alternative to costly vet bills,and the only option for some people. I hate to send people away when it may work for them. If it doesn't, I can promise you that the seller will stay in communication with you and do what he can to make sure that it does!!

First review: I can't believe these reviews!! The little micro lancet produces 100th of a drop of blood, which coagulates in seconds!! I had to jam my dog with that thing dozens of times and 45 minutes later, could still not get enough blood to actually drop into the vile...nevermind suck up into the dropper!!! I tried and tried and tried and my dog (a 15 lb. poodle mix is completely traumatized..as well as myself. I mean I was in tears! Needless to say, I didn't even get a chance to test the blood. Beware that pricking the dog by the hairline draws a bit more blood but is also absorbed by the fur quicker than you can blink...I even cut the hair around there to try and make it easier but still not enough blood. Mind you it doesn't help when your dog's legs are flailing. I just can't believe anyone was able to simply prick the dog, get a couple good big drops of blood to magically drop into the vile w/o the dog noticing. There's just no way! The dog would have to bleed a teaspoon of blood and that would take an exacto knife! Good Luck!

review_headline: My short-tailed possum wouldn't eat it, but it is a quality food.

I also tried a small bit with the gerbil, field mouse and hamster as treats just to not have the food go to waste. I did try mixing it with some baby food for the possum, because he does eat fruit sauce. It didn't work, he turned his little black nose up at it. They are notoriously picky.

review_body:

product_title: Durvet Nu-Stock Ointment, 12-Ounce
review_headline: Will update this as time goes on, but...
review_body:
So far, VERY promising. My BC mix has demodex, and has had flare ups since puppyhood. This last one has lasted months, and he is MISERABLE as he is allergic to the mange so it makes him horribly itchy as well.

We tried the tick collar chemical (a prescription one from the vet,) That helped a BIT, but it never completely cleared up. Tried letting his immune system kick it. That has done nothing in six months. Vet didn't want to try the Ivermectin until he's DNA tested since he's a herding breed, so have the kit to send - but hated the thought of MORE months of waiting. Tried the sulfur shampoo additive - and it gave some brief respite, but after 2 treatments, wasn't doing much.

I'm only on day 2 or 3 of this. I don't find the smell that horrible. I was expecting a rotten egg sulfurous reek from the other reviews. Instead, it reminds me of the very old formulas of liniment, algipan, or old old ben gay. It has that medicinal make your eyes water a bit smell. But to me, growing up with those, it's just not that horrid.

I started using it on his head, above eyes below ears - one of his itchier and balder areas from scratching. Itch relief has been INSTANT. I kid not. I have a comfortably snoozing, non scratching pup for the first time in months. And the red leeched out of the inflamed areas within a day. It dries to a slightly tacky yellowish coating, much like Algipan,. So it's not rubbing off on anything else after it dries.

I'll update this as time goes on - but so far I'm VERY pleased - even if it doesn't completely cure the demodex, knowing I can get him this kind of relief while we wait for the test and get the oral medication is a godsend.

Well, I bought this thing just cause I love buying stuff, and I've got to say it's pretty awesome.

2. press the button
3. Watch the "sludge" slowly drift up into the top compartment

product_title: UV Blacklight Flashlight Pet Urine Detector with 12 LED Ultra Violet Light - Find Dry Dog and Cat Stains on Carpets, Hard Floors & Paint - Alkaline AAA Batteries Included and Installed
review_headline: Hope for war against dog pee!
review_body:
I didn't see it on our carpet but started smelling strong odor of urine in our house. My husband did not and thought I was nuts, so I ordered this blacklight flashlight to prove it. Good news: It works!! Bad news: Our elderly male and female Cockapoos have been peeing all over the house. There were 3 foot wide spots in some rooms and markings from our male on nearly everything vertical in the house!
I also took it in the bathroom and let me tell you that when men pee standing up the fine mist hits the wall adjacent to the toilet!

I did my homework online and found an incredible product that actually works with not much effort other than pouring it on to saturate the carpet, cover it with a plastic bag, and let it do it's thing. It's called Earth Friendly Everyday Stain & Odor Remover. It's amazing. The spots are gone (that show up with the light) and so is the odor. I literally poured it on in hopes that it would go through to the carpet pad and the wood underneath the pad, and left it. I have done it in the dark with the aid of Black Light Urine Detector and not missed a spot. The odor will be worse at first but then it will go away completely. (...and I get down on my hands and knees and put my nose to it..)

I get the \\"Institutional Size\\" bottles of Everyday Stain and Odor Remover and the cheapest price I have found is to order through Home Depot online. Our local Depot does not carry it. You can either pick it up from Home Depot free shipping, or orders over $45 I think delivered straight to door free shipping. The 32 oz bottles from Home Depot are better bargain than buying by gallon from Earth Friendly website. (.you'd think it would be cheaper by the gallon due to the cost of spray bottles for the company) I haven't found it available anywhere by the gallon other then the Earth Friendly
website.
I've spent close to a hundred dollars on this cleaner with enzymes but it sure beats replacing carpet. Plus it's easy. Just pour it on.
Not supposed to use other cleaners before using it as they may inhibit the enzyme activity. Good luck! Needless to say our dogs are now under constant observation/ behind baby gates,... and one is wearing diapers.

I don't work for Earth Friendly...I just thought I'd share my find with desperate folks who are experiencing the horror of dogs peeing where they should not. :)

product_title: Road Refresher No Spill Portable Pet Bowl 54-Ounce
review_body:
I'm reviewing this bowl in the sense that this is intended for home use only. And by default, that may not be the intention of the manufacturer.

If you have an RV, or travel a lot with with your buddy, then this is the bowl for you. From its design, you're guaranteed to reduce spillage on a road trip.

Now if you're like me, and you're looking for a way to get your big dog to stop slobbering while inside the house, then this does an OK job.

I ordered the largest bowl, as our 80lb boy likes his water. The bowl is meant to be used with its three main pieces (bowl, black topper, middle floater).

If you're using this at home, you will find that the middle floater will severely limit the flow of water. This is genius for a vehicle. But it doesn't work at home. You will find yourself filling your bowl every hour.

To circumvent, you can take out the middle floater. But this will basically only leave the topper to prevent spillage. Trust me, it will prevent some spillage, but it won't work miracles.

I give it 3 stars because it's about a 30-40% improvement for outside its intended use. No bowl will ever solve the spillage problem, but you can at least alleviate some of the mess.

I purchased this particular item to replace that first ball (purchased 8 months ago) which my dog managed to de-squeak and loosen the top enough to make it turn inward (not break it, I can pop the top out and it looks/functions good as new). She enjoys this one as much as the first one (squeak or no squeak). I cut up treats to put on the inside the older one, give it to her and let her go to work! With the new one, we play fetch and just run around the house making noise.

I LOVE the fact that this toy holds up so well over time.

I definitely recommend it.

When I first applied the solution I got a rush of strong pee stench from wetting the urine along with the perfume of the solution. product_title: Crystal Clear Aquatics AAD00200 Acrylic Aquaarmor, 8-Ounce
review_headline: Cleans outer aquarium walls and keeps them clean
review_body:
I was having a terrible time trying to eliminate streaks from the clear acrylic sides of my jellyfish tank. No sooner would I get the sides somewhat less streaky than I would drip water on them and have to start all over again. I could never eliminate all the streaks on the tank from using plain water or a glass cleaner.

I was thrilled when this cleaner left no streaks whatsoever--just clear, shiny acrylic. I was even more pleased when I realized that my saltwater drips weren't sticking to the acrylic anymore. A few speckles of salt might show up, but not the long, messy streaks I had before. A quick buff fixes the problem. I've also had no problem with pet hair clinging to the aquarium. Ahhhhhh. So nice.

I tried this on a glass aquarium as well. So far, it seems to be working great. In fact, the glass looks clearer and cleaner than when I got it.

Although the bottle claims that this product will remove superficial surface scratches, I don't find this to be true--at least, I still see superficial scratches on the aquarium walls. Nonetheless, the price was well worth a streak-free aquarium.

Note: I paid $12.03 for this item in February 2014.
Since the product description doesn't show the whole bottle, here are the directions as printed on the bottle I received:

-----
Shake container well and apply on surface. Buff clean with a soft cloth and polish to a high shine. Repeat as necessary.

Use regularly for optimal results.

DO NOT spray directly into aquarium water.

Shake Well Before Use. Protect From Freezing. For External Use Only.
-----

And the text on the side of the bottle:

-----
Anti-Static formula for cleaning and coating acrylic surfaces. Repels dust, waterspots and fingerprints. Removes superficial surface scratches, protects and preserves, and leaves a protective glaze. Can also be used on glass, plastic, or all hard and shiny surfaces.

Avoid contact with eyes and skin. If in eyes, flush with water for 15 minutes. If ingested call physician immediately.
-----

Note: I paid $12.03 for this in February 2014.

product_title: Current USA Satellite Freshwater LED Plus Light for Aquarium
review_body:
Initial observations:

I just set this up today and I'm impressed enough to share a review already so that must mean I'm quite happy with the unit so far. I will keep this review updated, as longevity is key to LED lights (of any kind) to make the purchase worthwhile.

-Only burns 18 watts!
-Is significantly brighter than my old, worn out, Coralife 65 watt florescent fixture with what seemed to be a proprietary bulb. I came home to find that unit failed and didn't bother looking for bulb replacements since I wanted to switch to an LED. When that old unit was new it was brighter but still not as bright as this one.

-Briefly played around with the effects but these seem to be more of a gimmick. I suspect I will only use the moonlight presets.
-Sleek, low profile construction out of aluminum which makes a good heatsink for the LEDs. Hopefully this translates into extended life.
-I purchased the Current USA Single Ramp Timer to go along with this and so far it seems to work quite nicely. The sunrise/sunset will be nice to watch and for the fishes' cardiovascular health :P

Now, the hope is that this unit would last 20,000 hours. There is no manufacturers claim, and somewhat disappointingly only a 1 year warranty. Some LEDs claim up to 50K hours, while most are 20-25K so hopefully 20 is a safe bet. That's about 10 years of service with a use of 6 hours/day. Comparing electricity costs at .10/Kwh this unit will save me $10/year over my 65W florescent model.. If it lasts 10 years that's $100 in saved electricity costs assuming the rates don't change.. and mostly likely if anything they'd go up. So there you have it, assuming the unit lasts it will pay for itself over it's life.. and this doesn't take into account the fact that my florescent unit only lasted 6 years, cost $60+ new, and the bulb probably should have been replaced years ago at ~$33 a pop (just looked them up on amazon). Another thing I like is that these take a low voltage input from an external DC power supply.. this means you don't have to be worried about an internal transformer failing and rendering the entire unit worthless, and you won't be bombarding your fish with EM waves ;)'t take into account the fact that my florescent unit only lasted 6 years, cost $60+ new, and the bulb probably should have been replaced years ago at ~$33 a pop (just looked them up on amazon). product_title: Grannick's Bitter Apple
review_body:

Stern discipline is what works with a side of some home made pet deterrents.

I have a soon to be 1 year old Catahoula Leopard pup who at the ages of 4-7 months, had the nasty habit of chewing on our furniture.

I applied the spray as instructed but the effects lasted as long as my pup's curiosity.

A better solution is to search online on how to train your pup to not tear up the house and how to make home made sprays.

Most dogs do not like lemon/lime so if you apply that on a bit of non fabric furniture then for a short time your pup will not be chewing on that piece of furniture. This will not always work bc the lemon/juice will dry up but if you apply it and teach your pup not to chew then he or she will start to get the message (provide treats as well).

This worked for me but results vary, I made a few boundaries using Cayenne pepper on the areas that I did not want my pup to enter, dogs usually hate the smell and taste so they will stay away. This is also a great way to prevent your dog from digging outside, just spread some cayenne pepper on the ground you do not want him to dig and he or she will not.

So save your money and just google home made solutions.

Some she liked, others she wouldn't touch. With these Chicken & Duck treats she goes crazy over them. And by crazy i mean, as soon as I walk over to the pantry to grab something she's there rubbing on my legs and giving me the \\"I'm hungry feed me now\\" meows. If I happen to walk away from the pantry without giving her one of these, my legs and toes tend to be attacked as I walk. So needless to say, she loves these treats.

Now on to my observations of the treats themselves. The packaging is pretty much like most other types of treats, standard 2oz size plastic container, heat sealed opening with a slit between the heat seal and zip-lock section allowing you to easily tear open the package. The treats for the most part are approx 0.25\\"W x 0.5\\"L x 0.1\\"H, with some smaller pieces from either shipping or from the manufacturing cutter head mis-alignment.

Unlike most other brands of treats with their sometimes insanely long ingredient list filled with, well \\"fillers\\" of not so good stuff, these are made following along with the Wilderness line of foods \\"Natural diet of the Lynx\\".

Since the description doesn't show the list you can see the ingredients below as read from my package in front of me:
INGREDIENTS:
Chicken, Duck, Whole Ground Potatoes, Vegetable Glycerine, Gelatin, Natural Flavor, Salt, preserved with Phosphoric, Sorbic, and Citric Acids, Mixed Tocopherals (source of Vitamin E), Rosemary.

GUARANTEED ANALYSIS:
Crude Protein: 25%(min.), Crude Fat 18%(min.), Crude Fiber 2%(max.), Moisture: 28%(max.).

CALORIE CONTENT: 4,041 Kcals/kg, One Piece = 2Kcals

The rep I spoke with informed me that these treats have a shelf life of 15 months from the manufacturing date. review_headline: Exactly what I expected it to do!

He was eating so fast and so furious that I had a huge fear that my 5 mo old Dobie would get bloat before he turned 6 months old.  He has now turned 7 months and is doing OK on this bowl.  There are many to choose from, but this one has so many nooks and crannies that it is harder for him to gulp the way he wants to.  His next option is me feeding him one morsel at a time at a very slow rate.  THIS IS NOT a knock on the bowl. The bowls is doing what it is designed to do, it is just my pup has learned the pattern and wants his food right here and right now. I will give this bowl to my lab and force him to take his time and chew.  As for the dobie, I will go to the company and see if they can come up with a more complex pattern for the dobie. product_title: Ideal Pet Products Original Pet Door with Telescoping Frame
review_body:
The description and instructions say that it takes 20 minutes to install. That's probably an over-estimate if you have a power drill and sabre saw. I watched the "installation" video here at Amazon, did use a level, and didn't need the instructions that came with it, as it's very easy to install and the bezel will cover slightly uneven cuts.

As the instructions say, the template for the hole is the slide cover: just position it, make sure it's square, draw a pencil line around it, drill 3/8" holes at the 4 corners, then use the sabre saw to cut the hole in the house door. The pet door has two parts (plus the slide cover) that come apart: push one in from each side, place the 6 screws in the holes, and gently tighten (but not over-tighten) them. Putting a tarp or newspaper on the floor before drilling and cutting will make it easier to clean up afterwards.

This replaced a smaller "Johnson" pet door, as my elderly cats needed more width and height; should have replaced it years ago, but didn't know about this one until the other day. The flap doesn't provide as good a weather-air seal as the Johnson's overlapping flaps, but it's fine for where we are using it. "Ideal" makes a double-flap version for better insulation, but some air still will get through.

It's in a house-to-garage door that has beveled panels, so it will need to be caulked. I installed it with the screws and cover guides on the garage side, so we can easily close it from the garage when keeping the garage hatch open. This also makes the "house" side look a bit more attractive, as only the smooth bezel shows from that side.

I'd be hesitant to use this in an outside door, especially one that's exposed to direct sunlight, as I don't know what the long-term effects of sunlight and heat might be. However, there's an aluminum version of it, and if it's like the plastic one, I would consider using it. When installed in an outside door, the screw-and-slide panel side must be on the inside for security.

product_title: Aetertek AT-216S-350W Remote Dog Training Shock Collar
review_body:
I have a little white terrier that I love but she loves to run off. I've tried everything but she is stubborn. I bought this thinking, let's give it a shot. Hopefully I'll teach her to hear the beep and not have to give her the shock. So we got it in today and had to test it asap. So we went outside, at first she just stared at me... OH so NOW you don't wanna run. Like she knows something's up!!! Then, just like always she bolted. I called her first, no response, sent the beep, no response, shock on 4, \\"yelp\\" and returned right to me! Of course I praised her for coming back and turned the level down to 3. We had tested in ourselves and 1 you can't feel a thing. 2 is barely noticeable. So we are at a 3. She once again ran off and I called, sent the beep, and then the shock. Again, returned right to me! I'm hoping eventually all we will use is the beep or maybe even just a positive reinforcement. Only reason I gave a 4 is because there is no on/off switch on the remote. The battery will run down fast, so we are having to take the battery out. That's a pain. But I can overlook this for not having to chase my dog a mile down the road.

Update: 2 weeks later and all I ever have to do now is beep her. No shock since the first week. She immediately turns and runs back. Funny story, I take the collar off when it's not needed so it doesn't accidentally malfunction with her when I'm not around. She saw an opportunity and ran out the front door when I was running late for work. She got all the way across the street and in a moment of desperation I made the best high pitched beep that I could.... AND IT WORKED. She came right to me!!! We can now enjoy the outdoors without fear of her running off!

product_title: Chuckit! Max Glow Ball,
review_body:
My Dog Loves this Glow Ball and prefers it Over All Other balls.

I rescued this super Border Collie, and because they need to have a job and we have no sheep to herd, she has been trained to fetch. I have a couple of dozen toys and tennis balls for her to play with but they go untouched because she Only Wants the Glow Ball. If she can't find her Glow Ball, she will hunt and hunt and hunt until she finds That Glow Ball (or I slip a new one into the toy box - I can't make it tooo easy).

Outside on the covered porch I keep a glove for my left hand and I do use a racket just to hit the ball with. I hit the ball, and because it is hollow in the center with holes at either end, the ball goes whistling all the way out. If you can't see it, you can hear it as it goes. So, day or night, it is pretty easy to find the ball. Also, if I hit the ball too hard and it goes over the fence into the tall brush, all I have to do is wait for it to get dark. Then I can see where the Glow Ball has gone. If the Glow Ball is close to the wire fence I can use a small stick to retrieve it by putting the stick in the hole in the ball and pulling it back through the brush and the fence.

I just ordered 6 more Glow Balls, so I won't run out. One of these Glow Balls will last us for months, but we have lost 3 in the last month or so. I think the problem I'm having is, if I go up town and I leave the gate open, I think the neighbor dog comes over and steals them. Guess I need to put the ball up out of reach when I leave...

product_title: Dogtra SureStim H Plus Dog Remote Trainer
review_body:
Bought this e-collar on the recommendation of our professional dog trainer for helping to train our 2-year old Yellow Labrador Retriever who was having difficulty with both recall and resource guarding issues. Within 10 min of working with our dog using this device our pooch was responding immediately to commands that previously he would "think" about whether he wanted to obey or not. The first thing to know about this product is that it does not "hurt" the dog when a stimulation signal is sent to the collar, it is identical to the kind of stimulation produced by the very low level physical therapy devices used on myself when I had back trouble. We tested the strength of the collar signal by putting the collar on our own arms and then pressing the buttons, very subtle.

The product itself arrives in a durable hardshell black carry case and is designed to be used for two dogs (which we plan to have eventually)...black buttons for one collar, orange for another. So the orange set go unused in our case. The range on the transmission is incredible and allows our dog to be "off leash" now in wide open fields and completely under our control and commands. He is a MUCH happier dog now that he can run and investigate out in the country while still knowing we are right there to issue a command that he can feel.

One thing that would be a slightly better design though is to have the front button be the "nick" and the side button to be the "pager" rather than the opposite as is the case. Ideally, I'd like to see the pager option be the little toggle switch on the front and the buttons be the "nick" and "continuous" since "pager" is rarely used.

Another minor design complaint about this collar is that when charging the collar and transmitter both lights turn red but they never turn green to indicate full charge, it even states this explicitly in the directions so you just haveto know that it takes 10 hours to fully charge them while the LED's stay red...apparently just indicating that they are indeed plugged in to AC power. Weird design if you ask me given the fact that the LED's are multi-color capable and it should've been an easy design feature to implement. Other than that, this product is amazing and works as advertised. Would HIGHLY recommend it.

product_title: Arm & Hammer Clump & Seal Clumping Litter - Fresh Home
review_body:
We have a five-cat household and typically we buy traditional litter due to the higher expense of the scooping stuff. However, got a box of this to review so here's my 2 cents.

It's good litter! Basically the claims as to the smell seem to be correct. After a few days of heavy use by our brood, the box wasn't exactly a flower garden but noticeably better than other litters. The smell of the product itself is fairly pleasant - a little more perfume-y and less like chlorophyll. It was nice to smell this on our long-haired part-Maine Coon rescue kitty, whose fur really traps odors, as opposed to what he sometimes smells like.

It also clumps pretty well, in line with the claims on the box. I wasn't just overwhelmed, but again it was noticeably better than some competing brands. There was one wet area that came up mostly in one piece as opposed to my having to go through the box repeatedly.

The only downside? This stuff costs plenty. The box I got is about 10 inches by 10 by 3.5 or so, so it's not a whole lot of litter, despite weighing 14 pounds. If you have one small cat and a box will last you a while, then go ahead and buy - but if you have a whole horde of cats, it's probably going to take you the full box and to my mind this isn't a super-terrific financial decision. That said, I'll be keeping an eye out and buying some on sale where I can find it.

She is on many medications and it has been costing me around $200 a month. The Senilife, suggested by the vet, was $50 alone. It was getting tough to keep up with the costly meds and I was trying to decde if I could drop one when I discovered that I could buy it on-line for around $27.  Being a little suspicious of purchasing on-line meds I took the chance and was not disappointed! I discovered that what I ordered from Amazon had the same bin number as what I bought from the veterinarians so I was very pleased. My little dog means everything to me and I will do anything for her.  I will be buying Senilife from Amazon from now on!

product_title: Crown Majestic (Diamond Series V2R) Automatic Pet Feeder
review_headline: works alright, but must use small round food
review_body:
We got this b/c we have cats that want to eat at the crack of dawn which is just too early. It's set to feed at 6am once a day, we feed them the other times. At first it didn't dispense reliably but we had cat food that was X shaped. After switching to round kibbles it's doing fine. Cat's can knock a few pellets loose with their paws but not many and they usually don't bother to try.

The good:

works reliably as advertised (so far, only had it a few weeks)

The bad:

only works well with round food
can't use batteries and power adapter at the same time (so power failure resets it)
instructions suck

Intructions - the procedure for adjusting how much is dispensed doesn't state that there's a pin that prevents moving the slider door up and down so you have to pry the side of the door facing you up to get the pin out of its slot before the door will slide. The day after fighting with this I got a paper copy of additional instructions in the mail. Nice that they sent it, but in the box with the item would be a lot better!

Summary - Assuming it lasts a while, I feel it's worth the money to keep from being woken up every day at 5 or 6am. It's not a really refined or well-engineered device, the water thing is obviously and literally tacked on, but the cats do like it and use it. Also, the sliding door adjustment for the amount dispensed is crude and not well explained, but it works.

product_title: Dogtra IQ Remote Trainer
review_body: I received this collar from a trainer after having sent my dog to a board-and-train program.  The transmitter is small and fits comfortably in the palm of my hand.  The receiver is smaller as well (I recently ordered a Dogtra 1900, and the receiver is bulkier).  It does what it's supposed to do in terms of an e-collar.  The only drawback is that the transmitter doesn't have an LCD readout, so you're sort of guessing what level you're at.  It's not a terrible drawback, as once you find a dog's working level, you'll probably be working around there most of the time.  The problem, though, is that the dial is marked with 25 points, representing the 0-100 levels.  If you move up one dot (which is barely turning the dial), you're really moving up 4 levels of power.  If you can shell out a little more, I'd aim to get one with an LCD readout, otherwise, this collar is a good value and should accomplish what you're looking to do with an e-collar.

product_title: K&H Manufacturing Cuddle Cube
review_headline: My dog absolutely LOVES this bed!
review_body:
I wasn't going to buy this bed originally because it's made in China, it contains recycled rubber, and since the pet food recall and so many dead dogs and cats directly due to contaminated food from China, well, I have been strictly avoiding anything made in China. That said ... I read many dozens of the customer reviews on Amazon for this bed. A very large majority said their dogs absolutely LOVE it. I looked at my dog, looked at the bed, read some more reviews, looked back at my dog, looked at the bed ...and clicked "BUY".

Oh my heavens what a GREAT decision! I was afraid when I received it, there would be out-gasses ... were there? No, none. I was concerned about how the recycled rubber parts would feel ... I tested it first myself ... they are actually PERFECT for holding firmness and shape while also being able to be moved around by dogs' paws. I was concerned would my dog even get into it ... did he? As soon as I put it down on the floor, he went over to it, sniffed it, walked around it while sniffing it, climbed in, sat proudly, and looked up at me very happily.

I understand why some reviewers said they bought a second one. I'm feeling I have a second one in my future as well, for the TV room.

product_title: Cambridge Aquatics Power Filter, 5-20 Gallon
review_body:
I received this filter brand new with a 20 gallon tank I bought off of Craigslist. I have been using that filter for several months no problem. My tank needed more filtration, and rather than buy a random filter to go with it, I wanted to buy the same one again so they match. I couldn't find this filter in any stores, so I ordered it here on Amazon for cheaper including shipping than many filters in store. They both look great, and typically aren't noisy. Only if they are overfilled or it is not assembled correctly. Even still, you can remove the lid to solve this problem.

I really like that the filter is clear so that you can see when the filter pad is falling apart or if something is clogged. It also has 2 slots for filter pads so that you can insert a new pad to grow bacteria on before throwing away an old one to avoid a mini cycle. The only thing is that this is when the filter becomes loud. It's not too bad though. The tetra medium biobags fit this filter too, so you don't have to worry about tracking down replacement filter pads when the time comes since these are available everywhere.

review_headline: Wonderful For Feeding Pets When Away At Work...
review_body:
[[VIDEOID:mo2DMDURI3NTG6U]]Video Review Summary:
→ The [[ASIN:B00GNJEC5G Crestuff 6 Meal Automatic Electronic Pet Feeder]] works great for feeding your animal friends when you aren't there to feed them yourself. This feeder can make sure she has her feed in the afternoon, and that she gets the right amount each time. I have tested the unit over the last three days and it has performed dependably and reliably during that time.

→ The only things you need to provide out of the box are 4-C batteries and you animal food. The unit could work with wet or dry food, however keep in mind wet food might have a shorter amount of time it remains sanitary out of the fridge.

The unit can also be set to feed 2 times/day for 3 days and 3 times for 2 days and so on. Just remember, after the set number of days you will need to refill the inner tray and reset the unit. The feeder also allows for up to a 6 second message to be recorded, calling your pet to their meal.

→ Note that the inner tray can be hand washed with water, however it is NOT designated as dishwasher safe. The manual mentions the product carries a 6-month limited warranty in case of problems.

→ Overall, the [[ASIN:B00GNJEC5G Crestuff 6 Meal Automatic Electronic Pet Feeder]] is a wonderful multi-day, multi-meal feeder. The unit really is easy to use and the user's manual spells out all you need to know to get setup.

product_title: Oster Gentle Paws Premium Nail Grinder for Dogs and Cats
review_body:
Mechanically, it sounds simple and efficient. I decided to give it a go.

Placed the first nail in the hole so that I could start trimming... as soon as the grinding stone made contact with the nail, my dog immediately yanked back his paw. Unfortunately, the nail remained inside the hole and he took off with a buzzing nail trimmer firmly lodged on his paw. Since the on/off mechanisim is a switch and not a button, it did not turn off when released. This only added to the panic my dog was now experiencing.

By the time it finally came off, the nail had broken right through the quick. Blood everywhere.

Sticking with good old fashion manual clippers.

If you decide to give this a try, make sure you have a second person holding the dog the first few times you use it. You do not want to experience what I experienced.

product_title: Ruffwear - Palisades Multi-Day Backcountry Pack for Dogs
review_headline: Great pack...!!!  Easy to use..  Carries a lot...  And, the Dog Likes It..
review_body:
I recently wrote this review for another site.. I'll post it here as it may help someone to make a more informed buying decision.. I purchased this pack from Ruffwear several years back before I was aware that Amazon carried them..

Look at the Palisades pack as a 2-piece assembly.. Mine is sized for a MEDIUM DOG..

There is the harness part that is best strapped on and fitted first by itself.. Mine had movable pads built around the two belly straps. The chest "Y-assembly" is also padded where the three straps meet. The harness also has a heavy-duty attachment ring located above the spine just behind the withers area. This ring is normally used to attach a leash. We use a horse lead about 8'-10' long when in populated areas.. This attachment is probably strong enuf and located correctly to actually lift the animal into the air or up or down a steep rock face.. Just forward of the attachment ring is a strong sewn-in handle of the same strong material as the harness.. This could easily be used to lift the animal by the harness when the pack portion is removed. The underside of the harness is lightly padded and doesn't seem to rub the skin/fur wrong. It would be easy to attach another pad, similar to a saddle blanket under the harness. The entire harness assembly is quite sturdy. I would suspect that properly fitted it would remain serviceable for a long period of time. The stitching is exceptionally strong, as are the straps that are quite long but the loose ends fold up into the harness areas.

The second part of this rig is the actual pack portion itself.. It has a very simple throw-over-the-back pack that is similar to saddlebags for a horse.. This portion attaches to the harness by 4 simple yet very strong quick attach-n-release type attachments that are similar to those found on belts, backpacks, etc. Each side has a larger section for main storage, a small storage section, and the hydration bag section inside a separate zippered section in the main section.. Each small storage section also has adjustment straps used to compact the pack to prevent it from flopping around when partially loaded. I wouldn't hazard a guess as to the size but I'm sure each side probably has 300-400 cu" of storage.. The hydration bladders are probably about a quart each. The pack expands to about 5" wide at the bottom. There is also a short separate zipper at the bottom that allows access and use of the hydration bag tube without opening the pack itself..

All in all IMO this is a well designed and easy-to-use pack.. It is the first I ever bought for a dog so I have little to compare it to.. I researched it well before buying and certainly don't regret it. For us it works well.. We have not used it a lot but being retired military I'm pretty familiar with things that are well-built for field use. This pack is certainly one of them.. It is certainly not the least expensive but I doubt you'll find a good, well-designed pack that is more versatile and functional at any price.. It doesn't have a lot of bells and whistles to go bad but works well without them.. I'd buy it again and recommend it to a close friend.. Plus, the dog likes it.. product_title: Preg-Tone Pregnancy Detector
review_body:
Following is a copy of the email I sent to the company. It has failed on another goat.
They did not even bother to acknowledge the email I sent them.

Dear Mr. Larsen,
As per our conversation the other day, here is my email followup.
We purchased a new Preg-tone from one of your resellers. According to your website (and I copy and paste) from the website:

"No guessing and no question. 100% accuracy between 30 and 45 days depending on the animal type."

"Dairy goats such as the Oberhasli can be tested as early at 20 days."

First point: We only have Nubian, Saanen, and LaMancha Dairy goats. These are all well known dairy breeds, in fact the Nubian and the Saanen are better known than the Oberhasli.

Second point: I bred 3 does: Marguarite, Dancer and Yin on August 20, 21, and 22 of 2013. On October 8, 2013, I used the Preg-tone to check if the 3 does were pregnant. All were negative (short beeps). This was at day 47 from the breeding.
I kept putting the 3 girls in with the buck, because after all, the Preg-tone kept saying they were not pregnant. (going back to your website claim of 100% accuracy).
It was not until November 11, 2013 that the Preg-tone emitted the long tone on two of the does that according to your literature signifies finding amniotic fluid indicating pregnancy. So with that information and the fact that I had been putting the does in with the buck, I concluded that they were due March 10, 2014. The third doe, Marguarite, did not test positive with a long tone until Dec. 2, 2013 which meant to me and according to your website of 100% accuracy claim, that she was not due until April.

I have a protocol of vaccinations, worming, and herbals that I give a pregnant doe starting at 90 days pregnant. We sell our goat products to a variety of high end foodies and so we are very careful about the care and health of our goats. I attend every birth andmake sure that things go according to the way they are supposed to. Two weeks prior to a birth, I move the doe to the center pasture and the kidding pen.
So you must imagine my surprise, when on the morning of the 17th of January, I arrived at the barn to find Marguarite down and in great distress. (Remember, according to the Preg-tone, she was not due till April). There was a little ear sticking out of her vulva. I ran for the OB kit and called the vet. I had to push the kid back in and fish around for the legs, and assist in delivery of the now dead kid. It was not like a kid that was due in April. It weighed 4.13 lbs and was fully haired with teeth exposed. To me that means that the little doe kid was full term. The vet agreed with me. Because I had to go in to assist Marguarite in giving birth, we had to flush the uterus with antibiotics.
She did not get the proper vaccinations, worming and herbals that she needed prior to giving birth and did not come into lactation. So on that doe alone, I lost a lot of money.
Last year, she milked a normal lactation cycle of 305 days and produced a gallon of milk daily. We sell our goat milk for $5.50/quart so on the milk alone, I lost $6,710. (We also make goat milk soap @ $6.50/bar, cheese @ $10.00/8 oz, and yogurt @ $5.00/16 oz)
Plus, a doe kid that I would normally sell for $200. So, total loss on Marguarite will be $6,910 plus the vet bill. IF your machine had fulfilled your claims of 100% accuracy, I would not have had to call the vet, I probably wouldn't have lost the kid, and Marguarite would have not been in such stress that she would have come into milk. I don't know how long she lay there in distress.

After Marguarite's loss, I looked at the other two does, (Yin and Dancer). Remember, they were not due, according to the 100% accurate Preg-tone, until March 10, 2014.
The vet and I agreed that they should get the whole battery of worming, vaccinations and herbals (one is red raspberry leaf for uterine health) NOW instead of waiting according to the Preg-tone. It is a good thing, because since I was watching and on alert due to the failure of the 100% accurate Preg-tone, Yin delivered on the 22 of January and Dancer delivered on the 23 of January. Both were attended births.
I have 3 more pregnant does. One has indicated with the Preg-tone that she is due in early May. However according to her first breeding, she is due the 11 of Feb. She lost her mucus plug day before yesterday.
Another doe that I tested at 30 days indicated that she is not pregnant. However with the history of your machine, (100% accurate), I just can't trust it. The fifth doe, also indicated, with the short beeps, that she is not pregnant.

I realize that the money I lost because of your faulty machine is gone and I am never going to be reimbursed for my loss. Which bites, because I am a very small producer and almost $7,000 plus the vet bill is a lot of money to me.

However, I do think that you need to take down the two statements ("No guessing and no question. 100% accuracy between 30 and 45 days depending on the animal type" and "Dairy goats such as the Oberhasli can be tested at early as 20 days.), from your website. 6 wrong results do not make the Preg-tone 100% accurate.
I expect to see the change by the 15th of Feb or I will take your claims to another level of attention.
Sincerly
Christina Nielson

product_title: CANIDAE Grain Free PURE Canned Cat Food, 12 Pack
review_headline: High protein, low carbs, and NO GARBAGE!
review_body:
Canned food is healthier for cats than dry food because unlike dogs, cats are true carnivores; they basically require meat. What they DON'T really need is a lot of grain, soy, gluten, hormones, carbs, etc.

Yes, a quality grain-free food is usually more expensive. However, I've found that my cats don't need to eat as much of the good food as they do the poorer quality food (the kinds that grocery stores sell, I won't mention those brand names). So it probably ends up costing about the same. I believe that Canidae sells some varieties that are not grain-free, so make sure you read the label.

I have a cat that is very food sensitive and will regurgitate many different brands and flavors of food. I reduced this issue when I started to feed her only grain-free food. She can (usually) tolerate some flavors of \\"Wellness\\" or \\"Avo-Derm\\" grain-free canned foods. However, so far she hasn't had ANY regurgitation issues with this particular Canidae Pure grain-free Chicken/Turkey/Lamb. I suspect that my cat might have a problem with not only grain, but perhaps gluten or something else that the other brands include that this particular Canidae doesn't. Cats are very individual and finicky, however, so maybe not all cats will like it. I've yet to get any of my three cats to agree on any one food, and most cat owners can probably sympathize. I dock one star because my cat isn't real wild about it (probably because of the gooey texture).

This is a high quality cat food that you can feel good about feeding to your cat. And it's definitely worth a try if you have a cat that isn't doing well with other brands of food.

product_title: Fluval External Filter
review_body:
I recently setup a 36gallon aquarium that my wife bought on clearance from petsmart. It was a all-in-one kit sort of thing (which was surprisingly nice!). The only thing that I noticed after a week or so was that the filter was just plain inadequate. I had a couple aquariums back in the 80's as a kid and *always* wanted a canister filter, but they were way out of my price range back then. I did a quick search on amazon and this one had high marks so I bought it. I am absolutely amazed by it!! Do yourself a favor and get one of these for your tank; it will be clearer and quieter than anything you've ever seen!! Worth every penny...

Now for my -only- gripe: Less than perfect directions.
I was able to figure out what the directions were saying but there aren't very many pictures of the actual assembly procedure.

a.) Note that the rubber hose fittings that attach to the filter need to be held on to while you're tightening the lock nuts. If you don't they just spin. You don't need to crank super hard either; I just got it finger tight and I don't have very strong hands and it works great.

b.) Leave 6" instead of 4" of slack when trimming the hoses to fit.
I started off with the recommended 4" and just decided no way that was enough. The pictures of my install are shown with 6" and I'm very happy with the way it looks and works.

product_title: Lixit Animal Care Aquarium/Cage Small Animal Water Bottle
review_body: This product, for the most part, works as intended. Unfortunately, it has a tendency to constantly drip water; The product is supposed to hold a small amount of water at the dabbing ball without constantly dripping. Additionally, always be sure to check this product's functionality. I've got pet White-Footed Deer mice and they are very small. They require a constant and ever available supply of water or they can get dehydrated and possibly die. Several times now this product has gotten 'stuck' in one fashion or another and not allowed any water to be dispensed. I clean this product about every 3-5 days, so it's not neglected in that manner. The most recent malfunction almost caused the death of one of my animals. I would not recommend this product and would advise that a higher quality product be sought out in it's place.

review_body:
Our 24lb/4mon old puppy LOVES this thing. We got it when she was much smaller and it seemed to frighten her (it is on the loud side, especially rolling around on hardwoods), but once she got big enough, she figured out how to paw at it and get it to give her a few pieces of her favorite kibble at a time. product_title: Aquatop NP-302 Aquarium Submersible Pump
review_headline: Good generic replacement pump for tabletop fountains.
review_body:
Bought one for a relatively nice cut stone tabletop fountain that I didn't want to lose.
Water volume far more than sufficient for the 8 in (~20 cm) lift needed - had to reduce with the adjustable slider.
Lots of connectors, adapters, and extensions included.

Works so well I bought a second for a small outdoors flower pot fountain.
Waiting on the late January 2014 weather to improve before installing - don't think it will pump ice!

Can't really speak to long term reliability, but the materials and fabrication seem very good.
Recommended.

product_title: Halo Spot's Stew Healthy Weight Grain Free Turkey and Duck Recipe for Dogs
review_body: My older dogs really love this food and I have successfully slimmed them down without deprivation. I often augment their food with other things - a small amount of sardines, cottage cheese and flaxseed oil, vegetables but they are enthusiastic even without those additions. Grain free for many years, my dogs could never go back as they literally vomit grain back up - at least the one does without fail. I never would have believed she was so sensitive but all her stomach problems - and there were many- cleared up w grain free. Spot is not the first grain free I've used but I think it is the best. It even smells good. I wish it went on sale more often but, of course, all high end dog foods seem to bank on our buying what our dogs need regardless of price. I admit, I am now a loyal fan.

product_title: Stewart Freeze Dried Treats for Dogs
review_body: This is a great nutritional treat for your dog. My dog loves them. Another company stopped making the liver jerky which she loved so I searched for a replacement. This is it and I think they're superior. Highly recommend them.

product_title: PetSafe Easy Walk Harness
review_headline: Extremely Helpful In Controlling  A Huge Mastiff
review_body:
Our English Mastiff is huge, 251 lbs of muscle and bone. He is extremely powerful. Honestly, if he wants to go, Easy Walk or no Easy Walk he is going. However, with training and the Easy Walk we have come to a stable peace in our walks. He doesn't drag me and mostly walks on a loose leash by my side now. The Easy Walk Harness was an excellent training aid.

My word of advice is: Don't rely solely on the product to rein in your pulling dog. Training is critical. We use only positive reinforcement (clicker, treats and praise) with no aversive training whatsoever. This works the best for all breeds in my many decades of raising dogs. Mastiffs are a different breed entirely, extremely powerful and independent.

I highly recommend this product for all breeds as a tool in the training to curb the pulling canine.

product_title: Pet Clothes BARKING DIVA Dog T-Shirt
review_body: Got my money's worth and more- my dog love's it! The fabric is heavy knit that will hold up to wash and wear of and active animal. Sturdy seams, too. Plus the price didn't break my budget and it arrived promptly. I like this company VERY much and will spread word about their great products and service. Keep it up !

product_title: Cycle Dog 3Play Turtle Toy
review_headline: 15 Week Old Goldendoodle Puppy loves it!
review_body: My pup really loves this toy more than I could have imagined! He can't get the bigger treats out of the tummy yet because either he hasn't quite figured it out or he just isn't quite strong enough yet.  He loves to figure it out though.  This one of the most durable toys that I have ever gotten for my dog and he is a heavy chewer with his razor sharp puppy teeth.  This toy seems indestructible and I would highly recommend it!

review_body:
The stroller is perfect in the house. But, you get what you paid for, right?

The wheels are plastic and I just don't feel it is sturdy enough for outside. I use it in the house. It's like a bassinet. He lies in there and I move it around the house when I am cleaning - works perfect so I don't have to worry about him getting various cleaners on his paws.

It is cute and easy to assemble. It is just not practical for outdoor use.

review_body: The XL doesn't fit my smallest Yorkie, and he is a toy. I love the color and the logo. Your sizes are way off. I would like to return but it would to much trouble. I have ordered many off the pet clothes from Amazon, now I am in a long wait for the others to arrive. I spend a lot of money on my babies, but this i had to donate to local shelter. Sorry, I really wished they had fit.

review_body: Although we live in Southern California where it doesn't usually get too cold at night, this winter has been unseasonably cold, so I bought this bed warmer to use in my Rottweiler's house. He has torn up countless comfy Costco beds, but fortunately he is treating his house and its bedding with respect, finally. (Maybe because he's warm enough now?) I wrapped the warmer in an old nylon bed cover and it keeps him warm and cozy all the time. I should probably use a timer so I don't have to keep plugging/unplugging it.

product_title: Nutrived B-Complex with Iron - 4 oz.
review_headline: nutrived-b complex w/iron helps cat's with kidney disease
review_body:
Nutrived-B Complex w/ Iron is helping to maintain my cat's blood work counts by keeping them in an acceptable range. He is 2 1/2 and has kidney disease. A great product and I highly recommend. I administer the liquid by using an 0ral 1.0 monoject syringe from our vet and putting the syringe on the inside bottom of his gum.
If you have any questions please just ask, I will try to help.

review_body: Easy to assemble and varying speeds are great for larger or smaller dog nails. Comes with a number of tools and fast shipping!

product_title: Hydro IV Sponge Pro Filter - Up to 80 gallons by Lustar
review_body:
I use this sponge filter connected to a Marineland 1200 powerhead ($22) for roughly $40 you can have excellent biological filtration and water movement in your tank.

I use this is a 60 gallon corner tank with an AquaClear 70 and the tank is crystal clear. The sponge filter was all I ran for the first week and the AquaClear is more for mechanical filtration. I find the sponge filter will suck up a lot of food but some of the fish will graze off it. Be sure to clean the sponge once in a while or it will get clogged and you risk damaging your pump. I tried the filter with the air pump and air stone but because my tank is almost 20" deep, there was not a good enough vacuum effect in my opinion and when I turned up the pump the amount of bubbles was out of control.

review_headline: Bought (2) to give away because owners didn't know how to walk their dogs.
review_body:
One of my neighbors has a new large puppy, now 90#, that belongs to the daughter, and she, the mother, has bad knees. It was painful for me to watch her walk this dog when training is still infantile at this stage of the game.
My sister, of all people, couldn't walk her new dog either, now 90#. She was using the old choke collar method to "control" her monster. And she knows better on how to take charge over a dog and its training (it's not her first dog...more like 3rd).

I bought the PetSafe Easy Walk Dog Harness for both people as gifts. Immediately, my neighbor was in control over her grand-doggy and walking at the owners pace, and not the dog's. Now, my sister is another story...she had to hurt herself a few more times using the choke collar; and then admitted she didn't know how this new collar went on the dog. It's easy for me to see the hookup, but it may be a learning curve for others. Fortunately, the collar has (2) tones, black and grey. This allowed me to help instruct the hookup in a way for her to follow and remember on her own. That being said and done, she *loves* the control put back into her hands when walking her monster.
Conclusion: dog training is a must for all owners(period) but until then, this is a God-send product to keep me from watching others walking in pain. Thank you from myself, neighbor, and sister.

product_title: Catit Jumbo Hooded Cat Litter Pan - Warm Gray
review_body:
Like most cat owners, I don't hate cleaning the litter box, but it's not my favorite thing. You clean it often enough to keep your place from getting smelly, and so that your cats remain happy about using it. I've got 3 cats, and the litter box gets used a lot in the course of a day. A regular size box means that it's got to be cleaned twice a day to keep it decent. But...a large box can be cleaned once a day and still stay relatively pleasant. That's where this behemoth of a litter box comes in. This box is so large, that it will take 20 lbs of litter to fill it. That gives it the capacity to handle three cats comfortably.

The top for the litter has nice channels that overlap the bottom pan. That should keep keep any stray spray in the litter box, instead of leaking out. Well done! The four top locks would probably do a good job keeping the lid in place if you wanted to lift it while filled with litter...but remember that's 20 lbs. I just leave it in place without locking the latches.

The top comes with a clear door that I took off from the start. It don't think it's a good idea to concentrate the dust inside the box where my cats are going to be breathing, and it wasn't hard to remove. There's a portion of the top that sort-of rolls up out of the way to give you cleaning access, but I just remove the top to clean it.

The handle on the top is robust enough to move the entire litter box together, but it's sometimes difficult to pull up because it lays down flush. That's a minor problem that you can either ignore or modify by shaving off a bit of the plastic handle, so you can get a finger tip under the handle to fold it out.

The bottom of the pan is smooth and easy to scrape across. Unlike more poorly thought out boxes I've used, the bottom is well-designed for the purpose.

It's a good item that is amongst the best litter boxes I've used.

product_title: Dog Life Jacket Ripstop Life Jacket for Dogs
review_body: Got this for my sister's medium sized french bulldog when they moved to florida from texas...he's not use to the water..so we wanted to be safe..it fits well...and hes able to swim around with it...he just loves the water....good price too..

product_title: Go Pet Club Cat Tree Furniture 72 in. High Loft
review_body: This thing is a brute compared to the cheap trees I had been buying from the local big box store. It was very easy to assemble and I didn't bother with the lower ramp. I used tips from other reviewers to assemble it (lock tight on all threads & extra screws to attach upper ramp), I probably could have had it assembled in about a 1/2 hour, but I had two typically curious cats up and down - up and down -up and down on my lap; generally doing their best to redirect my attention to them.  So, after about 40 minutes I had it pushed over against the wall and all they did for the next hour or so was to explore the tree (and the box it was packed in).  Good investment for my two dingalings,,,

product_title: Etna Pet Booster Seat
review_headline: Saved momma's blood pressure and I can still go
review_body: This works great for my 5 pound yorkie who loves to move around in the car. The booster seat allows him to see out the Windows so he is getting used to it and mommy is happy.

product_title: Nutri-Vet Multi-Vite Chewables for Dogs
review_body: My 10 year old American Staffordshire Terrier refuses to eat these, and she eats anything!  Even if I mix them with canned dog food, I find them in the bottom of the otherwise empty bowl.  I bought them because the price was lower than the ones I had been giving her.  I will switch back to NaturVet VitaPet Senior.

product_title: Stoneware Dog Dish
review_body: This is a good looking and sturdy water bowl/food bowl for a dog.  Best for a smaller dog or puppy.

product_title: Carlson Pet Products Design Studio Home Decor Walk Through Pet Gate
review_body: As others mentioned the listing says the gate goes to 40 wide. The box that arrived says max width is 37.5 inches. This appears to be an incorrect Amazon listing rather than being sent the wrong model.

product_title: Castor & Pollux Natural Ultramix Weight Management Adult Dry Dog Food, 15 Pound Bag
review_body:
Since we first adopted our rat terrier he has never eaten his entire portion of food in one sitting. He does fine with the soft food, but he has never liked dry dog food. It was almost as if he would wait throughout the day hoping he would get something else, and then at the end of the day finally give in and eat "his" food. We have tried several different types/brands.

The first time we put this out for him he ate the entire portion! The second time, he did it again! He really likes this food. I'm guessing it has to do with the quality of the ingredients. I'm pretty picky with what I eat (in terms of quality ingredients), and after reading the ingredients label I was almost tempted to taste the food ;). Give it a try.

product_title: Armarkat Cat tree Furniture Condo, Height -50-Inch to 60-Inch
review_body: Yeah, COULD HAVE BEEN the best tree for the price over all, BUT, regardless of any other factor, the fact that they did not put anything at all between the hard box/platforms and the furry covering blows it...my cat wants to like it, but it is simply too hard to be an inviting lounge area. How much could a cheap piece of padding cost? Leaving that off the Cat Tree just turned this into a VERY expensive scratching post! BOO!!!

product_title: IRIS Nesting Airtight Pet Food Container
review_body: i bought two of these for cat food. One latch broke right  away, but the other one still works. They are the right size for about four lbs of dry cat food.

product_title: Our Pets Lift-N-Aid Large Mobility Harness
review_body: This works well but is a little difficult to put on my bull mastiff. It's not entirely the fault of the product. My dog can be a bit of a jerk sometimes. So, if want to carry your dog like a bowling ball this harness is for you.

product_title: Litter Wizard System Cat Litter Box Deodorizer Spray, 16-Fluid Ounce
review_body:
This is my second bottle. This stuff really works, even more so when combined with the Litter Wizard Granules. I like it because it's so safe for people, pets, and the environment. Try it out, and if you're using it correctly with a good litter, and cleaning your litter box as you should, you will see nice results.

I'm thinking any lower reviews might come from people who don't know the proper protocol of cleaning a litter box. Many don't. The rule of thumb is one litter box per cat, and they should be cleaned daily not weekly or every two weeks. It's amazing how many people think cleaning out a litter box once a week or once every two weeks is ok. It's really not. It's bad for a cat's health. :( I have two cats and use only one box because I don't have room for two, so it does get cleaned at least once a day for the sake of the human noses, and the cats' health. Using the Litter Wizard system gives everything a huge help.

So if you're using both items, good litter, and cleaning your litter box/es as you should, you will be very happy with the results.

product_title: Masione Anti-bark Static Collar with 7 Corrections and Adjustable Sensitivity Control
review_body: I only had to use this about 6 times on my dog and he already barks less than half what he used to. Only flaw with this is that it picks up on other noises or vibrations or something so I would not recommend using it for extended lengths of time and only use it when your dog is WITH you because it shocked my dog once while my other dog was making noise, so it basically shocked him when he did nothing wrong. BUT if you only use it when they decide to bark for too long for NO reason and only use it for a short amount of time it deffinitely gets the job done and my dog only barks when it's important mainly now. (which sometimes means because he saw a frog or something) But its under control and for that price you can't beat it.

product_title: Fashionable Safe Cat Collar - 3/8" - Pink Dots
review_body: I have a cat that adores pink toys, collars, blankets and anything pink. This arrived in good shape but it will be interesting to see how quickly the other cat will shred it wrestling with her. So far so good. Great collar very pretty and she likes it.

product_title: Freedom No-Pull Harness ONLY
review_headline: One great harness for the money.
review_body: It was what I was looking for!!!! Fits my Boxer great, no more choking!!!!! It was easy to adjust and take a second to put it one.

product_title: Bayer Advantage II Topical Flea Treatment Dogs
review_body: This product killed the fleas!  It's been 3 weeks and they haven't returned.  I am happy my dog is not suffering from flea bites anymore!

product_title: Orbit Nylon Dog Collar, Padded Big Dog Collar by Kakadu Pet
review_body:
I got this collar for my one year old weimaraner. The 20" was too big and this seemed to be ok.
Its not really flexible and pretty stiff. Seems to ride up a little high on his neck/head.
I washed him once w/ it and it shrunk so now it doesn't fit.

product_title: Alfie Pet by Petoga Couture - Jad Silicone Pet Expandable/Collapsible Travel Bowl - Size: 3.5 Cups
review_body:
Nice bowl, it does not hold more than two cups either water or food. They advertised as 3.5 cups, no way!
Thinking of sending it back, I need a larger bowl for my dog. Other than that it is nice, easy to carry in purse or car

product_title: Catit Style Scratcher with Catnip Tiger
review_headline: Not at first,but now cat loves it!
review_body:
Ordered this cat scratcher a month ago.
We adopted our cat from a shelter so we weren't sure what she liked. Bought a typical carpet scratcher from the pet store. She didn't care for it so we returned it.
She didn't care about scratching anything when we first got her, But then when we had her for a couple of weeks she started wanting to scratch.
Came across this cat scratcher with cat nip, it had great reviews so I figured it was worth a try. She didn't bother with it for a whole month, but just like cat scratcher said when it came in the mail...cats have to get use to it.
Now a month later after introducing her to it, she LOVES it! She scratches it then lays on it. So it's pretty much an all in one cat bed and cat scratcher.
It is just made of cardboard and the one side of zebra striped fell off once I opened the packaging, but that didn't bother me personally because I didn't buy it for the design just so my cat could have something to scratch.
I will for sure be purchasing again, and order one for my upstairs too :)

product_title: Tzou Dog Jacket Luxury Leopard
review_body: I gave this item four stars because the material isn't the greatest, but it looks cute on my Yorkie. I wouldn't recommend this item because I also ordered one for my daughter in laws Yorkie, and the label on the collar was upside down. It was a Christmas present, and since it took a month to come from China there wasn't time to exchange.

product_title: Nature's Miracle Jaw Scoop
review_body: Works better than my old one.  I purchase this in winter and  I hope it works great on tall grass too.

review_headline: Cats won't eat it even the ferals

I messed up. This cat food is a serious reject for all my 6 cats and even the ferals won't eat it. I put it out and then have
to throw it in the trash the next day.

product_title: PetSafe Healthy Pet Water Station Dog and Cat Water System with Stainless Steel Bowl
review_body: I don't usually set my cat's water bowl on the carpet, but the protective pad I was using wasn't big enough for this, a dry food  bowl and a canned food bowl.  So I set it on the carpet.  No spillage at all!  Never gets knocked over and keeps fresh water in the dish for days!  Great for when you have to leave your cat alone for a few days.

product_title: Kaytee Fiesta Rabbit Food, Various Size
review_body: Been feeding the bun this for a little over a year, so glad I found a huge bag finally.  So much more cost effective too.  The orange carrot shaped pellets are what she goes for first.  I ended up putting the entire bag into one of those huge dog food containers to keep it fresh seeing this will last a very long time.

product_title: Sentry Calming Collar for Dogs
review_body: I purchased this for a small dog. When I opened the package it was wound up so it wanted to stay wound up. The directions were to pull it and when I did all the powder seemed to fly off. The collar was so big, I had to cut quite a bit off of it. Then trying to put it on my Chihuahua was impossible. Since its rubber it was very hard to secure it closed.

product_title: #1 Best Professional Pet Nail Clipper,Easy and Safe To Use …
review_body:
Though I haven't owned this for very long, I'm impressed with it compared to others I've looked at in stores. It seems to be both substantially built (thick metal blades) and light-weight at the same time. Very smooth action, and, very importantly, sharp. You can just look at clippers on the shelves in stores and see that they don't look sharp.

I just found our old clipper that was purchased for our last dog, probably 15 years ago. I was never that impressed with it, and now comparing them makes me appreciate this one even more. This one has much better action, better blades, and much, much more comfortable handles.

Thanks for all the other excellent reviews that helped me make this purchase decision.

product_title: NoviPet Multi Vitamin Chews for Dogs
review_body: The actual ingredients of NoviPet Multi Vitamin for Dogs - i.e. typical vitamins - suggest that giving the dog the fraction of a human multivitamin dose equal to the dog's weight divided by your body weight should do the trick at a fraction of the cost of these.  Otherwise, they are OK.

product_title: Fitwarm® Cute Polka Dot Ribbon Dog Dress Dog Clothes Cozy Dog Shirt Pet Dress
review_headline: Beautiful color dot dress bad quality
review_body: The bow on the dress lasted like 2 days.. Seams looks cheaply done.  Dont waste your money.  The polka dot dress look cute thought.  Got the xsmall for my yorkee and it fit, i bought 2 dresses xsmall and one run smaller than the other.  Not recommended.

product_title: MidWest iCrate Single Door & Double Door Folding Metal Dog Crates
review_body: I had been looking for a while for a used crate similar to the one I already had for my first chug (chihuahua/pug).  The first one was crate was found on craigslist for $20, and was in pretty much new condition.  I had been looking for on for my second chug, also on craigslist. product_title: Little Giant Purple Plastic DuraFork
review_body: My favorite thing about this is the color, The only thing I would change is I would have it come with a handle. I thought it did when I bought it because of the price of it, but it was no big deal because I found one in my garage I could use.

product_title: East Side Collection ZM5084 08 83 Full of Heart Tutu Dress for Dogs, XX-Small, Red
review_body: Great Quality, but I have to agree, it was a little big, but my Yorkie- Bichon Frise is long, so it fit OK. The tutu part hangs a little low, but is not that bad. I worry about running outside.... will it drag? I guess we'll have to find out. Good thing its machine washable. But it really is great quality. Came in perfect quality and fast. product_title: PetFusion SmartGrip Cat Litter Mat. Large (35 x 24 inches). Safe for your cats, free from Phthalates & VCM
review_body: Very contemporary look/design, available in a nice selection of colors.  Catches & holds litter very well, very happy with purchase.

product_title: Quality Pet ID Tags for Dogs and Cats - Bone, Round, Heart, Bow Tie, Badge, Star, Flower, and Rectangle. Front & Backside Engraving. Various Colors and Sizes. Anodized Aluminum.
review_headline: Perfect for our newly adopted dog.

product_title: Large Replacement Squeakers, 2" in diameter, by Downtown Pet Supply
review_body: My dog's toys will last much longer.  Once the squeaker is broken, she loses interest!  We should be set to squeak for a while.

review_body: Our pit puppy loves it.  It's time to order another one.  The head is caved in now and it's wet most of the time, he plays with it all day. He bites on it and slings it around in circles.  Great toy and well constructed.

product_title: Perfect Pet Soft Flap Cat Door with Telescoping Frame
review_body: Was not sure it was big enough, but it is.  Cat has no problem going in and out.  Highly recommended good quality!

product_title: KONG Stuff-A-Ball Dog Toy
review_body: Our 60 lbs lab mix and our 50 lbs dobie mix are both powerful chewers, and this is withstanding their daily abuse admirably.  It also keeps them entertained more so than the regular Kong (the knobby, cone-shaped version), as it rolls and spins on our hardwood floor and keeps them on their toes. product_title: Angels' Eyes Tear-Stain Eliminator for Dogs and Cats, Beef Flavor, 120 Grams Bottle
review_body: Product really works and I don't use it every time I feed my puppy. He eats it mixed up with his food.

product_title: Wellness CORE Natural Grain Free Dry Cat Food
review_body: My cats love it and it's good for them. There's no garbage/filler in it. I've tried giving them the other flavors of Wellness Core, but they like this the best.

product_title: PetSafe Easy Walk Harness
review_body: I love the Easy Walk Dog Harness.  Easy to use, works great. I have a Catahoula/Boxer mix who loves to pull on walks.  I have tried the gentle lead (which works ok, but she hated it).  A friend recommended the Easy Walk Harness saying it worked great for her Dalmation. I love this and my dog does too!

product_title: F.M. Brown's Extreme Natural Mini Spray Millet Bird Treat, 8-Ounce
review_headline: Quality Millet for picky bird owners
review_body: My Love Bird  "Smoky" loves this millet. If I try to sneak a different brand millet in the millet holder, he throws it out and lets me know that he is not fooled. His is only happy when I give him Extreme Natural Millet. When Smoky is happy, daddy is happy!!!

product_title: BREEZE Cat Refill Litter Pellets 3.5 lbs (Pack of 4)
review_body: I have used this system for 18 months, and you cannot beat the ease of cleaning, scooping and no smell.  Of course when cats poo it smell  (like any defacation) but you scoop and discard and you're set.  Pads are easy to check and change.  Will never go back to clay litters...

review_body: Too small.  Doesn't catch enough litter.  Needs to be made more sturdy.  Not the product I thought I was buying.
