review_body: This case for my Galaxy tablet is almost perfect.  I use the tilt feature more than I expected I would.  The two things that I have issues with is that there is not an opening for the power plug so that you can close the case or use the tilt feature when it is charging and the "awake" when you open the case function doesn't always work.  Neither is that big a deal and I'm very pleased that I selected this case.

product_title: Boss Pet Chomper Mongoose Four Prong Squeaker Toy for Pets, Assorted Colors
review_body: The toy arrived and my dog loved it! It bounces in all directions and we had a blast playing with it for about 12 minutes - when one of the knobs broke off with barely and tugging between my pup and I. It was basically garbage. product_title: Merrick Texas Hold Em Lamb Lungs Dog Treats, 12 oz
review_headline: Merrick Texas Hold Em Lamb Lungs.
review_body: My dogs love these treats, and I feel comfortable about buying them because they are US made by the Merrick Company.  Nothing from China.

product_title: TRIXIE Pet Products
review_headline: Make them work for their food
review_body:
The lazy cats don't like it. They don't understand why after all these years they have to work for their food.

But I feel that it's more natural for the cats. It's like making them forage/hunt for their food. Also, it slows down one of my cats from eating too quickly.

product_title: Wysong Epigen Original Chicken Dog and Cat Food Bag, 2-Pound
review_body: The breeder I bought my cats from recommends this product.  My cats LOVE every flavor, although this is the cheapest (and I had to stop the fish one because they seem to be intolerant to all fish products).  There is no junk in this pet food, unlike the ones you can buy in supermarkets.  My only qualm is that it was $5.99 about four-five days ago, and I put it in my basket that evening.  In the morning, it had gone up to $7.24, and now it's $7.80.  So watch your price and don't be afraid to shop around - I've got a local dog food store willing to give me a significant discount if I buy larger quantities, and it's worth it if Amazon's going to keep messing around with pricing.

product_title: Nutramax Cosequin DS Capsules for Dogs
review_body: I have been giving my dog cosequin and dosoquin for many years and it seems to have slowed the progression of his arthritis

product_title: UV Flashlight Pet Urine Detector by Doggone Pet Products - Blacklight Finds Dry Dog & Cat Stains on Carpets, Hard Floors & Paint. Alkaline Batteries Included With 12 LED Ultra Violet Blacklight
review_body: Flashlight is a great help in finding cat's urine and throw up hairball stains on the carpeting. Works best in totally dark rooms.

product_title: Bergan Whirly Pop Cat Toy
review_body: Our cat is a little skittish, like most cats.  At the same time he likes surprises.  So when I saw this I figured he might enjoy it.  Sure enough it has become his new favorite toy.  He will pick it up and carry it around the house.  He will sit next to it and meow when he wants me to "Load it", by turning it inside out, and set it down and wait for it to pop in the air.  The suspense is what gets him.  Anyway our cat loves it, and if you have a cat you probably know they can be finicky.  So your mileage may vary.

product_title: Genuine Leather Dog Collar, Padded Brown, 1.5" Wide. Fits 14"-18" Neck Size , Medium
review_body: I reviewed my item in a very timely manner and so far (2-3 weeks) had held up to my extremely strong dog who has ruined all the rest if the collars I have bought her within 2-3 weeks so I'm very pleased.

product_title: Pet Parade Dog Repeller and Training Aid
review_body: Don't waste your money.  This didn't even slow down the snarling mutt that charged me when I was jogging.  I'm just going to keep carrying the baseball bat with me.

product_title: Nylabone Dura Chew Hollow Stick, Bacon Flavor
review_body: I was really hoping this would entertain our Old English bulldog who destroys everything, but instead she managed to gnaw at this for 5 minutes and she was breaking pieces off and her gums were bleeding.

product_title: Flexrake 2 Story US Cats Condo  1025
review_body: It is very light easy to move around. Our cat did not like to get inside of it. He like sleeping on the top of it.

product_title: Petmate Fresh Flow Replacement Pump 120V without Flow Valve
review_body:
While Amazon cross references to this pump (p/n TP-200-LVU) to replace the TP-180-LV that came with the Petmate fountain, it is physically too big to fit into the filter housing, even after snipping off the housing's pump guides.
After contacting Amazon by phone I received a return label, and it's being dropped off at UPS on Monday.

product_title: K&H Manufacturing Outdoor Kitty House (Heated & Unheated)
review_headline: Wonderful product, but the link to buy the heater later goes to the wrong pad.
review_body: We wanted to get a second pad and followed the link in the description to "buy the heater later". It says it will go to the Lectro-Soft Heated Outdoor Bed, which is the one that is included with the heated house.  It goes instead to a hard pad, Extreme Weather Kitty Pad.

product_title: Zanies small latex dog toy with squeaker
review_headline: A favorite for my mini dachshund!
review_body:
I bought these for my mini dachshund, Embers, and they are just perfect for her small mouth. They are about the size of a large egg and slightly flattened (disc shaped). Two didn't squeak as well as the others (one didn't squeak at all), but she doesn't mind. The squeaker is not a requirement for her to have fun.

We play with these every single night, and we've taught her how to catch them! She looks forward to indoor playtime with these toys... it's been a long winter, but fetch & catch with these helps her get plenty of exercise. We have had these for almost two months now, and even with a couple little punctures, they are still going strong! I will definitely buy again when these are completely destroyed, even though they're a little pricey.

I rated these 4 stars because of the price point, and since two had squeaker problems (which was more disappointing to me).

product_title: IRIS Neat 'n Dry Premium Pet Training Pads, Regular, 17.5" x 23.5"
review_body:
I regret making this purchase for two big reasons.

Firstly, the pads are not adhesive on the back. The pads we were previously using had tape that stuck to our hardwood floors to keep in place (I would give anything to recall the brand). Now our adventurous puppy not only slips and slides on the pads when in her pen playing but has discovered they can be a fun toy! She has started to pick them up and toss them about. Our floor constantly has exposed sections and I have to go in and try to straighten it out. Kind of defeats the purpose.

My other big issue is that they are not amazingly absorbent. She pees and there is dampness underneath the pad. So yes, it does succeed at preventing pee from spreading and keeping her paws drier, but there is unexpected dampness under the pad. The other ones we used were completely dry to the touch.

- we have an 8 week Lab about 11lbs

product_title: Dog Waste Poop Bags, 300 Count Blue, by Bark+
review_body: Poop bags are poop bags. We use these for our little man's icky diapers. They are the best value for the job! These ones are quite thick, no worries about holes/tears, etc. and they contain the stink. Bonus: WAY cheaper than Diaper Genie or other 'baby' poop bags. Mission accomplished!!!

product_title: Argo by Teafco Pet Avion Airline Approved Pet Carrier, Chocolate Brown, Medium
review_body:
We have a 10 lb dog who is quite tall for his weight. The bag is a great size for him. He curls up inside, but still has enough room to turn himself around. It looks great too. Finally, as long as your dog does not whimper, NOBODY will have any idea you have an animal with you.

Overall, a great purchase.

product_title: Zoo Med Repti Therm Under Tank Heater
review_body: This works as advertised.  Easy to install.  Be careful not to pinch cord at all.  I've used for 2 cages and they don't last forever but last a reasonable amount of time (2'ish years?)

product_title: Petstages Tower of Tracks Cat Toy
review_body: My cats are mostly seniors....so they are not impressed with much anymore.  My two younger cats seem to enjoy it.  I toss a little catnip in the grooves and they enjoy it even more.

product_title: GREENIES Original TEENIE Dog Dental Chews Dog Treats
review_body: My dog does not want to eat anything else, so that is what my vet calls her "Greenie addiction".  I've been feeding these for years, and they keep her back teeth sparkling clean.  Still have to get her front teeth cleaned.

product_title: Newton Homeopathics Cough - Asthma for Dogs and Cats
review_body: Its too strong of a product for my cat.  Each time I gave it to him, he either almost threw up or had an asthma attack.

product_title: MidWest Life Stages Heavy-Duty Folding Metal Dog Crates; Single Door & Double Door Dog Crates w/ Divider Panel, Floor Protecting “Roller” Feet & Leak-Proof Plastic Pan
review_body: For the price it is a great deal! It is the perfect size out dog loves it and easy to move around.

product_title: Categories Rollaround Mouse Electronic Cat Toy
review_body: I ordered it the same time as other pet stores but this item took the dealer another week to ship.  They were very slow.  When I got it at last I took it from the package and tried to turn it on- nothing.  I went and got fresh batteries because the ones it comes with are cheap.  I put good batteries in it, it still busted.  Cat never got to play with her toy because it was broken before we got it.  They did not bother to test to see if it worked before they mailed it.  They're pretty slow at responding to e-mails also.

product_title: Wellness CORE Natural Grain Free Dry Cat Food
review_body: Our cat is elderly (19 yo) and is a picky eater; we have to mix this with cheap (really cheap) grocery store dry food at about a 1:1 ratio and then he'll eat it. At least we know he's getting some good nutrition with it. It's a lot cheaper to buy it from amazon than to get it locally, even though we only need to buy it every couple of months.

product_title: Van Ness CP6 Enclosed Cat Pan/Litter Box, Large, Colors may vary
review_body: This is an attractive cat box and tracking of litter is somewhat minimized by the enclosed box and swinging door. It didn't take long for the cats to become accustomed to the door and it doesn't seem to bother them. I no longer have the problem of one cat managing to pee over the side of the litter box and the only scattered litter is from their paws jumping out, not from them flinging it around, digging. I had some problems with the latches for a short time, but it may be because I put the lid on the wrong way. It only goes on properly in one direction, which is different from the other lidded box I have.

product_title: Shearling "Duggz" Pet Shoes
review_body: cute design, good price, the sizing is off. After checking their sizing chart and measuring my pup, I was actually worried that it would be little too big for him. The truth is, that the size runs smaller than described on the chart. I should've gotten Small. Too lazy to return it, oh well, my pup earned 4 new toys.

product_title: Blue Buffalo Wilderness Grain for Cats - Free Chicken Recipe for Cats - (24 pack) 3oz
review_body: I don't know if it's the flavor, texture, smell, or what but our cats won't devour this like they have other brands. We switched to Blue because of the health benefits. The cats love the dry food. I'm going to try another flavor next purchase.

product_title: Precious Cat Ultra Premium Clumping Cat Litter

I was afraid of how the scent might be affecting the cats since they were in other rooms instead of the living room, as though they were hiding.

This collar might be better used if one could snip a peace of the collar and attach it to another collar. But the hard plastic could not be staples to a cloth collar at this time. I hope the company works on this product as I need something to calm my cats. Perhaps

review_body:
About 37 years ago we bought a Rainbow. That was thee best vacum we ever bought. I have never seen a vacum with such suction power as a Rainbow. It cleaned everything. Unfortunately we had to let it go whaen the motor caught fire after 34 years of service. It would have cost more to repair it that it was worth.
We used to get Kirby salesman coming to our door trying sell us one of thier machines. Usually once they heard we had a Raibow they just turned and walked away. One day a Kirby salesman tried to challenge our Rainbow. He came in, unpacked a new machine, attached this clear top filter catridge to the machines discharge port to show us what our machine left behind, sprinkled salt onto the carpet and rubbed into the fibers by hand. He then told me to vacum the area where the salt was with our Rainbow. I did so, without using the power head, only used the regular non-powered carpet head. I went over the spot about 4 times and stopped. He asked if I thought that was enough. I replied yes. The salesman then vacumed the same area I just had and was astounded that there was no salt left to pick up. His filter was clean. No salt or dirt showing. He went over it again and again, still nothing. All I could do was smile. He quietly packed up and left.
If I could afford one today I'd run out and buy one. They are the best!!!!

product_title: Back on Track Therapeutic Quick Leg Wraps
review_body:
I bought these wraps after a recommendation from my trainer.

My horse had been getting slightly swollen legs while in his stall over the last few months. I wanted something to help relieve the swelling and was unsure of what to try.

I got these wraps and have been so happy I have now bought a second pair. They are very easy to put on and take off, especially for someone not used to wraps. There are three short velcro straps and one longer one. The straps all close to the outside, so that makes it easy working out which leg it goes on. Cup the wrap around the fetlock and then attach one strap. Go up (or down) the leg and attach the other two. You can go up and down a few more times to get it on tight enough. Then wrap the very bottom (long) strap around the base of the fetlock - it almost rests on the hoof.

I leave them on him overnight and his legs are great in the morning. Now the swelling is gone from his legs and I use the wraps as needed.

He has a wind puff that has come up on one of his front legs and I am now trying these out to see if it will relieve that too.

They are magic, really. I was a little concerned they may be too hot in the heat of southern california but it has not been the case.

Yes they are a bit expensive to start with, but compare that to the cost of days off riding. It's an easy choice. Buy them!

product_title: Paper Magic Group Zelda Pumpkin Pet Costume
review_body:
If you are looking for an easy, cheep, fun costume, then look no further. This is the costume for you and your pooch! But if you are wanting a neat, durable, professional type costume, then you need to move on and look elsewhere.
This costume is fun. I bought it for my pooch to wear at a pumpkin festival. I was slightly disappointed with the thin, cheep quality of the costume when it arrived, but I paid a cheep price for it so I really wasn't expecting a tuxedo. It got dirty easily and I am afraid to throw it in the wash. It is cheep enough that it might not come out of the wash looking the same again. However, it was a hit at the pumpkin festival. Kids loved the "doggie pumpkin" and flocked to him like flies to butter. It turned out a be a warm day at the festival, so it was a good thing for my dog that the costume is made of thin material. The hat never stayed on, so I finally just took it off and put it in my bag.
All in all, I was basically happy with the costume, but I don't think I will use it again.
-It is not easy to clean. It picks up grass and small sticks like a magnet.
-The hat was basically worthless.
-It is a thin material, so DON'T put it on a rambunctious dog. He'll rip it.
-It is bright and happy. Everyone will love the look of the "pumpkin dog".

review_headline: Entertains dog, but drives me crazy
review_body: The buster cube definitely keeps our dog entertained for longer than other toys and is tough, but on hardwood floors it is LOUD! Plus it's hard for him to flip on hard surfaces. Paws and noses at it for a while then it suddenly pops away or slides. Maybe if your house is carpeted it's a good option, but just a night of it on the hardwood floor is enough for me to put it away. Going to try the Kong wobbler.

product_title: Bicycle Pet Basket
review_headline: so glad i purchased snoozer bike basket.
review_body: loved the sporty bike basket. very well put together and easy to install. my bella just loves it. she went on a ride with me moments after installation now she does her little doggy dance when ever she sees im going for a ride.

product_title: Petnation Port-A-Crate E2 Indoor/Outdoor Pet Home
review_headline: Great Product... but not for active puppies
review_body:
I got this crate as a present for my black Labrador puppy I was getting.

I really like that it was really easy to assembly and break down as needed. It is very sturdy and the material is nice. It makes it seem more like a home for my puppy rather than a wire cage where they have nowhere to be on their own.

My only complaint is the zipper. Granted, my puppy was only 8 weeks when I got her so she was definitely teething majorly. I had created a separater so that the crate seemed smaller to her and a large stuff animal that she loves. However, when the side entrance was zipped all the way, she was still able to chew on the zipper train, which caused it to break. So now I can't close the side zipper. To keep her in, I have to turn the crate around with the door facing a wall and put her in from the top. It's harder to pick her up, especially since she is like 30lbs now.

But overall, I love the design of the crate, just wished the zipper were sturdier to prevent teething puppies from breaking the zipper train.

product_title: Pill Gun
review_body: If it wasn't for this Pill Gun I'd seriously have no fingers left! All three of my cats hate taking medication but having a pill gun makes med time so much easier! This is a must have for sure.

product_title: Multipet Plush Dog Toy
review_body: This toy is carried around by our rescue Jack Russell and has not been ripped to pieces, we like to think it is because he thinks of it as a human and loves it. He has many because humans are not supposed to keep saying Oh No as it get on anyone's nerves even a dog.

product_title: Qpets Automatic Pet Feeder
review_body: We set our clock and feeding schedule and it worked for less than 3 days before everything randomly erased and reset itself. We set the clock and feeding schedule again and a few days later it reset again. We cannot depend on this to feed our cat when we are gone. Not worth the money.

product_title: SureFlap Microchip Cat Flap
review_headline: needed a secure cat door to keep invading cats out
review_body: This door really met my needs for letting my cat in and out but keeping neighborhood cats OUT!!  The only problem was it is a little small for a "large" size adult cat.  My cat weighs 13 pounds and she has to squeeze through it.  This made the initial training more difficult and she was used to using a cat door--but one that accommodated her size.  I'm happy with it.

product_title: KONG Naturals Incline Scratcher Cat Toy
review_body: Cats will not touch it. I set it up and put a ton of catnip on it but the cats do no go anywhere near it. Tried moving it around and nothing. I am now the proud owner of a brand new scratcher. I give it 4 stars because it seems to be well made but it is not for my cats.

product_title: Ultra Paws Traction Dog Boots
review_body: As others have said, definitely purchase a size or two smaller than you think, I have a 110 lb Ridgeback and bought the large size, but should have Medium.  These traction boots have helped but do spin on his feet, I have applied "Shoe Goo" to the other side to help when then spin.  My dog does enjoy wearing these which is a pleasant surprise.

product_title: Armarkat Pet Bed Mat, Ivory
review_body: I took a chance on this product because of the mostly good reviews here on amazon.  I have two dogs but my issue is my youngest who still has a habit of ripping into things- especially pillows.  This bed is simply two pillows together sealed in plastic and you simply put the cover over it and zip it up.  No issues washing it and since day one, he has loved this bed.  Never tried to bite it and when in doubt, he's in the bedroom sleeping on his bed.  He  loves the bed so much that he growled at my older dog when he approached the cage!!  I ended up buying a second bed and although my oldest likes it as well,  he still climbs on the bed at night--not a bad thing though  If you have a dog that's like my youngest, this purchase is worth it!!!!

product_title: PetSafe Busy Buddy Twist 'n Treat Dog Toy
review_headline: Had good success with bully breeds
review_body: I'm surprised to find that dogs have chewed this up, because it is the one toy my 2 pit bull and american bulldog have not altered in any way. I've tried many many toys and this one has held up. Maybe because I coat the inside with peanut butter and canned food they lick at it more than chomp. It will take them forever to finish it like that and my dogs love it.

product_title: Groovypets® Remote Dog Training Shock Collar Trainer / Rechargeable Dog Collar for No Bark Obedience Behavioral Training
review_body: My wife purchased this unit to replace our old unit that fell off our yellow lab.  She chose this unit because it fit our check list such as vibration & multiple levels of shock strength as well as water resistance; but most importantly, it was $100 cheaper than the unit we had previously owned.  WHAT A MISTAKE!!!  The battery life was insufficient, the range was inconsistent, the functionality was shotty at best.  The construction of the unit was poor, as it shattered while the dog was out running through the woods.  Save yourself the headache, and spend the extra $$$ for a sturdy device that is reliable and well built.

product_title: New BestPet Pink Sporty Pet Jogger Jogging Dog Cat Stroller Carrier
review_body: Just what we were looking for. Couldn't be happier unless it had been free and made of gold. JK. We are totally please and it fits our purposes prefectly. Nice and sturdy, big wheels were and are essential, material was great and color very pleasing. Wouldn't change the way it's made at all. :-)

product_title: Da Bird Pull Apart Value Pack (1 Pull Apart Da Bird Pole Cat Toy & 2 Extra Guinea Feather Refills)
review_body: This. Is. The. Best. Cat. Toy. Ever. Yes, even better than the much coveted Red Dot! Even my fat old tom, who actually sits and waits for the Red Dot to come within a foot of him before beginning to feign interest, will get up and chase this toy. I have to keep it hidden in a cabinet between play times because my cats will not leave it alone. They now sit in front of the cabinet and "ask" for their favorite toy to be brought out!

product_title: KONG Rubber Ball Extreme
review_body:
Only negative I can think of is that it's a very dense ball so it sounds like a bowling ball if you bounce it on the floor
But it's the only thing my dog can't seem to destroy

product_title: OASIS  #81010 Bird Bottle for Small Caged Birds -Green, 4-Ounce
review_body: I brought this water bottle for my bird cage.  I have a Vision cage http://www.amazon.com/gp/product/B0012DOXEI/ref=oh_details_o04_s00_i00?ie=UTF8&psc=1.  It became a pain to change the water dish every day.  It was also problematic when away from home for 1-2 days or over a weekend.  I decided to buy this product to provide clean water to my parakeet.  Have been using the water bottle since July 2013 with no leaks and issues and my bird drinks out of it.  I place the bottle near a perch that the bird can stand on and change the water in the bottle once a week.

product_title: Sofantex Micromink Sherpa Lined Pet Bed, 22-Inch
review_headline: Super pet bed for super pet
review_body: This pet bed is so soft and nicely design. The color is as appeared in a picture and the material feels so comfortable. I would definitely buy one more in the future when I have another dog.

product_title: Bayer Advantage II for Large Cats Over 9 lbs, 6 Pack
review_body: I have been using this since I got it originally from the vet 1 1/2 years ago. I have had people visit my home who had flea's in there home from the dog and still haven't gotten any fleas. The neighbor's cat upstairs came and sat by my door and didn't get any then either. This is the same as what I got from the vet but at a 1/3 less the costs. Sometimes it really pays to shop.

product_title: Solvit Tagalong Pet Booster Seat, Deluxe
review_headline: this pet booster seat is awsome
review_body: when it arrived and we put it together it fits both of my shitzus yes both can lay in this bed. but this is a good thing at least I know they can move around and be comfortable, we placed it on the floor near the window and yup" it instantly became the cats new bed,, well as soon as she left it later on my female shitzu instantly took it over, needless to say all 3 of my pets love this. so it will be no problem when it is finally placed in the vehicle for the intended purpose, not a kitty bed we plan on ordering another one so both shitzus will have their own when we travel, it is  a nice size I would not want any thing smaller my shitzus range in wt size about 20#  each so this is great,,

product_title: Pet Clothes BARKING DIVA Dog T-Shirt
review_body: Fits my little "step granddaughter" well. A barker and a chubby little girl. We had to reorder in a larger size.

product_title: Pet Naturals Hairball
review_body: My kitten nor my adult cat wouldn't eat them.  I did break them into smaller pieces but that didn't help.

product_title: Absorbine Veterinary Liniment Gel
review_body: I used the Absorbine Vet for my wrist and also my back and it works great. This is better than any prescription medication they only make you feel sick....and don't heal you.  My wrist is now healed, it took around 6 months but it worked.  I have been using this for over 15 years.....

product_title: Interpet Limited Superpet Roll The Hay Wheel
review_body: It's just so hard for them to get it out of the space. It's still a great product just rather large, have to have a large cage to hold the large wheel.

product_title: 180, 220, 500, 700, 880, 960, 2200 Dog Pet Waste Poop Bags, Bulk roll,Clean up refills-(Green, Blue, Purple, Red, Black, Pink,Rainbow of Colors or Paw Print)+FREE Bone Dispenser,Downtown Pet Supply
review_headline: Great Price and Does the Job!
review_body: While these bags are thinner the ones i usually get, they were thick enough, and large enough to get the job done for my 100 pound dog and the price was excellent.  Delivered quickly and as expected.  Will buy these again when the time comes.

product_title: Kurgo Car Door Dog Cover— Includes 2 Pet Car Door Guards
review_body: Got these this week to put in our new car. The are nicely made, super easy to install and will do well to protect the door panels from my Spaniel. However, they have a long strip of exposed Velcro running down the back (intended to make it easy for you to make them shorter) which, left exposed will definitely scratch the door they are intended to protect. Right now I have some tape covering the strips, but this could be better thought out.

product_title: HDP Knee Cap Bone Made in USA
review_body: These bones are wonderful, my diabetic lab loves them.  He can no longer have raw marrow bones but can have these and he's in heaven.  Thank you so much for a great product, I've tried others and they're not nearly as good.  Thank you so much.

product_title: PetSafe Indoor Ultrasonic Bark Control, Up to 25 ft. Range, No Collar Needed, Anti-Bark
review_body: Unfortunately it didn't work for my neighbor's dog, which is not to say it won't work on other breeds.  I even tried holding it over the fence and pressing the button.  No positive reaction from the dog.  "Yes, I did put a battery in the  device".  :)

product_title: FOUR PAWS PRODUCTS 456900 Red Cable Dog Tieout, 10-Feet
review_headline: Great leash for home / office use
review_body: Needed a leash to secure Le Mutt (30 pound Beagle) in an office, as she was smart enough to chew through cloth leashes. Works like a charm. Good length (10') for the office and to prevent her getting too tangled up.

product_title: Chasing Our Tails Elk Rack Snack, 100-Percent All Naturally Shed ElkAntler Chew, Large Size 7-Inch to 10-Inch, For up to 75# Dogs
review_headline: Big Dog Approval from Mr. Ridgeback himself
review_body: Our dog finds these a great energy burner when he wants to chew. No problems with splinters or mess on the rugs or floor, and easily stored in his basket for future fun. A little spendy but guarantees hours of chewing pleasure.

product_title: YKS For Pet Cat Bell The Dangle Faux Mouse Rod Roped Funny Fun Play Playing Toy by T.G.I. Store
review_body: This cat toy was a pretty cheap poorly made product. The mouse toy was ok, but the stick it came on was verrry flimsy. My cats like it so I guess its ok.

product_title: Plastic Emulational Decorative Fake Green Leaf Plant Underwater for Aquarium Fish Tank Home Decoration by TheBigThumb
review_body: My Betta, frogs and shrimp all use this plant to sleep or hide. It is soft, no rough or pointy edges. About the size of your open hand (small female hand), spreads out looks good and the color is great. Very sturdy and well made.

product_title: Imagine This, Bone Magnet, Plastic, 2x7 Inches
review_headline: Exactly what I was looking for
review_body: Excellent quality, strong magnet, perfect size. What more is there? Love it. I take it off when going thru the carwash, just in case.

product_title: Medium (5"-7") Elk Dog Chew Treat - Top Dog Chews
review_body: I'm disappointed in the antler I received.  It is very small in both length and diameter.  I'm even rather worried that my 7 month old puppy may accidently be able to swallow it whole.  I guess I expected more for the $$.  Wanted to try out Elk antlers but will go back to Newts Deer Antlers.

product_title: Casual Canine Reflective Jacket for Dogs
review_body: I ordered XXL and should have gone with XL. Our Labradoodle is more Lab than Poodle so she is big, but not that big apparently. Good price and quality.

product_title: Merrick Grain Free Real Pork and Sweet Potato Dry Dog Food
review_body: A few months ago I switched to feeding my dogs Merrick's Grain Free food from two other brands. We were growing out of puppy food for one of them, so I wanted them on the same food. The other dog was on a weight control product, so that wasn't appropriate. After discussing with a local boutique pet supply store, I liked what I thought to be a product that I could switch flavors without going through a transition process, just a change of protein. After a few weeks of converting all seemed well and the dogs loved the new flavors. I was on my third bag, bought from Amazon and this pork flavor was much more oily than the 2 previous flavors. It didn't sit with either dog well at all. I bought another bag of a different flavor and sat the pork aside. The dogs didn't care for the single flavor even after going back to the very first bag I had moved them over to. I ended up going to a different brand and used that bag to transition them to the new product. I still don't know why the pork product was so different than the chicken or buffalo, but it had to be put in the garbage. I'm disappointed it didn't work out as there were more flavor options than the other brands.

product_title: Excelvan Remote Control Dog Training Shock Collar for 2 Dogs with 100LV of Shock and Vibration, Rechargeable and Waterproof
review_body: For the price, you can't go wrong. I have used it for a month and the only problem is the battery life. I suggest charge when not in use.

product_title: Cloud Star Soft and Chewy Buddy Biscuits, Lamb Flavor, 6-Ounce Pouches (Pack of 4)
review_body: All I have to do is say "do you want a treat" and he is jumping all over the place with happy anticipation.

product_title: Conair Dog Palm Battery Powered Micro-Trimmer
review_headline: Conair Dog Palm Battery Powered Micro-Trimmer Is Excellent
review_body:
This is my second micro-trimmer by Conair. I have been using my first trimmer for over 5 years until the on/off switch stopped working a week ago. I opened up the trimmer to see if I could fix it but couldn't. I went to Amazon and found the same trimmer and ordered it, and got it within two days.

I use it to trim around my Maltese face and the bottom of her foot pads. I like this trimmer because it is battery powered and is quiet. I don't like to get out my 110v trimmer just to trim her face and pads, and so this does the job for touch-up areas.

product_title: Kong Classic Dog Toy
review_body: durable my dog love it. we play together with it and we really have a nice time playing together. the color is very nice too.

product_title: Zack & Zoey Polyester Nor'easter Dog Blanket Coat, X-Large, Navy
review_body: I really like this product. The only reason why it didn't get five stars is that it was not as thick as I thought it would be and it takes a very long time to ship.

product_title: Crinkits 8 Oz Water Bottle Dog Toy
review_body: I had no luck getting a bottle into this toy much to the chagrin of my pooch. I tired different sizes and materials but couldn't get any regular water bottle in because the material prevents the bottle from penetrating.  Don't buy this toy.

product_title: Safari® Cat Shedding Comb
review_body: I have a Persian cat and so far this brush seems to be working well. I don't find that it helps with the shedding as much as the other reviews, but it does definitely remove a lot of dead fur.

product_title: Posture Pro Double Diner
review_body: It took me 5.6 seconds to set this up from the box. The legs just pop out!! and they are sturdy, well made, doesnt stain from water, great bowl!

product_title: Merrick Training Dog Treats, 5 oz
review_body: These are basically the same thing as the Bah-Bah-qs that have sadly been discontinued. My dog loves them and they are something I can feel comfortable giving more freely. They are not hard but not soft, kind of like a cheese puff.

product_title: Conair Yellow Dog Round-Tip Shears, Dog Home Grooming
review_body: Bought these for a Yorkie. I like the round tip. Worked out beautifully. Would recommend to anyone who has a small dog.

product_title: HomeoPet Anxiety Relief
review_headline: Good price for something that works
review_body: This stuff works really well for my French bulldog on the few occasions his back muscles tighten-up and he needs a quick fix until the medicine has time to relax him.

product_title: Jardin Suction Cup Airline Tube 20-Piece Holders/Clips/Clamps for Aquarium, Clear
review_body: Very good quality, strong suction even at smooth dry surfaces. I do not have any problem with this product. Thumps Up.

product_title: Silly Squeaker iBall Dog Toy - 3 Pack
review_body: They love these things. They try and try to rip them apart with no success. The squeaker wears out but they still play with them. They like to rip the fur off and get at the eyes but those are safe because they are embroidered on. The white/brown is their favorite next is pink last is black but all get regular use.

product_title: Pioneer Pet Big Max Ceramic Drinking Fountain for Pets, White
review_headline: Great Fountain - Be Sure To Clean The Pump
review_body:
To be honest, I originally came here to leave a much less favorable review. Last night, just over one month after purchasing this fountain, the pump stopped working. Since I clean the fountain every other day, I mistakenly assumed that the pump motor had already malfunctioned and would need to be replaced. Then I noticed zips veggie's review about a video that shows how to open up the pump and clean it. A quick internet search (the link zips veggie had provided was apparently removed...) yielded exactly what I needed. The video is titled "Pioneer Pet Raindrop Fountain Pump Maintenance 101" and can be found on YouTube. A quick 1-2 minute cleaning later and the pump is working the same as always, much to the delight of my cat!

This is a good fountain that has done wonders to encourage my finicky cat to drink more water, and it is also enjoyed by my two dogs and four ferrets. I'm definitely happy with this purchase! Just be sure to clean that pump thoroughly before replacing it if it should stop working!

product_title: Chuckit! Small Ultra Duo Tug
review_body:
This toy is great! It's tough to find good toys that aren't trashed after a few minutes. This one is really well made, of good quality materials. The colors are very bold and bright. The ball is firm, just a little squishy, with textured bumps, so the chewers really like to have a go at it. It's perfect for fetching, even indoors -- the ball has just enough bounce to make it fun to chase, and not so much that it goes crazy and ends up making havoc somewhere.
The dogs loved it instantly.
I recommend this toy, and will purchase again.

product_title: PetAlive Ear Dr. - Ear Drops for Pets (30ml)
review_body:
The vet diagnosed my shar pei with a gram negative bacteria- really nasty stuff. He'd was on antibiotics for thirty days and still the infection persisted. It broke my heart almost to tears, he would cry and whine when we'd even touch it to clean it out :( His ears were smelly, gunky, with thick gooey stuff that crusted around his ear hair...

This stuff cleared all that. I'm not even kidding. The first day the smell was gone, then after a little over a week the gunky stuff and gooey-ness started to disappear. After about a month it was all gone!! I took my little boy to the vet and low and behold the infection is gone! My vet doesn't believe me, (ex-vet) he doesn't believe in "natural remedies" but this did what dangerous anitbiotics couldn't!

I still use it for maintainance as part of his ear cleaning (you know those shar pei ears are like little lids!) and it is wonderful!

product_title: Got Yo Gifts Pomeranian Mirrored Acrylic Keychain
review_body: I carry my dog wherever I go as it looks like my little Baby! I've gotten lots of compliments from those who see it and want to know where I got it and if they have other dog breeds. I tell them to log on and look...that's what I did and foundthis treasure!

product_title: Standlee Premium Western Forage Orchard Grass, 25lb Box
review_body: My guinea pigs and rabbits both love they're grass from Standlee.. This is our third purchase and will continue to use Standlee.. Nice green grass!!

product_title: Suede Dog Bed By Majestic Pet Products

review_body: Nice material. Not as big as you would expect, but a good size for my 50lb dog. Not good if your dog slobbers

product_title: Oster Professional Turbo A5 2-Speed Heavy Duty Detachable Blade Animal Clipper with #10 Blade 078005-314-003
review_body: This has made shaving my cats fur so much faster and easier.  The only draw back is that it is louder than I would like.  My cats do not like it because of the noise.  But since it gets the job done fast I am able to manage.

product_title: Charming Pet Products Grampa Hippie Chick Squeaky Latex Dog Toy
review_body: My dog loves these chickens and is always happy when she has a least one of them to "kill" as I prepare her dinner.

product_title: PetSafe Busy Buddy Tug-A-Jug Meal Dispensing Dog Toy
review_headline: Keeping our dog busy - lessening cabin fever.
review_body: It has been a long, cold, snowy, icy winter so far and since I am pregnant I can't get the dogs out to walk like I normally would.  I feel quite bad for them as they seem to be board so i decided to make their dinner time more of a challenge.  At first our german shepard/lab mix couldn't figure out how to get his food out of this puzzle and gave up after a while.  We kept encouraging him and he eventually figured it out.  Unfortunately in the process he chewed it closed and now we cannot open the container.  We have to feed the food through the top which takes forever!  The good part is he loves it now!  It takes him a long time to finish his dinner now and I think it has helped with his cabin fever.  I gave it a four star because he was able to chew it closed.

product_title: Dogipot Litter Bags - 200 bags
review_body: Perfect size.  Sometimes pick up after more  than one dog.  Can't see through them. I've tried many brands snd these are the best.

product_title: Integrity Bedding Orthopedic Memory Foam Joint Relief Bolster X-Large Pet Dog Bed - Toffee
review_body: Best bed we ever bought for our large dog.  He can actually fit on it without hanging off.  Like a temper pedic for your dog.

product_title: SportDOG Rechargeable Bark Control Collar
review_body: It was with great reluctance that I purchased this collar. I had hoped to divert my dog's attention and distract her from barking at the new neighbors everytime they were in their backyard. Of course it doesnt help that the new kids kick their ball at the fence and startles her HOWEVER, since my other two dogs jave adjusted to children next door so it was irritating that she wouldnt. First day I put the collar on, it was eerily quiet. I spied on her she seemed fine & when she spotted me, she was just as "crazy wiggly happy" as if she didnt have it on....just quiet.  She has not needed to go beyond the first level of training which surprises me because she has such strong drive. I highly recommend this collar to anyone at their wits end with their otherwise wonderful fur-legged companion!

product_title: KONG Naturals Double Scratcher Cat Toy
review_body: The kitties love this cardboard scratcher and it's standing the test of time.  I've gotten smaller ones at the dollar store, but this one is sturdy enough not to move too much under enthusiastic scratching.

product_title: Andis Pet Steel Grooming Comb (65730)
review_headline: Must have for any long haired dog
review_body: I have a miniature schnauzer, standard schnauzer, and bouvier des flandres.  They all tend to mat if not combed properly.  I used a slicker brush, but it doesn't get down to the skin.  I love this comb; however, it is uncomfortable on the hand.  It needs to have a rubber or wooden top instead of metal.

product_title: PupLight2 Twice as Bright with Reflective Dog Safety Collar
review_body: They are  so good for my dogs and myself,  at night I can spot them immediately , no more having to bundle up looking for them, can't say enough good  things about this product.

product_title: Comfort Zone Refill with D.A.P. for Dogs
review_body: I am so happy that I broke down and tried this product at my Vet's recommendation. We just adopted a 3 yr old rescue dog (lab mix) and he was having problems sleeping at night which was obnoxious as a parent of 2 small children. He was also a nervous wreck during the day whenever we would leave for work. He would pace and whine as soon as he saw our coats. It was awful. Tried crating him and he escaped every time. He was getting destructive around the house when we would put up baby gates so I had to do something. After 1 night having the diffuser in the bedroom, he slept so peacefully. He can even be left out during the day (with baby gates) and does fine now. It took a few days for the separation anxiety and the destructive behavior to ease up but now I will never let my diffuser go empty. I only wish I would have had this product sooner! Highly recommend to anyone adopting a new dog or getting a puppy!!

product_title: KONG Frog Dog Toy, Extra Small, Green
review_headline: seriously this is a dog toy?
review_body: This is ridiculously small. It seems more like a hamster toy then a dog toy. Maybe if you have a teacup poodle or something its ridiculous. When they came I was like REALLY? Its like the size of a pencil topper. TEEEEEENY TINY I have a daschund and I wanted a few toys for traveling this one would fit in my wallet nearly. Boo buyer beware READ the dimensions. Its more like a too scale stuffed frog for barbie

product_title: Baskerville 5-Inch Rubber Ultra Muzzle
review_headline: Effective but can cause other issues.
review_body:
I have a 95 pound Rottweiler who ended up cutting the tendon in his paw. He required stitches, At first I used a collar but he broke that. Then I used a double collar. He broke that as well. I eventually moved to a mesh muzzle but it was ineffective at keeping him from picking at his paw. Eventually i moved to this muzzle. It kept my dog from ripping his bandage. He was still able to drink water and clean himself.

The issue that arose from this muzzle is it rubbed into his face. My dog was constantly trying to get it off and pushing the muzzle into everything he could. It eventually caused a skin infection where the muzzle touched the skin. This led to me having to remove the muzzle sooner than I had intended.

If you do plan on using this muzzle I recommend you buy mole skin and wrap the muzzle with it. This should reduce the damage that the hard rubber/plastic frame will do to your dogs face.

product_title: Catit Design Senses Fountain with Water Softening Cartridge, 3L
review_body: I used to own the previous model of this which was green and white. I ended up buying a large dog fountain from the same company for my two large dogs and the cat ended up drinking from that .  So I gave my cat fountain away and regretted it soon after. Now that one of our dogs has passed away and those filters became harder to find I was in need of another cat fountain as I was finding my Siamese cat meeting me at every faucet crying for me to turn on the water. I've also had a cat pass away from urinary crystals and it was an expensive and sad process. I found this item and it appeared to be the same just upgraded and I bought one. My kitty loves it and since he was familiar with the design he proceeded to drink and drink and drink. It's very quiet and therefore it doesn't startle him like the freshwater fountain did. I also found that the filters are very easy to rinse out and really do last a long time.

product_title: Carnivore Crunch Freeze Dried Dog Treats-4_OZ-CHICKEN
review_body: Don't assume by the price that you will get 3 packs of treats like the other sellers are offering. This is a deceptive picture of the product for sale.

product_title: FURminator deShedding Ultra Premium Shampoo
review_body: This leaves our GSD smelling like a tropical drink, feeling soft and looking beautiful.  After a bath, our dog needs lots of brushing to remove the fur that is loosened up by the shampoo.  I'd give it 5 stars if it had conditioner built in - it's such a hassle to bathe the dog, and combining shampoo with conditioner in one step would be great. What a hoot watching these two pampered puff-balls burying their imaginary wildebeest.

They also thrive on this food. I do supplement it with a small amount of wet/canned food which is more for ceremony/routine than anything. These dry kibbles are their main source of nourishment, and they've had nothing but a healthy life eating it. I leave it out for them at all times, and neither is underweight or overweight. Everything looks right in the letterbox, and there's no smell whatsoever.

review_body: This will work, but the tubing was dirty, and crimped in places.  Expected it to be more rigid, maybe I'm just out of the aquarium loop

product_title: ProMeris For Medium Dogs 22 - 55 Pounds 6 Pack USA Version / EPA Registered
review_body:
The description says "ProMeris for Medium Dogs 6 Pack USA Version"

I received ProMeris for Extra Large Dogs. It was also a 3 pack, and all instructions and packaging are in Hebrew.

product_title: Allied Precision 1 Qt. Heated Bowl Plastic
review_body: I put it on the step so I didn't use extension cord. It did keep the water from getting frozen on the days it was 10 below zero. But it seem to evaporate fast, had to keep watching it to keep it filled up. Glad I sent for it.

product_title: Petego Cars Front Seat, Rear Seat, Hammock Seat, Interior Protector, Seat Cover for Cars, Minivans, SUVs, and Trucks
review_body:
I hunted high and low for the best price for this hammock. Not sure what it is listed for now, but I got a great deal here. I read all the reviews and was unsure whether to buy the larger version or the smaller version. I actually did purchase the smaller version by accident from another merchant - they had misidentified it. Sure enough the smaller/regular product wasn't the best fit for my VW Jetta. So, that got returned and the larger product IS big, but I prefer it that way. I previously had a hammock from Orvis-worked great, dogs loved it...BUT the foam backing disintegrated over time; the fabric trapped their shedding fur and their fur also suck up underneath the edges of the hammock.
The Petego Hammock (the larger one) will prevent all of the above. The only thing that doesn't fit so great are the bands that fit across the front seats-perhaps it's because it is made for a larger vehicle, but that concern is mainly an aesthetic one. The hammock is easy to keep clean. The dogs do not slide around on it. It's very durable. I am glad I made this purchase.

product_title: TetraFin Goldfish Flakes
review_body: my goldfish love this food they gulp it up every time I feed them. They are growing nice and healthy

product_title: GREENIES Original Large Dog Dental Chews Dog Treats

review_body: I have a 60lbs pure white female boxer and she loves her little shirt.We bought it for her because she loves to go out and bake herself in the Arizona summers. Her older brother, a 80lbs white boxer developed tumors because of sunbathing so we wanted to avoid that issue with her. The only reason it did receive a full 5 stars is because it has to be hand washed, and if you have a puppy like ours, that is 2 to 3 times a week. We also have a pure white one for her older brother now.

product_title: JW Pet Company Chompion Dog Toy (Colors Vary)
review_body: My dogs love this.  They will play with this for hours.  Very well made.  I have big dogs that can destroy anything, so I was happy with this product.

product_title: Ware Manufacturing Home Sweet Home Sunseed Guinea Pig Cage Starter Kit
review_body: Way too small for a guinea pig. My Guinea was soo unhappy until I got him a better cage! Maybe good for hamster

review_body: Before ordering this Kitty Pad, I owned another from the same company and it was an excellent product.  I could roll the pad or fold the pad in order to get it in a small space where the cat slept.  This pad, however is a solid plastic pad with a cover over it.  The pad heats well but do not purchase it if you want to get it into a small space because you need an entrance the size of the solid plastic case or you are out of luck getting it into a small enclosure.  What annoyed me was that you can not tell what the pad is actually like from the picture or the specifications.  The pad does a good job keeping the cats warm, if you can get it into the cathouse!

product_title: Home On-The-Go Dog Crate in Black
review_body: This crate is amazing. It takes less than a minute to set up or collapse. The metal isn't as thick and sturdy as an un-collapsable crate, but the ease and durability is still top notch.

product_title: Nutri-Vet Enzymatic Chicken Flavored Canine Toothpaste, 2.5 Ounce
review_body: This product has really helped improve my dogs' oral health. Daily application has cut down on bad breath and my dogs enjoy the flavor.

product_title: Taste of the Wild Grain-Free Dry Dog Food for Puppy
review_headline: Soft, pungent and massive puppy poo.
review_body: We have a 5 month German Shepherd/Standard poodle puppy. She enjoyed this food, but it made her have really loose (almost liquid) stool in large quantities that was orange in color coupled with a horrific smell. After buying the food, we read more reviews and found that other dogs had experienced the same thing. We switched her to Earthborn Holistic grain-free in bison flavor and she loves it. Her poop is now normal in all aspects. I would recommend skipping this food and going with Earthborn.

product_title: MidWest Homes for Pets Foldable Metal Exercise Pen / Pet Playpen, 8 Panels Each
review_body: This is a fabulous product!  We purchased two and used them both while our puppy was growing up. We still use them when traveling and staying in other people's homes that are not "dog people".

review_body: It's beautiful, but definitely didn't last long. If your dog is a puller or a biter you will have the most raggedy worn out leash in no time at all. The leather wears out when pulled or just used too often. If you want a leash based on looks alone, buy this one. If you want it to last more than a month or two buy something else. Pretty, though!

product_title: Neater Feeder Mess-Proof Pet Bowls, Large, Stainless
review_body: Bought two - one for cat and one for dog.  Was skeptical but after receiving and using for more than 6 months I have to say they were worth it.

product_title: Grizzly Pollock Oil Supplement for Dogs
review_body: Easy to use and is tasty for the dogs- makes a huge difference in the skin and fur - soft and shiny!

product_title: Catit Style Scratcher with Catnip Tiger

This wasnt too bad for the price but it wasn't the most durable scratcher I have ever bought.  The front design ripped off the same day I got it and there is no base so when you pour catnip on it the catnip just leaks right through the holes and onto the floor.

product_title: MidWest iCrate Single Door & Double Door Folding Metal Dog Crates
review_body: I love this! It has been strong and our dog hasn't been able to get out of it when we put him to bed. Just the right size for a small dog. Still gives him plenty of room. And it wasn't that bad to put together.

product_title: SUREswivel 360 degree Swiveling Pet Tie-Out, Made in the USA
review_body: stable and the swivel works great.  I put it on the edge of a mulched bed & am keeping it there to use frequently when I work in the front yard & my JRT want's to be with me.  I don't have to worry about her taking off to explore the neighborhood or try to chase the next car that comes by!

product_title: PET PROOF - Clear Acrylic Keyboard Protection Cover
review_body: It would have been a 5 Stars, however it slides on the desk and my cat was able to push it off the desk.  I put  Velcro on 2 corners and on the desk, and now it is fine.

product_title: MidWest iCrate Single Door & Double Door Folding Metal Dog Crates
review_body: I shopped around for kennels for a while and to be honest with you, based on the price I was extremely skeptical about this kennel. I received it earlier than expected and the quality is excellent. I will continue using this seller.

review_body: There were quite a few broken worms in the packages I bought and some black debris which were definitely not worms, almost seemed rock like about the size of a dime.  The chickens still ate them, but the quality control bothers me.  Also, this product is imported from China which was not clear in the product description.

product_title: Pet Laser Toy Dog Cat Toy 5 Patterns Pointer 5 Pattern Needn't to Change Head(without batteries)
review_body: I guess the description did say that batteries were not included. I just didn't notice that. My mistake. Wish I had noticed that before purchasing! Since I ordered this, I have seen this item in stores, cheaper, with batteries included.

product_title: Merrick Grain Free Dry Dog Food

review_body: This dog food had way too much protein in it for my dogs. I have three dogs and while they were on this food, they all had diarrhea.They had so much poop on this food, until it finally ran out now everything is back to normal.

product_title: Coastal Pet Products 763919 80045R Sponge Balls 4Pk Cat
review_body: Good product- arrived on time & my cat loves it.  Not much else to say- it doesn't shred easily, which is a good thing :)

product_title: Gooby Padded Cold Weather Vest for Small Dogs with Safe Fur Guard Zipper Closure
review_headline: Perfect winter coat for my French Bulldog!
review_body: I was unsure what size to get for my 26 lb French Bulldog, but I went by the size chart (she was between sizes) and sized up to an XL and the vest could not fit better!! The quality of the Gooby vest seems great and between the fleece lining and down-like stuffing, she will stay as warm as can be on our upcoming ski trip to Colorado. Very stylish as well - I love the Kelly green color. I would recommend this vest in an XL for all Frenchies!

product_title: Flexi Durabelt Soft Grip Retractable Belt Dog Leash, 16-Feet Long
review_headline: It sticks and it is not soft at all
review_body: Sorry, I love duraflex; but this belt sticks and the handle is not one bit soft at all.  Very surprised at that

product_title: PetSafe ScoopFree Self Cleaning Litter Box
review_body:
After having multiple pieces fail and being left with a "ball" which was hard to clean, getting out of the Litter Robot was a must.
Searching Amazon, I stumbled upon this item and boy, I'm glad I switched.
Let me begin by stating we have 2 cats and 1 is very fussy about his litter. If the box is not clean, hes looking for other places. What's so great about this product is 4lbs of litter will last a week with little to no maintenance necessary. The cats "business" stays within the box and the crystals quickly dissipate nasty odors. Even the screen seems to stay relatively clean with minor touch-ups being performed during the week.
Are the crystals more expensive....yes. Is it worth it.... absolutely. An 8lb bag costs around 10 dollars at walmart. 4lbs a week without needing to add much is 5 bucks/week. Sweet considering we are not throwing pounds of litter away like the old box.
I feel as though the plastic, re-useable tray is a must. That item is pricey and I felt robbed when making the purchase "its a piece of plastic" BUT it cleans quickly and has held up for 6 months.
Another bonus from this product is the electronics cannot be contaminated by the waste. Sealed unit and according to the website, tested for thousands of cycles without failure.
Make the purchase, you wont be dissapointed.

product_title: Wardley Tropical Fish Food Flakes - 6.8oz
review_headline: My fish are thriving on this fish food
review_body: I have been feeding my fish for about a year with the Wardley Tropical Fish Flake Food.  The fish have been doing very well with this food, they eat it very enthusiastically at feeding times, 2X per day.  The larger size container available on Amazon is convenient and economical, it costs much less than purchasing the food in smaller containers from the pet supply store.

product_title: Fluval View Aquarium, 4-Gallon
review_body: I really love this aquarium.  It's very easy to set up and the end result is a picture perfect tank.  I have a Betta and 10 cherry shrimp that share it together. There is plenty of room and the viewing is wonderful. I like the fact that the filter and heater ( which you must add ) are hidden from view.  A small 25 watt heater should fit inside the filter compartment, but you will need to add this to keep tropical fish ( like Bettas ) happy. Drawback is that be very careful not to scratch the sides, it does scratch easily. I would recommend this tank to anyone who wants a beautiful, functional, and easy tank to enjoy.

product_title: Kaytee Vitamin Hay Diet Rabbit
review_body: It is so hard to find rabbit food without filler (corn, wheat, soy). I didn't understand for my first several years of rabbit keeping just how much of their diet should be hay. This hay is both food and hay in one. It is a really great enriched hay. I still feed a little bit of pellets, but much less than I used to. Their poop is better & even coats & weight look better. Nothing else out there like this!

product_title: K&H Manufacturing Kitty Sill Deluxe with Bolster
review_body: we have 2 cats who love the windows. This bed is really nice and they are always in it. It is a bit small meaning it can only hold one of them at a time, but if it faces a public area and you have mini blinds it still gives you privacy from people looking into your house.

product_title: Nutramax Crananidin Pet Supplement
review_body: I am so grateful for this product.  My puppy has an inverted vulva which has been causing her to have chronic UTI problems.  She was on antibiotics for 4 months and they would not go away.  Surgery was a possibility but I didn't want to put her through that.  I have since bought CRANIDINE BY NUTRAMAX and they are working perfectly.  They are chewable, although my dog won't eat them, I have to force her to shallow them.  She has been UTI free for 3 months now!!! I would highly recommend this product.

product_title: DVM 9316 Synovi G4 Soft Chew, 120 Count
review_body: I love this product! I have a 10 year old Golden Retriever/ German Sheppard mix. She was having arthritis in her knee and was limping. I tried another kind of chews for her and it helped a little, but she would still limp at night. I had to start her on Aspirin, which helped. I just didn't want to have to give her that kind of medicine yet. Then my Aunt told me to try this product. They use it on their 14 year old Husky and he is doing great on it! So, I tried it for my dog. She likes to eat it and is doing wonderful on it! She runs around and has a lot more energy. I highly recommend it.

product_title: Bayer Advantage II Flea Control Treatment for Cats
review_body: From past experience I know this product works better than most others. It is very easily applied and priced competitively.

product_title: Fully Adjustable Mesh Pet Barrier
review_body: Works very well.  I especially like the large "cups" that press against the floor and ceiling to hold it in place. Also, the unit is very easy to adjust, and is a snap to move between out subaru outback and the toyota 4 runner.

product_title: Coolaroo Replacement Dog Bed Cover - Terra Cotta
review_body: My 115 pound lab used out the original cover, this one works just the same, was easy to replace and was a lot cheaper than buying a new bed.

product_title: Fresh 'n Clean Scented Creme Rinse, Classic Fresh Scent, 18 oz
review_body: This crème rinse goes with fresh n clean dog shampoo. Before I was paying a lot of money for my dogs to be bathed professionally and they were not smelling so good after a week or so.  I use the shampoo with this crème rinse and they are super soft and smell good for many weeks.

product_title: 1000 Pet Waste Bags Disposal Bags With Dispenser Dog Pick Up Bags
review_body:
Received as promised and as advertised! I love how the dispenser stops the roll at the correct spot for tearing off a bag. When it's dark outside and you can't the tear-off perforations on the roll so this solves that problem.
I would like to order 2 additional dispensers but I couldn't find them on Amazon.

review_body: I was disappointed in the pad holder. It sets up too high from the floor and the pads do not stay down. The dog can still pull the pads out and play with them and it really does not help the process much. Just easier to put on the tile or rug instead.

product_title: Everlasting Fire Plug
review_body: i have a 60lb boxer and he destroys all of his toys.  he has been playing with this toy for about a mth now and it has held up.  i will get him another one when this one reaches the point of no return.  he picks it up and swings it around like it is nothing.  a great toy for a big baby.

product_title: Pet Waste Disposal Bags - 1000 Dog Poop Pick Up Bags
review_body: 1000!!!! Wow. I pay more for these at the pricey pet and retail stores. Never again. They work just the same. I use them fto toss out diapers and stinky food from the frig. They seal the odor perfectly. Definitely buying again at this awesome price.

product_title: Paw Print Pet Memorial Stone
review_body: I have ordered 3 others previously and was very well satisfied so i knew what to expect. Nice memorial for your pets and i highly recommend this product to anyone looking for a way to remember them.

product_title: Cat Toys Variety Pack (Includes One Plush Interactive Feather Wand, Three Wicker Bell Balls and One Mouse Rattle Chew)
review_body: These are well made, attractive cat toys.  My kitten especially loves the balls with the attached ribbons - he bats them around all over the house.

product_title: Star of Life - EMS Prayer Brushed Steel Dog Tag

review_body: I thought this dog tag was awesome so I bought one!  It is thick, heavy, and very uncomfortable to wear around your neck.  I found that this dog tag fit well on my key ring though!  The seller was great and shipped quickly.

product_title: PetSafe Box Kennel for Pets, 10x10x6
review_body:
This kennel works very well for my pit bull, because she doesn't jump on claw at or chew on the fence at all. No issues with her. If I hadn't seen her i'm certain she could have taken the whole fence down.

This kennel will work well for a pet who won't get anxious and try to chew at it, but if you know your pet will try, this is NOT the kennel for you. Very flimsy.

review_headline: Pretty but be sure dog has little neck?,
review_body: Didn't get to use because my little chihuahua got a hold of it when I set it down for a  couple of min.  Rhinestones were all over and she bit collar in half.  It was pretty though and price was good but that was my extent with it.

product_title: Drinkwell Pet Fountain Mat for the Pet Fountain
review_body: We bought the mat at the same time as the fountain.  It's well made, the fountain fits perfectly. It sits on hardwood floors and completely protects them.  I'd highly recommend buying it if you're purchasing the Drinkwell Fountain.  Also consider buying the extra filters.  Priced all of this at local pet store... saved a fortune through Amazon.

product_title: Great Dog Small Cow (Beef) Bones, 3, 2-3" (Sourced & Made in USA)
review_body:
Our three dogs love these bones. There is quite a bit of meat and marrow on these. These bones are strong, no shards at all. My dogs have been gnawing on these for over a month now and there are still big chunks left for them to enjoy. I plan on keeping these in stock.

Also, these bones are individually wrapped inside the bag which I'll bet keeps the taste inside rather than on the shipping bag.

product_title: PetFusion SmartGrip Cat Litter Mat. Large (35 x 24 inches). Safe for your cats, free from Phthalates & VCM
review_headline: My cat's rating on this mat

product_title: Taste of the Wild, Canine Formula

product_title: Dog Harnesses- Puppia
review_headline: Falling apart in less than a month
review_body:
I got this for my dogs 1st b-day gift. I was thrilled when it got here, its a beautiful color and it was thicker material than her previous knock off harness.
Within a week the "Puppia" rubber logo was falling off. A couple more weeks and the edging started to come off. It's in almost as bad shape as her previous harness that she wore for 6mos.

product_title: Pet Supply Imports-SnuggleSafe Heatpad Cover, Tan with Black Paw Print

review_body: My bird chewed threw the threads that hold the hooks on to hang the bed to the cage, luckily I saw it while a few threads were stilling hanging on holding it from ripping completely off...I'm scared to think of what would have happened if I didn't notice it and it fell with him in it....ugh.

product_title: American Farms Natural PIG EARS 100 Count Unwrapped
review_body: These pig ears are very "crispy" compared to other pig ears I have gotten. One of my dogs choked on one because she is used to "chewier" pig ears. We got it unstuck from her throat but I think I'll buy another brand next time.

product_title: Outward Hound Kyjen  I-Qube Puzzle Plush Interactive Dog Toy
review_body: My puppy loves to get each ball, and where he enjoys his hide a squirrel toy, he tends to chew on the tree more than the squirrels that are replaceable. product_title: ZiwiPeak Oral Health Bones
review_body:

Keep in mind, the trachea thing was gone within 30 minutes but then she got to work on the rest of it. So far no pieces have broken off or chipped. I take that back. There's a knuckle part (or rounded joint part) that I took from her when it came off but that's it.
I can see making this purchase again since it's proved a worthy investment.
Really, the only reason I got it was because Ian Dunbar recommended the ZiwiPeak dog food (which I'm incorporating into her diet) so saw this on Amazon as related product & probably a healthy taste for her.

product_title: Petmate Giant Litter Pan For Cat
review_body:
If you have a big cat or two or three regular-size, this is plenty..
the walls are thick and sturdy, they clean easily and the storage
depressions are welcome additions. If your kitty is a wall sprayer,
just wrap some newspaper over the back side.

product_title: Tomlyn Nutri-Cal For Cats
review_body: My purpose in buying this was to find an alternative to pills for my elderly feline, so instead of struggling to give him a pill I can smear this onto his front paws and he licks it off. It works ok, but if the cat does not lick it all off, then it hardens to their fur, and is a real bear to get off.

product_title: AquaTop HT-300 Aquarium Heater - 300W
review_body: Bought this in April of 2013, and now in January of 2014 we noticed the temperature in our tank was 110F.  This heater just about cooked our fish.

product_title: TetraPond Spring & Fall Diet Fish Food
review_body: My fish eat it so I guess it is something I will be buying again.  These are hard to find in my area.

product_title: Zack & Zoey Nor'easter Blanket Pet Coat - Red
review_body: This blanket coat is easy to use and my 65# female boxer loves it. Protects her from the wind and cold. Easy to clean, love the outside layer from the weather and love the inside fleece layer for warmth and comfort.

product_title: Chuckit! Classic 26M Launcher (Colors Vary)
review_headline: If you have a retrieving dog, this is a must
review_body: This is a great accessory for any dog family. Just stock up on tennis balls cause this think chucks them far. Whats nice is you can use anykind of tennis ball not just the chuck it brand ones.

product_title: Composure for Medium and Large Dogs, 60 Soft Chews
review_body:
The main active ingredient is thiamine (vitamin B1). Giving extra thiamine does tend to improve mood in all species. The is also L-Theanine, found in tea and known to be calming. And they list "colostrum calming complex" but I don't really know what that is.

product_title: Safari® Cat Shedding Comb
review_headline: Works for my Maltese's hair wonderfully
review_body: My dog groomer recommended that I get one of these combs to keep the tanges and matts combed out on my Maltese.  The first time I brought my dog to the groomer, I brushed her for about 6 hours the days leading up to our appointment and I felt really bad because I have been told that the maltese has hair not fur and the hair in the brush is hair I am pulling out, not shedding.  Since I bought the comb, I use it every night for about ten minutes and it works really well to keep her under control.  The groomer charged me $20 less the last time because she didn't have matts to brush out and we didn't have to have any cut out spots that look bad.

product_title: Peter's Woven Grass Pet Bed and Toys
review_body: Unfortunately my bunnies little Matt didn't last long. He had so much fun throwing it around and eating it. Tub nines constantly need to file their teeth so this is a great idea for entertainment for them.

product_title: Wahl 8868 Figura Professional Lithium Ion Rechargeable Pet Clipper Kit by Wahl Professional Animal
review_body: Nice and quiet and battery lasts for a long time.  Two minor complaints are that the blade could cut closer (I just don't think that it is cutting a surgical closeness as the numbers suggest it would be), and the blades are not as long lasting as the heavier duty clippers.  All things considered, a good clipper though.

product_title: Guardian Gear 2-Step Pet Harness - Hunter Green
review_body: Too cumbersome, too much metal (makes it heavy) and I did not like double rings at the top.  the double rings make it more difficult to hook on the  leash.  wouldn't reccomend it

product_title: Go Pet Club Cat Tree Furniture Beige
review_body: My kitty loved it from the second I put it together. Pretty easy to put together but the bracket for the ramp is too small. The little mice came off  in a couple days, so I just hung some other toys on it. My kitten is getting too big for the little box but she sleeps on the top circle every day.. I put it by the front window so she can look out. Compared to other cat trees I have seen, I think it was worth the  money.

product_title: PetFusion SmartGrip Cat Litter Mat. Large (35 x 24 inches). Safe for your cats, free from Phthalates & VCM
review_body: I used to have a spare 2ft square piece of carpet in front of our two cat boxes and litter would always find its way into the carpet. This mat really does grab onto the litter and keeps it there. Easy clean up too, fold the mat in half and shake the lose litter back in the box. Will definitely order another for our other litter box.

product_title: LittleGifts Air Freshener
review_body: While these are absolutely adorable, there was barely any scent to them.  I sprayed them with Febreze to get longer use time.  it seems to have worked.

product_title: K&H Manufacturing Snuggle Up Bird Warmer Gray

review_headline: Marineland 32999 Single Bright LED Aquarium Lighting System, 36-Inch to... Marineland
review_body: Love it!  Love it!  Why?  I have a 45-gallon fresh water tank..no living plants..with a 36-inch hood with one 24-inch florescent bulb lamp in the underside.  Don't know the watts or voltage, but was good.  I had it on 12 hours daily. It is great for my tank. Fits perfectly!!  My whole tank is lit up, naturally and evenly, no dark corners now. The daylight is equal to what I had before, and just fell in love with the moonlight light!!  I guess, from reading other reviews, the old florescent blub gives off heat, which is why I had bad algae growth.  I am glad I did not buy the "double light" as I am sure it would be too bright.  I could care less about a timer to automatically turn the light on/off and the manual switch for daylight to moonlight, as I just daily feed the fish and enjoy seeing them. product_title: Dean and Tyler Wire Basket Muzzle, Size No. R2 - Medium Rottweiler
review_body: I have 6 Rottweilers of my own and have never felt the need for a muzzle, until now. I took in an older rottweiler mix as a foster. He came to me to recover from a double cherry eye surgery, double rear dew claw removal, and a neuter.  The vet sent him home with a nylon muzzle, a number of antibiotics and ointments, and wishes of "good luck."  I figured that I have always had great luck with medical fosters and luck wasn't necessary. Boy, was I wrong on this one. There was no way to apply eye ointment without losing fingers. Using the poorly fit nylon muzzle just agitated him and made the whole situation worse.  The day came when I was supposed to remove his leg bandages, but his trust issues and "bite before thinking" mindset made it impossible to accomplish.  I broke down, not really wanting to spend this much money on a foster dog. I took measurements from one of my rotties with a similar head and muzzle size and made the purchase.  I am very glad that I did.  After I used one of my rotties as a fitting model to get the straps close, I put the muzzle on the foster.  He really didn't fight the muzzle. He still snapped at me when I applied the ointment, but I was safe from his bite.  When I went to remove the bandages, he was also very aggressive.  The basket muzzle is very well made, and stayed in place, offering me the confidence and protection to remove the bandages and look at his stitches without incident.  I am now very happy that I spent the money on this well made muzzle. I now have it for future situations and use.

product_title: Chuckit! Max Glow Ball,
review_body: I bought two of these balls. One for my German Shepherd (GSD) and one for my sister's GSD. My boy is not a heavy chewer anymore. He just turned two and while he does love to gnaw on things, he's not an aggressive chewer.  My sister's GSD is four and a female, but has always been an aggressive chewer. This girl has destroyed all sorts of "indestructible" toys. My sister has resorted to only buying the ones with free replacement warranties because they all get shredded. My boy has had this toy since I bought it and it's provided many hours of fun. It still doesn't have any holes in it. I was hoping to use it outside more because of the glow feature, but really have used it more inside than outside. The glow feature is cool, but really it has to be in bright sunlight to get enough of a charge to then glow for a decent amount of time- enough to play fetch say - at night. We'd forget to put it somewhere to charge, and then it wouldn't work at night, hence it became and inside ball. My sister's girl chomped a hole the size of a half dollar in her ball in about 45 min. And just to give you and idea, that is actually quite good considering 45 min is a pretty long time for her to be going at something. Lesser toys are destroyed in under 5 min. product_title: Drinkwell Original Pet Fountain
review_body:

review_headline: Good value with free clicker, hinge stands up to daily use (so far)
review_body:
This treat bag with the free clicker included represents a good value for the money. The nylon is good quality and the sewing is careful and tidy. I use mine daily and have not had any issues with the hinge mechanism as I've read occurs with other bags. I expected the clicker to be a cheapo, but it is virtually identical to the Karen Pryor clickers, minus the logo.

The key ring and clip on the bank are convenient; I use the clip to permanently attach the clicker so I never have to hunt for or fumble with it. It also leaves me the opportunity to use either hand, or both as is sometimes necessary.

The treat compartment is large enough that I can carry multiple Ziploc bags with treats of various values. At the end of the day I put the Ziploc bags in the refrigerator to keep the bait fresh.

I have purchased one of the smaller bags that you attach to your belt, but could barely get my hand in it so I opted for this bag which resembles the one dog trainer Emily Larlham uses on her Kikopup Channel on YouTube.

There are other adequate bags I'm sure, this one appeared to be a good value for the money and I have been pleased with it.
