product_title: KONG Tug Toy
review_body:
Two items are depicted here. One all red. One with black parts. Most of the complaints seem to be about the poor quality of the black handled item.

I bought the ALL RED SINGLE PIECE version from a pet supply store. I bought it for my dogs to play tug with each other. For almost a month now two (2) 40ish lb GSD puppies have chewed pulled and tugged this thing every day. It spends most of its time outside in the weather. So far I have seen no damage to this item other than mild discoloration and abrasion from a cement patio.

This has been a great toy for both dogs to enjoy together. I throw it out and they both fetch it, one on each end and hilarity ensues. After a month they still don't always remember to both go on the same side of the tree. :-)

So avoid the black handled version. It sounds unreliable. Find the one piece all red from here or else where.

UPDATE 2014.11.13: Almost a year later and the ALL RED toy is still going strong. I'm updating to again point out that people should not buy the black handle version of this toy. Go to the store. They still carry the ALL RED version. I've had this outside unprotected for a year now with almost daily use and it is still near flawless. No weather damage at all which is amazing where I live.

product_title: C&S Hanging Suet Basket w/ roof
review_body:
I have always bought the basic. box cage type of suet feeders. They don't latch securely, but this flaw can be corrected simply by using a double dog leash type clasp. One end hooks thru the side and the lid, holding it closed. The other end clasps the pole or hanging hook to suspend the feeder. This will thwart the clever squirrel or raccoon from running off with the the whole suet feeder, cage and all. Believe me, this happened two or three times before I figured out this solution!!

OK, so I liked the look of this feeder and thought I'd give it a try. The birds were baffled and frustrated by it, as they were used to perching anywhere on my basic feeders, especially the top. The slippery roof gave them no purchase and they struggled to figure out what was wrong. I couldn't figure out how to latch the roof Securely on the darn thing. The next morning I found it on my deck, without roof and totally empty.

I replaced it with another basic cage type feeder with another clasp. Now we're all happy again. (Except for the thieving varments!)

Amazon carries the clasps of course. I used the\\"brass double end snap clip\\" Easy.

product_title: Best Pet Black 24" Double-Door Suitcase Style Folding Metal Dog Crate with Metal Pan - 24"(l) x 20"(w) x 23"(h)
review_body:
I had a longer but shorter crate for my mini cockapoo who weighs around 15lbs. That crate would make it uncomfortable for him to sit as it usually required a little bit of slouching. This crate though is perfect for my dog as it's the right dimensions. It's made very well and even with a fight, my dog won't manage to get out of this. Not that he ever puts up a fight anyway, but it's good to know that he can't try to squeeze himself out of this and hurt himself. It's very sturdy once setup, which usually takes all of 2 minutes. Ironically, the directions on the setup are on the inside of the crate, which you can only get after you're done with the setup.

We fitted this crate with a medium dog bed from Target which is just the right dimensions. He loves it in there and it's actually been easier to get him in the crate. See customer pictures on the product page for more details on the crate and my dog.

There is one flaw with this crate and one tiny annoyance. First, the door handles are not difficult to operate but not really smooth and easy either. It requires you to pull the lever up and pull out to open and you have to do this twice if you're using both locks. I usually only use one. The major flaw in the design is that the front door entrance (the bigger door) has a lower clearance level than the side door, about 2 inches in difference between the two. It makes it a little harder for my dog to get in and out as he has to slouch a bit more and not hit his head, which he has done a few times. I wish the front door had the same amount of clearance as the side door.

Still, a great crate and can't beat the price! Highly recommended.

**Update 3/1/2014**
I've added a picture of an Ikea Laiva desk I bought to put on top of the crate so I can place treats, doggie bags, etc. on it. Check it out in the customer pictures section! (scroll down to the reviews on the front page of the product and you'll see customer pictures on the right side) It's a great desk and only costs $18. The desk itself does come with additional parts for the legs, but I didn't install them so the crate can fit and be more flush. I think it looks great and it's been working out really well for us. product_title: Petmate Two Door Top Load Kennel
review_body:
I bought this crate because I have a large Himalayan cat that weighs about 17 lbs. We had a slightly smaller crate with the plastic door and he is strong enough he pushed the door so hard it flexed and he got out. The handle also broke when we tried to pick him up. We put him in this one and he didn't even get excited, I believe because he had more than enough room. My other cats also like it.

The top opening is great or loading because you can drop them right in, instead of having to try and push them in butt first. It is larger than any I have owned before, but it is worth it so the cats can sit up inside instead of having to lay down.

It is easy to put together, btw the top wires of the door do not go into the holes, they fit into the 2 points you see at the top corners of the door. I wondered if I too got the wrong size door but it fits perfectly. The instructions could tell you that, they are just line drawings with few details. the side go together with metal bolts and heavy duty plastic nuts. They work well and it seems very sturdy and held my big cat to his satisfaction.

It is definitely worth it, especially for my larger cats and especially at the 44% off price.

product_title: Richell Expandable Pet Pen with Tray, Autumn Matte
review_headline: Wish I knew about Richell products earlier
review_body:
I am not a professional dog trainer but am continually amused by the reviewers that complain that their dog can escape or that otherwise the pen is not the 'be all end all' answer to all their pet issues. I believe one needs to regard these as training aids – they are not in and of themselves the whole solution to the various challenges we as pet owners face.

That said, they are well-made items that with their wood frames look far more attractive than their all-wire or all-plastic counterparts.

The Richell and can be used with any pad or pad holder. I am currently using it successfully in combination with the Richell pen divider and the Piddle Place Pet Relief System both of which are also available here on Amazon. I have found that this allows for a more natural transition to the outdoors.

Another benefit as compared to the Puppy Apartment or any of the all-wire or all-plastic crates is the ability to expand the size as your puppy grows and/or becomes more trustworthy.

My experience with Richell customer service has also been excellent. My plastic base tray arrived with a slight defect and Bethany and Kristin promptly sent a replacement at no charge.

Some reviewers have also lamented the absence of a cover. Expandable covers are available on Amazon or presumably through any Richell retailer.

I've also seen that some reviewers have mentioned the price. It's true they are not inexpensive, but when I have compared the aesthetics and build quality to the alternatives I find the price differential nominal.

I was pleased to find Richell products while researching exercise pens on my breed forum and wish I had known about this company much earlier.

review_body:

product_title: PetSafe Simply Clean Self-Cleaning Cat Litter Box, Automatic, Works with Clumping Cat Litter
review_body:
Got this item during special promotion period. Item arrived in time, in fact ahead of time by Amazon. However, you have to use some efforts to make the item work a little better. The unit runs nonstop, I think that's why lots of people reported that the motor break down in a matter of weeks and months. This can be resolved by buying an inexpensive timer that have the unit turned on in frequencies specified by user.

The litter guard is useless! It does not prevent the litter being kicked out by my kitties at all, as other users have noted. I would suggest the manufacturer to make the guard longer like a wall. Also, the guard does not lock, unlike what the user's manual indicates. This has been reported by other users as well. As the result, as the guard moves with the moving bowl, it will get stuck at the end of the bowl, then the unit stops working. You will need to find a way to make the litter guard stay in place in order for the unit to operate smoothly. I used multiple duct tapes to glue it to the machine, but I think there should be better ways than the duct tape.

If the litter level is too high, litter may be pushed out as the machine motor turns the litter bowl. So you will see additional mess in addition to the litter kicked out by your cats after they finish doing their business.

Overall, for the price I will say the product deserves only 2.5-3 stars, hence my rating. It needs some serious improvements in order to make it work more flawlessly. I think the engineers of the company should listen to what customers have to say.

Am I a cautious person? You bet, particularly when it comes to my furry friend.

Yes, I have an electronic dog fence and yes I have an ID implant and yes strange stuff can still happen.

Old fashioned and low tech, absolutely, but a tag with my name and a couple of phone numbers is still indispensable. The fence gets a break, they miss the implant (my vet couldn't find it once and she knew it was there) and your best pal ends up in a pound or, worse, a lab someplace.

There are a lot of them to choose from and I don't know what the others are like but this one is nice and sturdy and the laser etching stands out deep and strong. After 8 months it still looks brand new and I can find very little evidence of wear and tear, and this is on an 18 month old Labrador who spends 50% or more of his time running around 3 acres of lawn, trees and woods. product_title: Weruva Grain-Free Canned Dog Food
review_headline: WARNING - Great product, but DAMAGED CANS
review_body: I love this food and would encourage all to try it. It's of high quality, looks and smells delicious, and my dogs love it. I love Amazon too, but they really aren't handling the shipping of this product properly, so buying it from them became nothing but aggrevation and waste. BEWARE: DENTED CANS ARE NOT SOMETHING TO CHANCE. There was no packing material for any of my 3 cases, and approximately 25% of my cans were dented, putting their contents at risk for contamination. I did not see any options to return these cases whole or be compensated in any way, so I was forced to work around my problem as best possible. I refrigerated the 12+ dented cans I first spotted at arrival and used them asap. The other cans looked fine upon inspection, so I stored them in a safe place and thought all would be okay from there on in. Unfortunately, weeks after the initial order, I noticed that other cans were showing signs of damage too i.e. sunken or slightly distorted tops that were not dented upon my first inspection.  I know that nothing damaged these cans in the interim, so I believe their seals must have been compromised when the others were initially dented, and with time the vacuum must have been compromised which resulted in the cave ins.  I was not going to take a chance and give contaminated food to my dogs, so I ended up throwing out 5 cans (there goes my savings). Thereafter, I also felt nervous to give my dogs food from the other cans that remained. This whole purchase was very stressful and wasteful and therefore I cannot recommend taking a chance to buy this great food from this site again, unless the issue of proper packaging is remedied.  Also, reveiwing others comments, I have noticed I was not alone in this experience.  If cans aren't packaged with some insulation, there is probably a good chance they will get dented. Maybe the shipper dents the cans, but the packager i.e. Amazong should protect them so they are not so vulnerable and we get the product we wanted and paid for.

product_title: BLUE Wilderness Grain-Free Biscuits Crunchy Dog Treats
review_headline: Too large for my 16-pound dog but otherwise good.
review_body:
My Shih Tzu, Missy, gets 2 or 3 treats when I leave the house. She has separation anxiety and the treats help distract her. These Grain-free Duck Biscuits from Blue Buffalo are my most recent purchase in the treat department.

Unfortunately, when buying online, it is often difficult to judge the SIZE of the treats in a bag, unless the verbiage specifically says for small dogs, big dogs, etc. These treats are too large in diameter (about an inch square) and too thick and hard (about 1/2" thick) for my Shih Tzu to want to eat, so I have to break them up for her. Thankfully, they do pretty easily break/crumble into smaller-size bits.

Missy is allergic to grains, so I buy all grain-free food and treats. I have only this past several months started buying both Blue Buffalo food for her and this bag of treats. I like not only that they are grain free but that duck is actually the first ingredient on the ingredients list. Additionally, there are no artificial preservatives, colors or flavors in these treats. I also like that these treats contain Omega 3 & 6 fatty acids.

Note that these treats "are intended for intermittent or supplemental feeding only." The bag gives no direction (that I could find) on how many treats per day are appropriate for the dog's weight. Since Missy gets multiple kinds/brands of treats for variety, she never gets more than 1 of these treats per day.

Both here on Amazon and on Wag.com (where I originally purchased these treats), the 10-ounce bag is sold for between $6.49 and 6.99. Considering that most of Missy's other treats come in an 8-ounce bag, I consider the price of these treats very reasonable, especially given their quality.

I just wish that there was some indication on online sites of the size of the treat. Even the picture on the front of the bag isn't true to size (it is larger than the size of the treat I pulled out of the bag to compare with).

4 1/2 stars. Only missed 5 stars because they are too large for her to manage so I have to break/crumble them up to feed them to her and they don't break cleanly so I have to be sure I'm breaking the treat into or over a bowl or plate.ly missed 5 stars because they are too large for her to manage so I have to break/crumble them up to feed them to her and they don't break cleanly so I have to be sure I'm breaking the treat into or over a bowl or plate.

product_title: MOTA Perfect Dinner Pet Feeder for Dog and Cat with Portion Control (DISCONTINUED)
review_body:
WIth all the automatic pet feeders out there, i had to go with a more reasonably priced and reasonably reviewed by other customers. I bought it because I was going away for a week and I usually dont leave my cat for that long. It arrived it a timely manner and i did have my suspicion because the box looked like it had been opened and re-taped again but I still opened it hoping nothing was damaged in the inside. Everything was packaged nicely so nothing was damaged. Instructions were easy to read. You can program it to feed 1 to 12 times a day (if i remember correctly) and i like how it has a voice recorder so if your four legged friend isnt used to an automatic feeder, he can learn by hearing the sound of your voice and of course training him to go by it. I didnt record my voice because my cat doesnt respond to me saying "ok time to eat!" he actually responds by the sound of his food pouring out of a container. So that's exactly what i did. I recorded the sound of the food pouring out of the container.

So when everything was set up and programmed (only took me 20 minutes to set up and test it out) I set it down and poured some of his favorite treats and had set it in the feeding bowl, sure enough my cat went right to it and started eating out of it. I was kinda astonished because he always eats out of his feeding bowl that he's had for about 3-4 years.

I waited the next morning to see if the time i had programmed it would actually dispense, and sure enough at 7:30 in the morning, it dispensed the food along with the sound of his food being poured (thanks to the voice recorder). Of course I had to do some adjustment because the instruction told you that portion 4 was equivalent to 1/2 cup or something like that but it's actually more than 1/2 a cup. So i re programmed it to suit his portion.

It's been 2 weeks since I had it and I cant really complain. It does it job. It doesnt over feed or dispenses more food than its supposeto and my cat actually got used to his new feeding bowl the very first time it dispensed. If you have a cat that craves food all the time, then i dont think you would have any problem teaching it to go over to the pet feeder. Battery life is still full, but for some reason, the voice recorder stopped working. I just have to re record it, but overall it's a reasonale product to try.

review_body:
Beware of cat food full of grains and fillers - this can cause all kinds of serious disease like diabetes, kidney blockages and obesity.
Buy grain-free food for your cats if they are hooked on dry food. Best to feed mostly wet, canned food like Weruva - high protein, low fat. Don't feed your cat foods with a lot of fruit in it - can raise blood sugar too high. Diabetes is very difficult to control in cats - I know - I had a diabetic cat. It leads to all kinds of problems like dehydration, constipation, blindness, heart disease, joint problems, and nerve damage. Very expensive to treat and very sad to watch your cat suffer. Keep your cat at normal weight, bring it to vet for yearly exam, vaccinate it and care for its teeth. This food will help with the weight - well worth it!

product_title: TEMPTATIONS Classic Cat Treat Variety Pack
review_headline: Cats are picky eaters but they love these treats!
review_body:
I have to share an anecdote, if you don't mind.

I recently went to a pet shop that offered, among other wares, what they said was irresistible cat treats. It required mixing bagged ingredients and baking them, and then cutting them with a fish-shaped cutter. I was confident, after following the directions to the letter, that our two cats would love the treats.

I was wrong.

They came over, sniffed the treats, and walked away, tails in the air.

I had much better luck with Whiskas. Your mileage will vary, but these bite-sized treats, given out two or three at a time, appeal to my cats. They prefer the tuna and the chicken but don't care for salmon.

Be careful about giving them too many treats in a day. We have found that two treats a day is plenty. At least with our cats, if you give them too many treats in a day (say 10 or more), they might throw them up.

These are indeed tasty treats for cats, and they'll come running when they hear the bag being opened.

Bottom line: Give treats in moderation, and don't overfeed them.

product_title: Pioneer Pet Raindrop Stainless Steel Pet Drinking Fountain
review_headline: A good fountain, but a bit high-maintenance
review_body: I have two cats that seriously prefer running water. . . they would slap their original bowls of water and spill the water all over the floor several times a day.  After much investigation of various pet fountains, I settled on this stainless steel one, and it's been a good choice.  They adapted to the noise and motion within a few hours, and now let me know right away if I don't change the water every morning.  Keeping it clean and flowing well is a bit of a pain.  I take it completely apart once a week, scrubbing the slime away with a toothbrush and a bottle brush and washing the stainless steel parts in warm soap and water.  I change the filter once every 3 or 4 weeks, as well.  I'm a little disappointed in the durability of the motor unit.  I've had it for 18 months, and one of the three suction cup "feet" on the casing has already broken off.  Plus, the motor casing has a notch where the cord goes to fit snugly between the top and bottom halves of the casing, and the cord is beginning to fray at this place.  This will soon become a safety issue, so I'm going to have to replace the entire motor and casing unit, which is a big disappointment after less than 2years.  My cats like it, so I will keep it, and of the choices available, I would recommend it.  Just know that you do need to do regular maintenance.

review_headline: Turn Off Your Cat's Urge to Mark
review_body:
I used six other brands of stain/odor remover before finally finding one that worked. Cat urine is designed to leave a permanent odor behind; it's how they mark their territory. So when my three cats "suddenly" began marking. it was a self-perpetuating problem. Each one would smell the mark left by the previous cat, and need to mark its own spot.

This remover has a pleasant odor to me, but more important, it eradicated the scent markers left by the cats. No more trigger for them to urinate where they shouldn't; this literally turned off their urge to mark. I wish they made a similar product for rugs, but by using it on the floor under the rug and pad, I was able to stop the cats urinating on the carpets, too.

I am so pleased with this product, I almost wish I needed more, but one spray bottle was all it took to correct the problem everywhere in my house.

Excellent tool for anyone whose pets have already started marking!

He brings us the bone in the morning and in the evening. He is an almost 5 year old Lab and his teeth are pure white and zero tartar!! Our vet cannot believe it. Others have tried using peanut butter instead of the gnawhide - but a total mess, don't try it!

I recently have been alternating the gnawhide rings with Dr Harveys Sweet Potate'r Chews. I break them up and place them inside the bone. Not ideal BUT they are made in the USA and truly ALL NATURAL. I have written to Dr Harvey’s and requested they manufacture their chews as rings, we'll see. Would love if anyone has any other ideas!

I wrote to PetSafe, (who is actually "radio systems?") and they said "they randomly check the shipments from Taiwan". Has me concerned but my dog is addicted to this bone.......

product_title: Current USA Satellite Freshwater LED Plus Light for Aquarium
review_headline: Don't wait to buy these, you won't be disappointed.
review_body:
These lights simply rock! I can't believe it took me THIS long to dump all the junky, clunky, plastic hood and tube lights! The only problem with them is that it gives you WAY too many color combinations and variations. Good luck picking a favorite. I have a 55 gallon show tank (longer than taller), that measures 48 inches long. I went back and forth trying to decide on the length to get and weather or not to get 2 smaller lights or one large one. I wanted to get the most coverage possible. So, in deciding to make the move to these lights, I had to (decided to) throw everything on the top end of the tank away and replace with sliding glass lids that I made myself. Plastic tracks and knobs from Lowes, glass cut to fit from the glass shop, I am in a new top for the tank 20 bucks! Plus now that the entire top of the tank is glass, I am making the most of the light I have.
Do yourself a favor and make the move to the glass top if you get these lights, it will ensure that you get the light you need clear to the bottom of the tank.

product_title: GREENIES Original TEENIE Dog Dental Chews Dog Treats
review_body: Seriously, this company could just as easily package these in bags and pass that savings to the consumer. Yet, they waste money on these unnecessarily big boxes and mislead their customers with the "value size" banner on the box. And, compared to their earlier prices before they had competition, these really seem like a value, but I refuse to see it that way.  I'm not complaining about the product itself, but I detest companies that try to make their products look like there's more inside by disguising them in oversized boxes. You can see this happening in so many products these days that come in boxes, or containers that hide the contents, but when you open them you see half of the product inside. Why are companies packing products in oversized boxes and other containers? What do you think? I think they are intentionally attempting to deceive us, and we just buy without questioning. As far as I'm concerned regardless of the quality of the product, deception is just not acceptable. So Greenies gets 3 stars, not 5.

product_title: Fluval Accent Glass Aquarium, 25-Gallon
review_body: First, internal filter stopped working.  I have a backup tank so I was fortunate that I transferred the fish to the backup tank otherwise I would have lost fish.  Internal filter is large and cumbersome to remove and I decided not to place it back into the tank and replaced it with a HOB filter.  Second, heater overheats when placed inside the internal filter as directed, it works better when placed inside the tank instead.  Third, LED lights stopped working and only the blue moon lights came back on.  Fourth, stand is made of MDF not wood so I waterproofed it before even placing tank on stand.  For less than half the cost u can buy a same size gallon tank with stand, filter & lights of your own choosing for less than half the cost.  It's not just that the system fails but from a design perspective the internal filter takes up a lot of space inside the tank and the process to detach it from the tank is not as easy and that's the selling point of this system - it's that it's easy and a time saver, which it is clearly not.  Be prepared to come out of pocket for replacement lights, filter.  There is similar feedback regarding this system on Petco's website and various aquarium forums - in some forums even the heater needs replacing.  For the cost, they should have included a heater that's adjustable, this one is not.  Stay away from this system, save your money and get your tank & components from another brand.

product_title: Fluval Advanced Filtration System
review_body:
This is a review after owning and maintaining this filter over a period of a year. The quality and engineering on this filter is very good. You are paying for what you get, that's for sure. If you keep feeding and waste to a minimum within the tank and clean the pre-filter on a regular basis, the filter will do well.

Problems that I've run into with the filter: the priming pump broke and for some reason no longer primes the intake water line going to the filter. The only way to prime the filter now is to take an underwater powerhead in my tank and shoot water into the intake pipe. That ends up pumping any air out of the filter/hoses and restoring water flow. The twist-in cartridges become difficult over time to twist out and remnove. This is solved somewhat by lubing the red o-rings on the pre-filter and chem cartridges with petroleum jelly. I've run into problems with brown algae growing in the included hoses, which clogs the hoses over time and greatly reduces the flow rate of the filter (easily noticeable from the output of the spraybars). The hoses, however, are easily cleaned out with long flexible steel wire brushes. If you notice high levels of algae growing in the filter/hoses, reduce feeding in your tank. I broke the original impeller, which pumps water into/out of the filter. You have to be very delicate when pulling the impeller out of the filter's headunit; use that hooked metal tool that comes with the filter. The impeller's spindle is made out of some very fragile plastic (or is it ceramic?) that easily snapped on me when i lazily tried prying it out from the filter's headunit with a knife. The blue pre-filter cartridges for this filter clog very, very quickly (they are made of a high mesh sieve and are easily renewable and reusable), and shouldn't be depended upon for prefiltering aquarium water for extremely dirty animals like red-eared slider turtles. The regular white-prefilters are claimed to be of a \\"no pass through\\" design, but if you look closely at the filter floss on these cartridges, you will notice holes in the filter strands where waste from your aquarium can slip through. The waste then ends up on the biological media, slowly creating a sludge on top of all bio media trays over time, further reducing the flow rate of the filter. This problem can likely be solved by adding a sponge filter of some sort to the suction end of the intake pipe.

Complete cleaning this filter is a hell of a chore--I feel that completely cleaning this filter is on par with washing a car. With that said, I would not recommend using this filter for aquatic turtles, unless you feed the turtles in a separate tank. I use this filter for a red eared and yellow bellied slider, and I feed my turtles in a separate tank just for the sake of reducing overall maintenance of the filter.

Other than all that, I would recommend this filter overall for its high level of engineering and ease of maintenance (outside of cleaning it completely). For turtles, however, I would recommend getting something like a wet dry filter or a refugium type filter. review_headline: Great product for anxious dogs! Great product for moving pets across country!
review_body: These seats are FANTASTIC! After seeing a neighbor with them, I really wanted to try it for our three dogs. They don't like crates, and would whine and pant the entire way when we took them to the vets. I procrastinated and finally purchased them knowing they would need to travel in the car between Denver and Ohio for our upcoming move. They arrived just in time for the start of our house showings. Since the dogs will not stop barking, they had to be out of the house for showings. My husband easily belted two of these side by side in the back seat of his Tacoma with no issues. They fit perfectly! For the first showing, he was able to pop all three of our dogs in the two seats. Two ten pound small dogs fit into one with more than enough room to both lay down, and our 30 pound French Bulldog was extremely comfortable with one all to herself. They love them! They can see out of the windows, and are seated in a comfy bed. No more whining and panting! These seats made their car trip to Ohio possible! Thank you for making these!!

product_title: Nature's Miracle Just for Cats Stain & Odor Remover
review_body: This is the only thing that has worked!  We bought a house and after we closed we found out the sellers had been spraying something to cover up a room that had been peed in by their cat.  I took a black light the room and there was almost 50 pee spots.  I thought there was no way to make the smell ever going away.  I was ready to have the carpet ripped out, floors sealed, and new carpet installed.  The house is a rental and we wanted to go as long as possible before replacing the carpet.  My husband ordered this and it saved the day.  I cleaned the carpets and  then sprayed this on when the carpet was still wet.  There was still a faint smell of the cat pee so I cleaned it again.  This time I added the natures miracle to the cleaning solution in the carpet cleaner and sprayed it on the carpet right after.  It has been over 30 days and the smell has not come back.  I have ordered more to deal with my cat that has some issues missing the litter box.

product_title: Allied Heated Pet Mat
review_body:
My new Beagles love the dog house when they are outside while I am gone. Problem is that they are house dogs, and really don't like the cold, even when they can snuggle up with warm blankets and each other. This mat fits the large dog house well, and allows both of them to look happy and comfortable inside it.

The house is molded plastic with a top that fits over the base. I drilled a hole in the base large enough for the plug to pass through. Then I plugged the mat into an outdoor extension cord and covered the connection with a unit designed to keep out moisture. The other end of the cord went into an outside outlet with GFI protection (important). That outlet is turned on and off by a switch inside my house; a red light glows when it is on.

The mat is very hard plastic nearly an inch thick. It appears to be dog proof. The included cover is junk. It is thin and barely covers the top of the mat. What dog neatly keeps his cover centered on his bed? Two older large human blankets work quite well, but it is a good idea to rearrange them when necessary so the mat is covered.

My pooches are very happy with their mat, and that makes me happy.

product_title: Lentek 6-Day Automatic Pet Dish
review_headline: Saves on pet sitter costs, and is durable.
review_body:
We feed our cat twice every day, so this lets us feed the cat for 3 days if necessary while we're out of town. I suppose we could do 6 days, but we're usually able to get a family member to check on her if it's more than 3. While we usually feed kitty a mix of wet and dry, we only use dry food in this machine. I don't trust the ice pack to keep canned food fresh for more than a day since the ice would return to room temperature in probably 12 hours.

There is a lot of evidence that the cat has tried to gnaw and claw her way into this bad boy, but to no avail. She has pretty much ruined the clear plastic button protector flap that covers the buttons in the middle - It's always missing when we come back - but the little saucer robot continues to function.

Probably lasts 3-4 weeks on one CVS brand battery, but I haven't let the battery get low enough for fear of starving poor Millie. I don't mind spending $5 on a new 9 volt battery, since this thing has already saved us 5 times it's worth in potential pet sitter costs...

product_title: Pet Naturals of Vermont K9 Slim Down Bone Shaped Chews, 60-Count, 10.58-Ounce
review_headline: Overweight Dogs Love the Chews, But Chews Don't Seem to Suppress their Appetite
review_body:
My two older, moderately overweight dogs, a 40lb terrier mix, and a 90lb Shepherd, readily accept and each these K-9 Slim Down Chews. However, after approximately 2 weeks, I have not noticed any difference in food quantity intake or appetite suppression.

Both dogs are fed a high quality dog food that contains no corn fillers, and neither dog gets table scraps, so their carbohydrate intake is not on the high side. Both dogs have plenty of space to exercise, and both do so on nice days. As older dogs they really enjoy their sleep too.

So, perhaps the K-9 Slim Downs are only effective if your dog has a high carb diet? Since my dogs do not, the Chews were not effective even though both dogs loved them and chewed them before swallowing (note the Chews are pretty small, so a larger dog may be more inclined to swallow without chewing).

I purchased two boxes from of this from a local Wal mart, we treated all of them.  essentially no effect.  we re-treated them about 3-5 weeks later and still really nothing.  I have used products like this before, (I dont recall the brand) and they all worked FAR better, with lower dose.  I think the batch they sold (distributed via Seacaucus NJ) is inactive.  I would have contacted them directly, however there is no contact number of even website listed on their packaging.

review_body: Our kitten loves this Scratcher! It's made out of cardboard type material, so it is a little messy, but it's a lot better than the him using my couch as his scratching post. He really gets into it when we use a little of the Catnip. It is a great product for the price.

After a 1500+ mile trip I noticed that the chest piece had deformed a bit and was folding inward. The fold developed right below where the straps join together (its the bottom colored section on the manufacturers pictures). It seems that this piece is only meant to keep the straps from rubbing directly on the dog, and that the fold will not cause any additional issues. Perhaps an adjustable/fitted piece would be better since it seems that its too long to fit when the dog is sitting and ends up causing it to fold.

A friend of ours highly recommended Cosequin. For the first two months, we gave Kota the maximum dose of 3 tablets each morning and 3 each evening. product_title: Vet's Best Flea & Tick Spray for Pets
review_body: Over the summer, we had a flea problem in the yard which turned into a flea problem in the house. Instead, I'd spray this on my dog before letting him outside and it did a great job of preventing him from bringing more fleas inside.  As an added bonus, it smells great, like cloves and peppermint, which fits my dog's old man personality.  The only downside is that it isn't effective for too long, so I had to spray him down every time I let him out.  But, it did the job and kept my dog happy and my house flea-free during the height of flea season.

product_title: Oster Professional Turbo A5 2-Speed Heavy Duty Detachable Blade Animal Clipper with #10 Blade 078005-314-003
review_headline: Absolutely the very best clipper for our cats.
review_body:
I bought these clippers because I wanted to groom my two long haired (one is a Maine Coon) cats instead of taking them to our vet's office each spring because it is so expensive. Unfortunately I didn't check with my cats about this and found that they were not as cooperative at home with me as they were at the vet's office so I called and asked for an appointment where I could watch them be groomed so that I could learn the technique they used. I learned three things: the proper nape of the neck hold, that two people is better than one, and that cats were usually more cooperative in a strange place on a strange table than they are at home. The other thing that I learned was that these clippers were better than the ones used at that vet's office. Both vet techs raved about them and had "clipper envy". I imagine our veterinarian is going to be ordering a new clipper in the near future and I will bet it is this one. It is easy to use, does a great job and the speed allows for quick grooming without any overheating issues. I bought the coolant that was recommended but never needed it.
I have recruited my husband to assist with grooming them am trying to master the correct "nape of the neck hold". We are making progress in the "grooming learning experience" but now have to find a strange house and table to put them on so that they are more cooperative. My other thought is that maybe I can wrangle a discount at the vet's office. I will let them use my "preferred" clippers if I get a discount on grooming. Now there's a thought! PS. We were one of the dumb ones who purchased a much cheaper clipper first and learned very quickly that you get what you pay for.

product_title: FELINE GREENIES PILL POCKETS Cat Treats
review_body:
I don't feed my cats fish anything, and have ALWAYS bought the chicken flavor Pill Pockets. Lately, I've been buying them at Costco, which charges $4.89 a bag - about what it costs with shipping online. But for some reason, my Costco doesn't seem to be able to get the chicken flavored ones any more.

This was a very good deal, however. Free shipping and about $4.00 a bag. My cats aren't enthused about the salmon flavor. I only have two cats that will actually eat their medications in the Pill Pocket themselves, and neither of them will eat the salmon flavored Pockets by themselves, sadly. Right now, we've got a sneezing epidemic, and I'm trying, in addition to medicating an epileptic and a hypothyroid cat twice a day, to give 7 cats an antiviral medication twice a day. Without Pill Pockets, I hate to think what condition my fingers would be in.

One other observation about Pill Pockets - they've (without any notice) apparently reduced the size of the Pockets by nearly half. Which is massively annoying when you have half a dozen pills of various sizes to get into a cat twice a day. The package still claims that there are \\"approximately\\" 45 pieces in each bag, which may or may not be true. Having discovered the change in size, I'm not really interested in giving Greenies any breaks.

I hope that this retail company keeps my email information and lets me know if they have another good sale on Pill Pockets, preferably the chicken ones!

review_headline: Used to be good until the formula changed
review_body:

I have confirmed with a very helpful Kaytee rep that this is correct for the formula going forward and are called "gentle bites" to help manage the bunnies growing teeth.

November 15, 2013: 5 stars. We have 4 pet bunnies and they ALL prefer this food. I like it because I can tell a huge difference in their fur! They don't shed nearly as much as normal. I tried switching to another food because I ran out, and they ALL immediately went through a massive shedding stage - NOT good! Fortunately, they cleared up quickly after returning to the ProHealth.

They love the little orange treats so much that they started to dig them out and leave the rest. I've started giving them each a few of the treats and scooping out only pellets into their food dish. They beg/demand the treats every morning, but they still eat the rest of the pellets now as well.

review_body:

product_title: Green Killing Machine Internal 9 Watt UV Sterilizer with Power Head
review_body:

I had green water taking over my tank even with water changes every other day (only have sunny areas in my house and picked the least sunny spot for my tank). First two days it didn't appear to be working, I then did a 1/3 water change and within 2 days my water was very clear... now 4 days later, my tank is the clearest it has ever been.

The only con is the size, I have a 29g tank and it takes up a good amount of space and is kind of ugly... Good to use for the time being, will look to convert to a in-line version once I switch to canister filtration.

product_title: Bergan Gourmet Feeders and Waterers
review_body:
Workable. It's made out of cheap plastic, but I love the fact that I can clean every inch of it by hand. The removable cap is a simple twist on-off, and the "will not release water until placed on the base" is but a simple plastic flap that looks like it would easily break. I'm not worried though. The hole it covers in the lid is small and I can plug it with my finger if I have to.

The water is slow to trickle out, which amuses my cats to no end. The only other downside is that the reservoir has no handle on it and can be slippery when wet.

Overall, the base is sturdy and thwarts small mammals from knocking it over. My obnoxious cat is the size of a small dog and hasn't managed to knock it over yet. From the human perspective, it's cheap and easy to clean.

I do not recommend this for elderly pet owners or young children, as a full reservoir can be unwieldy when transferring it back to the base.

product_title: PetSafe Yard & Park Rechargeable Dog Training Collar with Tone and Static Correction, Waterproof, Up to 400 Yards
review_headline: The "PetSaver" Yard & Park Remote Dog Trainer
review_body:
This product actually allowed me to keep my Doberman Pinscher. Without it, I would have surely had to send her back to the breeder. Before I began to use this product with her, she was simply \\"untrainable.\\" She was really the most stubborn dog I had ever imagined or seen. The whole \\"pack leader\\" concept and giving positive reinforcement with lots of treats is definitely no stranger to me when training dogs. This is actually my preferred method but teaching my dog to sit or walk on a leash was nearly impossible, not to mention stopping aggressive behavior towards other dogs and people. She would growl or bark at anyone who came into her path. I eventually took her to an expert dog trainer.

The expert dog trainer is a very-well known dog trainer in my state. He trains police dogs and other wild animals. The guy has over 40 years of dog training experience. I left my dog with him for 3 straight days. After those 3 days, he was unable to even teach her to sit or walk on a leash! He even tried using a prong collar on her to teach her to walk on the leash and she would just sit there stubbornly as he was tugging on the leash! A friend of mine with 4 dogs all successfully trained by this trainer recommended that I get rid of my dog. He said if that trainer could not train my dog it meant she was irreversibly screwed up in the head.

After that, I decided to break out the ol' Petsafe Yard & Park Remote Dog Trainer. I couldn't believe that I had almost forgotten that I owned one of these. I had used it briefly on my previous dog with great success. Matter-of-fact, many other dogs owners would say that it was the best trained dog they had ever seen.

I had not used the remote trainer for over 3 years so I was worried that the batteries would be dead or something. To my delight, after charging the remote and collar, the product was working like new. I put it on my Doberman and she learned to \\"sit\\" within 5 minutes! Three days with an expert police dog trainer and she did not learn to do this!

Almost 3 months later, she has been sitting consistently when I tell her to do so. She now comes whenever I call her. At first she would completely ignore me when I would tell her to \\"come.\\" Now she turns on a dime and comes darting to me immediately when I say \\"come.\\" When I tell her to \\"heel\\" she is right next to my leg like a pair of tight fitting pants, continuously gauging if she is doing it correct enough by watching my steps as we walk.

This trainer also has good transmission. I could be in the basement with the transmitter and the receiver on the second floor of my home and I can press the button and it would still beep. Not to mention that my dog could be way on the other side of the park and I could still \\"reach her.\\"

I have another dog that is about to join my family so I just ordered an extra collar from Amazon \\"just in case...\\"

Now, I am the person that researches things to death before I purchase or use a product. To use this item correctly, you must educate yourself on how to use it properly. If you don't, this type of training could blow up in your face.There are all sort of videos out there.

This Petsafe collar has different settings. You will only want to use the lowest setting that will get the dogs attention. The level 3 setting is what I use for my dog and she doesn't yell in pain or go into a confused state when I stimulate her. She simply looks up and do what I ask her to do immediately. She still tends to give a low pitched growl at other dogs she sees on the street but it is much less often and she tends not to growl at other people now. We are still working on this still but I do not use the collar for those behaviors. The collar helped her to learn that when I say \\"no\\" she should stop any unwanted behavior that she is engaging in immediately so when she growls at another dog, I will say \\"no\\" and she would then stop growling immediately.

Bottom line: I love this product and it helped me to keep my dog.

product_title: Boett Reflective Track Harness for Dogs, 2-Inch, Size 6, Black
review_body:
My three dogs have been through many different harnesses, and have worn this style Boett for the last couple years. See boett-usa.com for photos and examples of which size to buy for your breed. My ACD (aka blue heeler) was nicknamed "Houdini" due to his ability to ditch any harness (truly, ANY harness) at will. He can wiggle out of this one if he wants to, too...but even so, I've come to greatly respect this harness.

1) Outstanding night-time visibility to cars and in areas with any reflective light. Black dogs walked at night especially benefit, but what dog is truly safe from the hazard of cars? Note that this harness reflects, it does not glow, so I add a bike light for hiking in what will soon become a dark forest. 2) The D-ring leash attachment is attached to a long loop that greatly reduces sideways torque if your dog suddenly pulls. Meaning, his spine won't get thrown out of alignment in a "squirrell!" moment. 3) the earlier mentioned loop is an excellent handle for pulling your dog into a boat or simply restraining them for a moment. 4) it's easy to get the harness on, and easy to get it off with one hand. 5) I've come to believe that neck collars are not safe, even for play. There is NO strain or involvement of the dog's neck in this harness. A neck collar may seem like the most ordinary, safe thing in the world, but it isn't. For example, doggy day cares will not allow your dog to wear a collar during the day due to risk of strangulation. If your dog ever plays with other dogs or climbs over or under stuff, a neck collar is dangerous.

I use laminated labels to affix my dogs' phone number to the reflective part of the harness. You could also use the D-Ring / leash attachment for ID tags, though it would be noisy. The Boett harness is not intended nor marketed as a car restraint safety belt and it would almost certainly be insufficient to protect your dog in any serious accident. However, the design of the harness makes it easy to pass a shoulder seat belt through the black upper loop of the harness and thus constrain your dog to a small area in the car with enough leeway for your dog to choose whether to sit or lie down (and change her mind). This is an effective method to avoid driver distraction or window jumping, and this method never puts your dog at risk for strangulation. (NEVER attempt to restrain your dog by a neck collar in the car, please!)

product_title: Nature's Miracle Stain and Odor Remover - 32 ounce
review_headline: Proper use will rid your floor of pet, human and wine for good!
review_body:
This stuff really works for me and my home. The house always smells fresh and we always have at least a gallon lying around. I have two beasts and the eldest whom is 13 years old, has been having a problem going #1 in where she should. This has been a ongoing problem for at least 4 years. I tried steam cleaning, rug oder remover and Fabreeze; nothing seemed to work. In the last year I heard about the Nature's Miracle product through an online source so I immediately ran to the pet store and purchased a bottle of the Original Formula.

Upon the first application, I thought the smell was great and I was so shocked how the solution pulled up the urine stains only 5 minutes after applying. I also used the solution sparingly at first because I thought that it was kind of pricey. Now, I think the product is worth every cent, and I use it more liberally so that it really soaks into the carpet and padding underneath. I will sometimes apply a second dose and let it set for 15 minutes or more. Then I use paper towels to mop it up. I used to use rags but I went through too many and they get wet quickly. I hated having to wash and wait for the rags to dry while I was in the process of cleaning the carpet. I know that paper towels can get pricey too but I'm okay with it since I'd do just about anything to get the urine and smell up before I have company. After placing sheets of paper towel on carpet, I then walk on the sheets to dry the carpet areas and to get the liquid to soak into the paper towels. Whenever I use a second application of Nature's Miracle, I usually have to lay two layers down to soak up all the liquids and I leave it that way for about a half or whole day. Then I simply pick up the paper towels and throw them away. Depending on how much solution I use and what time of year it is (or how cold or hot my home is), it may take a day or two to dry.

I highly recommend this product for anyone that has pet stains they want to get rid of. I've actually used it for human stains on a bed once and then used fans to dry the mattress. I used the Original smelling formula for about 6 months, but it occasionally caused headaches because the smell was so strong. I've now switched to the orange formula which is much better for me but I also recommend trying the original formula at least once to see if you like the smell. If you end up deciding you want to buy it from the store, you can do a smell comparison there. product_title: PetSafe Gentle Spray Bark Collar for Dogs, Citronella, Anti-Bark Device, Water Resistant
review_body:
My standard poodle has separation anxiety. Moving is tough - my dog has been known to bark and bark for hours if he's left somewhere new. In an effort to keep my new neighbors happy and sane, I did some research and came across this collar which has made a huge difference in my dog's (and my) life. Here's a little routine that has really done the trick.

Step 1: Put on the PetSafe Gentle Spray Anti-Bark Collar. Wag wag, dog is happy because he knows about Step 2.
Step 2: Hide doggie cookies throughout the house, keep dog sitting on his bed, waiting anxiously. (Yum yum yum!)
Step 3: Set the mood - turn on some music (Motown Hits?), leave blinds open a little so he's got a view of the squirrels.
Step 4: Leave. Dog runs around on his scavenger hunt while forgetting about yours truly, who is long gone.

Needless to say the dog often seems happy to be left at home alone. The neighbors have had little to report (I think at this point he's learned what not to do), with exception of the day my dog sitter put the collar on upside down. He's a smart bugger. Also, sometimes when I get home he celebrates with a bark, so I am greeted at the door by the dog and a whiff of citronella.

So far so good! Oh yeah be sure to check that the battery is working and citronella is full. My dog still does sound checks. Replacement batteries and refill cans easy to find on Amazon, but can also be found at local pet store and battery store in a pinch.

The collar worked very well for about a week to ten days. It sprayed just as designed, and would even go off when he whined loudly. We didn't have any trouble with barking from other dogs causing the collar to spray. Overall, I was very pleased with this product until about three days ago.

After a day or so of random spraying, we took the collar off and won't use it again. That's a real shame, as it was working quite well.

product_title: Kaytee Clean and Cozy Small Animal Bedding
review_headline: Good product, stay away from scented for Guinea Pigs, CareFresh is better
review_body: If you are looking for small pet bedding Kaytee makes a decent product.  However, CareFresh is the standard that pet stores like PetCo and PetSmart use in-house and recommend since it is typically 100% paper based. They (Guinea pigs) tend to eat them and it can get lodged in their throats.  It is fine for smaller pets such as hamsters or larger ones like rabbits. product_title: Pioneer Pet Raindrop Ceramic Drinking Fountain
review_headline: Great product and easy assembly, my cat loves it :)
review_body: This is my first pet fountain however others in my family have tried several others.  Based off of family recommendation I wanted a ceramic fountain due to film build up and cat preferences. ( From my understanding some cats do not like the plasic taste from some other well known products like drinkwell.)  I really like this product.  My cat drinks alot more water.  I had concerns with my cats dehydration since he seemed to drink little from regular bowls and had stronger smelling urine, with is a sign of dehydration....  After realizing he prefers moving water and learning from others experiences I decided it was worth the money to buy a fountain and I'm glad I did.  This product had great reviews and were well deserved.  As suggested by a previous buyer I bought the white version so that I could view any cat food or other particles in the bowl.  It is very easy to clean and I figured out how to assemble very quickly.  Some fountains are complicated but this fountain is simple and pretty much a two piece assembly, triangular motor/filter container and "river" top(unless changing the filter or motor setting, then it is 3).  I did have to mess with it a bit to get it to line up just right but it still was simple.  This is a great drinking fountain and I have no complaints.  I would recommend this to anybody who asked.  Oh and just FYI of course it is a little weighty but I think that goes without saying since it is a ceramic bowl. So, don't be surprised that is well made and not a  thin ceramic that could easily break.  As far as spilling over as some others have mentioned I have no problem, my cat prefers to drink from the top so it never spills.  The fountain itself will not send water flying out so the only water that could come out is by the pet that is using it.

product_title: Sofantex Pet Paw Print Pet Bed, 25-inch
review_headline: Beds for the dogs, and peace for me!
review_body: Got two of these to put on the other side of my queen size bed for the dogs to use.  They hopped right in, thank goodness.  The reason I got these is because I have two mini schnauzers who got used to sleeping on my bed when they had a bout of illness that needed constant supervision.  Now I can't convince them they belong elsewhere to go beddie-bye.  They were pushing me almost out of the bed if they got cold at night.  In fact, the boy dog (Crickie) developed the habit of laying almost on top of me, then sliding down to be as close as possible.  Repeat that a couple times a night, and I was out in the cold!  With these beds, they seem to stay warm and don't need to be right next to me.  Sleep, at last!!  They look nice, too, and just happen to fit in with my bedroom color scheme. product_title: FURminator deShedding Tool for Dogs

product_title: Bio Spot Active Care Flea & Tick Carpet & Upholstery Powder
review_headline: Ok, but better cheaper products are out there. Use Diatomaceous earth.
review_body: Smells ok but can be overwhelming. Use it before you leave for the day, or a weekend. After used I still had Feas.It was kind of a painful process to use this powder. I would highly suggest using something like food grade "Diatomaceous earth", it causes micro cuts in the exoskeleton of insects (fleas, roaches etc) and causes them to dehydrate. Diatomaceous earth is what I used to finally ride my house of fleas. Either treatments take several treatments and ~60 days to kill fleas and eggs, but Diatomaceous earth didn't give me breathing problems. Skill an OK product, glad I tried it.

review_headline: Don't use if you or your cat has respiratory sensitivities
review_body: This is indeed a very economical litter, and it claims to be "flushable", though I wouldn't trust flushing it to any but the newest plumbing.  What I found was the amount of dust with this product is very disturbing.  Also, it is so fine that the dust hangs in the air for several hours after pouring this stuff. I also found it clumps poorly, which might be an advantage if you are flushing it, but is a distinct disadvantage if you are not flushing the waste.  Also, because it is so fine, it tracks everywhere.  You will have to make sure you have a really effective mat if you're going to use this stuff.

product_title: Aqueon Quietflow Internal Power Filter
review_headline: Works fine, just that the cartridges are costly and also not necessary.
review_body: I got this from a friend. I didn't want to use this because the cartridges are expensive. Instead of getting a cartridge, I put some bio-balls media that I had in it and layered some blue and white floss over it. I snapped the top on and it is all set. Buying the cartridges with the carbon is dumb. It's a rip-off. Carbon is only useful if you want to filter out medication. If you want to use carbon, get some loose stuff and put it in a small stocking in the filter. Buy the bio-balls media and a piece of floss and you are set for a very long time. The bio-balls last forever. Just rinse it in some tank water in a bucket so you don't kill the good bacteria with chlorine water. Other than my gripe about the cartridge, the filter is quiet and powerful. I like that you can rotate the return flow and spray it where you want.

I wish I had found this product earlier, as we've been to the Vet twice this year alone to treat her skin condition. I appreciated the inclusion of the travel size package by the seller. That's great customer service and something that anyone who travels with their babies will find very handy to have in their luggage!

product_title: Flea Flicker! Tick Kicker! 8 Ounces
review_body: First of all, we had been battling fleas for two solid years.  We took our cat to the vet, who recommended the usual Advantage, Frontline, and two other so called flea treatments. We just could not get rid of the fleas.  Then we treated the house with a spray, and tried still another flea  remedy that was supposed to be safe for cats.  The first time we did these two treatments, we saw a dramatic reduction in the fleas, but my cat got sick from the topical treatment, and it smelled awful; plus she acted weird for three day, and was just not herself. Worse, the fleas returned.  So the flea spray went into the trash. The second time we treated the house, I got sick from the stuff and my cat freaked out for three days.  So we visited a natural pet food store, and the clerk recommended two products, one of which I am reviewing here.  It was called Flea Flicker, Tick Kicker. The other was a liquid which was to be added to food and or water, called \\"Flea Free.\\" Within one week of treating our cat with the recommended spray between the shoulder blades, and the liquid in her food, she had less fleas on her coat when we combed her. The other product was added to her canned food.  It produces an enzyme which discourages the fleas from biting.  With no food source they are melting away like magic.  The Flea Flicker Tick Kicker spray worked for me, too.  Each morning the fleas would bite my feet and legs as soon as I got out of bed and it was maddening. I would spray my legs with this product and they quit biting me, too! Now my cat is not scratching frantically anymore, and the towel she likes to lie on has less and less flea dirt on it as the weeks go by. We are very pleased with this product, and are so glad to not be poisoning our cat nor ourselves anymore.

And in case I wasn't clear, my cats are psychotic. Anyway, the fountain provides a nice, non-splash stream of water, the stream is nicely adjustable, and the unit is ridiculously quiet. If it wasn't for the only-so-occasional sound of water, you'd never know it was running. The one cat will lap from it and seems to enjoy it. The other two are psychotic, so you can't judge this product by their behavior. I'm holding out for them to get desperate as I've finally removed their water bowl. I recommend this fountain.... despite my psychotic cats.

*** Update *** This product is NOT prone to leaking. What you may be experiencing if you think it's leaking is that the charcoal filter is dirty and in need of replacing; there are holes in the top body, interior to the unit, that will let a high water level on the source side of the filter over flow and "leak" out from under the center of the unit. Nothing's really leaking, it's just an overflow situation because the pump is moving water faster than it can flow through the dirty filter. Replace your filter, clean up the spill, then order more filters to keep around. All good.

product_title: JW Pet Hol-ee Treat Ball Dog Toy
review_headline: I like it a lot--my dog LOVES it!
review_body:
My dog is food motivated. She is a large, 135lb American Mastiff and is 10 years old. People are always surprised because she is so active and \\"puppy like\\". In addition to daily exercise, I like to keep her mind active as well. This is her \\"Go-To\\" toy that does the trick and seems to never stop giving--treats that is! Break up healthy treats small enough to fit through the holes, but large enough that they all don't come out easily. My dog knows by seeing, smelling and/or hearing when there are treats remaining inside. She doesn't give up.

I've seen other reviews that the ball doesn't last long but the abuse that my dog puts this treat toy through, I am quite pleased with its durability. I do buy a couple at a time and they tend to last about 2 months each. Even my Kong Super Strength treat toys last about the same amount of time as well. Other toys last 1-7 days before it either stops squeaking, torn at the seams, etc. I do have some electrical tape holding together the plastic ball on my current one and it has lengthened its life for an additional month and still counting. You'll certainly get many active hours out of this toy, and isn't that the point?

I love this toy. Yeah, it can be a little noisy. But that is a small price to pay for my dog's happiness. I mean, how long at any given time does she play with it? Maybe 5 at a time--multiple times through out the day. That's a long time in a doggy's life and it makes her happy. If she's happy, then I am happy! :D

It is made from natural rubber and JW Pet Company certifies that it is NON-TOXIC. That is another reason why I buy it.

You should consider buying this if you want to keep your dogs mind healthy and active. Also, if you are giving more healthy treats, be sure to make sure that your pooch gets additional exercise to avoid unnecessary weight gain. This combination is a winner. This treat ball is the ONLY TOY that keeps her coming back for more.

You can find the remote battery here: [[ASIN:B003V53DIW SportDOG WetlandHunter 800 Replacement Receiver Battery]] (the battery is listed as NiHm KINETIC 4.8v 120MaH) . You can find the collar remote here: [[ASIN:B003V56PPU SportDOG Dog Training Collar Transmitter Battery Kit for SD-400 Series]] (the battery is listed as NiHm KINETIC 7.2v 160MaH). Just remove the screws on the back of each unit, pull out and replace the dead batteries, put the backs back on, and the system will be as good as new and you'll save almost $70!

product_title: 11102 Canine Concepts Medium Black Mesh Non-pull Dog Harness
review_body:
Dear stupid reviewers that tried to talk me out of this product because you don't understand no-pull harnesses,
This IS a no pull harness. It's the DEFINITION of a no-pull harness.

Story: I adopted two young dogs from a shelter, litter mates. Their previous owners did not train them in anything and either neglected or abused them because they were fearful, destructive and resistant to training. They didn't know what a leash was, and have a little husky in them. So we were not able to walk them because they literally pulled as hard as they could until they started choking and coughing. We tried to leash train them and made a little progress, but it's embarrassing to walk them at a park and have people staring at your choking, gagging dogs. After we put this harness on them it was like a miracle. They would lunge forward out the door and then immediately stop and then walk like normal. They USED to pull so hard that one of them dragged me across the grass for a few feet. Now they walk like normal dogs and I'm so proud of them. They stay at a perfect distance and don't keep the leash taunt, and if they see a person or a dog they don't pull me to the ground. They just give up at trying to run off.

It is difficult to get the harness on correctly if the dogs are excited. You have to sit there for a few minutes and turn the harness around a couple of times in your hands to make sure it's right way around and gets on them correctly. If they are jumping around it's really irritating, but they are getting better about standing still for me. The mesh fits on their chest and the pads fit in their armpits. It tightens when pulled on, if it doesn't then you have it on wrong.

All in all, perfect solution for hard to train pullers and breeds that love to pull on leashes. I'm now even able to walk them on a normal collar-leash because they have learned not to pull from the harness.

review_headline: Very complete vitamin mix - includes D, K and lots of iron!
review_body:
I had been supplementing my cats' food with individual vitamins, which was time consuming, and pricey. While I had found other vitamins online, none had all the vitamins that my cats needed. What was missing was vitamin K, along with a good source of iron. I was thrilled when I found Hi-Vite online. The first store I found them only sold to vets. So I kept looking until I located the vitamins on Amazon.

As another reviewer mentioned, the liquid is very thick and sticky. (Resembles thin Vegemite.) It smells yeasty, and does contain sugar. However, except for the lack of vitamin C, it has a good selection of vitamins in larger amounts that the other vitamins I had been using for my cats. No more mixing vitamin K in their food!! And my cats like the taste! I had been struggling to get one cat to eat his food when B vitamins were added. He ate his food without any problems with Hi-Vite mixed in. (It may have more to do with smell than taste. Either way, he will eat his food with Hi-Vite mixed in.)

For sick cats, this is a great product since it has plenty of vitamin D, K and iron. Now if someone would realize that older cats need vitamin C as well, I would be super satisfied. For now, ascorbic acid added to their food works.

product_title: SunSun HW-302 3-Stage External Canister Filter, 264 GPH
review_headline: Well worth the money I spent
review_body:
to keep it brief.

flow rate does appear to be a little lower than advertised, i am currently running coarse foam pad, fine filter pad then a mix of eheim bio media and sea chem bio stars in order from top to bottom in this canister. it took a little bit, but an already pretty clear tank became even better looking.

The pump itself is a very quiet unit, priming does take some effort, but I will not detract, as even after a few media changes, the hand pump still works, and only needs to be depressed 1-3 times total to clear the system of air - the separation system is working great thus far (4 months in). the amount of debris that I remove from the filter is also rather disturbing, as it shows just how little the old whisper was actually cleaning before dying.

Another solid plus for this unit is the adjustable spray bar... while I love the other HOB i have, the water flow pummels the fish from time to time.

the green tubing also softened up enough with warm water to fit the seals easily and firmly, no leaks of any kind.

As for the negatives on this model:
Noticed immediately that the black plastic plumbing fixtures were brittle - took extra care and used petroleum jelly on the connections so they would piece together better.

the biggest negative is partially my fault (sand substrate) when the fish kick sand into the intake, the baskets (particularly the bottom one) becomes extremely hard to remove, again using petroleum jelly this is now not a huge issue. the negative is that the handles built into the baskets snap off VERY easily and become useless.

I would buy this again in a second, especially with the price I paid for it.
Parts are easily found for the twin model of aquatop in stores.

Tank setup:
55 gallon
sand substrate
10 African mbuna cichlids
fluorescent lighting

Filtration:
(1) Fluval C4 (running)
(1) whipser power filter 60 (this was replaced by the 302)
(1) HW-302 (being reviewed)

product_title: Educator Belt/Saddle/Purse Quick-Release Transmitter Holder for Educator and Einstein Remote Dog Training Collars
review_headline: A bit chinsy, but very handy.
review_body:
At first, I loved this clip, it made the remote for my Educator ET-1200UL so much more convenient, always in a place that is quick to grab, but not in the way.

After only a week though, simply brushing up against a door frame with it on cause the plastic to crack. For a $23+ item, this re-purposed phone clip really left me disappointed. I do not quite understand why Einstein would produce such a poor quality product, so uncharacteristic of their typical high standards. (I LOVE my Educator ET-1200UL, it is the most sturdy, well thought out, high quality training collar and remote I have ever seen).

The issue is the small round retainer that contains the attachment screw, that slides into a guide on the clip, this design makes any directional stress compound on the edges of this chinsy retainer, causing it to crack. The simple solution is either to change the design, or change the materials to metal.

I plan to call E-Collar/Einstein to request a replacement, I will update based on their service to remedy the issue.

UPDATE: One call to E-Collar/Einstein, which went straight to a real, live, english speaking person, and a new one was in the mail. There is still the quality problem, but at least the company is willing to make it better with great customer service!

product_title: SeaClear 36 gal Bowfront Acrylic Aquarium Combo Set
review_body:
First off, this is an approximately 36 gallon tank (mine is filled 3/4 inch from the the top, which I've measured as 35 gallons). The dimensions are 11(at sides)to 15 inches deep, 30 1/4 inches long, and 21 3/8 inches high. This version of the tank has a clear back, which I recommend, since it allows you choose your own back (I used reflective mylar, which makes the tank look deeper. It has acquired an algae and java moss patina over the years).

This is a gorgeous tank, but be aware that the top is partially enclosed (an advantage overall--looks nice and prevents evaporation and fish jumping out). The 36 gallon bowfront has a 2\\"x15\\" space 3/4\\" from the back for your filter, plus a 1 1/2\\"x2\\" hole in the back left corner for your heater. The main opening, 5\\" by 23\\", is under the light, and includes an acrylic shield which is easy to re-use if you upgrade your fixture. I had no problem fitting anything, but an unusual setup might require cutting the acrylic. The thin strip of acrylic between the filter opening and light opening has warped a bit, probably from the heat of my two T5 retrofit lights, but not enough to be a problem.( I've since replaced the T5 lights with LEDs.)

I have had this tank for almost eight years now, and still love it. I had no scratches until I started using (supposedly acrylic-safe) mag-float and mag-flip algae scrapers, which tend to catch grit and scrape it across the tank in the blink of an eye. The partially enclosed top does make scraping algae by hand a bit awkward, unless you have an arm with two elbows. ( Not a single scratch was put there by hand-scraping, though.) The scratches bother me, but other people claim not to notice them. The acrylic is still visibly clearer than my glass tank.

Acrylic tanks do require a solid surface to sit on. My stand is a particleboard (or composite wood, whatever they call it) one with a solid top. It shipped flat and was easy to put together. I worried about the laminate peeling and the particleboard softening from moisture, but it looks fine after eight years. You could probably fit a piece of exterior grade plywood into one of those frame-type stands.

product_title: Tetra Whisper EX Power Filter
review_body:
[[VIDEOID:mo3K0XR75RN1J3X]]I purchased 2 of the Whisper EX30 units for my 33 gallon long tank. Both work flawlessly and quietly. I even took a short video of them. Finally the air circulation system in the building shut off so I could tape this (Very rare, building owner doesn't like people suffocating in the building and dying I guess), both of these units run quietly enough together that the little bubbler is louder then them. The video is filmed in dead silence in the middle of the night. TV easily drowns these out. They do make a little hum, not a big deal, they all hum a little. These truly are whispers, if yours isn't, talk to someone about it and get it replaced, you have a defective unit. Neither has given me any trouble, both work the same and are very reliable. You can also see the water is crystal clear, my water is never any worse then it is in the video, even right before a bi-monthly water change.

Only thing that bothered me, not enough to take away a star, was it is a little snug on the tank, good in some cases, I just like a bit of play because down the road if they ever do start vibrating or such, I could put a thin foam pad between them and the tank and loud pumps go quiet then. Did that with the Aqua-Tech I had prior to these because it screamed like a banshee right outta the box. Seriously impressed with these units though, and fitting snugly is probably a good thing. And by snug I mean, it fits like a glove, no forcing it on or anything, fits right down as it should, but has no play. Like it was machined to fit (On my tank anyhow).

PS - Disappointed with the FEDEX guy though, slacker entered delivery attempt when none was made since I was here the whole time, gate unlocked and open. No door tag provided, secretary and surveillance cams saw no sign of him anywhere that day, didn't even drive past. Had to pick this up 2 days later and talked to manager. Disciplinary action took place before I had even left, glad I wasn't that guy, they were really tearing a strip off him.

product_title: FleaGo Flea Control Powder for Carpet and Floors, 2 lb Jar
review_body: THis was suggested by friends who have lots of cats.  I had major infestation and used Fleago throughout the house as directed.  Seems to have rid the fleas from the house.  Got this additional container in case they return next season.

product_title: Outward Hound Hide-A-Squirrel and Puzzle Plush Squeaking Toys for Dogs

I highly recommend this toy.

product_title: Coolaroo Replacement Dog Bed Cover - Terra Cotta
review_body: Great for having when you need to take one off to wash it.  You can just pop the clean one on.

product_title: Zoo Med Laboratories AZMBL20 Betta Hammock

review_body: Good idea, but my son's betta won't rest on it.  I've had it in the tank now for about a month and the betta will swim over it for a second, but that is all.  I'll keep in the tank, but don't recommend it since the betta doesn't use it.

product_title: ProDental Solution Pet Toothbrushes and Toothpastes
