product_title: Wooden Pet Toy Box - Walnut
review_body: I love this toy box....it's perfect for all of my pet's supplies.  I had plenty of space to have her name written on the lid and on the front of the toy box.  I'm very pleased!!

product_title: WARE BIRD/SM AN 089642 Critter Universe Avatower Small Pet Home Clear&Blue, 13.75X11.25X21
review_body:
I went to PetSmart with the family to buy hamster supplies. Our hamster did needed a bigger cage and we saw this one on sale, so we bought it. The wife and kids all love the cage. I immediately notice, in the store, that PetSmart didn't have any demo cages setup of this brand (they had a demo cage setup for almost all their other cages.) When I got home I immediately knew why... This cage is extremely cheap in construction; a Chinese knock would have been higher quality than this thing. The front isn't very secure, and it is apparent that it is only a matter of time before the hamster figures out how to get out. The only reason it didn't go back to the store is like I said, the kids and wife loved it. Yet I know within a year it will have to be replaced.

Update: Our hamster has chewed through much of the platics of the cage. So after just over a month we are forced to move him back to his old cage. This thing was a complete waste of money. I will make sure to watch out for any Ware products in the future.

product_title: PetEdge Super Styling Sessions DVD, Shih Tzu
review_body: This video is a great tutorial for the shih tzu breed. They demonstrate three different cuts including the \\"lamb\\" cut, a longer cut that shows off the shih tzu's beautiful coat, and a very short summer cut. The explanation of the blades and types of scissors and the technique of using each was very clear. It appears that this video was geared to other professional groomers, but it is very easy to understand, and thus would highly recommend to anyone who plans on grooming their dogs at home. My only wish is that they covered other basics such as how to clip nails and whiten the stains around mouth and eyes and best way to untangle knots. I'm sure I can find this via google search, but it would be easier to have it all in one place.

product_title: MidWest Stainless Steel Snap'y Fit Water and Feed Bowl
review_body:
Maybe the one I got is defective, because I don't see how anyone could claim this bowl is a \\"Snap'y Fit.\\" That suggests you can attach the brackets then pull out the bowl to fill it then snap it back into place snugly. NOT!

You have to disconnect the entire set up every time you want to fill the water bowl, or have really good aim for pouring from above through the grate. I find this extremely inconvenient and wouldn't have bought it if I had understood this. If this isn't a drawback for you though, then this is a quality product made out of solid materials.

product_title: OXBOW PET PRODUCTS 448009 Timothy Carrot for Pets
review_body: My guinea pigs will chew on these a lot the first week or so, but they won't care for it eventually. It might be a loss of its scent. That said they'll chew the larger upper area and the straight part that sticks out the most. There is another brand that makes one almost just like this, but it doesn't state that it's made from timothy hay. It's nice that the packaging is straight forward about what it's made of.

product_title: Doggles Dog Harness Dress
review_headline: Doggies Dog Harness Dress Pink,Extra small
review_body: this is so cute. looks adorable on my dog. I think she loved it too. The style and look is adorable.

product_title: SCRATCH'M Crocodile Cat Scratcher with Catnip
review_body: This is by far the WORST piece of junk I have ever purchased on Amazon (or anywhere else for that matter.) This company 'conveniently' leaves out the fact that this \\"scratching pad with catnip\\" HAS NO BOTTOM...therefore, if you do sprinkle the enclosed catnip (which is probably poisoned, courtesy of China) it \\"sprinkles\\" ALL OVER YOUR FLOOR. It is thin and flimsy cardboard and I will NEVER again purchase anything from delcacorp.com, \\"distributor\\" of this CHINESE CRAP that is sabotaging the economy of the USA.

product_title: MidWest iCrate Single Door & Double Door Folding Metal Dog Crates
review_headline: Perfect for a Pug or French Bulldog
review_body: I bought this as a second crate for at home for my new pug puppy.  It costs just as much as a cage divider, but comes with one!  It is so easy to put together and just the right size for a pug or a french bulldog.  What a great buy.

product_title: KONG PUPPY KONG Durable Rubber Chew and Treat Toy
review_body: I bought this for my Maltese, he is 6 years old because so many place recommend it and my dog just chewed my shoes. At first I was like o no, I bought the wrong thing, its for puppy! So I thought I would give it a try if he is interested then i will buy the adult one. I did everything they recommend such as put food in there, put peanut butter, put treats. My dog just doesn't like it. He completely ignore the toy, its actually his least favorite toy. Maybe bigger dogs like kong, i dont know...

product_title: Lentek Bark Free Dog Training Device
review_headline: Beeps are too long and too late - not associated with the bark
review_body:
This thing beeps 1-2 seconds _after_ the barking starts and then beeps for 4-5 seconds. If the dog keeps barking though the beep or starts up again right after the beep, the unit does not start beeping again for 5+ seconds. The association just isn't there. The beeping doesn't connect directly to the barking. It should start the second she barks and stop when she stops if it's going to help with training.

The design of this unit is just ridiculous. It's too top-heavy to stand on a table, even without the power cord sticking out of the base and pushing it further off. I couldn't get it balanced in any position without it beeping at me for touching it. I am certain that these false positives

The description makes it sound like there are lots of sound and sensitivity options. In reality, there are two options for each - high/low sensitivity and audible/ultra-sonic sound.

After 30 minutes of listening to this thing beep on and off at random while my dog barked continuously (mostly at the unit) I am done. What a waste of postage.

product_title: Reversible Sling Dog Carrier
review_body: I purchased this for my 4 lb Chihuahua, who fits in it just fine, but tried it on some of my other dogs ranging from 3lbs to 10 lbs......not a problem.  It's ease of use and the fact that it can be washed is a plus. The only reason I didn't give it 5 starts is because it's labeled as measuring 67\\" x 17\\" and mine is just barely 64\\" and that extra couple of inches makes a big difference.  Also, I knew it didn't have one, but it would be a good idea to have a clip on the inside that could attach to a harness for extra safety.  I'll be adding that myself.

product_title: Sentry HC WormX Plus Dog Dewormer (Round/Hook/Tapeworm) Dog
review_headline: If there is a better product I haven't found it
review_body: Worm X was prescribed by my vet for one of my dogs, who has worm issues.  Since he has a habit of eating animal scat, dead mice etc., he needs to be wormed regularly.  He tolerates Worm X well, but never seems to be totally free of worms. It worked better when I first started treating him monthly.  I suspect he was never worm free and the worms have developed a tolerance for this product.  If your dog doesn't have a chronic problem or bad habits like mine has, it will probably work fine.

product_title: Purness Van Ness Cat Pan in Gray
review_body: In a kennel area, it is really nice to have these compact litter boxes that don't take up the entire cage. The cats enjoy it too, since they have more room to move and play, and they tend to get less cat litter tracked everywhere--which means it also stays out of their food and water bowls. However, very young kittens or adult large cats should probably have a bigger box because they tend to miss from the lack of room.

product_title: Solvit Sta-Put Deluxe Hammock Pet Seat Cover
review_body: I purchased this Solvit Sta-Put Deluxe hammock pet seat cover for use on our vacation.  Opened the box and installed this in my Honda CRV the night before leaving on vacation.  Three days later, one of the strap buckles broke rendering it useless.  I do not recommend this to other buyers.

product_title: Portable Pet Crate for Small and Medium Dogs
review_body: I love the product.  It is very easy to take apart and clean also.  My daughter uses it for her rabbits.

product_title: ViaAqua 12in 2.7 watt Slow Color Changing LED Light & Airstone
review_body: This is a must have for any tank! Because of the size of the holes the bubbles come out in a wavy sort of line which is a really cool affect! The only thing I can say about this is after using it for a while it seemed like someof the holes were clogged so I took it out and tried to clean it but poking each hole with a thumb tack to clear the way, bad idea I ended up enlarging some of the holes which completely ruins the slow wavy bubble wall affect so I do not recommend poking anything in the holes. I loved it so much I am going to buy another one but this time I will definitely clean it a different way.

product_title: Halo Spot's Pate Food for Cats
review_body: I bought both the ground chicken and whitefish pate for my sister's cat.  He loves it and better yet, it's good for him.  According to my sister, he asks for it by name!  :)

product_title: Ultra Paws Traction Dog Boots
review_body:
I measured my dogs paws and decided to get a size up so they'll fit as she gets bigger. don't do this! just measure and order the size based on your dogs current paw size otherwise the boots will fall off.

Obviously my fault for getting them too big, but the 3 stars I give this item are for its quality which doesn't seem to be long lasting.

product_title: PetFusion SmartGrip Cat Litter Mat. Large (35 x 24 inches). Safe for your cats, free from Phthalates & VCM
review_body: Really glad I bought this mat.  It does cut down on the litter mess.  I don't have to vacuum as much as I did to clean up the litter box mess.  Would highly recommend this.  I also recommend the larger size one.

product_title: Indipets Extra Heavy Stainless Steel Non Tip - Anti Skid Health Care Slow Feeding Dish "Colors May Vary"
review_body: Received this product and was skeptical about whether it could slow down my gobbling dog.  From the start, it has caused my dog to pause and chew her food and triple the eating time and reduce her eating speed.  While she has never had a big problem by eating too fast, it certainly is nice to be able to leave the area after feeding her and not have her on my heels wanting more.  This really works for my dog.

product_title: Nutramax Cosequin Sprinkle Capsules for Cats
review_headline: Cosequin Gave Us Our Cat Back, Best product ever!
review_body: I noticed my cat not being able to jump on the chair, she started growling & screamed when she would try.  I immediately took her to the vet and the x-ray showed she had arthritis and also the last vertebrae in her spine was swollen.  She was given a pain medication and Cosequin.  She showed marked improvement the next day.  The second day, we had our cat back!  It worked on her that quickly.  She is on maintenance, one capsule every other day.  I found the exact same medication on Amazon.  Oh my goodness, what a savings!  I ordered two bottles and received it in less than a weeks time.  Now my cat expects the Cosequin to be sprinkled on her food daily and just picks at it on the off day.  They really like the flavor.  I do feed her dry food and just sprinkle it on top, she licks it all off.  It is made by Nutramax Laboratories which also makes a product for dogs.  When my dog shows any sign of discomfort, I will place him on this also.  I highly recommend this product.

product_title: FURminator deShedding Tool for Dogs
review_body: I ordered two of the items at the same time. They arrived 6 days apart. My sister had one and extolled it's value, and we have kin with cats who both needed some thinning. One has received the gift and we have no report back on whether or not the critter liked the grooming. The second unit is still waiting to be delivered....

product_title: Kenic Medi-Tar Dog Shampoo, 17-Ounce
review_body:
the product arrived on time and worked exactly as I expected .
It is not as harsh as the similar shampoos offered by some other companies so you avoid replacing the itch scratching with minor burn scratching, and the corresponding dandruff like flakes of skin .
as an added bonus it smells nice so the dogs don't mind it going on them ( mine hate stuff that smells weird )
I will order it again, and being able to get it from Amazon is a plus, I don't have to hunt all over for it!

product_title: Reef Builder, 600 g / 1.3 lbs
review_headline: Safely raises Alkalinity for a healthy reef!
review_body:
What do I love about alkalinity? It's the easiest test to run and the easiest to dose!

Seachem's Reef Builder will safely raise your reef tank's alkalinity without depleting other levels of your tank if used correctly and as directed on the label. They suggest mixing with at least one cup of fresh water, but I personally like to mix it in a larger volume of water so that it dissolves faster. Once resolved in the fresh water, it is ready to go into your sump or display tank! The directions on the back are very precise and detailed, so it's very easy to use the product. If you do a little searching around on the web, you'll find that there are websites that have calculators for this specific product so you know how much to dose to reach your desired level. The big benefit of using this product, is that it works very well with [[ASIN:B0002A5W8S Seachem Reef Advantage Calcium 500gram]] without fighting against each other and causing an ionic imbalance. This is a staple item I always have on hand for my reef tank. If you plan on keeping a reef tank for a long time, don't bother with the smaller quantity. Go straight for the biggest bottle you have space for! Once you use this, you won't want to use any other alkalinity products!

product_title: Catit Style Scratcher with Catnip
review_body: I ordered two of these scratchers because I have two cats and one is rather large. They are big enough for my smaller cat to lay on but the larger Main Coon kind of hangs off. I really don't think he minds. My cats have always scratched on my furniture even though I bought them expensive cat scratchers before. They actually use these and they have stopped scratching on my furniture! I didn't think that I would be able to find something that would make them stop but they love their scratchers. I don't think they will last more than a year with how often the cats are using them because they are cardboard but the point is that they are using them! I would much rather buy a couple of these a year than purchase a new couch every few.

product_title: Bacon Mini Bones Dog Treat
review_body: I found this product at PetSmart and gave it to my 14 lb. Shihpoo on Tuesday evening.  He threw up at least ten times on Wednesday and then twice more everyday since.  He hasn't been able to keep down anything but plain rice and cooked chicken all week.  Luckily, he is still playful and active, but this stuff is still in his system.  DON'T BUY IT!!!!

product_title: 2 PACK Preventic Tick Collar 18" for Dogs up to 60 Lbs
review_body: [[ASIN:B0015X9TQW Preventic Tick Collar 18\\" for Dogs Under 60lbs - Pack of 2]]  This is the best.  Right around now, the ticks jump on to my dogs, and enjoy fine dining on my poor little pugs.  I put on their new collar (regular cycle) and a few weeks later, I saw something on my dog's forehead.  Low and behold, it was a dead tick.  Whew.  As opposed to the other kind.  Just make sure that you stay on cycle.  Of course, I also use Frontline--my vet says to use both.

product_title: K&H Manufacturing Pet Bed Warmer Tan
review_body: My pup figured out right away that this little heat pad was oh so comfy.  It's not hot.  It's just right, as described.  I suppose it mimics momma yorkie's warm belly.  I put it in his bed and placed it under a towel and the heat comes through nicely.  When he outgrows his puppy bed I will look for beds that have a zip off cover or pouch for pads like this to slip into.  He does chew on the cord, just as he chews on every other cord = puppy.  So I've ordered the Grannick's Bitter Apple chew deterrent to spray on this cord, ....and every other cord in the house.

product_title: Outward Hound Hide-A-Squirrel and Puzzle Plush Squeaking Toys for Dogs
review_body: My dog is a poodle chihuahua rescue. He is 23 pounds and loved retrieving his little squirrels. He has since destroyed all the squirrels 6 weeks later (with the help of my 60 pound pitbull mix) but i think i will buy him some more.

product_title: ZippyPaws Small Hedgehog - Squeaky Plush Dog Toy
review_body: We have a papillon mix, about 14 pounds (full grown).  It is not his favorite - not adequately broken in yet - but he likes it and to me, the quality seems good.  However, for a larger dog, or an energetic pup, this might not be the way to go.

product_title: Ultra Paws Cool Boots - Petite - 4 Boots - 1 1/4" Paw Width
review_body: The very stiff recycled tire sole on these boots actually extends up the entire back of the leg of the boot. The material is definitely not pliable enough for a smaller dog.The toe and inside padding is too stiff and bulky also.Please don't put these boots on smaller size dogs,you might damage their legs.For walking boots for a smaller dog try Muttluks all weather boot for summer and Muttluks fleece lined boot for winter-these are soft and pliable, but rugged enough.Hate to write a bad review,I just don't want anyone's dog to get hurt.

product_title: ABO Gear Happy Habitat for Indoor Cats
review_body: This was one of my better investments for my 3mon RV trip. My cats were a little uneasy at first, of course, but after the first time or two they just go in and relax and enjoy the sites, fresh air and sunshine. I put their food, water, a towel and a toy they can climb into. It is extremely easy to set up and take down once you get it. I did forget to tie a knot in the top once and it colasped on them. It did not hurt them or even scare them because it is so light, did annoy them when I was trying to get it back up. It goes back into it's carrier with ease which is something I am normally unable to accomplish with most things. I don't use it every stop just when it is suitable and I never leave them in it if I am going away. I put a sheet on top of one side if it's real sunny and for a little more secure feeling for them.

product_title: Petmate Microban Pet Bed Petmate Deluxe Pillow Bed with Microban, Gusseted Red/Gold Striped Chenille, 27-inch X 36-inch
review_body: It passed the only test that matters - my dog loves it.  Rather than pacing most of the night she now sleeps comfortably throughout the night, to the benefit of both of us.  It's larger than what a Cairn Terrier needs, but better too large than too small.  I'm quite pleased with this purchase.

product_title: Elite Underwater Mini Filter, UL Listed
review_headline: Good but not for my Betta
review_body: I think this would be a fine filter for a small tank but the flow output was not directionally adjustable right or left, only flowed straight out.  I need a filter that can be turned towards the wall to help buffer the output.  My betta was sort of blowing all over and hid out.  The nozzle can only be moderatly adjusted to flow upwards or downwards, and this is a stretch.  Other than than the motor was quiet and powerful.  I ended up with the Penn-Plex Cascade 170 (which says 10 gallons or less but I used both in my 3 gallon tank and Elite seemed a stronger flow).  My betta completely ignores the Cascade one with the nozzle turned to the back wall.  Sorry Hagen.  I also cut the top quarter off the sponge and added a section of charcoal pad to add chemical filtration on the Cascade so I think that would work for the Hagen Elite too.  Good luck![[ASIN:B002RM1882 Penn Plax Cascade 170 Internal Filter for Aquariums]]

product_title: Petmate Fresh Flow Filter Refill
review_body: Just what I needed and arrive as promised.  Great!  Love the Pet fountain, just can't find filters close to home so thanks for being there.

product_title: Seachem Purigen for Freshwater & Saltwater
review_headline: AMAZING- Highly recommended for all aquariums!
review_body:
I can NOT believe how great this works! The 100mL comes in a mesh bag that you can just use as a filter itself, no reason to purchase another bag. I bought this because I have driftwood in my tank and despite me boiling it for two days, the water still was sorta brown. It cleared it right up! No problems at all and now the tank looks more beautiful than it did before. The water is so clear it's crazy! I will definitely be purchasing more of this for my other aquariums! This stuff blows carbon, corals and resins out of the water in comparison. I love how you can just take a peek at the color of the bag and tell how well it is working and when you need to change it out instead of just guessing time estimates for a regular filter.
Like some others on here, I have no needed to change the filter out yet, but I don't think that I will be messing around with bleach and stuff that could potentially harm my fish. It's so affordable on Amazon I see no need for that!

product_title: Nylabone Dental Dinosaur Chew
review_headline: Stegosaurus or Brontosaurus are the best for strong chewers
review_body:
I am a long-time dog trainer and rescuer. I've owned all the versions of this indispensible toy! The Stegosaurus version held up - for years! - through Australian Cattle Dog, Border Collie, English Staffordshire Terrier, and Irish Wolfhound puppies. They even chewed on them as they got older. I wouldn't recommend Tyrannosaurus (too many gaps to crunch on) and Brontosaurus (the tail eventually breaks off) if you have dogs like mine who have huge jaws and teeth the size of my thumb. If a toy lasts at my house it truly is almost undestructible.

As with any toy, don't leave your pup alone with it until you've watched to see they can safely chew it. Do examine it regularly to make sure there are no cracks. Unlike most Nylabone bone-shaped toys, my dogs prefered the shape and texture of these. I usually start them off by rubbing a bit of peanut butter into the nubs the first time. After that the dogs carry them around while teething. Best of all, they wash up great in the dishwasher!

product_title: Cox Premium Pine Bedding, 9.0 Cubic Foot Bag
review_body:
This stuff works really well for my 6 large parrots. 4 of them like to forage so I took the grate out of the bottom of their cages so they could forage but was concerned about the poo. I sprinkle the bedding just thin enough for them to easily find their seeds but place a much heavier portion under their favorite \\"going\\" places. Daily I use a scoop to scoop out only the \\"poo\\" shavings instead of having to change the entire cages and change the rest as needed.

Saves me a LOT of work and the little beaksters are happier now, too, because they're able to do more of what comes natural to them.

product_title: Kaytee Comfort Exercise Wheel, 8.5", Large
review_body: This wheel could not be louder. Was really disappointed that I wasted my money. I ended up buying a silent wheel, but my chinchilla didn't like it for whatever reason. Please do not waste your money on this item.

product_title: Bouncing Cat Toy with Rattling Mouse on Spring - Play Natural Interactive
review_body: This toy was After 1 use of my cats playing with it, the mouse toy came unattached and left a large metal wire exposed. Deffinately dont waist your money.

product_title: KONG Cat Wubba Mouse, Cat Toy (Colors Vary)
review_body: Our ferocious kittens like this toy.  Attack!  It's been holding up well, too.  How much can you say about a cat toy?

product_title: Miracle Coat Equine Grooming Shear
review_body: I use these on our shih tzu, they work great on rounding the puppy cut near the face. I have been pleased with all of the miracle coat shears.

product_title: Simply Natural Premium Chicken Jerky for Dogs, 12-ounce
review_body: I almost backed off ordering the jerky when I read the review about the moldy bags.  Too bad the company ever allowed their product to go out in such a condition.  But, the supply I had here, a Target brand made in the USA, was no longer available at our local Target store.  I ordered from this seller.  I got two bags of jerky that were in great condition.  My dog would eat the whole bag if I let him!  I am ordering more of this.

product_title: JW Gripsoft Pet Hair Magnet
review_body: I received this item well before time and in perfect condition.  This product is wonderful.  You just rub it along the area where you want to remove the cat hair and it pulls it up in a pile that can be thrown away.  It works great on my carpet, but the handle isn't long enough.  Would like to purchase one with a broom handle attached.

product_title: Cats Rule Perfect Litter Box Liners, 10 Pack
review_body: I purchased the Cat's Rule litter box for my aging cat. I could originally buy the liners at my local pet supply store, but then they stopped carrying them, so I was really happy to find them on Amazon. Like all liners, they aren't indestructible. However, as long as I scoop the business every other day or so, they last at least a month without tearing. Even though my cat has no front claws, the liners do eventually develop tears and holes, but I am, overall, very happy with these litter box liners.

product_title: Iceland Pure Unscented Pharmaceutical Grade Sardine Anchovy Oil For Dogs and Cats.Bottle Size 33oz
review_body:
Use this product on all our dogs and it has helped their coats improve immensely!! Less shedding, prevents dry skin, and all of them love the taste. Originally got it for a grain allergy dog and saw what an improvement it made in his skin and coat and decided to try it on all of them. The smallest gets one pump of the oil and the rest get 2 to 3 depending on their weight. Very economical in the long run because of the problems it solved with itchy skin and hot spots and dryness from those conditions.
I feed a high protein, low carb, and grain free feed and this supplement only. For us, it worked much better than the plain salmon oil and they tolerated it better. Salmon oil gave some of them loose stools, but this blend has never upset any of their stomachs.

product_title: Hyper Pet Flippy Flopper
review_body: My dog is a crazy jack russell,but frisbee lasted about 10 minutes. the last one i bought similar design lasted him the whole summer.

product_title: Our Pets Company AS-4115455-2 (Pack of 2)  Cosmic Catnip Chili Pepper Cat Toy
review_body: I bought the 8 oz version awhile back. I know the size because I measured it and it holds 8 oz of water. It's a great bowl, but I needed a bigger one, so I ordered the 12 oz version. But the one I got is the same size as the 8 oz. Someone needs to get their act together.

product_title: Frontline Plus Flea and Tick Control for Dogs and Puppies 8 weeks or older and up to 22lbs, 6-Doses ---
review_body: I couldn't believe the great price for this product. I was paying way more at my Vet's and they even beat the online pet pharmacies. I would definitely buy from this seller again.

product_title: Four Paws Wee-Wee Pet Training and Puppy Pads
review_body:
This brand of pads are the best that I have tried. I recently purchased a different brand because of the pricing and I will never make that mistake again. They leak through and I was cleaning up the mess every time, might as well have nothing. So I had to double them up = paying more for them in the end.

I have always used this brand and am sticking with it from now on.

product_title: High Tech Pet Microsonic 2 Plus Ultrasonic Transmitter Collar MS-2
review_body:
I bought this dog door 8 months ago and am on my fourth collar (for two dogs). They are fragile and not designed well. I don't know why they have the battery indicator light as the light works well past when the battery has enough juice to power the door signal, as far as I can tell. When you open the case, the button often falls right out.

If you have two dogs, both have to have the water-resistant transmitter or both the non, because they have different signal strengths so one dog will be opening the door from 10' away while one will have to be right in front of it.

To get around having the silly second collar on the dog, I use the flimsy nylon strap to tie the transmitter to their real collar. I like the zip tie idea better.

In case HiTec Pet reads these, your web site stinks. The flashing graphic is so annoying. Click on FAQ and it takes you to a fence FAQ. I wait a week for a response on a 'support ticket' email, or 20 mins. on hold on the phone. The site says to use the MS-2A collar if you burn through collars, then there is apparently no such thing? There is no page for collars/accessories for sale?

product_title: Da Bird: Wild Refill Pack - Guinea Feateher, Sparkly & Mouse Attachments AND Laser Toy
review_headline: Da Bird refills for Da Bird Pole
review_body:
My cats absolutely love these! I have four cats ranging in age from 5 months to 17 years old. The younger ones go nuts over it. They know the word \\"play\\" and immedately run to the closet where I have Da Pole stashed away. It is great exercise for them and a great way for them to enjoy the hunt, catch, kill process.

They make me laugh daily!

product_title: Marina I25 Internal Filter
review_body: It's a nice little filter, works well with low flow. I have it in a betta tank and it gets the water circulated without pushing the betta around. The reason I gave it 4 stars is because I wish there were more options for filter cartridges. Once a tank is cycled, you shouldn't remove or replace the filter media or you will cause the tank to cycle again, which can kill fish. This filter only has cartridges that have a teensy bio sponge, then a compartment for carbon, and another compartment for ammonia absorbing media. Once a tank is cycled, there's no need for carbon or ammonia absoribing media, and these two things stop working after a week or two and need to be replaced anyway. To solve this problem, I took some cut-to-fit filter floss and used fishing line to \\"sew\\" it into a pillow the same size as the cartridge, then stuffed it with bio beads and sewed it closed. It fits into the filter and doesn't obstruct the flow and I can use it for years with nothing more than a swish in a bucket of conditioned water.

product_title: Natural Flea and Tick Shampoo with Oatmeal for Dogs, 16.9-Ounce
review_body: I will agree with one of the other comments that this stuff does smell like \\"Christmas in a Bottle.\\"  Not so much the pine scent, it's more like cinnamon Christmas-time.  Hope that made sense.  As for keeping the fleas away.. The bottle says that it is effective for up to 7 days. I have to say that it did keep them off of my puppy. I was so happy when I gave him a second bath in this stuff to not see fleas anywhere. The first time I bathed him there was like 5-6 fleas that died while washing him.( & this was with him having a treatment of Pet Armor topical flea treatment a couple weeks before, so I'm not sure if I'm satisfied with the Pet Armor since there were fleas on him a couple weeks later, when it's supposed to last a month like Frontline etc..).  This time there were none, thanks to this shampoo. It is different than using \\"regular\\" dog shampoo though. It doesn't lather well, & you don't drench your dog with water before adding shampoo. You lightly dampen the coat, then try to pour it directly on the dog (not on/near eyes, mouth or nose of the animal). & then work it in. I work it in for at least 5-10 min, then rinse. It takes a bit to get used to working with the thin consistency & the low-lather of this shampoo, but I can deal with it if it's going to work. As for the oatmeal keeping the itch away. I've only seen mild improvement with that.  I bought this shampoo because it is more natural than most, & I figured that it would be good to have \\"double\\" protection from fleas. It's safe to use with topical treatments (Pet Armor, Frontline etc..) cause it won't wash them off.  I also like that it kills and repels fleas, ticks, flies, and mosquitos.  Only drawbacks are the price, and maybe the consistency (you may need to use quite a bit of the bottle if you have a large dog, I have a small dog so it's not as bad). But all-in-all If this continues to work, I will most likely be buying it again.

product_title: Oster Heated Pet Pad
review_headline: Our cats are loving this pad.
review_body:
Our cats stay in an un-heated garage, or home-made winter shelters.
Most cats ~ even the abandoned pets we've taken in are picky about most everything.
So I was pleased to see that they appreciate these heating pads.

The industry average heating temp for pet pads is around 102 degrees
which is close to a cat's normal body temperature of between 100.4 and 102.5 degrees Fahrenheit.
With a humans temp. being 98.6 ~ that small 3 1/2 degrees difference can be difficult to distinguish.
Especially since the 102ºF is only when and where the pet lays.
This energy efficient technology doesn't heat the entire surface of the bed.
This is a thermostatically controlled design which only warms up where the pet lays.
The pad stays 10-15ºF warmer than ambient room temperature when left plugged in, but not in use.

Heat can be felt all-over where you press and hold your hand,
except for 1\\" to 1 1/2 \\" on the outer edge around the pad.
The heat radiates through a small amount of padding to the top surface ~
again ~ only when & where you hold your hand.
This is a low-voltage ~ controlled heat ~ therapeutic pad
that will provide special orthopedic relief for older cats with aching joints

The cover is plush & contains a zipper to remove for washing. A piece of 1/8\\" foam is on each side of a vinyl heating unit.
I'm surprised how large the outer cover is ~ 26\\" X 36\\" ~ that's twice the size of the 18\\" X 23 1/2\\" heating unit.
So we centered the pad in the cover ~ then centered that where the cover would lay up and around ~ for more coziness.
Also the pad could be turned perpendicular to use only half the covering, and would be an exact fit.
The pad is plug in only ~ there isn't any switch on the cord.

Pets pads for in-doors don't have wire protected cords ~
and are made of a thinner plastic such as this one is.
Pads for out-doors have the cord wrapped in a metal sleeve for safety.
and are hard plastic ~ stiff as a board ~ not bendable.
The thinking is in-door pets aren't as likely to chew on these items.
Out-door animals are more prone to chewing on these items.

Research was required to understand the features of this pad ~
where-as it should defiantly have been included with the product.

January 22, 2013 ~ I received 2 different size Oster pet pads approx 2 months ago ~
both pads have been in beds made up for feral cats since the day they arrived.
They're both continually used every day ~ except on occasional warmer sunny days.

product_title: Purina Fancy Feast Medleys Tuscany Collection Gourmet Wet Cat Food Variety Pack- (24) 3 oz. Cans
review_body:
I am the proud owner of 5 cats and whenever a new type of canned food is tried in our household, all five of the kitties try the new food and then, after having tried the food at least four time, the kitties hold a meeting with me and then tell me how they vote for the new dish.

This review is of Purina Fancy Feast Elegant Medleys Tastemakers Yellowfin Tuna and Shrimp with Wild Rice in Gravy Cat Food. I, the owner of the group, initially saw this new offering from Fancy Feast in PetsMart. Occasionally, I make a run in there to pick up a few items to supplement what we get from Amazon. I like to buy a few cans of a new food and introduce it to the group instead of buying an entire case from Amazon and taking the chance that it will get a \\"thumbs down\\" vote and then I will be stuck with a whole case of something that no one likes. Oddly enough, even though I have five tasters, it almost always happens that everyone likes a given food, or everyone dislikes it. Rarely to I chance upon something that gets a positive vote from one or two and a negative vote from the others. I was quite hopeful when I initially purchased this Yellowfin Tastemaker as the kitties all DO LIKE the plain Yellow Fin Tuna with nothing added to spice it up. However, shrimp is not always a favorite, so I had to wait and see.

So, about a month ago the kitties had their first can and scarfed it all down, right now, right away. Hah! All you cat parents out there know this is not a sure thing. So, a week later, can number two was given...and inhaled, then on two successive nights the other two cans were given...and every one ate it up and sat around smacking their lips. So, time for a vote:

Gabriella, the Lady in Charge, age 3, stated that it was FINE, but gave not other details. Trinity, THE LEADING MALE, age 4, feigned a fair amount of disinterest and noted that it was OK, but he would prefer variety. He would not make this and \\"every day\\" meal for himself. Then the twins, Wisdom and Mercy, age 1, little ladies popped in and gushed about this food and fell all over each other giving it \\"Rave Reviews!\\" Both LOVE the Gravy and are Delighted with the Tuna, like the crunchy Rice, and state that \\"here even the Shrimp is good.\\" (\\"We usually do not like Shrimp at all, at all. We do not even like Fancy Feast Fish and Shrimp!\\"[[ASIN:B0012KB466 Fancy Feast Gourmet Cat Food, Flaked Fish & Shrimp Feast, Flaked 3-Ounce Cans (Pack of 24)]] They are a bit spoiled. Finally, Mr. Yellow Kitty, Grand Male, age 10, weighed in very thoughtfully and stated that he liked this because the Tuna was not overwhelming, the shrimp added an understated taste explosion, the rice was good fiber for the older set, and \\"He especially likes the generous amount of Gravy.\\" \\"I COULD eat it every night if I needed to do so.) (Wouldn't it be a dream to find six or seven varieties that THEY would eat night after night after night!!!!...an owner's dream come true!)

The kitties stated that IF POSSIBLE, they would give this four and a half stars instead of five because not everyone would eat this everynight. Both Gabby and Trinity made it clear that about twice a week was all they could handle of this. \\"A bit too fishy\\" they state. But their lack of enthusiasm is trounched by the other three who are VERY FOND of this.

So there is the vote: two who like it OK and three who put it on the FAV LIST. And the kitties, Gabriella, Trinity, Wisdom, Mercy and Yellow Kitty say a big \\"thank you\\" for listening to their opinions. review_body:

review_body: I used this pet kennel for my cat when moving across the country by car. I set the kennel up in the passenger seat of my small sedan. It was not the ideal way to travel, and she did fuss some, but having my cat along for the journey might not have been an option at all without this kennel. I highly recommend it for such excursions!

product_title: FURminator deShedding Tool for Dogs
review_body: I bought this at PetSmart (for $55.00). There was an elaborate display with a video and I figured if they have the chutzpah to charge four times the price of the other brushes in the store, it must be something special (or a sucker is born every minute). I began using it on my dog with some detangling spray. It worked impressively, but after about a minute, I heard a \\"snap\\" and the plastic head had broken straight through where there was an interior screw. It may have been a \\"one off\\" manufacturing defect, but I then pulled out a \\"rake\\" I have had for years that is similar to this product except the teeth are spaced further apart. It was then that I realized that my good old inexpensive rake was removing as much hair as the \\"miraculous\\" FURminator. Back to the store it went. I also should have been wary of their claim that it \\"reduces shedding up to 90 percent.\\" The problem with that claim, of course, is that even if it's true, it's not making any comparison to conventional brushes. Maybe all brushes reduce shedding by 90 percent. So what.

review_body: My cat would just flop down with other harnesses, if I could even put them onto her. She accepted the Kitty Holster after two tries. I actually rarely use it with a leash, although it certainly works that way. My cat has only wiggled out of this once when she was really frightened; I may not have had it on tight enough. The holster is easy to put on and take off; I just undo the neck velcro and she wiggles out of the tummy strap. This is an excellent product and cute, too!

product_title: V-Oratene Drinking Water Additive 4 oz
review_body: I adopted a retired greyhound which had a lot of tartar buildup from his bland \\"racing days\\" diet.  I try brushing but it's hard to get a good scrub on the back molars.  I gave him bully sticks and started adding this to his water and his teeth have improved dramatically.  It could be a combination of the two that has helped a lot.  I think the sticks helped scrape and the water additive has aided in preventing anymore adherence of plaque.  The yellow on his teeth is almost all gone.  He doesn't have a problem with this in his water. The only con is It's a bit expensive because he drinks about 4-5 quarts of water/day and I have to do 8 pumps per bucket fill, so this little bottle goes fast.  But as far as the product itself, I recommend it.

review_body: I bought this dog crate so I could bring my two Maltese dogs with me on trips out of town. It fits them perfectly and also folds up nicely in the trunk of my car. No complaints.

review_body: This did absolutely nothing to control the fleas on my dogs.  I found 3 fleas on one of them not a week after I applied it.  The other dog had half a dozen on him when I gave him a bath days after that.  They are both inside dogs and when I found the fleas on the first dog she hadn't even been out yet that morning, so I know they didn't just jumped on her.  Maybe it was better at controlling fleas when it first came out, but its not now.  Save your money and get the better treatment from the vet.

review_body: This is an excellent product.  It arrived very promptly and was exactly what I had ordered.  I've shown this to many of my friends and they've been impressed.  I highly recommend this item.

product_title: PetSafe SlimCat Interactive Toy and Food Dispenser
review_headline: I still love them after a year and a half
review_body:
Update - I have had these balls for over a year and a half now.

They have lost their shine from rolling around so much. They are easily washed in the dishwasher or by soaking in soapy water.

What I am most impressed by is the fact that they really take a beating well. My husband tosses the balls 3-5 feet onto hardwood floors every day. At least once a month they have tumbled down wooden stairs to a concrete basement.

I've had to purchase three more, but not because of the quality. It's due to the cunning of the cats. You know what I am talking about. The cat has dozens of toys, but you can't find any of them. Then one day you come home and there are 10 of them scattered around the room. Same with these balls.

I cannot recommend this product enough.

Original review -

We have three cats who eat very fast so they can steal food from each other. This has resulted in fights and vomiting from eating so fast. We ended up having to feed them in separate rooms.

With these balls, they each have to work for their food. We do see some swapping of balls as one will try to steal a ball from another cat. They eat slower (it takes them 15-20 minutes to get a 1/4 cup of food out). And it is just darn cute watching them.

We have had these balls for over a month. The quality appears very good. We have not noticed any nicks or scratches.

Downside - it can be really loud with three cats rattling these balls around!

review_body: I recently purchased a Zieis digital bird scale (A42SS-NMTP)with a wooden T perch and suction cup. The scale arrived promptly and was securely packaged. review_body: I was very excited to receive this collar. The colors were amazing and I removed the tags and discarded the packaging. review_body: The online photo does not do justice to this attachment for the Neko Flies toys.  It is well made and the wings are irridescent green. It makes it fly lopsided.  The lobster claw for attaching is really nice.  I must say after using this toy with my cats and comparing it to Da Bird, the wand accompanying these Neko Flies is just much too short for the long string attached.  I believe a longer wand is really needed to make these fly better.  I am going to try them on Da Bird wand and see if it works better. Harry dog sits by wide-eyed and waiting impatiently when I am holding his toy for repair. He can't wait for me to finish so he can kill the new squeaks until he is completely exhausted. Because I put a few in, it takes a few weeks for him to be successful.

I have sewed squeaky buttons in my kids discarded Disney stuffed animals. Harry is only 15 lbs. It may not work for larger dogs who ripped things up and could swallowed these.

review_body:
PROS:
- Aesthetically pleasing
- Good ventilation
- 2 level

product_title: Zuke's Z-Ridge Fresh Breath Dental Chew Bones
review_body:
If I could rate this product a zero stars I would!

My dog a 10 pound terrier/chihuahua mix also got very sick after eating the Carrot Crunch chews from ZUKES...she started out with horrible gas, then she had diarrhea and throwing up chunks of the chews over and over again until she just started throwing up foam. I took her to the Vet day 1 of being soo sick and she had formed pancreatitis. She is now on antibiotics and stomach medication, and almost $600 and 3 days later and she is still not well. I reached out to ZUKES and not only did they not even offer my money back they also did not accept responsibility they also tried to blame her sickness on a high fat diet, or her being overweight without even meeting my dog or reviewing her vet records or even seeing a picture of her. My dog is very fit, excercises regularly, does NOT have a high fat diet and is NOT overweight. The ONLY thing she had out of the ordinary that day was the ZUKES chew. I am very dissapointed that they have not pulled these chews off of the market. My case is very new but I will make it my mission to get the word out to as many pet owners as I can that these chews though some dogs like them and can handle them, other dogs cannot and do get very sick from eating them. Please do not use these chews and if you do please do it with caution.

review_headline: Great product, I bought a second one
review_body:
I'm very pleased with this product, it greatly exceeded my expectations. I have a small little shih tzu, about 15lbs. He's 10 years old and because of his older age he can no longer jump up onto beds anymore. He tries to jump onto the bed and then stands by the bed crying for me to pick him up, it's the saddest little thing. These steps are awesome and completely fixed that problem. My dog's so happy he can be more independent and come and go as he pleases by himself again.

It's a nice looking product and I would have no problem leaving them out in the living room or when company comes over. They feel sturdy and stable. I'm not afraid they're going to collapse at any moment and my dog is comfortable using them. They come with little sticker grip pads for each step which makes it easier for him to use. The height is just fine and fits up against the side of my bed nicely, and my dog has no problems getting onto the bed from them. However, it is a tight fit so if that's a concern for you at all then I recommend measuring the height of the steps up against the height of your bed.

The price of these steps is one of it's key features and I really don't think you'll find anything better in the same price range. These stairs compare more to others in a higher price range and blow most of the cheaper ones away, so I definitely recommend this product as a great value for your money. I've ordered a second one to use in the other bedroom.

Extra perk: These stairs are made in AMERICA.

Note about other pet stairs: I bought my dog another pet stairs before these and I really, truly, honestly would not recommend them to anyone. I won't name exactly which ones they are but... they're sold on Amazon and are smaller and cheaper than these stairs. I was disappointed with them right out of the box and disliked them for several different reasons. They were short, cheaply made, and unstable. They would wobble constantly and the plastic \\"base\\" of the steps partially collapsed a couple times. They're advertised to support around 60 lbs but it was a real stretch for my little guy. The entire product is just a flimsy snap in plastic base with a removable fabric cover. Do NOT waste your hard earned money on those steps! I wish I would have just paid the extra little amount of money for these stairs in the first place. product_title: PetSafe Drinkwell Platinum Pet Fountain
review_body:
I read through a ton of reviews, both negative and positive. A lot of negative reviews complained about the unit's noise level. The trickle of the water I hear asin my cats drink and move the water stream is louder than the hum of the fountain if that helps any.

It works great and was easy to assemble. It holds a ton of water compared to the older and smaller Drinkwell's we have. This is a blessing with 16 cats. One reviewer mentioned their cat was scared of the noise. The fountain is quiet, though I did have one cat kind of curious and stand-offish for about 1-2 minutes. I then turned around to find her drinking from it.

I do know these fountains and most I have had in the past will get loud if the filter is blocked, something is installed incorrectly, or the water is low. On one occasion I had a fountain that was loud and it was simply that the pump was bad. It wasn't a Drinkwell, though I do imagine it could happen. I love Chevrolet vehicles and have had nothing but good luck, I know people that bought lemons, same with Ford, Dodge, etc.

The little removable trap to block hair and lint from circulating back through the pump is a nice add on as well.

This fountain worked fine for me, and is as quiet as the smaller models. If you can hear this fountain two rooms away like one review mentioned, something isn't right, either with the setup or the unit may be defective. It has a low hum when working properly. The water reservoir fits on easily and the water stream is adjustable.

product_title: Deep Blue Solarmax T5 Double Strip 30in
review_headline: Best freshwater lights for the dollar
review_body:
These are fantastic lights with great color, brightness, and depth. I have 14 of them! I have two each on my 150s ... great depth and brightness ... and one on each of my 30 breeders.

The reason I'm writing this review is to point out a design flaw. There are three lights, strip one (usually white), strip two (usually actinic), and the led moonlights. There are two switches, one for each of the strips, but no switch for the moonlights. So, you can never turn off the moonlights without unplugging the unit.

However, my main complaint is that there is only one power cord! This means that I cannot operate these lights properly with a timer. Think about the fact that I have 14 of these. If I wanted to keep the moonlights on while the other lights were off, I'd have to manually turn all 14 of these on and off each day.

So, while these lights might really appeal to people with just one aquarium, people with many aquariums might be reluctant to invest in many of these. However, as I said earlier, the other attributes of this product ... including price ... do outweigh this shortcoming.

UPDATE 7/2012:

I've documented a MOD to install a separate power cable to control the led moonlights! This way, you can use a timer to control the regular lights and these will stay on at night because they can be plugged into a non-timered outlet. Alternately, you can use a day timer for the regular lights and a night timer for the moonlights.

I've had this running in all my aquariums for the past few months without issue, so ... this is tried an tested. You can find the mod as one of the loaded product images.

product_title: PetSafe SSSCAT Spray
review_body: Here is my story: we moved to a new home, new city. We purchased 2 beautiful and expensive area rugs for the formal living and foyer areas. Our 3-year-old usually well-mannered and loveable cat started pooping on the new rugs, even though his litter box was clean. At first, I put Saran Wrap and tape on parts of the rugs as booby traps, which looked stupid and didn't work. We had to roll up one of the rugs and put it in the store room because it was light-colored and I didn't want to pay to have it cleaned (not yet anyway). So I bought 2 of these SSSCAT cans for the remaining large rug. First of all, you have to have 4 AAA batteries each. The directions say press the top part down onto the can until you hear a click. I wasted about 5 or 6 sprays trying to press down until I heard the click. No click on either one. The trick is to line up the top part with bottom can gently and then push the \\"collar\\" down BEFORE there is any pressing. So I set the cans up in strategic places and brought the cat for a test run. There is a long delay before anything happens. Long. Then there is a spray that lasts maybe 2 seconds. I heard the spray go off 3 times and the cat was near it, so it worked. But this evening, I was walking about 10 feet away from one of the cans and it went off! I nearly had a heart attack, which is, I guess, the point of scaring the cat away. Not to mention it was a waste of another spray.  It does work, but it is unreliable as to how many feet away any moving object should be when it gets sprayed and there is a delay of action.

product_title: Wisdom Panel Mixed Breed DNA Test Kit
review_headline: Adjust your expectations and enjoy the results
review_body:
I went into the processing of having this test run on my little guy Digit with only the expectation that it would be entertaining, and the test fulfilled that expectation.

My assumption was that Digit was predominantly some type of terrier, perhaps Cairn or Border, this based on both physical and behavior qualities. But I had always had a sneaking suspicion that there was some Chihuahua mixed in there. The test came back with the result that he was half Chihuahua, which was amusing because it confirmed my suspicion that there was some of that heritage in him. The rest of the analysis suggested a potpourri of breeds, very few of which were terrier. ostensibly, the other parent was whippet/poodle, and I don't believe that for a second. I remain convinced he has a large dose of terrier in him, along with the Chihuahua.

So, I wouldn't call myself a \\"True Believer\\" in these tests - I understand just enough of the science to understand it's limitations - but I think this is fun product if you can afford it and have curiosity.

I have two dogs, and the other is almost certainly a pure bred Border Collie, but he's a rescue and unusually large for a border collie. I had the Pure Breed test done on him and will review that separately.

product_title: Walky Dog Plus Hands Free Dog Bicycle Exerciser Leash 2017 Newest Model with 550-lbs pull strength Paracord Leash Military Grade
review_body:
So, I have an 85 lb lab/pitbull mix who is about 2 years old and has a ton of energy. I recently started graduate school and have had to keep him in his crate a lot more than normal. He's been a little destructive, and I had been running myself ragged trying to walk him for 1+ hours a day, plus taking him to the dog park. The Walkydog seems to be a great solution for getting my dog more exercise, more efficiently.

I only weigh about 110 lbs, so I was worried that my dog would rip me off my bike. He can pull the bike a little, i.e. I have to be more careful steering, but it really didn't make me feel unsafe at all. I chose the WalkyDog over the Springer because I didn't want a leash that has an automatic release if your dog pulls too hard (the Springer has a release mechanism). I would worry that I would end up chasing my dog all over the place, or he'd get hit by a car if he got released.

The Walkydog was VERY easy to install. I watched a video on how to do it at thedogoutdoors.com, and it was really simple. The tool is included. I started out by walking the bike a little, then got on it. It's actually easier when you get going. I found that when there were distractions (other dogs, etc), it actually helps to speed up on the bike. My dog had to work to keep up and didn't have a chance to try to pull away.

I can't comment on durability, but it seems to be quite good. I would agree with a few other reviewers that the blue leash part seems a little chintzy, but it is also easily replaced with some cord from a hardware store if need be.

The first time out I was able to run my dog for 3 miles or so at a fast pace and he is now sleeping like a baby! (That rarely happens after a walk). Great product!

product_title: Kong Extreme Flyer Dog Toy
review_headline: Perfect for training a young dog
review_body:
I have half a dozen discs for dog play. This one is by far the best of them for training a young dog. It is fairly easy to make it \\"float\\" at a moderate speed so that the dog can win most of the time with a good catch and return. It is not good for challenging a strong sprinter for distance.

It is also perfect for a first trainer in that it is very soft and will not cause discomfort and hesitation if the catch is not perfect. This encourages an unflinching catch.

For those who have had the disc chewed up, I would suggest a different training routine.
I never allow a dog to use the throwing disk as a chew toy. Discs are only used for the game of throw and catch and no other use.

product_title: Alfie Pet by Petoga Couture - Pet Home Grooming Kit - Curved, Straight, Thinning Shears, Round-Tip Scissors, Razor Comb Trimmer, Travel Case Set
review_body: I bought this for my poodle mix pup to use in between trips to the groomers.  The scissors are sharp and work great on his fur.  The only piece I am not too satisfied with is the razor comb.  You can adjust the razor which is nice, but I haven't been able to get it to cut the fur...may just be me.  Overall great product and would recommend.

product_title: Zack & Zoey Polyester Snow Leopard Vest, XX-Small, White
review_headline: Really Cute and Cool! Fits Well!
review_body:
I got an XXS for my barely 5lb. Yorkie (Neck to Tail measures around 9\\", girth is 12\\" ) and it fits her perfectly! She looks so cute in it. With a girth of around 12\\", the vest fits her just right, snug (I can still insert one finger between her and the vest).

The quality and material used is sooo nice. When the black side is up, it has that quilted effect on it (similar to those puffy jackets humans have). It is quite thick which I think will keep your little ones warm enough.

As for the length, since it's a vest, I think an XXS is just right for my Yorkie. It doesn't reach her tail (around 1\\" short) so if you want it to reach the tail part, you might have to get a bigger size. But since it's a vest and not a dress, I'm ok with it :)

I also love the snow leopard side. It's soft to the touch -- and it matches my own snow leopard hoodie, haha!

product_title: Cat Dancer - Cat Charmer Wand Teaser Toy
review_headline: There are more enticing dangle toys
review_body:
My kittens rate this an "OK".
They'll give it their attention for a few minutes, but it doesn't
obsess them like the "Cat Dancer" and "Da Bird" .

product_title: K&H Manufacturing Thermo-Kitty Bed Deluxe Hooded Cat Bed 4 Watts
review_body: I already bought a Thermo -Kitty bed for my oldest cat, Butterfly, and she loves it. On occasion she would allow one of the other cats a few brief minutes in the bed so I decided to get another one. When I saw this one with the hood I decided to give it a try because one of my other cats, Sylvester, loves a non-heated bed that I have that has a hood. All the cats love this bed, so it looks like I will need to get another one! They don't always like to share!

product_title: FURemover Broom with Squeegee made from Natural Rubber
review_body: This is a fabulous product for anyone with messy pets and carpeting. It is easy to use and very thorough on pet hair and saves stress on your vacuum.

product_title: IRIS Open-Top Cat Litter Box with Clear High-Shield without Scoop, Navy
review_body: I move apartments fairly often, and when I do, I usually just get the kitties a new box because it's just more convenient.  Last time, I bought two rather expensive covered litter boxes as my cats tend to fling litter.  What a mistake!  My cats crept in there like they expected to be murdered at any moment, and leaped out like the devil himself was after them.  I then saw this box and ordered it, and they vastly prefer it with the open top.  It keeps the litter in and it's a lot easier for me to scoop.  I don't have the problem others report about the uneven bottom making it hard to scoop, but I have seen that the kitties will sometimes pee on the sides and it will get between the two pieces.  I still think this litter box is just great, though, the cats are much more comfortable with it and it keeps the litter in.  I'll be getting a couple more for my next move!

product_title: Solvit PupSTEP Plus Pet Stairs
review_body: This item is for a specific size dog.  A very small and light weight dog would be ok, but any dog weighting over 20 pounds has a hard time with the shallow steep steps.

product_title: Outward Hound Treat Wheel Treat Toy Dog Toys Scent Puzzle Training Toy
review_body: This is a review for the Treat Wheel by Kyjen. This is my second product with them and will most likely be my last as the other one had some design flaws as well. Overall, the concepts seem to be good, but there's always one glaring flaw and cheap materials/construction. This treat wheel is a good idea: pull out the \\"pegs\\" and find the treat then use your nose to push the wheel around until you find a secondary treat in another chamber. However, the execution is anything but good. First, the pegs are in too deep and with little (except a dangerously small hole to snag a nail) to grip except super slippery plastic. I tried myself to push and pull the item out of place, and it wouldn't budge (not surprising since 3/4 of it is \\"buried\\") and my dogs just grew frustrated and quit. I thought of using it without the pegs and just as a spinner but all the chambers are connected, and the top portion is so badly attached to the bottom that it wobbles about instead of spinning smoothly around. Plus, the chambers are so slick (all the toy being made of that same super slippery plastic) that the treat just slides around. And forget durability. I've seen Dollar Store toys constructed better. A medium to large dog could break this thing in one sitting.

product_title: Conair Canine FX Moda-Groom II Professional 2-Speed Animal Clipper, Dog Professional Grooming, Pearl White
review_body: I have now used this on my 20lb miniature schnauzer four times with ease...At $40 per trip to the groomer this has more than paid for itself. The blades are great w/out being worrisome, i dont fear cutting my pup, and they are easy to maintain. The case is great for storage. I had an oster model before this one and it was pretty much useless...about $45 model from wmart...feared this one would be similar but boy have I been surprised/pleased. No problem trimming her up with this...though it is a bit noisy, so if your dog has fear of noise that may pose an issue, otherwise highly recommend this trimmer, it's very smooth , durable and strong.

product_title: Armarkat Cat tree Furniture Condo, Height -50-Inch to 60-Inch
review_body: I  am very happy with my purchase of this product.  Very easy to assemble and just the right size for the house. My cat has claimed the top pedestal as her new spot.  I would recommend this product.

product_title: Remedy + Recovery E-Collar, Colors Vary
review_body: I ordered the one with the largest range of adjustment, in order for it to fit our 60 lb labmix female. It barely fit her neck. The width was about 2 inches short and she could still lick her front leg....where a granuloma was causing trouble. I used it anyway, so maybe the annoyance prevented some of the licking while she was being \\"boarded\\" by a relative. Wish it had been wider. Will sell it to someone else or donate it to Pets Inc. local shelter.

product_title: Groovypets® Remote Dog Training Shock Collar Trainer / Rechargeable Dog Collar for No Bark Obedience Behavioral Training
review_body: I bought this on a recommendation from another dog lover who wanted to train a young dog off the leash. I have two 15 month old lab/dobie mix pups who are receptive to commands and training, but with a strong instinct to bark and chase anything that ventures close...deer, racoons, armadillos and their favorite squirrels. Because of the size of the yard it was difficult to reprimand them while the activity was taking place. The collars have allowed be to get the dog's attention without having to get to them. I have not used the shock feature as I have found that the vibrate is sufficient to stop the unwanted behavior. After only a few days the dogs have learned that excessive barking bring out the collars and putting them on for just a few minutes usually results in an hour or more of peace and quiet. I have a pool which the dogs use several times a day and have tried to prevent the collars from getting wet, however, I have not been completely successful and the water resistant claim from the manufacturer has proven true. The only downside to this purchase was the length of time it took to receive the product. It shipped USPS and took 10 days.

product_title: OurPets Play-N-Squeak Twice the Mice Cat Toy, 2pc
review_body: We have a tabby that just loves these little mice. They have to be brown for her small compact. She bats them around and has a big time. She will fetch them and bring them back when I throw them.

product_title: Omega Paw Self-Cleaning Litter Box, Pewter
review_body:
I was very skeptical when I bought this -- and even more skeptical as I put it together... but now I have had it just about two weeks and I am already singing the praises! LOVE this litter box!!!! It works EXACTLY as described and couldn't be any easier!

It is pretty large, so you need a fair amount of floor space to roll it each way. It does and EXCELLENT job of separating the clumps from the clean litter. No more scooping and dealing with the dust and odors in my face. I bought a small sisal rug to put outside of it, because quite a bit of litter gets kicked/tracked out by my kitty. I also noticed when rolling it to clean, a few little crumbles slip out the side. Not enough to outweigh the amazingness of this box, though.

Anyway, if you hate scooping a litter box, THIS is what you need!

product_title: Bow Wow Holiday Dog Collar
review_body: I have purchased many UpCountry collars for our dogs and this collar is really cute for Christmas. They are well made and they have a lot of very cute designs. I've found they hold up well and wash well. I would highly recommend these collars!

product_title: Green Cow Rawhide Dog Bones, Natural Chips, 5-Pound Bag
review_body: bought this product several times - dogs love it - all natural and helps tremendously clean their teeth. i recommend it strongly.

product_title: Snoozer Lookout Car Seat
review_body: Before I bought this car seat for my chihuahua, it was difficult taking her in the car with me, unless I had someone in the passenger seat willing to hold on to her.  Even then - she was constantly wanting to move from the passenger side to my lap.  She couldn't see out the windows & wasn't stable as I braked or turned.  But now, I slip her harness on her & attach it to the strap that comes with this seat & she's in doggy heaven.  Quiet as she can be.  Just stares out the window & watches the world go by.  I feel so much more comfortable knowing she's safely secured to the seat belt in the event I need to stop quickly or turn.  Also, the liner comes out & is machine washable,  haven't had to do that yet, but s nice feature nonetheless.  Well worth the money.  Works just as we'll in the backseat as the front.  A harness is a must with this seat, but that's true with any dog car seat.

product_title: Snoozer Luxury Cozy Cave, Leaf, X-Large
review_headline: Would buy another if they wouldn't have jacked up the price by $30
review_body: Unfortunately only bought one and two of my dogs just LOVE it! As soon as one gets out the other gets in. This is a high quality bed and I would have bought another if they wouldn't have raised the price by $30!!! SHEESH

product_title: Zoo Med Sun Dried Large Red Shrimp
review_body: My turtle LOVES this product. This is the 3rd purchase because he loves it so much. If I mix this with other food he generally picks all of this sun dried shrimp first. The rest gets eaten if he is hungry enough.

product_title: PetFusion SmartGrip Cat Litter Mat. Large (35 x 24 inches). Safe for your cats, free from Phthalates & VCM
review_body:
I have been searching my local market for months for this product. I needed a solid mat for the cat litter box and finally have exactly what I need.

The product appears to be strong enough to last a long time. I highly recommend.

product_title: Roll n Clean Self Cleaning Litter Box
review_body: I loved this litter box because it's the perfect compromise between the more expensive automatic ones (that the cats don't usually like anyway) and a traditional scoop it out yourself one. At first I was hesitant because I couldn't use pine litter, but I use Tidy Scoop litter with this and it clumps perfectly for the mechanism and I (who am pregnant and have a super sensitive nose) can't detect any odor. Our cat had no problem getting used to it from a normal one, but she's a kitten and pretty adaptable. I also loved that it kept her from flinging litter everywhere. My husband empties the tray, and he has gone through the main compartment to double check but it really does get everything. I would say, though, that the regular size is really too small for most grown cats.

product_title: Petstages Puppy Cuddle Pal
review_headline: Not safe for puppies- Do not purchase
review_body: Our new puppy is 12 weeks so I used this in his crate at night to help him settle without his littermates. The second time I used it he quickly bit open the toy and the sack of grains inside, spilling them all over his bedding. Hoping he did not ingest them- glad I have a vet appt. today. Our pup is not a destructive chewer and is not teething either. Do not give this toy to a young puppy- much safer to let him adjust on his own. Also did not stay warm long and is very small- much smaller than he is at 12 weeks old. I wish I still had the box as I would return it immediately. What a terrible idea.

product_title: Cat Dancer - Cat Charmer Wand Teaser Toy
review_headline: Of all the expensive toys out there, my cat loves this one best!
review_body:
Sometimes the simplest things are the best. This is a great and inexpensive toy that any cat will love.

-1 star because the wand could be slightly less flimsy. It feels as if it could snap if my kitten gives a good tug.

product_title: Femitu 50pcs Natural Peacock Tail Feathers (Big Eyed) 10-12 inches
review_body: I used these for my wedding decorations: center-pieces, aisle decor, arch decor, stage decor, gift table and moeybox: everything! And some i cut and shaped them and stuck them on little blue boxes containing a cupcake. Everyone loved the decor! great item, most of them came in great condition, and had great colours.

product_title: Red Dingo Designer Dog Harness, Medium
review_headline: Super cute and a great fit!
review_body: I love that it came with a matching leash. The pattern is really cute, and it adjusts easily to fit my puppy!

product_title: Zack & Zoey Day Tripper - Green
review_body:
I bought this dog pack for two reasons:
1. It was the only pack I could find that was not a bright stand-out color like orange or red; I can understand why some people wan that, I didn't.
2. It had a large capacity: maxed out I could put about 20 lbs of gear in it when my dog and I hit the trails.

While this item fulfilled both these criterion, I did not count on the most basic needs for a pack to not be considered: quality and durability.
I used this product both for hiking and to make my dog's everyday walks more challenging but after only about 40 uses, The whole thing just started falling apart. This pack is riddled with poor seams and unreinforced joints. Save some money and buy a higher quality pack the first time around...

product_title: PetFusion Ultimate Cat Scratcher Lounge. [Superior Cardboard & Construction]
review_headline: This should be included with any new couch purchase!
review_body: We recently bought a new couch because the previous one had been literally torn apart by our cat. I planned for this cat scratcher to arrive a couple of days before the couch, so that we'd have time to \\"wean\\" the cat off the couch and onto the scratcher. I cannot believe how well it has worked. I actually bought another tower-type scratcher as well and our cat has yet to go near the thing. The only thing I'm kind of anxious about it how quickly this scratcher is getting torn up (the scratching part is cardboard, not sisal). I imagine we can use one side for about six months, then flip it over and use the other side for six months, and then we might have to buy a new one. But if $50 a year is going to save my $2000 couch, then it's totally worth it.

product_title: Knight Pet Mylar and Glitter Ball Toy, 4-Piece
review_body: My kitten and grandkittens love the glitter balls.  The little glitter strands do shed, however.  We find them in the oddest places and wonder how in the world did it get tehre.  This inexpensive toy is well worth it!

product_title: Zoo Med Reptibreeze IguanArium
review_body: This habitat is horrible. It had a top hatch opening, it also has a very low down opening. ( that does not latch properly) as we all know iguanas are prey animals and fear being approached from above. So either entrance I go through to get my pet scares her and puts her in defensive mode. I do not recommend this product. It is not accessible to your pet. Nor iguana social behavior acceptable.

product_title: Petmate Replendish Charcoal Replacement Filters, 3-Pack
review_body: The product arrived fast to my residence. when I replaced the old one for the new one, it worked great. My dogs are very happy and drinking healty water.

product_title: Nutramax Dasuquin with MSM Chewable Tablets for Dogs
review_body: The product was recommended by our vet. Sugar lived her 15 years suffering from hip displacea. Dasuquin helped for a while. Now that she is deceased, we cannot use the unsealed product. Hopefully we can return it!

product_title: Purina ONE Cat Food
review_headline: our cat could eat this all day long
review_body: She had no problem eating this all day long and she never threw it up so it can't be that bad.  I switched her to an all wet diet since then though because this did not seem to control her weight.
