review_body:
man. these must taste great because my dog absolutely loves them. he gets 2 a day and no prob getting him to eat them.

for the price ( which is awesome btw for vitamins ) the bottle is well made, packaged well, in date, arrived quick and enough to last for awhile.

i dont obviously know if they help him, but i do know i feel better when i give them to him.

quality, price, piece of mind.....recommended.

product_title: All Star Squeaky Football Dog Toy
review_body: This football is pretty nice, although it isn't as big as I was looking for. The dogs play with them a little bit.  Would suit a smaller dog much better, but over all, a good buy.

product_title: Ethical Plush Skinneeez Fox 24-Inch Stuffingless Dog Toy
review_headline: australian cattle dog mix's favorite toy.
review_body:
my little six month old puppy loves this thing so much!
it has two squeakers which just makes her day and not to meantion keeps her busy when i cant. however i did buy mine at Petsmart because it was cheaper, but these things are really awesome!

product_title: Eheim Battery Operated Auto Fish Feeder
review_body: No problems so far.  I used to have one that would spin around but it never worked very reliably.  Granted this one is 3 times as expensive, but it is digital and it seems to work well.  I set it to feed the fish twice a day.  I have had it a couple weeks and it has worked perfectly thus far.

product_title: Ideal Pet Products Fast Fit Aluminum Pet Patio Door, 96"
review_body: Came on time. Took some time to get it to fit, my door was a little bit smaller than this door and much bigger than the others. With a little bit of work it fit just right. Very happy with the door.

product_title: PetSafe 6-Volt Lithium Battery (2 Batteries per Pack)
review_headline: Be sure to check items that come up automatically
review_body: When something pops up saying that other people also bought this item when purchasing same item that you just put in your shopping cart, beware.  I automatically clicked on the battery that came up believing it was the battery to be used in dog collar that I just purchase, only to find out when I received them, that it didn't fit my item.  Be sure to check numbers before assuming just because the item comes up automatically that it is correct

product_title: Yeowww! Catnip Toy, Yellow Banana
review_body: All love this.  Well worth spending the money for. I have bought other catnip toys from petstores and they like them for the day if that long.  But all the yeoww products my cats love for months. I dont know what catnip isin them but they love it.

product_title: Dogit Design Fresh and Clear Dog Drinking Fountain
review_body: I was thrilled to buy this for my \\"boys\\" - excited that they'd always have fresh clean water from a fountain.  The first one I received had a bad motor.  The second one I received seemed to be humming along just fine until I realized there is a huge water stain on my living room carpet.  It has somehow developed a slow leak.  Not cool Dogit!!

product_title: Tetra 25905 Decorative Reptile Filter for Aquariums up to 55 Gallons
review_body: This is a nice, scenic addition to my turtle aquarium and has plenty of flow and filtration for my needs. The only thing, my baby sliders have a hard time climbing up the sheer face to get to the basking platform. It usually takes them several tries. You can't raise the water level past a certain point, so you have to provide a ramp or some other lower place to get out of the water. I bought the 12-pack filter kit to save money because believe me, they fill up quickly.

product_title: Coolaroo Elevated Pet Bed with Knitted Fabric
review_body: I bought this for my 70-lb American Bulldog and she every time I let her outside the first thing she does is run and jump on her bed. The frame is sturdy and the material is very durable. The assembly is so easy, that even if the bed did get wobbly, I could just tighten one of the four screws used to hold it all together. My dog's nails always get pretty long before we can cut them and the bedding never tore. She stands on it, jumps, on it, sleeps on it -- she really does love it. This is a must-have for your dog!

product_title: Fleabusters Rx for Fleas Plus 3Lb Kills Roaches Kills Ants Odorless
review_body: It worked! We tried several other products before this and none of them worked completely. Now the fleas are gone and our renter is happy!!

product_title: Kaytee Forti-Diet Pro Health Honey Stick Parakeet Treats
review_body: My paraqueets start to go crazy as I'm un-opening these treats.  They absolutely devour them.  The only problem is that the treats fall off the stick very easily and oddly the birds won't eat them once they've fallen to the bottom of the cage.  But, I will continue to buy these treats because my birdies love them so much.

product_title: Fruitables Pumpkin Dog Treats
review_body: I like them because they're a healthy treat, nothing fake in them at all - my little Murphy loves them for the taste. They smell good enough for me to eat.

product_title: Nutramax Dasuquin with MSM Chewable Tablets for Dogs
review_body: My pup was diagnosed with osteoarthritis at 1 year. After weeks of oral steroids, my vet also suggested this vitamin supplement as a form of prevention. I have had no problems and my dog is running around with strong joints ever since.

product_title: Armarkat Pet Steps Stairs Ramp for Cats and Dogs
review_headline: Bought these for my larger-than-average arthritic cat
review_body: I bought these for my 17-year-old cat Mosey who has pretty bad arthritis in her hips and back. She hasn't been able to jump up on furniture for several years and I wanted to find something to help her get onto the bed. At 16 pounds, Mosey is almost twice the size of your average cat and so I needed something built to accommodate her larger size. These steps are great! They were the only ones I found tall enough to reach nearly to the top of my mattress which is 27\\" from the floor. The steps are sturdy and wide and Mosey was able to walk up and down them easily. Since they only arrived today, she still has to get used to using them but I'm very happy with them and know Mosey will be too. Highly recommend!

product_title: Nature's Miracle Jaw Scoop
review_body: So far, this is much easier to use than the ones in the past and seems like it will last longer.

product_title: Dogit Knit Dog Sweater, XX-Large, Purple
review_body: VERY UPSET WITH THE FACT THAT I ORDERED AN XXLARGE AND IT WAS STILL TOO SMALL FOR MY CHOCOLATE LAB,PLUS THE COLOR WAS SUPPOSE TO BE VIOLET, IT LOOKED VERY FUSHIA TO ME, AND OF COURSE NO INFORMATION TO SEND IT BACK, WHAT A BUMMER! HIGHLY DISAPPOINTED.

product_title: Life Line Wild Alaskan Salmon Oil for Dogs and Cats
review_body: Wonderful product.  I give my show Yorkies 1cc daily and feel there is an improvement in their coat growth and texture when using it.

product_title: Catit Style Scratcher with Catnip
review_body: The kitten hasn't quite figured out the scratching function of this lounger yet, but she sure does enjoy sleeping on it!  When I first got recieved this, I thought our older cat would steal it - she's a catnip fiend - but the kitten quickly established this as \\"hers\\".  She will sleep on this all day - between bouts of frenzied playing and eating - while I work from home.  It's definitely her favorite perch and the green definitely looks snazzy.

product_title: PetSafe Petite Martingale Collar
review_body: Product works as described. No qualms with appearance, construction, or expectations. After a couple months, it is showing no signs of wear and has been continuously worn.

product_title: Cardio Canine Hands Free Dog Leash 25-34" waist
review_body:
I had my eye on this leash for about a year. When my current hands-free leash broke, I took the plunge and bought it. The color and design are awesome. I love the fact that there is a water bottle for when I go on long runs with my dog, but it causes the belt to bounce while running way too much. The side pocket it wonderful to have and the cushioned belt feels great.
I like that there are multiple places for attaching my dog to the belt, but I would prefer him attached to the front, but when he pulls, it starts to peel off the velcro, undoing the belt. So I've tried attaching him to the side and when he runs in front of me, it twists the belt uncomfortably. I also notice the belt doesn't stay low on my hips where I'd like it. It bounces up as I'm running to mid-waist and becomes loose.
So I've learned to wear the belt tight at mid-waist for less bounce and more comfort (looks a little dorkier, but I can get over that), and also will be working on my dog with running on one side on me to keep the belt from twisting.
I love the concept and design.

product_title: Little City Dogs BEEF FLAVORED Flea Killer Capsules for Dogs - 57 Mg Nitenpyram ...compare to Capstar® - 14 Capsules for Dogs 25 to 125 lbs
review_body: BEWARE:  Look at the little white box. They are packaged wrong. I bought the pack for large dogs and the little box said it was for small dogs and cats. They sent me the 12mg inside a 57mg box. No wonder it doesn't work for some....and the box only had 12 capsules instead of the 14 that are supposed to be for the larger dogs.

product_title: Novartis Capstar Flea Tablets for Dogs and Cats
review_body: My dog is not badly infested and the first time I gave him some Capstar I actually saw a flea jump off my dog. However, since then, from time to time when I run a comb through his fur I still pull up lone fleas. They don't seem to be dying at all. I think I'm going to have to see Frontline or something else. The reason I got Capstar was because I was afraid to apply the Frontline to my dog.

product_title: Dr. Elsey's Cat Attract Cat Litter
review_body: When we moved into our new house, one of our cats suffered anxiety and started to pee outside her litter box. I other litters, frequent box cleanings and new litter boxes but nothing worked. Someone suggested Cat Attract to me and so glad they did. This stuff worked great! Filled up the litter box and cat started using her box again.

product_title: Outward Hound Kyjen  PP01128 Hedgehog Girl Plush Dog Toys Squeak Toy, Small, Brown
review_body: My dogs love this toy!  Two big dogs playing with a little hedgehog - they can almost fit the whole thing in their mouths.  It is great and the squeeker has lasted a long time.  Love it!  wish the company had a few more toys like this!

product_title: Cat Dancer - Cat Charmer Wand Teaser Toy
review_body: This is one of my cats favorite it toy along with the laser light and the feathers on a string.  I foster cats/kittens an all like it.

product_title: Marineland Pro Series Bio-Wheel Power Filter, Emperor 280
review_body:
Has caused me nothing but trouble and the loss of a fish. I bought this filter for a 30 gallon gold fish tank, as what I thought would be an upgrade. With-in a month both of my large gold fish had ick, which eventually killed one of them. Since then I test my water very frequently and have found that even with a 50 percent water change I can not keep the nitrates at a safe level.
The manufacture suggested that I change the filter media once a week, and do a 50 percent water change at the same time.

I do not have the time or money for this filter. Will not be purchasing another Marineland product.

product_title: KONG Air Dog Squeaker Dog Toy
review_headline: Dog loved it... while it lasted
review_body: My 2yr old medium sized lab mix got his paws on a nerf football and loved it more than any toy we'd ever given him. It lasted less than a day and when I threw it out, he was so upset he would go into the trash to get it. So... we got this Kong football at Petco. He LOVED it -- carried the damn thing everywhere and would not stop squeaking. But it's been about two weeks and sadly his new favorite toy is deader than dead. He pulled all the yellow fuzz off it quite quickly, and then today when he pressed down to squeak it, the whole ball split in half right down the seam. Wish this were more durable. I know dogs chew like crazy, but I wish we could find something he loves that actually lasts. Sigh.

product_title: Sound Barrier Indoor Sonic Dog & Cat Fence SB-1
review_body: I was really skeptical but this product works great for my Morkie and Doxie! We were using baby gates inside the house now i use these and love them. Thanks

product_title: Snoozer Lookout Car Seat
review_body:
This pup seat is just what I wanted and it came just in time for the weekend in perfect condition and at a great price.
Thank you!

product_title: Petmate Pet Cafe Pet Waterer
review_headline: Cute but the water spillage is irritating
review_body: No matter how careful I am, I cannot get the water to not spill when refilling and setting back up.  Other than that is is a cute little waterer.

product_title: PetSafe Drinkwell Replacement Carbon Filters
review_body: Good quality for the price. I Would highly recommend this to anyone owning a Drinkwell Original Pet fountain. Each lasts up to 2 weeks.

product_title: Etna Pet Store Shoe Cat Playhouse, Red
review_body: My cat and I were very pleased with the playhouse. Only problem is that it will not stand up on its on.  I glued 2 paint stirring sticks to the back to give it some form.  Now my cat can go in and out of all the openings without any \\"caving in\\" problems. Also quick response by company to my order.  I would recommend this item to friends.

product_title: Leather Dog Collar
review_body: The color of this collar is true to the image, but the leather is extremely stiff.  I plan on finding a way to soften it a bit before putting it on my dog.  It's also slightly annoying that there isn't a loop to hold the excess color to itself, as it sticks out awkwardly straight.

product_title: Tomlyn Nutri-Cal For Cats
review_headline: Approved by both the cat and the owner
review_body:
One of my cats has always had a problem keeping on weight (a problem her owner wouldn't mind having!) and I've found this to be a great way to supplement her diet with some extra calories.

I give it to her at pill time (she has to take a pill twice a day to help regulate her thyroid). The Nutrical helps get the pill down quickly, easily and in a far more tasty format than other methods I've used for pilling. It's also useful as a treat - she finds it tasty. I do have to be careful since the other cats, who certainly don't need extra calories, also find it tasty.

My only complaint is that it comes with a screw top closure instead of a flip-top as it has in the past. The flip-top was easier to deal with.

The price on Amazon was better than in the store. Oddly, however, the price on Amazon for a two-pack was higher than buying two single tubes. You'll want to check the price of buying two singles vs. a two-pack to see which is the better value.

product_title: KONG Squeezz Ball Dog Toy
review_body: My dog is a vizsla mix and has chewed through fire hose toys in less than 15 minutes. The medium size KONG dumbbell didn't last a day but I think that's because my husband played 'tug' with her using it. The LARGE size dumbbell is doing very well. So far there are no puncture marks and the \\"ball\\" as we call it has survived literally hundreds of times being thrown and returned. I'd recommend this to a heavy chewer unless the dog is really big and could get the end of the dumbbell entirely in its mouth. It is a good throw toy but not a toy to us playing 'tug'. I bought a second one to have ready when this one eventually wears out.

product_title: Canine Friendly Vented Vest Harness Air Mesh
review_body: I purchased four of these Harnesses only because they ate the last 2 off of each others back. That was my fault for leaving them on overnight! These are soft and I mainly purchased them because they do not rub the fur off like other types of harnesses can do. Its also very lightweight and strong and I love that I can put them in the washing machine. There is another brand called Puppia that I was originally looking for but unfortunately they only make them for small dogs. No complaints here, buy with confidence.

product_title: Wellness CORE Natural Grain Free Dry Cat Food, Original Turkey & Chicken, 5.9-Pound Bag
review_body: After the vet told me my 8 month old kitten was getting a \\"pouch\\" I cut back on his food a little. Johnny turned into a cat who ate when hungry to one who was constantly crying and begging for food. I choose this brand for the quality of the food, but my kitty seems to love everything about it. I'm still mixing it in with his other food but he hasn't cried at all since I started feeding him Wellness. This seems to keep him full and happy even when his dinner time is pushed back a few hours.

product_title: MidWest iCrate Single Door & Double Door Folding Metal Dog Crates
review_headline: Wonderful crate at a great price!
review_body: We upgraded from a smaller crate when our puppy outgrew her other. It is used everyday while we're at work.we're even able to fit a bed in there for her.

product_title: Wahl Professional Animal Powerful Motor ARCO Cordless Clipper Kit
review_body:
We adopted an adorable little dog who transformed from Dr Jeckyl into Mr Hyde whenever I tried to groom him. He always ended up a nervous wreck, with me bleeding from numerous bites.

Because this Wahl cordless clipper is very quiet, vibration-free & remains cool to the touch, he now stands there & accepts grooming with no problems. The multi-position blade saves time as no blade changes are required.

I highly recommend this clipper to anyone, especially to those with high-strung dogs who are a problem with traditional clippers.

product_title: MidWest iCrate Single Door & Double Door Folding Metal Dog Crates
review_headline: A  fabulous dog crate at a fabulous price
review_body:
I'm so happy I ordered the icrate. I really took a chance with this purchase. Usually you get what you pay for. I figured that there was a chance I would get a flimsy metal cage. Instead, I received a crate that was comparable to my dog's more expensive crate. I ordeded the 24- by -18 by -19 inch and paired it with Slumber Pet Sherpa Dog Crate Bed, Small for my Chihuahua mix. See attached photos.
We are both very happy.

product_title: Doggles MonsterPulls Dog Toy
review_body: We have a little Chihuahua Jack Russell mix and boy can he rip apart a toy in less than thirty minutes.  He only weighs about 10 pounds but his jaw and teeth are lethal.  This is probably the only toy that can make it for three or four months before he destroys it.  So do not fear if you have a chewer this toy is the best out there!

product_title: MidWest iCrate Single Door & Double Door Folding Metal Dog Crates
review_body: My Rottie/Shepard loves this crate, he is 6.5 months & 50 pounds. We had a smaller crate that was 25 inches high (same brand)& he is too tall for that one. This crate id HUGE yes I saw the measurements but when I unpacked it holy moly its HUGE. We are keeping it because he will be that big one day but just make sure you measure this out & hve room for it. Love the brand great quality!

product_title: Petstages Fresh Breath Mint Stick #335
review_headline: Petstages Fresh Breath Mint Stick Cat Toy
review_body: I purchased this and the Petstages pretzel, mice and health chews.  My two boys love them all.  The mice are their favorite.  I first purchased three catnip chew toys locally back in Dec. 2011 for the kittens.  Those are still in top shape.  Since they carry them all over the house and like to hide them, I just might end up needing more in the future.  These are the only toys that survived the kittens into their adulthood!

product_title: K&H Manufacturing Furniture Cover
review_body: I meant to order the tan but got the mocha. I decided to keep it. It works quite well. One arm keeps sliding off. I need to figure out how to keep it on. I have washed it once and it looks great. Our basset/beagle mix is a real shedder. This keeps the hair off the couch and looks nice at the same time.

product_title: Frontline Flea and Tick Treatment Dog/Cat Spray, 8-1/2-Ounce
review_body: Safe to use on cats and dogs. Last as long as frontline plus topical. My pets are all different sizes so by using the spray I don't have to buy multiple packages. It works!

product_title: Andis CeramicEdge Carbon-Infused Steel Pet Clipper Blade
review_headline: Stays cool and cuts real fine hair.
review_body: This blade is my favorite.  It stays cool, cuts fine hair with perfection.  If the ceramic blade is available I will allways perchase it as a first choice.  Andis detachable blades simplfy home "DoItYourself" if you have only one clipper like me.

product_title: Elite Submersible Preset Heater, 50 Watt
review_headline: Seems solid, dont trust temp gage.
review_body: As described, fully submersable. The temeture settings are not close to accurate. I have to set to 68f to keep a 76-78 temp in a 16gal tank. Make sure to have a thermo handy so you can check the acctual temp or you may cook your fish.

product_title: Conair Yellow Dog Massaging Shampoo Brush, Dog Home Grooming, Yellow
review_body: Love, love, love this item!!  We have 2 large German Shepherds and use this brush for every bath.  The design & handle provide a good grip and the massaging brush helps gently work the soap and conditioner through thick top & undercoats.  Don't ever want to go back to bath time without it!

product_title: Chuckit! Amphibious Boomerang (Colors Vary)
review_body: I have had this dog toy in the past.  Great for in the water but Jake's overall favorite for me throwing and him fetching.  We live in the woods and I can sail it through the trees and he has to use his sense of smell to find it.  Not all stores carry the water boomerang so glad to find it on amazon.

product_title: SmartyKat Corrugated Cat Scratchers
review_body: I got this at Walmart for my cat. It was only 5 bucks so I figured what the heck. I got this because she likes to scratch on the furniture so I thought this would be a good substitute. When I brought it home she was very excited and started rubbing herself on it while I was assembling it to be hung on the door. When I did put it on the door, she went to scratch on it, and because its so light weight it, it kept hitting against the door and that scared her. Ever since than, she hasn't touched it while it was hung. So I took it down and layed it on the floor and surprisingly  she liked it that way instead, then she started scratching on it. If it was a little sturdier and heavier, I think she would of liked it more. It also comes with catnip which she liked. Hope this helps :)

product_title: K&H Thermo-Kitty Mat
review_headline: This is the best product I've ever purchased for my cat
review_body: My cat loves heat and LIVES on this pad.  It is seriously the best cat product I've ever purchased. Have had for two years now and she's on it day and night.  It's true that the entire pad does not get hot, but she just centers herself on the spot that does.

product_title: PetFusion SmartGrip Cat Litter Mat. Large (35 x 24 inches). Safe for your cats, free from Phthalates & VCM
review_headline: As good as they say it is.
review_body: LOVE this mat! The Beige and white design is classy and fits in well in my living room (Yes, that's the ONLY place I had room for a litter box in my tiny apartment). Of course, with a litter box in the living room, I wanted ZERO tracking! And that is what I got! It seems like your average litter mat, but it works wonders with catching stay pieces of litter. Perfect size, perfect color, easy to clean, works GREAT. I would definitely recommend this to friends and family.

product_title: Orbit Nylon Dog Collar, Padded Big Dog Collar by Kakadu Pet
review_headline: Just what I was looking for (well, mostly)
review_body:
I just adopted an adult dog and I have this thing about getting a new addition a fresh collar. I had in mind what I wanted. He's only 50ish pounds. I was hunting for a 1\\" nylon collar with a metal buckle (I don't trust the clips and I hate the adjustable collars) for a 15\\" neck for around $20. Sounded easy enough. I looked through a couple of brick stores and brought a few things home to try, but wasn't happy with them. I searched for hours on a ton of sites online, finally I came back to Amazon, changed my search criteria and this eventually popped up. So many collars I found have a 15\\"-20\\"something fit. I didn't want to buy one where my dog's measurement is the lowest option as that doesn't leave us much room to adjust. Plus, the padding is a great feature and the price is unbeatable.

It arrived today. It fits really well, the hardware is solid, and the other materials and stitching feel strong and well made. My new guy even seemed excited to get dressed. My only little complaint is the color. I knew what I ordered, but if there had been other color options I probably would have chosen something else. I did look at the Kakadu site, and for my tastes, the other colors they did/do produce are as equally unappealing. So my dog has a great collar, he just looks like Superman or the U.S. flag...

On a related note, to complete the set, we're waiting for our new tag from boomerangtags.com. I've ordered from them half a dozen times. Their products, service and prices are fantastic.

Update 12/19/2012: Four months later, I'm still happy with this, but the rivet in the hole it's set to is loosening so I'm not expecting it to last much longer. I think I'll try something else as a replacement.

product_title: A Little Dog Company Zip up Fleece with Hoodie
review_body: This is a great product that I will recommend to my 'dog friends' or friends dogs!  It slips on nicely and is thick enough to provide some real warmth!

product_title: Boss Pet Prestige Dog Tie Out
review_body: I purchased this tie out for Sam a few years ago. It is still in good shape. There are a few knots in it that I didn't see right away therefore I was unable to take the out, but other than that I am very plesed with this tie out. It is long and give Sam a lot of room to run after the squirrels in the yard. The price was wasn't bad at all. I would recomend it to anyone. Marie

product_title: Just the Crystals Premium Crystal Cat Litter Absorbs More, Lasts Longer, Fragrance Free, Best Odor Control. Conveniently Packaged in TWO Pre-Measured 4.4lb Bags -- 15% off when you buy two boxes!
review_body: I start all products off with five stars (I try to be positive).  Minus one star straight away because it stinks.  I don't think fragrance free was the right choice here.  For the love of nostrils, add fragrance!  Now we are down to 4.  Minus another star because it is D-U-S-T-Y.  *cough cough*  Now we are down to 3.  Minus one more star because it didn't last as long as the Mimi I got from Walmart did (not even 2 weeks and the Mimi is now going past 3) - and the Mimi is the same price!  So, that leaves one measly star just because it works in the ScoopFree and doesn't clog it.  I think I'd rather pay twice the price for FreshStep if I can't find Mimi anymore.

product_title: Bionic Bone Durable Dog Toy Chew Toy Treat Toy, Orange
review_body: I thought this would be a good choice for my dog, he is very active swimming in the pool everyday I was pleased when I found a strong toy that floats !. Sad to discover Surtr would destroy it in less than 5 minutes.

product_title: PetSafe Healthy Pet Water Station Dog and Cat Water System with Stainless Steel Bowl
review_body:
I bought two of the large water stations because I had a five-day business meeting out of town coming up. The cats already have two water fountains but even the one with a gallon capacity has to be refilled every third day or so. As it turns out, Hurricane Sandy started up the coast so I hauled out the water stations for emergency water for the cats. I live on the coast and these are nice to have for that purpose in addition to the usual bottled water and other emergency supplies. The cats took to them immediately, drinking out of them and splashing their paws.

My destination was Atlantic City and my conference was cancelled due to the devastation, so I didn't need these for my original purpose. I left them out for a week to see how they would do, and there was still lots of water left. (I have three grown cats and four rescue kittens, and they drink a lot of water.) I took the water stations up and put them in storage for the next trip or hurricane, and the cats actually miss them. It was easy to remove the water jug portion even with water in it because you only have to cover a small hole with one finger as you lift. The stainless steel bowls are easy to clean by hand or in the dishwasher. I'm satisfied with them because the cats like them and they suit my purposes.

*** 3/7/13 Finally went to Atlantic City this week for five days: I set everything up the morning of the first day and came back the afternoon of the fifth day. The cats had about half of the water in each unit left, and about a pound of dry food in the matching feeder (10 lb capacity.) They are all hale and healthy, so it worked out well for them.

product_title: PetFusion SmartGrip Cat Litter Mat. Large (35 x 24 inches). Safe for your cats, free from Phthalates & VCM
review_body: It's exactly what we wanted, maybe more!  It does exactly what is says it will do and it's fairly attractive.  My husband used to complain about the litter on the terrazzo, but not anymore!  Because I have two litter box stations, I bought one and cut it in half.  I see that it's currently unavailable, but I will be checking back to buy one more for a third station.  The cats love it too!

product_title: Majestic Pet Cat Cuddler Pet Bed
review_body:
Some info for the prospective buyer: My two cats are 10 and 11 lbs. They are cuddly cats who like to sleep together, so I bought one Cuddler in the medium size and hoped for the best. I got it. My boys fit nicely in the bed together, and it's not so big that a single cat isn't effectively cuddled when taking a solitary snooze.

So why not five stars? Folks, it's a foam form with a cloth cover, elasticized nicely so as to be easily washable. It's a good, fully functional pet bed, but it's merely a so-so value. If the price were $10 less I would be a more excited about it, as it is, I'm pretty content.

product_title: Kaytee Hay n Food Bin Feeder with Quick Locks (Colors May Vary)
review_body: I have been looking for something like this for my piggies for the longest time!  It is very sturdy and holds a decent amount of food and hay! It even gives my two bigger piggies a place to keep the hay off the ground so they can eat it up! product_title: KONG Naturals Double Scratcher Cat Toy
review_headline: Best Cat Scratchers You Can Buy
review_body: Kong scratchers are the most durable, long-lasting cat scratchers I have purchased.  We have three cats and they all enjoy the scratchers (luckily, instead of the furniture).  Other scratchers don't seem to last nearly as long before needing replacement.  Highly recommend the Kong brand of scratchers if you have cats.

product_title: AquaClear Power Filter - 110 V
review_body: after 4 month it still works very well , almost no maintenance needed, easy setup, the current is just right so the fish's aren't bothered by it. The only bad thing is you need to pour water into the filter before starting it otherwise it won't run. Overall the best filter you can get.

product_title: JW Pet Giggler Ball Assorted Color
review_body:
I got this thinking it would make lots of noises, but it really only makes one type of noise. You really have to shake the ball hard in order for it to make noise, so it's a toy you can shake to get your dog excited, but then when you set it down for them to play with it, it goes silent. If you're looking for a noisy toy to keep them entertained, this wouldn't be my choice.
Pros:
JW Toy (which are always innovative)
very durable
it's a ball (not sure what more I can say)
Cons:
it doesn't do much unless a person shakes it
only makes one noise
not super exciting

product_title: Special Edition Pet Stroller
review_body: Very Dissapointed in this stroller.  I have another pet gear stroller that is still fine after 5 years.  This one looked like new when I had to throw it in the trash.  The front wheel bent after not even at least 20 uses.  Short uses at that. No warranty past 30 days, very upsetting to me.  Overstock or Pet Gear could do nothing for me, very upset about this, since it was a defect, not my fault.  Never, ever would I order this again.  Also not sturdy like the All Terrain by Pet Gear, which is great to this day.  Cute, but not sturdy!

product_title: FURminator deShedding Tool for Dogs
review_body: My family recently adopted a dog from a rescue. She is a Dalmation mix with short course hair that tends to shed a lot. We had heard of the Furminator but was discouraged by the high price in department stores. When I found this listing on Amazon the price was low enough to take a gamble. Glad we did. The Furminator does as it claims in reducing shedding. We were a little worried that our dog would not let us use this product as she tends to be difficult  but she does not seem to mind the brushing at all.

product_title: Tetra 26445 Aquatic Reptile Heater, 100 Watt
review_body: I bought this and tried to warm my tank with it. I have a turtle. I saw that it wasn't heating the water at all. So I contacted the company and they sent me a new one. This one also didn't work.

product_title: 12 Month Supply Frontline Plus Kit for Dogs up to 22 Pounds USA / EPA 3 6 A
review_body: This is a great way to save some money !  Instructions were very easy to follow.  I will be ordering more using this method.

product_title: EQyss Micro-Tek Pet Shampoo - Stops Scratching, iItching, Biting, or Licking Hot Spots
review_body: I use this shampoo on my Papillion.  It cleans well and smells good.  Seems to be gentle on the skin.  Excellent product.

product_title: Royal Canin Dry Cat Food, Maine Coon 31 Formula, 6-Pound Bag
review_headline: Maine Coon Cat Food by Royal Canin
review_body: The Maine coon cat food is the best there is for my cats.  Amazon delivers as promised.  I only wiah it came in a larger size bag.  The large kibble protects the larger jaww and teeth of the Maine Coon.[[ASIN:B000634J62 Royal Canin Feline Health Nutrition Maine Coon 31 Formula Dry Cat Food]]

product_title: Chasing Our Tails Elk Rack Snack, 100-Percent All Naturally Shed ElkAntler Chew, Large Size 7-Inch to 10-Inch, For up to 75# Dogs
review_headline: Great toy - Weight rating is off though
review_body:
I got this for my 30 pound lab-mix puppy (about 4 months old). I had read the reviews for the \\"up to forty pound\\" version, and it seemed like this one would be better. Boy, am I glad I got this one. Anything smaller would have been too small. He loves this thing. It's his go-to chew toy - more so than any bully stick, kong, or stick. I mean, he still prefers the toys that make noise when he wants to run around the house like a freak, but for just chewing, this is by far his favorite.
I'm imagining my friend's 50 pound lab-retriever mix dog with this toy, and I think it would be a good size for her, too. I can't picture this with a German Shepherd or an Akita or anything like that, though - I think it would be too small, then.

product_title: Guardian Gear Cotton Web Dog Training Lead 6'x5/8", Black
review_body: This leash either had a defect I failed to notice or it is simply not strong enough.  The narrow 5/8th inch cotton web leash has begun to tear apart in a spot about two feet from the end clip.  My dog is a 60 pound lab and quite energetic when not heeling. When I give him the \\"go on\\" command he tugs away like crazy and is proving too much for this leash.  I'd prefer a 1 inch width but haven't been able to find it in a 20 foot length.

product_title: Lixit Animal Care Dog Treat Jar
review_headline: Great!... A lot bigger than I thought, but it's a great product
review_body: Definitely did not really  look at the size before I bought it, apparently. It's bigger than my dog! But great product. Has a tight lid so that if it fell on the floor, it shouldn't open.

product_title: Natural Balance Ultra Canned Cat Formula
review_body: I had been using cheaper name brand wet food for my cats but had noticed a decrease in quality and an increase in stomach issues with my cats.  I've had great experience with my dogs on Natural Balance dog food, so I decided to try this for my cats.  The cats LOVE it!!!!  I worried that the pate-like appearance would be a turn off for my cats, I had been buying chunky food, no problems though.  They scarf it right up and I'm happy to know that I'm feeding them the best for very little more than the store brand.

product_title: Armarkat Cave Shape Pet Cat Beds for Cats and Small Dogs-Waterproof and Skid-Free Base
review_headline: It doesnt matter if I like it, it matters if he does!
review_body: I found my cat sleeping in an eco-friendly grocery bag one day, so I thought \\" Hey, lets find him a bed that he can snuggle in\\". After looking around, I found this bed; cute, affordable and snuggly. I received it, opened it up, placed it on the floor and introduced my cat BooBoo to it. Within hours, he was sleeping in it, and now I catch him in it all the time snuggling up in it. He's a large cat (tall, not fat... ok a little fat too) and it fits him well. It was well worth the money, and if BooBoo likes it, I like it. :)

product_title: NutraMax Denamarin Chew Tab - Dogs All Sizes - 225 Mg
review_body: I purchased this product because either one or both of the individual items (Denosyl and Marin) were unavailable. I was hesitant  at first, because many of the reviewers stated that their dogs found the product unpalatable. However, since my dog needs these liver supplements I ordered it anyway. He seems to have no problem with the tablet. I break it in half, since he is small (22 lbs, chihuahua/terrier mix), and he takes it readily without any food to mask the taste. While I would purchase this product again, I think I still prefer buying the Denosyl and Marin separately. I prefer to give Denosyl one day and Marin the next instead of giving both on the same day, every day.

product_title: R-Zilla SRZ100011868 Fresh Air Screen Reptiles Habitat, 18 by 12 by 20-Inch
review_headline: An Excellent Temporary Cage, but it has a few flaws
review_body:
I actually bought this cage for my praying mantis, so that i couls house multiple mantis's in the same cage with less chance of cannibalism. First of all, when i first got my packages, i was very disappointed. I ordered this item NEW, and the box looked like it had been smashed around in someones garage for a few years and then poorly taped back together. I was not very happy because if a box is in that condition, you know the contents inside have probably been handled in the same fashion. Luckily everything was intact and i made sure to check every corner for bumps or scratches and was pleased to not find any at all.

It takes about 15-20 minutes to set up, and its super easy to set up. The instructions that come with it are simple, but pretty useless because it is quite easy to set up. I was a little disaapointed with the screen on the largest piece, it wasnt as tight as i would have liked, and i imagine it would be rather flimsy if a larger creature was trying to crawl up the wall. It displays nicely once assembled, but the plastic \\"locks\\" on the door are a downside. They look very cheap, and are very small and could be easily broken if you are too rough with the door.

The screens are all metal and just like it says, has an aluminum frame. Another side note is that their is virtually no lip on the bottom panel, so if you plan on using substrate, make sure its large pieces or it may slip out through the screen on the sides of the cage.

I know lots of people use screen cages for chameleons too and i would have to agree that this would be a very nice starter cage for a chameleon before they are moved to their permanent cage once they grow larger. I just got this, and have it all set up. If i remember, i will try to update later on how it is holding up. For now though, it seems like a great little cage.

product_title: Puppia Santa Claus Winter Coat, Large, Red
review_headline: Excellantly made and worth twice the price
review_body: As an Amazon Prime member,  I make many purchases and I love the convenience of shopping from home...I never take the time to write a review, as reviewing ALL of my purchases would take too much valuable time from my day...HOWEVER, I must make an exception for this Santa coat from Puppia....This is my 3rd Puppia Santa coat,  and I may order MORE....It's October, so I decided to order early for cold weather....I have a female mini Dachshund, and so I ordered a Medium....it arrived quickly , and in beautiful shape....The beauty and craftmanship took my breath away.....just gorgeous, and beautifully made....thick and warm, cuddly and soft....and the colors were so vibrant....It is so much prettier than the display photo...I am a discerning shopper, and very fussy about quality....alas, the size medium was too small as I had mis-judged my dog's girth....I gifted it to my neighbor, and looked for a Large....I saw none...(  maybe I should get vision checked..LOL  )  so, I ordered an X-Large ...2nd try...it came quickly , and even more beautiful than the Medium....I tried it on my doggy, and she loved it....I am going to take my 2012 Christmas card photos with my doggy wearing this coat, and I am going to wear a white sweater so I do not distract from the beautiful Santa coat she will be wearing....The coat is a bit large around the chest , but not too much , and it perfectly covers her entire butt,  and the trimmed hood fits perfectly....Today, I am back online , and I have found 2 size larges (in stock)...I am going to order a large for the slightly smaller dachshund next door....This is going to score me HUGE brownie points with another neighbor,  and may benefit good relations with my friend for some time....Merry Christmas !!!  In closing, I would easily pay 75.00 ++ for this Santa Christmas coat....The 41.xx price ( Oct 2012) with free (Prime) shipping is a steal.....My dog was whining pretty loudly yesterday, and I stopped washing dishes to see what the noise was about....She was on the floor , under where the Santa coat was hanging (displayed) in the living room....she was leaping up, trying to \\"get\\" her coat off the hanger....maybe she wanted to go out for a ride...do not know, but she definately is very fond of her new coat....I highly recommend this company, as the quality is the very best I have ever seen in dog wear...and I used to think Pet Smart was the best I could do....PUPPIA....remember that name.....PUPPIA.....*** note..this is the only review I have ever written on Amazon, even after about 200 purchases....gotta go now, as only 2 larges left in stock, and I need to purchase once again.....Merry Christmas to you all....

product_title: SportDOG Rechargeable Bark Control Collar
review_headline: You can not test if the 2 contact points are working or not and these type of electronic collars have a serious design flaw.
review_body:
I like the built quality of the device, rechargeable and replaceable battery, some of its features, the numeric lcd, but you can not test if the 2x contact points are working or not and these type of electronic collars have a serious design flaw.

It does not include an electronic/light tester to test signal and strength, or a way to test it on your own skin to see what your dogs will feel (ie: in case signal is too strong, you can lower it), and has some issues as all the other brands as well) :

1) The 2 point contacts / electrodes are like rounded nails (around 1 centimeter each), and with short term use can hurt/damage the dog's skin. The manuals of these collars including other brands clearly indicate that, and the name of the disease is: Pressure Necrosis. You have to clean dog skin regularly in case of irritation. The point is: as the manual indicates you can not leave the dog unattended when the dog has that collar (as no electronic device is perfect, as indicated in the manual). Whoever created those stainless steel contacts should try them on themselves for a few hours and see how that feels. This is not the only electronic collar with that nail type contact issue. All of the ones I saw including other brands have 2x very similar contacts on each collar (some brands longer than others, this SportDOG brand had longer contacts / more pointy than 2 others brands I used). I would have preferred something like: multiple short rounded contacts around the dog's neck to ensure conductivity, or something else. I tried the collar with a proper snug fit (as indicated in the manual) on myself for less than a minute and the 2x contacts left marks on my skin. Imagine if you were to keep the collar on for multiple hours, and then look at the condition of your skin.

2) My dog barked a few times, but she did not stop, and I did not noticed that she felt anything. There is no way to know if the device was bad, or a way to test if the electronic stimulation was too strong or too soft, or if the device was not sending stimulation at all when dog barked. There is a another brand of these type of collars that includes a very useful light tester to make sure that the device is working, and that it sends stimulation to contact points.

I would have kept the device if it worked, and provided those essential options mentioned above, and had multiple or better designed contacts to ensure conductivity and most importantly a collar that does not damage the dog skin. These collars are supposed to help the dog's owner eliminate the bark issue not for creating new issues: skin irritation, Pressure Necrosis, you don't know what type of stimulation your dog is getting etc..

By the way, these are some of the instructions included in the manuals for these type of collars:

- Place the collar high on your dog's neck close to the ears. Center the contact points underneath your dog's neck, touching the skin.
Note: It is sometimes necessary to trim the hair around the contact points to make sure that contact is consistent.
- Check the tightness of the collar by inserting one finger between the end of a contact point and your dog's neck. The fit should be snug but not constricting
- Check the fit to prevent excessive pressure by being able to insert one finger between a contact point and your dog's skin.
- Examine your dog daily for any signs of a rash or sore.
- A condition called Pressure Necrosis, which is a devitalization of the skin due to excessive and prolonged contact against the contact points.
- If a rash or sore is observed, discontinue the use of the collar for a few days.
- If the condition persists beyond 48 hours, see your veterinarian.
- Your dog's neck and the contact points must be washed weekly with a wash cloth and mild hand soap, then rinsed thoroughly.
- A loose collar can promote skin irritation from moving or rubbing too much on a dog's neck while they are running or training. The proper snug fit will help prevent this from occurring.

product_title: Bergan Comfort Carrier Soft-Sided Pet Carrier
review_headline: Great Bag... Work in Progress for Puppy
review_body:
This is a very nice bag. The issue is mostly not the bag, but the puppy getting used to it. For reference, my cock-a-poo puppy is approximately 11 pounds and 5 1/2 months old. He fits very comfortably inside of this bag, and the bag is extremely flexible because the material is very stretchy.

I really like this bag because my puppy is able to turn a full 360 degrees inside of this bag. The bag has mesh on all sides, so my puppy is able to see me when he is inside. He has a fit about not being able to sit on my lap while driving. I place him on the seat in a way where he is able to see me, and then he quiets down and enjoys the ride. The bag also has two pockets that I am able to keep his leash, treats, potty supplies, etc inside. We will eventually be flying on Delta, and according to their regulations, this bag is approved. Since the bag is flexible, the puppy and bag will be able to fit in the designated space beneath the seat as a carry-on. Finally, the two features I love the most? The fact that the zippers lock, so he cannot jump out or unzip the bag once he's inside. I also really appreciate the fact that the bag opens at the top so that I am able to rub his face, back, belly, etc when he needs to be calmed down.

The only thing I don't like, is that I have not been able to figure out how the seat belt piece works. I have attempted to fasten it in the seat, but my seat belts don't exactly fit through the little straps. That is the only reason why I gave the bag 4 stars instead of 5.

My puppy has only been in this bag twice, but both times he has been calm once he's settled in. I found it helpful to have treats inside the bag waiting for him once he's gotten in. I am hoping that he will eventually just walk in and lay down. That's why I say the process is a work in progress.

product_title: Fluval Edge Aquarium with LED Light
review_headline: Are the LED lights dimmable for the new FRUVAL 12 gallon tank?
review_body:
I started out a year ago with the 6 gallon tank with halogen lights on a regular lamp dimmer for over a year and the water still hit 85-90 degrees. I placed frozen water in ziploc bags to cool the water down in between water changes. The used the regular dimmer without any problems with halogen supplied lights which I found to heat up the tank.

I recently ordered the 'dimmable' MR11 LED white lights for that tank and am was using a LED LUTRON lamp dimmer which I use on all my lamps. The bulbs worked for less than a week! Could be a faulty dimmer ( not both bulbs).

I have converted the entire condo over to LED lights and dimmers in most of the rooms (so, I do know alot about it). You may mix the dimmable LED bulbs with the dimmable CFL, halogen and incandesant ones. My electrical bill has dropped about $50 a month.

I'm trying to contact Fruval in Boston to find out. I broke it and had to replace the glass tank and lost all my fish! The day it arrived I put a little chip in the top front, it still hasn't leaked. Just my luck!

If anyone has used the LED lamp dimmer on the lights....please comment! I love my new 12 gallon tank!

product_title: Petmate Le Bistro Single Food Mat
review_headline: Holds tightly on the floor, but traps small food pellets.
review_body:
I don't ask for a lot in a pet food mat. I want it to not slide around the floor, to be capable of capturing water in the event of a spill, and to not feature any gaudy colors or patterns. This mat fits the bill. I placed it on a hardwood floor, and it does not slide around at all. I purchased the small which measures 18.5\\" L X 12\\" W. In hindsight, I should have gotten the large. The small was fine when my two kittens were two months old, but now that they are a little older, the small does not really accommodate their larger bowls. I think the small is really only suitable for one cat or a small dog.

My one problem with this mat, which I consider to be a bit more than just a minor nuisance, is that the grooves on the mat cause small food pellets to become trapped; I can't just brush or shake them off. I have to manually pick them out. Maybe not a huge problem, but it is probably an unnecessary one because I don't know what purpose the grooves serve. In fact, without them, the mat would have more surface area to capture water spills.

product_title: Laguna Max-Flo 600 Waterfall & Filter Pump
review_body:
I have a small pond in my back yard near my deck. I built it myself. It holds about 800 Gallons of water. My previous pump quit working after about 5 years, so I looked for a replacement pump. This looks similar to what I had but is a different brand. I liked the way the old one worked and this pump is supposed to handle 600-1200 gallons and the price is right, so I picked it up.

When I got the pump and removed it from the packing material, I noticed that this pump's outlet is too small for the 2-inch pipe I already had installed in the pond. I had to fabricate a reducer to allow my hose that feeds the waterfall to be able to connect to this pump. The pump works but is obviously undersized for my application. While my pond size is in the middle of the specs, it appears my waterfall is either too far away from the pump (about 10 feet) or the waterfall itself is too high. It takes about a minute for the water to start flowing when I plug it in, and the amount that actually flows down my waterfall is more a trickle than what I had before. So, it does the job, I like the design, but it is underpowered. I should have spent the money and got a model 900 or 1200 which would probably have given me the results I wanted and would have handled my 2-inch waterfall hose.

Since it does work, I am not returning it. I will just live with the underpowered result. I am not one to make someone else pay for my mistake so I would never return an item that does work but is not suitable because of a mistake I made in sizing. As long as it does work, it stays in the pond. The birds still take their baths and get their drinks and that is what is important. If this one wears out prematurely, I would buy the next size up of this brand as I do like the design.

review_body: I absolutely love this dog door. After reading several reviews on different ones, I opted for this specific one. Primarily for the fact that it was a hard plastic door and sealed around all the edges. After my dogs (two very active miniature schnauzers) go in and out of the door, it automatically seals shut without question. This helps with insulation. I did use this on a raised panel door which I had to add a few inches of foam insulation on the sides to solve that issue. No biggie. What I didn't realize at the time was that on the door which is sort of glazed, there is a small square that is clear for which my smallest dog can sit and look out of waiting to see what she can go bark at next. They love it and I assure you they are in and out of the door numerous times a day.

product_title: Red Dingo Dog Collar, Medium,12" - 18"
review_body: Our dog is very happy with his new comfortable collar, his buddy's want to know where he got it. Exactly what I would expect from Red Dingo.

product_title: Premium Durable Orthopedic Shredded Memory Foam Dog Bed Pillow with Waterproof Internal Liner and Strong External Cover for Small Medium to Extra Large Pet - 6 Sizes
review_body:
Product is what it is - a denim shell over a bag of shredded foam (which, for whatever reason, my dogs REALLY enjoyed). The dogs used the beds right away and seem to like them. More importantly, the company truly stands behind what they sell.
Highly recommend buying from them.

product_title: SturdiBag Pet Carrier
review_body:
I really love this carrier. Admittedly I have not had it for long but I already love it.
I have a cat, she is lovely and I spoil her to no end. She was used to her old carrier but that one is no good for trips since the base does not give any stability and I may as well have use a cardboard bag for all the protection it offered. The SturdiBag is great. I was a bit concerned about the mesh since I had not decipher how was the mesh exactly. My cat has never scratched herself free of anything but there is always a first time so I was nervous at first. Nevertheless when I got the bag and I actually touched the mesh I got really happy. It is fabric but it is a sort of plastic fabric. It is very resistant, although if you have a kitty who enjoys scratching you may consider changing this mesh for a plastic wire one.
This bag has ventilation at: the back, halfway its own height is made of this mesh; above, where you can also find a small zipper to reach in an pet your dog or cat -I love that-; in front, the whole door panel is made of mesh. Nevertheless, if you would like to be ore conspicuous or if the weather is getting cold each mesh panel has a fabric panel that secures itself with a couple of Velcro patches.

The thing I like the most is the stability offered by its base. It is some sort of compress foam an cardboard of around 0.4 inches that you can insert and remove without bothering your pet through an independent zipper. Also I really love the fact that it keeps its shape. That is a must when you are traveling with a pet. You do not want the carrier to collapse over your pet. This bag is great for in-cabin intercontinental trips since it is flexible enough to be push down under a plane seat but sturdy enough to try to fight back and offer your pet all the space it is likely to get. For in-cabin trips though I do not recommend using the padding this comes with unless it is winter because it takes a lot of room. Now that we are in summer I recommend just covering the inside with one of those absorbent pads.

If you are the proud owner of a \\"runner\\" like me -whenever my pet gets nervous she either pushes herself to the very end of the carrier trying not to be reached by her vet, or she jumps and runs for it- you would be glad to know that this has a leash. Its length is of around 17 1/2 inches so it allows your pet to move well but not to run when you open the door to offer water -when offering cookies I use the upper smaller zipper-.

The handles and the shoulder straps are very comfortable and if you have a mind for it to can use one of the shoulder straps to secure your pet over some luggage. To mind any changes in the surface you are taking your luggage over.

Finally... This also has zipper locks which comes very in handy with a pet like mine. First time I got her inside the bag she got bored and decided to open the zipper and go away. I habve no idea how she did it,, but the point is she did. Second time I got her to go inside I use the lock on the upper part of the zippers... bad idea... she made the bag bent for her to create a whole big enough for her head and she escaped again! But the third time is a charm ans so I use the lock at the lower part of the zipper. This time she really had no way to go out and she stayed there :) until I wanted her to get out.

There is nothing left to say expect that I love the thoughtful design of this carrier and that I am absolutely glad I bought it.

product_title: Zoo Med Labs Drip System - Little Dripper
review_body: It works wonders, but it just has the one spot that drips. Its not really \\"rainfall\\" as a dripping faucet kind of thing. We got it for our frog tank for some more humidity. We ended up having to get this tub that connects to it from a local store(not from the product company) that has more holes to simulate actual rainfall. Works much better now! Still, deffinately recomend this product!

product_title: CatGenie 120 Self-Washing Self-Flushing Cat Box
review_body: I HAVE 3 cats. They wont use this thing. I have tried everything.  They just can't be trained tricked or be dazzled into using it....I Spent 2hours installing it!  I spent over $340 on the unit. And it is WORTHLESS. ..lesson learned ..what a waste!

product_title: Bags on Board Dog Waste Bag Bone Dispenser with 30 Refill Bags
review_body: There isn't much to say other than it works, the bags easily pull out from the side, and it is much better than any other bag holder I have tried.  Great product!

product_title: Pet Qwerks Talking Babble Ball Dog Toy
review_body:
I have never seen my 50 lb lab mix, Mischka, act so silly with something!!! It's wonderful! This toy was worth it's money in the first 5 minutes we had it out of the package. She pounced on it. She barked and growled at it. Then she proceeded to roll it all over the place. It kind of looked like she was kicking it around like a soccer ball!
I would recommend this toy for any puppy parent who is looking for something durable and different from the same old boring squeaky toys we all have piling up in the toy box. The replaceable batteries are an added bonus!

product_title: 120 grams Angels Eyes Tear Stain Remover Eliminator for dogs and cats Chicken Flavor + FREE Scoop
review_headline: Beau thanks you, I thank you,...We all thank you!
review_body: Finally! Something for all of Our Precious Little One's little teary-stained eyes,...that REALLY WORKS! I was always cutting my Bichon's tear stained hair from around his eyes because I could not wash that sightly ugliness off fast enough before they were right back, taking away from his handsome Calender looks! :-) It's easy to give & he likes it! Thanks to Angel Eyes, Beau is Full Calender Handsome again,...all 12 month!

product_title: Laguna Aeration Kit for Ponds
review_body: Great pump, far superior to the aquarium pumps I had been using for my pond.  You are able to adjust the volume of air with the turn of a dial.  Very strong airflow - you need at least a 5 inch disk or stone to replace the small one it ships with it.

product_title: Mal-A-Ket Wipes 50 ct
review_headline: works great on my dog's recurring  fungal rash
review_body: My Rhodesian Ridgeback gets a recurring rash in the warmer weather,small red raised circles that become large round black spots the size of quarters and it is not very pretty. It bothers him too because he licks at it. The $100 a month antifungal pillsfrom the vet work no better than this stuff and it goes in a week or two as opposed to a month with the pills. I use these pads everyday with an anti fungal shampoo a couple times a week until the rash is gone.

product_title: Cox Premium Poplar Bedding, 9.0 Cubic Foot Bag
review_headline: Not "virtually dust-free," not for small pets...
review_body:
I was hoping this product would be a fluffier alternative to Aspen bedding, but as soon as I got it out of the package, the dust was evident. It formed a fine film on the large measuring cup used to transport it to the cage and around the plastic bottom tub itself. A faint dust vapor rose in the air each time the shavings were dropped onto the cage floor. It shouldn't be used for small animals, as their little noses are right in the bedding.

It's too bad, really, as these are otherwise nice shavings, no odor, soft-and a little goes a long way; the item was also well-packaged. They are a bit more absorbent than the thicker aspen shavings I'd been using.

I did call the company (and Amazon refunded my money promptly); they stated how much the product was liked by horse owners, and that it was filtered many times to remove dust-but that some always remains. I explained that a horse's nose is considerably higher off the ground than say, a guinea pigs! I also explained to them the bedding needs for small animals, which they clearly are unaware of; for example, he recommended the regular pine shavings to me as an alternative. I then needed to inform him that pine and cedar shavings have oils/odors harmful to small animals, just as dust is harmful to their respiratory tract. I think the company needs to adjust its product description regarding the dust content, as it will mislead small animal owners, such as myself.

product_title: Esky 100LV Rechargeable Remote Control Dog Training Collar For One to Two Dogs
review_body: Well FINALLY figured it out! 3 hours later, Collars are really hard to connect with the receiver, not only that but you have to charge each piece minimum 6 hours WITH ONE CHARGER. After the wait of shipping then receiving you get to wait ANOTHER 18 hours to use.

product_title: Petco Black Aquarium Sand, 20 lbs.
review_body: The grain of this sand is fine, but not too fine, I was concerned it would look like the display picture and be more like gravel, but it is perfect. It was easy to clean too, I was expecting the worst from what I have read about sand, but I was pleasantly surprised. A few bits will clump up and float but it takes little effort to scoop it out with a net, shortly after it will all sink as intended, and the water didn't cloud at all. Great sand with an unbeatable price, for that I rate 5 Stars.

product_title: Royal Canin Dry Cat Food, Babycat 34 Formula, 3.5-Pound Bag
review_body: My new kittens didn't like this food and didn't eat it at all for about a full 24 hours. Maybe they were just getting used to the new kind of food from the old owner who was feeding them regular cat food. They still don't eat alot of it considering. I think my girlfriend keeps filling them up on kitten treats. They eat it, but I can tell that they aren't really crazy for it. I guess I just bought this thinking that they would be fighting over it. I will continue buying it though since they both look really healthy. They do have worms currently too, so maybe thats what it is too. I will know more after we deworm them this next weekend.

product_title: Carlson Extra Wide Pet Gate, with small pet door
review_body: This was my first pet gate, so I don't have much to compare it to.  That being said, it is very secure, the door functions great, and installing is cake.  Excellent product, especially for the price.

product_title: Floppy Disc "Import Discs" Soft Bite Disc Toy for Dogs
review_body: We have two Jack Russell Terriers.  This frisbee is their favorite toy!  I recently purchased a second identical one so that there is one for each dog.  The first one we purchased is still going strong after a year and a half of daily frisbee sessions in the back yard and many weekends at the lake.  The pink and green colors do fade after a few months of being in the sun, but of course the dogs don't care.  We have the 10 inch version and it is just the right size for my smaller female dog to carry it in her mouth without tripping on it.  She is about 17 lbs.  It might seem pricey but is worth the initial investment for the durablility and quality.  Your dog will thank you!!

product_title: Chuckit! The Whistler Balls
review_body: Well, my dogs seem to like it but they are ball crazy anyway.  I must not hear well because I cannot hear it whistle.  Maybe it is because I just throw it by hand.  Anyway, just a little disappointed.

product_title: ABO Gear Happy Habitat for Indoor Cats
review_body: I thought this was going to be a smaller version of a tent- which it is, but set-up is SO much easier. Everything is attached- no pole threading or looping or assembly required. You spread it out, pull the cords on the top gently and- pop- the thing sets itself up! It came with 4 plastic bright yellow stakes (I wont lose them!) to stake it to the ground (which I recommend if you think your cats might get spooked and run into the sides of the thing). I have three cats, and this thing could easily fit four comfortably. The bottom is mesh too, so When I set it up I put a towel down so they can choose to lay on the towel or grass. It has a double zipper to open the door, and toggles if you want to roll up the door to keep it open. It has a carrying case so when you take it down, roll it up, and stuff it in the case it's super easy to store. Definitely worth the money (I paid $45) of you have cats that can not go out doors. And by the way- I've only used it a couple of days, but whenever I take it out and go outside the cats immediately go to the door, paws up, meowing to get out! I think they're hooked ;).

product_title: Catit Small replacement filters (models 50053 & 55600 only)
review_body: after reading reviews, I got this mainly to leave for my two cats if I had to be away overnight. They would not go near it!  Or went a few steps away and ran away.  I tried locating it in different areas, but that did not help either.  I am still trying!

product_title: 8 in 1 eCOTRiTiON Snak Shak Edible House Natural Hideaway for Guinea Pigs, Rabbits & Chinchillas
review_body: I love the way this looks and my guinea pigs love it. Unfortunately they especially love the hay roof. We have had it for a week and the roof is almost unusable. I do not recommend this.

product_title: Dr. George's Plaque Blast Dog and Cat Oral Spray, 1.928 fl. oz.
review_headline: Dog is afraid of noise but still seems like a good product
review_body: Unfortunately my dog is afraid of the spraying noise so I may just put it on a cottonball or pad and still use on his teeth.  It seems like a good product if you can get past the spray noise scarring them.

product_title: Aspen Pet Lebistro Programmable Food Dispenser
review_body: The control buttons are not responsive and one has to repeatedly go through the same procedure before it works, causing you to question whether you did it right.  Then it did work fine for 3-4 business trips of about 5 days each.  I next replaced the batteries and after that the programming simply no longer worked -- the \\"MEALS\\" light flashed, it refused to allow me to program meals, and it didn't go into automatic mode.  So it's shoddily made (buttons) and the controls fried from replacing a battery.  Gotta love their QA/QC.  But somebody else will love it because I will never buy one of their products again.

product_title: Joy Double End Pet Dental Tooth Scaler, Stainless Steel
review_body:
This scaler is metal and feels substantial/sturdy in your hands. I also checked with my vet to make sure it was safe for me to use this on my lab. He confirmed it is safe and recommended that i focus on the plaque/tartar buildup by the gum line, as that is the most critical to remove, since it causes bleeding gums once the buildup goes up the gum line.

I was VERY pleased to see that within a 30 minute session, I was able to get one entire side of my 80 lb lab's teeth clean. The plaque just chipped off as I scraped away. It was actually kind of fun/exciting to see such dramatic results.

Save yourself $100 and scrape your dog's teeth yourself. But, if you're uncomfortable sticking your hands in your dog's mouth (you have to pry their lips apart with your hands), this may not be the tool for you.

product_title: FURminator deShedding Tool for Dogs
review_body: My only complaint about this brush is how often I have to empty it. I have a long haired dog who sheds a lot and we had other brushes but they didn't work as well as this one. She loves being brushed and I'm amazed at how much hair this brush is able to get out!

product_title: Innotek Basic In-Ground Pet Fencing System, SD-2000
review_headline: Innotek SD-2000 answer to my problem
review_body: I have waited 1 year and 8 months before writing this review. I have a 1-acre chain-link fence and a Siberian Husky. The 3-year old Husky I got from a rescue center was a runaway escape artist. I figured that with my large yard, free access into the house, other companion dogs, and dog-heaven environment it would not want to run, but that was not the case. Two months later I purchased this dog fence. The Husky has dug under and run away a total of 24 times but not once wearing the collar. The mistake I made was guessing it no longer needed the collar after a period of time. Now the husky wears the collar every night and I take it off during the day and that seems to work. I installed the wire on the fence about 10 inches from the bottom and only buried the sections across the gates. Attaching the wire to a metal fence does not affect the performance. The batteries seem to last forever. I am still using the original batteries after 1 yr 8 months. This dog fence has been the answer to the runaway problem. I am close to a busy highway and each of the 24 times it has been a near disaster, terrible ordeal, and a story. I have had Siberian Huskies before, but this one is the worse dog I ever had but thanks to the Innotek SD-2000 this dog has the best life anyone can offer. For some this solution seems cruel and Inhumane but this shock solution was recommended by the dog humane society and I noticed that the adoption cats having free run of the office were wearing similar collars and induction ring at the door where people came and went keeping the cats contained inside.

product_title: Fluval Edge Aquarium with LED Light
review_body: This is a classy tank. It's very quiet. My favorite part is that the small hole at the top enables you to fill the tank so no water line is visible and the tank is completely full. Yes, it takes some creative maneuvering to get larger sculptures in there, but it has been possible for us to insert a large dragon and tree. My only regret is that, now that the goldfish is much bigger (4\\"), he doesn't have as much room to run as I imagine he would like.  So many aquaria are ugly and noisy; if aesthetics are important to you, take a serious look at the Fluval Edge 12 gallon in black.

product_title: KONG Squeezz Ball Dog Toy
review_body: I have three dogs. One lab, one medium sized mutt, and a small mutt. The small one destroyed this in about two seconds.  It literally tore in half. I was expecting something more durable. I put gorilla glue on the inside of the tube and hopefully that will fix it. If not I'm sending it back.

product_title: Bayer K9 Advantix II Flea & Tick Control Treatment
review_headline: Product great, but it was already open...
review_body: The product was exactly was described, but when I opened the package, the plastic bag containing the drops was already opened..

product_title: Hartz Cat Litter Scoop (Colors Vary)
review_body: I was pleasantly surprised at how sturdy this litter scoop was and how well it did the job considering it's so inexpensive. I highly recommend this to anyone who's in the market for a regular, garden variety litter scoop.

product_title: Zack & Zoey Polyester/Cotton Basic Dog Hoodie
review_body: My elderly dog isn't as \\"robust\\" as she once was, so I bought a couple of these sweatshirts to give her an extra outside layer. She looks really cute and loves it!

product_title: VOLVO V50 Wagon Pet Barrier (2004-2012) - Original Travall Guard TDG1230
review_headline: Expensive pet barrier, but extremely well made!
review_body: This pet barrier, although much more expensive than the standard one-size fits all adjustable models, is worth the price. It is far better made and installs in such a way that you do not have to ever hear it rattle. It does not block my view and is custom-fit to my car. Love it. Best of all, it shipped VERY quickly.

product_title: Empire Dog Leash Coupler, Two Dog Lead by Kakadu Pet
review_body: Nice for walking two dogs.  Good swivel so even when the dogs switch positions with one another, it doesn't tangle up

product_title: Precision Pet Soft Side Play Yard
review_body: Bought this as a place to contain our 4 lb maltipoo puppy. He figured out in almost no time that if he scratched at the bottom long enough, the scanty pieces of velcro that hold it on would give out. He then happily pulls back the bottom and crawls out from under the play yard. Great idea, but useless the way it has been made.

product_title: Pet Qwerks Talking Babble Ball Dog Toy
review_headline: Dog loves it but wont last too long
review_body: My dog really likes to play with this toy. The downside is the outside is a hard plastic which makes it noisy on tile and wood floors and reduces it durability. My dog likes to bring it to me and lets it drop out of her mouth and it bounces on hard floors. I believe this is why the talking is not consistent any more and you can hear something rattling around on the inside. Would be a great product if they could make the outside absorb a little more impact so it wouldn't damage the insides. product_title: Sweet Potato Dog Chewz - 3 Pack - Value Pack Veggie Rawhide
review_body: Made in America, My Dogs have Loved these great Vegetable treats a lot of bulk so it helps in other departments too. Just kinda expensive.

product_title: NOZTONOZ Sof-Krate Indoor/Outdoor Pet Home
review_body: I just got this today for my labradoodle who has sezuires. We thought a soft crate would be safest for her incase of a sezuire in the crate.
