review_body: I'm sure I have one of those dogs that can chew up anything. and I mean anything. But I got a recycled fire hose and it lasted awhile. He did eventually chew it up. So I thought this would be a good durable toy. It lasted 5 minutes. No joke. As soon as I gave it to him, he had a hole in it, and the strap chewed off in about 30 seconds. The rest was completely destroyed in literally 5 minutes. I'm sure it was made ok, but didnt hold up to my extreme chewer.

product_title: Ideal Pet Products Replacement Flap/New Style Plastic/Deluxe Pet Door
review_body: Love this product, does what it is supposed to do. I will be order products like this i the future from this seller.

product_title: Marina Deco-Wood Ornament, Small
review_body: When I had received this decor, it was kinda small so instead, I put an airstone in it and used it as a mini-bubbler for my fish. :D

product_title: Coolaroo Pet Crate Shade and Pillow, Desert Sand
review_body: The product was poor quality. It didn't meet my standards and was a waste (I am very picky on what I like and dislike. I ended up returning it and will never buy it again.

product_title: Tetra Gel Fish Feeder
review_headline: Came back from vacation all my fish were dead
review_body:
I bought this product based on some external reviews from Amazon. I should have listened to the good people here. I placed the block in my tank 2 days before leaving for vacation so it would be soft and ready for the first day i was gone. I came back to all of my tetras, the only fish in my tank, dead. All 15 of them. I did a water change before I left and these fish had been in my tank for over 3 months. They 100% starved.

The block upon my return was intact and hadnt dissolved as advertised.

STAY AWAY.

product_title: Purina ONE SmartBlend Healthy Puppy Formula Dry Dog Food
review_body: We have a pure bread German Shepard puppy that is 60 lbs. at six months old.  We were feeding her Costco's puppy dog food, but when we ran out at a time that Costco was closed, I went to Walmart and found this.  She just loves this dog food!  She eats much more, and yet is still lean and fast.  We are very happy about this.  Just wish Amazon could ship larger bags than 18 lbs.

product_title: FURminator deShedding Tool for Dogs
review_headline: Product works great for dogs and cats
review_body: This is a great product that my girlfriend and I share. Really good for short hair dogs or medium hair cats. Does not work well for very puffy dogs (Pomeranian). So if you have a long hair dog, get that model. The new model has a hair removal button, which is really not needed. If your model does not have the button, don't worry you don't need it. It really lowers the amount of shedding I have to deal with on a daily basis, but it does not eliminate the problem completely, so just know that. Just fyi I have a small 9lb mutt that looks like a terrier wire hair mix. It works perfect for him and his two cat \\"friends\\" that have medium silky hair.

product_title: Krebs Recycle Climbing Rope Dog Leash
review_headline: A stylish and high quality leash for dogs greater than 35lbs.
review_body:
I have a very demanding dog and he will not accept anything but the best. I have to feed him out of my hand because he doesn't like the aftertaste of his porcelain dog bowl. He also sleeps in my bed because he proclaims that he has restless leg syndrome that is aggravated by the cold floor. I exclaimed that I shouldn't have to sleep on the couch in my own home, but he protested that he preferred the bed because my downy pillows \\"reminded him of the soft underbelly of his mother whom he will never know because I took him away from her when he was just a pup.\\" As such, he will not put up with a traditional nylon leash that relegates him to the same level of the \\"street urchin\\" he has to share a sidewalk with. Last week I came home to find that he had taken advantage of my Amazon One Click settings and purchased this Krebs Climbing Rope leash.

I will say that this is a very attractive leash. Although it is listed as \\"recycled,\\" you would never know because the rope looks brand new, without any signs of wear or dirt. The designs and colors are very stylish and will definitely get attention. The build quality is very high. When I first looked at it, I thought \\"I could make this myself.\\" Although it is a very simple design, since the handle is just made by creating a loop and then stitching it closed, the stitching is very strong and is not going to come apart easily.

If you are debating which leash to get, due to the extra weight of the leash, I think the 6' leash is going to be too long for most people, and it will drag on the ground. I'll use mine for trail hiking when I want to give my dog a little more room, but otherwise, I prefer the 4' (which is still a bit long), and the 2' when I want to keep my dog close. The leashes use slightly larger and heavier clips than most leashes as well. I think the 4' and 6' leads are going to be too heavy for any dog under 35 lbs. You don't want your dog to feel any tension on their leash if they're walking in place, and smaller dogs will likely feel like something is slightly pulling on them. Otherwise, I am very satisfied with it and although the price is a bit high for what you get, I like the idea that it's an upcycled product and created by a family-owned business. My only complaint is that I wish the actual clip at the end was replaced with something more colorful. I removed mine with a hacksaw and replaced it with a carabiner to complete the outdoor look and make sure everyone at the pet store knows that I have an Extreme Dog who lives live a quarter mile at a time.n place, and smaller dogs will likely feel like something is slightly pulling on them. product_title: Indipets Extra Heavy Stainless Steel Non Tip - Anti Skid Health Care Slow Feeding Dish "Colors May Vary"
review_body:
I ordered this bowl after reading all the great reviews and have to say I was disappointed upon receiving it today :(

I have a 70lb Weimaraner who eats 1 and 1/2 cups per meal. I ordered the large size bowl and it looks like a medium... I didn't even try it because I knew he wasn't even going to be able to fit his muzzle in the bowl to eat! Maybe it is made that way to REALLY slow the dog down but it just looked impossible for him to be able to eat out of it! The bowl is really attractive looking and would be great for medium/small breeds but I can't imagine large breeds (who are more prone to bloat anyways!) eating out of this bowl! Needless to say, I am returning the bowl and hoping to find something better suited for us.

Amazon, as always, was great in returning the bowl for us! Thanks!

product_title: Organically Correct Dog and Cat Protein Shampoo
review_body: This shampoo lathers up very nicely.  It was also easy to rinse out.  It seemed like it only took 1/2 the time to bathe my dog. This stuff is wonderful!

product_title: Classic Accessories 70-037-014205-00 Dog Whisperer Quick-Fit Dog Automotive Bucket Seat Cover
review_body: Like another reviewer, I purchased this for one of the back bucket seats (RAV4), which are the same size as the front. The bottom absolutely does not stay put so the dog sits on the non-covered seat. I'm going to try rigging up some bungee cords to see if that helps because I'm sure this cover is much more comfortable than the leather seat.

product_title: Oster Professional Pet Grooming Undercoat Rake, 10 Teeth Coarse
review_body:
I bought this for my American Eskimo. It's perfect for removing her thick undercoat for the hot summer weather. works much better than a brush.
I took her to Petco for a \\"blow-out\\" at the beginning of the hot weather. They removed so much undercoat it looked like she'd lost 3 pounds! Terrific! Then this rake is used as a \\"touch-up.\\"
So I recommend a professional blow-out (expensive but so worth it, both in keeping your dog cool in summer as well as saving your couch/rugs from inevitable summer shedding), then followed up by your using this rake at home as needed. This worked much better than a furminator, which just grabbed the long outer coat and snagged, rather than getting the undercoat. (side note: i recommend the furmiator for shorter haired dog breeds as well as short-haired cats, on whom i've found it works great).
I found that this rake worked well on my (20 lb) american eskimo and i'm sure it would work well on other breeds with undercoats such as Siberian Huskies, although you might want to get the larger size rake if you have a husky. The only reason I recommend a blow-out first is that the snow-breeds have so much undercoat that you'll drive yourself insane trying to get it all yourself; better to pay a professional if you can afford it and then follow-up yourself with this wonderful tool.

product_title: Citrus Magic Pet Litter Box Odor Eliminator, Light Citrus, 11.2-Ounce Shaker
review_body: We have five cats and four litter boxes.  This product really helps eliminate odors!!  Just a sprinkle or two and the boxes are fresh and ready for use.

product_title: Purina Friskies Indoor Wet Cat Food - 24-5.5 oz. Cans
review_body: Both of my cats love this stuff and at a great price. I pull out one of these cans and they come running and rubbing everything insight.

product_title: Pioneer Pet Raindrop Stainless Steel Pet Drinking Fountain
review_headline: Very functional but not good quality.
review_body:
I had purchased two of these for two households.

Cons:
* The adapter blew within the first 6 months and I had to purchase new ones
* Can be loud at times especially if the water is half gone
* The white plastic casing for the motor does not close shut and so the noise level can increase due to this
* The point of a metal or ceramic fountain is to avoid the build up of bacteria which can occur with plastic bowls - so why is there a plastic casing for the motor? I find that all the gunk settles on the plastic
* The rubber bit that goes in the whole of the top half of the fountain gets dirty very quickly and can even grow mould even if I clean it every 3 days. I removed it all together but Pioneer needs to rethink this or provide replacement rubber bits

Everything else is great about the fountain. It really works well and my cats are always drinking from it. One cat had chin acne and it was gone within a week after use of the fountain. Even though the construction is not up to par, it is still the best fountain out there for your pets. Worth it.

product_title: Cycles of Life Geneflora for Pets
review_body:
My Mastiff girl suffered from frequent bouts of gastro-enteritis and also had chronic yeast infections in her ears. Since I've started giving her Geneflora about a year ago, we haven't had a single episode of vomiting/diarrhea and both ears have cleared up completely. Can't say I miss the wrestling matches over the ear drops! ;)

Yes, the stuff is expensive, but it's definitely worth every penny!

product_title: Eheim Battery Operated Auto Fish Feeder
review_headline: EHEIM got the quality you need
review_body: I bought EHEIM fish food dispenser over a year ago, it worked fine 24hrs a day 7 days a week. Until one day I discovered that the unit was accidently dropped into the fish tank for at least couple hours before I found it. I was so worry because the unit was completely wet and it went dead. So I immediately removed the battery inside, cleaned it inside out and let it completely dried for 24 hours. The next day I put on new batteries on the unit and Voila! the unit worked normal just like before. I already satisfied with EHEIM products and now I love it even MORE. I strongly recommend this product to everyone. EHEIM is not a cheap product but it worth paying it once you know that the quality is there. I give 5 star rating for EHEIM!

product_title: Pet Gear Portable Cot for cats and dogs up to 75-pounds, Moss Green
review_body:
I had this product previously. I got the cot that could hold up to 75 pounds for my 50 pound dog. I had the cot for three years, and it was GREAT until my mother tried to sit on it with the dog........... When I needed to replace it, I decided on another cot due to the poor reviews this cot had received. Well, that other -- higher rated -- cot didn't last even one year. We live in FL, and bought the other cot in the fall. Due to rain, heat, and the cot's lack of drainage, the other cot's fabric rotted and then ripped down the middle by mid summer. Both cots were left outside year-round.

Since I had to replace that one, I DECIDED TO GO BACK TO THIS COT! I am very pleased with my purchase. This cot allows the water to drain through, and the mesh fabric also keeps the dogs cooler when they lounge outside. Now I have two dogs who collectively weigh about 65 pounds (and they lay on the cot together), and it is holding up well.

SUPER EASY and SUPER FAST to set up!!! Way easier than the other one, and took about 5 minutes to set up compared to the 20-30 minutes of struggling and wrestling the other one required. This cots just expands and snaps into place.

I highly recommend this cot!! It may not work for huge dogs, but it TERRIFIC for dogs who are under the listed weight load for the cot.

product_title: World's Best 00631 Cat Litter, Multiple Cat Clumping Formula
review_body: This product doesn't even work well enough for one small cat. It creates a gummy mess on the bottom of the box that is so thick I broke the scoop trying to lift it or scrape it out. I have been working in vet clinics for almost 20 years and have had companion cats at home for more than 10; I think cheap, generic clay cat litters work as well as, if not better than, this product. Save your money; you can buy at least 4 bags of store brand litter for the price of this product.

product_title: Cat Mate Electromagnetic Cat Flap White
review_headline: keyed entry from only one side?
review_body: Description was misleading. Unkeyed access to the outside. Keyed access to the inside. We bought this to keep one cat in, while allowing another cat to roam freely. This cat door is going back.

product_title: Chondro Flex Powder (750 gm)
review_body: This was a great price for a large container. thought i had a great deal till my dogs wouldnt touch there food. i even tried reducing it to a minute amount..still wont touch there food. So now...its wasted powder. They need to add flavor to this or something..would be great if they did.

product_title: Wellness Complete Health Natural Dry Cat Food
review_body:
I've been switching my cats over to healthier food and it's been a struggle. They love Purina Indoor Formula but any dry food other than that? They refuse to eat. After trying a few different 'healthy' brands, I've settled on this one.

It's a pebbled hard food that's probably really tough on an older cat's teeth, so fair warning. It's also smelly as heck. It smells a bit like wheaty cardboard and is the same color. My cats turned their noses up to this for DAYS and I worried that they wouldn't eat it. Now they eat it, albeit reluctantly. It's the cat equivalent of broccoli or brussel sprouts. It's good for them, but they're not enjoying it.

I've been giving them the Indoor Health recipe for about a month now, and they eat it, but very slowly and pickily. I supplement their diet with Wellness Core canned food (which they love), and will stick with this a bit longer. It does make a difference in their coats. I have one cat that has dry skin and her coat has been a lot healthier and with no dry skin flakes, so that's a success. Hairballs have gone down to almost nothing, too.

I just wish they enjoyed it more!

product_title: Cheapest Advantage for Cats Over 9 Lbs. ~~ 4 Months (Purple)
review_headline: We've been FLEA-FREE for months now. Great results!!
review_body: I've been using this product from BestFleas on my cats since last year and I haven't seen fleas or flea dander on them for a long time. So I'm happy with the results, for sure.  This is SE Florida so fleas are a big problem here year-round. This company is a real blessing, IMO, because in this economy it's just impossible for me to spend USA prices on flea control. With everything, absolutely EVERYTHING, jumping in prices by leaps and bounds, it's a relief to find some mercy somewhere.

product_title: Ocluvet Eye Drops (15 ml)
review_body:
OcluVet Eye Drops are a special kind of bad. NO STARS needs to be an option.
These people who designed this bottle take planned waste to a whole new level, it leaks tremendously.
So much leaking that over half of the bottle's contents will purposefully leak out and be wasted so the customer (sucker) has to buy more of this snake oil.

Gave it to my cataract afflicted dog for several months who is not a good candidate for the cataract surgery, and now she has extreme dry eye to deal with in addition to cataracts. Her eyes started having a yellow discharge when using these bogus product which went away once OcluVet was stopped. Ocluvet is the epitome of everything that is wrong with veterinary \\"science\\".

product_title: Petco Replacement Suction Cups for Aquarium Accessories
review_body: I'm rating this item based on the quality of the item, which I believe will serve its intended use for aquariums.  I purchased this item, however, to use the suction cups for another project.  Obviously, use of this product is limited to the ingenuity of the user.

product_title: Outward Hound Hide-A-Squirrel and Puzzle Plush Squeaking Toys for Dogs
review_headline: My two puppies love this product
review_body: I bought this for my two siberian husky puppies. They love this toy, especially the \\"tree stump\\". They often both bite onto opposite sides and play tug-a-war with it. The only complaint I have about this product is that the green leaves that are sewn onto the stump have now been removed by my puppies constant tearing at them.

product_title: Outward Hound Kyjen Puzzle Plush Replacement Animals
review_body: My dog loves these, she loves squeaky toys, we have the squirrels also.  I put them in the house and she gets them out, keeps her happy and busy!

product_title: Cosequin With MSM 1400 Gram/3 lbs.
review_body: The vet said I should try this on my 17 yr old mountain trail horse. We ride long trails and she is still going strong.

product_title: Manual Old Fashion Pet DOG CAT Hair Trimmer With COMB 2 Razor Cutting NEW
review_body: The comb came a lot sooner than expected. It seems very easy to use. My dog doesn't realize she's being groomed, big plus!! I will definitely buy from this seller again. 5 stars *****

product_title: Addiction Holistic Dry Dog Food - Wild Kangaroo & Apples Entree - 3 Pounds
review_headline: Very good food for dogs with allergies...
review_body: Excellent food & my dogs are doing well on it.  I just wish they would create a corresponding Wild Kangaroo wet!!! My bulldogs are getting a little bored of the repetition & canned options would be nice.  I don't know why they don't offer this!

product_title: Yogies Rabbit Treats
review_headline: Rabbits are not to have dairy!
review_body:
Rabbits are not to have any form of dairy, whether it be cheese, milk, yogurt, whey, casein, or anything else. Unfortunately, there are many companies out there that are only aiming to increase profits and have no knowledge about the animals they market their products for, and unsuspecting caregivers of the animals buy their products with good intentions, but end up harming their furbabies in one way or another. I've even found fish meal, yes, ground up fish, in treats for rabbits! Rabbits are herbivores! After being weaned, they survive and thrive on only plant matter.

Take care of your bunnies and do not purchase any \\"Yogies\\" or other dairy treats for them, and ask others to do the same.

product_title: Ware Clean Living Cage, 2 Level, Large
review_body: I had gotten this cage for my baby rabbit and she has grown into it but not outgrown it.  At first she was scared to go up to the second level, but now she loves to sit there because she can watch us better from that second level.  It is expandable with additional levels and a playpen to hook to the door.  I do not have those options yet.  The cage is easy to clean.

product_title: Laguna Plastic Heavy Duty Rectangular Basin, 60-Gallon, Black
review_headline: It's a big tub - it also has a hole in the side which isn't mentioned in the description
review_body: This is a big rectangular tub.  It is indeed quite heavy, and ought to hold up to most reasonable tasks.  Prospective buyers should be aware that there is a hole ~ 2 inches below the top of the rim.  I bought this for a fountain, so the hole is actually useful - but some buyers might find this problematic.  There are two plugs for the hole that were included - one solid plug, and one screened plug - so there is a means to stopper the hole, but some users may find this insufficient.

product_title: Omega Paw Self-Cleaning Litter Box, Regular, Taupe
review_body: I needed to replace a poorly functioning LiterMaid \\"Elite Mega\\" (!) LME 9000 with something else and I thought I'd give this box a try.  It was certainly less expensive.  It turns out that it works great!  There was only one problem ... the top of the box did not fit quite right on one side.  As a result, I had to hold one side very tightly while rolling the box to clean the litter (great concept!).  This box would have otherwise received a 5-star rating.

product_title: Excel Hairball Remedy for Long-Haired Cats, Malt Flavor, 2.5-Ounce
review_body: This is the ONLY hairball remedy my cats will happily ingest, after trying other brands. And, it works, even for my long hair cat. Can't find it in petstores anymore. So glad Amazon had it.

product_title: Laguna Max-Flo 600 Waterfall & Filter Pump
review_body: Stopped working after two months. I checked for clogs or anything that could have prevented operation but clean as a whistle. Just stopped sucking water in but kept it's buzzing noise. Amazon was great in giving me a partial credit. I bought through Amazon a Beckett pump to replace the Laguna one and so far so good although it's only been a few weeks.

product_title: Sam's Yams Big Boyz Sweet Potato Dog Treats, 15 oz, 425 grams
review_body: My dog has a health issue relating to digestion, so I make his food etc. and am very careful with what I give him. One of the acceptable things (which is in his normal meals) is sweet potatoes, so I thought I'd give these a try as I am pretty limited with chew toys. Was afraid he wouldn't like them as much because he already gets cooked sweet potatoes but he really does love them. The big size is great, yes they aren't going to last a long time, but it makes him very happy. I would highly recommend to people whose dogs have allergy issues. For the people that said it gave their dogs diarrhea or gas, yes, sweet potatoes have a LOT of fiber in them. I am careful not to overdo it but if a dog's system isn't used to it then I can see why that might happen. Anyways, great product.

product_title: Petco Carmel Wood 20 Gallon Tank Stand with Shelf
review_body: This product is very sturdy and stylish, the perfect height for a fish tank. I love the texture of it, the woody smell of it, and the general design of this stand. I have a 10 gal fish tank on it and in the second shelf all of my fish supplies, its very convenient! This stand is a very good investment, and feels like it can last a lifetime.

product_title: Zuke's Mini Naturals Dog Treats
review_headline: My dogs like them, but they STINK!
review_body:
We got the salmon and the peanut butter flavors for our puppies, and they go crazy for them. They were really hard to potty train, but these were small and healthy enough that we were able to give them to our dogs every time they pottied outside. They worked great for that, and our dogs finally got the message! But they really don't smell appetizing, and even one of the salmon ones will make their breath smell terrible for a whole day!

I'm giving it 4 stars for that reason. If your dogs like them as much as ours do, I think it's well worth the stinky breath.

product_title: Tidy Cats Cat Litter, Breeze, Litter Box Kit System, 1 Kit
review_body:
I got this system for my first cat 4 years ago, because I was living in a carpeted apartment and normal litter was being tracked all over. In addition, the smell was just awful, and would fill the whole apartment for what seemed like ages any time she used the box.

At first, she didn't want to use the Breeze, and she kept using the old box even after I stopped maintaining it like the Breeze suggests. Eventually I just took away the old one and she started using the Breeze. No accidents, even though I could tell she wasn't terribly happy about it.

The pellets completely solved the tracking problem, and while the feces does still smell immediately after the cat uses the box while it's still fresh, the pellets dry it out pretty quickly and then it doesn't smell at all.

I just got a second cat, and a second Breeze. I will never go back to regular litter.

product_title: Mingo
review_body: We just got Mini Mingo, and my Toy Poodle LuLu is in love.  Her other favorite is West Paw's Baby Salsa.

product_title: Petstages Occupi Treat Puppy Toy
review_headline: Wish I could find something that lasted
review_body: This was a great idea - only IF YOU have a dog that doesn't chew as if it's a professional sport.. if you do have a high end chewer - don't get this. It has not lasted but a few days - had to toss it out because I worried about them eating pieces of rubber.

product_title: MidWest Life Stages Heavy-Duty Folding Metal Dog Crates; Single Door & Double Door Dog Crates w/ Divider Panel, Floor Protecting “Roller” Feet & Leak-Proof Plastic Pan
review_body: We bought this cage for my daughter's new bunny.  The metal bottom is awesome as it helps keep bunny cool and she can't chew it up. We love that it has the three doors, so my daughter can get bunny out wherever she is in her cage easily and so she can place cage anywhere she wants in her room. Bunny seems happy too! The only problem we have had is that one of the door latches sticks a bit and is difficult to open at times.  Otherwise, great cage for the price.

product_title: Everlasting Treat Liver
review_headline: Not everlasting but long lasting, the second time around.
review_body: We have a 5 year old Saint Bernard. It's hard to find treats that can stand up to her for more than 20 minutes so I thought I'd give these a try. First one disappeared literally within 5 minutes. Disappointing. Gave her the second one and it lasted for 2 hours. I suspect the first was broken into pieces and chewed that way, whereas the second was chewed on as a single piece making it last longer. She did enjoy them - a lot. As for it I will buy one again, I'm unsure. She did enjoy it but not enough for me to buy the ball that goes with to make them last longer. So my opinion, go ahead and buy it and your pooch is sure to enjoy it - but it's  50/50 if it's going to occupy them for 5 minutes or 2 hours.

product_title: Stewart Freeze Dried Treats for Dogs
review_body: I have been giving the Stewart's Pro-Treat Freeze Dried Beef Liver to my maltipoo named Elvis Lee for many years now along with his daily meals.  It is all PURE Freeze Dried Beef Liver which provides him with protein since he is a very active boy who likes to go for long walks and play ball!  Elvis Lee is very particular about what he likes and this Freeze Dried Liver is on his list of FAVORITES!!

product_title: O-ring for Eheim 2213 and 2013 Canister Filters - Red
review_body: Was the right ring for our eheim filter and works great!  No problems getting it to fit.  Would order again if needed.

product_title: Nylabone Dental Chew Bacon flavored Pro Action Bone Dog Chew Toy
review_body:
I have two Staffie's that destroy normal toys within minutes.
These Nylabone toys last for weeks and they don't lose interest in them either. I don't bother buying other dog toys now, these are just fantastic!

They're a bit expensive in shops but Amazon price is great.

product_title: Aquarium Pharmaceuticals BettaFix Remedy
review_headline: This Likely Saved my Betta's Life!
review_body:
My lovely betta, Pugs, for no reason we can determine, suddenly came down with a severe case of \\"pop eye.\\" His tank was clean, the water kept fresh. What could we do?

I sought out a \\"cure\\" and bought BettaFix with (frankly) little hope that it could help. Three days following the recommended regimen and he is almost completely his old self. The \\"pop eye\\" largely gone, and he is again active with a healthy appetite.

This particular malady is not even mentioned in the literature but there it is. Five stars!

product_title: Bag Clipper (1-pack)
review_body:
The plastic poop bags slide in well and leave the other hand free for opening doors. So it is useful.

Of course you can just transfer the poop bag to the leash hand when you need the free hand.

Useful for other purposes. Carrying paper money when you don't have any pockets in your walking shorts, is just one example.

product_title: Esky Dog Training Collar Waterproof 330 Yard LCD Backlight Remote Control Dog Training Shock Collar
review_body: I've used this for a few weeks now on my stubborn 1 yr old pit.  I bought it to help with teaching him not to jump on guests that come to the door and chasing cars and people walking by.  His jumping and chasing showed improvement in less than a week.  One thing that you have to remember to do is make sure the collar is \\"awake\\" when you know you might have to use it.  It falls asleep and you have to shake the collar to get it back on.  I usually test it with the beep option before going outside to make sure it's working.  The remote is quite small and light so I have managed to lose it in the house a few times and currently can't find it but as long as I find it, I'm happy with my purchase!

product_title: Dog Step Ladder, 3 Step
review_body: I was a little skeptical when I first laid eyes on this.  It is basically just foam blocks with a covering on it.  However, it works well and is also very lightweight.  I bought it so our little yorkie could get up on the bed.  I should have gotten the 4 step one as he has a big jump at the top but he seems to manage. He is still just a 3 pound pup yet so it won't be an issue once he gets a little bigger.  If you have a pillow top mattress, the 5 step would probably be the best. The 3 step is perfect sofa height.

product_title: SmartyKat Hideout, Tunnel and Playmat Cat Toys
review_headline: 8 week old kittens love this toy
review_body: We have three 8 week old kittens that love this tunnel. They run through it and use the hole in the side to jump in and pounce on each other. It is a little loud but we don't mind - that seems to be part of the reason they love it. I'm not sure how well it will work when they are full grown because it is somewhat small.

product_title: Groovypets® Remote Dog Training Shock Collar Trainer / Rechargeable Dog Collar for No Bark Obedience Behavioral Training
review_body: This product worked well...that one day it worked. I will say it was very easy to get a replacement sent, and came very quickly...by the time the replacement came in the other collar gave up...it became too much of a hassle to send that one back...and avweek later the replacement quit...so that was 3 collars all with the shelf life of about a week...the one star was only for customer service

product_title: GREENIES Original TEENIE Dog Dental Chews Dog Treats
review_body: my dog love it very much, the fist thing that she wake up in the morning is eat the greenies!

product_title: Carlson Extra Wide Pet Gate, with small pet door
review_body:
I needed a gate to restrict my elderly German Shepherd from accessing the stairs while allowing my Cavachon free access. This gate looked like it MIGHT fit the bill, but I was concerned about the size of the pass through door, so I asked another buyer what he thought. He said he thought it would be fine. When I received it, I thought the pass through was WAY too small for my little guy, but, his desire to be upstairs at bedtime proved me wrong. The pass through IS very small and the door is difficult to open and keep open, but my 23 lb. Cavachon DID get through it. He prefers the Richell door, though. It is a bigger size and gives him extra space to get through.

I had purchased the Richell Wood Pet Sitter Gate and it was exactly what I needed, though it is a \\"step over\\" rather than a \\"walk through.\\" I found, however, that ITS opening is TOO big. My 110 lb. German Shepherd, frightened by a distant thunderstorm, squeezed her way through it, climbed the stairs that could have killed her, and was whining at the side of my bed, not once, but three times! Now I have to lock RIchell gate, which makes it unsafe for my purpose, and, maybe yours as well.

My Cavachon is about the size of a Bischon, 23 lbs. A \\"mini\\" dog would fit fine, I think, but NOT all small breeds. I'm guessing that a dog under 20 lbs would do fine, if it's not too tall. If your dog is bigger than that, save the expense and aggravation of getting something that won't work for your purposes, and buy the other. Having said all that, only trial and error will totally determine which pass through gate is right for your purposes.

product_title: Simple Solution Washable Diaper Cover Ups, Medium, Pink/Purple or Blue/Black
review_body: My female Boston terrier had an infection called vaginitis and she was expelling a very smelly yellow liquid! Since I got this product I never had to worry about her going up to my bed or couch!

product_title: PetSafe Gentle Spray Bark Collar for Dogs, Citronella, Anti-Bark Device, Water Resistant
review_body:
We have a toy poodle that barks and grumbles at just about any noise. Have had enough so we bought this product.
At first the dog was freaked out by the spay, (the house smelled good) but the container that holds the spray is used very quickly
and I think the dog caught on to that. The batties also dont last that long. I would take it off at night (yes I would shut it off) and in the morning before going to work I
would put it back on so when I came home I was not arriving home greeted by his barking. I found that we were either dealing with... container empty of spray or batteries dead... ?

Time to move on to a shock collar....

product_title: Purina Friskies Classic Pate Wet Cat Food, 5.5 oz
review_headline: my cats favorite is the pate
review_body: she has been plied with all brands and flavors (she is also old and obese) but likes this one best..tho shell eat some others too. I like to make her happy tho I wish I could do that without putting another species on her plate. However she is older and a love so...

product_title: Joint MAX Triple Strength - Chewable Tablets
review_body: My dog is 13 and has arthritis. He was on Rimadyl for about 5 years and I thought it was helping until I tried this product.  Not only do you receive more in the bottle for less but it is 3x the strenght, has more glucosamine, pain management probiotics, and many other nutrients.  I was lucky and you can be too.

product_title: Milk-Bone Flavor Snacks Dog Treats for Small/Medium Dogs, 60-Ounce (Pack of 2)
review_body: I got this box because previously I had ordered the larger size bones. My Weim had no trouble eating them but my Bichons struggled with the size. This solved the problem. The size is smaller and there are different flavors. I purchased a special canister to keep them in so they stay fresh and they are easy for the kids to get their pets a treat.

product_title: PetSafe Pet Loo Portable Pet Potty
review_body:
We purchased the Kitty Kat Loo for our Chihuahua puppy and he used it without fuss from day one. He started to chew on the fake grass layer after the first week while we were at work. So, we bought four giant river pebbles to weigh down the corners and haven't had any issues since.

If you don't flush the Loo and empty the tray every night, the smell can get a bit much. To combat this, I'm now experimenting with bags of activated carbon etc that you can get from aquarium stores.

Overall, great product. Really light so it's not too much of a drag to perform weekly cleaning.

product_title: Bags on Board Regular Bag Refill Pack
review_body: I have used Bags on Board for many years, through the lives of four dogs.  Now, all of a sudden, the manufacturer decides to cut corners and produce an inferior product.  The bags are thinner, tear easily, and very difficult to pull apart.  In fact, I wound up with holes in several bags just trying to get them apart.  I'm about to throw the order out, and want to advise Amazon not to carry this brand any longer.

product_title: CESAR Classics Meat Flavored Adult Wet Dog Food Trays
review_body: My little poddles love this brand and it's nice to know there is somethig out there that  they will not turn their nose up at!

product_title: West Paw Design Tuckered Out Dog Bed
review_body: This dog bed is great. The stuffing amount is perfect for my dogs- not too much and not too little. I have a 60lb dog and 20lb dog that share the large size- each taking a side and they both use it all the time. I've washed the cover and had no problem putting it back together- it comes with instructions- which once you have the visual it's easy. Probably not the best for puppies potty training because I think the stuffing inside would fall apart if I had to wash that.

product_title: Milk-Bone MaroSnacks Dog Treats for Small Dogs, 15-Ounce (Pack of 6)
review_body: My Border Collie mix 7 month old puppy loved these treats. I used them for training and playing games with my puppy like \\"find the treat\\". I would order these again but I've switched my pup to Pup Corn treats made locally, cheaper and healthier too but still eats milk bone biscuits. The free I.d tag is promotional is a pretty good deal and I plan to order Oreo one.

product_title: Vetoquinol BPO 3 Shampoo 3 Benzoyl Peroxide (16 oz)
review_headline: Cheaper than buying at the Vet
review_body: Same product I bought last time at my Vet except it's a lot cheaper.  Product itself helps my dog's skin.  He has allergy issues, yeast issues, flaky skin, smell.  This helps to keep it at bay during the summer months.

product_title: Solvit PupSTEP Plus Pet Stairs
review_body: The transaction was quick. The ensemble was quick and with some determination and placing treats on certain steps, my dog learned to use them. Learning to go up was quicker than learning to go down. But now my dog has an increased sense of independence. Great buy!

product_title: Screen Door, Pet Passage Door
review_body: i labeled this as customer service because I did have to contact them when I saw that my order showed a very extended out time frame for delivery.  When I inquired about this, I was contacted right away and assured that it would be must sooner and it was.  Very courteous and I appreciate that.  As far as the door itself - I have two cats and my big one (34 pounds at one time) had helped himself to opening our screen and making himself a cat door.  I ordered this pet door to be able to basically fix my screen door and also provide a better appearing cat entrance/exit.  This worked well.  I actually purposely installed it backwards due to the shape of it and I needed the straight edge along the edge of my door frame on the inside in order to take care of their cat flap.  It worked well.  Because my screen did not have much screen material along the edge, this door doesn't have quite enough to attach to so I had to use some duct tape (which is about the same color) to hold that straight edge as this door has two frames (inside and outside) and they need to secure on the inside and outside of the screen material to hold.  It works and both cats - the 7 pound weenie and the now 22 pound brute - both can come in and out of it well.  Neat product!

product_title: VitaLife Plus Chicken Rawhide Hips & Joints 5oz
review_body: This product is TOO SMALL for large breed dogs! I will not be ordering these again...The WRAPS (currently unavailable) are the way to go for large dogs!

product_title: 16 ounce OdorXit Concentrate odor remover for pet and other tough odors
review_body: I had several items of clothing that had been saturated with cat urine (many stains were quite old before I found them), and NOTHING I did got rid of the odor from the color fabrics even if the stains were gone. I used everything from white vinegar, Oxiclean, tons of detergent and chlorine-free bleaches, and even used them together. For the strong odors NOTHING worked, and I couldn't use Clorox bleach because they were colored fabrics. Finally after a couple weeks and in desperation I decided to try OdorXit. One wash and all but one gray T-shirt out of the bunch were smelling great. I rewashed the shirt with some OdorXit concentrate applied directly over the shirt's stubborn odor as the washing machine refilled and the smell was gone. I didn't even need to let it sit soaking in the diluted concentrate as some suggested. I've found my Holy Grail for cat soiled clothing!

product_title: PetSafe Outdoor Ultrasonic Bark Deterrent
review_headline: My neighbor's dogs become nice doggies in 2 minutes
review_body: I installed a battery and hanged the birdcage up on the side of the yard facing the neighbor's barking dogs.  After a few barks and 2 minutes, the dogs never barked in their yard again.  It's day 2 now, and no barking.  The birdcage works!

product_title: PetSafe Twist 'N Treat Food Dispensing Cat Toy
review_headline: Premier FUNkitty Twist 'N Treat Catnip Toy
review_body: This is a great treat dispenser... My kitty cats just love it and play and play with it till it's empty. It screws apart and you put the treats inside. How hard or how easily the treats dispense depends on how tight you screw it shut. You can leave the hole large enough that they barely have to tap it for the treats to fall out. You can also screw it tighter shut and they have to work for it. I started out making it really easy until they learned the trick to it.Now they love playing with it. I recommend it.

product_title: Solvit Tagalong Pet Booster Seat, Standard
review_headline: My Chihuahua LOVES this booster seat!
review_body:
He's no longer nervous about car rides. His booster's high enough for him to enjoy looking out of the windows. If he's tired he feels secure enough to curl up and takes a nap. The seller shipped the product FREE and long before the due date.

NOTE: The booster's a *snap* to assemble but can only be correctly installed in the front seat of a 5-passenger vehicle. This means your pet gets to ride shotgun while humans take a back seat. If you have an SUV or minivan, however, your pet can ride in a back seat.

product_title: Four Paws 3-In-1 Pet stroller and Carrier
review_body: What can i say?  It does exactly what it's supposed to do, and more.  I would just like it to have had a bottom shelf and be easier to collapse without having to remove the carrier. Seeing as how I live in a small NYC apartment it's now become a fixture in my living room, a pull up side table.  This now makes it a four in one stroller.  The shelf would have been great for magazines.

product_title: Go Cat Teaser Cat Catcher Wand Cat Toy
review_headline: Falls apart, but cat loves it, and seems to be improved
review_body:
My cat ADORES this toy, so I have bought several, but they all fall apart. The mouse's tail is the first to go, sometimes within hours of taking it out of the bag, which is understandable considering how much my cat loves it. But the wire has always broken off the plastic tip and started fraying, so I will not be buying it again.
UPDATE 1/2013: I gave in and bought a new one, because I can't find anything else that my cat loves as much. The new one seems to be constructed better than previous ones I've purchased- the wire still came unattached, but the new construction allows it to be reattached if you pop off the rubber cap and pull out the plastic insert.

product_title: Seachem Flourish Excel 500ml
review_body: We love Sea Chem products and always can find what we need on Amazon!  Our plants in our aquarium look a whole lot better once we started using Flourish excel!  There is a difference when using this compared to using other products that claim to do the same things.

product_title: Remote Dog Training Shock Collar for 1 Dog
review_body: Works wonders when used properly! Was EXTREMELY skeptical about using a shock collar but I tried it on my own skin first and its not a cruel level of shock but enough to redirects dogs attention! Would definitely recommend this to any one with a stubborn thick headed dog like mine!

product_title: Kurgo Backseat Reversible Dog Bridge Car Extender — Water Resistant — Universal Fit
review_headline: Too small for a Ford F250 extended cab
review_body: The product seems to be reasonably well made and would appear from the reviews to work in some vehicles, but it's too small for the backseat of a Ford F250 extended cab pickup truck, and I suspect it would be too small for a larger SUV. It was also quite difficult to figure out the proper configuration of the various straps and snap hooks, as both sides of the user information sheet are in French ! We finally figured out what went where from the drawings and by trial-and-error, but it would seem to be the manufacturer's error to have both sides of the user guide in the same (foreign) language. The product information seems to indicate that it's a one-size-fits-all item, but it's not. Will return this item for one of the foot well \\"filler.\\"

product_title: Ware Manufacturing Natural Broom Grass Bristle Bunches Small Pet Chew Treat
review_body: Not really sure if the piggies like these that much.  But they haven't had much of a chance.  The package comes with only two which doesn't give you much opportunity to experiment with it (and anyone who owns guinea pigs knows that the first try is never a good indication of whether or not the piggies will accept the treat you've given).  The first one I gave, they seemed to show interest but they were having trouble getting their teeth into the tight bushell.  So I decided to remove the rope from one end of the bristle bunch and they went to town, but they were soon all over the cage (which is not very sanitary for guinea pig treats/food).  I gave the 2nd one to them this morning and this time I will not take the roping off.  We will see how it does over the next few days.

product_title: Bella's Multi-Color Crystal Luxury Leather Rhinestone Dog Collar (for Small Dog Breeds)
review_body: We bought two collars.  (The thinner pink one did not last.)  This one is beautiful and very sturdy.  Jewel looks great in it and feels real naked if it is not put on directly after her bath.

product_title: Dean & Tyler Service Dog Patches - Fits Small & Medium Harnesses - 5" Length By 1.5" - Made From High Quality Nylon with Velcro on the Back - Sells As a Pair - Made in Europe.
review_body:
I felt the description a little deceiving. I wrote a review sharing how I felt and why. The description does not say it is really only for their harnesses, that while there is velcro on the patch you have to go buy the other half of the velcro in order to use the patch.

I received an email from the company after placing my review offering to refund my money if I would delete my review. I thought that was fair but could not figure out how to delete it so did nothing. A few days later they wrote again asking me to delete the review (not as nicely), this time there was a link for doing just that. Thinking I would get my money back I followed the link and deleted that review. Guess what, I never received the refund. This may be a good company. My impression is that it is not.

The patches are durable, I have made them work on my dogs coat.

product_title: GoPetClub Cat Tree Condo Scratcher Post Pet Bed Furniture F2040-Blue
review_headline: Great piece of furniture for your feline friends
review_body:
Assembled myself in about half an hour. Instructions weren't extremely detailed but they sufficed, especially with a bevy of images online to help me see what it's supposed to look like at the end. Best piece of advice I can give is make sure you organize the posts; different types have slightly different heights.

The actual structure wobbles a little bit when forcefully manipulated, but it is very sturdy, especially if you can brace one or two sides of against a wall. The condos are very spacious, the top tier pads are very attractive for cats that like to perch (i.e. most of them), and the toys can take a surprising amount of abuse. For the price, I think this is an excellent piece of furniture. Don't bother with those $300 implements.

The only reason I took a star off is because larger cats have a tougher time navigating it. I have two cats, one that is twice the weight of the other. The heavier cat explores the lower tier, but only the lighter cat adventures up to the top. Still, I'm very happy with the use it gets from my cats, so unless you only own cats with large body frames, this is a great addition that gives cats perches, toys, scratching posts, and housing.

product_title: PetSafe Gentle Leader Head Collar with Training DVD

The sock threading is cheap though and has already started to unravel. I think this would be fine for a smaller tank (I have a 5 gal) or for those times you can't do a proper cleaning.

product_title: Litter Locker II Hygenic Soiled Litter Disposal System
review_body: My cat's litter box is in a closet off of the kitchen. We block off our window air conditioners so the kitchen gets extremely hot! This completely conceals the disgusting hot summer litter box smell!

product_title: Omega Paw Little Buddy Lunch Box
review_body: This food container works good, it's just as advertised.  I don't like how the cover is the bowl though. product_title: Pet Residence in Dark Brown
review_body:
I hesitate to call it a crate, it is really more of a pet residence as it is called in the review. I recently adopted a 7lb. Cockapoo and he willingly goes in on his own many times during the day. It is very roomy for him and I also purchased this item: [[ASIN:B001CQRZWC Midwest Quiet Time 23-By-18-Inch Ombre Swirl Deluxe Pet Bed]]--also from Amazon. My wife loves it because it does not take away from the room much and really does pass for a piece of furniture. I highly recommend this to any dog owner who can afford this--to me it was worth the price to be able to use this anywhere in your home.

product_title: Clear Conscience Pet SuperGravy Pet Food Supplement
review_headline: I wish the food I ate was so reliably healthy

I can't even know if I'm getting gentically modified food or other junk when I go eat lunch today but here there is an approach to pet food I hope I can enjoy one day as a human.  I would trust anything this company puts on the market!  I hope this level on integrity catches on with other companies.

product_title: Outward Hound Kyjen   Designer Pet Saver Life Jacket, Orange
review_body: This ripped in multiple places the first week we used it. The handle even came off completely when someone was pulling our dog back into our boat. I should also note that our dog weighs less than 70 pounds, so weight should not have been the issue. There's no way I would recommend this product.

product_title: Vision Bird Cage Model L01 - Large
review_body:
I purchased this cage about 4 years ago, when it was $40 more expensive in cost. I loved the smart, sleek design and the fact that their was a built in \\"seed guard\\". At that time we had a male and female budgie, they were both under a year old. At that time many were complaining about the durability and the plastic clips breaking. I have to say after 4 years I have not had any problem with the doors, clips, perches, seed cups or top. All have weathered very well. Now the bottom tray did wind up cracking on me, a small hairline crack has slowly creeped into a larger crack. It has been cracked for the past 3 years, so that says something for the durability. The only reasons we are upgrading from this awesome cage is because of the cracked bottom tray and primarily because we now have 3 male budgies (my female wound up dying due to ovary complications and infection) and the 2 younger ones are constantly jumping onto each other or the older male. I thought about upgrading to the Vision L02, but much as I love the vision cage I did find pulling the top off for the bottom tray a bit hard and could not fathom how I would be doing it with something so much taller that the current cage I have. All in all I don't regret purchasing my Vision cage, my birds have loved it, sitting in it, playing on top of it, hanging to the outside bars...which are horizontal making it easier for the birds to get around unlike most cages which have the bars vertically arranged making it harder for them to climb.

If you have finches or 2 budgies I would strongly recommend this cage, it will be tight for more than 2 budgies though.

PROS
1.) Nice airy design, sleek and horizontal bars make it easy for birds to get around, hold onto cage.
2.) Though it has plastic parts, it is very durable. The fact that you can take it apart so easily also makes it great cage to keep clean
3.) Very light cage, movable when needed.
4.) Bars are bird safe with no paint to peel off.

CONS
1.) I did work with the bottom tray, having to clip it off and remove for cleaning, but I would have preferred a pull put tray instead. It was a bit bulky to move and that resulted in it cracking and ultimately having to be replaced.
2.) I did have a problem with the little white clips popping off every so often and then it would be a hunt to find them. They hold the sided of the wire frames together.
3.) When I purchased it it was pricey ($127.99), though now it is $40 less so not really an issue.

Ultimately this is a great cage and like I said I have no regrets having had purchased it. It was a wonderful home for my budgies for 4 years.

product_title: Tuffy Ocean Creature Octopus
review_body: Mine only lasted a couple of days before my Border Collie Sheltie mix was ripping the stuffing out,  I'm going to try and sew the seams with a stonger thread.

product_title: Caitec Paradise Large Cotton Snuggle Ring Bird Toy

product_title: Petco Jumbo Enclosed Litter Box
review_headline: Good design but W/acute functional flaws
review_body:
This jumbo enclosed litter box has the initial design concept somewhat right...BUT... the bulit in clips are unnecessary and actually allow any urine that hits the walls to leak and migrate to the outside of the bottom half, then down the sides creating a 'stinky' mess. My cat is a litterbox 'sprayer' and not a 'squatter'. Not a deal breaker, just a suggestive wishful possibility.
The hood could also be about 3 inches taller to accommodate larger cats. I've tried at least 8 different litterbox styles, and have yet to find the 'ideal' candidate for my cats.
Some pluses are the clear lid/hood, neutral bottom half color and smooth surfaces. They ALMOST got it right. In my opinion, just a little 'tweaking' could make this the GO-TO litter box for millions of cat guardians.

product_title: Indipets Stainless Steel Spill Proof - Splash Free No Tip Anti Skid Dish with easy pick up grip handle
review_headline: Handle lets puppy grab and flip

This was almost the perfect bowl. The rounded lip cover definitely helps contain the drips and splashes that puppy makes. However, the built in handle is the weakest link. product_title: IRIS Premium Airtight Pet Food Storage Containers
review_headline: Iris Premium Airtight Pet Food Storage 67 quart ~ PERFECT!
review_body: We have been searching for an airtight container to store our dog's food.  Most products are stainless steel and cost over 300 bucks each.  I had my doubts about the quality of the Iris plastic containers but trusted the many 5 star ratings from other customers.  I am glad I did!  We buy high quality dog food that is vacuum sealed in the bag and prior to this purchase all that freshness would be gone in a day or two due to not storing the food correctly.  We bought 4 containers.  They sit neatly side by side.  They each hold the 44 lb bags of food no problem with plenty of room to spare.  My only concern would be the plastic hinge, I am worried about it's durability.  In our case, it is a non-issue as we put the bins close to the wall, so when opened, the lid leans on the wall and never has any pressure in the open position on the hinge.  The wheels are a plus and are sturdy enough to roll 44 lbs of dog food around a smooth concrete floor no problem.  All in all ~ Great product!

product_title: Kong Extreme Flyer Dog Toy
review_body: I LOVE Kong Extreme Chew toys for my little pitbull since he's an agressive chewer & they are usually the only toys that last with him. This product sadly was a disappointment & no where as durable as the other products. product_title: Earthbath Hypo-Allergenic Waterless Grooming Foam for Dogs
review_headline: Nice product, but doesn't last long for large breeds
review_body:
It's a very nice product, natural and effective. It leaves my dog's coat soft and shiny, and the smell is mild and pleasant. This is my second waterless shampoo for my Lab. The first one I tried was Nature's Miracle No Rinse Shampoo, which was okay but the smell was strong and didn't help with the coat as much. It also contains harmful ingredients.

I would definitely recommend Earth Bath Grooming Foam to small to medium dog owners. But for larger breeds, such as my 80-lbs Labrador, the product doesn't last very long. I didn't use much on my dog for each grooming and didn't even need to towel dry him in the end. But the foam only lasted about 8 groomings. So, for the price, it's a bit expensive.

product_title: Designer Catbox Litter Box Enclosure
review_headline: Loved it, liked it, and then wished it was better ... until I finally got rid of it.
review_body:
I searched long and hard for a good quality cat box cover before I settled on this one -- it had great reviews, and I really liked the look of it and the fact that I can determine which side it opens to. I was already really happy with my plain old litter box out in the open -- it was big and set on top of a mat; it was easy to keep clean, and I never really had any problems with that set up whatsoever.

What prompted me to look for a cover is the fact that I have a small niece now, and I wanted to be able to invite family over to a childproof house where toddlers couldn't easily get at a dirty cat box. So I got this enclosure. I loved it in the beginning, but now that I've lived with it for a while, there are quite a few things about it that I would change before I could be really satisfied with the product.

PROS:

1. Easy enough for one person to assemble -- though they recommend a second person, especially for the attachment of the lid, I was able to rest the lid on a step stool, adding books for height, and attached the lid by myself that way. Took maybe half an hour.

2. Looks great and has a clean, simple style that matches most decor -- it actually fits perfectly in the corner where I have it, on top of the same cat box mat I used before I got the enclosure, and it matches the walls. I would have preferred a natural wood color to match my furniture, but the only other options available were black and a dark brown called espresso.

3. Lid has a safety hinge -- I love this feature as I don't have to hold it open with one hand while I clean out the cat box with the other. Also, at first, I would leave it open for better ventilation, but I stopped doing that the night one of my cats frightened me by jumping on top of it and slamming it down, waking me from a sound sleep. I keep it closed now except to clean it.

4. Hook to hang scoop on the inside -- though my scoop is actually too big (too long) for meto use it in that way. I do, however, use the hook to hang an air freshener.

5. Fairly easy to wipe clean -- except for a few spots, if it gets dirty on the inside, you can easily wipe the surfaces clean. I recommend you don't use any spray cleaners that have any ammonia in them, as I've found it only increases any bad smells. I personally use Simple Green, which helps not only in cleaning the enclosure but in neutralizing any smells.

CONS:

1. Doesn't fit flush against the wall -- it would, if the lid were designed differently. I like the look of the lid, with the back and side pieces of wood on top, but the pieces of wood keep you from opening the lid if you have this enclosure flush against the wall. A better design would involve an extra piece of wood and a few more screws, the hinges placed in a slightly different place -- that way you could still have the decorative top. Or you could eliminate the decorative bits on top entirely. Either way would allow you to have the enclosure against the wall as you opened and closed the lid.

2. A little too small for messy or bigger cats -- I had to buy a smaller litter box to fit, and that would have been fine if my older cat didn't need the bigger box to begin with; she tends to miss the box because she's not too bright, is a little long, and has bad aim, so with this new set up now, she urinates a little bit outside the box and leaves a wet mess on the inner surfaces of the enclosure. Before, I only ever needed to scoop daily and do some other maintenance cleaning once a week. Now, I have to clean the area everyday or suffer the bad smell constantly. It's why I have an air freshener in the enclosure; I sorely need it. I have tried to counter this problem by using absorbent pads normally used for housebreaking dogs. I cut them to size so they fit in the two inner areas so that urine is absorbed and isn't left standing. I still have to clean the box every few days, especially tochange the padding, but at least it is a little easier. If I *don't* use the padding, the urine pools underneath the litter box, coating the bottom surface of the cat box, and I have to remember to place the cat box on something other than my carpet or the wetness transfers to the carpet, too.

3. Not quite as waterproof as it could be -- for the most part it is, as the walls wipe clean and the urine mostly stands and isn't so obviously absorbed, but the inner threshold was ruined within the first week of use. I don't know how or why as the paint looks the same throughout, but the paint started cracking there in a day or two after being wet with urine ... and this was back when I was cleaning the thing everyday, so there should have been no reason for it to happen. I can only guess that it wasn't treated the same as the other wooden surfaces. The inner threshold now looks horrible. Not only that but that inner piece of wood that separates the enclosure into two rooms has now soaked in a good bit of moisture and is somewhat swollen at the bottom. It's not too apparent, but I can feel the rough surface of the wood at the bottom part of that wooden piece; it feels like what particle board feels like when it gets wet. Everywhere else is smooth but there.

4. The inside could have been better designed -- I would have preferred an inner separator I could easily remove, maybe one you could slide in and out instead of screwing in permanently, if not for easier cleaning then for opting whether or not to even use it. But if it were designed to slide in and out, I could have used the absorbent pads without cutting them to size -- place the pad at the bottom, then slide the separator in place. Or I could have left the separator out entirely and used the bigger cat box that I had, which would have eliminated messes with urine in the first place and would have made the entire enclosure the perfect size. Also, the corners where the pieces of wood are joined areweak areas vulnerable to wet messes. Litter sand gets in those corners, too. I found myself using the wiper blade on my OXO deep clean brush set to get at the wet sand stuck in the corners. I often judge things by how easy they are to clean or maintain, and the design of this thing has just made it a pain for me to deal with in the long run. I want something easier to clean.

5. Could have come with custom waterproof mats to fit on the bottom -- something made of plastic or rubber with a cupped design that ran up the walls a little to contain fluids, something I could easily remove and wipe clean before placing it back in the enclosure. Maybe there could even be a piece to put over the threshold to protect that area. These are just things I find myself wishing for when I have to clean the enclosure yet again.

So ... all in all, not bad, but it could be better. I think next time, I'll have something custom-made as I have a better idea now what I would want for a cat box enclosure.

UPDATE: About a month after I originally wrote this review, I got rid of the enclosure. The smells just got worse and worse until I couldn't stand it any more -- I could smell the thing from the other room. Regularly cleaning the enclosure didn't help. Once the urine gets soaked into the wood, there's no going back. It wasn't just the bottom of the partition any more; the front piece of wood also got soaked, and you could feel the roughness in texture where it used to be smooth. The back piece was soaked also, which I discovered later, and urine had actually leaked out onto the mat beneath the enclosure. Given how much I spent on this thing, I was not happy about getting rid of it, but I'm sensitive to smells and didn't want to live where it smelled like a back alley. I went to PetSmart and shopped around for a covered litter pan -- I got the [[ASIN:B003RQVGKC Catit Jumbo Hooded Cat Litter Pan - Warm Gray]], by the way, and more than a month later I'm stillvery, very happy with it -- and took the designer cat box enclosure to the dumpster. Unlike when I first set it up, I had to get help this time because it's bulky and impossible for one person to carry, and because of the soaked wood I really didn't even want to consider taking it apart first. I remove the lid and the hinge hardware, though; they were untouched by urine and might be useful for a project one day, so I kept them. So, for the $120 I spent, I have some hinges and something I might be able to turn into a lap desk of some kind.

review_body:

I recommend starting with the rubber ones). He is a big dog, with a lot of fur, so that may be why? (Now, before you think I am really mean, I always check to see what it is that they are barking at! I never punish them for barking at people coming on our property or because they are excited. I use it when I have commanded them to stop barking because it is either someone across the street, far away, little kids playing in the street, or just nothing at all! They are smart dogs and follow other commands!)
Summery: I am very happy with this product! I love that one controller works for two collars, but that I can able to control each collar differently. I love the cost and I love that they are rechargeable! I don't like that the controller won't stand up and that they need to be recharged fairly often. I would highly recommend for someone with a dog that does not respond to verbal commands to stop barking. Every dog should be allowed to bark! But when they won't stop when you tell them to...this works great!

product_title: JW Pet SkidStop Slow Feed Pet Bowl ( Blue/ White )
review_headline: HELP! My Dog Eats WAY Too Fast
review_body:
Eating fast is not good for your animal's health because they run the risk of developing digestive disorders. Our newly rescued young Lab-mix \\"Lucy\\" can't get her food down her throat fast enough and it concerns us. At mealtime, she \\"wolfs\\" down her food as if she hasn't eaten in months. At first it was amusing, but now she hasn't shown any signs of slowing down and she runs the risk of digestive problems including bloat and even worse - \\"gastric torsion.\\" In our case, the drawback was Lucy became a serial farter. She dropped \\"dirty bombs\\" all night long! Because she ate so fast, she swallowed a good deal of air and, thus, we got to smell her dinner that (on most nights) woke us up out of a sound sleep!

Gastric Torsion is when an animal's full stomach gets twisted up after rigorous activity immediately after eating. This requires corrective surgery or the animal will (in most cases) pass away.

I spoke with an old-school Vet Tech friend of mine and she suggested putting golf balls in Lucy's bowl. With our luck, Lucy would actually swallow one or more of those too and then really require surgery. So I did some digging... on the net. Turns out there are several vendors on both Amazon and Ebay selling bowls designed to slow fast eaters down. There was one model that had vertical cylinders that stood up and forced a fast eater to eat around them but it struck me as a bit cheap. Then there was this JW Pet model bowl in a variety of sizes and two colors - white and blue. Since many more people were buying this JW bowl, my decision was simple. I paid $8.83 including shipping from Oregon to California.

I used a ruler to determine the size bowl for our Lucy as compared to her regular stainless steel bowl. I chose the \\"large\\" for our Lab mix, but sizes also include XS, small, medium and jumbo. The bowls are comprised of four sections divided by thick plastic walls. We were a bit nervous the first time we fed Lucy with her new bowl, but I'll bedarned - it worked. She's no longer finished first - in fact, she finishes her food dead last now and by a wide margin.

Lucy did a head tilt and paw'd at the bowl, but when she got to eating, she wasn't able to gulp it down like before. She had to navigate around the dividers. And really use her half-open mouth and tongue. My wife and I looked at each other with big smiles on our faces and did a fist bump. Mission accomplished.

Once Lucy knows the other dogs won't steal her food and once she gets into the rhythm of eating more slowly, we'll gradually allow her access to her regular stainless steel bowl again. I guess the only negative (for us) is that this bowl was designed to sit on the ground and not in or raised dog bowl feeder (that I built for the pups so they shouldn't have to strain their necks when eating). While the bowl does have integrated rubber feet, it does move across our tile floor so she does spend time running the bowl all over the room.

I would STRONGLY recommend this type of bowl to anyone with an animal that eats too fast. If you consider how much trips to the veterinarian will cost, this bowl is money well-spent.

product_title: KONG Extreme Dog Toy, Black
review_headline: 4 stars but only because of the [new] odor
review_body:
I'll just touch briefly on some of the concerns that others have mentioned in their negative reviews.

*Is it counterfeit?*

I compared to a Kong I bought several years ago from a local pet supply chain store.
The Kongs are identical in every way although the graphics on the packaging has changed. That style of the packing, however remained the same. And yes, I actually did save the packaging because I can never remember what size it is.

* Did they make it smaller?*
As I said above, these kongs purchased through Amazon in Apr 2012, were identical to kongs I purchased locally in 2009 from a pet supply store. Picture the courtroom tire analysis scene from the movie My Cousin Vinny... I-(claps hands)-dentical!

*Why doesn't my dog want to play with it?*

If your dog is anything like mine are, they aren't interested in rubber chew toys. They're into bones and stuffed animals that they can destroy in 2 seconds. However my dogs were kong & chew-toy trained at an early age. More on that in a bit. I give them a stuffed kong. I used to put all kinds of goodies in there like kibble and peanut butter but now I just put a little piece of sliced bread in there. If I want to make it extra challenging, I'll break off about one quarter of a piece of a hot dog bun and wedge that in the kong. That'll take some work to get out.

\\"Working\\" on the kongs is sort of a mental exercise. Not just chewing. One of my dogs learned the best way to get the treat out of the kong is to throw the kong down the stairs. Once my dogs get the food out, they lose interest in the kong completely. That's normal. But it's a piece of rubber folks, not a beef bone. It does however serve another valuable purpose and that's mental stimulation.

*Does it stain the carpet?*

I haven't noticed the black Extreme Kongs to stain carpet and I have white Berber (unfortunately) so if anyone's going to notice... I have had problems with the BLUE kongs staining the carpet. Not the puppy kongs but the dark blue ones they sell (or used to) in bulk to vets, labs or kennels. They were the same thing, just a different color and in a very plain box. They were not as durable as these black ones either.

*Is there an odor?*

Unfortunately there does appear to now be a rubbery-chemicalish odor. Even after washing them and even after a few weeks of use. My dogs aren't complaining. They still use them but then again my dogs are trained to use them.

*Do they fall apart easily?*

I have gone through a lot of kongs. The are not indestructible but what I can tell you is these black ones are the most durable and if you get the right size for your dog, they will last a very long time and you should definitely get your money's worth.

Usually where they start to fail is they get a little frayed around the widest part but it's not that big of a deal. Then the top one third of the kong starts to get ripped until one day you can pry it off completely. That's when it's time to get a new one.
I have tried less expensive similar devices and I can tell you that these are much better.

*What is Kong training?*

Kong training is using a stuffed kong to teach your dog what is an acceptable chew toy, to give them a safe object to \\"get their chew-on\\" with and it's also a way to transition your dogs from an active play session to quiet nap time.

My dogs get two stuffed kongs a day. Once after our morning walk. This signals that it's time to wind down and sleep until dad comes home from work. The other is after our evening play session which signals that it's time to wind down from that for night time sleep.

My only complaint is the new odor. It's not terrible as in, it doesn't stink up the house or anything but if you take a whiff, it does make you wonder if a dog that isn't trained to enjoy kongs will be interested in it.

All in all, I recommend that you get these kongs and use them for training purposes, where you'll get the best benefit and so will your dog(s). I wouldn't let the odor stop you but I do hope they get that worked out.
