Poor design and workmanship[[ASIN:B007X4DTUY Whisker World 71021 / 71022 / 71023 103\\" Stairway to Heaven Cat Tree Color: Beige]]

product_title: Simple Solution Washable Belly Band Male Dog Diaper
review_body: My dog is disabled and this wrap is a Godsend.  Without it I wouldn't be able to keep my dogs diapers in place.  This product has made a near impossible situation workable.

product_title: Chew - A - Bulls 12 In, 100% digestible, Wheat, Gluten and Soy Free
review_body:
I purchased these at a big-box petstore locally and I was rather miffed to discover that these are not what they appear. I expected bull pizzles, but it seems all of the \\"Red Barn\\" brand Chew-A-Bulls are reconstituted and not real pizzles. They have gone to great lengths to make the product look like a real bull pizzle, but they are not the real thing and do not last like the real thing. I knew something was wrong when my dog had devoured it within minutes. Close inspection revealed flashing from the mold used to form them and the ends were smooth and uniform, unlike a real pizzle.
Bull pizzles aren't particularly cheap, and neither are the cheap imitations like these.
I truly felt like I had been deliberately deceived, enough so to warn others.

product_title: Natural Balance Indoor Ultra Dry Cat Food
review_body: Don't buy this product.  Company would like you to think it is healthy, but it isn't.  Made my cat sick, throwing up.  Now I find out it is made by Diamond Foods and is in the recall list just anounced 5/30/2012.  Diamond Foods makes alot of pet food products and has a very poor rating for safe products.  They had to shut down 3 of their plants because of contamination.  I had to throw this product away, and it cost over $30.00.  Save the money and don't buy this crap!!!

product_title: BPD-1 Bear Power 2 HP High Velocity Pet Groomer Dryer, Lime Green
review_body: I own a small home based Doggie Wash and I bought this dryer 5 months ago, I only use it maybe 4 0r 5 times every two weeks if that, well when I first got it I loved it, i had no problem getting the undercoat out of my Husky or Malamute clients, lately when i would use it the tip of the hose would fly off, i mean completey come off the hose, that was beyond irritating, and just yesterday i am in the middle of drying a 5 month old husky and it just quits on me. SO NOT HAPPY!!!!

product_title: Martine Style Solid Wood Frame Dog Cat Pet Bed Cushion
review_body: I bought this bed for my baby a long time ago, but never got a chance to write a feedback til now. I had purchase it when it was on sale...luckily only bought it for about 60-70 bucks...not the 100 dollar amount it shows now... My baby loves it. Though the chenille cushion was not enough support for my 'overweight' baby =) I was able to put in more cushions...it's great that the cushion has an insert and you can take the sheet out to wash. I had added extra bed sheets for him (so I don't have to wash the chenille all the time). He loves it! I even decorated his bed (as you can see) with his favorite stuff animals! Love this bed. It's just like the human size! He sleeps just like mommy!

product_title: Jolly Ball Original
review_body: This is a Great Toy for my Dog Kojo, He loves me to throw it and then he carries it by the handle back to me. Another great thing is at 96 lbs he cannot tear it up when he chews on it because of the air hole.This is the 2nd Jolly Ball he has had and there will be many more in his future.

product_title: Four Paws Magic Coat Gentle Slicker Wire Brush for Cats
review_body: The price and product is very reasonable.  The Bristol's are the right size for a short hair cat.  This really sheds the hair and my Jasper loves it when he is being brushed. It is very easy to clean. Thank you

product_title: Lixit Hand Feeding Syringe for Baby Animals, 10 ml
review_body: I have had this for about a week.  Using it to hand feed a parrot.  It gets used 2x/day.  I HAND WASH and air dry.  The numbers and letters have already rubbed off where my index/middle finger grip it.

product_title: Bergan Turbo Track Cat Toy
review_headline: The ball needs to be smaller
review_body: The track toy fits together as well as most other track toys we have.  However, knowing that it is an imperfect world, Bergan should have supplied a smaller ball.  The ball that comes with the track does get snagged at some connection points.  We make do with some smaller tennis-like cat toy balls instead.  I've reconfigured the track a few times and I am starting to see stress marks in the plastic.  Thankfully the price dropped substantially before I bought the set or else I'd be a lot less happy.

product_title: Hydor Koralia Evolution Aquarium Circulation Pump
review_headline: Size is a factor for a Nano.
review_body: This is a well made pump for it is huge for a pump that has such a small amount of flow. I also have a Koralia Evolution 1400 and this thing is the same size as that. Not worth the trade off to me, so I sent it back.

product_title: VETiONX Defendex - All-Natural Flea, Tick, and Mange Shampoo for Dogs and Cats. Homeopathic Pet Shampoo Naturally Washes Away Flea, Tick, Mange and Scabies Infestations. Addresses All Stages of Life Cycle Including Eggs. 1 Bottle
review_body: This shampoo is excellent -- the relief and progress of my cat's skin condition was visible very soon after shampooing -- will be shampooing again soon (once a week is my preference -- on the other hand, maybe twice a week would be better -- play it by ear and see what works); skin has almost returned to being smooth and silky.

product_title: Marineland Perfecto Glass Canopy 28 Euro
review_body: Fit my Marineland aquarium perfectly. Glad I found this it's the only way to get a replacement canopy for your Marineland tank.

product_title: Fluval Foam Filter Block (204/205/306 & 304/305/306)- 2-Pack
review_body: This foam really traps debris great!!! you can use it in any filter you will just have to cut to fit

product_title: PetSafe Pawz Away Pet Barriers with Adjustable Range, Pet Proofing for Cats and Dogs, Static Stimulation
review_body:
This works fine as long as you don't have a big area to keep your dog out of.
It will not work past five feet from the transmitter.

product_title: EzyDog Doggy Flotation Device Dog Life Vest Jacket (DFD)
review_body: I ordered this for my dog after he suffered from an embolism and was partially paralyzed and I found out that water therapy was the best thing for him.  The fit was good and the wide straps that go under the dog are so much better than the little nylon straps on other doggie flotation devices.  The buckles are very strong, they held up to carrying a 105 lb lab around.  I highly recommend!

product_title: Oster Professional Turbo A5 2-Speed Heavy Duty Detachable Blade Animal Clipper with #10 Blade 078005-314-003
review_body: I used these clippers on my cocker, and I was pleased with the results.  I would definitely recommend them.  I do wish a guard would have been included.

product_title: Van Ness EC4-B ECO Large Pet Bowl, Spice Brown
review_body: Good bowl.  Cool design and it's very sturdy and can't easily be tipped over. There's not much else to say about a bowl.

product_title: PetFusion SmartGrip Cat Litter Mat. Large (35 x 24 inches). Safe for your cats, free from Phthalates & VCM
review_headline: Too small to do a good job
review_body: Yes, I said it was too small. Based on the reviews, I thought the mat would be rather huge, so that my cats would land on the mat when they get out of the litter box. Instead, my cats hop right over the edge, scattering the litter all over the floor, which is precisely the result I hoped this mat would prevent. One of my cats has a habit of getting her feet in the litter box and that's about it... but the mat doesn't even keep much of THAT contained. Overall, I'm pretty disappointed.

product_title: Bellyrubs 1-1/4-Ounce All Natural Cat Treats, Bonita
review_body: All 5 of my cats love this & eat it right up.  Very large container, so it lasts months when given a few flakes to each kitty.

product_title: New Large Economical 4 Levels Ferret Chinchilla Sugar Glider Rats Cage For Small Animal or Bird 30"Length x 18"Depth x 36"Height
review_headline: WARNING ferret owner - possible loss of toes
review_body:
Where the sides meet they are too close and not close enough. I know of two ferrets who have lost their toes because as they climb all over the cage they get a nail caught in between the bars. The cage holds firm and they death role until it breaks their toe off. SERIOUSLY. If you get this cage you need to tie wrap all the sides together and possible put duct tape where the wires leave a small gap.
I also don't like the wire shelves. A fuzzy can fall from the top all the way to the bottom. Make sure there are a ton of hammocks.
Hard to clean.
Bottom tray does not keep spillage from being everywhere.
Don't like this bulky cage.

As for Chinchillas, the poo flings all over unless you cover the cage with a sheet.

product_title: MidWest iCrate Single Door & Double Door Folding Metal Dog Crates
review_body: This deal was so good it was almost too good to be true. I saw the same kennel at petsmart for 72! It is insane how much money you can save by doing research and shopping online! The crate size is perfect for my miniature poodle I am getting. It was easy to snap together and I didn't even need to ask husband for help. It's solid and sturdy and the extra adjustable panel is a nice bonus!

product_title: Purina Fortiflora Canine Nutritional Supplement Box
review_body: We were unfamiliar with FortiFlora, but we are sure aware of it's success. Our St. Bernard had  a serious case of diaherra and our daughter suggested this product. Within a couple of days the problem cleared up and our dog was back to normal. Very satisfied with this product. Will keep it on hand always for future problems. Really a great product.

product_title: Prozap Garden & Poultry Dust
review_body: I am a breeder of small and medium exotic birds. Got tired of spending $4+ on these small bird protector tin cans to hang inside the breeding boxes. When I sold some cockatiels to an other breeder, he told me that he uses poultry dust in his breeding boxes to keep mite away from his birds and this is so much cheaper. I have been using this now and would say it is well worth it. It lasts so much longer then the stuff they sell in pet stores. All I do is mix some of the powder with the aspen shavings and put it in the nesting boxes to keep mite away. Seems to work like a charm and the powder may last 2-3 breeding seasons easy! It has not hurt any of my birds

product_title: Catit Design Senses Play Circuit, Original
review_body: I purchased four sets and connected them all together to create an awesome track with four balls for my cats.  I think the price for each set is more than reasonable.  Easy to assemble, smart design, looks great.

product_title: PetSafe Stay + Play Wireless Fence, Covers up to 3/4 Acre, for Dogs and Cats over 5 lb., Waterproof and Rechargeable, with Tone and Static Correction
review_body: We had an underground wired fence but the line is broken in numerous places.  The dog was great even three years after we stopped actually using the fence.  Then she decided to wander again and even with her collar on, she knew there was no signal.  So, I wasn't in the mood to spend 1/2 a day burying wire, so I purchased this wireless unit, plugged it in, tested it and put the collar on her.  Instant fence, and instant well-behaved dog.  I was worried about it not working because our house is built into the side of a small hill, with a walk-out basement.  We put the unit on the first floor and it still creates a perfect circle even with the drop in elevation between the front of the house and the back.  One irritating thing is that I can hear the unit.  It's a super high-pitched squelch.  Irritating.  So it's plugged into an outlet near a computer that also makes noise.  Hopefully I'll forget about it soon.

product_title: Beef Pill Pockets Large 7.9oz
review_headline: Pill Pockets great but from Amazon, not so much.
review_body: I've purchased pill pockets for years now to pill my multiple dogs on medication. They love them and think they are getting a treat. I have always bought the capsule size so I could pinch off just as much as I need for the pill(s). But lately every time I buy Pill Pockets on Amazon, they're too dry and crumbly to pinch off or to even pinch the top closed. Pill Pockets are a great solution but I've given up buying them on Amazon due to poor quality and started to buy them at PetSmart again. I always get the soft and fresh ones at Petsmart which get 5 stars.

product_title: Dog Hair Dye Gel
review_body: I have been using the pet dyes for the past 4 months on my shi-poo and client's dogs.  Some colors stay longer than others.  In the salon we wash, dry the dog completely, then dye dry for about 15 mins.  My clients have loved the colors and the results.  No dog has had a bad reaction.  Some colors have to grow out, some will fade, and some will wash out after a couple of washes.  Unless you have been doing it for awhile it will be messy.

product_title: PetSafe Outdoor Ultrasonic Bark Deterrent
review_body: This worked so well, our neighbors dog would bark all night.  After a couple attempts at barking he has almost stopped the hours of noise. Every once in a while we hear a woof, but no more hours and hours of barking.  I hung it near our mutual fence.  Peace and quiet at last.

product_title: Arm & Hammer Essentials Natural Clumping Litter, 10.5-Pounds
review_headline: Not for chemically sensitive people... or cats!
review_body: This stuff is deplorable!  Who cares if it clumps or not... just opening the bag and getting a snootful of the vile chemicals causes immediate stomach evacuation for those of us with Mutliple Chemical Sensitivity!  It took a lot of fresh lavender to get the smell out of my sinuses and fresh ginger to defeat the intense nausea.... and I had to boil rosemary and place bowls of vinegar around to get the smell out of the house.  All of that just from opening the bag... can't understand how they can get away with calling this natural....

product_title: Merrick Whole Earth Farms Adult Dry Dog Food, 35-Pound Bag
review_headline: Switched from Chicken Soup 4 Dog lovers soul
review_body: During the last recall (not the 1st for them) I bought this and like it better then CSFDLS. Dogs like it and I feel better with a product that has not been recalled. Quality Control and Poor Custome service during the recall lost me and this dog food fits the bill and is about same price..THANKS!

product_title: PetSafe Gentle Leader Head Collar with Training DVD
review_headline: Gentle leader for a large adult dog
review_body:
I got this for my families 75# golden retriever who who liked to pull. I found this to be a very effective solution for him and I feel much better about using this as opposed to a choke collar.

The product itself shipped in great time and so far has held up to weeks of use without any visible wear and tear.

product_title: GoodBye Odor for Small Animals, 8-Ounce
review_body: I like this stuff, my bunny's enclosure is in my room so it CANNOT be smelly!!!! I began giving this to her at 6 months old.  I went home to visit my parents and forgot it- she stated going crazy, peeing on everything and being aggressive.  It may be because she was not used to the way she was smelling. I don't know, maybe they are not related.  It works as it says it does, eliminates most odors but don't stop using once you start!

product_title: Venture Series Trainer Remote
review_body: This training collar has the range to be able to use it on an open property of 3 acres. Works like a charm even at great distances.

product_title: Quick Clean Cat Litter Box
review_body: Had Little spinner cat box for about a week so far, so good.  I agree that cat box is small, so if you have big kitty this one may not be for you.  Easy to assemble - but make sure you follow all directions, not fitting together correctly may hinder operation (just match up arrows and a insert on one panel).  From other reviews I read there may have been some changes to product.  Mine came with metal reinforced screw inserts - they made a very tight fit. Box feels solid.  Also with correct level of cat litter it does not roll when kitty is in box.  Litter + cats weight stops the rollers from working.  Only problem I have is that collector drawer is just a screen, so when it pull out litter will fall to floor.  I use flushable litter, so I move tray to toilet (couple feet away),empty and flush, but some litter falls. Have to figure out way to stop that. But minor problems compared to the ease and not having to bend down and scoop twice a day.

product_title: WildSide Salmon - Wild Alaskan Freeze Dried Salmon Treats for Dogs, 3 oz (6 Pack)
review_headline: yummy dog treats but cats love it too!!
review_body: I HAVE 7 CATS AND THEY ALL LOVE THIS TREAT. FINALLY A TREAT THEY ALL EAT. HAS ONLY ONE INGREDIENT AND THATS RAW FREEZE DRIED WILD SALMON. I DO HAVE TOO BREAK UP SOME FOR THE SENIOR CAT BECAUSE HE HAS NO BACK TEETH, BUT BOY HE DEVOURS THEM LIKE NO TOMORROW. ALSO DELIVERY WAS RIGHT ON TIME. A DATE WAS GIVEN AND THAT WHEN IT SHOWED UP. IN FACT AMAZON HAS BEEN RIGHT ON THE NOSE ON MANY OCCASIONS. THEY ARE AMAZING,,,

product_title: Pet Tag Pro No Bark Collar, Black, Large
review_body: I ordered this for both of my dogs, the collar would go off when my dog would shake her head but not when she would bark! And most of the time the collar would vibrate when the other dog barked not the one that needed the training.  UGH! Wish I could return. Batteries actually got hot and made the collar hot too!

product_title: Wellness Complete Health Natural Dry Small Breed Dog Food
review_body: I went online and did some research on dry dog foods.  I thought of course that I just had to have a 5 star food.  What I now know is that  tons of protein is not always the best for every breed.  I started my three little dogs cavapoo 15 lbs cavachon 12 lb yorkie 5 lbs on Wellness Core which is I'm sure a wonderful food but the protein is rated at 36% which turned out to be far to rich for my little dogs. After talking with the breeder of my yorkie she explained that too much protein in some breeds can be taxing on the liver and kidneys. I saw this in my dogs right away so I knew I had to make a quick change.  I definately wanted to eliminate the gas and copious amount of poop do to the protein content so I checked with the other foods made by Wellness and found that the simple five mix has a lot of the same wonderful ingredients as the Core but with a much more practical protein content for my dogs life style at 28%.  The results were amazing, immediately I saw a reduction in the amount of poop fewer times outside as well.  Everybody seems happier and life is easier with all three dogs on the same kibble.  I'm THRILLED.  Thank You WELLNESS.  I would strongly recommend this product.  One more side note...I really appreciate the promise made by Wellness on the front of the bag.  IT STATES: NO meat by products corn or soy  and so on.  Check it out for yourself you will be glad you did:)

product_title: Conair Yellow Dog Round-Tip Shears, Dog Home Grooming
review_body: I have been using these scissors for about a year now and absolutely love them. I own a Cocker Spaniel and use these scissors to cut the hair between his paws and around his paws between groomings (and even along his legs to even things up). They're great because unlike common hair cutting scissors my fingers do not get caught in the handle looks and they easily cut. Everyone I know who has seen me use these scissors has been impressed and gone out to buy a pair of their own! They're so easy and work well with any hair type! I highly recommend them!

product_title: FURminator FURejector deShedding Tool for Dogs
review_body: Very happy with purchase and results I get when using this de-shedding tool.. I can't believe how much hair this picks up.. I only wish I would have bought this long ago...

product_title: Prevue Hendryx Pet Products Wrought Iron Flight Cage
review_body: I purchased this flight cage for my 2 Gouldian Finches a little over 2 months ago. My babies love the huge space they now have! It is very easy to clean. Nothing fancy but for the price-you cant go wrong. It is very sturdy and has wheels so it would be easy to move if needed. The only negative thing I have found is the large feeder containers..they do not fit well between the bars and two have broke because of the bad fit. I am still using the 1 (double compartments)and am looking for a couple other single dishes to offer vegetables in. I am so glad I purchased this cage-Most likely the only cage Oliver and Olivia will ever need :-)

product_title: Yak Pak Dog Leash and Collar Set, X-Small, Multi Check
review_body: I ordered an x-small collar and was sent a small which doesn't seem like a big deal but my dog is a toy breed and it doesn't come close to fitting her.

product_title: Grizzly Salmon Oil for Dogs
review_body: I bought this product with some skepticism, many before this never worked.  Within 3 weeks of using this all 3 dogs (Kuvasz, Yellow Lab and a mutt) coats were shining.  Now word of caution, they did shed a little bit more than normal at first, but after the first 3 weeks the coats was nicer and the shedding was less than ever.  I am going to keep my dogs on this from now on.

product_title: Celltei Pak-o-Bird - Olive color with Stainless Steel mesh - Medium Size
review_body: Everything I expected and more. Well made and my african grey is very comfy in it!  Now he can go with me to so many places!

product_title: Drinkwell Multi-Level Lotus Ceramic Drinking Fountain
review_headline: CAUTION - great fountain but some vendors blacklisted by manufacturer
review_body:
Bought from an outside vender through Amazon. Great fountain. Would be excellent table-top fountain as water sound is *big*. HOWEVER....called 1-866-322-2530 (Radio Systems Corp petfountain.com phone number in insert) because housing cap was cranky & was informed that some vendors are blacklisted. Ergo replacements? Oh nooooo. One of the blacklisted venders is OZBO & this is where my fountain (thru an Amazon vender) shipped from!

So...though it's a great fountain - really super attractive - you might want to call them before buying.

BTW, a couple pieces are plastic but it's no big deal.

product_title: Fresh Kitty Litter Box Liners, Jumbo with Ties (Pack of 30)
review_body: Received this package promptly. However, I opened the package to find the box of liners was opened, very damaged and missing 2 of the 30 liners.  Talk about ticked off.  These silly bags are so expensive as it is.  Gave 3 stars because these are the bags I wanted and fit the extra large covered box we have for our two cats.

product_title: PetSafe Gentle Leader Deluxe Headcollar, Small, My Little Angel
review_headline: Turned nightmare walks into pleasurable experiences
review_body: My dog gets overly excited on walks when he sees other animals, and had a real problem with pulling and lunging. The gentle leader head harness has been a godsend! Far less of the previous behaviors and correction/handling is SO much easier and more effective with this tool. It took my dog very little time to get used to the Gentle Leader and my arms don't get jerked out of their sockets! This product is a true winner - I wish I had tried it sooner!

product_title: Comfort Pet Products EZ Step Pet Steps, 5 Steps, 30-Inch Tall, Tan
review_body: they stated the steps were 30\\" high and the steps are 21\\" high not high enough for my bed so the dog can climb it. they need to get their information corrected!

product_title: Innova HealthBars - Small - 4 lb
review_body: The Collies in rescue can't wait until the morning when they have their Innova Treats....they are the best...it is yumyum here.

product_title: Lentek Super Bark Free Dog Training Device
review_body: My dogs paid no attention to it.  It did not go off when they barked but it did go off at lesser noises not made by dogs.  I returned the item.

product_title: Ware Manufacturing Chew Proof High Rise Pet Cage for Small Pets
review_headline: Idea is good, product is not
review_body: Bought this off of amazon last (?) week, received very quickly and everything, but was very disappointed. The idea is great, I needed a high rise that was not made of plastic since it would be put on a gerbils cage and they chew everything. The product did not come with everything it said it would and many of the wire bars were bent and 2 were even broken (On the ramp) The ramps and levels were hard to put in and were uneven and very cheap feeling. Dont but this product, I returned mine and will be looking for a better solution

product_title: Pioneer Pet Big Max Stainless Steel Fountain
review_body: Design of how the tiny pump goes in its housing is bad.  The stainless cleans easily but the tiniest hair or food stops the flow.  Finally managed to have it run for longer than one hour.  Purchased because of BIG dogs and their lips hold lots of varying things..  Was hoping it's performance would ease constant cleaning...and it's a slight improvement only

product_title: KONG Naturals Catnip Spray for Cats, 1-Fluid Ounces
review_body: I bought some toys I thought my kitten would play with which didn't have catnip in them. Others I bought did. I just got the kitten who was six months old. I had some small toys I thought if I'd spray this catnip on it, \\"Piper\\" would love them. He hated it, and the toys he had tried to play with, he didn't want to have anything to do with. I wouldn't waste my money on this product.

product_title: Tradewinds Tape Worm Tabs 3 Tablets (Cats) Medications - Non Prescription
review_body: Purchased this for worm troubles my feline had. It comes in a tiny little bottle, 3 little tablets. I gave one tablet that evening when it arrived, next morning they were gone. I haven't seen any worm segments since and he's been more active. Listen to the other reviews, this stuff definitely works and isn't harmful from my experience. Only wish maybe they'd give it as capsules or tear-away packets instead. That little bottle with that much room that holds such tiny tablets seemed like a waste of packaging.

product_title: Nature's Recipe Easy to Digest Chicken, Rice & Barley Cuts in Gravy Adult Canned Dog Food
review_body: I have been using Nature's Recipe \\"Easy to Digest\\" Chicken Cuts with Gravy for about six months. My 12 year old beagle was having kidney problems and had refused to continue eating dry food. We looked for a wet food, which the vet suggested would be easier for him to digest and reduce his need for water. We tried the Nature's Recipe brand and he loved it. Acts like a puppy at feeding time. His general health has improved and we are happy with this product.

product_title: Woodland Getaway
review_body: If you own a dwarf hamster, he/she will think they're living in a mansion! I have a pretty hefty hamster myself (he's a little bigger than the palm of my hand) and he rests comfortably in this hamster house. Definitely not suitable for a larger rodent (rats/gerbils/etc).

product_title: Miracle Coat Equine Grooming Shear
review_body:
I use these shears once a month to trim the paw pads and around the feet of my maltese. I also use them to cut out any mats and trim around the eyes. The gentle curve of the shears allows me to trim evenly around the paws and helps to keep the blunt end of the shears away from skin and eyes when trimming the face.
They work great!

product_title: Frontline Plus Flea and Tick Control for Dogs, 45-88 lbs, 6 MO SUPPLY
review_body: I currently live in NH and the blood sucking critters here, like many places, are atrocious. I do a lot of field work and take my dog to accompany me. Because we are out so much this leaves us often being used as a buffet. When I get home I am able to get all the ticks off me, but my dog is a black lab which causes difficulties in always finding the ticks. I like this product because when I don't find the ticks right away, I will often find them in the morning dead on the floor. I have not found one engorged tick on her yet, which is really saying something. When it comes to ticks and fleas it does exactly what it is supposed to. If it isn't, I would check to make sure it is the real thing. Now, if you are expecting this to repel mosquitoes or various flies this is not the product. I would recommend getting a fly/mosquito repellent collar as well. We need to make sure to protect our pets against the outside critters and I recommend this product.

product_title: Holistic Select Natural Dry Dog Food
review_headline: My dogs got sick off a bag,and cost me 300$ in vet bills
review_body: I have been feeding this brand to my bulldogs for 2 years.  Petco stop carring it, so I have been buying from Amazon.  I buy two 30lb bags at a time.. I never thougth it would make by bulldogs sick.  I stop feeding them from that bag, and opened the new one after I had taken them to the vet and they eventually got better.  I ran out of the 2nd bag  so I put them back on original bag, and they started vomiting again..It's hard to see my pupps so sick, and don't know if I should keep buying this brand.

product_title: 2 Pack 10 Soft Bite Floppy Flyer Disc (Catalog Category: Dog / Toys-other)
review_headline: This dog toy a high flyer
review_body:
Product is very good in general and the 2 pack worked out very well for us. I chose this product based on reader reviews, and I wanted a soft flyer to avoid damage to the pet's teeth. Full marks there. It is also quite easy to throw and catch as promoted, which is important as my friend, the dog owner, is a senior.

The dog had no previous Frisbee type toys (with original owner) and initially wanted to play keep away or tug-of-war type games once she had possession. We let her tear around the yard a few times carrying it but we refused the pulling game. The flyer did not tear or puncture from her teeth trying to get it from her initially, so very tough and durable.

That is where the two pack became a great training tool. My friend's dog learned to drop the first flyer when I motioned that I was about to launch the second one. Less keep away, more chase and catch, which she loves, and she is more cooperative in giving up possession of all toys now.

A great start of the day for an energetic teenage black lab to burn off excess energy before retreating to the house to beat the heat. In fact she insists on it.

product_title: Little City Dogs CHICKEN FLAVORED Praziquantel Tapeworm Wormer Capsules for Cats (6 Capsules)
review_headline: Cheaper than a Trip to Vet
review_body:
One treatment eliminated the problem. Proudct was received in a timely manner. Mixed with food since treating a kitten. Definitely cheaper than trip to vet. Bought enough product to share with friend with 4 cats - saved a bunch of money for vet bill.

Did not cause any reaction with kitten as medication from vet used on my older cat. A little tummy upset, but expelled dead worms from both ends. Appetite resumed within a day and kitten immediately started gaining weight.

review_body:

review_headline: not quite as expected  but good
review_body:
UPDATE: if your MOTOR stops working, take it apart and clean the pieces out, i've had the same motor for over 4 yrs. it works off magnetic connection and if you dont clean the magnet, it will stop working. i wish i had known this earlier.. the pieces all come apart easily, and fit right back together, 5 minutes of cleaning can save you tons of money.

That being said, this motor seems very loud and the ease of cleaning and placing this on the floor is not where it should be. the two pieces require separate placement and an unnecessary step in my mind, unlike some all in ones. i'm hoping the motor will quiet over time, the cats have had no problems getting used to it, but this is not their first fountain. had this been the first fountain, i dont think my skittish one would use it at all. i'll be buying the additional filter methods as described in one of the product photos, to hopefully cut down on the cleaning frequency.

review_headline: Great mat for litter, easy cleanup
review_body: This mat has been great. product_title: Ware Manufacturing Crinkle Hang-N-Tunnel Sleeper for Small Animals - Colors May Vary
review_headline: Wonderful product. Amazing value. You need to get one. UPDATE
review_body:
UPDATE:
I originally gave this product a glowing review. Not so much this time. When I ordered another one, I received a hanging tunnel with fleece only on the OUTSIDE. The inside is just plastic and is not nearly as pleasing to my rats. They use it sometimes, but they were always in it when it had fleece inside. With the cold weather, this has been a serious disappointment.

OLD REVIEW:
This hanging tunnel turned out to be much, much better than expected. It has a nice material on the outside, fleece on the inside and some waterproof material between the layers. product_title: Automatic Cat Feeder, CSF-3 Super Feeder, Stand/Bowl, Analog Timer
review_body:
This cat feeder saved our lives (well, mainly our cat). As dramatic as that sounds, my boyfriend and I were being awoken to a starving kitty every morning, including weekends, at around 6 am, until we fed her. The same routine happened the minute I set foot in the door, being greeted by a screaming cat who just wanted food. It wouldn't stop. We can't free feed her because she will eat everything in sight and then regurgitate it back up. No matter how many times we fed her an allotted small portion a day she would always whine at us. This cat was my boyfriends to begin with and her screaming at us every hour did nothing to make me enjoy her. It was causing problems. Finally I got on Amazon and read all the reviews about this cat feeder. With much hope I splurged (this is more expensive than most but I figured if I was going to try and solve this problem I might as well get a quality product) and received the feeder within the next few days. Setting it up was no problem as long as I watched the video.

We had it scheduled to feed her 4 times a day and after the 1st day our lives changed for the better. Our cat has become the best ever and has not hassled us once (except when we need to fill the feeder back up). We can't believe how much this changed our situation and made our lives so much more pleasant. Instead of screaming at us and begging all of the time, whenever she's hungry she just goes and sits in front of the feeder and stares at it (she hasn't quite caught on to the fact that it's on a timer). This is the best investment I've made in a long time and now our entire household is happier. I can't recommend this product enough.

review_headline: Poorly designed. Don't waste your money!

My dogs are little and not aggressive, these things are just poorly designed that any dog biting them could get them off.

I spent a lot of money for the system and pre-paid service. I called them to see if I could at least get a refund for the pro-rated services that I didn't use and they said no, they don't give refunds after it is purchased. He then asked if I would stay with the services if he could replace the bad trackers, but after checking on it he then said he couldn't replace the trackers anyway. They took my hundreds of dollars and I have nothing to show for it.

product_title: BLUE for Cats Adult Dry Cat Food
review_body:
UPDATE 2/14/16: Kitty just stopped eating Blue Buffalo. We switched to The Honest Kitchen, Prowl (Dehydrated Chicken). She's eating again and I feel good about the ingredients.

ORIGINAL REVIEW:

Kitty's been eating ONE for several years and started throwing up her food pretty often right after she'd eaten... no evidence of hairballs. I thought it might be a food allergy. After reading a lot of reviews, I tried Blue Buffalo Indoor Cat Dry Food.

Since we started Blue about 3 weeks ago these are some changes I've noticed:

She eats EVERY BITE and licks her bowl clean. She never finished her ONE before she asked for more. It lost its appetizing smell pretty quickly.

She hasn't thrown up.

She's 10 years old and slept almost all the time. After a few weeks of Blue, she's started making her hunting rounds like the old days, checking the walls and hide-y holes for geckos, bugs and whatnot. Didn't find any, but she's on the lookout!

She started initiating play-fights with my husband when he walks by.

Last night she threw a toy mouse out of her bed and chased it around for 15 minutes. No catnip was involved! I keep finding her 3 mice in different places so she has been entertaining herself while we're away.

The only change has been the Blue. She's re-energized and engaged. I thought she was bored, old, and sleeping her life away; who knew it was a nutrition problem? Thanks BLUE BUFFALO for reviving and rejuvenating our sweet Kitty!

product_title: Tropiclean Fresh Breath Plaque Remover Pet Water Additive 33.8oz
review_headline: Aloe Vera is toxic for cats and dogs!
review_body: I bought this because my cat has horrible breath.  Within 12 hours of adding this to his water (not as much as specified) he began acting very upset, grouchy, and did not want human contact; the complete opposite of his personality. He also had horrible diarrhea that still has not stopped two days after I changed his water (though he has started acting normal again).  It turns out one of the main ingredients in this concoction is aloe vera leaf juice, a plant that the ASPCA says is toxic to cats. I don't know why something that is recommended for pets would have a toxic ingredient in it at all. Do NOT buy this, otherwise you will most likely be cleaning up a lot of cat diarrhea, which smells far worse than bad breath. Trust me.    [...]

product_title: Guardian Gear Polyvinyl Chloride Large Dog Pool, Red/Blue
review_headline: Shorter sides, please, and more room to move
review_body:
I bought the large for my dogs, an elderly LARGE (118 lbs.) German Shepherd, and a 20 lb. Cavachon.

CONS:
The walls are too high for the dogs to get in and out comfortably. The Shepherd can't lift her rear legs that high any more, and the Cavachon has to jump over the side to get in. Also, the water heats up VERY fast. So you have to empty and refill it almost everyday, or it becomes a warm water tub. Barely big enough for the big dog to stand in. She has always loved to turn and splash in her old pools, but there isn't enough room in this pool for that.

PROS:
It is very easy to \\"assemble.\\" Just spread out and fill. Very easy to empty, just unscrew the plug. Great, if you're a camper, like me, and want your dags to have a pool at your camp site.

All in all, I'm disappointed because my \\"kids\\" aren't excited by their new pool. I have used larger kiddie pools, which I reinforced, in the past, and they LOVED them. Not so with this one. My Shepherd goes in, stands there for a few seconds and comes out. My Cavachon just looks over the side. Back to the kiddie pools for us.

product_title: Best Pet Black 42" Triple-Door Suitcase Style Folding Metal Dog Crate with Metal Pan - 42"(l) x 27"(w) x 30"(h)
review_body:
Both doors are right handed. I.e., as you are looking at them, the hinges are on the right and they open outward, swinging to the right. This matters if you want the crate against a particular wall and you want the door to open against the wall.

Doors are in one end and one side, and on top, should you want access from the top.

The metal pan is 26\\"x41\\" in size and makes a LOT of noise against the wire mesh bottom of the crate as the dog moves about. Our smaller crate had a plastic pan and didn't make that much noise.

If you cut a piece of foam or carpet and place it inside the crate but under the pan, the noise goes almost completely away. I cut the 3/4\\" thick foam a half inch smaller than the pan so the dog could not reach it to chew it. It also makes the pan a bit \\"cushy.\\"

The pan slides out one end for cleaning and has a retaining clip so the dog cannot push it out from inside.

Each door has two latches on it. Sets up and folds easily and has a carry handle that slips onto the mesh where you want it. A bit heavy and definitely large, but it's also roomy and he's taken to it already with no problems.
