Sometimes we don't give him these for a few days and we notice more plaque on his teeth. He likes to hide them around the house, and eat them when he gets hungry.

product_title: Multipet's Wiggly Giggly 6-Inch Bone is a Whimsical, Polyvinyl Dog Toy
review_body: This was the worst waste of money I have ever encountered on amazon. This toy is advertised for dogs when it obviously does NOT stand up to dog teeth. Two minutes into playing with this toy and it was punctured and didn't make noise anymore. My dog is not a chewer it was just from typical run around and shake it play that this toy broke under. My advice never purchase one of these even if you have a toy breed they are crap toys and I am quite irritated at this wasted expense.

product_title: Aottop Dog Rope Toys Rope Dog Chew Toys, Puppy Chew Teething Rope Toy, Pets Puppy Dog Pet Rope Toys For Small and Medium Dogs
review_body: I think that the sliding circles are to loose. You can shake them back and forth like a rattle. My dog, after playing with it once, he is able to grab the snacks on the spot. There are other snack toy out there if you want to challenge your dog and occupy your dogs time.

product_title: Zoo Med Reptivite
review_body: Vitamins for my Leopard Geckos.  I just put it in a small tupperware container, and put my crickets or meal worms in with it for a little while before I feed my lizards.  They eat everything just the same, so I guess it's lizard approved too.

product_title: Andis ProClip  Speed Detachable Blade Clipper, Professional Animal Grooming
review_body: This clippers handled shaving my Great Pyrenees so I'm confident they are capable of shaving any dog. The extremely long cord is handy and very heavy duty. Make sure that you buy cooling spray because the clippers do get warm. I would purchase these clippers again, one more shaving and they will have more than paid for themselves in grooming fees.

product_title: Sentry Calming Collar for Cats
review_headline: A miracle for my anxious cat
review_body:
I've bought 3 calming collars and I can't give enough praise for this product. I was very weary about using these since reviews seem to say their either work wonderfully or don't work at all. After months of going insane, I gave this a try. I adopted a cat who would cry for no reason in the middle of the night and in the early morning (plenty of food, checked out with the vet, lots of playtime in the evening and before bed). He would also howl by our front door when he sniffed any of the neighborhood cats outside. I was getting barely a few hours of sleep at night and ready to rip my hair out until I tried this collar. Within a day or so of putting this collar on, my cat's demeanor changes completely. The crying is reduced significantly and he is overall much calmer and happier, which makes me much calmer and happier! I only wish the effects lasted longer than 30 days. My cat has grown a bit dependent on the calming effects of the collar but at least Amazon has it for $10, rather than $15 at pet stores.

I personally really like the smell of the collar. As everyone else has mentioned, the powder on the collar IS NOT the phermone. The powder is dandruff-like and will get everywhere your cat sleeps until it's completely flaked off so beware. And it comes in the correct position, not backwards like it looks! My cat hates collars but I put this one on very loosely and he's fine. Putting it on loosely also compensates for the fact that the collar isn't actually breakaway. Love this collar and would recommend anyone with an anxious cat to give this a shot.

product_title: Andis Ultra Edge Size
review_body: Bought two sets of clippers before this and they were ok for alittle while but after a few uses just didn't do the job anymore.  I have 2 dogs that need clipping one is a big Cocker Spaniel and she has really thick curly hair the other clippers just would not go through that hair.  These do a really nice job.  I bought an extra blade to cut my little Yorkies hair a little longer, and the normal blade for clipping a close cut on the cocker.  I gave it a 4 star because they do get alittle hot when your doing a big job but the cooling spray helps.  You just have to keep an eye on that as to not make the dogs uncomfortable while using them.  Would recomend these clipper---don't waste your money on the cheaper ones.

product_title: The Original Pet Net Barrier
review_body:
I ordered the Pet Net thinking if it didn't work, I wouldn't be out much money. We have a German Shepherd who thinks he belongs up in the front seat. Not! We normally crate him when traveling but it was getting to be a bit much lifting him up onto the back seat platform of the truck. We discovered he can jump up into the truck if the platform isn't used but we needed a way to keep him in the back, not up front. We took our first trip this weekend with the Pet Net and it worked terrific. Our dog respected the boundary he was given and didn't try to get through the net, even though it doesn't go all the up to the ceiling. With his dog bed on the back floor and the Pet Net between us, it turned out to be an enjoyable trip. Plus it was super easy to install. Now to see how it works in our Jeep Grand Cherokee!

** Update on Sept 17, 2012 ***

We liked our Pet Net so much, we just bought a second one. We were swapping the first one back and forth between our 2006 Ford F550 truck and 1999 Jeep Grand Cherokee and felt it was well worth purchasing a second one. It is easy to set up, but for the money, why not get 2?! The Pet Net is a great product and I highly recommend it for anyone contemplating getting a pet restrainment system.

product_title: Yeowww! Catnip Toy, Yellow Banana
review_body: My two cats really are obsessed with the larger Yeoww products - especially the rainbows and the bananas. They are both attracted to the banana and bite, lick, and rabbit kick it daily. The banana shows the wear easily though as my cats lick the product, as they do because they love the catnip inside, the saliva mixes through the banana's skin with the catnip inside and consequently, the banana turns greenish and is not very pleasant looking. I wish the skin was a little tougher as it gets punctured by their canines during play attacks and there is a bit of leakage of the catnip powder. I would definitely buy one per cat as they will fight over it (definitely at first) and be prepared to replace them as they do get a bit gross after a while. 4 stars for the leaking catnip powder and greenish color changing, otherwise 5 stars.

product_title: ScoopFree Litter Tray Refills with Premium Blue Crystals - Pack of 6
review_headline: Crystal will be all over your house
review_body:
Our cat somehow drags these crystals out of the box and all over our house every single day. We vacuum constantly but nothing seems to work. And our cat doesn't even cover his poop. He does his business and then scratches the inside of the machine not even touching the litter. Yes, somewhat strange behavior.

So there is no logical reason why this litter sticks to his feet and finds its way all over the carpet and tile everywhere in our home...but it does. We step on it every single day and it hurts and is pretty disgusting knowing it is possibly urine or feces-coated litter we're stepping on.

There doesn't seem to be a perfect automatic litter box out there. This one has its advantages but the litter all over our home is enough to have us searching right now for a new machine.

product_title: Catit Design Senses Grass Garden Kit 1x70g
review_body: On the first go, I followed the instructions as specified, using all of the vermiculite and seeds at once.  All that I got was moldy seeds.  After reading some reviews, I tried just using about 1/3 of both the vermiculite and seeds, which worked like a charm.

product_title: Multipet Plush Dog Toy
review_body: My dog loves to chew these apart and pull out the stuffing. I just put the stuffing back in till the toy gets too used and then give her a new one in a few days. She also loves the squeekers also...

product_title: Clear Pond Sludge Buster Blocks, 8 1-Ounce Pack
review_headline: These are so simple to use & they work!
review_body: I love it that you just toss these into your pond or in my case, pond and pondless waterfall,,, they do a super job of helping keep my water nice & clean!

product_title: Everlasting Fire Plug
review_body: My 30 lb 17 week old puppy loves this toy. I almost didn't buy it because... face it... the price is pretty steep. However, it looked more difficult than the options I had in the store at the time, so I splurged on it. I don't regret it at all. He LOVES this this. He is able to carry it around in different positions, he can insert some of his lower jaw into the bottom opening to try to fish the treats out, he enjoys rolling it around, and he really loves the chicken flavored everlasting treat at the other end. He hasn't damaged the rubber, even at its weakest points (at least, not yet, but he's only had it a week). I'm watching him play with it right now and he has been focused on it for the last 30 minutes. It's a keeper!

product_title: K&H Manufacturing Bolster Couch
review_body: I have an 12 year old 90lb lab/collie mix who has arthritis and I have been trying beds for him.  They invariably flatten out under his weight.  So far this has not flattened and he can snuggle into it and have his head on the bolster, which helps him breathe better.  I bought a second one for our 80# Great Dane/pointer mix and she is the same way: she can curl up and be supported.  Great bed, especially for such a great price for a large breed dog bed!

product_title: Artemis Fresh Mix Adult Cat Formula - 5 lb
review_body: I just purchased this brand about 2 weeks ago. I was previously feeding my cats Taste of the Wild and it recently got recalled; I was unsure where to turn to because most Grocery stores only sell grain ridden processed food. This food however, is grain free and holistic and you can tell when you check the ingredients on the bag. My one cat is a real finicky eater and refuses a lot of food, she LOVES this stuff, she gobbles it up. I think its a great product for the price and you can tell my cats are eating healthy food, their hair and eyes are shiny and bright.Pick up a bag, its worth every penny.

product_title: Living World Jumbo Rope & Block Chime
review_body: I have to re-arrange my Macaw's area over the weekend to fit this in..  Having purchased so many XL toys, this will stand up to the bite and appears that it will last a while.  I believe in toys, toys and more toys to keep my \\"budgie\\" happy and in full feather.

product_title: FURminator deShedding Tool for Cats
review_body: This actually works! We have a short hair mixed breed who sheds constantly (she must have some Siamese in her - Siamese are notorious shedders) are this really helps to get a lot of her loose fur out - a lot better than any and all brushes that we have tried.

product_title: Puppia Authentic Diamond Harness B, Medium, Black
review_body:
My dog, half yorkie, half Pom weighs 8.6 pounds. He ALWAYS takes a medium in the harnesses. This harness was more the size of a small. Make sure that you order up one size.

As far as the harness goes, as always, well made and smart looking.

product_title: Frontline Plus Flea and Tick Control for Cats and Kittens, 6 MO. SUPPLY
review_body:
I've always found Frontline to work very well, but this particular pack had some of the tubes already loose from the blister pack, and one one of the tubes', it appeared that there was no fluid in it at all.

We tried this over three months on two cats, and did not even see so much as a sick flea - we saw no reduction in fleas at all.

We just ordered Advantage II - it was packaged perfectly and within less than a day we are finding dead and dying fleas.

With the success we have previously had with Frontline, I am just suspicious about the authenticity of the item we received.

I will be ordering directly from reputable suppliers only from now on.

product_title: Wahl #30 Torsion Spring Replacement Blade
review_body: We shave our cats once a year and the old blade wasn't cutting it anymore.  Bought these blades and they cut the cats' hair with ease.

product_title: MidWest Homes for Pets Dog Crate Replacement Pans
review_body: The pan that came with dog's three year old crate started cracking where it rested on the wires of the bottom of the crate.  I ordered this to replace the cracked one.  It was exactly what it said it was.  It fit perfectly.  It wasn't too expensive and it arrived in a timely manner.

product_title: Vittles Vault II Pet Food Container
review_body:
I'm very container-friendly, I guess you can say. I like to be organized and take advantage of a space. My room isn't small but I would hate to see the bag of dog food I had in there all lopsided. It threw off the cleanliness of the rest of the room. Adding this to my room has been a real nice visual touch. I'm more aware of when it's time to buy more food and it's also kept the food very fresh; no ants or anything have ever come close. The lid is very, very well sealed. One of the best investments I've made so far in providing for my beautiful dogs!

*UPDATE- 5/5/14*

Two years later and I'm still using the same container! In fact, I bought another one. I got a third dog and switched foods, so I require more food now. I have NEVER had any ants or other insects inside, which is awesome. However, depending on which food you use, it won't hold 40 pounds. With [[ASIN:B00HM9OX3M WHOLE EARTH ADULT 30LB]], I would hold 35 lbs. (the bag used to come in that weight). Now, with [[ASIN:B006H7CRQA Select Adult Dry Dog Food Size: 6-lb]], I can fit a 30 comfortably. Yes, there's some space left but anymore would feel too close to the lid. Not a big deal, just noting a slight discrepancy in the description. This won't keep me from purchasing again if need be.

product_title: Kaytee Run-about Mini 5" Exercise Ball, Clear
review_body:
I know that alot of you are going to say.... \\"Oh well just a couple of bad reviews.... what's the differance???\\"

Well...... Here's the differance!

I got this ball and right away i put mr. hammington in it and he was kind of confused. We let him roll around in the living room and about five minutes later the top came off and luckily i dont have a SMART hamster! So he did not escape.... But later on i tried this out while there was no hamster in it and i was just pushing it around on his little track that i got at petco and the track is good but if your hamster is really fast dont waste youre money because he/she will fly off.... jk. but they may fall off the track!

Now back on to the ball... The ball opened again and by now i was really mad! So i took it downstairs and my mom looked at it and we figured out you do not twist the top left ( This will make it looser, and more likely to fall off after a little bit )you twist it right but the peg that holds the top on it was a little too close to the hole and we figured five bucks isn't worth losing a hamster for....and we took it back and well we are going to get something that isnt going to kill/harm or lose our/my hamster!

It may only be ok if youre hamster is very well trained and well trust worthy.... OR you can just use it in a playpen!

IF YOU USE IT IN A PLAYPEN IT IS A GREAT BALL< WELL KIND OF ALL OF THEM (BALLS) ARE THE SAME!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!

product_title: Pet Food Storage and Server
review_body: i have 2 of these sets and was ECSTATIC to get them! i have a problem with 1. water damage on the lid/top. youd think with this thing being $40 they would have waterproofed the top of it, given it is made to hold a bowl of water. 2. around the bowls, water gets under there and drips into the storage and it caused the same water damage and warped it. i cant store anything in there, for fear it would mold. it seems to ALWAYS be wet. although i love how they look, they are appearing to be more of a hassle than helpful. they are a GREAT height for my dogs but thats about it. i dont necessarily recommend this product. NOTE: i have only had this 1 month.

product_title: Allersearch Laboratories Pet+: Anti-Allergen Pet Shampoo, 16 oz.
review_body: I've used this on my dogs for the past couple months and I love it! It really helps with my allergies. It smells kind of like Tea Tree Oil, which some people have an aversion to, but it doesn't bother me. My dogs hate getting a bath as much as with any other shampoo, but I look forward to it now. And one of my dogs has slightly sensitive/dry skin and it doesn't bother her. Not to say it will work on every dog, but it works miracles for us!

product_title: Carefresh Ultra Pet Bedding 50 LITER
review_body: This product is great!  I buy it for my niece's hamster, Muffin, so that my 11 year old niece doesn't have to spend her good grade money on it!  She likes this brand as it keeps Muffin's hamster palace smelling nice and fresh for a whole week!  She changes Muffin's bedding every Sunday afternoon after church. It's a big pricey, but worth it!  :-)

product_title: Jolly Pets Monster Ball Dog Toy
review_body: This is a good treat ball, which can hold about a cup of food or treats.  If intended for food it may have too wide a mouth opening - my dog's food came through far too easily and made me look elsewhere.  My dog definitely enjoyed it but it really needs to be filled with treats to be a challenge.  However it has survived a mastiff puppy - so it is a pretty solid toy.  I have been satisfied with this product.

product_title: Protective Collar for Cats and Dogs
review_body:
My dog had surgery for removal of cysts under her chin and on her leg. She was SO unhappy with the plastic cone and in fact, had figured out how to get it off.

While this product is probably better for some smaller breeds, my dog is a 50 lbs Dobie mix with long legs and it has definitely limited access to her wounds. She cannot scratch her chin area at all. And she LOVES it. She is so glad to be free of the plastic cone, she actually struts in her new doughnut.

The plastic collar scared her, made visibility very limited and was horribly uncomfortable. Her vision is not impaired at all by the Pro Collar, it is comfortable for her to wear and she sleeps soundly. She has been wearing this for 6 days and has not touched her bandages yet; paws crossed!

You do have to blow it up once in a while, but it isn't a big deal or difficult to do. I do wonder why it couldn't be made wider for larger breeds; seems that would be very effective.

product_title: Our Pet's Play-N-Squeak "Mouse Hunter" Cat Toy
review_body: The cat however won't have anything to do with it.  I think she is afraid of it. She tapped it a few times, cocked her head to one side when it squeaked, and really scrutinized it from all angles; but ultimately is happy to just leave it alone.  I suspect she isn't all that keen on catnip either. Seems like all the cat toys have catnip in them. I'd buy it for another cat, just not ours.

product_title: Van Ness CP7 Enclosed Cat Pan/Litter Box, Extra Large
review_body: Received the litter box very quickly and was pleased with the size of it.  I have a very large cat so I knew it would be the best choice for him.  The only problem is the front right latch was broken off, so it doesn't close tightly on that side.  I will keep it as it's too big to box up to return.  Disappointed that a new product would come defective!

product_title: AETERTEK AT-216 WATERPRROF 550 METER RANGE REMOTE CONTROL DOG SHOCK COLLAR TRAINER WITH BEEP SOUND,VIBRATION AND 7 LEVELS OF SHOCK FOR DOG BEHAVIORAL OBEDIENCE TRANING
review_headline: Happy dogs, happier owner with Aetertek Training Collar
review_body:
I have been using the Aetertek AT-216 training collar for almost a month now. I have 3 dogs; 2 terrier mix & 1 lab mix, ranging in weight from 25-60 lbs. & 2 to 10 years in age. I use this collar on all 3 dogs. I love the fact there are 3 types of alerts on the controller; beep, vibrate, and shock. I tried the shock while wearing the collar on my arm and although it got my attention it was more annoying than anything. No pain involved at all. 2 of my dogs responded immediately to the beep, the other took all three alerts to figure it out and now she responds to the beep alone. The system I purchased will support 3 collars and I plan to purchase 2 more soon!

The system is well made and super easy to use & was delivered within 5 days of ordering. I only have to charge it once every 5-7 days, depending on use(charger and nice carrying bag included). The controller comes on a lanyard that easily slips over my head even with my glasses on. It has a small light indicating when it's on and ready to use. It's only a little bigger than my cell phone, although it's thicker it is lightweight and easy to use. The buttons are well marked and easy to understand. The collar was too long for my needs so I cut it to fit the biggest dog. Again, easy to cut and east to adjust even down to my smallest dog. The collar is made of a better grade vinyl/plastic but I don't leave it on my dogs when they are in the house or in the kennel so it suits me. It also comes with an extra set of contact nodes. The reciever isn't super heavy and the dogs don't seem to mind it at all.

I live in a very small, rural town and like the fact that I can sit on my porch and let the dogs exercise themselves or just roam around around our property without being on a leash. This was far from the most expensive units I looked at but I can't imagine a better one. I am so pleased with this system that my only regret is I didn't try it sooner. If you aren't physically able toproperly exercise your dogs (I have a knee injury) and have the luxury of space for them to run and play, this collar is such a fantastic tool. We have roughly an acre of property and open ground beyond that. I haven't tested the collar beyond approx. 100 yards but it did work at that distance. Like I said in the title, happy dogs, happier owner.

product_title: Marineland Penguin Power Filter
review_body: It worked for about a month then I came home from work and it was smoking and where the motor is the plastic around it is melted.. I also run a pet store and I started reading reviews offline and found out that this isn't the first time this has happened with marineland filters. So now my customers only buy fluval and I recommend canister filters for any aquarium 30+ gallons.. I no longer sale these filters and I wish I could get my money back.. what if this had burned my house down with my kids in there.. this is a fire hazard..

product_title: PetSafe Automatic Pet Feeder
review_body: Automatic feeder has changed my relationship with my cat. She is no longer violently waking me up before my alarm clock goes off in order to be fed (which was creating quite a resentful relationship over the years). She now sits patiently by the feeder waiting for the whirling sound which she knows is the source of her next feeding, while I am blissfully asleep.  Surprisingly, she has not learned to rotate the dish with her paw to get to the next bowl, which was my main concern when deciding whether or not to purchase this item. Ultimately, I am very pleased with my purchase. Only reason I did not give it 5 stars is because I noticed the unit has recently started to occasionally make two rotations at its scheduled time, instead of just one.  It's very sporadic, but I have noticed its happened more than once.  Since its past the return date on Amazon, I've written to PetSafe directly to see if they will honor the one year warranty they offer on their products. Stay tuned.

product_title: 8-Gallon Extra Large Pet Food Dispenser (Clear Container with White Lid) (20"H x 10"W x 19"D)
review_body: Exactly what I needed. Strong and sturdy product, that is keeping a HUGE bag of cat food fresh. Shipment arrived on time.

product_title: Marineland C-Series Multi-Stage Canister Filter
review_body: This is a pretty good pump, kept my 26 gal reef tank looking good, no problems with flow. The only complaint I have is the seal can be a little tricky once you put the pump back together after cleaning it. All in all a good purchase and I would recommend to a friend. Also, Marineland is an excellent company that I have used for years.

product_title: Doggie Walk Bags Classic Baby Powder Box Blue, 70 Pop-Out Bags
review_body: We started buying these in Jan and we love them! They are large enough to pretty much pick up any size of poop my pup can generate. The handles are nice as it makes the bags very easy to turn inside out, tie, and then to hold on to until I can get to a garbage can. The scented feature is a huge plus. Would definitely recommend.

product_title: Vo-toys  Animal Chatter Talking Plush Toy  65205
review_headline: Good service but needs better description
review_body: When I originally ordered I thought (incorrectly) that all 6 were part of the deal then only the ape arrived. It was so cute that I ordered one for a friend except the pig arrived. I am not sure how to figure out how you get what and wish I could. I'd like to order another but do not want another pig or ape. If you don't mind getting surprised they really are wonderful toys. I have two dachshunds that just love them.

product_title: Petmate Scratch Post Jute Refill, Lean on me
review_body: My cat loves to scratch this material. Great product that lasts and does not make a mess like some of the carpet or cardboard scratch posts.

product_title: BarkOff Platinum Ultrasonic Dog Training Aid (SET OF 2)
review_body:
First time I tried it, it didn't seem to work. But, tried it a few days later and with it in my pocket, I went up to our neighbors barking dogs and they stopped barking and ran off.
Triedit again and the same thing happened, so worked like a charm.. NOw when the dogs see me, they don't bark at all! Thanks.

product_title: API Water Softener Pillow
review_body:
In order for this product to work effectively and efficiently it must be placed in the path of water flow. I suggest placing it inside your filter for best results. Within 48 hours this product worked as advertised. After 48 hours it must be recharged in a specific salt solution. Once you have made this solution you can contiue using the same solution until the pads no longer work. I have used and recharged this product 3 individual times and it continues to work as advertised.

As long as you use this product as instructed you will be satisfied with the results. If you do it any other way you will end up writing a negative review.

product_title: Petsafe HDT11-11049 Little Dog Remote Trainer
review_body: The collar arrived quickly and came with complete instructions. I could barely feel the #1 setting, so I started there on my miniture Schnauzer. She couldn't feel #1 either, but responded immediately when we got to #3. She is a perfect dog when on a leash, but totally ignores me when not leashed. She has a powerfull chasing instinct, and will run 200 yards down to the road to chase a car. I'm hoping that I can get her to stop chasing cars before she gets killed, and now I have a better chance.

product_title: Hartz Wood and Sisal Twine Medium Bird Toy
review_body: Hi, so I got this toy for my budgie. He loves it! It has ropes that he likes to tear up and he also likes to chew on the wood. It is a little too big for budgies but  he likes to swing on it since it is so large. I put this toy in a spot where my budgie could fly onto it and play with it. I also like the look of it. The picture amazon gives you does it no good. It looks very nice and colorful in real life. I  Recommend this toy for any playful Cockatiel, Budgie, Conure, Love Bird, Amazon Parrot, African Grey or any other small/medium bird.

product_title: Seachem Flourish 500ml
review_headline: be cafefull how much you use
review_body: This is an awsome product when it comes to plant nutrients but be carefull.. The bottle says to treat 1-2 times a week.. I had a planted tank with about 5 medium sized plants and it was going good for months but the plants were starting to change colors and wilt. So i picked up some seachem, and the plants popped right back to life. Then about 2 weeks into treatment my tanks bloomed with algae and black beard algae which there is no way to get rid of. I know this product did not cause the black beard algae but by treating twice a week there was so much extra nutrients that the algae took off and out of control.. SO be warned, use this product as needed not as suggested on the bottle.. it wont take much to over do it..

product_title: FURminator deShedding Tool for Dogs
review_body: The FURminator deShed Tool model (Dog MED/ORG) for short hair dogs is the best comb and grooming tool I have ever owned. I use it on my two beagles and my two Jack Russell terriers. It is the best!!!

product_title: Zymox Ear Cleanser With Bio-Active Enzymes, 4 oz.
review_body:
I do not write many reviews but I must say this product has stopped my Pugs ear infections with use twice a week. I do not know what is in it but my Pug went from ear infection to ear infection and this all stopped after using this product for about a month. We now use it to maintain keeping his ears clean and as long as I am diligent about using it twice a week no issues or trips to the vet.

Update after two years my Pug has not had single ear infection using this once a week. Has saved me a lot of money on vet bills and has saved a lot of suffering for my Pug highly recommend

product_title: the Original CLAWGUARD - The Ultimate Door Scratch Shield - Door and Door Frame Protection
review_body:
Was just looking for a door guard online .... Was not sure what was available but found yours in amazon . I chose yours based on the reviews and that it went over the door handle, and came off easily. .

I also like that it had a side that made
Noise To deter them from scratching further.

All of my doors are scratched from our two lovely pugs !!

Now our new home is protected !!

Has worked great . Really covered the area perfectly and now we have two good dogs and a very happy door !!

Also it comes with a little velcroe piece that holds it in place when u are using it !! Very handy so the guard does not slide all over while the dogs are scratching .

We use ours on our font door and it is great !!

Hope this helps and thank you

Ara Marshall

product_title: Hugs Pet Products Apple Chew Toy
review_body: I have a black lab mix and a cattle dog mix and they broke them apart on their first go.  I don't know if it is due to poor craftsmanship or my dogs chewed hard but I am not satisfied.

product_title: PetSafe Gentle Spray Bark Collar for Dogs, Citronella, Anti-Bark Device, Water Resistant
review_body: Due to all the other wonderfully positive reviews, I decided to try this bark collar for my maltipoo.  He already has an invisible fence collar which he NEVER sets off but I didn't want to confuse him by getting any kind of vibration or zapping collar.  This collar works wonderfully.  Literally the first time he wore it, he barked once and never again!  I couldn't get over it.  His trigger is the doorbell and the UPS delivery man.  If he sees his truck and then he rings the bell, he goes ballistic.  Then when I try to bring the package in, he tries to attack the packages!  It's a crazy ritual that had become unbearable.  Especially because I order a lot from Amazon and I get a good amount of packages.  I can now bring in my packages and he just sits there, he doesn't bark and he doesn't go into his attack frenzy mode.  I honestly feel this is a miracle.  And I love the fact that it's safe and perfect for a small dog.  Now I can relax if someone comes to the door and rings the bell.  People will think we got rid of our dog he's so quiet.  But it's such a pleasure.  I do hope eventually he will not bark when the collar is not on because right now he still knows he can bark if he isn't wearing it and I don't have him wear it all day or when he's outside wearing his invisible fence collar.

product_title: PetFusion SmartGrip Cat Litter Mat. Large (35 x 24 inches). Safe for your cats, free from Phthalates & VCM
review_body:
I purchased 2 of the Pet Fusion Smart Grip Cat Litter Mats, since I was tired of using a towel (raggy ones dedicated to litter duty.)
I am very pleasantly surprised. The mat is large enough to be under a larger litter pan, and leave enough space to catch ALL of the loose pieces of litter. So I like that litter doesn't scatter all over my floors. I also like that the mat is washable with a hose and soap. The towels would absorb urine and then smell the heck into the laundry load. Even though they were washed separately.

I like the appearance of the mats, but I should have picked the tans!! my colors are warmer and it would have been a nicer mix. If I ever needed more I would not hesitate to buy these again. My guess is that they will last a pretty long time.

The mat is thick and rolls out nicely and just lays there. Very obedient, no curling edges snarling at you. Looks and feels like a quality mat, one that I could not find locally in any pet store or box store.

product_title: Life-Glo Ii Fluorescent Bulb T5
review_body: I bought this for my Hagen Glo T5HO light fixture. It has nice color and works great for my aquarium plants. Not much else to say. Great product!

product_title: Prevue Pet Products Parakeet Twig Large Bird Hut
review_headline: Great product, But birds can chew though the botton!
review_body: The nest was great, by my parekkets loved to chew on the bottom! and then a week later, a huge hole was on the bottom i fixed it with sticks and now it looks better. I would recommend, just make sure they dont make a hole!

product_title: Innotek Automatic No-Bark Dog Collar, BC-50B.
review_body: This comes with a 6volt battery, but I almost threw it away due to packaging.  Once inserted into the big box housing, its a simple screw to secure everything in place.  The collar is long enough to fit around my bulldogs giant neck, but doens't have so much excess that it's a safety hazard.  My gripe is that the box has a light on it and no matter which way I had the battery face, it did not light up.  How do I know if this thing even is doing what it's supposed to???

product_title: Animal Essentials Fish Oil Plus, Omega 3 Supplement for Dogs & Cats (90 Capsules)
review_body: I noticed that my dog was occasionally lifting it's hind leg when running around. I did some research and many websites advised to give glucosamine treats with fish oil to help heal the joints. Since I have done so, my dog is running around at full speed again and I have not seen her limping. She eats these from my hand as a treat a few times a day. They are also pretty cool looking--little blue fish. I would recommend this if your dog is starting to develop joint problems--I heard it's good for the coat too, but I did not purchase this product for that.

product_title: Mutt Mitt Dog Waste Pick Up Bag
review_body:
I have ordered from Amazon many times and this is just another of the products I've tried that has lived up to my picky expectations. Since I use it several times a day, every day.....I am totally satisfied and will be ordering Mutt Mitt for the lifespan of my dog! I know it's going to sound corny but I keep one in my pocket at all times (folds up nice and flat) since I don't want to need one and not have it with me.

It is through Amazon that I found the lowest prices.

product_title: Bike Balance Dog Jogger Kit
review_headline: good for running off toxic energy.
review_body: Have a 1 year old high energy poodle. I run him 1-2 miles a day average 6-8 MPH. The bungie cord reduced his ability to pull me off balance. I like this product and will recomend for other high energy dog owners.

product_title: Arm & Hammer Ultra Last Clumping Litter for Cats, 28-Pound
review_body: Unlike other reviewers, the scent of the litter didn't bother me at all. I don't think it smells anything like ammonia, and I had no problem with it clumping like normal clumping litter. In fact, I thought it was pretty great until...I noticed my cat was losing fur on all four of his legs. Not sure if he was doing it to himself (constantly licking/chewing to clean off the litter) or if it was an allergic reaction. I immediately switched back to \\"Arm & Hammer Double Duty\\" and his fur is slowly coming back in. My other cat was totally fine. So whether or not you like this stuff probably depends on you and your cat's tolerance of the strong scent.

product_title: Advantage Kit Refill for Dogs and Cats 4.0ml Tube
review_body: I bought the original kit from this vendor for use on a 10 lb cat and a Silky Terrier, and neither of them suffered any ill effects from having this applied. I had some concerns after a reviewer in the section for the original kit (with the glass vial) pointed out these pipettes of Advantage show indications of being what is considered counterfeit in that they say 10 percent imidicloprid, not 9.1 percent. My pipettes show the same 10 percent which indicates this is either repackaged or not from the US. But it was working on my cat's fleas with no side effects, so I decided to take a chance on another pipette. It still works. I had let a little time go by since the last dose, wondering if I should switch her to the new OTC fipronil product instead, but I noticed flea dust on her belly and decided not to keep dithering about it and put this product on her again. Flea dust disappeared, kitty stopped scratching, no side effects. I am leaning towards thinking this might be actual Advantage from overseas. Full disclosure, I have been erring on the side of caution with the dosing. There are guidelines according to weight, but there is a big jump between dosing for cats under 10 lbs and cats over 10 lbs. My cat is barely over 10 lbs so I give her a .70ml dose rather than the recommended .80. Also, I have noticed that this only seems to work temporarily on the little dog. Unlike the kitty, his fleas return inside a week. This definitely works best on the cat and I will keep buying this for her. The dog is going to need another solution.

product_title: Hippie the Hippo Bite Meez Dog Toy
review_headline: This toy was my dogs favorite!
review_body:
This is a great dog toy. I recommend this toy to every pet owner. It was my dogs favorite, and really brought out her wild side!!
I threw it out after it finally got too worn out. Never did I think I would never be able to find one again. This is a question for the seller: when will there be more? Why was such an amazing dog toy discontinued? Why hasnt anyone else been making something like this?

product_title: Reptomin Fish Food
review_body: Cheaper than the pet store prices. My turtle loves it. the only downfall was that when i got it in the mail, the top was cracked and the food fell out and was in the bottom of the package but everything else is fine.

product_title: Pet Trex Dual Door Live Animal Trap Racoon Skunk Cat Traps, 26"
review_body: The seller was great, shipped fast, this trap however is NOT good to catch cats. They will go half way in with their body holding the door open, then eat the food and back out. In the morning, you have a empty trap with no bait. It is a nice trap though, maybe to catch smaller animals....rabits or somthing? NOT cats though! Also the seller processed my refund fast and paid for return shipping, so not all bad.

product_title: Ruff Riders Roadie Canine Vehicle Safety and Training Harness - Size Large
review_body: I think this is a great seatbelt harness and definitely keeps my dog safe in the car. I like the fact that my dog can sit, stand, or lie down using the harness.  I originally got the size that he measured for and it was too tight on him, so I did have to order a size larger and it fits him well.  I find it easy to put on/take off and easy to use in the car.

product_title: Best Choice Products Pet Puppy Dog Playpen Exercise Pen Kennel 600d Oxford Cloth
review_body: I tried this product w/ 2 dogs and was very dissatisfied. The pen is not stable at all the dog  can nt b active w/o the pen caving in. Because the bottom is nt secure. They were able to get out. I really feel like i  wasted my money bc its just sitting in the box for no usage

product_title: Petco White Aquarium Sand, 20 lbs.
review_body: almost didnt order because there are no reviews or anything about this sand, but glad that i did.  Its nice and white like beach sand but the sand itself is a little larger in size. still looks good, this bag almost filled the bottom of my 55 gal aquarium. freshwater or salt

product_title: Epica Remote Dog Training Collar Shock and Vibration for 2 Dogs, Provides Safe but Annoying Static Stimulation- Ability to Shock or Vibrate Each Dog Separately
review_headline: Why didn't we do this sooner!?!
review_body:
Granted, we have only had the devices for a day now but, there has been an immediate affect on our household. We have two female JRT's that have recently started fighting for dominace. They were easy to assemble, fit our 15-18lb dogs perfectly and the way the remotes work is very easy, anyone could do it. Now, as long as we don't let them go swimming with them on, I think we are set.

product_title: EZ Dog Pet Toothpaste - 2.5 ounce
review_body: My dog enjoys the taste of this toothpaste so much that she allows me to brush her teeth without any protest. This has not been the case with any other product.

product_title: Bigeloil Horse Liniment

review_body:
A friend told me her husband got relief from knee pain with Bigeioil.

Ted

product_title: SmartCat Bootsie's Three-in-One Cat Scratcher
review_body: i'm sorry to say that neither of my two cats have given this product more than a cursory once over since we got it around 10 days ago, nevemind use it for its intended purpose. they are both horizontal scratchers. basically, if its on the floor, its fair game. but not this thing! i tried placing it in their favorate scratching places, rubbed it with regular catnip + even tried Catit Liquid Catnip (see my review for that!) once, my older cat laid down on it + fell asleep like it was a floor level window sill but no action whatsoever since that thrilling performance. what a waste of money!

product_title: Zoo Med PowerSun UV Mercury Vapor Lamp 100 Watts
review_body: This thing is garbage. It gives off no real heat & it only lasted 3 months. This light sucks. Should not have ignored the bad reviews.

review_body: Big enough that my dog can't eat it in five minutes thank goodness. Sometimes she doesn't ever finish it in one setting. Came as described in decent time. Great deal!

product_title: Purina Friskies Classic Pate Seafood Variety Pack Wet Cat Food - 32 -5.5 oz. Cans
review_body: the packaging for this cat food was great, im not going to say that this stuff is amazing because in reality it not.  it like feeding your cats mcdonalds, but i have three cats and i split one can between all them as a treat they go nuts for it!!!! they are a fairly large can at 5.5oz and it being only $0.55 a can i haven't come across anything better.i feed my cats science diet dry cat food for their regular, so like i said this stuff is just like a treat.

product_title: ROYAL CANIN FELINE HEALTH NUTRITION Special 33 dry cat food
review_body: I have the pickiest cat on the planet and 12 years ago I mentioned to a pet store clerk that I couldn't get my cat to eat the same dry food more than 3 days in a row and she recommended I try the Royal Canin Special 33 formula.  The cat loved it and has eaten it every day for the last 12 years (he's 14 now).  It's priced higher than regular store brands but to me it's worth paying the extra money.

product_title: Four Paws 3-In-1 Pet stroller and Carrier
review_body: We purchased this at the last minute when it was necessary to take our 14-lb terrier mix to Las Vegas with us for a seminar we were attending.  Our dog, Wally, took right to it.  He napped in it while we were attending one of the seminars and just sat there as proud as can be while we strolled him about.  We easily had 100 people stop us and ga-ga over him & his 'wheels'.  The only complaint I have is that it isn't that easy to collapse and I did a number on my finger (pinch) when I was closing it.  Our grandchildren like to walk him too and I'll feel much more comfortable with them pushing him in this than trying to control him on a leash, particularly when we're in a crowded setting.  Wally is also not a marathon walker and this is especially good for those times when we're out doing lots of walking.  I recommend it.  Just be careful folding it up.

product_title: Himalayan Dog Chew
review_body: I have tried all kinds of chews to try and keep my Pomeranian and Chihuahua busy and entertained. They eat every other chew way too quickly! These chews are great! They last for a very long time and my dogs keep going back to them. I'm back to order more so I always have these in stock! Being a veterinary technician, I have witnessed firsthand the dangers of rawhide chews. So I was always hesitant to give them to my small dogs for fear that they might become obstructed and need surgery. I feel so much better giving these to my dogs because they don't break off chunks. As the description states they soften a little and simply get smaller in size as your dog scrapes off bits with their teeth.  And when it gets small enough to become a hazard I just throw it away. I'm so glad I gave these a try!

product_title: 80" Premium Extra Large Cat Tree
review_body:
I was excited about this product because I have 3 cats at home, two of which are kinda sluggish and overweight and constantly look bored. The other is our feisty active kitty, so I figured this would provide enough activity for our active one and hopefully encourage the other two to become more active. Not so. The box arrived in an adequate amount of time, and I was excited to get it all put together. The fabric was VERY soft... but the excitement ended at about the second level of assembly. The cats do not use it, it leans, the house is NOT secure (it wobbles back and if pushed will lift up) I don't know why I don't send it back.
