PLEASE unless this thing gets some MAJOR improvements (because the idea is great I would LOVE it had it been more sturdy and at least been inspected to make sure it is correctly proportioned)

PLEAASE don't waste your time or money...

product_title: GMI PetShield Mesh Travel Barrier
review_headline: So so gate for my ford escape
review_body: Yes it does the job but I will probably could have bought something better. The plastic suction cup are not great at all.

product_title: Vibran-Sea Melon Leaf Flowering Cluster Aquarium Plant Assortment
review_headline: What actually arrived was a different color.
review_body: I wanted to let potential buyers know about a color difference in these plants. The long, slender \\"eel plant\\" shown in Amazon's image is a bright, vivid purple. It is one of the reasons I decided to order these plants. When I received the item, the plant was actually green (see my product image). It was a huge let-down cause I looked forward to the bright purple color. I put it in the water and it flopped over right away. The white plant did stand upright, the smaller plant may be *too* small (in my 55 gallon), but the green would not stay upright! Expect it to be about 50% shorter in the water. The good news is they do stay put. Only buy if you're okay with plants flopping over in your tank, and beware - your plant may not be purple, either!

product_title: Jolly Pets Push-n-Play 14-Inch
review_headline: Forget the dog, this is MY new favorite
review_body:
So we adopted a rather reserved, but young Australian Cattle Dog in January. I was looking for creative ways to wear him out, heard about herding balls, and I ordered this thing in February. I was disappointed when I tried to introduce him to it, and he wasn't interested and even seemed a little threatened by it. (To be fair, we had to teach him how to fetch too - I think he was cooped up a lot and not exposed to many things in his former life.)

He's come a long way in the last 8 months, and I've tried introducing him to it (rolling it in front of me and encouraging him to go after it) at various points with no success. Today I tried again, and this time he POUNCED. We brought it to an open fenced space across the street, threw the ball, and WOW. I didn't have to teach him anything -- he had a few false starts but by the third time he was bringing the ball back, although he needs more practice steering the ball. When I'm throwing a ball with a chuck-it for this dog, he runs like crazy to get it and then trots back in a very leisurely fashion - this time he was running full speed both ways, so he got tired a lot faster. Not only that, but you could see he was having to think a lot more which is great for wearing out smart dogs like ACDs.

(I tell you the whole story because I know there are other folks out there adopting high energy dogs who might really benefit from this thing - in our case he just needed some time to settle into his new life and get some confidence.)

As for the product itself, it's just like everyone says - nice sturdy plastic, a little heavy even, definitely indestructible as far as this dog is concerned, and I can't imagine even the biggest mastiff or GSD being able to put more than a scratch into it. My guy is only 45 lbs and low to the ground like heelers are, but he can move the 14 inch ball just fine. Because it's so sturdy I wouldn't recommend it for indoor use, but we can use it outside in the dirt,bring it back into our apartment, wipe it off and store it no problem. If you've got a herder, you'll both love this ball. I'm very satisfied with my purchase, even if it's 8 months later! One caution: because this thing is heavy enough to get some momentum, make sure that you're either in a fenced area, or away from roads/cliffs/alligator pits and/or people who don't like it when dogs come running at them full speed - especially when the dog is still learning how to steer!

product_title: Catit Design Senses Grass Garden Kit 1x70g
review_body: Same issue as many other customers here - my grass never sprouted, followed directions exactly at first, then realized that it was being watered too much, so began sprinkling every other day - 2 weeks later, still nothing but moldy seeds.  I dumped the mixture out and am trying to plant some new seeds in miracle grow.  Gave the product two stars b/c the container is decent.

product_title: OMG Pet Urine & Odor Eliminator - 2 lb
review_headline: OMG!  is the best to get rid of pet urine odor
review_body: I have tried many odor eliminators for dog urine and had just about given up on finding a product that would totally eliminate  dog urine odor out of my carpets until I discovered OMG.  It is the best ever.  You just sprinkle it on and let it of to  work. I am so glad I tried it .  It is somewhat  expensive when compared to other products,  but unlike the others it works and a lot cheaper that buying new carpet.  Love Love Love this product.  http://www.amazon.com/gp/product/B005C46V5W/ref=cm_cr_rev_prod_img

product_title: Ceva Feliway Plug-In Diffuser Refill for Cats
review_body: This is a good product. We have 4 inside cats and we keep it upstairs and down. We have one newtered male that bullies the other cats but since feliway he has calmed down a lot. My only concern is the cost, but as long as it helps keep the peace it is worth it.

product_title: Nature's Miracle Stain & Odor Remover
review_body:
This product WORKS!!! the evidence of my cat's behavior problems (aka - his urination on the carpet) is gone. It's not just being hidden by obnoxious perfumes, it's actually GONE!!! It even worked on older stains. You will have to use an ample amount of this product on larger stains - but it's worth it.
BUY THIS PRODUCT!!!

product_title: Grizzly Salmon Oil for Dogs
review_body:
My long haired dachshund is very picky about her kibble. (I'm using Enukunaba dachshund kibble now but before that I tried Blue, Solid Gold, Beneful and a couple of others.) I broke down and bought this,after reading all of those reviews.
Now she gobbles her food down! I will be ordering more from here, it's a miracle worker!

The oil is strong-smelling, but only if you TRY to smell it. The smell doesn't linger much after the dog is done eating. (Except in her mouth! No kisses for you, haha.)

I haven't seen her hair get softer(her hair was soft to begin with) but it seems a lot more easier to comb through and I think the bald spot on her chest is finally growing back!

5 star product!

product_title: Kennel Odor Eliminator - 16 ounce
review_headline: The final solution to cat urine odor!
review_body: Excellent product!  Worked first time on old odours.  Had tried Febreeze, Pine Sol, vinegar, Out!, etc., and nothing worked.  One overnight soak with this and no hint of odour, even after a month.

product_title: 3M Pet Care Liquid Bandage (Spray)
review_body: Our dog had a sore on her leg that wouldn't heal because she kept licking it.  Couldn't bandage it because it was right on a joint.  Liquid bandage solved the problem.  She stopped licking when this stuff was sprayed on, I think because the sore didn't taste interesting anymore with a Liquid bandage barrier on it.  And the wound was protected from any licking by the thin protective layer.  Within ten days of starting with Liquid bandage it healed on its own.  After a few days I didn't even need to spray on every day.

product_title: Little Giant Farm & Ag Rubber Trough-O-Matic Stock Tank Float Valve
review_body: I refused to pay 100 dollars for a plastic float that was especially made for a pool.  As primitive as it may seem we mounted this float to a bucket and set it on the steps of our pool to maintain the water level necessary.  It works great.  We even installed a quick release on the hose to make it easier to move in and out of the pool.

product_title: Frontline Plus Flea and Tick Control for Dogs and Puppies 8 Weeks or Older and Up To 89-132 Pounds, 12 Doses
review_body: I got both the 23-44lb and 89-132lb twelve-packs, and it was a great bargain compared to our Vet and what Walmart is currently asking for. The product itself has given us no issues in over a decade, and even seems to help a little bit with the flies we get around here in the summer.

product_title: Petsafe RFA-450 In-Ground Fence Wire Break Locator / Detector
review_body:
I read the reviews prior to purchasing. Some people claimed they couldn't make the frequency low enough but that didn't matter. There was some music playing through the receiver but I could clearly here the pulse from the invisible fence line when I was over/near it.

I followed the directions and it worked great and was easy to use.

product_title: Paws Republic 3100 Freedom Leash
review_body: This is a good concept but the product is crap.  Right out of the box the lock release button didn't work and one leash did not retract as designed.  The product description said the leash is 10' long but it's much shorter than 10'.  Overall, this is a waste of money because it did not do what it was suppose to do.  Don't waste your money.  I should have heeded the other reviewer's warning.

product_title: Feliway - Refill, 48 ml
review_body: This works well to settle aggression between two of my four cats. I can tell by their behaviors when it is time to replace. Great product

product_title: Matrix, 4 L / 1 gal.
review_body: I have used just about every bio media out there - with over 30 years of fish keeping. For nearly 3 years I've used Seachum Matrix in my 30 gallon tank with spectacular results. I just bought the 1 gallon bucket and filled a Fluval Fx5 for my 210 gallon tank I just setup. Great stuff, I use it in conjunction with another Seachum product -Purigen. Purigen will make your water crystal clear and the Matrix will filter out the rest. Matrix gets rid of nitrates too- something most other bio media doesn't. Do yourself a favor and buy Matrix and Purigen for your filter ( I get purigen in the 100ml bag on amazon). My fish look like they are floating in mid air! Oh, and my 210 completely cycled in 3 to 4 days- amazing stuff.

product_title: Ethical Pet Wide Durable Heavy Gauge Plastic Colorful Springs Cat Toy, 10 Count per Pack
review_body: I'm not sure how you can put together 20 words on tiny, multicolored plastic slinkie type spring toys but these really were a big hit for the two kittens.  They chased them all over the place, carried them to their favorite hiding place under the sofa and batted them about with no mercy.  I'm not sure who had more fun, the cats or those of us watching them.  This is a very good value for the money.

product_title: Aquatop CF Series Canister Filter (370 and 525 GPH with UV)
review_headline: Excellent canister filter for the price
review_body:
This canister filter is rated at 370 gph, which is way more than what I need for my 29 gallon. It comes with a 9W UV bulb, as well as a spray bar for flow control. However, it does NOT come with any additional filter media other than a few pads of mechanical filtration so you would need to purchase your own biological/chemical filtration medias. (which I planned to, anyways).

The filter itself is extremely quiet, much quieter than the whisper PF 60 I had. As with all canister filters, you can pack quite a bit of additional media in if you'd like, which gives much more leeway than power filters in that aspect.

The instructions on how to set this thing up can be a little bit confusing, but there are videos online showing you how to set this thing up, which is pretty clear.

Overall, I would say I am very satisfied with this product.

product_title: Dogbed4less Orthopedic Memory Foam Dog Bed for Small, Medium to Large Pet, Waterproof Internal Cover with Durable Blue Denim Cover and Extra Bonus External Case - 7 Sizes
review_body: I bought this orthopedic bed for my three elderly (one disabled) bunnies.  They seem to enjoy lying on it and grooming each other on the bed.  I like the fact that there is a waterproof inner cover as my disabled bunny is incontinent.  They have chewed a few very small holes in the denim cover, but it's great to have the other brown cover for a replacement as they both get laundered frequently.  So far so good.

product_title: Care-Eze Dog and Cat Carrier
review_body: I purchased this item a few years ago and have been thankful ever since. This crate has served as a nursery, a carrier, a place of refuge for the cat to hang out in. It's been bumped, dropped, sat on and generally used and abused. Through it all it remains easy to set up and take down, although the tabs that secure the sides are a bit of hassle to lock in place sometimes. Nothing has broken, nothing is worn, it's easy to clean with a hose if there's been an accident and keeps no residual smell. When folded flat, it takes up very little room and has a clip that secures it neatly in it's little clamshell position. All in all a great product....willdefinitely buy another if this one finally goes the way of the dodo and dies off.

product_title: FP WEE WEE PADS GIGANTIC 18CT
review_body:
This product saved my life. It is big enough for my two small dogs. No way to take them outside during
work hours, or late at night. They are super absorbent, great size and sold at a good price.

product_title: Ultra Paws TrAction Dog Boots - Petite
review_body: I read a lot of reviews before purchasing, even read through all of the recommendations/pointers from the manufacturer's website to make sure I got the right fit/size for my  pup.  I was really excited when these little boots arrived (excited for dog boots?...yes...my dog makes me carry him around the house because he's scared of hardwood floors..lol).  But I was sorely disappointed to find that these things DO NOT stay on his paws.  No matter how tight I adjust them...they end up flying off after a few minutes of walk/running.  Do not purchase these.  Waste of your dollars.

product_title: F.M. Brown's Twirls N' Cob Bedding, 4-Pound
review_body: I tried this bedding for my guinea pigs. It seemed different from what I had been using so I gave it a shot. I wouldn't buy it again. It wasn't that absorbent, and they didn't care to play with the \\"confetti\\" pieces like I thought they would. It is colorful and not dusty, but maybe better for other animals.

product_title: ARK Naturals PRODUCTS for PETS 326013 Neem Protect Spray, 8-Ounce
review_body:
The scent is very strong, so those with sensitive noses beware!

But it's worth it for me because we live in tick central. I've sprayed this on my dog right before going hiking and the number of ticks I find crawling around on him is exponentially lower than when I don't use it. Could be a coincidence (I've only got one dog, so I can't run solid AB testing) but I'm a believer!

product_title: FURminator Large Yellow deShedding Tool with 4-Inch Edge
review_headline: Product works perfectly on big cats!
review_body: The furminator is a perfect product. It is great quality for a great price. The only down side is that my cat seems to have a love/hate relationship with it. He purrs while I furminate it and then he meows and rebels. It doesn't matter though because it does not hurt him in any way, and it gets all his extra hair off. I tried two other brushes before the furminator - and the furminator is the only one that worked. The first time I tried it, I accumulated a trash-bag worth of extra fur. I highly recommend this product

product_title: PetSafe Pawz Away Medium Mat, 12 x 60 inches
review_body: I bought two of these mats to place around my cut live Christmas tree this year (the tree was in a corner of a room) to keep my two cats away from the tree.  It works!  The first day I heard the alarm go off a few times.  The next day maybe a couple of times.  After that, the cats stayed away.  No more cats climbing the tree, peeing underneath it or attempts at drinking the water.  No issues whatsoever!  They pretty much stayed out of the room entirely!

product_title: Bags on Board Original Dispenser with 15 Waste Pick up Bags
review_body: The good news:  pretty indestructible, easy to fill and dispense bags, if you use those on a roll  The bad news:  the loop on top for attaching this to leash or whatever is so small, only a zip tie will work, which requires another attachment device, like a clip if you want to be able to move it from one place to another without having to cut the zip tie, rendering it useless; it is heavy if you clip it to a leash handle, as we do, and bangs around.  Conclusion:  for us, a soft-sided pick-up bag dispenser is going to be better.

product_title: Wellness WellBites Soft Natural Dog Treats, Lamb & Salmon, 8-Ounce Bag
review_body: Can you think of anything more unappetizing.  Not to dogs, they love these.  I just wish they were less expensive.

product_title: Nootie-Shampoo & Daily Spritz Combo Bottle,  Pet Shampoo & Conditioning Spray in one Package, 1 Unit ,12oz/4oz,Sweet Pea & Vanilla
review_body: I personally love this shampoo and spritzer, I just purchased another bottle of the spray so even when I'm not using the shampoo I get to enjoy the scent! I am a groomer and have one client who really didn't like the smell, so like with anything scented it is subjective. The spray is very strong and I will probably be diluting it a little, but it is definately my favorite and it what I use on all my personal dogs!

product_title: Sticky Paws Scratch Control Strips
review_body: Only thing I would wish is that there was one to stick on screens! My cat is baffled by these when I put them on the couch and knows to avoid them. They never leave behind residue. Now to keep her off the window screens!

product_title: Litter Locker Refill Cartridge 5 pk
review_body: Product received is as advertised. Price is better than in the local stores. Received order in a short period of time.

product_title: Pet Ag KMR Milk Replacer Food Supplement for Kittens and Small Animals Liquid
review_headline: My cats don't like it and my Vet doesn't recommend it
review_body: My cat was sick and not eating well so I bought this on advice of a coworker after my cat had gotten a force feeding and meds from the Vet. She wouldn't touch it! I was surprised because both my cats like to lick the milk out of my cereal bowl when I am done. I asked my Vet what the major difference was between cat milk and people milk, she said they are basically the same but cats milk has taurine added to it, a nutrient that cats need more of. The vet recommended to give the cat regular milk and a taurine supplement if she would eat that. Luckily, after second force feeding she started eating again so I didn't need to go that route. My Vet said that cat milk is way over priced for what you get. This can is also very large and you have to use it very quickly.

product_title: Petego Traction Control Socks for Dogs, Set of 4
review_body: I ordered size L - dogs 75 - 95 pounds for our lab of 75 pounds. I was so surprised when I unwrapped booties for a dog the size of a fox terrier. I was unable to even pull them over her paws. They look well made, but are of no use for our old lady. will return them. The search continues.

product_title: Cosequin Bonelets Hip and Joint Support Tablet, 85 count
review_body: This is a relatively inexpensive product that is extremely good for young and old dogs hips and joints. I know of a rather famous wildlife manager that special ordered a similar product for his dog. This version is as good, but considerably less expensive. The product is liver flavored, so I say the all important word to our eleven month old pup in the morning, \\"snack\\" the tail wag increases rapidly and he goes to his bowl and gets the snack and his firest feeding. I highly recommend this product.

product_title: KONG Summer Fun Pack Dog Combo, Dog Toys, (Colors Vary)
review_body: My one year old German Shephard loves all the toys. They are durable enough for big dogs. I recommend this fun pack for large dogs who like to play with toys.

product_title: Novartis Capstar Flea Tablets for Dogs and Cats
review_body: Capstar works great at killing adult fleas. It makes my cats a little wired as the fleas are dying, but dead and nearly dead fleas literally come up to the surface of the cat's coat and fall off. No more itchy fleas for my babies. I just wish this would kill more of the flea life cycle, but because it doesn't you may have to use it 2-3 times to get all of the fleas. I used this along with frontline plus drops, once weekly baths, frequent vacuuming and and doing laundry, and diatomaceous earth on some of their frequent spots, like their beds and cat trees.

product_title: Simple Solution Spot Spotter Ultraviolet Urine Detector
review_headline: Takes too long to warm up
review_body: I like that this light is big (about a foot long) but it takes too long to warm up, if it decides to come on at all.  Cannot recommend this to anyone.  Would have sent it back to the vendor but figured it would cost about half the price to get it back, not worth it.  Will probably look for another brand.

product_title: Zanies Cotton Minty Ropes Dog Toy, Large
review_body: I bought this item with hopes that it would give our 50# dog something to play with for at least a couple of months. It did not even last three days. I was very disappointed with it and I know that my money was wasted.

product_title: Canyon Creek Ranch Chicken Stix 60ct
review_body: My dog is older and can't chew the other types of rahide bones any more, so this is perfect for her.  She can get the chewing with a great taste she likes.

product_title: MidWest Guinea Habitat
review_body: mostly people above here are people who are hired by the people who made this cage i did a lot of research don't buy this

product_title: Omega One Cichlid Small Pellets 3.5 Oz
review_body: The Cichlids love this product and they act like they never get feed. It brings the color out and I like the sinking tablets because the fish get them and the loaches and pleco to. The look really healthy and they like it and it don't cloudy the water. The clown loach and the red tail sharks go nuts for this food.

product_title: Penn-Plax Pro Balance 14-Day Vacation Feeding Blocks Fish Shape (Pack of 2)
review_body: This is an inexpensive and very east to use fish food that can last more than two weeks without a hitch. Better feeding block than regular self seeding gadgets.

product_title: Hydor Koralia Evolution Aquarium Circulation Pump
review_body: This pump has awesome but gentle flow. runs very quiet without vibration. My reefkeeper elite won't turn these pumps off because of the low power draw.

product_title: KONG ZoomGroom, Dog Grooming Toy
review_body: I have an 11 month old weimaraner who was skinny when I got him. It was hard to use regular brushes on him because they would scratch him if he moved at all. This is so much better. He actually likes being brushed with it. It loosens up all the extra hairs but it does not pick it all up. It gets about ¼ of the loose hair. I just sneak a few good brushes with a natural brush after loosening everything up with the Kong brush. I just let him hold the Kong brush in his mouth when I do the last quick brush to pick up all the loose hair. It makes him happier and that makes my life easier. I can't wait to use it at bath time.

product_title: Black Custom US Military Dog Tag Personalized ID Set. Complete with Chains and Silencers
review_body:
These are absolutely perfect.

The item is exactly as pictured and everything is ready to wear right out of the plastic bag they come in. You receive one long dog chain and the short dog chain attached to the long one. Both dog tags have the silencers on them and are on the chains. The engraving that I requested was accurate and looked great. The black is a pure black and has shown no fading after a week of wear.

I personally love these dog tags because they are personal to me with the engraving I requested, and I never see anyone wearing black ones.

I highly recommend these to anyone, especially at such a cheap price with fast delivery. It literally took the seller a day to finish engraving the product, yet I did have to wait until the 5th day of the 3-5 day expected delivery to receive them.

product_title: Petite Cuisine Grilled Tuna Treats, 4.2-Ounce
review_body: my girls absolutely loved this tuna. they were in heaven and couldn't get enough of this tasty treat. A bit pricey since I do have 4 cats and the pack went super fast giving each of them a treat

product_title: Spotless Paw Dog Paw Cleaning and Grooming Glove Clean Dirty Dog Paws With This Six Fingered Glove
review_body: I received my first Spotless Paw from the animal shelter near my home when I purchased a young kitten.  \\"Grayson\\" loves to grab hold and kick with his back paws and chew on the fingers.  It is great to get some of his aggression out and fighting skills when I put it on.  Nobody told me it was for dogs!  My Petsmart store knew nothing about it when I was ready to purchase another one (after numerous washing, it looked ragged.  So glad you were online!  He know nows to be gentle when I don't have the glove on.  Thanks so much.

product_title: Li'l Pals® Double Side Comb
review_body: I use this little comb on my yorkie's snout and beard and it gets all the gook out wonderfully. The brush just don't cut it for such a small area. I highly recommend this product for small areas and getting out small tangles.

product_title: Interpet Limited Superpet Crittertrail Pet Cage
review_body: It was about four years ago when I was at the pet store and saw these two adorable baby dwarf hamster I begged my mom to get them. She said, \\"it's fine with me, but you have to check with dad.\\" My dad didn't answer his phone so we ran to a house he was working on, he's a drywaller. Any way he said yes, I got my dwarfs then it was time to get a cage. I fell in LOVE with a pink one, mom said no cos it was like 50 $$. Then I found this one I got it and got sooo many compliments. One day I walked in my room to feed them and the cage door had broken. So I had to stand there holding it closed while my mom jumped in the car and made a 3o minute drive to petco. After that I just get a regular old boring cage. Sometimes less is better. Also it was hard to see them. I did like the wheel and I LOVED the petting area. All in All it's OK. :) Now I have an adorable guinea pig! :)

product_title: Blue Buffalo Longevity Dry Food for Kittens, 5-Pound Bag
review_headline: My Kittens Will Not Eat This High Quality Food
review_body:
I have purchased alot of the Blue Buffalo canned food for my kittens, so I thought I'd try the Dry food. Unfortunately, they don't like it. My rating is only based on my kittens not liking this food. Your cats may love it! I think the quality of the product is superb, with the first ingredient listed as deboned white fish, followed by salmon meal. There's also vegetables listed: carrots, spinach, broccoli, tomatoes. The crude protein % is listed at 35%! I do think this product is high quality, and the price does reflect that. I'm a firm believer in \\"you get what you pay for\\" -

Some of us don't like caviar.

I really wish my kittens liked this food. The size of the food pieces are tiny for little kittys mouths. This item uses REAL FISH and my cats will not eat it. I'm bothered by that. They like the Hill's Science Diet for kittens.

I rated it 3 stars because I think it's a high quality pet food with excellent ingredients even if my kittens don't like it. I would have rated it 5, if they did like it. I think it's a great product and priced fairly. I don't expect to pay pennies for quality, and this is a premium food for kittens.

product_title: PetSafe Bolt Interactive Laser Cat Toy
review_body:
So far the kitten likes it best of my four cats. We had a laser pointer for awhile that we would take out and run the cats up and down the hall with so we figured this \\"auto toy\\" would be great. The kitten likes it but the other cats just watch it move around. I swear they look at me like \\"if you're to lazy to play, then we are not chasing that thing.\\"

Now that the price has come down on it, I would say it's worth a shot. Sometimes I know my local stores have them for about $10. But a cheap laser pointer that teachers use is much more interactive and fun.

It's kind of hard in my small house to get the thing set up somewhere that the pattern doesn't run the cats into my curtains, up a wall, into my t.v. etc. Not sorry I have it - Just wouldn't buy it if I had any insight on it before hand. Just because your cat likes the little laser toy doesn't mean they will like this.

UPDATE: After a few days the cats all lost interest in this toy. They much prefer a regular old pen laser that I can control and play with them with. I update my star rating to a 1 - at least for me and my four cats can't be bothered.

product_title: Zack & Zoey Polyester/Cotton Basic Dog Hoodie
review_headline: Nice quality hoodie, but hard finding correct size
review_body: I have three pugs ranging from 15-24 pounds. I tried both the medium and large and couldn't find a good fit. First, the head opening is very small and has no stretch in it at all. The large was enormous for the 23 and 24 pound dogs, but the medium was way too small. I spent more money shipping the hoodies back and forth.  As far as the quality of the product otherwise, I'd say it's good. The colors are nice and vibrant and the fabric is somewhat soft

product_title: Petmate Cafe 3.5 Lb Pet Feeder in White
review_body: Nothing mechanical about this feeder however it does the job will. Easy to wash and put food. Great for cat. Would recommend! I not giving this 5 stars because it took long to deliver.

product_title: Milk Bone Soft & Chewy Dog Snacks (Beef & Filet Mignon Recipe) 37oz
review_body: I purchased these treats from a different store (BJ'S) and they made BOTH my dogs sick! One of them being a 8 week old puppy! DO NOT BUY THESE! DO NOT FEED THEM TO YOUR DOGS! They are dangerous! I will never purchase another Milk Bone product EVER AGAIN!

product_title: Boneheads Waterproof Raincoat for Dogs Medium, Medium, Color:Yellow
review_body: Returned item to Petco Store item was so small for my baby girl, although it was so cute.  Size was not stated clearly for the built of my baby girl.  But it was returned without any confusion.  Will probably purchase another one in a larger size as it is so cute.

product_title: Petrodex Enzymatic Toothpaste for Dogs - Poultry Flavor, 2.5-Ounce, Pack of 1
review_body: Just like another reviewer, when I'm brushing one dog's teeth, the other is \\"standing in line\\" (if there was a line).  And my dogs seem to love the taste, whether I get poultry or beef flavor, it doesn't matter.  I decided to get serious with keeping my dogs teeth clean about 2.5 years ago, when I spent over $300 a piece to get their teeth cleaned (nearly $700 for both).  Not to mention that they had to be in discomfort with the bad teeth, etc. etc.  So, now I brush them daily with a regular soft tooth brush.  I started with a finger brush, but when it wore out, I couldn't find any more of that particular kind.  So, I just use some Petrodex on a regular tooth brush now, and it works great!  Just about every time I go to the vet, they mention that their teeth look great.  One vet even referred to me as a \\"super owner\\", because I brush the dogs teeth, and flush their ears regularly.  Plus, she said that it is good for their overall health.  So, get a properly sized toothbrush for the size of your dogs mouth, get them some Petrodex tooth paste, and clean their teeth regularly (I do it every day, unless I don't have time), and judging by the results I've gotten the past 2.5 years, your dog's teeth will look great.  My dogs' teeth look like they were just professionally cleaned yesterday, after 2.5 years of using Petrodex!!

product_title: MEDIUM - PEACH - Waterproof Storm Dog Jackets
review_headline: Our all time FAV doggie rain jacket
review_body: this style of rain jacket is the best - principally because it covers the doggie's 'under carriage'. I find the hood just gets in the way - my dog refuses to have her ears covered. I just fold it back and sew it out of the way - no problem. I've bought 4 of these over the years - with our rainy days it is the 'go to' coat. It also protects the upper part of each leg and those mud splatters are easy to wash off the coat - less work for me when we return from our walks. I keep two on hand at all times. They rinse off easily and dry quickly. If they get too dirty - in to the washer they go. Love this product.

product_title: Whiskas TENDER BITES Favorite Selections Wet Cat Food Pouches
review_body: My cats simply just love em'....they're quite finicky...but I am finally able to find it without having to donate many previous cat food that my cats simply refused to consume.

product_title: PetSafe Gentle Spray Bark Collar for Dogs, Citronella, Anti-Bark Device, Water Resistant
review_body: I used it for about two days successfully, but accidentally left it \\"ON\\" when I took it off my dog. Now it doesn't work. I replaced the batteries and the citronella, but it still won't work. She still barks now.

product_title: Marineland Rite-Size Cartridge Refills
review_body: I have a Marineland water filter for my aquarium, so I kind of have no choice on which brand to choose. These filters are much more inexpensive when bought on Amazon that at petsmart or petco.  I will continue purchacing my replacement filters here.

product_title: Solvit Products 62283 Deluxe Bench Seat Cover Natural, Large
review_body: I have a 2011 Honda Accord with leather seats and this seat cover works beautifully. I have a border collie/pug mix that weights 45lbs and a boston terrier that weights 18lbs and they are both ALL over the place in the back seat. I've had other seat covers that slide all over the place and end up not really protecting the seat, but not this one. I put it on and haven't had to adjust it since.    There are only a few things I would change if I could:    1. The seat belt slots do not have velcro. At the end of the day, I'm not sure how much difference this would actually make, but I'd feel better if I could seal those openings closed.    2. Color options. From what I saw the only option was brown/tan. Which looks great...especially since the seat cover stays where it is supposed to...but I can't help but think how much nicer it would look if I could've gotten black to match the rest of my interior. Again, something that doesn't REALLY matter as long as the seat cover is doing it's job.

product_title: Doggles Originalz Frame Goggles for Dogs with Smoke Lens, Chrome
review_body:
I've had these Doggles for about 6 months now. I put them on the dog when he's riding in a box on the back of my motorcycle, and when he's riding in his dog seat in my side-by-side ATV. He's endured high winds, has been hit in the face by small tree branches, and has had mud splattered in his face. And he loves every second of it. He leans way out over the side to get the best view (hence the branch whippings), and I feel very secure that he will not be seriously injured, because he's wearing his dog helmet and Doggles.

I am dismayed by how quickly he can get them off when we've stopped riding, but he always leaves them on when we're riding, as if he understands why it is important to wear them, so I guess it's not a big deal. As another reviewer said, I imagine it's a bit difficult to engineer a product that will stay on a dog's face.

My reason for 4 stars instead of 5 is that the color description is not very good. The color is listed as \\"chrome\\" - but it's the brownest chrome I've ever seen. I wouldn't go quite as far as to call it brass - maybe \\"beige\\" is better - but it's definitely not chrome. My product does not match the color in the picture. But they're good enough.

product_title: Solid Gold SeaMeal Kelp-Based Nutritional Supplement for Skin & Coat, Digestive, and Immune Health in Dogs, Cats & Horse, 8oz Tub
review_body: Ever since I started adding this to my dog's food, he can't wait for me to put the dish down and he eats the entire bowl.  He's never done that before so I attribute it to the Solid Gold Seameal.  It did not seem to help his itching problem as some other reviewers had mentioned.  But I might have to give it more time - it's only been 2 weeks.

product_title: Pioneer Pet Raindrop Ceramic Drinking Fountain
review_body: Best fountain I've had so much better then the plastic ones.  My cats love it and it' s easy to clean.  I've had it for a month and I've had no problems with water spilling on the floor. Great value, great fountain!!!

product_title: LitterMaid LME9000 Elite Mega Advanced Automatic Self-Cleaning Litter Box
review_body: Mine died within 2 months of purchasing it.  Littermaid said they would replace it... however, I've been waiting over 2 months for my replacement.  They keep telling me it's backordered.  I finally got them to agree to a refund and I'll go find another box on the market that actually works longer than 2 months.  In the two months that it did work, it constantly dumped clean litter all over the floor (it's like it slid down the top or something) I was constantly cleaning up large amounts of clean litter.  Don't waste your time or money.

product_title: Bergan Signature Series Comfort Pet Carrier in Coral in your choice of color
review_body: This is a great carrier! My puppy (14 lb cocker spaniel) was really comfy in it for a full day of travel. There are plenty of pockets for leashes, food, treats, toys. The side zipper is just right for giving comforting scratches while the doggy is inside. Plus, it's pretty.

product_title: Mars Original Stainless Steel Coat King Pet Stripper with Wooden Handle
review_body: The Mars Coat King Medium is perfect for my Australian Shepherds' coats.  It removes enough undercoat but doesn't take too much at one time.  Both have thick coats and I am able to keep them looking good with this tool.

product_title: Multipet Plush Dog Toy
review_body: someone dumped a blind dog here and i was at my wits end... he LOVES this toy!!!!  And I Don't mind Mister Bill's \\"Ohhhhhhh noooooo!!' it's always funny every time LOL  thank you for this!  Ordering another just in case... but it sure seems VERY durable even for an Anatolian Shepard... teeth like a tazmanian devil.  He broke it with his massive teeth within an hour... he is too smart and can figure out where rattle/noisemakers are and -purposely- broke it.  That's ok, I ordered another.  It was worth the price for his entertainment!  But it would be nice if they could build a super durable chip/box that can stand up to a lot of hard chewing with big, gnarly teeth.

product_title: Bergan Comfort Carrier Soft-Sided Pet Carrier
review_headline: Great for on the go pups!
review_body: I bought a few different carriers at Petco but none of them seemed to accomplish what I wanted. I wanted a carrier that would secure my dog in the car. She drives in the car at least twice if not more each week. I tried the carriers that just clipped the dog's collar to a raised platform but she just fidgeted around in it and was uncomfortable. I found this one at PetSmart for around $50 a year and a half ago. Amazon's price is definitely better and worth it. It's nice that there are so many features to it. I especially like that I can take out the padding and wash it (without it being warped). I got it because of the loops specifically made for strapping in a bag through a seat belt. The carrier is nice and secure. I have been using it for 2-6 trips per week without any problem! My dog mostly just lays down in it and stares at me while I drive. It is definitely a lot safer than having her wonder around the car getting dangerously close to the airbags. Oh I got the Large and she is 12.5 lbs and it is just the right size for her. Any dog over 13 I do not think would be comfortable.

product_title: Pre-Filter Sponge 3 Pack for Fluval Edge Aquarium
review_headline: Increases biological filtration and reduces cartridge changes
review_body:
Even though these are manufactured by Fluval, they work on filters that are not made by Fluval. I have used one of these as a pre-filter on an Aqueon QuietFlow 10, and I now use one on a Cascade 150 in a tank with some fish and one shrimp.

The tank where I have this installed is a planted tank, and often a piece of Java Fern or moss will decide to float around the tank. This filter helps keep the plant matter from being sucked into the filter intake, and it also protects my shrimp from being harmed by the filter. She likes to hang on the intake and eat the particles of food that get trapped in the sponge. It allows just enough flow to interest the shrimp while reducing the flow somewhat to the benefit of my Gouramis.

Because of this pre-filter, I only have to change the filter cartridge about once a month. The $3.99 I spent on three of these filters paid for itself within the first month of use. This does not even take into account the boost to biological filtration this sponge filter provides in my tank. This might be the best $3.99 I have ever spent.

Note: These pre-filter sponges will work for brands that are not Fluval, but only smaller models designed for 5 to 10-gallon tanks. The intakes on larger filters are too large for these sponges to fit. Furthermore, they will not fit the Marineland filters at all; the intakes on Marineland filters are too large.

product_title: Outward Hound Hide-A-Squirrel and Puzzle Plush Squeaking Toys for Dogs
review_headline: No match for a 90 lb. German Shepherd.
review_body: I thought I'd get this for my dog after talking to a friend about a similar puzzle she got for her pitbull. I definitely think this toy is more designed for dogs that are more...subtle in their methods of extracting the bees, because mine just decided it would be faster if he ripped the thing open. This took all of about 30 minutes. Don't get me wrong, he loves it and carries the mangled hive around with him where ever he goes including out into the yard, but I think this toy is better for smaller dogs or ones that won't choose brute force over \\"problem solving\\". Not to say my boy isn't smart. That's just it, he figured it'd be faster to get the bees after shaking them out and chewing them out, than by normal methods of retrieval.

product_title: Flat Latigo Lead 1" x 6'
review_body: This is a very high quality leather lead that we are extremely happy with.  The hardware is strong and there is no doubt you have control of your dog when using this lead. It is easy to grip while walking our large and strong Alaskan Malamutes even while wearing gloves.

product_title: KONG Flyer Dog Toy
review_body: I love kong products, usually toys do not last one second with my two dogs. The kong toy held up longer than expected. I would buy the kong disc again.

product_title: Van Ness EC1-G Leaf Green ECO Pet Bowl, Extra Small
review_body: This is a very durable pet bowl and made out of natural product. We have the small ones for our cats to eat their wet food out of and one large to hold their dry food. It feels good to know they aren't eating their food out of cheap plastic that could be hazardous to them.

product_title: World's Best Scented Multiple Cat Clumping Cat Litter
review_headline: May not be safe for cats
review_body: We have been using World's Best Cat Litter for Multiple Cats for over a year now. I saw the scented product come out and decided to give it a try. The cats seemed to like it (we have five), but now a week later two of our cats have come down with bladder infections. They refuse to use the cat boxes and have blood in their urine. We have not changed their diet, they are drinking plenty of clean water, we have the proper number of catboxes (6), and I scrubbed the cat boxes like I always do before putting in the new litter. The only thing I can think of is this new litter, so we are heading to the store to get the unscented litter and replacing all the litter tonight. I can't confirm 100% that the cause is the litter, but it just seems so suspect at this point. We have never had any of our cats get a bladder infection and now two are sick. World's Best Cat Litter makes a great product, but I will never buy their scented products again. Just thought I would post our experience.

product_title: Posh&Co Nikki Green Olive Oil Dog Shampoo with Lavender Essential Oils, 16-Ounce
review_body: My yorkies have long hair and get bathed at least once a week. It leaves them looking and smelling clean.

product_title: HDP 6" Bully Sticks
review_body: Fast service, easy to deal with, would definitely recommend. Best price that I found on the internet or in retail stores.

product_title: Hamilton Double Thick Nylon Deluxe Dog Collar
review_body: I purchased this for my 3 year old boxer who normally wears a 20\\" collar. This 20\\" collar was extremely tight. I measured it and discovered that the nylon is only 18 1/2 inches long, with the longest hole at 16 1/4 inches. I measured two of his older 20\\" collars (different brands) and they both have a 20\\" long piece of nylon. The collar itself is very nice so I will be exchanging it for a larger size. I recommend getting a size larger than you think you need.

product_title: EzyDog Neo Collar
review_body: Do like this product very much.  Doesn't bother dog at all to wear it.  I like that it keeps the dog tags on the side and not under her neck.  One thing I don't care for is all of the velco showing when the collar is moved to a larger setting.  She is a growing girl and the collar looks ugly with the black velcro showing on the side.  I ordered the correct size for her, but I should have ordered a large so the velcro wouldn't show as much.

product_title: Zoetis Terramycin Ophthalmic Ointment, 1/8-Ounce
review_headline: Looking for an ointment safe to use around the eyes
review_body:
My dog doesn't have teary eyes, but his allergies caused him to rub his face which resulted in his skin being very irritated around his eyes. He would rub so much that he would be bleeding when I got home and while the sores were healing he'd be very itchy. I was looking for a safe antibiotic to use around his eyes.

I applied this ointment around both of his eyes for a week and the wounds healed. Unfortunately, we are still trying to treat the allergy that has caused the rubbing, but I keep a steady supply of this at home in case need to use it again! After a recent vet appointment where the vet scraped his skin to check for mites, he irritated the area and had a open wound right under his eye. I treated the area for a few days and now it has healed!

The information on the tube is not written in english, but it does have a Pfizer label. Some reviews said the medication they received was expired, but mine doesn't expire until January 2014. The same medication from the vet would have cost me hundreds of dollars.

product_title: Solvit Front Seat Net Pet Barrier
review_body: I was excited to get this product, as we have two corgis, who love the front seat whether we are in the car or not and it can get very hairy, in more ways than one.  I had just bought a new car and was hoping to keep it somewhat clean, but alas on our first trip out the center pole, which is the only thing that keeps this rigid, broke.  I'm going to try and make a pole that might be more durable, but until then, it's a loss and very disappointing.  My dogs were even in seat belts and were able to do this. product_title: Rena Smartfilter
review_body:
I've had a pair of these Rena SmartFilter 30 units in continuous operation for a couple of years now without any failures. I was originally very impressed with the features of this design; however, my enthusiasm has waned due to a few \\"shortcomings\\" that have become apparent over time. As with most products, there are both positive and negative points which I will try to cover in my observations below.

1.) This Rena SmartFilter utilizes a fully submerged self-contained pump. I've owned a variety of other rear hanging filters over the last 30 years with the majority of them employing a design whereby the impeller is driven by a motor attached to the bottom of the filter unit. In my experience, these units generally ended up being noisier than I would have preferred, so when I came across this Rena unit with the fully submerged pump I had to pick one up to give it a try. Sure enough, this submerged pump design results in impressively quiet operation and the units I have still operate just as quietly today. While there have been occasional annoying vibration noises noted after re-assembling the unit following a cleaning, I've always been able to eliminate these with small adjustments to and/or reseating of the lids/covers of the unit.

2.) There is an available heater that can be substituted in place of the intake tube. This is another really cool innovation/feature that saves space in the tank, looks cool, and generally results in a more secure mounting of your tank heater when compared to a standalone unit simply attached to the tank with suction cups alone. Combined with the previously mentioned quiet operation this feature ultimately convinced me to purchase my second unit for my other tank.

3.) The filter cartridge design is pretty unique and incredibly easy to maintain/service. The only downside here is that the cartridges are a bit pricey... and, of late, the local pet stores seems to have stopped carrying them. So I've been forced to purchase filters online, which wasn't all bad as I discovered that they may be purchased in a more economical 12-pack as opposed to the 6-packs the local stores carried. Unfortunately, this 12-pack seems to have become somewhat scarce online lately as well. It's unclear whether this is simply a temporary shortage or not as API seems to have repackaged these filters under their brand name. For folks having trouble finding filters for these units, look up the API BioChem Size 4 filters which would appear to be the same thing as what was originally sold under the Rena brand. Bad news is that the biggest pack I've seen under the API packaging is qty 4... which, again, makes these filters somewhat expensive to purchase. I've purchased and confirmed that these API BioChem Size 4 filters do work with the Rena SmartFilter products. As a matter of fact, on the API BioChem Size 4 packaging, it actually states that the filters are for use with the SmartFilter units. Anyway, this may be a sore point if the 12-pack goes away completely...

4.) This filter unit has \\"snap adjustable\\" standoff legs at the bottom that are used to help position the unit so that it is level... and herein lies my biggest complaint with these units. It appears to me that there is very little margin provided at the top of the unit with respect to the operating water level such that if the unit leans back much at all water begins to drip out of the unit at a pretty steady rate, thus soaking whatever lies underneath the filter unit and continuing to do so until you happen to notice the problem. This problem also seems to be compounded by the lids/covers of the unit seemingly being designed to fit over the outside of the filter reservoir and, again, if the rear of the filter unit is a little below level, then condensation that forms on the inside of this lid would also seem to roll back and down the outside of the filter reservoir, adding to the problem. Again, this really shouldn't be a problem if the filter is maintained in the proper position. Unfortunately, the \\"snap adjustable\\" standoff feet on the two units I have cannot be readily secured against accidental unintended changes which might occur during servicing of the unit. Which means that once or twice a year I get a surprise when I discover that the standoff settings have somehow been disturbed and the filter has been leaking for a number of days prior to me catching it. This has happened enough times with bad enough results that I've become downright paranoid about checking to make sure the filter units are not dripping. At this point, I'm resolved to replace these units once I've used up my remaining supply of filter cartridges. I've never before had a rear hanging filter be so prone to concerns of leakage and it's really quite disappointing given how good this filter unit could have been with just a little more attention to detail.

product_title: Nothing Like It Designs Original DOH Housebreaking & Training Pad Holder
review_headline: I'm a Yorkshire Terrier Breeder and I Love these trays.
review_body:
I'm a yorkshire terrier breeder. Several years ago I bought two of this size tray, and at the time you could also buy a dbl tray. I bought two dbl trays as well. I love these trays. They are far superior to other pee pad trays. When I went to reorder, the mail order catalog I bought them from had discontinued them. I didn't know they were made by \\"This is The Spot.\\"

All my adult dogs go on these. I love how easy it is to change them. In addtion the outer frame is small so you utility almost all of the pee pad where in the other trays a lot of the pad is under the frame. You end up with more usable area, yet the overall size is smaller than the white and aqua snapping design. I've found the trays that are hinged, are difficult as the pad gets in the way of the hinge, so you have to fold the pad to get it to fit properly. (While you are fussing trying to get the pads in the puppies are jumping all over you and the pad!) As for the ones that snap together, they should put the snaping sides on the long sides not the short sides. The pad is very easy for the puppies to pull out of the frame. Sometime they don't snap properly.

I sell puppies to a lot of older couples, who don't have the best of balance and this is much easier for them to change than either of the other two styles.

I train all my puppies once they are weaned to go on these. Most of my customers living in condo, apartments, or working full time love the flexability of this system. I can't say enough about this product. I just hope they continue to be available!! NO LOL, I am NOT getting paid to say this!!! Betty Wilkinson

review_headline: Try it on yourself before putting on your loved pet
review_body: I was wondering why our 55lb collie puppy was whimpering when this thing \\"Corrected him\\" for whining once. It was set as the directions stated to the \\"Progressive\\" level.  He is a tough puppy that is very vocal, but this thing made him scared and almost petrified. So I decided to see how bad the \\"Vibration\\" was to see if it was hurting him or correcting. (Don't really do this, there is ALWAYS one genius who does) That is how bad it HURTS. I had to look in the mirror to make sure I didn't have a burn mark on my neck. IF YOU LOVE YOUR PET, DO NOT GET A STATIC \\"Correction\\" collar... THERE IS A REASON WHY IT SAYS TO CHECK THE PET'S NECK WEEKLY!

product_title: PetzLife Oral Care Spray, Peppermint, 2.2 ounces
review_body:
We have a seven year old Pekingese and she had really bad teeth, a lot of nasty buildup and her breath smelled like... well if you're looking for a product like this, you know. Last year, our Vet said we really needed to get her teeth cleaned and it was going to cost close to $400; not an cheap expense but something we were willing to live with to keep our pooch healthy. The Vet also said that the month of February is National Dog Teeth Cleaning Month or something like that and we could wait until then and get a discount (I didn't verify if there is a National Dog Teeth Cleaning Month). I looked at various different alternatives afterwards and decided to use this product and also a product called C.E.T. Enzymatic Oral Hygiene Chews. We used both for about 45 days before the dogs next Vet visit. The Vet said, \\"I don't know what you're doing to keep her teeth clean but keep doing what you're doing\\". That's all it took to have us sold.

We gave her one of these treats once a day for the first 30 days and also used the spray every evening and kept her away from water for about 30 minutes. We still use the spray and she gets a treat about every other day. I don't know if she loves the spray but she tolerates it. She absolutely love the treats though. We're happy too; she can lick our face and we no longer worry about her breath smelling like... well if you're looking for a product like this, you know.

product_title: Jones Natural Chews Knee Cap
review_body: I buy mine from my local pet store and have also bought the petco brand bag of 5 for $10 (in store only). My dog is 8lbs it takes him maybe 5 times @ 30 mins before there's nothing on the bone anymore, and even after the stuff is gone he gnaws on it a bit. I'm very happy my local pet place turned me on to these. I get them for him only every so often as a super special treat. : ). I'm really happy these exist. There is one drawback and that is the oily substance on them, if you have a long-haired dog, makes their facial hair kinda gross.

product_title: Iams Savory Sauce for Dogs & Puppies 11-oz bottle country style chicken flavor
review_body: When I first started to use IAMS Savory Sauce, my dogs loved it. After a few weeks, they don't seem to care too much for it anymore. They still get a little drizzle in their kibble every once in a while, and will eventually eat it when they are hungry, but they don't consider it to be a treat anymore. I still buy it once in a blue moon when it is on sale because of it contains vitamins and its decently priced, and low calorie. One big negative I have noticed about it is that their face is getting dirty from it. They are white dogs and this product tends to cause increased tear and around-the-mouth stains. I used to buy all different flavors of IAMS Savory Sauce, buy my groomer told me the chicken flavor is best as the beef and pork based flavors can cause an even worse increase in face staining. VitaGravy is a similar product that contains more vitamins, so if your must have some sort of gravy, I recommend VitaGravy a bit more. Or you can also just mix in some warm water with your dog food and let it sit for a bit before you feed it to your dog. This creates a \\"gravy\\" like texture and aroma that most dogs love. Not the greatest idea if your dog has dental issues, but a great free solution for picky eaters.

product_title: Boots & Barkley Medium Vest - Fits Dogs 15lbs - 30lbs
review_body:
Our dog is part whippet (gosh I hope people don't read all my reviews..I say this way to often) and as a result, she gets cold rather easily. We can be sitting at home with the windows open on a nice 60 degree day, and she will let out the odd shiver. So when the midwest winter rolled around, with its -40 with windchill, we knew that we had to invest in some clothing. Now as I guy, I was firmly against this initially - \\"clothes don't belong on animals\\" I always said. It took about 3 seconds of my dog shivering for my mind to change.

QUALITY
Now at the price this is, I wasn't expecting much - turns out Boots & Barkley have done a decent job at creating a nice vest at a good price. We have had this for about 6 months now, and so far it has held up very well. The vest wraps around the top of your dog, and then secures with velcro underneath the chest, and around the neck. Now whenever I hear the words \\"velcro\\" and \\"budget\\" I always get a bit nervous, but so far the velcro has remained well attached, and sticks well.

FIT
We have an awkwardly shaped dog - she is part whippet so she is quite thin, but she is also part German Shepherd so she can be quite robust in the chest area. Fully grown, she weighs 24lbs, and this ended up fitting nicely albeit a little short along the back. The only issue that I have with this vest, is that it is shaped in a way that the back of the best (tail end) sticks up and will not lay fat. This is simply because of the way the velcro pulls to fit around our pup. Not a huge deal, but sometimes it looks like she has a little superhero cape on.

OVERALL
It's definitely a budget option, but if spending big bucks on dog clothes isn't something you (ever) want to do, this is definitely a good choice!

product_title: Joint MAX TRIPLE Strength SOFT CHEWS (240 CHEWS)
review_body: This is my third time purchasing Joint MAX triple strength soft chews. My dogs can't get enough of it. I initially purchased Joint MAX triple strength soft chews to facilitate my Border Collie's recovery from hip surgery in October. I only recently began giving it to my other two dogs. It is probably a little early to judge its effectiveness. I do, however know that my dogs absolutely LOVE the taste.     Below I give some background information on my dogs for anyone interested. Later I will add to this review regarding my opinion on its effectiveness.  We have 3 dogs with hip issues. Two hybrids with minor issues and one Border Collie named Ceasar. Ceasar showed up one day about 5 1/2 years ago. Our Veterinarian said he looked about 3 years old at that time and weighed only 23lbs.   He is a free spirit who loves to chase cars, so we had a tough time keeping him in the back yard. We ended up running a electric wire around the top of the fence. He only attempted to get out one more time after that. He favored one leg when he came to us and acquired a few more injuries over the next 2 years.   My husband took him along once when he dropped one of our horses off at the Veterinarian's Office. After seeing Ceasar run around our veterinarian, who is a friend of ours, told Michael that he ran like a rabbit and asked when Ceasar was going to have surgery.        Ceasar had 2 major surgeries in 2011. One in September and the other in October. The surgery is called FHO (False Hip Operation). This surgery involves the removal of the head (and sometimes the neck) of the affected femur. Then the muscles somehow form what the vet calls \\"a false hip joint\\".   Before the surgery out veterinarian told us due to Ceasar's age and the degree of joint degeneration and muscle atrophy he couldn't make any promises about how successful the operation would be and that there was the possibility that he could cut a nerve in his hip which could cause him to drag that leg for the rest of his life. We had 2 options:    1. Have the surgery and greatly increase the quality of the remainder of his life; or    2. Don't have the surgery and watch the pain suck the life out of our wonderful, loving dog.     After the second surgery our veterinarian told us that he didn't think he cut any nerves, and that it was the toughest surgery he had ever performed. Ceasar was in great pain for about three days after each surgery. But then he would get really bored and want to be busy again, but only for a little while. We began giving him  Joint Max Triple strength after the second operation.I am very happy to say that Ceasar has made almost a complete recovery and is doing great!!!

product_title: Fluval FX5 External Canister Filter
review_headline: One of the worst filters around
review_body: After reading all the reviews here I decided to get this filter for my 110 gallon aquarium. On paper it looked great. High enough flow, large media chamber, happy users. When I finally got it I filled it up with media (lava rock ) and a fine filter pad. After just a few days I noticed that there was tons of air in the filter and the filter was spreading tons of micro bubbles in my tank. Stoping the filter (and letting the air out) and restarting it multiple times did not help. I removed the fine filter pad which was already clogged. Hoped that would solve the problem. After a week or so the bubbles appeared again...opened up the filter...everything looked fine. Couldn't explain the bubble problem. The damn thing just kept sucking in air, no matter what I did. Then, I started hearing weird noises from the pump attached to it. The noises turned into loud sounds and the next day the pump was dead. Greeeaaaattt!!!   What can you expect from a filter that has a built in design flaw? I mean, the filter shuts off once every 24 hours TO LET OUT TRAPPED AIR!! That's part of its design. In other words, Fluval is fully aware that this terrible filter sucks in air, so instead of solving this design flaw, they decided to stop the pump once every 24 hours to let all the trapped air out. The problem is that the trapped air does not all go out and every 24 hours is not enough to avoid the micro-bubbles that will fill your tank.    Also, the way the water flows through the filter is is absolutely DESIGNED to get clogged very easily. As opposed to going through coarse media (such as lava rock in the media baskets) and then through finer media (such as the sponges that come with it) the water FIRST goes through the sponges before hitting any media in the media chambers. So all large pieces of gunk sucked in by the filter clog the sponge first. Granted, the sponge has larger pores..but not large enough to not get clogged within a few days to a few weeks.    Lastly, then this filter actually works without filling your tank with micro-bubbles or just dying on you, the water flow seems actually too high for effective biological filtration. I would definitely stay away from this filter. It just looks impressive (with impressive stats like water flow), but it's another cheap below average product from China. Like one of the reviewers before I went back to an Eheim classic and could not be happier.  Those are still the best canister filters money can buy (not so crazy about the newer Eheims, though).

3/5/2013 Update.... I meant to do this update some time ago but it's almost better that it is close to a year later as the fix is still working great!! The little fabric tabs ripped off within a very short time. Our solution was high strength, industrial, sticky backed Velcro. It fits snugly against the back and the wall. It has not once pulled away from the wall and the cats are pretty rough with the scratcher. Yes, it will cause damage to the wall, if and when removed but so do the screw holes that will need to be filled and didn't work in the first place. They had to cut through 3 layers of stomach, muscle and skin to extract the large toy. This was invasive, painful, expensive and something I don't want someone else to have to go through.

product_title: Pioneer Pet Raindrop Stainless Steel Pet Drinking Fountain
review_headline: Just okay, would not choose it again
review_body:
At it's current selling price, this is one relatively expensive water dish. Is it worth it? When I chose it, I hoped so. One of my two cats was becoming picky about drinking water and I hoped the bubbling design would peak his curiousity. At first both cats were turned off to the motor noise but eventually the female started to use the dish, but preferred a standard water dish. I wondered why both cats would try to drink but got turned off to using the dish, I assumed it was the motor noise so I waited a few months to see what would happen (and held off writing this review).

After careful observation I see now what's happening. It's not the motor noise, it's the design of the bowl itself. I wonder how a company can make a water dish without understanding one of the first basics of cats ... they don't want to stick their faces into places that are smaller than their whisker span. Duh. The artsy design of this dish makes the actual drinking area extremely tiny and odd teardrop shaped, with a high wall (the water slide) imposingly placed adjacent to the bowl. The cats just can't get their faces close to the water without their whiskers being squished and an unfriendly surface blocking their view (cats also need to be in control for protection against the unknown, the high wall prevents that).

Yesterday after cleaning the bowl I had the idea of setting the motor to the lowest speed and leaving the fancy curvy top off. Success! It is much more cat friendly now and still has the bubbling effect. But that leaves me with a very expensive plain water dish.

As others have noted, I suspect this is not really stainless steel but rather chrome plated metal. Even with soft, filtered water the surface stains and scales something terrible and is not easy to clean. I don't know why, but as others have noted it also gets slimy very fast (faster than a standard water dish), I suspect it's because the water is trapped under the metal cover and can't \\"breathe\\". I finally ran it through the dishwasher and had to spend a half hour scrubbing it by hand after that.

Looking back at the other bubbling water dishes, most have a large easy to access water surface (like the same company's Big Max). I should have seen the issue as soon as I looked at the photos, there is no logic at all for having such a tiny teardrop shaped water surface ... it's purely design over function and it makes this a poor choice for a feline water dish.

[ADDENDUM] After I wrote this review I decided to remove the motorized pump entirely. Now without the odd top cover and the whirring sound of a motor my cats love this dish. The picky one drinks from it regularly throughout the day. And the water doesn't get slimy. I could have (and should have) just bought a stainless steel dog dish for a fraction of the price. I'm leaving it at two stars which means \\"I don't like it\\" rather than one star for \\"I hate it\\".nd can't \\"breathe\\". review_body: We have a dog with skin issues that resulted in him smelling bad within a day or two of washing with conventional dog shampoos. I figured it was worth a shot. Well, it was! This is a good shampoo. It clearly is more than many of the pet shampoos that simply try to disguise odor with strong perfumes. We have found that we can wash him and now wait a full week and he still doesn't start to smell nearly as bad as he would before. He also rarely scratches now. It must be the tar or salicylic acid or maybe both..but the formula helps. Also, after the dog is washed, there is a slight medicinal odor that definitely lets you know he's been washed, but it's not strong. It's a mild, pleasant smell. This shampoo worked very well for our dog.

product_title: 2-Pack PetSafe Basic Bark Control Collar
review_body:
**UPDATE** a year later and we no longer use this. She started to outsmart the collar and would bark or whine low enough so the collar didn't detect it. It also on occasion would go off and not stop until we took it off her and took the batteries out. The burn thing is definitely true one of those going off non stop happened while she was outside and I couldn't here her it left a very large gaping wound. At that point I threw it away. I will say that the batteries lasted way longer than i expected, about a month each.

Honestly I hated the idea of using this and over 2 years we tried everything to get our female black lab to stop barking and freaking out over everything! If we left the house she would bark like crazy when we left and came back even if we were gone for 30 seconds ( forgot something and had to turn around. we tried leaving her in the house unsupervised, tried crate training (2 heavy duty crates with padlocks later) tried leaving her in the backyard, even with our other dog, she would still freak out. Long walks even a couple mile runs, hikes and swimming did NOTHING to calm her down.

At first she obviously freaked out and there were a couple times were she would bark constantly and get shocked but it does shut off when that happens. We dont even really use it anymore and it's been about a month or so and she can stay in the yard perfectly fine doesn't bark or whine or try to get out. She sits under a tree and plays with her bone or ball which would never have happened before. She's way more calm when people she knows come over she still barks but only once maybe twice for new people AT the door not just walking by, which is exactly what we wanted.

We did however need the extra batteries but haven't even gone thru all of them yet. All in all I would definitly use this again instead of spending hundreds of dollars on crates, crazy toys and meds, none of which worked.

product_title: Fluval Underwater Filter
review_body: I have an older Fluval 3 Plus in the main aquarium in our living room and a Fluval 2 Plus in my son's 20gal in his bedroom.. My daughter decided she wanted her own tank as well, so we bought one of those all-in-one kits that came with a Bio Wheel filter. It was obscenely loud! I don't see how she could have slept with it running!   I ordered the U2 to quiet things down and it has done that well. It doesn't seem like it moves as much water as the older 2 Plus, but I haven't noticed any problems with water clarity or quality, so it must be doing just fine. The tank has stayed clean, and I like the ability to add Biomax into the center compartment - that's something the older Fluvals didn't have. The selectable sprayers are kind of nice too, but I just have it set to the top sprayer. On the older filters you could \\"aim\\" the nozzle, which gave you more options for hiding the filter but directing the water out into the tank better - this one seems to just shoot straight out, but they do have a little 'C' shaped cone that you can put on the nozzle that redirects the water a little bit.  Also, on the older Fluvals, they had an indicator that would pop up on the top of the filter when your flow was good, but as the media got funky it slides down into the filter body - kind of a nice visual reminder that it's beyond cleaning time! That's gone on the U2.  All in all it's good filter, but I would give up the bells and whistles (multiple sprayers, biomax inserts, etc) to have some of the basics back like the swiveling sprayer and reminder, so I docked it one star.

product_title: Cat Dancer - Cat Charmer Wand Teaser Toy
review_body: My cat is profoundly weird as it is possibly the only cat who doesn't go nuts over a laser pointer, so toys for him are a little hard to come by.  But this toy is practically a worship object for him.  He ADORES this thing.  He goes crazy when I bring it out, and he has started to find all my hiding spots, so he drags it out all on his own to play with it.  I make sure I pin it down with something heavy if I leave the room.  This is a supervised toy.  You'd think a stick with a string wouldn't be that fascinating, but when I slide it tantalizingly across the ground in agonizing slow motion, he literally can't stand it.  Must.  Attack.  Now.  He pounces so hard he invented carpet sliding.  His record is about a foot.  This is a great little toy, because it is made from soft (super soft) felt, so you don't have to feel bad if you whack your cat (or an innocent bystander).  It's sort of like a whip, so this is bound to happen.  Actually, my cat prefers to get hit in the face with it.  It just slides over his head between his ears, and he flips over on his back in a frantic lunge.  Must Bite.  Must Chew.  Must Annihilate!  It's seriously adorable to watch.  The plastic stick on the end is really light weight, so your arm doesn't get tired until about the hour mark. Extended playtime.  Concerns about tangling and knotting can be cast aside.  My cat enjoys getting tangled up in it and just laying down with it around him, but the felt slides.  Just a little tug and the network of string he's created around his paws comes undone without any knotting.  Again, though, this is a supervised toy.  I would not recommend leaving your cat alone with it.  It is hard to get tangled permanently because of the slipping felt (a great, great feature), but there is the chance (however remote) it can wrap around the cat's neck.  So if you let him play with it by himself just keep a close eye.  The only problem I have found is my cat has all of his claws, so occasionally he snags one of them in the fabric.  The problem fixes itself, though, because of the sturdiness of the felt.  It is a tight, sturdy material, so there's no fraying to make the snag permanent.  When snagging does happen, my cat has figured out he's just digging in too hard, so he lets go.  Nothing actually gets stuck stuck, just caught for a split second.  Not only is the felt sturdy, but so is the stick it's attached to.  The string is attached with a rubber cover piece, and my cat has yanked on it for all he's worth.  The thing hasn't budged.  This toy is going to last for a long time.  All in all, it is amazing and totally worth the price.  A must buy for any cat owner.  You will get hours of entertainment.

product_title: PCI Chicken Nibbles 4- 1lb. Containers
review_body: Bodie, our 2 year old Maltese-Yorkie \\"foodie snob\\"  loves these treats! He finds all sorts of reasons to earn Chicken Nibbles. review_body: I bought this because of the good reviews, but it wasn't what I was looking for. review_headline: Very Safe and good brand for large breed puppies
review_body: Large breeds such as Bernese Mountain Dogs should not be fed puppy food due to very high protein content in puppy food. So our Bernese puppy typically has adult kibble with lower protein content. However, his litter have a lot of digestive issues so now and then he needed a soft food versus kibble & needs t be bland - that's where this product comes in. Our puppy (who's never been a good eater) will eat Organix canned chicken& rice especially when he's not feeling so great. We've noticed that his tummy's able to handle this food without him being in pain or having diarrhea. He also loves the kibble version (once in a while for a change from his usual kibble).

product_title: Go Pet Club 72" Tall Beige Cat Tree Furniture
review_headline: My cats LOVE their cat tree!!
review_body: My cats love this cat tree.  It is the perfect size for them.  It was easy to assemble and is sturdy when placed in a corner.  The cats jump around on it and sleep on the upper platforms at night.  For reference, my cats are 8 lbs. and 17 lbs.  Both fit comfortably on it.
