product_title: Four Paws 200pk Bags 22x23 Wee Wee Pads
review_body: I have 2 (4lb) small breed puppies 1 female and 1 male just so you have a picture. The puppies were definitely attracted to the pads and it was very easy to get them to use the pads which I am grateful. The first pads I ever purchased were the Natures Miracle Advanced Wee Pads and not by choice I just walked in having just gotten my puppies and grabbed the first thing I came across. Now Natures Miracle was a tad expensive so I started looking for another brand more in my price range so I did a lot of research and this brand was rated high by people, then as luck would have it Pet Supplies Plus had a great sale on Four Paws Wee-Wee Pads, now after some use and after the excitement of them actually using the pads I started to become a tad disappointed. You pay a good dollar for these pads and I started to notice things, the size is smaller than the other pads and the 23x23 size meant I had to use 2 of them in my crates and on a side note the actual size of usable pad is 21x21. They are pretty thin and I have felt dampness on the underside of these pads which is a problem since they were sitting on carpet( I have since bought crate replacement trays). When the pups went tinkle it would just sit on the top of the fabric and pool before actually soaked in allowing the pups to walk thru it and tracking it on my carpet. When the  female went tinkle she pretty much use up a good portion of the pad so I was changing them often so the price savings now has gone out the door.  I also found there was no odor control with these pads.   So now I have tried Four Paws Wee-Wee pads, Dynarex Under pads(worst),Simply Right Super Absorbent under pads(very good-still use) and Natures Miracle Advanced Wee Pads(still use)and find Natures Miracle Advanced Ultra is the best by far for doggie wee pads!   I have to admit I am impressed on how absorbent Natures Miracle Advanced Ultra turned out to be. They claim to hold 6 cups of liquid and I believe it, this is the only pad with Polymer in it, Polymer helps absorption and keeps the spread of the liquid to a minimum getting more use out of the pad, this pad is also fantastic at keeping odor absorbed. I find Petsmart is the only place I can get these pads in-store in my area. The pad size is larger than the other wee pads at 27x23 compared to 23x24 and Natures  usable pad area is pretty close to the 27x23 size where  the other pads can be up to 4inches smaller in usable area size (so your 23x24 pad is actually 19x21 inches)because the blue border is non-absorbent and not usable(Dynarex brand)!! I just bought Natures Miracle Advanced Ultra on sale at Petsmart, 100pads for $39 which is a great price but I only use these in my crate due to that high price and for visit at friends houses. For daily use, I now go with Simply Right Super Absorbent 23x36 under pads from Sam's club which is also a very good product, not bad at keeping odor at bay,  the size fits replacement crate trays, more room for 2 pups to use and best of all the  cheap price tag of  $24 for 120 pads and they are sold in-store, no need to order online.  I will admit I would use these pads again if need be but there is no real savings in them as you do use more.

product_title: PetSafe Drinkwell Platinum Pet Fountain
review_body: I was a little skeptical about buying this product but because Amazon is terrific about returns, I went ahead with purchase.  It had very little assembly and at first when I set it up, it made a horrible noise, but in a few minutes it got a little less.  When I moved it to the floor after about a day, I put it on a rubber mat and it was very quite.  I found out later that you have to fill up BOTH the reservoir and the filter tank!  I only filled up the reservoir.  My cats were a little nervous, but after a day, they love it.  Great product.  5 stars from me!

review_body: I was very pleased to see the 2 cat bowls with the stand.  It looks nice and is well worth the money paid.  Thank you.

product_title: PetSafe Gentle Spray Bark Collar for Dogs, Citronella, Anti-Bark Device, Water Resistant
review_headline: Border collie learned in first spray, schnauzer has issues as his head shacking sets it off...
review_body: I ordered two collars a few days ago and was amazed at how fast they arrived.  At first glance they look pretty good, perhaps a little cheap but fairly sturdy.  I opened the first box and filled the sprayer and quickly found a co-worker who wanted to try it.  It worked with the slightest of barks from her, the office busted out in laughter and I then had a line of people that wanted to try it.    When I got home I opened the other box and set them up on my two dogs.  One is a 9 year old Border Collie which has a few little isms but after the very first spray she instantly stopped barking/growling.  A+  Now the second collar went onto my white Schnauzer.  I fitted the collar on him and he was ok with the collar, he likes collars.  He is the main reason I bought them.  He goes into barking fits when we leave and will nearly never stop until we get home.  Our neighbors told us this and we have seen it first hand.  Well, the collar is on him and he is good with it.    **He follows me upstairs and shakes his head, SPRAY! he sneezes and SPRAY, shakes his head again as some got into his eyes and SPRAY again!  I take the thing off and right when I did that my border shook her head and SPRAY.  No where did I read that them shaking their heads would make this thing spray and I am royally pissed off now.**    My poor border is looking at me all sad (she was a abused rescue and is beyond smart and sweet.)  My Schnauzer is a little booger at times and while I do want him to learn not to bark I do not want him to get sprayed for just shaking his head.    I am going to give it a day or two after I monkey around with it and see if I did something wrong or if there is a way to adjust the sensitivity (doubtful.)  Does it work on Border Collies, yes and very quickly.  Work on Schnauzers...the jury is out.  I just wonder if \\"corrective stimulation\\" AKA Shock collars do the same thing...  I will update this review in a couple days.

review_body: I'm very happy with this playpen for my rabbits. I set it up in a square so I can bring up the sides of the plastic mat. I have a Mama dwarf rabbit and two babies. They spend their nights in a cage and all day in the playpen. It's very easy to keep clean. I just take it outside and hose it off.

product_title: American Classic Mallard - Large
review_body: The toy seems to be holding up pretty solidly with my 2 75 and 90 lb labs.  Normally, this kind of toy is destroyed in an hour.  It has lasted 5 days and shows no wear so far, although I am not allowing any tug-o-war.  I do have 1 big complaint tho. product_title: Groovypets® Remote Dog Training Shock Collar Trainer / Rechargeable Dog Collar for No Bark Obedience Behavioral Training
review_headline: Fantastic!! Why did we wait so long?
review_body: Our Groovypets collars arrived last week... and one week later we couldn't be more satisfied.  We have two small (less than 15 lb.) dogs ... a Cockapoo and a Yorkiepoo.  One's a barker ... the other is the stubborn type that stands and stares at you in defiance with that look that says: \\"I know what the command COME means, but I have no intention of obeying.\\"  Truly, we're amazed. Vibrate does the trick!! (OK, I'll admit, the stubborn 'bolter' has required two L1 corrections, but that's it!) FOR OTHER SMALL DOG OWNERS:  Don't panic at the size of the collars. product_title: Coralife 05618 Aqualight T5 Freshwater Dual Lamp Fixture, 30-Inch
review_headline: One bulb dead in less than 2 months, now completely dead @ 4 months.
review_body:
I was happy with this fixture. It works well on my 29 gallon 30\\" tank. However, less than 2 months after purchase, one bulb is out and the other one is very dark on one end. I went to Petsmart and picked up 2 new bulbs (for almost the cost of this fixture). And now it's working well again. Hopefully this was a fluke with the bulbs that came with the fixture.

review_body: There's not much to say about what amounts to a shag rake, but it does its job well, holds up under repeated use and doesn't take up much space in the closet.  I'm glad I bought it.

review_body: Over all happy with my Sherpa Original Large Pet Carrier. It's more than roomy enough for my 9.5 lbs Sabrina and the construction is sturdy. My only quibble is that the carrying strap for the shoulder could be longer.

review_body: We have a cat who refuses to drink from a bowl and insists on sipping from the faucets, so this little purchase has proven quite helpful! However, it runs very quietly and is not a disturbance to a quiet home. It's flow is also adjustable and is not overbearing--no overflow splashes noted on the flooring. I copied and pasted it, and came up with:  [...]    I also read that the small animals' feet get stuck in the ramp's bars, and the petstreetmall one had covers and the price was much cheaper.

product_title: Pioneer Pet Raindrop Ceramic Drinking Fountain
review_body:
I'll keep the review part of this short to make room for the modification... Basically this works great. My cats both drank out of it right away although the older one was a little timid for a few days. Now they both drink quite a bit more water which was the goal. We always feed dry food, canned only comes out once a month or less unless they're sick and need coaxing to eat. With a dry diet they need to have access to lots of water and be encouraged to drink, this product does that.
---
The Cons: Some water noise and a very small amount of splash over the edge. Enough that I'd put it on a plastic tray if I didn't do the below modification.
---
The Mod: This mod will cost about $3 and fix both the noise and the splashing. Order this fountain and then go out and buy some Sabra hummus, eat and enjoy, retain lid. (google image search Sabra Hummus) Once you're done take some scissors and cut the lid along the \\"wave\\" in the label, discarding the part of the lid with the label. Now trim off about 2/3 of the red rim on the remaining section of lid leaving a tab or hook in the middle. Slip this between the \\"waterfall\\" part and the bowl and you're done! For me this solved both the noise and the splash with about two minutes work. (PS, try the Buffalo Wing hummus!)

Four stars because they could have included a part like this in the design and I don't think it should need modification in order to not splash water. Maybe they should include a coupon for hummus?

Now that she has stopped licking the soap during bath time I am going to switch to something with a more heavy-duty cleaner in it, because afterall she is a dog and loves to roll in whatever stinks the worst. This was a great starter shampoo but I found myself doing 2 washes each bath-time, it was hard to lather, but was very gentle. Good puppy shampoo. The best part about this shampoo is that it smells really good.

product_title: Bergan Turbo Track Cat Toy
review_body:
I bought two of the track sets fearing that they would be ignored and planing on donating them to the local animal shelter in case they were a flop, cats are so hard to predict, but I couldn't resist this, what a great design! I set them up yesterday, and as feared, it was ignored after a couple of sniffs. I maniacally rolled the balls around the track for my two cats, a nine year old and a four year old, saying, \\"See?! Isn't this fun?!\\" Nada. Sigh. This evening however, the four year old walked by the track and gave one of the balls a whack. (YES!) He has been at it for a good ten minutes now. I did put a few treats under the balls for motivation. I'll try a pinch of catnip later and see if that will make the nine year old interested.

So far the track hasn't come apart even with the vigorous activity, the rolling on it with legs flailing in the air, and this Tabby is a tad tubby. It's on short pile carpet right now but am thinking for those with problems with the track separating, maybe a sheet of foam core or Crescent board under it might solve that problem, I plan on doing something like that for when I need to move it. Gee, I want to get more track now, some of the configurations I've seen on YouTube are quite inspiring.

The next day: The four year old, Mafufo, must have played with this all night. Each time I woke up I could hear the two balls bumping against each other. They sound like billiard balls. Needless to say, I dreamed I was playing pool.

He is my new little fur ball so I have been very cautious about what he eats and the type of foods that he is exposed to. I really didn't want to get into the habit of buying cheap foods and treats with random fillers and terrible nutrition, so I was always open to advice from the \\"experts\\". After doing some reading, I realized that Blue Buffalo is indeed one of the best most natural brands of Dog Foods available, so I jumped at the chance at trying these little treats for my in-training pup. They are great! He absolutely loves them and will literally do anything for them! He has already learned how to sit, lay, 'dance', 'paw', and stay! One thing I do recommend, is that if you have a smaller pup (mine is a shihpoo, 5months, 8lbs) cut these treats in half! They are perfectly capable of eating them as a whole piece, but you totally get your money's worth by breaking them down in halves ;)

product_title: Fluval Poly Foam Pad - 3-Pack
review_headline: C3 Filter Media this is the only place to Buy them!
review_body:
Although this filter (c3) has many parts to buy and change these units are very nice. Granted they are just little pieces of foam, but at 5 dollars it was great finding them here, and not paying 12 bucks. You can get them other places online, but they are more expensive. As for stores like PetSmart, no they don't carry the C3, C4, any of the Fluval products. Very irritating. I suggest you order them way before you need them, because you won't find them without waiting for shipping. Order at least 2 at the 5 dollar price, because the c3 filter uses these very quickly, and they are hard to clean out, or reuse.

EDIT*
These foam pieces rinse out a few times with little fish debris in them, but after a while they start breaking apart, and becoming flimsy. Esp if you use hot water to rinse them.
Save some money and buy Marineland Rite Size Filter pads. They last forever, and can be cut to fit perfect in any of the C3, C4 etc models. They collect just as much debris at a fraction of the cost and rinse better and last longer. OR you could buy these over and over and keep throwing five dollars plus shipping away.

product_title: Triple Cat Tunnel
review_body: This cat condo/perch is very sturdy, but also a bit wobbly. The tunnels are a good size for average and larger cats.  The top platform is very large and can fit more than one cat comfortably.  The cats play by jumping and running through the tunnels and when that's over, the cats sleep in them.  My recommendation for a future product improvement:  sisal on the posts. product_title: Pyrantel 50mg 16oz
review_headline: Comparing "apples to apples"  or should I say,  "meds to meds"
review_body:
I raise cats and have a menagerie of pets. Finding the best way to care for them AND my pocketbook is what I have done through researching the FACTS. This product is the identical medication you find in some of the varieties of worming products found at your local pet store for cats and/or dogs. This product does not treat tapeworms, but most of the other worms dogs and cats are afflicted with. I have saved a small fortune in many ways by using common sense to my approach to taking care of my animals.

For preventative measures I have all my cats, 2 dogs and 3 horses on strict worming programs as well as flea prevention programs. Many of the ingredients are the same in many products (NOT ALL PRODUCTS!) I have used certain types of horse wormers for my cats and dogs because it is the EXACT same medication. I use SPECIFIC \\"large dog\\" flea products on my cats and save this way, too! (not all flea meds are safe on cats) The important thing to know is if the medication can be safely used on a specific species and the CORRECT DOSAGE. Basic math skills provide this as well as understanding the CONCENTRATION of the medication.

Bottom line is knowing all the FACTS. And one of the facts is that this is a great product at a great price!

product_title: Romp! Dog Whisperer with Cesar Millan Tied and True, 3-Knot Cotton Rope Toss and Tug Dog Toy, Large

product_title: Precious Cat Ultra Premium Clumping Cat Litter
review_body: The price is right and there is no dusting or fragrance, but when litter doesn't do it's main duty of clumping, it's not worth it.  I just switched and won't be buying again.  I have a sifter box and it's horrible...either my cat has super pee or it does next to nothing for normal cats pee.  Hardly even sticks to the poo.  I had to clean it with its own trash bag and didn't even last a few minutes while I gathered my other garbage cans to consolidate, it smelled so bad.  I'll be going back to fresh step, fragrance and dusting or not.

product_title: Angels' Eyes Tear-Stain Eliminator for Dogs and Cats, Beef Flavor, 120 Grams Bottle
review_body: I finished the bottle of angel eyes on my 6 month Cockapoo and had no luck. Her tear stains are still as bad as ever. She never had a problem with the taste though, just mixed it in with some wet food every night.

product_title: JW Pet Company iSqueak Ball Rubber Dog Toy, Colors Vary
review_body: These types of balls were never designed to be chew toys and one should supervise their use.  This isn't the type of toy where you give it to your dog and walk away hoping they entertain themselves. If you want that type of toy look to getting a Kong.  But even their sqeaker ball was destroyed when I was not paying attention.  I sometimes think the destruction comes from the dog's frustration at my not paying attention to her.  I came to this realization after buying every squeaker ball made and my new Belgium Malinois destroyed them all.  There isn't a ball made she can't destroy.  So I reserve this ball for when we play together and put it away when we are done.  This makes the ball super special to her and it makes me take the time to interact with her.  This method means that I \\"own\\" the ball and allow her to play with it thus increasing the value of the ball as a reward. Since I began this practice the ball survives and my dog and I have good times together.

product_title: Miracle Coat Equine Grooming Shear
review_body: This was exactly what I wanted and the posting described it exactly and correctly.  The scissors are very sharp but safe because of the rounded tip. The case is an added plus.

product_title: Cayman 2 Pet Carrier
review_body: We ordered the Cayman 2 for our 12 pound cat. The assembling of the pet carrier took approximately 10 minutes and was easy. One month later we moved from L.A. to Houston. The carrier is secure, sturdy, has enough openings for the air-circulation and our cat was happy in it during the flight. The most important thing is that our cat is never scared when we use it. We would definitely buy it again.

product_title: Beef Pill Pockets Large 7.9oz
review_body:
I bought 2 bags from Costco which was cheaper than from my vet's office, until I saw this on Amazon. There is no way you can find a better deal anywhere else. Some people think the quality is not great. To me, I don't really see a difference.

If your pet needs to take meds, get this. Ever since we started using the pill pockets, my husband is happy, I'm happy, and our dogs are happy as well. They love the pill pockets. In fact, they look forward to getting their meds now.

product_title: Vibran-Sea So. Amercian Rift Cluster Silk-Style Aquarium Plant, Large 13-14 tall, Plum
review_headline: It's Artificial, What Do You Expect?
review_body: I'll give this plant a 4-star rating. The plant has some realistic motion in the tank from water currents, but you won't see much movement if you are only using an over-the-back style filter, a power head is needed to get the water moving enough. I like the purple coloring in the plant, but it seems a bit unbalanced. I am using mine in an aquarium with white sand and dark rocks so the contrast is pretty cool. I am not super-fond of the base. You can't really bury these too deep and keep it looking somewhat realistic. Therefore, if you have fish that like to root around and move your substrate for you, the base will show eventually. Overall, this is a decent artificial plant for a fair and reasonable price. Silk plants are much better than plastic and this is about the same price as a plastic. We'll see how it stands the test of time, however, since silk plants tend to fray over time...

product_title: Instinct Grain-Free Duck Meal, Sweet Potato and Cinnamon Dog Biscuits by Nature's Variety, 21-Ounce Packages (Pack of 2)
review_body: Agree with the other reviewer, everything about these treats is great.   The ingredients are fantastic, not too expensive, (although not exactly cheap), they're easy to split up but don't end up all crumbled at the end of the box. they even *smell* good! and my dog loves them.  Ingredients. Duck Meal, Tapioca, Garbanzo Bean Flour, Sweet Potatoes, Pork Fat, Pumpkinseeds, Montmorillonite Clay, Natural Vegetable Flavor, Dried Egg Whites, Cinnamon, Guar Gum, Inulin, Mixed Tocopherols with Citric Acid (a natural preservative), Rosemary Extract, Direct-Fed Microorganism (Dried Bacillus Coagulans Fermentation Product).

product_title: Zanies Poly/Cotton Embroidered Heart Berber Bones Dog Toy
review_headline: 8 bones?  NO 8" bone for 6$- way too expensive for what it is!
review_body: I am culpable for thinking it was 8 of these toys- a crappy 1-3 dollar item at best.  The title uses the number '8' and I wrongfully assumed I was getting these at just under a buck.  That would have been worth it but 6 bucks for this is insane, get it at a dollar store.  Maybe it's just me, but I think using the 8 in the title without an inches mark or the word inches was a deliberate attempt to mislead the consumer and I sincerely feel ripped off.

product_title: Solvit 62294 Pet Vehicle Safety Harness, Small
review_headline: Solvit 62294 Pet Vehicle Safety Harness, Small
review_body: I was not very pleased with this harness.  The one that I received looked different from the one pictured; therefore, I had difficulty determining which part was the top and which part was the bottom.  The instructions were not very clear.  Also, my dog was not comfortable wearing it.  I traveled with her in November of last year and had to take it off because she was uncomfortable. I would prefer having one that looks like the one illustrated.  But it is too late to return it.  I did not immediately try it on my dog when I received it unfortunately, and too much time has passed.  I am stuck with this harness.

product_title: Pet Studio Dog Ramp Folds Flat Carpeted 3 Step Stairs
review_body: These stairs are well made and stable.  My dog who is about 15 pounds is fine on them.  She still hasn't warmed up to them yet (been about a month) still wants to jump on and off bed but I think she will. All in all a very nice product that delivers what it promises.

product_title: Marineland Emperor 400 Pro Series Bio-wheel Power Filter - Up to 80 gallon, Rite Size "E"
review_body: [[ASIN:B000HHOI8G Emperor 400 Pro Series Bio-wheel Power Filter - Up to 90 gallon, Rite Size \\"E\\"]]I highly recommend this filter. I was pleasantly surprised when it arrived after only 4 days. I set it up and can't say enough how happy I am with it. It's very quiet and easy to use.

product_title: Our Pet`s Durapet Stainless Steel Slow Feed Dish Small
review_body: Was excited about this product for my ridgeback as she eats ger food in about 10 seconds!  This was nice looking and well made but, after one or two feedings, she was right back to her old speed in eating.  This leaves too much room between the bump and sides so a smart pup just eats around the bump as fast as ever.

product_title: K&H Manufacturing Outdoor Kitty House (Heated & Unheated)
review_body: This product is wonderful! It is very easy to put together (it all velcro's together) and I have to small cats who both can fit inside comfortably. They love it in this cold weather! I am so glad I got this!

product_title: F705 14" Self-watering basket
review_body: I was stationed in England and these are just like the ones I'd buy at the garden centers there.  Heavy construction with chain, as self-watering reservoir a the bottom that has a capillary mat to feed the roots without keeping the roots in the water;  much healther for the plant.  I only wished it came in a 16 inch as well as a 14 inch size!  Excellent choice for hanging baskets. I expect them to last for years.

product_title: Gumby 9" and Pokey 6" Dog Toys
review_headline: Durable Toy even for a large dog.
review_body: Looked at quite a few different brands for this type of chew toy.  This one turned out to be very durable and has been a good toy for our lab.

product_title: Integrated Pet Solutions SnuggEase Washable Dog Diaper
review_body: Works perfectly for my Great Dane which is 125 lbs and in Heat. We use a pad as well BUT NOT needed at all. It has an inner pad that is reusable and keeps its quality wash after wash. The outer shell is like a raincoat keeping all waste and smell inside. The hard side of the Velcro never touches the dogs skin so as to prevent chafing. Overall, works for what is was made for bottom line.

product_title: Petmate Replendish Gravity Waterer w/ Microban
review_headline: Too difficult to put bottle in
review_body: I was hopeful that this would be the best large water bowl, but I am unhappy with it. The screw in bottle is nearly impossible to seat properly with the heavy 4 gallon bottle filled. Heavy AND slippery. A different type of plastic would be less slippery and more durable. The thinness of this plastic makes it easy to dent and crack. As much as I like the capacity, it is difficult to use.

product_title: Heated Pet Mat
review_body: Had a litter of puppies in December. Placed the pad in a 4 x 4 whelping pen so the mother did not have to lay on the pad.  Puppies stay so nice and warm on pad, that I'm no longer using any additional heat source.  They have learned to crawl off of the pad when warm and pile up on it when they get cold.  Pad works great. The cover is sort of a joke but I just let puppies lay right on the heating pad.

product_title: K&H Manufacturing Kitty Sill Deluxe with Bolster
review_body:
My kitty absolutely loves this bed, in fact, he never wants to get out of it.

I liked the fact that screws were included so that it could be mounted to the window sill with ease. You can also remove the bolster because it is only attached with a zipper.

The best part about the bed is that the cover is removable and washable, which comes in handy since my kitty is long-haired.

product_title: Da Bird Feather Teaser Replacement Feathers, Assorted
review_body: My cats loved it, so that means i loved it. I was happy with the purchae! I would certainly buy it again.

product_title: Base Jumper Rain Coat, Yellow Medium
review_body: This item is puzzling because although I was careful to get the correct size according to the seller's reckoning, it was much too small when I tried it on my Maltese.  I had bought this item to give as a gift for a friend with a Maltese the same size as mine.  At the same time, I bought a different, blue, rain/wind coat for my own Maltese.  It turns out that the 2 garments were almost identical in fabric and construction but this yellow one was more than twice the price of the blue one!  It got sent back...

product_title: Farm Innovators Model R-19 Economical 1-1/2-Gallon Round Heated Pet Bowl, Blue, 60-Watt
review_body: This is a simple, perfect solution for watering our chickens.  Stops heating when the temperature rises, saving energy - turns on when it gets cold, so the water never freezes.  I'll dump it & rinse once a week and that's about all it needs.  The heat does tend to make the water evaporate faster than you think, though, so check it every day.

product_title: Wellness 95% Natural Wet Grain Free Canned Dog Food, 13.2-Ounce Can (Pack of 12)
review_body: This is a great product for my dogs. They love it and it is grain free for their allergy sensitivities.

product_title: Joy Double End Pet Dental Tooth Scaler, Stainless Steel
review_body: This product will save me alot of money in cleanings for my 4 yorkies.  My dogs don't really like things in their mouths, so it is going to take some time for them to get use to ... but getting a 392 dollar  estimate, they will have to get use to me scraping their teeth.  I know now I will have to do it in short spirts, they wiggle so much.  This is very sharp, so you have to be so careful not to cut their gums.  I am glad I purchased this instrument.

product_title: 2-Piece Dog Crate Cover and Bed Set
review_body: I was pretty surprised when I opened the box and there was no crate with it. I clearly didn't read the description very well lol. But before I returned it because I need the actual crate more than the pretty cover, I checked it out and love it. Its high quality and really pretty. I got a crate at Petco because I couldn't return this product (even though I spent twice what I want to... :)

product_title: Metal Curry Comb
review_body: I love my new brush. I use it on my dog. She seems to enjoy it and it picks up lots of hair. I have the furminator, but it seems to make her uncomfortable but she loves the curry comb and just relaxes when I brush her.

product_title: Cat/Dog Pink Collapsible Paw Prints Pet House-Medium
review_body: This house is adorable, it is soft and roomy enough for a cozy sleep. I got it for my 4 month old shih tzu and she loves it. Sure, she gets rough and jumps all over it at times but its easy enough to put back together, only thing i found was washing the little mattress thing, the foam gets all bunch up inside the cover and it can take a while to pull straight since there is no opening for it but otherwise i'd recommend it!!

product_title: Purina Friskies Classic Pate Wet Cat Food, 5.5 oz
review_body: I purchased this to replace another brand that has been discontinued. Am I ever glad it was! I just thought my cats were saving some for later.... They absolutely love this brand in every flavor!!! I have one cat with special urinary tract needs so they all get the special diet food. I am very happy to have found Little Friskies Special Diet!!! Please don't ever stop making this canned cat food!

product_title: Nilodor Natural Touch Bio-Enzymatic Stain and Odor Eliminator
review_body: yeah the people come out to your house sell you this expensive unit and FAIL to tell you that you have to have this thing SERVICED every so often!!!!!!! yes this unit works great- but there is better out there than this heavy, and EXPENSIVE unit!!!! had ours for under 5 years didnt know we had to have it serviced as no one ( the sales person ) told us this and this expensive piece now is sitting in a shed because it doesnt work! SO DO YOUR HOMEWORK ON THESE BEFORE SHELLING OUT MAJOR DOUGH ON IT!!!!!!!!!

product_title: Classic Accessories 70-006-013701-00 Heritage Automotive Dog Rear Seat Protector
review_body:
Love ordering from Amazon. My products come in a timely manner and they are always what I expect.
This is a great product for anyone who transports pets.

product_title: PetSafe Simply Clean Self-Cleaning Cat Litter Box, Automatic, Works with Clumping Cat Litter
review_body: Didn't take my cat long to get used to this cat box. It keeps it clean which both my cat & I appreciate.  Only thing my cat is big & throws some of the litter out of the box.

product_title: AquaTop Aquarium Heater - 100W
review_body:
I bought this to use in my 30 gallon tank. It is very easy to set up and use and it works well. The heater is fully submersible and probably the best part of it for me is the ability to calibrate it. If the temperature of the water doesn't match what your heater is set to, you can easily change that.

Took me several calibrations to get it right but it does work in the end.

product_title: Multipet Plush Dog Toy
review_body: My dog got this toy as a birthday present back in Sept. He loves it and it still works so the batteries last a really long time. It's pretty durable and it's cute.

product_title: K&H Cool Bed III Cooling Dog Bed
review_body: My 13 year old Lab loves her cooling bed.  She has a thyroid condition that keeps her panting all the time.  We have a high velosity fan going all the time on her.  It took her a few days to get used to it so I put her old bed next to it.  I found each day more of her body would be on the water bed.  First just her head.  Now she stays on it all the time.  She also has the hip problems that come along with older Labs.  I am so glad we found it for her. Great product and the merchant shipped it right away.  Got it fast.  Very pleased. Amazon helped me fing the best deal online!

product_title: Anti-bark Dog Training Shock Control No Barking Collar
review_body: When ordering the item description said it was for small dogs. I have a toy poodle that weighs about 6 pounds. I put the collar on him and he seemed comfortable.  The test came when my brother walked through the door. He barked and the warning sound beeped. He barked again and another beep. Well the next bark caused the shock. He continued to bark and the shocks intensified. I guess it became painful because he started running, screaming, and trembling.  As he continued to scream he was continuously shocked. I had to hold him down to remove the collar. Apparently the shocks were too sttrong for his size.

product_title: Hugs Pet Products Apple Chew Toy
review_headline: Too big for a 20 lb dog
review_body: Our 20 lb dog was just not interested in this toy. it was too large to fit comfortably in her mouth, and she found it too solid to just play with or chew. A larger dog would probably have enjoyed it. I had no problem inserting the treats.

product_title: VetriScience Laboratories Mega Probiotic for Dogs and Cats, 120 Capsules
review_headline: Cats can't detect it in their food.
review_body:
I went shopping around for a broad probiotic for pets and I needed it to have three specific flora strains in it. The Vetri-Mega product turned up in the results. After reading the reviews, I went ahead and made the purchase of the Vetri-Mega and I couldn't be happier with the ease of use and results. For cats, it says they should get 1/2 a capsule once per day. The capsules can be opened up easily to pour the probiotic powder onto their food before stirring it in.

Neither of my two cats can detect it in any of the flavors of the wet foods it has been offered with. This product also mixed in just fine with the occasional water-saturated dry food they get and the cats still had no issues with detecting it or rejecting their meal. I wish I could say that about other powdered supplements I have tried. Some dissolve so badly it makes the cats sneeze when trying to eat, even if well-mixed. Not this one! The Vetri-Mega will dissolve quickly and is fine enough that the cats don't care about it being in the food. I would definitely make the purchase again.

product_title: Esky Dog Training Collar Waterproof 330 Yard LCD Backlight Remote Control Dog Training Shock Collar
review_body:
Have a Walk Hound, nearing 100 lbs just over 1 yr old. When master weights only 116 lbs, well you can see I needed something to help my pup help me. Rascal is his name, but Pupzilla became his nickname as he is one big pup. Dearly love him. After a hit by a snowmobile trailer from not listening and totally back to the norm, this device became my new best friend. Took only three try's on Pupzilla and no more chasing cars. He looks at me now as if to say, \\"Mom, they bite back\\". I only had to use 60% mode for Pupzilla to see that cars do in deed bite back. Haaa

Some reviews said the auto shut off was annoying, but personally I like it as not wasting the battery. When it shuts down and if not too long after needing it again, one tap and it comes back on and ready for use. 100% sold on it and not expensive taboot! God is good!

product_title: Ethical Pet Skinneeez Exotic Series Dog Toy
review_body: My youngest dog loves this toy.  This is her favorite.  I like the skinneeez toys becaue there is no stuffing in them.  Seem to last longer then the toys with stuffing in them.

product_title: HDP Paw Style Small Pet CARRIER
review_body: This carrier is the best for small dogs! My chihuahuas love it! I know they are secure and safe in this carrier. It's also extremely comfortable.

product_title: K&H Manufacturing Lectro-Soft Outdoor Heated Bed with FREE Cover
review_body: So far so good !  My brother recently found 2 kittens on his property and he knew if he did not take care of them the harsh Indiana winters would be the end of them.  The kittens are now healthy, happy, well fed and have a warm heated bed in the extra garage. The product works as described and the kittens stretch out the full length and purr themselves to sleep.  I hope the product continues to perform, the winter is just beginning!

product_title: Marineland Double Bright LED Light
review_body: I originally purchased 2 of these units for a 180 gallon freshwater tank. Lighting setup was; (2) 36inch LED units placed end to end to traverse the 72 inch length of the tank. I choose this unit based on its LED technology and all the related buzz about it being latest and greatest thing in aquarium lighting, with low maintenance (don't have to change bulbs annually), the long life and low power consumption of the unit. I installed the light and found the tank roughly only half as bright as my standard single florescent bulbs. So I purchased 2 more units (now 4 in total) and placed these units beside the original units (doubled the light output). After installing the next two units, the tank was still dark. The way I ultimately fixed this was to purchase T-5 units and place them in the same configuration (at less than half the price). This did the trick, but now I'm stuck with 4 LED lights and out about $400, which admittedly half of the cost is my fault.  In a nutshell here are the pros and cons:  Pros: Ability to use white and blue or just blue light (simulate full moon at night)    Good construction of units    Small foot print of the unit and light weight   Cons: doesn't provide adequate lighting     Price of the unit is still too high  I honestly can't recommend this product to anyone. Marineland has potential with the unit, but it is woefully inadequate providing light,which is way you buy lighting!

product_title: Anit Accessories Tank Top Lace Dress Dog Apparel, Small 12-inches
review_body: Surprisingly very nice for the price. The dress is MUCH cuter than the photo. It has an crinoline underskirt sandwiched between the grey outer skirt and the white cotton inner skirt that makes it like a ballet dress. Perfect for a dancing little dog. Easy to put on and good quality.

product_title: Hugglehounds Monster Bugs Assorted Colors
review_body: I bought the black Monster Bug over a year ago, and it's still going strong. My chihuahua mix destroys most plush toys. I had to give this one a \\"haircut\\", because he was ripping out the hair, but the body is still intact. I had bought several toys at once with this one, and it's the only one that's left. The size is perfect for his little mouth. He loves to pick it up when I come home and run down the hall with it in celebration. I just bought some other varieties from this brand, so I hope they last just as long.

product_title: Medium Travel-Aire Plastic Dog Kennel
review_body: for the money this thing is awesome much better then i expected. still will get the zip ties though if she goes traveling. got the thing overnight too.

product_title: Armarkat Cat Tree Model
review_headline: Great! Easy to build. Solid Construction. Cat Loves it!
review_body:
This is a great cat condo. It's very solid, easy-to-build with clear directions and includes an allen key. Of course, I just used my own metric ratchet to make the job easier but what a great condo. It's very stable, even when my cat jets up the longest pole. I actually got this model in particular because of the challenging climb for my fairly-adventurous 5-month-old Burmese.

This is a great design and great quality. You can't go wrong. Way better-priced than the cat condos at my local PetSmart too.

product_title: Prevue Hendryx Earthtone Dusted Rose Rat & Chinchilla Cage
review_body:
First and foremost, this is an attractive cage that more than serves it's purpose. As a chinchilla owner, I was happy to find something with safe, solid shelves and ramps. The cage is an excellent size and still gives my chin enough room to run around. The shelf on the bottom of the cage is helpful for storage and the pull out tray is WONDERFUL for clean up.

That being said.. the packaging of this product was less than impressive. The screws needed to assemble this cage were NOT included in the package and because the cage needed to be assembled promptly, we ended up making multiple trips to the hardware store because the instructions do not tell what size screws are being used! I contacted customer service who offered to mail me the screws, which being as the cage was already assembled with screws NOT from the manufacturer, there was no point. Double check your product when you get it!!

product_title: Kyjen 2474 Dog Auto Travel Back Seat Pet Hammock Easy-Fit Seat Cover, Large, Black
review_body: We love this hammock for our new car.  It is easy to install and remove, has the slits to still have seatbelt access, cheaper to buy than what I could make and keeps our dog happily close to us without her able to climb up front.  I have a super sniffer and had no issues with the smell some have complained about.  We do throw her blanket on op though for a little added comfort.

product_title: Chuckit! Ultra Ball
review_headline: Greatest Dog Toy in the World!
review_body: My dog sleeps with this ball in his mouth, would jump out of a car window to get it.  He loves this ball and does not destroy it (he tries) and he destroys everything.  He can kill a tennis ball in 20 seconds, but these balls have lasted for months, until he loses it.  He likes to carry the ball in his mouth when he walks.  It is the greatest.

product_title: Wag'N Dog Passport for keeping Veterinary Records
review_body: It took forever to find these, but I am happy I finally did. These are great for keeping all of your pets vital info in one place in case of emergencies. I understand that if there is an emergency, you will have to show proof of vaccinations for your pets to take them with you. Since leaving them behind is not an option for me, I am glad I have these. I live in an area that may have to be evacuated (SoCal), and I would not want to have to leave my dogs behind because I cant find all of their records. I feel all pet owners should get one of these, or something similar.

product_title: Aqueon 100106105 Pro Adjustable Heaters, 50 Watt
review_body:
My fish were happy with the easy install and love the design, they say it looks much more durable. They are looking forward to many warm years.
2-14-15..... That was almost four (not three) years ago in April, 2011. I have been very happy with the heater and it's precise temperature control in our 29 gallon tank. The submersible design allowed installation without modifying the aquarium cover. A tiny space between the air hose and the cover was enough for the cord.
The heater died suddenly in January, the water cooled very quickly in the winter weather. I contacted Aqueon at their website, they responded quickly and the heater was replaced at no charge. In 2011, the 'lifetime warranty' was an attractive feature, they really do believe their heaters are that good..... so do I. I will always have a spare heater in future. Who else thinks my 'spare' should be an Aqueon Pro-150, what else would I buy?

product_title: TetraCichlid Floating Cichlid Sticks
review_body: the fish really like this food item, although I thought it would be a little larger in size. Roughly a good replacement for chow mein noodles as a prank on a friend lol. types of fish that like it, in juvinile and mature sizes (that I have that eat it) Clown Knifes, parrot cichlid, varying african cichlids, texas cichlids, Osphronemus Gorami (even the really large 2 ft ones love it)

product_title: JW Pet Good Cuz Rubber Dog Toy
review_body: This is a good toy especially for the price.  The pro's:  1) its inexpensive  2) it bounces weird (makes for a fun fetch toy)  3) it has a good squeaker  4) plastic seems pretty durable  Cons:  1) I would not get this for a large dog, it is pretty small, and could possibly be swallowed  That's the toy in a nutshell. I needed 3 more dollars to get free shipping, and this product was the perfect product at the price I needed. Would I spend more than $5.00 on it? Nope, just a regular squeaker toy, but it is pretty durable, and Bailey likes it just fine.  UPDATE JANUARY 9th, 2012:  squeaker broke this past week, so it lasted us all of 2 weeks :(  Still at 3 dollar it is okay, but of all the Christmas toys (including treats) this has lasted the least amount of time.  This toy is better than dollar tree squeakers (they will last us less than an hour) but of all her squeakers not bought at dollar tree this has given out the quickest. I don't regret that I bought it, but I will probably not buy it again.

product_title: K&H Thermo Perch
review_body: My small bird has not taken to the perch as I had hoped.  Other reviews raved about it and I thought it would be nice for my rather cool house.  The plastic that the perch is made from is not very comfortable to my bird.  We still keep it plugged in when it's cool and place him on it when he goes back into thc cage.  We've only been using it for just under a month, so I'm hoping it will still catch on.  I think it is a great idea, I just have to convince my bird.

product_title: Waterproof Kennel Deluxe Dog Blanket, 20"
review_body: This is an excellence dog coat/cover that works great even in the rain. After walking in the steady rain for about one hour, dog was dry under it on it's first use. The best feature is it protects the underbelly from rain, but as you suspect your dogs legs and paws (tail & head too) will still require cleaning or drying. It also drys itself very fast not like the other rubber type dog rain coats or felt-type dog coats if they become wet. It does make some noise but that should not be an issue if your dog loves to go outside like ours. Guess the only improvement that is needed is a change in color since it is really non-reflective at all being dark in color, but we use a red lighted collar-type ring anyway on our dog at night when walking. Very pleaded with this purchase.

product_title: goDog Dinos with Chew Guard Technology Tough Plush Dog Toys
review_body:
I bought this (and 5 others) for my pug mainly, but my mutt also tends to give them a chew once in a while. For the pug these are great. He grabs them, chews, squeaks, shakes his head from side to side, and they hold up against him. My Mutt however, has torn a hole in each and every one of them.

Pros-

The squeaker is not obnoxious
Fairly resilient
Good toy for the price

Cons-

Eventually will break down (don't we all)

product_title: AlphaPooch Cuddler Rectangular Bolster Dog Bed, Red and Tan Plaid Fabric with Fleece, Medium
review_body: Super product and great quality.  Better then most of the ones we have looked at for Sam.  Sam loves the bolster for his head and the fit is perfect for him and his crate.  Best buy - even if it cost more.  Well worth the purchase.  As a nice bonus it is a very attractive, the pillow bed has a side for winter and one for summer comfort.

product_title: FURminator deShedding Tool for Cats, 1.75-Inch Edge
review_body: I think my cat weighs 2 lbs less now! That was a lot of fur that came off and that will not be in my house!

product_title: Zoo Med Aquatic Turtle Tub Kit

product_title: Medium - Top Dog Tuxedo - Dog Costume - Dog Wedding Suite
review_body: So glad I picked this one. Ordered it and received it within a week, fit perfectly on my 1 and a half 15 lb pug. He was a hit at our wedding, got a high five from everyone. As long as you measure your dog correctly there shouldn't be a problem with the fit. Again I'm so happy with this purchase and I would highly recommend it.

product_title: Bella's Luxury Leather Polka Dot Rhinestone Dog Collar, Xx-small 1/4" X 9", Dark Pink
review_body: Looks a bit wider in the picture, but nevertheless, is very beautiful.  My chihuahua gets many compliments on this collar and it photographs well!

product_title: Jolly Pets Jolly Egg Dog Toy
review_body: I've had this toy for well over a week and while it's one of the few that has survived, it never gets played with.  I've tried throwing it and kicking it, etc to get my Labrador to play with it--but nothing... Needless to say it's going back today.  :(

product_title: CANIDAE Life Stages Dry Dog Food for Puppies, Adults & Seniors
review_body: Our Rhodesian Ridgebacks were on this food some years back and we moved, thus losing access to it at the new location. I am very glad to see Amazon carrying Canidae and that it's available using the Prime Membership! We have fed many, many dogs the Canidae when we we were fostering rescue dogs (an average of 3 new dogs a month for years) and it was the only food NONE of them ever had any trouble eating & digesting. Our own pack has a couple of members with soy allergies, so I'm careful about what we feed. They have been back on the Canidae for a few months now with no drama at all. The switch from their old food back to the Canidae was easy and stress free and all 6 dogs scarf it down like it was prime rib. (or you know...a squirrel) Even my father's Chihuahua likes it and that little diva used to think she could only eat human food! I have been able to cut back by a half cup on the daily ration for our largest dog as he was putting extra weight on with his previous amount from the old food. Everyone's coat is soft and shiny, they all have loads of energy and are generally in excellent overall health - that doesn't happen with the grocery store bargain foods. Again, I am VERY VERY glad to see the big bags of Canidae available from Amazon!!

product_title: AQUARIUS AQ22502 BettaWave 2.5-Gallon Tank with Divider
review_body: I bought this for my two bettas and it works great.  There is no light or heater but the top snaps back on snugly with the heater cord underneath and the heater resting underneath the rocks so it can warm both sides.  The materials are a bit flimsy but I don't plan on moving it around much so it does the job well, it's right by a window so there is a lot of natural light allowance.  As long as it's not filled to the top for bettas they shouldn't be able to jump and should work fine.

product_title: SturdiBag Pet Carrier
review_body:
I must've studied every cat carrier available for in-cabin airline use this past month. I finally decided to go with this carrier. I am so happy that I did. It's light, extremely flexible and has great ventilation for my 8 lb kitty. I wanted to get the large size so my kitty can have all the room he wants for our long trip this coming month. Right after I assembled it, actually during too, my kitty couldn't wait to get in it. He absolutely loves it. I've taken him on 3 road trips already. My kitty is a crazy cat, he rips and tears everything. Having said that, the mesh is extremely sturdy, and after a lot of chewing and clawing, the mesh looks like the first time I opened the package. I've heard of nightmares where cats rip through similar types of bags, and I knew that I could not get that bag, no matter how good reviews it had.

As far as the assembly, it's not difficult, It consists for 3 things: 1) Unzipping the bottom compartment, sliding in the foam floor, and zipping it back up. 2) Placing the fleece lining in the carrier where the cat will sleep, and 3) putting in the 2 flexible rods on each side of the interior roof. You just slide each rod through 2 guides to hold into place. Don't be shy really bending the rods. There is an insert that explains the assembly too.

product_title: Kyjen 2474 Dog Auto Travel Back Seat Pet Hammock Easy-Fit Seat Cover, Large, Black
review_body: We have been using this pet hammock for a few weeks now and I am very happy with it. We have it in a 05 mazda tribute and it fits nicely...super simple to install and stays in place. The only reason for the 4 stars and not 5 is that when its installed there are a couple of places that kind of pucker out and are atractive to chew on. all and all this is a great product and a great price. I looked at some much the same for 3 times the price.

product_title: Bergan Dog Auto Harness with Tether
review_body: Received on time,well packaged...I thought it was going to be a litter big for my 57 pound  dog...but the harness is very versatile can be adjusted perfectly to my size of dog....for a 50 pound dog  medium might be perfect I bought large. well constructed,as you can see in the ad. it is what you get...tether excellent....if I do not give 5 stars is because I contacted the company via email(no answ.back) requesting  if available another tether...since I have two Vehicles and  I want to install them one in each so I do not have to  connect and disconnect it to switch in  vehicles.  I will call Bergan. ...EXCELLENT PRODUCT! recommended .

review_body: In the past I've had occasion to use this Pet Temp. The last time I used it on one of my cats (a couple of weeks ago), the cat's behavior told me he was sick but the Pet Temp said \\"normal.\\"  I took him to the vet anyway and sure enough he was running a temperature.  The Pet Temp has given me so many erroneous readings that I finally decided to buy a real pet thermometer (just like the one the vet uses).  The vet remarked that he's compared the Pet Temp's readings with the ones generated by his thermometer and he said the Pet Temp is unreliable.  That's good enough for me.

product_title: Petmate 23297 Cat Dish, White
review_body: I think that the quality is good but the size is smaller than I had expected.  I think that it was definitely overpriced after looking at some dishes that I found after my purchase.  The rubber bottom works well which is good compared to some.

review_body:

review_body:
This \\"super\\" refill has an extra feather in it and it does seem to last a little longer than the regular refills, but because it has that extra feather, it doesn't flutter in the air and my cats were not as interested in it.

They do really like it if I swish it across the floor -- they chase it and pounce on it. But if I swing it through the air, they just watch it and don't leap. As soon as I get out a regular refill with two feathers, they are leaping through the air again.

product_title: Lupine 1/2" Black H-Style Pet Harness
review_body:
My husband and I have a cat who wears one of these every day. When we got Eustace 6 months ago he was very aggressive and needed to be attached to a long lead to avoid him attacking one of the other cats. We were using another harness (to which the lead was attached) and that harness wasn't working very well. This one is an excellent replacement. It clips (rather than buckles) around the cat's neck and belly. Putting it on is a quick, easy procedure. Within a very short time Eustace learned to simply stand still for a moment while I clipped on the harness; he knew it wasn't going to hurt and that it wouldn't be a fussy job that would take longer than he was willing to stand there -- this from a cat who, in the beginning, would seriously bite due to fear-based aggression. He also tended to be a chewer, but there's no way he could chew through this halter, or even put a dent in it, so to speak.

Six months later Eustace still wears the halter during the day instead of a collar (his name tag is attached to the ring at the top) -- though he only really needs it while tied to his lead at meal times, a.m. and p.m. When the weather gets warm, with this halter we'll be able to take him for walks on a leash if we wish.

The halter does sometimes slide a bit to the side: i.e., the top -- with the piece connecting the two neck piece and belly piece -- sometimes slides partway down the cat's side. He isn't at all bothered by that, however, so it's no big deal. (I'd recommend allowing that to happen as opposed to tightening the halter too snugly.)

We've had cats for years and have used various types of halters with them because we take some of them for walks and/or let them explore the yard while wearing a halter and long leash pegged into the ground (or on a sliding ring on a clothesline). I think this halter is the best I've come across, and has the best design. Not incidentally, for our cats the figure-eight style halters do NOT work well; the cats are uncomfortable in them.

product_title: Dogtek Electronic Bark Control Dog Collar
review_headline: Poorly made and even worse customer service
review_body:
The collar was purchased for my two year old lab/boarder collie mix. I set it up according to the instructions and put it on my dog. I noticed that even the slightest shake of her head and the collar would beep so I turned down the sensitivity. Even with the sensitivity set to the lowest possible point the collar would still beep and then shock her just from shaking her head.

I tried contacting DOGTEK about this. I explained the problem in an e-mail and, despite saying they usually get back to customers in 24 hours, I finally heard back from them a week and a half later after sending a follow-up e-mail and calling them. The only response I received stated that the sensitivity was set too high, even though I'd clearly explained in my e-mail that the sensitivity was set to the lowest possible point.

If this had been a defective collar and it had been taken care of I wouldn't be upset. Unfortunately it seems that DOGTEK doesn't back up it's product so I am very upset about the $50 wasted. From the other reviews it sounds like if you get one that works then they are great, however I certainly won't risk my money on a DOGTEK product again because if you get a faulty one the company can't be counted on to support the product.

product_title: Nutramax Cosequin DS Chewable Tablets for Dogs
review_body: This is such a fantastic product. I have a yellow lab and a golden retriever, both with joint problems. Cosequin DS has been miraculous! I saw an improvement in them within the first week. They are able to run around better and clearly have improved in their mobility.

product_title: Petego La Cinopelca Cheri' Italian Leather Collar in Blue and Tartan Fabric, Large, 20 Inches
review_headline: Finally a collar that won't slide down my dog's neck
review_body:
My Pit Bull has several nylon collars and a couple other leather collars. Because of her short fur which all leans straight back along her neck anything that is not smooth will slide back on her neck and then never slide back up. After some activity most collars will be tight as far back on her neck as it'd go and that just irritated her skin. I have one leather collar that was far too heavy and stiff and although it didn't slide down her neck it still irritated her neck a little due to the weight and stiffness. If she's not happy I can't be happy.

Now comes this collar. The leather is thinner and very very soft with a fabric outer. The design is very pleasant but it's a very light color, almost pastel, and my dog's fur is lighter so it doesn't stand out. I figure if there was a brighter colored collar with the same design I'd prefer that much more. If you haven't trained your dog properly and she just pulls and pulls this collar may not be the best option since the leather is soft and relatively thin. My dog walks right next to me so this is no big deal. I love that the leash attachment is in a completely separate area than the buckle so the leash can sit higher up instead of dangling down from the neck which then hits my dog's right leg as she walks. Now the leash hangs a little down the side and doesn't bother her one bit. Also, because her dog tags are away from the buckle area when she shakes her head the tags don't bang against the buckle and make a lot of noise so that's a huge plus. If it's noise for me it must be deafening for my dog with the noise just inches away from her ears.

This is my favorite collar so far so I give it 5 stars after having had it for a couple of weeks now but I can already guess what's going to happen. Her tags hang down next to her collar and the fabric portion there will of course get stained over time. However, because of the very soft inner leather side it glides easily back and forth on her fur and doesn't ever get tight on her neck. My dog's comfort is the most important thing to me.

Having said that, my 3 older and bigger cats that are used to an open litter box wouldn't use it.  I guess there is something about going into the hole that they didn't like.  Our 2 smaller kittens had no problem jumping in and doing their thing!  It all depends on your cat(s).  Very disappointed that I had to send this back because it was so easy to deal with. product_title: Oceanic 82053 BioCube Protein Skimmer
review_headline: Skimmer is fine, prepare to throw the rest away
review_body:
From day one, this skimmer worked as expected, generating foam. Lowering the pressure will eventually yield a dry foam. I have a 14g BioCube and the installation only took a few minutes.

Unfortunately, the accessories included with the skimmer are very poor quality. The air valve only lasted two days before the plastic threads stripped out. With the threads stripped, the pump produced too much wet foam, so back to the store for a new valve.

Two weeks later, the pump gave out, possibly from poor materials or too much back pressure. I disassembled the air pump knowing I was going to replace it with a name-brand unit. I found the diaphragm had torn. Two weeks for an air pump is really disappointing. Back to the store again to buy a new air pump.

Even with all the problems, the skimmer itself is nicely made and was simple to adjust. With a good quality replacement pump and valve, the skimmer works just fine and produces a greenish liquid. The fact it fits inside the overflow chamber and out of sight is worth the price for me. Considering the cost of the replacement parts, however, the value of this product is poor.

product_title: KONG Wubba Dog Toy
review_headline: Squeaker still going strong after 5 days!!!
review_body:
I own two German Shepherd dogs; one who loves to \\"kill\\" the squeaker in any and every toy given to her and another who will play with toys just to keep them away from his sister and destroy them in front of her. I usually purchase toys of varying types every few weeks with the expectation that the squeaker portion will last at most, an hour, even on supposedly \\"super durable\\" toys.

On Sunday I purchased a Kong Wubba in the hopes that the squeaker would last; covered in a nylon fabric and with the Kong name on it I hoped it might last a bit longer than other brands. It is now Friday, and the Kong Wubba is STILL squeaking. The other toy I purchased lasted about 5 minutes (as expected with most toys), but the fact this one is still going strong has me very impressed. Even after they finally silence this toy's squeaker I have every intention of purchasing another one of these as it has lasted the longest out of any squeaker ever purchased for my two dogs (over the span of 8 years mind you).

review_body: I bought this for our 65lb dog and she really liked the height of it so we thought it was great. However, after a few weeks of use we discovered that there was black mold growing inside because of the water dripping from the dish on top. There's no ventilation when the food and water dish are in place, so it's just a constant dark and damp space, perfect for mold. Of course we took the dishes out to wash them frequently, but I didn't think I'd have to worry about black mold and the dark color of the stand made it difficult to see. product_title: K&H Manufacturing Bolster Couch
review_body: For the past year we have been buying $5-$10 pet beds from CVS/Walgreens for our 3 Havanese.  They look nice but the quality is horrible.  They claim to be washable but once you wash them, the filling gets clumped up.  They also attract hair and dust like crazy.  Even after the wash, hair and fuzz are still stuck to the bed.  We have gone through at least 10 of these.  We finally decided to go for a more expensive quality bed.  We went to Petsmart and Petco and their $20 beds are equivalent to the $5 CVS ones.  Their $50 beds are ooook but totally overpriced.  We are so glad we bought the K&H Bolster in small.  It's actually bigger than we expected.  All 3 boys wont fit in it but 2 of them can get pretty snug.  The boys take turn sleeping in it.  They love it more than their CVS beds.  We haven't tried washing the cover yet but since it's removable, it shouldn't be a problem.  Our one concern is if a boy throws up on it, the cover is not waterproof so it's possible for things to leak into the filling.  The boys also love that it's higher off the floor and the sides are great.
