We put it in several different places but it doesn't do anything to silence the dogs. These are Shelties, bark all day and all night. My neighbors keep them on the side of their home next to ours. Nice folks but haven't got a clue about being good neighbors.

I should have returned it and I didn't. It's people like me these manufacturers count on. Lot of $$ to waste.

product_title: Nutramax Dasuquin with MSM Chewable Tablets for Dogs
review_body: We are well pleased with this product for our dog. It is the same brand prescribed and carried by our vet. We are very pleased with this price as we can get the large 150 tablet bottle for less that the 80 tablet bottle costs at the vets. Shipping was fast. We are well pleased.

product_title: TetraPond 16359 Koi Vibrance Floating Pond Sticks
review_body: I've been using this brand for a long time, but paid a lot more before I found this deal with Amazon.

product_title: Vittles Vault Gamma TRAVEL-tainer
review_body:
I got this as a gift and absolutely love it. We have a small dog who eats small amounts of a very high-quality, specialized food, so this holds slightly over a week's worth of food for him. Great for travel, allows us to keep his food with us easily as well as providing bowls when we are staying as guests in someone's home.

It's great for us, but if you have a larger dog I'm not sure how many days' worth of food this would hold for you. It's really not a big container! Just depends on what you need.

product_title: Jolly Pets Tug-n-Toss - Heavy Duty Chew Ball w/ Handle
review_body:
I almost didn't buy this ball based on the reviews. BUT, I find most people will generally tell you about a negative experience more often than a positive one. I disregard a lot of the negative reviews because people like to complain. I was wrong and should rethink my theory. haha

My dog is an 80 lb, 8 month old, Staffy. He's a power chewer. I took his indestructoball away because it's noisy in the house. The tug-n-toss seemed like a durable and quieter alternative. Damn, I was wrong again.

Oddly enough, 24 hours after I gave him the tug-n-toss ball, the handle survived. The ball? Well, the ball has a about 3 inch hole with jagged edges. He's a bit upset that I took it away from him so I gave him back the indestructoball (it really is indestructable). I may have to put carpet down to dull the noise but my baby is happy.

product_title: Catit Design Senses Play Circuit, Original
review_body: This was really easy to put together.  It is nice quality and the ball rolls smoothly and easily back and forth.  My 4 pound chihuahua absolutely loves this!!  It keeps him entertained longer than his other toys since it is interactive.  LOVE IT!!!!!

product_title: SureFlap Microchip Cat Flap
review_body:
I bought this since I have two cats, one which can free feed and the other that gets fed on a timer. I needed to keep the timer-fed one from having access to food any time she wanted.

I installed this cat door in a large clear Rubbermaid container with small holes drilled in the sides and lid. There is a bowl of cat food inside it.

I easily registered the free-feeding cat with the door. Training him to use it took about a month. For two weeks of that he would go in the box but only if he walked up to it and I opened the door for him. Once he figured it out he hasn't had a problem since.

product_title: Hydor Submersible Glass Aquarium Heater - Original Theo
review_body:
very happy with this heater. i needed a small one for my baby biorb which is a pita in regards to positioning a heater inside.
what i did was put this nice small one sideways and put rocks on top. cant even see it.

keeps a good temp.

product_title: Catit Design Senses Play Circuit, Original
review_body:
I purchased the basic track for our two young cats, since they still like our old donut track with ping pong ball we have had for years!
Both cats like this track very much, and both interact to push the ball back and forth
to each other! 7 month old and 1.5yr old.

I am planning on adding a second track to it next order in fact. It was easy to assemble, and
I expect it to be very popular next winter when they cannot go outside.

The price is not high in my opinion, and definitely worth the expense. It is very clever, and
we enjoy watching them play with it, too.

product_title: Kitty Mansions Havana Cat Tree
review_body: This comes not assembled. Screws were missing,..could not attach second rope, and no hole for the pole that has the ball hanging, therefore no place to put this. Cat scratched off one of the eyes in the first three days. Head tube for top had staple in way, so very difficult to put in screw. Looks much better in picture then actually is. definitely would never purchase another.

product_title: ROYAL CANIN BREED HEALTH NUTRITION Bulldog Adult dry dog food
review_body: We have given our bulldog Iam's for most of his 12 years.  Over the last year he has lost a significant amount of weight and had grown several bald spots.  Knowing the normal life expectancy of a bulldog we had assumed the inevitable was upon us.  However my wife saw the reviews for this food and we decided to give it a try.  The results are amazing.  He put on weight - returning to his normal size - and his coat looks better than it has in years.  The bald spots have regrown hair over the past two months and the overall sheen is great.    We could not be more happy to have found this 'fountain of youth' food.  Atticus even feels up to visiting parks and playing with other dogs.  After a couple days of adjustments, even the flatulence seems to have improved.  This product easily gets five stars despite the cost.  We are a Royal Canin family from now on.

product_title: Farm Innovators Model P-60S 1-1/2-Gallon Round Heated Pet Bowl, Speckletone Gray, 60-Watt
review_body: This product is great for my dogs that like to be outside in the winter. The bowl holds plenty of water and does not freeze.

product_title: Cat Dancer 101 Cat Dancer Interactive Cat Toy
review_body: 4 out of 4 cats in my house love this little toy. It has great movement to it, and the cats could play with it for hours. Like other people have said, I wish I came up with this toy, it is so simple!

product_title: CUTTER LEMON EUCALYPTUS [Misc.]
review_body: I did the \\"scientific\\" left/right comparison, and found this works better than Off. For me. In the Yucatan. It also stinks less - but it will still dissolve your nail polish. Small price to pay though.

product_title: Bergan Turbo Scratcher Cat Toy, Colors may vary
review_body:
Update: Originally purchased two years ago in March 2014, the cat still loves it. I've replaced the inner cardboard twice so far, Sprinkle a little catnip in the cardboard & she's a kitten again.

The cat seems to enjoy this a lot. She keeps coming back to it, so it's obviously entertaining. It does include a small pack of catnip to sprinkle into the corrugated cardboard area, but that goes quickly so you'll want to order a pack along with this.

product_title: Petrodex Enzymatic Toothpaste Dog Poultry Flavor, 6.2 oz
review_body: I wasn't aware of the need to brush my dog's teeth until speaking with my friend, who is a vet.  After an unsuccessful dental nylabone try, I bought this.  My dog enjoyed the taste, and enjoyed having her gums brushed.  I noticed a difference in her breath immediately.  Great product.

product_title: Dingo Kitty Anchovy Fillets, 1-Ounce
review_body: My kitty is not a fan of these at all. She is not drawn to the smell and when she comes across them on the floor she will only put them in her mouth and then spit them out. She is not particularly picky and one of her favorite things to chew on is cardboard so I was pretty surprised... I won't be purchasing these again.  I am giving 2 stars because I like that they are only 1 natural ingredient, I'm bummed my cat doesn't like them.

product_title: Solvit Deluxe Telescoping Pet Ramp
review_body: I ordered this because my 80 lb dog was due for a knee surgery and would not be able to jump in and out of the cab of my slightly raised Ram 1500.  The ramp itself is a little cumbersome and not small enough to easily store in the cab of my truck for quick use so I have to actually open the canopy and the tailgate each time I want to get it in and out of the truck.  This is my biggest complaint about it, so in reality, it's not much of a complaint.  It's sturdy and my boy uses it just fine.  Going up is hardest because he does fight for traction, especially after the surgery when he's only using three legs.  He comes down it with no issues at all, even with three legs.  I imagine that eventually I'll have to re-surface it with some sort of traction surface because going up he scratches the sandpaper type surface currently on there.  The ramp itself has been a lifesaver for getting Coleman home after surgery and back and forth to the vet's for check ups.  If you need help getting your bigger dog in and out of a vehicle and storage room isn't an issue, this ramp is fantastic!

product_title: MJ Multipurpose Powerhead Pump - Cobalt Aquatics
review_body:
I went through 4. Yes 4 maxi jet 1200's for my aquaC remora skimmer. Each one raddled and sounded awful. This pump, although named similarly, runs whisper quiet. I will be buying another for my other skimmer!

Not sure if maxi jet rebranded or what but these are great pumps.

product_title: Tetra Whisper Air Pump (Non-UL)
review_body: After much debate I orderd this. It is not noisey by any means. I have the aquarium on a towel and this pump sets on the towel also. the bubbles in the tank make more noise than this does. I have been running it for almost 6 months non stop without any probloms. Great little pump.

product_title: KONG Naturals Crinkle Ball with Feathers Cat Toy 2 pieces
review_body: Our cat is 9 years old, and she didn't used to play much. When we gave her these feather balls, she went crazy. Within a few days, she had ripped out all the feathers, making us think she had caught a bird. Even without the feathers, she still plays with these toys quite a bit. I wish the feathers had stayed in place longer, but the cat doesn't seem to care. Great product!

product_title: Petmate Litter Catcher Mat Large, Waterfall Blue
review_body: Moved from an apartment with carpeting to one with hardwood floors and I didn't want to be constantly sweeping litter up.  Tis traps the litter that falls out when he leaves his box and helps eliminate the litter in his paws.  When it arrived it had the strongest chemical odor, but that went away after a couple of hours...or I just got used to it.  The mat nded up being a lot cuter in real life than in the picture.  I thought the paw prints would be super tacky, but it isn't so bad.  So far so good.

product_title: Vitakraft Reptile Gammare, 5.2-Ounce Pouch
review_body: My turtle will eat nothing but dried shrimp, and it's difficult to find in our local pet stores.  This product comes as advertised in a resealable pouch, and my turtle is thriving.  Highly recommend this to anyone looking to feed their turtle without having to drive all over the place looking for the right food.

product_title: The Illusion Collar and Leash Set
review_body: First, Ill say I love Cesar Milan. I think he's great. I also like the Illusion collar concept. Im sure it works great with short, slick coated breeds like pits and Jack Russels, but it didn't do well on my medium haired Border Collie. He pulls, but not to an extreme. I put the collar on and with just a slight pull it tightened to the point of choking my dog. It didn't loosen. It had to be manually loosened every time.Next little pull, it tightened again. This was how our walk went the whole time.It was miserable for us both. Maybe it loosens easier with short haired breeds, but sure didn't work for my dog. Im returning the collar to try something else.

product_title: Good Pet Stuff Company Hidden Cat Litter Box
review_body: I recently did remodels of my bathrooms and the old traditional enclosed litter box just didn't work with the new decor. I decided to try this style despite some misgivings based on reports of flimsiness, cheap looking, fake looking plant, etc.  It is pricey...but it is the only thing like it I could find on the market. It arrived very quickly and I was pleasantly surprised at its appearance.  It looks exactly as I had pictured...it is plastic afterall...so it won't look like a true ceramic planter...but it's fine. I like the fact that it is light because when it has several inches of litter in it you can still lift it if necessary. I found it very easy to remove and replace the top once I did it a few times and figured out the best way to hold onto the top and line up the grooves.  I don't use the plant in the bathroom as it is too big for the small room, but I put the plant on the cats' tree house and they like to hide behind it and give it the occasional swat. Instead I put river rocks in the top part of the new box and glued them down..and they look great. Finally, and most importantly, the cats LOVE LOVE LOVE it.  They climbed right into it as soon as it was set up. They are big guys (15+lbs) and it gives them plenty of room to turn around and toss litter to their hearts' content without piling it on the floor.  I suppose my only criticism would be that the round shape makes it a little harder to scoop with a typical style scooper..but the other features far outweigh that minor issue.

product_title: Miracle Care First Aid Solutions
review_body:
This is supposed to have some bitter tasting element in it but it can't be that bad because it didn't keep my dog from licking himself. My hope for this product was to help deter his licking and biting during his rough allergy seasons. Maybe if your dog doesn't have any other issues this might help, but like I said it didn't stop him from licking himself.

He has all year long allergies and sometimes the prednisone RX from the vet and the additional items I give him aren't enough to keep him from licking or biting.
He also takes (all bought from amazon):
[[ASIN:B004OA5XP4 Omega-Caps ES - For Large & Giant Dogs (250 Softgel Capsules)]] (these are much cheaper and work the same as [[ASIN:B002IL8WB8 AllerG - 3 Large Giant Breed 250 Capsules.]])
[[ASIN:B0002YFAVI Pet-Tabs Plus - 365 ct]]
If he's doing really bad I'll give him Benadryl as well, but the next step is a $100 vet trip for a shot :(

product_title: Purina Tidy Cats Breeze Litter System Cat Pellet Refills
review_headline: Best litter box ever -- smart design
review_body: I LOVE this litter box. \\"Self-cleaning\\" litter boxes get gummed up, so the Breeze is a really smart solution.  The pellets (litter) can be flushed and they sit on top of a grid that lets the urine seep through down to a \\"diaper\\" in a tray underneath the litter box.  What I do: When my kitty poos, I wait for it to dry and then scoop it into my toilet. I change the \\"diaper\\" once a week (as suggested) and scoop out poop daily. There is absolutely no cat smell in my 450 square foot condo. It stinks only when my kitty has just pooped.  This litter box is the best design and easy to upkeep.  My only complaint (worry) is that it takes proprietary litter and \\"diapers\\" (pads) to continue using the litter box. Now, I have no complaints about the cost; however, if Tidy Cat stops making the litter and pads, I'll have to rethink my strategy.  @Tidy Cat: Please don't ever stop making this cat litter system!!! It's the best.

product_title: Smokehouse 100% Natural Piggy Slivers Dog Treats
review_body: More jerky that is made in China. Unknowing owners are feeding this potential killer to their loved pets. Please research dog treats you feed your pets before you end up heartbroken and with high vet bills.

product_title: LuckyPet Pet ID Tag: Collar Tag - Attaches flat to any collar - Perfect for Dogs or Cats - Custom Engraved - Durable and Silent!
review_body:
The collar tag is perfect, I don't know why that type of tag wasn't invented before now, it has Velcro and wraps around the collar.

Linda Foley

product_title: UGODOG Indoor Dog Potty
review_headline: Great product, consider using with pee pads at first
review_body:
It's been working great with my american cocker pup.

I used to put a wee pad underneath the grates (started with some used ones), and the pup knew right away what this thing is for. Later on he started showing interest to anything made of paper, so no more pee pads under the grates (still works!).

I think it's all about the scent. One time I washed the whole thing with [[ASIN:B00251GJ5W Nature's Miracle Advanced Stain and Odor Remover for Pets, 1-Gallon]] when it got too stinky; the next thing I saw was my pup peeing on the floor next to the potty. Looks like washing with warm water and soap is fine, but not with anything that kills enzymes (or whatever that dogs can smell and we don't).

Hope it helps.

product_title: KONG Squiggles Dog Toy, Colors vary, Assorted
review_body: Firstly.....they come with too many tags and unnecessary packaging in my opinion.  My little dog at first was so excited about this, but after a few minutes of trying to get it to squeak you could see the disappointment on her little face.  The darn thing won't squeak unless I step on it!  (and then it screams 'NO NO .... HELP!\\")

product_title: Aspen Pet Lebistro Programmable Food Dispenser
review_headline: Great Product! Works like a champ!
review_body:
I've had this feeder for over a year and have not had any issues with it whatsoever. I have one cat and have it set to feed a 1/4 cup at 6am and at 6pm.

I travel occasionaly for 3 to 4 days at a time and can say that I don't even worry about cat feedings anymore. I use to set out large bowls full of food and come back to a fat cat, now I know she is getting fed regularly and the correct amounts.

product_title: MidWest iCrate Single Door & Double Door Folding Metal Dog Crates
review_headline: Love this iCrate - Single Door Pet Crate!
review_body: I received my iCrate yesterday, and was immediately impressed with the quality of the construction, and the ease of putting it together.  It's sturdy and the perfect size for my chihuahua!  I'd also purchased a side-mounting water bowl, so we're all set for when I can't supervise my (often naughty) dog.  I would highly recommend this crate to anyone - you won't be disappointed.

product_title: Fluval FX5 External Canister Filter
review_body: Ive never had a canister filter before and i am sure glad i made the switch. It is almost maintenance free and my water is crystal clear . Ive had aquariums for years and have never had such clear water.  I made a rookie mistake and didnt shut off both valves before i attempted to remove the top and water went everywhere so be sure to shut off the valves before you try to add new carbon or other media.  No complaints about this product and i give it an a++.

product_title: PetSafe Outdoor Ultrasonic Bark Deterrent
review_body: Our next door neighbors have two Bassett Hounds.  One barks in a deep ruff and one whimpers and whines as if it is being beaten (its not, that is its \\"bark\\"). It is the most irritating combo imaginable.  They do this for HOURS every single day whether anyone is out or not.  I sometimes work from home and have had people on the other end of conference calls ask me what the noise is.  But that is just the baseline.  If I have the temerity to drive up to my house in my own driveway they go absolutely bonkers.  Same if I actually go into my own backyard.  Sadly, we have basically quit using our backyard.    The owners will not do anything, not even put on bark collars, and are simply daring any of us to complain to the city. The dad, who is never hardly home, gets belligerent when asked to do something.  Well, if they won't do anything, I will.  I bought two of these and hung them about three feet off the ground, very near the fence, spaced to cover the fenceline very well.  The barking has dropped to next to nothing. Unfortunately, I can't tell if its because the dogs are quitting barking or because the owners are actually keeping them in more because of the cold.  All I can say is that it appears to be working and I can't believe how pleasant it is now to be in my own home.

product_title: HDP Large Hooves Naturals Made in USA
review_body: These hooves range from medium sized to large which is great for my dog. He gets excited about them. I have bought them from a different bulk vendor before too. I'll buy from these again as these hooves keep my dog busy chewing the hooves and not on other things.

product_title: Pampered Pet Jogging Stroller for Small Dogs and Cats
review_body: I bought this pet stroller 7 months ago to transport my large cat with me. I've used it quite a few times now. It makes travel so much easier. I've used it on the train and have been easily able to use this along with my luggage that rolls with no problem. My cat is so much more comfortable and a little less stressed out. I really dislike carrying him in a pet bag, it's too heavy and hurts my shoulder, not mention the stress of trying to get him to go into a pet bag and trying to keep it from bumping into your body as you walk, whereas a pet stroller he goes right into and transport is smooth and easy. The stroller is so cute and when people see it they initially think it's a baby stroller until they hear my cat meow! People who see it ask about it and think it's a great idea.  The front wheel swivels and maneuvers in any direction easily. The compartment is large and spacious. My cat is long and weighs 12.5 lbs and has plenty of room and views all around him to see what's going on. The brakes keep it steady on the train when it is stopping and going. It is durable and easily folds down for storage and pops-up to use again. This was a great purchase for me and Chewie :0)

product_title: Zanies 7-Inch Plush/Cotton Tiny Tuggers Dog Toy
review_headline: Last not more than three days
review_body:
My puppy love it but the rope break into pieces within 3 days.
some thread went inside my puppy stomach. I won't recommend this product at all.

product_title: Beige 4 Steps Pet Dog Cat Step Stairs by BestPet
review_body: We purchased this because our small dogs and munchkin cats can not jump up on our raised bed.  We sat this at the foot of our bed and serves its purpose well.  Its not that wide to intrude into the room at the end of the bed and sturdy.  Color is pleasant ..neutral ... worth its money... found the best price for it right here.....

product_title: Marineland Penguin Power Filter
review_headline: Superior filtration, quiet, easy to use
review_body: I have five of these marineland filters.  Two 350's on a 90 gallon tank, One 200 and a 350 on a 55 gallon tank and a 350 on a 40 gallon tank.  I have 2 oscars, (one in the 90 gallon and one in the 55) which are very toxic fish.  These filters keep my tanks crystal clear, and my water parameters spot on. The bio-wheel technology comes from water treatment plants.  The bio-wheels work wonderful! They are quiet, but you have to keep the water level at the base of the water output.  If you don't, all you hear is water falling which isn't really that bad is it?  I would suggest that you purchase a filter that is 10 times the amount of water volume that you have in your tank for accurate filtration.  That is the general rule for a hang-on filter.  A 350 should be adequate filtration for a 35-40 gallon tank ect. Happy fish-keeping to all!

product_title: PetSafe Deluxe Bark Control Collar (PDBC-300) for Dogs 8 lb. and Up, Waterproof, 3 Modes of Static Correction
review_body: We got it for our small dog. The first time it went off, it startled him so much that he yelped. Which only made it shock him harder... This created a vicious cycle until he was crying, I was tackling him (so I could get the darn thing off) and then he hid under the bed for like an hour. He only came out when he heard a new noise worth barking at (obviously never correlating the shock with the bark).

product_title: Pinnacle Peak Protein Grain-Free Formula Dog Food
review_body: Got this for my big running Llewelyn setter. He runs every day and on hunts can log up to 20 miles in a 3 hour hunt. He weighs 42 lbs and I feed him 2 1/2 cups when he runs only an hour and three cups after a big hunt. This seems to keep him ready to hit the field the next day with lots of energy. He inhales the stuff and it seems to agree with his digestive system. Expensive compared to grocery store premium brands, but compare the quality of ingredients and the nutritional differences and it is well worth the price for your hard working, best friend.

product_title: NaturVet No Mark! Stops Cat's Desire to Urine Mark Spray, 16-Ounce
review_body: From the review distribution, it looks like it alleviates one of the primary causes of spraying.  Sadly, my cat apparently sprays for the other reason :(.  The spray had no effect for me.

product_title: Seachem Flourish 500ml
review_body: I have been using this product for a few months.  I bought it because I heard that it helps remove or suppress black fan algae, which has infected my tanks for years. It has substantially reduced the black fan algae in my tanks when I have been unable to find any other algae destroyer that can do the same. I recommend this product if you have been frustrated in dealing with black fan.

product_title: Marshall Pet 2-in-1 Ferret Bed
review_body: got this for my ferret. she loves it. made good. the insides layer comes out so you can wash it. which is nice. bad thing is, my ferret throw it out. So I just leave it out.

product_title: LitterMaid Classic Plus
review_body: I had an older model that lasted almost ten years, and worked great. It finally died, so i went and bought a new one. It didn't have enough power to scoop up the poop the first time it ran, then kept jamming! I called customer service, and got a another one, after less than a month that one doesn't work either! Obviously the quality has gone down hill, as the one i bought ten years ago worked great. This product as it is now sucks, and i would never buy it again. I would give this a negative star if i could.

product_title: Remote Control Micro Mouse Blistr - Colors may vary
review_headline: Good in theory, poor in execution.
review_body: I read all the reviews so I pretty much knew what to expect. The only problem is no matter how long I have searched for a remote controlled mouse I cannot find any that have good reviews. Must be a common problem. I had several problems with this:  1.) It was hard to get the connection needed to charge. It doesn't connect right and takes much longer than 45 seconds to charge.  2.) It holds its charge must less time than it took to charge it in the first place. Why hasn't someone made a remote controlled mouse that has a small battery in it, like the ones they make for cat lasers? It seems most complaints are about how it doesn't hold the charge long. By the time my cat got interested in the toy it died on us and she hasn't wanted to play with it sense.   3.) It was really expensive for how little it does!

product_title: Tetra Whisper Air Pump for Deep Water Applications
review_body: I've been using the whisper air pump 150 for about 2 months.  It's hooked up to a gang valve and currently opperating 2 devices in my 20 gallon aquarium (over kill I know).  It has a gentle hum that is drowned out by my h.o.b. filter most of the time (depending on where I'm running my water level for various purposes).  It will be going into a 46 gallon when it's set up as that's what I intended it for.  The amount of air that gets pushed through would be way too strong for what I'm currently running without the controls on the gang valve.  I'm confident that it will work perfectly for what ever configuration I come up with as its performance thus far has exceeded my expectations.  It's powerful and quiet, I couldn't ask for anything more.

product_title: Solvit Standard SUV Cargo Liner
review_body: I purchased this liner for my small SUV in the hope it would protect my car from my dog. Little did I know that was the last thing I needed to be worried about. I purchased bleach spray and the top was not on properly it spilled all over my cargo area. Luckily for me I had my liner in the car. My carpet was saved and the cover was only slightly bleached. This is well worth the money.

product_title: The Original Monkey Cord Purple Pomeranian
review_body: I love this Monkey Cord!  It took a while to put on but once I got it on I was in heaven.  No more tangles in my clipper cord.  I'm a happy groomer now!!

product_title: CET Poultry Toothpaste, 70 gm
review_body: This paste does an excellent job of cleaning my dogs teeth, and to top it off, this is the only way he will even let us in his mouth to brush!

product_title: AquaBella Bio-Enzyme Salt Water Treatment
review_body: I was very intrigued by the promise of no water changes for a year and lowering ammonia/nitrates.  After completing the 5th treatment, there has been absolutely no improvement in clarity.  The beneficial bacteria that is described seems only to be the proper marine traces needed to establish a biological filter when cycling a tank.  My water was a bit cloudy but not to the point where I could not see my fish, so in my case the AquaBella system should have made my water crystal clear.  I am extremely dissapointed in this product.  I cannot speak for the freshwater system but for a saltwater tank it does not work at all.  Giving this product a full star is too generous.

product_title: Outward Hound Kyjen  Squicky Squiggler Sea Monster Dog Toy
review_body: Got the jelly version of this toy for our shihtzu mix and he loves playing tug of way and flapping its legs around. Seems very durable so far.

product_title: Aqueon Algae Cleaning Magnet
review_body: works well on 1/4\\" glass but not suitable for anything thicker. No scratches (only have glass aquariums) cleans fantastically but wished that in the description it gave the recommended glass thickness.

product_title: PetSafe Premier Nylon Dog Leash
review_body: Love this leash.  I got it when I ordered a matching collar.  It's durable, not flimsy like some other brands.  It's also a great value.  A+!!

product_title: Snoozer Medium Catitude Cat Bowl by Tina Ledbetter
review_body: This cat dish is just great.it is just the right size and I just love the pictures on it. Very well done!!

product_title: Guardian Gear Oxford Boots for Dogs, XL, Yellow
review_body: The boots came on time and are exactly what I ordered. Now, to convince the dog to wear them.... and to have snow to need them....

product_title: Our Pet's Play-N-Squeak "Mouse Hunter" Cat Toy
review_body: Squeaker did not work  :( But Elvis enjoys it as is, so not a total waste just a disappointment and paying shipping charges makes it not cost effective to return.

product_title: Rawhide Munchy Sticks Beef, 5" 100
review_headline: BUYER BEWARE  --- MOVE OVER ANTIFREEZE ~~~~ NEW NASTY
review_body:
I wish i would have heed the warnings from other shoppers! I've NEVER left a product review before BUT I HAD TO FOR THIS ITEM... I wasn't until the third day of giving these to my Bestest buddy that I realized they were not agreeing with him... I know, bad daddy..
Old Iron gut met his match. Price shouldn't really be an issue here - yeah they are cheap (never again) but Id like to know what they put in them to make them desirable because once its gone - illness sets in. product_title: PetSafe Pawz Away Pet Barriers with Adjustable Range, Pet Proofing for Cats and Dogs, Static Stimulation
review_body:
First of all, Amazons price is MUCH better than Pet Smarts ($123) but I had an emergency and had to buy this from Pet Smart.

I have a 6 month old 'Puggle' (Pug / Beagle) that learned how to dig under our fence. There is only ONE area of our backyard she digs at due to for some strange reason so I decided this would be better than a full wireless fence enclosure.

I bought the unit, tested it and had it installed in less than 30 minutes. I placed the 'rock' at the part of the fence
where she digs and let her off the porch. She ran around and after a few minutes gravitated towards the problem area, the collar begin emitting low beeps which caused her ears to perk up and I noticed her neck twitching from the low 'corrections'

She immediately backed off and the collar stopped beeping. I went inside and watched, she roamed the yard with her brother (who NEVER digs or tries to escape) and then walked to the problem area and again stopped and walked off.

So far, I am very pleased!

Update (04/07/12) - Recently we went out of town for a week and boarded our dogs at a kennel. I removed the collar and put up the rock after powering them both off. When we retrieved the poochs a week later my wife and I decided to see how the puggle would do without the 'pawz away' and let her run around the yard.

No sooner had we placed her in the back yard when she went straight to the 'problem area' and began digging. So I placed the rock back in it's spot, put the collar back on and powered them up. Again she ran straight to the problem area, skidded when she got close to the rock and ran the other way.

That happened this morning and since that time she has yet to go back to the problem area or any part of the fence.

This device works for us!

product_title: Pioneer Pet Big Max Stainless Steel Fountain
review_headline: Great fountain, does get slimy quickly. Not worth the upkeep.
review_body:
I am editing my review because the fountains became too high maintenance. They work quite well, but they absolutely MUST be cleaned very thoroughly at least once a week or they build up mold inside them. They just became a pain, and if you neglect them for a full week, your pet might as well be drinking out of a puddle in the street for all the health benefits you're providing.

I have since removed the pumps and ramps, and I now use just the steel dishes as plain old water dishes. I do like them - they are easy to clean and clean up very well - but I should have just bought a couple high quality steel water dishes in the first place. I rinse them out at least once a week and run them through the dishwasher every two weeks or so.

If you have the time to keep up the fussing, these dishes are excellent. I don't have the time, but I can't let my \\"kids\\" drink out of icky dishes, so I quit using these dishes.

--------------------------------------------------------------------
Original review:

I've had two of these fountains several months now, the larger one for three small dogs and a smaller one for the cat. All the beasts love them and took to them immediately.

One buzzes a little, the other is very quiet unless the water is a little low. I think the buzzing has to do with the clam shell housing for the pump, perhaps how tightly it closes, because I switched shells and then the other fountain was noisy. I'll tinker for a solution. The cat's fountain is on a hard surface, the dog one on a rug. To reduce vibration, I put little plastic feet on the bottom of the cat's dish. However, I often run all the parts except the pumps in the dishwasher, so these may not last.

I find the dishwasher does a great job of cleaning the fountains, and I run all the critter dishes once a week anyway. (It's surprising how many people forget to clean the dogs' dishes.) Whether I wash them by hand or in the dishwasher, while they are being cleaned, I put the pumps in a tall plastic container with 3 parts tap water, 1 part vinegar, and let them run for at least 15 minutes. (I did this after my doctor told me to soak my asthma nebulizer parts in this kind of mixture once a week.) If you are hand washing them, be sure to clean the little white rubber tube the water comes through. It gets slimy, too.

It's not that these fountains are difficult to clean. The bother is that they ABSOLUTELY MUST be VERY thoroughly cleaned at least once a week. I have one of those drip jug type waterers outside, and it gets cleaned once a month. I add a drop of bleach to the water, and it's good. I do think these fountains are better and potentially cleaner, but if you forget about them they become disgustingly fetid and very unhealthy. I went to a conference and no one cleaned them in my absence. When I got home, they stunk and had mold growing in them. If I have to go away again, I'm taking out the pumps and leaving them as plain water dishes while I'm gone.

I don't understand why the fountains slime up in a way that regular water dishes don't. Another person noted this: using an additive that helps reduce doggie plaque does seem to keep the water fresher. I bought the multiple filter replacement pack, but I used to have fish tanks, so I'm going to check out activated charcoal and see if I can change the contents of the filters, too. Someone here said they were also using this barley straw that's used to keep ponds clear without chemicals (Google \\"natural pond cleaner barley\\" and it comes up.) I think I'll try that, too. I'm also considering placing the fountains away from their food dishes, since so much of the little debris in the water seems to be tiny bits of pet food.

Lastly, I ended up removing the little ramp from the smaller fountain entirely. Even with the pump on the lowest setting, water was still splashing out, just enough to keep the little mat damp all the time. I just stuck the clamshell more towards the middle of the fountain, and it bubbles in the middle of the dish now. The cat loves it.

At some point I may decide all this maintenance is not worth it, but for now, my dog with kidney disease and my aged cat are drinking more water, so I'm happy.tle mat damp all the time. At some point I may decide all this maintenance is not worth it, but for now, my dog with kidney disease and my aged cat are drinking more water, so I'm happy.

product_title: Feline Furniture Feral Cat House - Green
review_headline: Feline Furniture's Feral Cat House Is Fabulous!
review_body:
I have two of these cat shelters in my yard. I love them!

First of all, they arrived totally assembled. They are lightweight and easily movable. They smell like wood, not like plastic. Feline Furniture obviously takes pride in a well constructed product. These homes are made in America, not in an overseas factory.

I tried these shelters in various places in my yard. I had one on my front porch which encouraged a neighbor's cat to move in and drive off my feral cat. So now the neighbor's cat lives inside my home and my feral is thriving outside. She has never looked so good!

One of the problems I have had is that we have quite a population of raccoons and possums which makes my feral very skittish. It took two years of feeding her before my feral allowed me to pet her. So now she has two shelters to choose from, one in my front yard and one in my back yard!

I could see a bunch of these little houses set up in a row like vacation cottages used to be set up in Wisconsin in the 1950's. Wouldn't that be a hoot! So if you have a lot of cats with territorial problems, they would all be happy in their own little houses!

These do well inside the house and outside. When it rains, they stay dry inside. I don't know how that works, but it does, and well. I really like the flaps over the front and back doors that can be left open to encourage entry. They are held up by little magnets, pure genius! That was such a surprise when I first got my shelter.

I would HIGHLY recommend these shelters, for both inside and outside use.

It is now May 2013 and two kitties are now using the cat shelters. The shelters are holding up extremely well. No rain inside them. They are wonderful! My two outdoor cats love them.

product_title: K&H Manufacturing Lectro-Kennel Igloo Style Outdoor Heated Pad Black
review_headline: Beware Size Descriptions - and doesn't come with cover!
review_body:
I'm searching for a solution to house two outside cats during the winter.

I ordered this \\"Igloo-Style\\" heated pad.. the medium size. The specifications state that it is \\" Approximately 14.5\\" x 24\\" \\". On Amazon's page for this item they advertise under *Frequently Bought Together* another item.. the Petmate 25702 Kitty Kat Condo, Mouse Gray. Also the Petmate Igloo is listed under the *Customers Who Bought This Item Also Bought* list. Ok, I get it - these items were made for each other.

The Petmate 25702 Igloo specifications state it is 26 x 25.3 x 18.5 inches. And this pad is \\"Approximately 14.5\\" x 24\\". After all this information and encouragement there is no way these two items won't fit, right?

Wrong. It doesn't. It is about two inches too wide to fit in the Igloo mentioned above. These two items are completely incompatible.

UPDATE: Ok, so I returned the medium and ordered the small (even though no size information is given for the small). It's 11.5\\" x 18', by the way. According to the website description here on Amazon, \\"The mat now comes with a free removable fleece cover\\".

Did it come with the \\"free\\" cover this time. Nope. It did come with safety insert though informing me not to use anything *but* the official fleece cover or the warranty is void and the unit will overheat and probably malfunction. So I need to spend another $20 on this cover to keep from voiding the warranty or my cats will be sleeping on a hard piece of ABS plastic?

The small unit doesn't even fit very well. It is too small and doesn't go to the edges of the igloo. The installation instructions also advise you to drill a hole into the side of your igloo to run the power cable.

In summary, I'm docking this review down to 2-stars from 3 because of the missing pad. Don't buy this item if you have the above igloo, and if you do, don't be surprised to not have the cover included in the box.

You're much better off finding another heating solution - this pad is expensive, doesn't fit, and the provided description is inaccurate.doesn't fit, and the provided description is inaccurate.

I sat in the middle seat both ways based on other reviews that the middle seat has the most leg room. review_body: I have 4 cats and all of them have benefitted from this product. All 4 are short hair and and all four have much silkier coats and much less dandruff as well as significantly less hair loss.  I used it about once a week for 4 weeks and then occasionally. This last time one of the cats got a bald spot where I applied it :( but  the skin is not red nor inflamed so I presume the hair will grow back. review_headline: Sizing is off, but product is Fantastic!!
review_body: I have a little 7 lb toy poodle.  She may be small, but she's a mighty puller! Determined to find a solution to her  pulling, I purchased the head collar anyway, cut the strap and re-sewed it so it fit her.  Well........the differnce was like night and day on our very first walk!  No more pulling!!! This is a no bull review, I'm telling it like it is. I am amazed how well this product works!  Our walks are now enjoyable.  My only gripe:  the product should be sized better.  Size 0 is the smallest size and recommended for my dogs breed, but as I stated was much too big for her. I would recommend giving this product a try if your dog is a puller.

product_title: World's Best 00631 Cat Litter, Multiple Cat Clumping Formula
review_headline: I loved it for a year then cat refused to use it.  Try Cat Attract instead
review_body: I loved this cat litter in the beginning. I felt quite noble about my cats' inhaling something biodegradable. And the peed in litter is lighter when you dispose of it.  I noticed that after a while, it smelled sour, but not ammoniated like SwheatScoop.  But never mind.  And it was expensive!  And DUSTY.  It pretty much filled my vacuum cleaner every week with yellow powder.  A few weeks ago, however, I noticed my male cat wasn't doing his normal early morning wake-up pee.  Then I notice there seemed to be a urine odor near my front door.  I'm a little slow, so it took a while until I realized he was peeing on and soaking the carpet. No inflammation or FLUTD, so I cleaned out his pan and filled with brand new WBCL.  He would sometimes, agreeably, pee in there if I put him in the box (and, I guess he had to pee <g>) but he wouldn't go there voluntarily.  I was devastated.  Suddenly, I had an aha! that I had read about Dr. Elsey on catinfo.org, and I ran out to buy some \\"Cat Attract.\\"  I put it in the clean box, and both cat fought over who could get in first.  He won, and peed to his little heart's content.  Now they both are using Cat Attract.  It's cheaper.  It seems do be dust free.  And, so far so good.  A  Since my cat hasn't learned English and I'm not fluent in Catanian, I can only guess that it was the sour smell of the corn, or something about the smell or feel of the WBCL that offended my cat.  Is there a muldicide?  Fungicide?  Something that is especially bad for his sensitivities?  I'll never know.  But I won't use it or recommend it again.  I have an extra 17lb Bag of WBCL in my car.  Anyone want it? (haha)

review_body: I purchased this playpen for our indoor cat so he can join us when we are on the deck.  I set it up first in the kitchen so he could test it out.  He LOVED it and stayed inside even with the door propped open.  He is quite a large feline, but has plenty of room inside.  The quality of the item is excellent.  The carry case is excellent as well. I'm really impressed with the construction of the playpen and found it to be very easy to fold up afterwards to store it in our shed.  I highly recommend this playpen.

product_title: Ware Manufacturing Chew Proof High Rise Pet Cage for Small Pets
review_headline: Buy Something of Better Quality with your Money...
review_body: Okay, so there's good and bad about this product.   I'll start with the bad:   - This thing is horribly constructed  - It was shipped TERRIBLY..When I received this it was in a huge box, not even sealed all the way with tape so things like bugs could have easily crawled inside..Also the box was way too large for the product, it was not stuffed with anything to secure it so the product took a pretty good beating on the way here.  - Falls apart so easily  - Doesn't fit the tank very well  - Looks like something I could make...and I might have even done better, which is pretty harsh to say because I'm a girly girl and NOT into constructing things.  - Some thin wires sticking out I had to cut off, which could have hurt my gerbils if I didn't notice them.  That pretty much sums up the negatives of this product: Poorly constructed, carelessly shipped.  The good:  - My Gerbils love it, regardless of how much mommy hates it.  - Has a good concept..if only it were constructed better.  - The whole reason I got this instead of the plastic one which costs about the same price, is because gerbils (or maybe its just MY gerbils) LOVE to chew through plastic. So this does the job, because they cannot chew through it and destroy it.  I would have sent it back and asked for a refund, but it warms my heart to see my gerbils happy with it so I'm gonna keep it. Not buying another one from this company ever again though, and I'd say you should save your money and get something of higher quality while you have the chance.

product_title: Flexi Classic All-Belt Retractable BELT Leash for Dogs up to 44 lbs. (16 ft.), Color: RED
review_body: I purchased this leash about a month ago for my 5 pound chihuahua.  We walk daily.  The leash snapped and retracted when I was 2 miles from my house- this is my 4th retractable leash in 4 months!!!!  Once it retracts you can't pull it out to even tie it to your dogs harness so I was stuck carrying him home.  This leash is supposed to be strong enough for dogs up to 44 pounds and yet my little chihuahua was too strong for it!  So disappointing!  Worse yet we paid $30 for it at the pet store!  I would love to know if anyone has found a strong retractable!

product_title: Carlson Extra Wide Pet Gate, with small pet door
review_body: I have a nine month old baby and two dogs, a snoodle and a shezapoo. My dogs had no problem going in and out of the doggie door on the gate.

product_title: Kitty Pirate Ship Toy
review_headline: Flimsy, perhaps, but the cats love it
review_body: A friend of mine works at a cat shelter where they had the pirate ship, and she saw how much the cats liked it.  She got one for her six cats.  I've been to her house many times, and there are always cats in or on the pirate ship.  The mast is long gone, but the rest of the ship is intact.  The cats actually seem to like it better without the mast, since that leaves plenty of lounging room on top.  Five of her cats are Cornish Rexes, with slender physiques.  The heaviest weighs 12 pounds.  They all enjoy the ship.  Her other cat is an 18 pounder, and he seems to enjoy swatting at cats in and on the ship.      A month ago I got this ship for my own four cats (7 to 12 pounds).  The youngest were climbing in to it before I had finished putting it together.  When I finished, they showed no interest in it at all.  Then I started noticing that when I came home from work the ship was in a different position.  After about 10 days, I saw them playing in it.  Now one or the other of the one year old cats is always inside the ship, and often the other is trying to climb in with his brother.      The construction IS flimsy, but based on seeing my friend's cats use their ship for two years, it's well worth the price.  The shipping was high, so I ordered two and am keeping one in reserve, in case my cats are more destructive than my friend's elegant Rexes.

product_title: Marshall Ferret Hanging Bed, Pattern Fleece
review_body: The bed is very nice and cozy, however, it is not that big.  The picture shows the ferret laying in it with room.  I am assuming this is a baby ferret as this bed for my 8 mth old ferret is kind of small.  He has to lay half on the shelf and can not fit all the way in.  The sheepskin on the bottom was constantly found outside of the cage so i just removed it permanently.  Nice bed overall but your ferret will not fit all the way in comfortably.

product_title: Power Walker Retractable Dog Leash
review_headline: Complete garbage, not worth it at one quarter the price
review_body: Bought this leash out of desperation, couldn't find the Flexi brand that I had for my other dog.  Before one month was up, it stopped retracting unless I slapped it a few times.  The spring was weak and pretty ineffective from the beginning.  Very expensive and if extended to the limit, it is nearly impossible to retract.  Has resulted in my dog coming close to getting into bad situations since I can't control the dog properly once the leash is extended if I need to reel her in quickly.  Very angry and disgusted with this product. Utter garbage, and I will never buy anything from this company again.  Would rate this zero stars if I could.

product_title: Four Paws Magic Coat Red Pet Love Glove
review_body: Our dogs line up to get their twice daily (or more) rub down with this handy glove.  The nubs must feel good on their fur/skin, because all we have to do is bring out the glove and their tails start thumping furniture and people!  Excellent buy!  And certainly affordable.  We have two; one upstairs and one down.

product_title: Nutro Ultra Weight Management Dry Dog Food 30lb
review_headline: Great food but don't be fooled by price
review_body: The food is great.    But something has to be done about companies using ridiculous \\"list Prices\\" as a selling point.  There is no where in the country where this food is selling for $120 as is claimed here.  It is just a gimmick to make there price look good.  But there is a time when a gimmick turns to fraud and I think this is it.  Studies have shown that the the variation in prices is higher online than in brick and mortar stores - you aren't guaranteed a good price without looking around regardless of where it is coming from.

product_title: Dogit Silent Dog Whistle
review_body: Couldn't figure out how the \\"silent\\" was supposed to work and had no effect on the dog. Works fine as a whistle but not for much else.

product_title: MidWest Life Stages Heavy-Duty Folding Metal Dog Crates; Single Door & Double Door Dog Crates w/ Divider Panel, Floor Protecting “Roller” Feet & Leak-Proof Plastic Pan
review_body: We have two of these crates and couldn't be happier with the quality and price. The latch is a good design, our two year olds are able to put the dogs away. Oh yeah... the dogs love them too.

product_title: Zymox Otic Pet Ear Treatment with Hydrocortisone
review_headline: Zymox cured 2nd infection within 2 weeks of spending $160 at the vet!
review_body: My new rescue dog had an ear infection so I took him to the vet. Within 2 weeks of the infection being \\"cured\\" he had another one. I figured if we're spending a lifetime together I'm going to find a more holistic and effective and less expensive solution. Zymox was it. Within a day it was already looking much better and healed rapidly. 2 years later I just used it again for a new infection. What's especially great about it is that you specifically AREN'T supposed to clean the ear before applying. Gotta love that!

product_title: Pedi Paws Dog Nail Grinder by BulbHead - Professional Style Dog Grooming Using Gentle Filing Wheel for Your Pet's Happy Paws
review_body: This is a great little nail file for a small toy dog breed. I have used this for two years now and have found it most effective by trimming the nail first with nail clippers then using this to finish the nail to a nice smooth edge. This product is not designed to do large thick nails or extra long nails! It is great tool for someone who gives regular trimmings to the dogs nail as it shoud be. I would recommend this product.

product_title: Zoo Med PowerSun UV Mercury Vapor Lamp 160 Watts
review_body: Have had this lamp for a while and love it! I can see a positive difference in my Green Iguana! Would definitely recommend this item.

product_title: West Paw Design Nature Nap Dog Mat
review_body: I loved the way it looked, but my lab/doberman pup chewed a hole in it in less than five minutes.  I put it right back in the box and returned it.  Amazon was very good about taking it back.

review_body: I have a miniature dachshund and wondering about what size to get her. I have gotten tshirts for her before and small is usually too small but medium is usually too big. If someone who has already purchased a medium or small size and knows the actual size in inches of them could let me know what they are it would be appreciated:]

product_title: PetSafe Gentle Leader Head Collar with Training DVD
review_body: Does not work for small dogs. My chihuahua puppy can sneak this thing over his snout every time. You're better off getting a harness for something this small. You'll just get frustrated with it.

product_title: Soft Claws Black Cat Nail Caps
review_body: These nail caps work pretty good.  As your cats nails keep growing and shedding the outside layer they come off.  That is the only pain is that every day or two I have to put some more on.  But at least it saves my couch.  Before I used them when I got a new couch and eventually she stopped trying to scratch it and stuck to her scratch pads.  But I got a new couch and she is into scratching it again.  I hope these will again train her to stop.  The only real problem is there is never enough glue and application tips in it so I would recomend buying the refils that some people sell on amazon.

product_title: Natural Balance Healthy Bones Turkey, Oatmeal & Cranberry Treats, 8 Oz Bag
review_headline: Pups are in Love with these
review_body: My 2 dogs loves these treats and I do to as I do not feel guilty giving them a few of these a day as they are extremely healthy. They are what my trainer calls one bite treats as they are fairly small and light that it does not take the pups long to eat them and they are always asking for me.

product_title: LupinePet Basics 1/2" Red Leashes for Small Pets
review_body: The handle on this leash was way too big and too stiff compared to the actual leash on the 1/2\\" version. I got the skinniest version of this leash...the handle probably works for a wider leash...so probably a great leash for a bigger dog but not really for my 14lb terrier.

product_title: Grab bag assorted 20 pieces cat toys bag
review_body: some of these toys were filled with catnips, so my cat was being crazy with nearly all of them! The price is good and free shipping! I will recommend this to all cat owners!

product_title: PetAlive EaseSure and Pet Calm ComboPack
review_headline: My Dog Is More Relaxed And So Am I
review_body:
EaseSure has made a huge difference for my dog. Drayk is a 3 yr old Border Collie / Lab mix. He has cramping episodes that look much like the condition Border Terriers sometimes have. It is not epilepsy, a brain tumor, or a metabolic disorder according the vets we've seen. Though we know what it isn't, none of the vets know what the cause is or what the best course of action would be to help prevent these episodes, or at least reduce the severity.

When these episodes happen, my poor baby's entire body cramps, sometimes violently. I have to give him muscle relaxants and put cool packs on him because his temp skyrockets. If none of this works, it means a trip to emergency for us. I was searching for something natural that might help him when I discovered EaseSure. I showed the product info to our vet team and asked if they thought it would be OK to give it to my dog. After reviewing the ingredients, I got unanimous approval to give it a try.

So glad I ran across Native Remedies during my search for alternative products. Drayk has had only a couple of very mild episodes since I started using this product. I wasn't sure of whether it was just coincidence or not until recently (because he does seem to have them in clusters at times). Drayk was doing so well that I forgot to give him his EaseSure for 3 days in a row and we ended up in emergency due a severe cramping episode. That incident removed all doubt as to whether or not this product was beneficial. It clearly is!

Now I make sure that he gets at least 1 dose a day (about 10 drops), sometimes 2. I always give him some before leaving the house (this way, I can be more confident that he isn't having an episode while I'm gone). In the evening at bedtime, he sometimes will breathe heavily or pace (sometimes a precursor to an episode). On those nights, he gets a second dose. The EaseSure helps Drayk relax, and me too.

He'll lick up the EaseSure from a small bowl if I crumble his tasty vitamin on it (he won't take it otherwise) but most often I just use a dosing syringe (no needle) and add just a touch of water to the drops, squirt it in his mouth, then give him his vitamin. He doesn't seem to mind either method. I get a laugh out of the little sneeze he often does right after getting his dose. Not sure what that is all about, but no complaints.won't take it otherwise) but most often I just use a dosing syringe (no needle) and add just a touch of water to the drops, squirt it in his mouth, then give him his vitamin. He doesn't seem to mind either method. I get a laugh out of the little sneeze he often does right after getting his dose. Not sure what that is all about, but no complaints.

product_title: Flexi Retractable All Belt Lead, 16ft
review_body: Have been using these Flexi leashes for over 20 years with wonderful results.  Other brands do not compare to the durability and strength.  Would recommend for small and mediums sized dogs and large dogs with proper training and correct collars.  [[ASIN:B0002ZJWI4 Flexi Classic 1 Small, 26lbs, Black, 16ft.]]

product_title: Puppia Soft Dog Harness (Mesh) Red Small
review_body: This are really nice harnesses.  My only mistake was ordering \\"small\\".  It fit my Yorkie at first, but she's gotten fat since I bought it!!!  I'll probably get another one in a medium.  Hope she doesn't gain anymore weight after that!

product_title: Petego Mesh Car Barrier - Compatible with Kar 9 Keeper and KAR 9 Guard
review_body: Although it won't make the dog sit, it WILL keep him in the backseat.It honestly was a hassle taking our dog anywhere before we decided to get this.It's a small car & we would let her ride the passenger bucket seat & wife n back to stop the dog trying to always get up front...Not now!! Quality good & received on time & description of item accurate.

product_title: K&H Manufacturing Deluxe Ortho Bolster Sleeper Small Eggplant Paw
review_body: Lori is my seven year old Jack Russell mix. As soon as I unwrapped this bed she went and laid on it!! I wanted to get her a high quality bed that was comfortable and I couldn't be happier with the quality and price.

review_body: AS I SAID EARLIER THEY FIT IN A CORNER JUST RIGHT. MY SKUNKS ALWAYS GO IN CORNERS SO I HAVE THEM IN THE LIVINGROOM,DINING ROOM AND KIT FOR FAST CLEAN=UP. THEY ARE GREAT.

product_title: Chicken Soup for the Dog Lover's Soul Dry Dog Food for Adult Dog, Chicken Flavor, 18 Pound Bag
review_headline: Really terrific dogfood for the money.
review_body: We have used Chicken Soup Dog food for years. It has the right ingredients and is reasonably priced. We have fed our German Short hair the senior food and our Jack Russell on the adult. Both seem to agree with the dogs.

product_title: Powzer Flash n' Dash Ball Interactive Dog Toy Colors May Vary
review_body: I too was dissapointed in the new version. The old one lasted six months of really hard chewing, and I have two pit bulls.  She finally chewed a hole in the old version after several months.  With the new version, it split at the seam in 10 minutes.  The plastic is thinner on the new versions.

product_title: Crabworx Shell, Large
review_body: After receiving the large and medium shells, I thought the openings were a bit too small. However, my largest hermit crab took hold of the large shell. If she likes it, I'm satisfied with this product.

product_title: OurPets Healthy Pet Diner Elevated Feeder
review_body: I'm surprised nobody has said anything about this major design flaw...  We bought the 12\\" feeder for our German Shepherd and at first I really liked it, but whenever your dog slurps the water everywhere or even if you spill a little while filling it up the water seeps down underneath the bowl and after a couple of days if you lift up the bowl the dark crevace underneath is growing eyeballs and reeking like you wouldn't believe! I've had to wash it every other day since we got it, but we're going to have to recycle the plastic holder and find an iron one that will hopefully fit the bowls.  Don't waste your money. If you want an elevated bowl get one that won't trap food and water underneath and grow bacteria. Yuck!

product_title: Mailwraps Cat In The Garden Mailwrap
review_body:
I ordered this cover along with a new mailbox.
I think our mailman is now a cat fan.
The mailbox looks so much nicer and it seems to hold well against the weather.

product_title: Ethical Pet Spotbrites Laser Pet Toy and Exerciser
review_headline: stopped working after a couple of days
review_body: Worked about two or three times after taking it out of the packaging. Was useless by the third time I tried using it...

product_title: The Official Vick's Dog Chew Toy
review_headline: Prompt Delivery of Dog Chew Toy ~
review_body: We received our toy very quickly. The quality is excellent. Our dogs are fighting over it so I place an order for another today.

product_title: Bayer 60 Count Free Form Snip Tip Nutritional Supplements for Dog, Medium/Large
review_body: These work great.  My dogs take them to help w/their allergies-their fur is extra soft and smooth now since they started taking these.  It's a lot less expensive to buy them here on Amazon then at my vet's office

product_title: 2 Pack Feliway (150mL) Spray
review_body: I was at my wits end with my two lovely cats - brother & sister. They were constantly  fighting & marking their territories - often in a very disgusting way. So went on line for more info. Bought a 2nd domed kitty litter that only my small female could enter & started with the Felliway spray & plug ins. It took a month for them to finally stop their bad behavior but it did work. Just be patient. Also don't buy at local pet store as almost 2 times the price.

product_title: Purina Tidy Cats Instant Action Non-Clumping Cat Litter
review_body: I have yet to use this product but felt that someone should add to the very non-useful description on this. As a caveat, so I don't seem quite as big of an idiot, I typically purchase the same brand of litter every month & don't even look at other kinds. However, I signed up for diapers to be automatically sent b/c I hate schlepping them home & decided to do litter too b/c that's even worse. In choosing which litter to have auto delivered, I made a few assumptions that, as it turned out, weren't right. Hence this review.    First of all, the description says, \\"Tidy Cats advanced hard clumping formula enhances clump hardness over time\\". However, when I received this in the mail, the bag clearly says NON-CLUMPING. This is a problem for me because I use the clumping kind & I now have 40# of this stuff. Just be warned.    Also, it is 4 bags of 10# each shrinkwrapped together. I don't feel that was explained very well either.     Hopefully this review (even though I haven't used the actual product) is useful for someone.

product_title: Dog Harnesses- Puppia
review_body: I do not write this to discredit the product, but rather warn potential buyers.  While the harness has a good design for very small dogs, its fixed neck hole makes it difficult to near impossible to get on some dogs.  I have a puppy with a small body but a head too big to fit through the hole.  Therefore, this product does me no good.  I should have read the reviews, BUT there should be a disclaimer on the site.  All buyers, please do not be like me, and buy this product without thinking it through. However, if you have a very tiny dog with a smaller head than neck, this product does look like it would work nicely.

product_title: PetSafe Outdoor Ultrasonic Bark Deterrent
review_body: I am not sure this product performs as advertised.  I did not see a change in the dog's barking habits.  The dog still yaps 24/7 as it did before I purchased this item.

product_title: Four Tiered Step Tabletop Water Fountain
review_body: This tiny little fountain is ridiculously over priced. I cannot believe how cheap and sad it is.  I was so disappointed and returned it immediately. I could find a better one on the endcap at CVS for about $5.00.  I had to pay about $10 to ship it back and I was not happy!

product_title: Armarkat Cave Shape Pet Cat Beds for Cats and Small Dogs-Waterproof and Skid-Free Base
review_body: Bought one for my new kitten, but she didn't use it much until it cooled off. Now, my older cat (& puppy) are in this bed & my kitten is laying on the floor waiting for the chance to get in it.  So, I'm back to order another!! My animals love this bed!!

product_title: KONG Ball Dog Toy
review_headline: Has lasted 2 years with a Doberman Pincher
review_body: I have a 4.5 year old 70 LBS. Doberman Pinscher that has chewed this ball for 2 years and there isn't even 1 piece missing!  I even bought 1 for a friend that has 2 Boxers that have destroyed other toys.  My Dobie can go through toys, bones, and other things in weeks, if not days, but not this Kong Ball.  The only other toy that has survived her teeth is the Extreme Kong.  They can easily be washed in the dishwasher and are tons of fun for the dog as it bounces extremely well.  I've wasted tons of money on other toys that were just shredded in days but the money spent on this Kong Ball and Extreme Kong have been well worth it!

product_title: Tetra Water Wonders Aquarium Kit
review_body: Perfect for my dad's 2 african dwarf frogs and snail.  May put a Beta is this also but we'll see.

product_title: Precious Cat Ultra Premium Clumping Cat Litter
review_headline: We all stopped sneezing (me and the cats too)
review_body:
I'll get right to the point:

PROS:
Hardly any dust, I stopped sneezing as well as my cats.
Firm clumps that don't break apart when the cats are digging and burying their \\"treasures\\".
As inexpensive as store-brand litter since I buy it locally with no shipping.
Easy to vacuum out of the carpeting.

CON: The bag is heavy and cumbersome. When I get it home I pour it into a 5 gallon plastic bucket making it easier to handle.

product_title: IRIS Airtight Food Storage Container
review_body: I bought this to store my dog food in. It will hold a 40 lb bag with no problem. I am looking into buying another one or two. Just to store other things like a second bag of dog food or even to store my bird seed in it.  The wheels make it easy to move around and put it where you need it. I highly recommend this container.

product_title: Remote Control Collar with Vibration and 6 Levels of Shock for Training Stubborn Insensitive Dogs
review_body: Broke within 2 days.  Unable to repair or return.  Not for active dogs.  Buy the heavier duty kind if you expect to train a dog with it

product_title: FELINE GREENIES PILL POCKETS Cat Treats
review_body: I have an 11 year old cat who was just diagnosed with hyperthyroidism.  Basically he will have to take a pill twice a day for the rest of his life.  Have you ever tried to PILL A CAT???  Unless he is super laid back it's quite a challenge.  These little 'pockets' work like a dream.  Just pop the pill in the soft pocket, squeeze the top shut and there you go.  I put the pocket on the floor along with other soft treats so Alfie just eats them all up. He is totally in love with the pocket 'treat'.  Such a great idea.  They have them for dogs also...

product_title: COZY PLUSH PET BED SACK - CHOCOLATE EXTERIOR WITH BEIGE INTERIOR
review_headline: I wish the cats were smarter - they sleep ON it instead of IN it...
review_body: These are a great idea if you have a cat smart enough to get inside it; mine are older and don't seem to get the concept.  In any event, it is soft, plush, a great value, and would be wonderful for kitties that GET IT. Mine seem quite content to  plop down on top of it...

product_title: Durvet Nu-Stock Ointment, 12-Ounce
review_body: I have a small dog that has hot spots all over and looking pitiful and so I tried this product and within a week you can see the effectiveness of on my dogs skin and now im a believer...you just have to deal with its smell...but you'll get used to it.

product_title: Premier ECO Dog Collar
review_body: I bought the 3/4\\" large collar in blue. Initially, I was very pleased with this product as the material was soft, smooth, and vibrantly colored. However, by the second day, I started to notice fraying and stretching. I've had it 2 weeks now and it has only gotten worse. It requires daily adjustments to maintain the proper size. I purchased the same style collar for my other dog from a different company and it is still in great condition.  Needless to say, I will be replacing this collar very soon.

product_title: Armarkat Cat tree Furniture Condo, Height- 60-Inch to 70-Inch
review_body: This is our third Armarkat tree.  The first was a small one for them as kittens and was given away when they got their first big tree.  They always found it hard to share the top perch and fought all the time.  The older cat won and claimed the tree as her territory along with my son as her human.  The jungle moved into his room for her highness not to fight.  Got this tree that is similar in style but has two tall perches.  Our second cat claimed it as i was building it!  She was so happy!  It was like \\"Ha ha I got my own BETTER tree!\\"  She claimed the top and the older cat had nothing to really say.  When she does use it she respectfully lies on the lower of the two perches and leaves the higher one for her sister.    These trees or jungles as we call them are amazingly made.  We've had the other one for 4 years now and it still looks great when you vacuum the hair from it (it's navy blue to match my son's room)  This new one is ivory and looks much better because it doesn't look all covered in fur.  I also like the sheep pile versus the furry style of the other one.      The old tree needs new posts as the sisal is all scratched but the cost of replacements are almost as much as a new tree.(they are $18-$20 per post)  so i think i will order another tree like this one or slightly different model on amazon for the free prime shipping.  Amarakat has a great big selection and no shipping cost to some areas, but not all models are on amazon.      Another great amazon buy!

product_title: Tetra ReptoFilter Filter Cartridges
review_body: These replacement filters were impossible for me to find at my local pet stores.  Even big name retailers (Petland, Petco, etc.) never had the product.  I considered purchasing the unassembled packs as they are cheaper but I don't know if I'd be able to do it correctly (plus I'm lazy so these already assembled replacements work perfect for me).  They are convenient and no hassle, simply remove your old filter and place this one it's place, worth the price!

product_title: Guardian Gear 4-Feet Nylon Dog Kennel Lead Multicolor
review_headline: Does the job but not the best quality...
review_body: I bought these for my Yorkie and they do the job but they are a thin weave and cheap.  As the saying goes, you get what you pay for in this case.  I do give them kudos on quick shipping.

product_title: PetSafe Magetic Key with Adjustable Cat Collar for PetSafe Magnetic Key Cat Door
review_headline: Lets my cats in and keeps other critters out
review_body: The collar and magnet work great with the companion cat door.  It lets our cats in while keeping other animals out, specifically a pesty raccoon. The collar is adjustable and the magnet is light weight and effective.  It would be nice, however, if you could just buy the magnet and put it on your own cat collar; but, it works great and that's what mattered most.

product_title: Nature's Variety Raw Medallions Food, Chicken, 3-Pound
review_body: My 4 1/2 month 3.7lb yorkshire terrier LOVE!LOVE!LOVE! this food. It is easy and convenient, yet is best for dogs. I love that my dog now eats excitedly and looks forward to meals. He started eating raw and this is the first Nature's Variety flavor he tasted. He now has finished his 3 lb bag and moved on to try the beef. I plan on having him try all flavors. So far I am very impressed. His pooped is so much smaller than when he was on kibble. His coat is so shiny and soft. The goop in his eyes is almost disappeared. I would definitely feed this food to any future dogs we may have.

product_title: East Side Collection Polyester Faux Suede Cozy Sherpa Dog Harness, Small, Chestnut
review_body: This dog harness is soft against the dog and fits very nicely. It is easy to put on. It slips over the head and then connects around the body. It is very nice quality.

product_title: PetSafe Deluxe Little-Dog Remote Trainer for Pets Under 40 Pounds, PDLDT-305
review_body: I went through the set up and checked the collar for operation. It checked out okay, but my dog never responded to it.  I may return it when I have time to deal with the process!

product_title: Zymox Otic Enzymatic Pet Ear Treatment without Hydrocortisone
review_headline: Works very well for my GSD
review_body: Occasionally one of my two GSD's gets ear trouble, sometimes after swimming, other times perhaps due to allergies?  The first time I went to the vet and he used antibiotics but it returned a month later.  I prefer to use homeopathics or natural remedies .... I tried a few different over the counter products with not much luck. The reviews for this product enticed me to try it. Just this past fortnight, my GSD had a horrible sore, itchy and very red ear.  She was miserable. I told myself that if it wasn't better in a week of the Zymox, I'd take her to the vet.  A week later, there is no redness at all.  If you catch the itchy ear as soon as it starts, all the better.  Hope it works for your pup ....

product_title: Drinkwell 360 Fountain for Pets
review_body: We have a cat named, Gabe - he is a diabetic and is obsessive about water.  Gabe would begin to cry early in the morning because he wanted us to shower in order to jump in afterwards, just to lick up the water.  Although Gabe had a bowl full of water, he liked \\"running\\" water or water that was recently poured.  This condition of his was frustrating to my husband and I because his constant meowing in the early hours caused for us to loose a great deal of sleep.  We purchased the Drinkwell 360 in hopes that it would satisfy Gabe's desire for moving water - and it has!  This is an incredible product - the water stays fresh with the filter (additional filters available with separate purchase), there are a variety of ways for the water to \\"fall\\" with the attachments.  Gabe took to it instantly!  He no longer meows in the morning nor does he jump in to the tub after we have showered.  He's a completely different cat - very calm.    In our household we do have 2 cats - his sister has not taken to the water fountain - doesn't want anything to do with it.  So, we keep the regular water bowl out for her.  Overall:   Pros:  Fresher, moving water for the cat \\"obsessed\\" with drinking from showers, faucets etc.  Cons:  Haven't discovered any.  Just wish I had purchased the stainless steel version so it would last longer.  And NO worries to all of the cat owners out there - we are very much on top of regulating Gabe's diabetic condition!
