product_title: Angels' Eyes Tear-Stain Eliminator for Dogs and Cats, Beef Flavor, 120 Grams Bottle
review_body:
I have 2 paps. Gorgeous little things. Both right around 3 yrs. old. When they were pups, I went & bought a $600 camera to make sure that I captured their growing up. When the teething stage began, well, so did the stains. Ok...figured things would \\"right themselves\\" as they matured. - NOPE!! :( Actually, things got WORSE!
I packed them up, &, off to the vet we went. Vet suspected they had conjunctivitis, or allergies perhaps, so...got prescribed eye drops, which, BTW, did NOTHING to quench the yucky, crusty, salty red stains(clinical term for it is called epiphora).
I tried every OTC method imaginable - apple cider vinegar & distilled water water for drinking, plain yogurt(that red staining in the fur is actually a yeast infection that lives in the hair mixed w/salt that causes the stains; yogurt w/active cultures works to kill yeast), eye wipes, q-tip cleaning w/every kind of hair stain remover out there for dogs...NOTHING WORKED!
I went so far as to then purchase Photoshop to manually edit out the \\"yuck\\" on both of my dogs faces(there went another $80 or so)...I found it to be too time consuming, so, eventually, I put my camera up, &, quit taking pictures altogether. My dogs just looked so hideous, &, in fact, I was quite embarrassed(reminds me of a teenager hitting puberty, & having acne on steroids).
I did NOT want to use this product initially. I had read all of this \\"bunk garbage\\" about how the Tylosin antibiotic was harmful, & not healthy. After much research, & the A-OK from my vet(who, BTW told me that unless I was dumping gobs of it into their food daily would I have problems due to liver damage) finally decided, at wits end, to order Angel Eyes.
That was around 4 months or so ago. It took a while before I REALLY saw results(remember though, I have paps, &, cutting damaged hair off as is custom in some breeds, is a no-no since they have real fur vs. actual hair).
The results of trying this product have astounded me! Looking back on old pics of my dogs DO NOT resemble how they look now vs. then. Clear eyes, white faces,...they no longer have to succumb to the face cleanings. Its amazing! I'm not even half way through my first bottle! I sprinkle a minuscule bit over their food maybe every 3-5 days or so, &, gosh,...they are so much prettier now, &, I would venture to say MUCH happier w/o my having to scrub red crust off of their faces.
I think that most folks that have dogs that DON'T have white faces/masks, really don't/can't understand the frustration that tear stains present, but, to those that DO struggle w/those abysmal stains - give this product a try. I am so glad that I did, the end results are quite pleasant!

product_title: Doggie Doo Drain Dog Waste Sewer Line Attachment
review_body: I bought this product directly from the manufacturer.    My sewer clean out is set in concrete at an odd angle that prevents adaptation or use.  So, I bought a  6\\" to 4\\" pipe adapter and 4\\" threaded clean out and attached it to my landscaping drain. Screwed the Doggie Doo Drain into the 4\\" clean out and I was set.  The mfgr says not use the landscape drain because flows water directly into the storm drains and which flows into and can foul open water supplies, but I've also read that dumping your dog's poop into the sewer lines is not good either because sewage treatment plants are not set up to deal w/the harmful stuff in your doggie's poop.  IMHO, it's much better to dilute poop in the larger open water sources than to dump it into a closed water treatment system via the sewer.  In either case, trying to dump the poop directly into the Doggie Doo Drain can clog up the drain even if you flush liberally w/water.    What to do?  Pre-treat the poop by dumping it first into a small garbage can (which is much easier than trying to dump it directly down the Doggie Doo Drain) w/water and a portable toilet or septic system chemical enzyme treatment - like Rid-X or Rex Bac T. This will deodorize and break down the poop into a bio-safe fluid that you can easily pour down the Doogie Doo Drain w/o backing it up every coupe weeks or so.  These products will also supposedly kill e-coli and other harmful bacteria in your dog's poop if the breakdown occurs aerobically (ie., w/oxygen).  However, any parasites or worms in your dog's poop will probably not be killed by these products.  The only way to make sure bad things don't end up DIRECTLY into the water supply from your dog's poop is to bag the poop and dump it in the trash or use a real doggie septic system, like Doggie Dooley or a home brew system.  Use your conscience as a guide in deposing of your dog's poop.

product_title: Top Quality Freeze Dried Brine Shrimp 85gm
review_headline: A Good Addition to My Fish's Previously Poor Diet - Good Product
review_body:
Don't be like me and wait too long to learn that the ingredients contained in the standard flake or pellet food are inadequate.

I have a few larger sized fantail goldfish in a 40 gallon tank. Since I am a casual fish owner I just always assumed the flake food and pellets contained the correct ingredients to provide a fish with a balanced diet.
I was wrong. And, now I am looking at my most favorite fish in the tank next to me sitting on the bottom of the tank suffering with constipation.
For months this fish would swim and lay upside down. It was upside down as much as it was right side up. It wasn't until it stopped swimming altogether that I realized I had neglected to balance it's diet properly and it is severly constipated.

Brine shrimp are recommended to prevent this condition. And, your fish won't necessarily exhibit clear signs like mine did.
So, add this item to your fishes diet and do them a favor. My fish love it, and go crazy when it hits the water. Time will tell if I waited too long for the upside swimming fish.

In my opinion there are a lot of fillers in this product. It is difficult to tell by the label (see below) since I don't know the make-up of brine shrimp, just basing that on appearance. But, there is a product out there that is not in chunk form and is not grey-ish in color. It is pure, freeze dried brine shrimp. No fillers. When you open the bottle there are literally small shrimp you take out one by one to feed the fish. I won't mention the brand or store out of respect for this product, because it works great also!

product_title: Tap Water Filter
review_headline: Convenient, but expensive for hard water.
review_body: So I have off the scale, hard municipal water... and this filter actually does a pretty good job on it. It produces water completely free of contaminates, chlorine, etc (using api test kit ofc), and does so at 10 gph with no runoff - more efficient than most home RO machines, especially at the price. It's also extremely simple to hook up and use.  The problem is, I too only got an estimated 30-40 gallons out of the canister, which is well short of the advertised average of 50-150 gallons.   My tank is an open design 55 gallon, and I lose close to 5 gallons a week to evaporation. So I did some math.  40 gallons produced (1 canister) / 5 gallons per week  = roughly 8 weeks of use, for $22 plus shipping  40 gallons x .50 cents at the RO machine down the street = $20 (minus hauling all that water up 2 flights op stairs every other week)  After a close race, the machine loses by a narrow margin. But only because the canisters cost too much. If they were to drop the price a bit, I might pick some up for the convenience alone. As for now, I'll pretend to be content lugging water cans around all the time. Guess it's good exercise.

review_headline: Nice Quality but Way Too Small!!
review_body:
My cats love anything they can fit inside of. It doesn't matter if its in a box, under the rug by the door, behind the back of the couch, under the covers, etc.. They have even torn the webbing under my box spring mattress and they actually climb up into it now. That's where they go when we get bad storms. Anyways, I am always on the look out for cat products that can satisfy this aspect of my cats behvior. As soon as I saw the Igloo pet bed, I knew that my cats would absolutely love it. My only worry was if they would ever come back out. I immediately ordered one. To say I was disappointed is an understatement. The quality is nice but the size is just way too small. You would have to have a very small cat or dog for this to be any use at all. Its also a bit misleading as I figured 18 inches meant 18x18 and that would have been plenty big enough. Unfortunately its like 18X10 and it just way too small for even a moderate sized cat.

Unfortunately I ordered from a company through Amazon that only had a 10 day return policy, which I was completely unaware of at the time, so I am now stuck with it. So make sure you look at the return policy before ordering from a company through Amazon marketplace. I had never even heard of a 10 day return policy before. I will never make that mistake again.

Bottom line - The Igloo is just way too small. I would definitely recommend this for those people who do have small cats or dogs but everyone else would be smart to go elsewhere.

product_title: StarMark Clicker Dog Training System
review_headline: Learn to use your own voice!
review_body: Your own voice can make any tone, and project it with much volume, so that for the most part no devices are needed. I didn't buy or watch any videos, read any books or received any advice from other pet owners. I've had dogs in my family since birth, and I've always used mouth sounds, (such as clicks, tones, very high pitched whistles - thanks to my imperfect teeth - and other sounds, words, body and eye gestures) to communicate to my dogs from any reasonable distance. Dogs are quick to pick up on these signals if you treat them well and are consistent with your behavior.    I'm sure the clicker works fine, but use you're own voice. There are many advantages to doing things that are natural to your own body. It feels good to communicate with your dog this way, because they know it's coming from you, which is in itself important. And it's free!

product_title: Eye Envy - Tear Stain Remover Powder- for Dogs and Cats, 4oz - Safe and Natural
review_body: It works great. But it has to work with Eye envy solution. I once ran out of solution so tried to use other brand with this powder; it didn't work.

product_title: Petrageous Designs Glitzy Dots Pet Bowl
review_body: This bowl was so much cuter once I saw it in person! I did not realize through the photos online that the dots and paw print in the center are a metallic (copper/gold) but I could not be more pleased with our purchase. Very cute little bowl while still tastefully fitting in with our home decor. Not to mention it is the perfect size for our little Shih Tzu puppy.

product_title: Petmate Infinity Elite UV Light Purifying Pet Fountain for Cats, 125-Ounce
review_body: The first one I bought died in 2 months so I took it back to the store and returned it thinking it was just defective.  The second one lasted an hour before it too died.  I also took that one back and returned it.  The third one died today after 3 days working.  This one I'm returning for a refund and wont ever buy petmate again.  Its constructed very poorly.  They shoudnt be allowed to sell such shoddy products for 80+ dollars.

product_title: 42" Orange Pet House Soft Crate Carrie
review_body: This crate has been great for us. So far it is durable (had about a month). The mesh does have sort of large holes which isn't a problem for me because my dogs do not try to get out, but if you had a dog that wanted out, it probably wouldnt take much effort. Love the color and it is huge! Fits both of my dogs comfortably (55lb & 25lb) with room to spare. Very happy with product, but unhappy with seller. My crate arrived with some blue staining on it so I contacted the seller only to not hear back... I rated the seller separately which is why this still has 5 stars.

product_title: TetraPond Bio-Active Pressure Filter with UV Clarifier
review_headline: Very Disappointed in this Product from Tetra
review_body: I bought the 1500 UV from a local supplier and was told it would clear up the algae in my small garden pond.  After 2 weeks the algae got worse and discovered the UV light was not working.  I was told to make sure the bulb was plugged in; I did and held down the micro switch and the UV light still would not work.  Called Tetra and they said it was probably a bad ballast and the representative said it happens often.  I paid over $300 for a piece of junk.  I would not buy anything from Tetra period.  I got to take the whole filter system back to the dealer and I don't know what or if they will do anything about it.  I hope I don't have a fight on my hands.

product_title: Brown's Tropical Carnival Gourmet Macaw Food
review_body: Product received very quickly.  the fruit and nuts were much fresher that the same product in the same type of bag that I got at our local pet store.

product_title: PetSafe Easy Walk Harness
review_body: Can't find this S/M size in stores, but small is too small and medium is too big.  We got the harness right away, perfect, brand new, cheaper than Easy Walk Harnesses in Petsmart.  Oliver doggie is not near as \\"pully\\" with this harness on.  Very happy with this purchase!

product_title: PetSafe SSSCAT Spray
review_body: This thing worked twice and thats not enough to deter a cat.  I changed the batteries  in the top thinking that might be the problem but nooooooooo.  First can I had worked first time and every time till it ran out.  Now what do I do?

product_title: Bice-Universal / Adjustable PET AUTO SAFETY GUARD BARRIER
review_body: ya solucionamos el tema de los perros pasándose a la parte delantera del auto, lo ajustas de los cabezales de la parte de atrás y es todo! fácil de quitar y poner! una gran compra!

product_title: Fleabusters Rx for Fleas Plus 3Lb Kills Roaches Kills Ants Odorless
review_body: Have 2 kids and needed to resolve a flea infestation.  followed directions and so far so good.  Left the stuff down a couple of days and then vacumed.  Had residual fleas for a couple of days, but it seems to have taken care of the issue in treated areas.  The worst part about he whole thing is swatting at all the imaginary ones I now feel crawling on my legs after this started.  It takes a lot more time for those to go away.  Good product worth the money for sure

product_title: Pioneer Pet SmartCat Peek-A-Prize Toy Box with 2 Toys
review_body: The activity balls included don't interest my cat whatsoever. On the flip side, if I grab a packet of treats and sprinkle some in, she will go to town fishing them out one at a time. It keeps her occupied for hours. She has to figure out how to get to the ones in the middle which keeps her sharp. Since she is 14 years old, that's important.

product_title: ThunderShirt Classic Dog Anxiety Jacket
review_body: This shirt works wonders for my 2 year old yorkie! She used to freak out every time it thundered...so much so that I had to get anxiety medication from my vet. I saw this shirt on a dog at the doggie daycare that I take my dog to, and decided to give it a shot. I can't believe it!! I wasn't expecting it to work, but it completely cured my dog's thunderstorm anxiety. I put it on her right when it starts storming and she completely calms down. I would tell anyone to try this product!!!

product_title: EliteField 3-Door Folding Soft Dog Crate, Indoor & Outdoor Pet Home, Multiple Sizes and Colors Available
review_body: I love this crate! It's very simple to set up and take down and the materials are very durable yet lightweight. This is exactly what I was looking for and just as described. It shipped quickly and was packaged well. Can't wait to take it camping and see how it holds up. Five Stars

product_title: DogPause Dog Bowl (Red)
review_headline: For a dog who does not know when to take a breath when eating
review_body: My little 8 lbs. Maltese is like a vacuum cleaning when she is near a food bowl.  Many times she would make herself sick.  This bowl was the answers to my prayers.  Not the cutest bowl but works out well when you have a fast eater.

product_title: GREENIES Original Regular Size Dog Dental Chews Dog Treats
review_body: I ordered 3 packs of 27-count greenie dog chews from Entirely Pets and have ordered this product from various sources for many years. I have now opened the 2nd pack and both were the same:  all of the greenies were stuck together in one big lump.  I had to forcibly pull them apart.  Although I didn't try them myself, it leads me to believe these are old products and probably stale.  I will not order from this vendor again, even if it is a buck or so cheaper.

product_title: THREE STEP - Fold-Away Pet Steps and Ramp in One
review_body: We bought this when our Weimaraner had a clot at the base of her Aorta (saddle thrombus). Before she was diagnosed correctly the vet said she had some spinal problems causing the back leg muscle weakness. She put a moratorium on stairs or jumping, so we had to find a way to get our dog onto the bed and sofa (the floor and her beds weren't good enough - she was a Weim after all). We bought these stairs to help. They are attractive, hold up well for a 75lb dog and have a decent and manageable rise between steps (something I cannot say for other pet steps) an important quality the older the dog gets. They are a bit creaky and project a bit far into the room, and will not hold up to human weight using them as a seat. Other than that, they were an excellent help for our little girl and kept her sleeping with us for the next 18 months. The only diffculty with these is training a dog to use them: the older the dog, the tougher to train away from jumping. I recommend using these steps long before the dog actually needs them. Good purchase, and so very thankful we had their help getting her onto the bed those last months.

product_title: PetSafe SSSCAT Spray
review_body: Sometimes I use my kitchen table as a desk and tend to leave paper on it.  I have 3 feral cats and for the past several years one of them would periodically urinate on the paper left on the table. I could never figure out who was doing it.  I have gone through the gamut of vices to stop this behavior.  The problem was not health related, the vet says the cats are healthy.  The problem was not environmental, no major changes have occurred in the house for years.  Each cat has had their own litter box for years.  I have tried moth balls and aluminum foil and the \\"surprises\\" on my table continued.      One day I was watching \\"My Cat From Hell\\" and Jackson recommended this product. My cats hate it but I love it. Because the cat did not regularly jump on the table it took a couple of weeks before she did.  During that time I got sprayed a lot cuz I forgot it was on,  but I did not give up.  Now, I am used to it.  But the cats are not.  The culprit finally jumped on the table and got so startled she kicked everything of off the table and hid for several hours.  I now leave the can on the table and have not had any more incidents since then.    It is definitely worth the money.  It works...................

product_title: H2O Animal Hydration Aqua Buddy 2-Quart Homelife Series Automatic Waterer
review_body: I had bought an automatic water dish made out of metal a few months ago and it developed holes within about two months so I bought this one to replace it. The real problem is the hose attachment it is so deep that my hose would not tighten down. To solve this problem I added another washer and this seemed to solved the problem as long as it does not get too hot. It tends to leak when it is really hot (above 90 degrees) which happens a lot in South Texas. Other than that problem it has worked flawlessly and I know it will not rust. All in all a good buy they just need to redesign the connection.

product_title: Tuffy Ultimate Dog Toy
review_headline: Only thing that stands up to our bully!
review_body: We have a bully that LOVES squeakers! I have bought toy, after toy, after toy! She SHREDS them! UNTIL I bought Tuffy's Ultimate Dog Bone! She LOVES it! She has had it 6 months now and has not torn it up yet! AND both squeakers still work! One is getting a little weaker but if she hits just right it squeaks loud! She likes to walk around 'popping' it in her mouth just to hear it squeak. I have bought everything imaginable from Nylabone to 'non-stuffing-invicible-' toys. She goes through them like they're nothing. I HIGHLY recommend Tuffy's products if you have a big dog that love's squeakers and is tough on toys. She did get a hold of the stitching on the side the first week- but I kept it trimmed back & have had NO problems what so ever since!!! I will be buying more!!!  She also has a Kong which she love's to have treats in.

product_title: SportDOG Brand YardTrainer Remote Trainers - Basic Obedience Dog Training Collars for Around the House or Yard
review_headline: It's like having a new dog!
review_body: I have a 1 year old German Shepherd that weighs nearly 100 lbs.  The poor dog (and poor me) has more energy than he knows what to do with.  It's hard to even pet him because he won't sit still long enough.  I was skeptical that ANYTHING would help him with his bad habits of running cars (in the driveway.  He has an Invisible Fence keeping him in the yard.  ONE time of getting a correction and he's now going for the doghouse when a car comes in the drive.  His \\"over-excitedness\\" when he gets attention is curbed by ONLY a warning beep.....no electric shock at all.  How long did it take to achieve this?  The first day!  He's like a new (and MUCH better) dog!  The unit is very well built and the transmitter is small enough to have on you without being cumbersome.  It's works too well to even dream of not having it!

product_title: SynergyLabs Xtreme Catnip
review_body: My cats are crazy about this catnip, and they don't really like any of the other ones.  It's great.  Lots of fun watching them.

product_title: Tape Worm Tabs for Dogs (5 tablets)
review_body: (Praziquantel) Canine Tape Worm Tabs.  The medication worked well.  Our package arrived promptly.  Our dog is cured.  All is well in the dog world at our house, for the time being. (Why does he eat squirrels anyway?)

product_title: Hi tech ecological Flea Trap - The Original Product - Now in special price
review_body: I gave it a 2 because it did catch fleas, among other things. I bought this product directly from the company  and right off had problems with it. After a few days of wondering what was going on with it I noticed that the left led would not go on. I contacted the company and they promptly gave me a new one, without needing me to return the defective one free of charge. I was surprised and grateful. After a week of having the new one (both leds working) I had it in the hallway and my 15 month old son picked it up and dropped it from about 2 inches off the ground. I didn't think it would break from that little happening but it did. Now nothing on it works at all. It seems like any handling would break something from this. Sure it is pet and child safe, but not safe from pets and children being around it. They need to create a product that can be handled better. I was told an electrician could change the non-working leds but something that is 40$ should not break so easily.

product_title: NutraMax Dasuquin For Cats
review_body: This supplement appears to have helped my cats, 10 and 13 years of age.  They are moving much more freely--good quality-of-life booster.  I recommend trying it.

product_title: Kobi Pet Carrier - Soft Sided - Airline Approved, Charcoal, Small
review_body: This is a GREAT carrier! It is made well using quality materials. It has awesome features, like nice padded handles, a strap that can be used as a leash and a LARGE storage pocket. The accessories that can be purchased separately, are great as well. It has mesh windows on both ends and on one long side, all which can be opened or closed. It also has a large zippered mesh openings on both ends AND on the top UNDER the privacy flap, which is nice. The mesh is a tightly woven \\"plastic\\" type mesh that I do not believe my dog could claw/eat through. My 11 pound Maltese Shitzu mix tore through his $171.00 carrier with fabric mesh in about 10 minutes the first time he used it (Seriously). The only problem I have with this carrier is that is collapes a bit (height) when my dog moves around in it much like a duffle bag would. My dog's height is 11.5\\" and the regular size carrier is a bit to short for him (just an FYI). I wish Kobi would make a \\"large\\" size carrier! I am seriously considering having covered flexible rods put in to keep the carrier open (dome-like shaped) to add to the height...THAT'S HOW MUCH I LIKE IT! I could not send this back because it is the best looking carrier I have found to date.

product_title: Ethical Skinneeez Big Bite Wolf Stuffingless Dog Toy
review_body: I have 4 Yorkies and they think this is the best new toy around. They shake them and pull them between each other. This is well worth to cost.

product_title: IRIS Open Top Cat Litter Box Kit with Shield and Scoop
review_body: This is my favorite litter box for my long legged Savannah cats. They pee standing up, so they can't crouch down in the closed litter boxes. The walls are nice and high so no litter is not kicked out on the sides. I have 5 cats, and three of these boxes.

product_title: Hydor ARIO 2 COLOR RED LED Aquarium Aerator Red Bubbles UL
review_body: This item comes with a US  type plug. There's no info that it has it and I had to buy an adapter. Shipping and handling I think is extremely expensive.

product_title: BLUE Wilderness High Protein Grain Free Adult Dry Cat Food
review_body: My cats were too young to have serious health problems.  However, they did eat compulsively and throw up (on the carpet) at least once a week even though we fed them the best quality grocery store cat food (Iams).  We switched to Blue Buffalo after the cats flatly refused a transition to raw food.  No more vomiting, no more constant eating, decreased shedding.  They eat less and seem much more contented.  Blue Buffalo may be more expensive, but it is still much less than the vet.  One bag lasts our two smallish cats seven weeks.

product_title: Downtown Pet Supply PUPPY PADS - Dog Wee Wee Housebreaking Disposable Training Pads
review_body: These are the best pads I have tried. The liquid soaks in and never leaks, even when I have the pad on carpet. I have a Shiz Tsu so I don't know about large dogs, but there is something in the pads that turns the liquid to a solid state.

product_title: Nutramax Dasuquin with MSM Chewable Tablets for Dogs
review_body: Great product! I have been using Dasuquin for awhile now and am very happy with it. My dogs are doing great and they love the taste! Highly recommended.

product_title: Simple Solution Extreme Stain/Odor Remover
review_headline: Didn't believe the hype.. but yes, it's amazing!
review_body: When other reviewers said you could literally spray this on a stain/pet urine/etc. on the carpet and let it sit and the stain would disappear, I didn't believe it. Sounded too easy! Even those magic vacuum salesmen that come to your house didn't really get pet stains out of the carpet with their machine. But it completely works! I probably used most of the bottle I got in the first few days just cleaning up various spots here and there. And - this could be a coincidence - but my Silky Terrier hasn't marked her spot on the carpet since I've started using this. It's amazing! I know the price can seem a little steep, but trust me, it's a great value! Looking forward to purchasing my next bottle already. Highly recommend!! : )

product_title: JW Pet iSqueak Funble Football Dog Toy
review_body: Save your money on this product. Although it feels tough and durable, our dog quickly found the weak spot -- the insert for the squeaker device. It was just a matter of time before he tore a hole in the toy and dislodged the squeaker completely. It all happened within the span of hours, so the toy didn't even last a day. Definitely not a toy for dogs that are aggressive players/chewers! Very disappointing, especially because he was otherwise quite taken with it.

product_title: BRAVO 294118 Dried Beef Trachea for Pets, 20-Case
review_body: I have two strong chewers and this product keeps them busy for two days. Best long lasting chew I've tried. Also bravo products have little smell so they can chew in the house.

product_title: SkunkOff Shampoo (8oz)
review_headline: Doesn't just work for skunk smells!!!!!
review_body: I bought this product because we adopted a Siberian Husky that had been kept in a kennel and no matter how many times we gave her baths- she still had that \\"kennel smell\\".  We even took her to Pet Smart and had them use deodorizing shampoo- and that didn't help much.  I ordered skunk off and mixed it in with a shampoo and it completely took that smell off!  Best stuff ever! We couldn't believe how great she smelled after we used skunk-off.  The shampoo is mild and the smell isn't overpowering.

product_title: Ware Manufacturing Hay Ball, Assorted Colors
review_body: The picture of the item shows it is blue and that was the whole purpose of buying it from this seller. when it came it was a magenta color, i wasnt very happy with that. I was wanting blue for a reason bc its my sons favorite color and it is for his guiena pig!

product_title: Fancy Feast Flaked Skipjack Tuna Appetizer in a Delicate Broth
review_body: Why would any pet owner (who is mobile) order from PetCo? -- Or shop at PetCo for that matter. Their prices are always higher. With the shipping this item prices out at $1.50 per pack. It's always $1.25 at Petsmart (sometimes less); same at the local super market (Vons). I know because I buy 21 packs of this per week. It's great stuff.  PetCo rips us off ... check for yourself.

product_title: The Original Anxiety Wrap
review_headline: did not work for our situation
review_body: I bought this for my son older dog.  The dog has   extreme seperation anxiety due probably to poor  hearing on her part. The dog whines constantly unless  someone is interacting with her.  This is new behavior  on her part.  She also does not seem to be house broken  any longer.  We believe she is senile. The vest did  not change her behavior.  I had hoped for miracles.  The vest might work well in other situations.  I have friends who rave about how well this worked on  their hyperactive, anxiety seperation monster dog.

product_title: Fizzion Pet Stain & Odor Remover, 32-Ounce Bottle w/ 2-Pack Refill
review_body: The listing is misleading at best, deceptive at worst. 32-Ounce Bottle w/ 2-Pack Refill -  sounds like a 32 oz bottle of product with two refills, three bottles of product. Nope, you get an empty 32 oz bottle and two tablets that make ONE bottle of product. Wanted to try it but gotta send it back. A $5 box of BIZ would make about 20 gallons of pet stain and odor remover. It works, I'll just stick with that.

product_title: Poinsettia and Holly Tree Skirt or Table Cloth
review_headline: Pattern only - not the skirt itself
review_body: Please note that this is for the quilting pattern only, not the skirt itself. Wish they'd mentioned that somewhere in the description as it looks like it's for the actual finished item. Also $6+ shipping for an envelope with a couple sheets of paper in it is ridiculous!

product_title: Vetri-Science Omega 3 6 9 Fatty Acid Pet Supplement
review_body: Vetri-Science Omega 3,6,9 softgels are great!  They make my fawn doberman's coat look healthy, shiney, beautiful and illiminate problematic skin conditions:  bumps, rash, etc.  Would recommend!

product_title: Precise 726159 12-Pack Feline Foundation Turkey Food, 13.2-Ounce
review_headline: One food my picky cat likes
review_body: This food was recommended by our local pet store for our 16-year old cat, who has become more picky about her food, and has lost weight.  It was mainly chosen because it's available in senior formula of dry food, and in the canned.  Skat loves both, and eats the canned even better than canned tuna.  Only drawback is price (more than $1/can either locally or here w/ shipping) and that it is hard to find elsewhere.

product_title: Aqueon Submersible Aquarium Heaters 50W
review_body: perfect heater have yet to have a problem i own 3 of these 300w they perform well , sutrdy and quality build

product_title: World's Best Scented Multiple Cat Clumping Cat Litter
review_headline: Why am I (& my cats) the only ones giving this 5 stars?
review_body: I have two cats and have used the regular \\"World's Best\\" for a while and really like it, and now this new scented version is even better--it's soooo nice to go into the bathroom and smell lavender! The cats have not problem with it, and now my mom's cat is using it and likes it too. Hope they don't stop making it!!!

product_title: Vo-Toys 1208 Ferret Cat Toy Cat & Dog Toy
review_headline: Cat that dislikes furry toys went nuts for this!
review_body: The product photo shows a tan colored, segmented creature toy which the product is not. After seeing photos uploaded by another reviewer and checking other website photos, I knew the picture didn't match the product, so I was already expecting it to look differently and it wasn't a big deal. It is actually a one piece very furry grayish toy with a long furry tail.  I have two cats and got this for my 3.5 year old who absolutely loves super furry mouse toys. She has yet to discover it, but to my surprise, the younger 1.5 year old who actually dislikes any of the fuzzy or furry toys immediately went crazy over this. She shook it, pawed at it, tossed it in the air, fetched it, and just had a blast playing with this toy! My youngest cat is small with a very small frame. She seems to have no trouble at all carrying this around in her mouth.  I am about to get a couple more. One for my oldest one who will no doubt want to claim it as her own (it was supposed to be hers anyway) and one for a friend whose cat also goes nuts for ultra fuzzy creature toys. I am very happy with the purchase!

product_title: Made in USA Dog Bed King Cuddler Nest Bed. XL- Extra Large. Outside Dim. 42x32x7". Inside Dim. 38x28x7". Brown Exterior with Imitation Lambswool Interior. Removable Machine Washable Cover.
review_body: My two small dogs have been used to sleeping with me since they were babies, but lately it's been so annoying and hard for my girlfriend and I to sleep with them in our full sized bed because they move around and lay allover us all night, so we looked on Amazon and found this bed. It took about a week to get here and it's huge! I bought the bed for the two dogs to share but still have room to move around and have their own spaces and they absolutely love it. They slept like babies all night. Great bed for two small dogs or one bigger dog. It's comfy too :)

product_title: Remote Dog Training Collar Shock Collar Vibrate Trainer 8 Levels Shock
review_body: I got this product back in January 2011.  The battery will only last a couple of days to a week and they cost 12 dollars a piece.  The collar doesn't seem to work some times.  My dog doesn't notice the shock even at the highest level so it doesn't help to discourage unwanted behavior.

product_title: Aqueon Coralife 50/50 Straight Pin Compact Fluorescent Lamp
review_headline: bright at first, but it quickly fades
review_body: When you first plug this bulb in and turn on the fixture, it will make the colors in your tank \\"pop,\\" from fish to corals. Sadly, that doesn't last long, and within a couple of months it's not much better than any standard fluorescent bulb. (I really noticed the difference when I replaced one of the two bulbs on my fixture, and saw the radical difference in light intensity and hue between the new and old.)  I think for my next fixture, I'll be looking at LEDs...

product_title: Catit Scratcher with Catnip
review_body: I purchased this, my cat used it twice. Once when it was new, and to investigate the \\"catnip\\". The herbs included drove my cat away despite his typical catnip love affair.

product_title: Kyjen Invincibles Purple Lizard Squeaker Dog Toy, 9" L X 3" W
review_body: I bought this toy on a whim. Our dog is a mid size terrier with a knack for killing squeakers within minutes.  It has been two weeks and she has punctured the squekers but it still squeaks.  We only let her play with it for about 30 minutes a day now because it gets so annoying.  This toy makes a rather odd squeak as well.

product_title: 8 in 1 Perfect Coat Tender Care Puppy Shampoo, 64 oz.
review_headline: 8 in 1 Perfect Coat Tender Care Puppy Shampoo
review_body: This is a great smelling shampoo for dogs.  It made my dogs hair nice and soft.  Highly recommend this product.

product_title: Purina Fancy Feast Delights with Cheddar Grilled Gourmet Wet Cat Food - (24) 3 oz. Cans
review_body: My cat has chronic renal failure and often doesn't want to eat. He will always eat this, and while I try not to give him fish every day (or tuna ever), I will let him have a can of this 2-3 times a week if needed. It's such a treat for him and I feel better seeing him eat with gusto. Highly recommended.

product_title: T Bonz Dog Snacks
review_headline: Dogs love them and they leave no mess
review_body: This is one of those treats that the dogs just love, and it is a bonus that they do not leave crumbs all over the floor.  My dogs can be pretty picky about the treats they eat, but this things are always a winner.

product_title: Dingo Goof Balls
review_body: As always great product.  I have a 11yr old Chihuahua that loves them.  All of Dingo's products have been top notch for me.

product_title: JW Pet Company Bad Other Cuz Rubber Dog Toy, Medium, Colors Vary
review_body: My dog loves this toy so much. She brings it up to me all the time for playing which is whenever I am home. I will recommend it to people who are looking for a fun toy for their canine friends.

product_title: Zoo Med Laboratories AZMBL20 Betta Hammock
review_headline: I never thought I'd say this but...
review_body: My betta freakin' loves this thing!  He actually sleeps in in at night and lays in it when, I assume, he's bored. I bent the 'leaf' so that it's curved with the tip just poking out of the water. He'l get on and lay on his side with his head sticking out of the water and occasionally pull his head back down and blow some nest bubbles. At first I thought maybe he was sick or something but after a bit of research on the web I found out that it is perfectly normal for a betta to sleep this way. Weird huh?

product_title: World's Best 00631 Cat Litter, Multiple Cat Clumping Formula
review_body: I don't know if this is the \\"world's best\\" cat litter ... but it is very, very good!  The multiple cat formula clumps even better than the original formula, although my cats love both.  My older cat will use a variety of litters (and has) but makes it very clear that she prefers this one over the rest we have tried.  I litter trained my youngest cat on this from a 2-week-old orphan, and I keep telling myself I need to mix up the litter routine occasionally so she won't be too stuck on just one litter (just in case) but it is so convenient in every way that I keep putting it off.  I've recommended this litter to several friends.  Many love it as much as I do.  Some didn't care for the \\"farm\\" smell of the corn-based product -- I find any smell barely noticeable, except a slight smell when it first comes out of the package, and I prefer the faint corn smell over the smell of any scented litter or the \\"dirty\\" smell of clay litter.  The only downside to this litter is also one of its best features, in my opinion: this litter does track a little bit, but only because it is so light.  I put an extra bath mat under my litter box and 99% of tracked litter gets tracked there.  A very, very small amount gets tracked up to 3 feet away from the mat, but I don't find it tracked outside of that area.  I keep a small whisk broom next to the litter scoop, and do a quick sweep every day or two, while I am scooping the box.  It takes less than 20 extra seconds to keep the floor tidy, and that is more than worth having a lightweight litter that is easy to haul to the trash as needed!

product_title: Best Friend Mobility Extra Small Dog Wheelchair
review_body: I ordered the doggy wheelchair for our 7 year old miniature dachshund that had some how injured her back causing paralysis to her back legs. Dazzle unfortunately never had the chance to use the wheelchair and passed away 1 week after her injury; the box had not even been opened and when I contacted the company explaining that the wheelchair needed to be returned the company was very courteous in responding and the return process was painless. They were quick to credit my amazon account.

product_title: Rubbermaid Scoop'n Store Pet Food Storage - Extra Large
review_body:
This holds 100 lbs of Chicken Crumble.
It is perfect and is airtight.
Love the scoop that comes with it.

product_title: Vet Solutions Lime Sulfur Dip (4 oz)
review_headline: Great for killing those pesky mites off your Dwarf hamsters!
review_body: I followed the instructions and a week later my little hamster's itching stopped and his hair grew back which before he was losing a bit due to mites.

product_title: CatGenie 120 Self-Washing Self-Flushing Cat Box
review_body:
I give thanks daily, every time I walk by the cat box and realize I don't have to clean it. I previously tried the Littermaid electric box, but it tended to jam, and the collection tray quickly got full of cat poop and was unpleasant to handle. I travel a lot and the Genie works well.

In fairness, things can go wrong. In two years' time I've twice had to call Cat Genie, once when the water wouldn't run into the bowl and once when the machine was not reading the level of disinfectant left in the cartridge. Each time, Cat Genie customer service promptly diagnosed the problem and shipped me (overnight) a replacement unit at no cost to me.

A last comment -- the cleaning cycle, from scooping to washing to drying, takes about 30 minutes, so if you have a multiple-cat household, you might need more than one Genie if your cat, like mine, is picky or impatient. But overall, my compliments to the engineers.

product_title: Armarkat Cave Shape Pet Cat Beds for Cats and Small Dogs-Waterproof and Skid-Free Base
review_body:
I looked at many dog houses, this one fit the bill perfectly. Its well made, warm, and looks good.
The color is atractive too.

product_title: Remington Brand Professional Silent Dog Whistle
review_body: Took a chance after reading review of all the silent whistles on here. Even after tuning this is is still very audible and shrill. The point was to make the dog stop barking when everyone's asleep. Not wake everyone up because the dog is barking.

product_title: Automatic Cat Feeder, CSF-3 Super Feeder, Stand/Bowl, Analog Timer
review_headline: The perfect device for tired cat parents!
review_body: I am really grateful for this device! Our cat had been driving us crazy at all hours of the night begging for food. It took her a couple of weeks to adjust to being fed on a schedule, but since then we have been getting much more sleep! My only suggestion would be to have a larger container for the food on top, but overall, I am very satisfied with this purchase and would recommend to other cat owners.

product_title: HDP Large Roasted Pig Ears
review_body: I tried purchasing the lowfat cow ears but my dogs will have nothing to do with them. I give them one of these when I start to eat and I get 10 minutes of peace and quiet. Don't know what I'll do with the cow ears but I know the pig ears will always be in stock at our house.

product_title: Puppia Soft Dog Harness (Mesh) Black Large
review_headline: Puppia mesh harnesses on my two miniature schnauzers
review_body: I ordered two black mesh harnesses for my two miniature schnauzers who are chubby and weigh about 25 lbs each.  I ordered size L. based mainly on their chest size.  The neck part is a little loose (wish it was adjustable) but they haven't come off.  One dog does not mind wearing it but she hesitates to let me put it over her head and on.  The other dog runs and hides under the table and she really does not like it!  She is the one who used to choke so I thought she'd do best but she hasn't.  She constantly stops and refuses to walk with this on her.  She does have more of a hump on her back and a broader chest than the other dog so maybe it isn't as comfortable on her? If she sees rabbits, geese or other dogs she forgets it's on and runs and walks just fine.  In any case these harnesses stopped the pulling immediately and now we can walk a normal pace as long as the younger dog doesn't stage a \\"sit in.\\"  We will keep trying because I do feel these are much safer for them.

product_title: Pioneer Pet Replacement Filters for Ceramic and Stainless Steel Fountains
review_body: These do the job and our pets love the water fountain! We have a chihuahua and 4 cats, and find ourselves cleaning the filter/fountain about every 2 weeks.

product_title: KONG Air Dog Fetch Stick with Rope Dog Toy
review_headline: Alex the Doberman gives it 5 paws up!
review_body: He adores this toy. He holds it by the rope and shakes it and runs around. He literally sleeps with this toy he loves it so much. We love to play tug-o-war with him and he gets a great grip on the tennis ball like material. In short - a huge load of fun!

product_title: Teddy's Pride Oral Care
review_body: Save your money. This product does not work. I have now used two 2 ounce containers and have noticed absolutely no change in my dog's teeth.

product_title: ValuePad 300 17x24 17 gram Economy Small Dog Puppy Pad
review_body: I purchased these for my pad trained maltipoo but didn't notice that they are smaller than the regular pads (about half the size).  Normally, I put down two regular size pads before leaving for work which cost 25 cents each; with these I had to use three to get same coverage area which only cost a penny more.  Sasha didn't appear to notice any difference and the pads are very absorbent.  Likely won't buy again as the larger pads are a better fit for us.  These would be excellent for a toy sized dog.

product_title: Drinkwell 360 Pet Fountain
review_headline: Should Have Stayed With Previous Design
review_body: Stainless steel is good for cleaning but they should have stayed with the design used on previous models. The little clips used to hold down the cord and inner ring are easy to break off when inserting & removing. The old design just had little tabs on the inner ring and you just twisted it to secure it in place. The cord came out the bottom with a little slot in the side. On this model, the cord comes out over the side, thus the need for plastic clips/cord cover.

product_title: Simple Solution Washable Diaper Cover Ups, Small, Pink/Purple
review_body: I got these for my Jack Russell  with 17 in waist.They are way too small. I think they will be fine in medium. They seem easy to put on. I wish the sizing guideline was more accurate.

product_title: Zoo Med Laboratories AZMBP5 Dial-A-Treat Food, 0.12-Ounce
review_headline: Rocks, shells, dirt, random bugs... Not safe for bettas at all
review_body: As I was going through the the daphnia and blood worms, there were tons of dirt clots and other random debris as well as containing tons of useless powder. The mysis are fairly clean but they tend to clump together.  Not buying again.

product_title: Perfect Pet Tubby-Kat Cat Door
review_body: This was extremely easy to set up, takes about 20 minutes. Comes with cut out template for door! I needed to move my indoor cats litter box from our vacant laundry room to the garage when we bought our washer and dryer. It took about 1 week to slowly coax them into using it. Now it is just habit for them. I highly reccomend this product. It was so easy to set up and it is a solid great working pet door not cheaply made. My 3 cats have never been outdoors so training them was a small challenge, DO NOT force the cat through the door it will only cause them to fear it. I kept the door open for 3 days, Next place a treat or something special your cat really enjoys on the out side for 2 days, when they go to it close the door and they will want to come back in bad enough to learn to push with thier head or paw. After that they learn to use the door with ease, in fact they now love hanging out in the garage!

product_title: Best Pet Black 49" Triple-door Suitcase Style Folding Dog Crate with Free Pan - 49"(l) X 29"(w) X 32"(h)
review_headline: Mastiff puppy has lots of room to move
review_body: I purchased this for my Cane Corso puppy, she is now 7 months old and still has plenty of space to sleep, play and stretch out. I like the sturdiness of this product, the latches easily open and close. The door on the top allows me to put things into the crate without my puppy running out. Easily unfolds to set up, I have moved it from room to room with ease. This is my second crate, my mom has a german shepard and I purchased one for her. We both enjoy this product for our oversized pups.

product_title: Jungle Talk Pet Products Talk & Play Phone - Small/Medium
review_body:
My husband and I purchased 2, one for our two Lovebirds and one for our two Parakeets! They love it, especially the two females, \\"Juliet\\" (lovebird) and Carla (parakeet). They are now learning to use it when they want me. At night, the lights and music go out automatically except the large light. One of the four will remind me to turn the light off by pressing one of the buttons (ex: \\"I love you\\").

product_title: IAMS Dog Food Ground, Savory Dinner with Wholesome Lamb & Rice, 13.2-Ounce Cans (Pack of 24)
review_headline: My dogs like it, taste is good
review_body: My dogs really suck this stuff up like none other. They enjoyed it so much that I had to try some myself. It wasn't actually that bad, kinda salty. Now, I didn't have a spoonful or anything, just stuck my finger in and tasted. IAMs is a pretty decent brand and we'll keep feeding it to the boys...

product_title: Dogit Go Slow Anti-Gulping Dog Bowl
review_headline: Way Better than the Brake-Fast Bowl!!!
review_body: I have a pekingese that gulps her food without chewing and I first bought one of the very famous Brake-Fast bowls for $14.00 plus shipping. The bowl did it's job and it was very light so my dog could easily push it around like a hockey puck. Then I got my baby Boston terrier and she easily chewed the knobs on the bowl and the edges. Then I came across the Dogit Go Slow bowl. The price caught my attention at first and then I saw that the design was as same as the Brake-Fast bowl. I ordered two and I was very pleased when I received them. They're heavy enough that my pups can't push them around like toys and the knobs make them take their time eating. I LOVE these bowls and would recommend them to anyone with dogs that have gulping/inhaling their food problems. Great product!!!!

product_title: Finnex Digital Temperature Control Glass Heater, 100-Watt
review_body: Worked great for the first 3-4 weeks. Suddenly stopped working. It would just read the temperature accurately but the actual heater stopped working. Money down the drain. Don't recommend.

product_title: Vetri-Science Laboratories Glyco-Flex III Bite-Sized Dog Chews
review_body: Our 12yr old Black Lab was having a hard time getting up, especially after exercise. After about 3 months of taking the Glyco Flex iii she showed Great improvement. She acts like a puppy again! And she loves the taste of the chews. . .we call it her \\"nummy\\". She has been taking them for a little over a year now and is doing fantastic.

product_title: Pet ID Tag - Bone - Custom engraved cat and dog ID tags. Pet safety tag has reflective coating and is available in stainless steel or brass, or plastic which comes in a variety of colors.
review_body: I'm very satisfied with my new id tag. The quality is great for the price and the size is as I expected.  Very readable text and light weight. Delivered on time!

review_body: The EVO 95 has been the one thing that has stopped my cat from bleeding when he uses his litterbox...in other words, it stopped his colitis/internal allergies and he's been a healthy, active, loving cat since. product_title: Petstages Soothing Cat Easy Life Hammock and Scratcher
review_body: The actual product is great. Looks awesome and my cat gets a ton of scratching out of it. But she weighs almost 17lbs and she has already broken 2 of these guys. But I won't stop buying these, she's just on a stricter diet.

product_title: 180, 220, 500, 700, 880, 960, 2200 Dog Pet Waste Poop Bags, Bulk roll,Clean up refills-(Green, Blue, Purple, Red, Black, Pink,Rainbow of Colors or Paw Print)+FREE Bone Dispenser,Downtown Pet Supply
review_body: These little bags are great. It seems my young pup will not evacuate unless I have one wrapped around my hand prepared to catch whatever falls out of the monster. I have yet to find a bag with a hole in it, which is great news!!! the free bone shaped bag dispenser is quite handy also. I'll be buying more of these soon!

product_title: Coolaroo Elevated Pet Bed with Knitted Fabric
review_body: Best investment for my dog!

product_title: PetSafe Deluxe Bark Control Collar (PDBC-300) for Dogs 8 lb. and Up, Waterproof, 3 Modes of Static Correction
review_body: I did a lot of research and read probably fifty reviews before I decided to purchase this product. Even though I pulled the trigger, I was still skeptical that it would curb my dog's barking. Fortunately, my worries were put to ease the day I received the collar. It worked immediately. All it took was one time and my dog stopped the annoying barking. He was a little sheepish for the rest of the day, but he quickly got back to his old demeanor (not the barking part). What's even better is that he is trained to bark/not bark when the collar is off or on. Meaning, there are times when I *do* want him to be able bark, when we are not at home, for instance, or when he is playing with the kids. When I take his collar off, he knows that he is allowed to bark. Conversely, when we are at home and he begins to bark at an inappropriate time, as soon as we put the collar on, he stops barking--immediately! It's great! It's at the point where he does not wear the collar for most of the day and night because his barking has subsided. We only put it on him when we don't want him to bark. The rest of the time, he doesn't bark uncontrollably like he used to. The collar trained him so we don't even have to use the collar! Although the price was a little more than I would have liked, you know what they say, the results have been \\"priceless.\\" Overall, I am very pleased with this product. As a side note, Amazon shipping rocks! I always pick the slowest shipping method, yet I continually get my products way ahead of schedule. Nice!

product_title: BLUE Wilderness High Protein Grain Free Adult Dry Cat Food
review_body: After we switched to blue, my cat's belly is gone. She is more energic! Blue is the only brand we buy now!

product_title: MidWest Deluxe Bolster Pet Bed for Dogs & Cats
review_headline: Not the best quality, but dog loves it
review_body:
This dog bed fits perfectly in the crate. And, it has this bolster around the side that my dog props her head on - very cute. Compared to her last crate bed, she absolutely loves this one.

Unfortunately, it doesn't wear all that well. The material is this furry/fluffy top and I find balls of this all over my house. Not from my dog ripping/grabbing at it, but it just balls up out of normal wear. The flat part also gets matted after awhile and doesn't look fresh and new anymore.

product_title: Whisker World Cat Scratch Tower Cat Furniture, Beige Plush
review_body: I think you can \\"teach old dogs new tricks\\" but CATS are different kinds of people.  I moved to a new and beautiful apartment with all new furniture.  Max and Mary, 13 year old brother and sister still prefer the sofa, chairs and bed to do their 'tricks' on. :-(   The only reason I gave this scrath post a four star vs five is that it would probably take a miracle to know what this is for and to use it. But a miracle might still happen.  A few days ago I got up in the middle of the night and caught Max actually playing with the little fur balls that hang from the top. (Something that had nothing to do with my buying this).  So I'm thinking that if he can do that, we might just have the miracle yet. I doubt it will help Mary as she is a Ms Priss and everything new makes her jump. The scratch post came exactly as described and I have no complaints about it what-so-ever.  Maybe with just leaving it in the room may help them want to play with it sometime in the future.  Anytime at all will be bettr than none. I so appreciate all the reviews that Amazon has for each and every product as I know everything about what I'm purchasing - sometimes better than even seeing it in stores.

product_title: LCD Remote Training Shock Collar 100 Levels for 2 Dogs
review_body: This is well worth the money.  You get what you pay for, so don't buy this expecting a really well made product.  You're buying cheap electronics from Asia.  That said, it works as advertised and for the money, it's a great value.  I couldn't find a two collar set up anywhere else for under $100.  My only complaint is that I wish it would vibrate and shock at the same time.  I'm finding that the vibrate function has little to no effect on my dogs at least.

product_title: ZiwiPeak Air-Dried Dog Cuisine
review_body: I finally upgraded to the 11 lb bag after purchasing several 2.2 1b bags. I have two small dogs at home, both are 10 pounds each. I was trying out the raw food diet after doing research online, and while the dogs loved it, I was definitely not a fan of the raw meat and having to wipe everywhere when they were done eating.  Along comes Ziwipeak, and I tested out the different flavors in the smaller portions, ALL of which the two dogs loved.  Here are the marked differences since switching over (previously they were on Merrick dry food, before that was Halo).  Fresh breath, no more doggy odor!  Stools do not smell (or very very faint)  One of the dogs - a Maltese - her tearstains have completely disappeared!!   Glossier coats  More energetic  Etc etc.   So even though this is expensive, in terms of the visible differences you can see in the dogs, I believe it's worth it!

product_title: Mendota Products Slip Lead
review_body: This is a great training lead! My 2 year old rescued chow mix learned to heel on this leash. She is 7 now and has used one anytime we walk where there are other dogs.  It can be adjusted so that she can stay in an attentive and calm attitude.  The nice thick rope (like a rock climbing rope) is easy on the hands. The bright color is easy to see and find in dim light.  On the down side, the leather adjustment tab works by friction and can be difficult to slide to a new position.  Luckily, you don't have to do this very often.  The other disadvantage is that the human being must pay attention!  If adjusted poorly, your pup could choke if it slides too low.  She could also slip out of the collar end if you let the leash go too slack.  Do not leave your dog unattended on this leash!!  This size is for medium to large, muscular dogs.  Mendota uses a smaller diameter rope in leashes for lighter weight pups.

product_title: Mini Sofa Leatherette Pet Bed
review_body: This arrived on time and was welcomed by our pooch \\"Dinky\\" a 7lb Papillon.  Great quality and a super schick style that looks good in any room.  The only problem is that it is a little too small for our pooch to stretch out, therefore, the term \\"Mini Sofa\\" we belived, would be a bigger sitting space than the chairs we looked at.

product_title: GREENIES Original Petite Dog Dental Chews Dog Treats
review_headline: Fat free, good for oral hygene and the very favorite of my dog
review_body: Finding this product on Amazon was like finding an unexpected Christmas present!    Highly recommend by the vet, because of price, I save it for special occasion (always once a day) and, by far, the treat my dog just loves.  True story.  Since I am not able to walk my dog, when the mail lady delivers my mail, she often leaves screen door  open so Scrappy can take off and run for exercize.  She leaves screen door open, whe he has been out running when he should be back, the mail lady hollers \\"Greenie, greenie\\" and this 15# of black fur runs full speed ahead, into the patio and the door inside (which I left open.  A good testiment for a fantastic product!!

product_title: GREENIES PILL POCKETS Chicken Flavor Treats for Dogs
review_headline: Good way to give dogs their pills
review_body: These came very quicky. I have no complaints on the delivery. Most of the pockets were in pieces, so I would just build a pocket around the pill with the pieces. It still tasted good, as my dog didn't notice the difference.Still takes her pills with no problem.

product_title: Hikari Bio-Pure FD Brine Shrimp
review_body: I bought this for my guppy fry and adults and they love it.  It's great that I can crumble it for the little ones, making it easier for them to eat.  This is a large container, so it will last for quite some time.  The package arrived quickly, I was very impressed with the seller.

product_title: Wahl Home Pet Pro-series Complete Pet Clipper Kit #9590-210
review_body:
I have used this multiple times to groom my poodle. The clippers are easy to handle & quiet which is a real blessing b/c my poodle does not like noises. He also is finicky especially around his paws but there isn't a lot of vibration or noise so it is less stress for him - making it less stressful for me.

Some of the reviews mention they get hot. I felt them heat up a little during my first use. I assume it was because I as inexperienced and slow. No problem now.

The cordless feature is priceless!

Very happy with this purchase!

product_title: Virbac C.E.T. Enzymatic Oral Hygiene Chews for Cats
review_body: I am desperate to find a good dental product for one of my cats, and I hoped this one would do the trick. The reviews sounded positive, but you never know until you try it with your cat. The treats are quite large for a cat's mouth, in my opinion - about the size of a wine cork. The idea is that the cat will have to chew it for awhile, and it will do its tartar-control thing. My cat expressed some interest by sniffing and licking it a little, but he didn't attempt to eat it. I then tried cutting the treat into smaller pieces, thinking that if I got him hooked, he would eventually take the full-sized treat and get the full benefit from the chewing. He ate one little piece one time and then never again. My other cat, who has healthy teeth and gums, did eat one full-sized treat once but didn't go for it the next time. So we'll try something else, which is fine. I do wish there had been a smaller bag of these treats available so I could test them out first.

product_title: Natural Balance Dog Food, Lamb Formula, 4 Pound Roll

product_title: The Pet Loo Indoor Yard Pet Toilet 33 " x 33"
review_headline: Long term owner - Read for useful tips!
review_body:
I've owned this potty for about 3 years now, purchased it direct from the manufacturer for twice this price. I know all the ups and downs by this point and would like to share them with you.

History:

Originally we used potty pads in a litter box. They were very expensive. Our male dog would miss half the time and the pee would get underneath the pad (gross). Overall a disaster.

So we bought a PupHead indoor potty. Well the grass that came with it stunk to high heaven! Not only that, it was a nightmare to clean. After that waste of money, we searched for something that would seem to make up for the PupHead's downfalls. We came across the Pet Loo.

The good:

* The design is actually better than a lot of the potties out there that don't have any kind of container to drain the pee into. The drain - container is by far the nicest part of this potty and the only saving grace.
* I'm going to be honest. We don't follow the directions. We do not clean or empty this thing every day. However, we have two dogs and they fill the pee container within 4 days which is nice because that means 4 days of not having to deal with their pee.

The bad:

* When the pee container is at least 1/3 full and the dogs jump off of the potty, the pea will splash into the inside of the potty causing a headache to clean! Bad design.
* The grass is a very horrible design/quality. It has a rubber bottom with a hole here and there so the pee soaks into it and you cannot ever get the smell out after that.
* The grass bottom disintegrates after a month or so of use and wash.
* The pee container gets very gross no matter what you do.
* The plastic diversion grid under the grass becomes stained and gross.

The hard learned tips:

* Buy yourself some Glad Press and Seal plastic wrap and coat the entire pee container. Every time you empty the container, replace the plastic wrap. It keeps the container like new and it's dirt cheap compared to the plastic ones you can buy!
* If you want, you can even coat the pee grid under the grass with plastic wrap (do it like roofing a house).
* Throw away that garbage grass. Go to pupgear corp (the makers of PupHead potty) and purchase the synthetic dog grass. You'll have to cut the grass to fit the potty. IMPORTANT: Make sure it does NOT have the \\"Natural Attractant\\" because it smells WORSE than the PEE!!!
* When you do a full wash of your potty grass (from PupHead), first rinse all of the pee out of it (because it has amonia which is bad to mix with bleach) and once the water runs clear, soak it in water with bleach. The bleach will remove all smell!
* I put the potty up against the wall. I have a male dog that likes to pee against the wall as a target. I bought a sheet of plexy glass from Home Depot. They cut it to my specs. I put one edge in the potty and the other is resting against the wall. Now when he pees against the wall the pee instead hits the plexy glass and this diverts the pee into the potty instead of behind it.

This tip is not a must but might help those with dogs that have aiming problems.

* I bought a water diversion base for a clothes washer and put it under the potty. My male dog misses (they just can't aim to save their lives), sometimes he also thinks he's on the potty just because his front paws are on there and his entire back half is on the floor. If he does miss, instead of going on the floor, it goes into the water basin which is a lot easier to clean than tile (The grout acts like a channel and carries the pee all over the room). This can be found at hardware stores like Lowes or Home Depot.

I hope this helps those of you who have put forth a bit of money on this very imperfect potty system. If it does help or you have more tips, please leave comments.. It keeps the container like new and it's dirt cheap compared to the plastic ones you can buy!

review_headline: Advantage is the best flea treatment bar non.
review_body: My cats had a massive flea infection. It spread to pretty much every corner and nook in the house. I researched probably 10-20 hours of flea remedies including Borax (don't bother), vacuuming (definitely), bathing them (only temporarily effective), fogger (not effective) etc. but Advantage with rigorous vacuuming (not on the cats!) and spraying severe areas with an insecticide (?) product_title: KONG Cat Zoom Groom Brush
review_body: After reading the reviews, I was very excited to use the ZoomGroom on my two cats. Bengals have a very short pelt, no undercoat, and don't shed much in general so it seemed like it would be the perfect alternative to harsh, wire brushes. They tolerated it at first, and it did remove a few loose hairs, but none of them actually stuck to the brush. Messy but not a huge deal, since it was basically still serving its purpose. But now whenever I try to brush them they just bite it relentlessly! I should mention that my cats are not biters, nor are they teething. They are extremely loving and tolerant -- they let me clean their ears/eyes/noses, trim their claws, groom them with a soft-bristle brush, and even brush their teeth. So they must truly, truly hate this thing... or possibly they love it... for chewing. Either way, it's become a rather expensive chew toy and is completely useless as a brush. On top of that, the poor ZoomGroom kitty no longer has ears. :( I'm giving it two stars instead of one, because I'm sure it works better on cats who shed more and have longer hair. But if you have a bengal or very short-haired cat, you might want to try something else.
