I started with the blade that came with the set (it was a smaller size) and it did well on his belly but bogged down as soon as I got to the undercoat. I was glad I listened to another review and got this size blade at the same time! Once I switched blades it buzzed right along. You won't be sorry if you have a hairy beast!!

product_title: HDP Premium Natural Rawhide Bones 6-7"
review_body: Let your puppy naw on these for a month each. They will last for months. Alot less expensive than buying them one at a time at your local pet store. Save, Save, Save! Only complaint I have is it would be nice if they had a beef flavor added. Ever the less, my Lab chews on these rawhide bones alot.

product_title: SportDOG Rechargeable Bark Control Collar
review_body: Occasionally I foster a small rescue dog from a kill shelter. At this time, I happened to have a very sweet girl with my two personal dogs (also small dogs). They all get along very well and have had no history of fighting among themselves or other dogs. They do enjoy the backyard a little too much, meaning, apparently they bark a little much when I'm not home, or so I'm told. I was sent a nice letter from the county that said I could face up to a $1,000 fine or spend 30 days in jail if I couldn't control my \\"nuisance\\" dogs. Nice. Thank you neighbor. Anyway, so I was desperate to find something that worked. I tried the humane route first, the ultrasonic Birdhouse (PetSafe Outdoor Ultrasonic Bark Deterrent) which didn't phase any of them so I had to move onto something stronger. I really HATE shock collars but I was desperate to get them not to bark, so I read reviews, researched and decided on this collar because it stated that it shocks on vibration & sound so that if one barked, the other two wouldn't get penalized. When the collars came, I was surprised as to how large the box is on the collar and the collar itself is so long I could practically use it as a belt!   I had the dogs all wear the collars for a few hours on Saturday and then for the day on Sunday while I was there to observe- no barking. Monday I left them with the collars on and went to work. When I returned, the kitchen was covered in blood and fecal matter and two of my dogs covered in blood and bite wounds. One had burn marks on his neck from the collar and the other was covered in poo (from shock I'm assuming) - she had many more bite wounds than the other. They both were very upset and depressed and I know how lucky I am that I didn't come home to a dead dog. The collars were immediately returned. My assumption of what happened is that one barked when she was playing with dog2, and when she got shocked, she blamed dog2 so that quickly turned into a fight. They have recovered and are fine now butI'll never try this again. If you have more than one dog, be careful with these collars.

product_title: Brake-Fast Dog Food Slow Feed Bowl - Medium Blue
review_body: I've waited several weeks to write this review, but I was ready to give it in the first few days.  WONDERFUL!! This bowl has really helped our dog. Diesel, a 23 pound Dachshund/Jack Russell mix recently (after the addition of a new dog) started gulping his food and throwing it up. It's not that the other dog bothers Diesel or his bowl, but he feels the need to eat as fast he can, resulting in it coming back up almost every day or at the very least, burping for hours afterwards.   The bowls design does exactly what it's supposed to do- makes him slow down and work out how to get the food around the three built in pillars.   The bowl does move as there isn't any \\"no skid\\" rubber on the bottom. This is not a problem for us as we feed our dogs on a rug in the utility room. It doesn't move that much, but when it slides Diesel really has to work at getting the food, often having to step back and go at the bowl from a different side. I think that it moves is part of the solution.   I was initally taken back by the size- it seemed huge, but it is right once you factor in the \\"obstructive\\" pillars taking up space. Any smaller and it would be impossible for him to get at the food.   The bowl is well made, smooth so it wont irritate your dog and easily washed out.  Diesel's eating has slowed dramatically!

product_title: Tripett Grain-Free All Natural Dog Food, 13 oz cans, Pack of 12
review_body: My dogs love this dog food supplement even though it smells anything but good to me.  A couple of spoonfuls will make the dry dog food go down. The cans open easily and it stays fresh in the fridge for two- three days. It is not cheap, but it is worth the expense to see the otherwise finicky dogs enjoy their meals and get the right nutrition.

product_title: Guardian Gear Cotton Web Dog Training Lead 6'x5/8", Black
review_body: This lead is great!  It gives my dog plenty of distance to run ahead and come back.  I'm still learning how to manage the amount - keep getting tangled.  He is super strong so things happen quickly but we're coming along.

product_title: Dean and Tyler Nocturne Dog Leash, Black 6-Feet by 1/2-Inch Width With Solid Brass Hardware.
review_body: Love this leash! It has the braided ends instead of metal brackets. Great for training and everyday use. Easy on my hands unlike nylon leashes. I've been using this for my German Shepherd since he was a puppy. Spent the money to buy a new one after a stray Pit chewed through my last one. Definitely worth the money and it's even priced decently compared to others. Will definitely be keeping my business with these folks.

product_title: Chlorhexidine Solution gallon
review_body:
I have been using chlohexidine based products for my dogs for a little bit over a year now. This product is simply amazing for use as an anti-bacterial and anti-fungal.
I used the flush for post-surgery wound cleaning, to treat a puppy's stomache acne, and to treat/clean paw pads.
I used the spray to treat a lab's reoccurring skin problems. Dogs will lick and scratch a spot open. This product works great to treat those spots. The spray is also good for paw pads, but I found I get quicker and better coverage with the flush.
I bought another brand here on Amazon. This was the first time I bought the gallon bottle. With this, I've been able to make my own flush and refill the spray bottle, following the diluting directions of 2 tsp per gallon. For the price of the flush and spray, I was able to buy an entire gallon. I've already made two containers of flush and one spray bottle, and it barely made a dent in the gallon. Even though the shipping on this product is higher than one would want, the overall value can't be beat.
I added a cup of it to the lab's bathwater and let him soak, further treating his skin condition.
I am thinking I can add some of this to the dog's shampoo, making my own chlorhexidine based shampoo for the skin conditions. Vet Solutions is my favorite shampoo and does a good job on it's own. Can it not be better with chlorhexidine for better control of skin afflictions? I have to research if there may be problems with mixing ingredients. The amount added would be minimal. If I go that route, I will update this review with the results. Even if not, I still can use as a rinse and soak.
I have not used this as a dental product. If I do, I will update this review with the results.

In summary, get a gallon of this, read all the various uses the reviewers have noted, and reap the benefits and savings.en if not, I still can use as a rinse and soak. I have not used this as a dental product. If I do, I will update this review with the results. In summary, get a gallon of this, read all the various uses the reviewers have noted, and reap the benefits and savings.

product_title: ThunderShirt Classic Dog Anxiety Jacket
review_headline: It  is amazing how well this works!
review_body: Our dentist told us about this because we have an extremely storm/fireworks phobic miniature schnauzer.  Our poor baby runs around the room panting and shaking looking for a space to feel safe whenever there is a storm, fireworks or even high winds.  She wants to be held, but can't stay in one place.  We had an unexpected storm right after the shirt came in the mail and we didn't have time to follow the \\"get to know the shirt\\" suggestions.  We just put it on her and hoped for the best.  It was amazing the result.  She just jumped into my lap and waited quietly for the storm to end.  She quivered occasionally and looked unhappy, but NOTHING like her normal reaction.  She even went to sleep before the storm completely ended.  The shirt is a little large for her and we have ordered an extra small for her.  We gave the small to our daughter for her cocker spaniel who suffers from car anxiety.  This shirt is SO worth the money and we are very happy to have found this.

product_title: Timex Ironman 30 Lap Digital Resin Quartz Ladies Watch T5K515E4
review_body: I bought one of these after reading many good things about them. I got it, placed it in the tank, set it up on wave mode where it worked great for about 45 days. Then it overheated and started making a deep violent grinding noise. I tried dealing with EcoTech but they wanted more money for the replacement head and I politely told them to fornicate themselves with a sharp stick, so I took this $235.00 device and threw it in the garbage and went and bought a 50 dollar Hydor that still works to this day. I probably just got a defective one. Story of my life. Long story short...they are cool pumps but I would never buy another one.

product_title: Pet Store Suede Soft Pet Couch
review_body: I purchased this for my Jack Russell. I realize the measurements were listed, but a casual look at the picture made me think it would accomodate my small dog. My mistake. Boy was I wrong!   The dog was cramped and confined.  I love the long drape over the front of the cushion, the bolsters are small but firm, stays in place and is a good color.   I kept it because my small cat liked it and it fit in a chair well, and the cost was not too bad.  All in all; fairly nice product, but don't be fooled by the size/picture, it is small.

product_title: Carefresh Ultra Pet Bedding 50 LITER
review_body: I always purchase my carefresh pet bedding for my bunny from this seller. They are much less expensive than what I've seen in stores and online, and their shipping is SUPER FAST. I typically order this the day before I need it and it's at my house the very next day! Sometimes they also give me free cat treat samples in the pet bedding too! Very satisfied!

product_title: Explorer Double Fleece Reflective Dog Coat by Kakadu Pet
review_body: This coat was absolutely perfect except it was not as long as I would have hoped and I needed to add a little extra strip to the velcro strap underneath, that was my fault however, but after adding the additional piece the jacket is great and I really like how it is reflective because now with it getting darker earlier, and earlier it works well when I take my dogs out at night. Great product, just check your measurements mine was a little small but that was my own fault.

product_title: Feline Furniture Feral Cat House - Green
review_headline: Give your outside cat a way out of the weather
review_body: All over the United States right now, the weather is just going crazy. Snow arriving early, freezing rain and hail, blustery winds and this was all before Halloween! I live in Oregon and have the privilege of working with feral and stray cats. It is always a concern when the weather starts getting colder about what to do for the cats. One of the most effective ways that I have found to help these cats survive the cold, is with felinefurniture.com's feral cat house.     What it has that other cat houses don't is a way to make a porch of sorts, by moving the plastic back a ways from the stand, you can allow your cat to stick his head out of the doorway without getting wet. Two entry ways exist to give the cat a chance to escape should a predator show up at the front door, kitty can quickly slide out the back.    If you pile some straw inside the house then your cat has extra insulation to help keep him warm, but as weather tight and waterproof as it is made already- this isn't really necessary.    I have two of these homes, one on top of the Jacuzzi outside as it also proves an additional protection against our slamming rainstorms. One, in the bedroom and I say in the bedroom because I have two feral kitties hiding under the bed currently and putting this house out in the open has coaxed them out of hiding weeks before I would expect they would come out.    The price is reasonable, the unit is made in the U.S. and completely easy to clean and maintain. It comes fully assembled, nothing needed to construct it except to slide it out of the box.    5 Paws Way Up for [...] and their snug feral cat houses-

product_title: Large, KeepSafe Break-Away Collar (Deep Purple , 1'w, adjustable 18'-28' )
review_body: My Rottweilers play rough and this collar is a must have! All three of mine have only these collars from the time I got them as puppies.

product_title: Neater Feeder Deluxe Cat (All Colors) - Mess Proof Elevated Bowls, No Tip Non Slip, Stainless Steel Cat Food and Water Dish Stand
review_headline: Dexter and the Traveling Water Dish
review_body: Our cat Dexter decided that he needed to drag his water bowl about 3 feet away from its normal spot.  Nothing could dissuade him from this - we used a bowl with a rubber grip around the bottom combined with some 'grippy' shelf liner and he still managed to move it.  Plus, not having thumbs, his efforts resulted in a slip-n-slide of water from the point of origin to the 'better' location.  This system is large enough that he can't move it more than a few inches and has a reservoir to contain any spills, so Dexter has given up on his former hobby of water bowl relocation in favor of just yelling at us.  Priceless.

product_title: PetSafe ScatMat Indoor Pet Training Mat for Dogs and Cats, Pet Proof Your Home
review_body:
Pros: Easy to use. Just unroll, place, turn on. Doesn't keep much of a \\"memory\\" when rolled or loosely folded. Can use battery or AC adapter.

Cons: Doesn't quite fit my couches full length or seat depth. To remedy this I just use pillows along the back and sides to take up room. Need multiple scatmats to cover all \\"sittable\\" surfaces such as the arms and the back of the couch and they aren't exactly cheap.

The good news is, they are doing their job. The cats don't seem to be getting on the couch while we're out of the house. There's a lot less cat fur on the couch. They also are more deterred from getting on the couch while we're on them ourselves. Whether or not this is a permanent thing or if they'll just jump up on the couch when they notice the mats aren't there is still left to be seen. We've had them on about a month now and haven't removed them while we were away from the house.

product_title: Eheim Battery Operated Auto Fish Feeder
review_headline: Solid feeder, solid price, solid results.
review_body:
As has been mentioned in other reviews, the programming of the device isn't \\"simple\\" but if you read the booklet and envision the steps it actually makes a lot of sense. I think a lot of people get thrown off by the use of \\"army\\" time over conventional 12-hour timekeeping.

With regard to the feeding itself, the access door which allows food to escape upon the unit's rotation is a bit flimsy but if you need it to hold tight to a specific setting, a small piece of tape will work perfectly. I feed my fish flake food and at times the flakes can be very large - upon testing the feeder I saw that they would block the opening which may hinder feeding - so if you use flakes, make sure to break them up into smaller pieces.

Also, as I mentioned, it would be wise of you to TEST the feeding before leaving the fish to the mercy of the feeder - you'll get an idea of how it works, what they'll get for food, and you'll know that the feeder works. I also didn't bother to use the batteries that came with the feeder since they were generic and who knows how much of a charge they might have had - I replaced them with fresh Duracells.

product_title: Panther Vision Pup PowerCap Men's 100% Cotton Twill LED Lighted Cap
review_body: The switch feels substantial and the LEDs are bright.  We use them camping and they do just what is wanted.  The CR2032 lithium batteries (2) last a long time and replacements can be bought in quantity for a reasonable price now.  We don't know when they will quit they just keep going and going......  The lights point down at an angle that is perfect for walking and reading.  Most hat-brim lights we have tried shine in others faces- not a polite thing and these don't.  Oh... the hats are a nice twill and fit well.  The battery is in the side of the band and don't bother the feel or fit.  The supplier had them to us quickly.

product_title: Dogbed4less Orthopedic Memory Foam Dog Bed for Small, Medium to Large Pet, Waterproof Internal Cover with Durable Blue Denim Cover and Extra Bonus External Case - 7 Sizes
review_headline: Not worth the Money or for Puppies
review_body: Bed looks amazing with pics and all and when we received the box with the foam and denim cover.  Thought wow this is perfect.  Actually this bed is better for adult dogs not for Large Breed puppies or any puppies at that matter.  Zipper is cheap and would not close the two sides together, resulting in our puppy to eat the plastic cover over the so called \\"memory foam\\"  and eat and pull the foam to pieces.

product_title: Merry Products Cage with Crate Cover Set
review_body: Being a neat freak and a first time dog owner...I searched the web knowing three things..I needed a large dog crate..I wanted my dog in the living room for social  reasons (after reading & reading  ...the 3rd being it was very important to me it matched my home. \\"The Hurricane\\" a.k.a Katrina & I both love this product. It grows with her & not an eyesore to me.

product_title: Feeding Tube #3.5
review_body: As a wildlife rehabilitator, I believe these tubes are perfect to feed baby Opossums less than 60 grams of weight.

product_title: Kaytee Take Me Travel Carrier, Small
review_body: I bought two of these to transport my pet birds on a transcontinental flight. The carrier comes with a perch, which is perfect for my parakeets. The wire spacings are small enough that my birds are safe in the cage (small birds can get their head stuck between the wires if the spacing is not narrow enough). Two of these carriers fit very well side by side in an airline-approved pet carrier (the clam shell type), which fit under the seat on a plane. The TSA inspected these cages by hand, did not need to take the birds out, and the whole security check process took only 5 minutes! I was also able to use the feeders I normally use that clip on to the horizontal wires securely. I'm very satisfied with this purchase. It's a simple cage, easy to assemble, and has just the right amount of space for a small pet. Both my birds arrived at the destination safe and sound after this 12-hour journey (first in a car then on the plane then in a car again).

product_title: Zoe Dental Chew Treats
review_headline: Joy-Joy Says Order Some More Please!!!!
review_body: I have a 9 month old Boxer/Pit, she is an aggressive chewer.  These bones crumble some but, she vacuumed up the bit -n- pieces quickly; leaving nothing behind.  She enjoyed these bones but devoured them in less than 10 minutes.  The only thing negative was the smell - they are the strongest smelling treats she has encountered.

product_title: Kaytee Koi's Choice Premium Fish Food
review_headline: Good fish food at a good price
review_body: This is good fish food for a really good price. My koi fishes like the food; however, 10 pound can feed my koi fishes months, maybe years...

product_title: Eye Envy NR Solution Cat 16 oz
review_body: I tried other brands before; but only Eye Envy works for my two White Persians. I am very happy now.

product_title: Mission Dog Clothing by Kakadu Pet, XX-Small, 8", Green
review_body: Just right for my baby dog. He look so cute. People stop me to look at him and tell me how cute is my dog.

product_title: TetraMin Tropical Flakes
review_body: I use this for my goldfish betta (passed) guppies (passed) in one tank. they shared it and they couldnt get enough, my turtle also in the same tank love it. But walmart has this same can for 11 dollars!

product_title: Kaytee Rabbit Hay Buffet Feeder with Snap-Lock Lid (Colors May Vary)
review_body:
Got this for my Chinchilla because he LOVES his hay and I hate cleaning it up! First thing to note is how large this is, really too big for my Chinchilla, but he likes to jump on the top 'lid' so I kept it. However, hay is just messy no matter what, stuffing it in there still caused a mess on my counter top. Also, it's like a basket, BOTH sides have bars, is not a flat covered side with the other just having the bars.
He seems to do well getting his hay out so no problem there, he is smaller then a Rabbit and also uses his 'hands' to help in pulling it out. So a larger animal (again like a Rabbit) I could see having an issue. Lastly, the 'snap lid' isn't much of a snap. It kept popping open when I stuffed it with hay and took a few adjustments to keep it in place. But no problems with it since I put in the cage and also it hangs just fine. So no problems with it attaching either. There are 'hooks' on both sides so you have lots of option in where to place it.
I think my Chinchilla is happier with it than I am :) So he can keep it and if it tears up I will just find something else, it won't break the bank. lol.

product_title: Marina Air Pump
review_body: Just got this air pump and set it up in my Fluval Edge. I wanted an air pump from a reputable manufacturer and (most importantly) that was quiet as can be. This air pump by Hagen fits the bill, especially on the quiet arena. My other aquarium is using a Tetra Whisper 10 air pump. I thought that was as silent as they come, that is until now. But hearing this Hagen Marina 75 in action, my Tetra Whisper is far from being a \\"whisper\\" and more like a lawnmower by relative comparison. Okay, I'm exaggerating a bit, but honestly, the Marina 75 is quiet and puts the Tetra Whisper to shame.

product_title: Roll n Clean Self Cleaning Litter Box
review_headline: Best Investment for my Pets I Ever Made!
review_body:
This box is simply put, the best thing I've ever owned. It works exactly as described with little to no fuss, and keeps my hands out of the litter box, saves my back from being bent over as much, and my cats love it!

Before this box, cleaning the litter box was always a chore, and if someone was house sitting for me I always felt as if it was too much to ask to have them clean the litter box out for me. Now, I literally have the box cleaned out within 2 minutes, and my house sitter (usually my sister) never complains about cleaning it. She thought it was just as cool as I do!

I do have the large size, green, and use it with two cats.

I have not found a problem with anything sticking to the grate inside, however once in a while when rolling it over, a piece of \\"kitty buried treasure\\" falls behind the tray, and you have to lean the box forward to get it out. (I've had this since May and have had it happen only twice).

I do see where people think that the clips aren't as sturdy as they could be; they are made out of plastic is all, but so far mine as holding up, and I don't think it will be a problem to zip tie them or something similar if I ever did have one or more break up.

Overall, I highly recommend it, and I will probably be sending this to friends and families with cats for Christmas gifts!

product_title: Brindle 4 Inch Solid Memory Foam Orthopedic Dog Bed - Removable Velour Cover with Waterproof Liner
review_body: I have been shopping in stores and on line for a new dog bed for my 16 year old, medium sized dog.  I wanted an orthopedic/memory foam type, but couldn't believe the prices they wanted for them!  I was excited when I came across the Brindle bed, but assumed it had to be too good to be true.  Happy to report I was wrong!!  Loki loves his new bed and I can see the support and extra padding are just what his old bones were needing.  The color of the velour type cover is a light brown/tan. It was tough to tell from the ad.  Lucky for us his fur matches it perfectly!  Thanks again for the great product at a great price!

product_title: Muttluks Red Reversible Dog Snowsuit
review_body: Was in Chicago during the blizzard in February, 2011.  Came up from Florida and brought my puppy.  He had never seen snow or experienced weather below 60 degrees.  I put the snowsuit on him and was able to take him for a nice, long walk in -10 degree weather.  He seemed impervious to the wind and cold.  It was very easy to put on because it closes up with velcro.  It stayed secure during our walks.  It also washes nicely.  He didn't seem to mind wearing the snowsuit.  He wore the yellow side at night so he was more visible.  Nice product!  A little pricey but worth it to keep pets warm and safe during super-cold weather.

product_title: Ferrera Farms 6 Inch Regular Bully Stick, 7-Count bag (Pack of 2)
review_body: I bought these a few weeks ago for my dogs because buying them at the big box pet store was getting too expensive.  I paid about $12 for 14 sticks, two pouches of 7 sticks each.  Today I tried to reorder them and the cost is now $60????   Are you kidding me?   Although my dogs loved them, buying these again at this price would be ridiculous. As for the product itself, my dogs enjoyed them as much as the other brands.  They were all decent size, some a little thinner than others but all still ok.  Even my power chewer rescue dog, who can shred most dog toys in less than 30 seconds, spent a few hours contentedly chewing one of these.  Yes they are smelly, (but think about what they are...of course dehydrated bull parts are going to smell), but they are no worse than any other brand my dogs have tried.   I'm hoping the price increase is a mistake.

product_title: Nebo Dog Toy
review_headline: MUCH more durable than the Beba toy
review_body: I received this toy as a replacement for the Beba toy.  The DuraDoggie company was true to their guarantee and kindly took back the Beba toy my dog destroyed and sent me a new one.  The gentleman stated that this one would be more durable, and he was right.  My dog plays with this for up to an hour at a time, trying to get the treats out and it's withstood her efforts to destroy it.  The openings are flexible enough for me to stick treats inside, but then will retract back for their safe keeping. It keeps my dog busy for a long time! Definitely recommend for dogs who are treat-motivated thinkers who enjoy a good challenge

product_title: Our Pets Company AS-4116896-2 (Pack of 2)  Cosmic Alpine Cat Scratcher Toy
review_headline: Didn't Think It Would Work But My Lazy Cat Actually Uses It! But, Not Like I Thought She Would.
review_body:
My cat is almost 7 years old and over the last couple years she has really lost that kitten energy and gained weight. When she does play it's with string-like and small soft plush toys. She NEVER plays with hard toys and she RUNS AWAY from toys that make noise.

That being said, I wanted a toy that was inexpensive, provided mental stimulation, got her moving even if I could not be there because I work and travel a lot. I saw the Go Cat Go Play-N-Treat at one of the big box stores and thought, for the price, I would give it a try.

I was pretty skeptical but I am pleasantly surprised by the results. It took a little while for my cat to realize there was food in it and that she has to move it in order for food to come out but once she made the association she loves it!

Just a couple recommendations and notes on how to use it:

1. Avoid larger treats because they get stuck.
2. Filling it 50-75% the way full is best. If you only place a couple treats inside, they will come out quickly. Every time my cat rolls the ball 3-6 pieces of food come out.
3. Because of #2 above, I advise against using actual treats because of calories and cost. Instead I fill the ball with my cats dry food.
4. I wouldn't call this a high-speed, high-action toy. Instead my cat nudges it with her nose and then stops to eat the treats that fall out before nudging it again. If you had visions of your cat running all around, chasing the ball, just understand that was not my experience. It might be different if you have a younger/more active cat or multiple cats.

Hope that helps you make a decision!

product_title: The Wild Thing 227 Swarovski Crystals Jewelled Python Print Leather Dog Collar and Leash Set - Pink Python
review_body: I initially loved, loved, loved this collar and lead. But after a few months, the crystals began to fall out of the collar and bone that's on the collar. While I loved the \\"diva\\" look, it's now starting to look like skid row....

product_title: Newman's Own Adult Dog Food Formula
review_body: It's all organic and it's on PETA's (People for the Ethical Treatment of Animals) list of \\"CRUELTY-FREE\\" brands.  Did you know that the leading brands of dog foods conduct horrible and cruel tests on laboratory dogs?  Plus it is delivered to my door and no shipping charge (Super Saver Shipping), and costs less than the product I used to buy, saving me time and money. Oh yeah, and my dogs love it!  [[ASIN:B00139TT72 Newman's Own Organics Adult Dog Food Formula, 12.5-Pound Bag]]

product_title: Nature's Miracle Stain & Odor Remover, Orange Oxy, Trigger Spray
review_body: I foster dogs through a local rescue and many of them are not housetrained. So I spend a lot of time cleaning pet stains. This is the best one out there! Won't stain your carpet and gets the mess out. Wonderful!!!

product_title: Ware Manufacturing Chew Proof High Rise Pet Cage for Small Pets
review_headline: Great way to add space for your critter!
review_body:
After reading some of the prior reviews, I was a little concerned about the quality of this product, but I have to say, it met and exceeded my expectations, especially for the very reasonable price! Our hamster has been desperately trying to escape her 10 gallon glass aquarium home - too small and cramped. But we did NOT want one of the plastic homes. Prior experience tells me that they become chew toys and end up with sharp edges and holes in the walls. Also didn't want to spend tons of money on a huge new cage.

Our product came exactly as pictured. I wonder if prior reviewers were expecting it to come with the 10 gallon aquarium part - it does not, and the description makes that very clear. You need to buy the glass aquarium separately, and they are very cheap at most pet stores. It was very easy to assemble, less than five minutes. We did not need zip ties or any other supplemental wiring or connectors. I do have to note that it does not fit perfectly across the top of our base aquarium, but with the springloaded clips, it is perfectly secure and we have no problems with it staying in place.

The layout does make it very difficult to access the bottom level of the cage without removing the entire top, but if you keep the food bowl in the \\"penthouse\\" then you only have to remove the top for cleanings. The hamster is much happier with the additional space and loves exploring.

All in all, we are extremely pleased with this product. It does exactly what we bought it to do, it works exactly as intended, and the price was much better than comparable products. I recommend it for your hamster or gerbil friends!

product_title: Wellness Sliced Canned Cuts Chicken Adult Canned Cat Food, 3 Oz(Pack of 24)
review_headline: It's Hard to Do Better than Wellness
review_body:
Wellness is among the best cat foods out there. It is grain-free and it has ingredients of high quality. There are no meat by-products. My only caveat is that Wellness' products with fish are not so good. Quite frankly, cats don't eat fish in the wild, so their digestive systems are not designed for consumption of fish. That being said, this is a fantastic specific product. The meat is fresh, and I know my cat loves it. I adopted my cat (he is five), and within weeks his coat was softer, the colors more vivid and I began seeing markings and colors I never saw before.

On another note, I can't help but take a dig at one of the worst, if not THE worst, foods out there...Science Diet. Take a read on the ingredients. In doing so, you will the natural, very high grade, pure ingredients of Wellness contrasted with the low grade, artificial, even mysterious ingredients of Science Diet food. review_body: I recently purchased this cage for my 2 little guinea pigs. I did a lot of research on cages and types of bedding to use decided to go with this cage. I put some puppy pads in the bottom (to protect the liner as I saw people say it would stain), then newspaper, then a towel followed by the fleece(clamped to the sides with office paper clamps). I always sweep up their droppings daily when I give them fresh food, water, vitamins, and a snack. I just cleaned the cage completely for the first time and it was easier than I expected and took about 30mins that including I had to cut a new fleece to fit the cage. I didn't have to change the puppy pads as nothing soaked through that far. Also, instead of putting a different bedding in the small side for them use as a bathroom, I decided to just put their food, timothy hay, and water in that area for their feeding room. I read that most piggies don't really use the bathroom in an assigned designated area so I figured it would make better use of that space. It also contains their mess from the timothy hay to a small area. Also, to make clean up easier lay a small piece of fleece over the food area that way i can just take it out side and shake it out each evening instead of trying sweep it up(which is very difficult and time consuming). Now they have the whole other area of the cage for running and playing. Also they are loving their cage as they are always popcorning around and they love to run back and forth over the ramp. I first put fleece on the ramp by just tucking it under the edges bc I thought with it being slippery they may not want to go to the other room as I really didn't want to mess it up with glueor anything but they kept getting it off track so I just took it out and now it doesn't seem to bother them as they still run back and forth all the time. product_title: Wahl Home Pet Pro-series Complete Pet Clipper Kit #9590-210
review_headline: Excellent Product - I have a Great Pyrenees
review_body: This is a great product and exceeded all expectations by far.      When summer gets rolling Grt Pry's need to be clipped more than once and it's not just expensive but time consuming going to the groomers.  So when I saw a friend buy some clippers and groom her dog (she also has a Pyr) it gave me the confidence to give it a try.  I borrowed her Andis 60105 12-Piece grooming kit (initially this is what I was going to buy), it did the job (it's a solid product) but I wasn't satified with the quality of the cut because it streaked and no matter how hard I tried (I even oiled the blades), the latter couldn't be avoided.  Also, my dog's hair thickness varies so it would struggle with the finer hairs which made clipping her underside difficult and it struggled in dense areas.  My pup was left with a bumpy coat (as well as the streaks).    One of the reviewers for the Wahl 9590-210 mentioned Bernese Mountain dogs and raved about it, hence I decided to buy it.  After my first trimming the conclusion is; there is no comparison between the two products, the Wahl is superior by leaps and bounds.  You know, comparing the Wahl to the Andis doesn't do it justice, the Wahl does an excellent job period.    Initially, when I opened the package the Wahl kit didn't have the quality feel of the Andis product.  The case felt a little thinner (it's still very durable), the clipper attachments have flexible teeth, the blades aren't shiney etc..  I couldn't have been more deceived and wouldn't be surprised if the feel of other products could be a gimmick to make up for key components.    I did the initial charge as per instructions then set to it.  The clippers rocked; going from thin to thick hair or vice versa was almost seamless and minimal bumpiness, there was no streaking, there was still plenty of charge when I finished, the device is light (for clippers), it's quiet (for clippers), they didn't get hot, it didn't clog or struggle, the attachments were great (for my use the flexible teeth are the way to go as they don't dig), the Wahl trimmed her underside/tail/tip of the ears, it's so good I could even do some fine tuning, my dog seemed happier because I could trim in one sweep with a smooth motion (last time I had to press and go back & forth) and the flexibility from no cable means you don't tie-up your puppy or run out of cable when they decide there's something more intersting going on a few feet away.  She looks great, plus we were done in about 25-30mins.     The components are solid such as the comb (OK), scissors (great), mirror (OK), attachments (great) and there's oil.    I'm really happy with this purchase.

product_title: Blue Dog Bakery Natural Low Fat Dog Treats
review_body:
I have two boxers - a 60lb highly food motivated male who literally drools when I reach for these \\"cookies\\" and a 45lb finicky princess who thoroughly inspects anything offered to her before eating it (or not). These Blue Dog Bakery Treats are hands down, the best dog biscuits I have found... And both of my dogs LOVE them.

Even though both dogs are on grain free diets, I make Blue Dog treats the one exception because of the clean, all natural ingredients. product_title: LitterMaid LME5500 Automatic Litter Box
review_headline: Absolutely Horrible - Should be zero stars
review_body: If you don't mind scooping daily and possibly cleaning a litter box every week then go ahead and purchase this.  If you want something that actually works pick another brand.  I just threw my 2nd of the Littermaid boxes in the trash.  It just doesn't work as I expected and when something breaks you cannot buy replacement parts from the company.  Let me give you my experience with it and you'll understand my frustration.    You put about 8-10lbs. of litter in the pan and the litter needs to be level at all times or the rake has problems.  I couldn't get my cat to understand that his digging created mounds that the rake would have problems with later.  So the cat buries his/her waste and this creates an enormous drag on the system when the rakes tries to sift thru the litter.  If your cat urinates in the litter and the litter level is too low the clay in the litter may cause it to adhere to the bottom of the pan.  As the rake comes thru it hits the clumps and if it can't pull thru it will back up and try again, up to 5 times.  If unsuccessful the unit will stop trying and the indicator light will flash.  There is nothing more frustrating than coming home after a long day and seeing that yellow light flashing and knowing I have to clean a litter box before going to bed.  If the cat doesn't bury the deposit deep enough or the poo is too soft the rake may tear thru the waste and you will have a cat-poop coated rake and on reverse the rake will leave the \\"bits and pieces\\" throughout the litter.  Another annoyance is the rake pulling the litter to the back of the unit as it travels back.  When too much litter is behind the rake it can't reset which causes an error fault and the owner to again dig in the pan.  While the noise level isn't that bad it gets annoying when its doing the back-and-forth thing when it gets stuck. Sometimes you can hear the gear slipping and you know it won't be long before the unit jams or breaks.  I tried all the \\"fixes\\" - I sprayed the rake withPAM, I sprayed the litter pan with PAM to prevent the urine sticking problem.  Nothing worked for more than 2-3 days.  I purchased the bagging system to cut down on the number of deposit boxes we used. We tried the \\"Rake-Saver\\" - what a joke, my cat pooped on it.  Ultimately it was the cheap construction that made me say enough.  I dropped the ramp one day while cleaning it and it broke.  Like I said in the beginning, not being able to purchase replacement parts is just stupid.  Maybe my expectations were too great, when you say \\"automatic\\" to me that means I don't have to think about it everyday.  If I come home late or skip a day of checking, the litter box will be ok.  Not so with this unit.  Farewell Littermaid.  I went with the Litter Robot and will do a review on it after a month of use.

review_body: Our dogs absolutely love these sticks, but it did take a little while for them to warm up to them. Once they figured out that they were edible they became addicted to them.

review_body: We moved into our house a few weeks ago.  Apparently, the previous owners chose not to take their kitty with them when they moved, and we would often see her roaming around the neighborhood.    We live in the Upper Midwest, and it can get very cold.  Once the temps began falling at night, she began to show up at the door regularly, wanting in.  We have bad allergies in our family, so that just couldn't happen.  We called the local rescue centers, and they weren't accepting any more cats.  We decided to make her as comfy as possible on our back deck.  It it sheltered from the North wind by our house.  Prior to this heated pad, Kitty was sleeping on old towels we put out for her, and she would wake early in the morning at paw at the door for her breakfast (yes, we've been feeding her, too).  With this heated pad, we awake to her sleeping soundly, curled up, with her head tucked under her paw to help keep her little ears warm, too.  She is in no rush to get up now!  P.S. Her new outdoor kitty house arrived today!  Between the heated pad and the kitty house maybe she'll keep warm and have a chance for more than *just* survival.

product_title: Hill's Science Diet Adult 7+ Active Longevity Original Dry Cat Food
review_body: We have five cats - one an elderly cat of 15 years, the other four in the 9-11 year range.  The oldest cat was diagnosed a couple of months ago with the beginning stages of chronic kidney disease.  His numbers didn't warrant being on prescription food yet, but we needed to start paying attention to things like protein and phosphorus levels in his food.  Because we have five cats, and some of them are nibblers eating four or five nuggets at a time, we decided to switch them all to an acceptable food for the oldest, so we picked the active longevity because it specifically mentioned kidney support and calories appropriate for less active older cats.      Since we made the switch 6 weeks ago, all of the cats have gained weight.  This was fine for the little old guy as he was a bit underweight; not good for the rest of them.  Our other male went from a slightly chunky 18.5 lbs to an obese 21.25 lbs - almost three pounds in 6 weeks!  The 3 females gained between 1.5 to 2 pounds each.  We noticed them making a lot more visits to the food bowl, like they couldn't seem to get full.  We also saw a lessening of coat quality - lots of shedding even though they are brushed regularly (including with a furminator) and one developed bad dandruff.  The stools developed a really bad odor, although I do have to say nobody developed diarrhea which I am grateful for.  Most worrisome was that the lab results on the old guy came back with some of the kidney values of concern having worsened.      I am very disgusted with Science Diet - they are actively fooling the public with the nutritional claims on the bags. One of the sites I researched on for chronic renal failure has charts detailing the nutritional breakdown of most of the various foods available.  If you compare the various Science diet formulae that have different health claims on them - the nutritional values for the components listed are all within a tenth of a point or two.  Basically from the nutritional analysis it appearsthat they are  the same base formula with maybe a slight difference in a vitamin or additive.  With other brands, such as innova or royal canin, there appears to be an actual difference between the different formulae.      Now to deal with the weight gain, as well as the other problems we noted, we are switching foods again.  This time we are trying royal canin indoor mature.  Wish us luck.

product_title: Adams Flea & Tick Mist with Pyrethrin, 32-ounce
review_headline: Not a good option for a larger dog
review_body: I got this product because my dog is allergic to *everything* and I wanted to be able to test a small amount without committing to a full application. I know that lots of animals do have sensitivities to flea and tick products (it's not easy to kill fleas, so yeah, the ingredients in most of the products are pretty harsh), and this has similar active ingredients to leading flea and tick treatments, making it a good test.    After a test (and waiting a couple of days to make sure there were no adverse reactions), I tried a full application. The dosage information for cats and smaller dogs is fairly clear (1-2 sprays per pound the animal weighs), but for larger dogs it's very vague (spray until damp, not saturated). I have a 98 pound German Shepherd who had fleas before application. I sprayed him with the flea and tick mist to the point where I would have called him thoroughly damp. I gave it about a week to give the spray a chance to work, and still found fleas when I checked. Figuring there's a lot of room for interpretation in the word \\"damp\\", I sprayed him again more thoroughly. That was about a week ago and I just found more fleas. It wasn't a bad infestation to start with--I was hoping to nip it in the bud--and at least it doesn't appear to have gotten any worse...    The dog doesn't care much for the spray part (strange sound, then sudden cold wetness? I can't blame him) and hates the smell (alcohol and chemicals--again, can't blame him) even though it dissipates after an hour or so). He runs away when he sees the bottle, and tries to get away throughout the application process. With a big dog, it's just not practical. And, since he still has fleas, it's probably also not the best application method for large dogs.    I'll keep using it on the cats, though. They didn't have fleas before (despite living with a dog who does), still don't have fleas, and are small enough that application is quick and straightforward. (disclaimer: my cats are fairly tolerant and don't scratch or bite even when I give them baths. Experiences with less tolerant cats could be painful--this stuff stings if you get it in cuts)

product_title: Red Sea Nano Aquarium Filter
review_headline: Just what I wanted for my bettas
review_body: I am using 4 of these filters, one on each side of two divided 10 gallon tanks, and so far everything seems like it will be fine (tanks are currently cycling).  Construction is solid, and it's a nice little HOB filter, especially for the price.  I like that there is room in the chamber for whatever additional (or replacement) filter media one wants to use.  One of the 4 did have a slight leak (more of a drip) from the back of the housing, which I fixed with super glue and aquarium silicone rather than return it, as this is a common problem with filters.  No leaks since, and they've been running at full flow for 3+ weeks.  They're pretty quiet - go check out some of the Youtube videos where product is in use, you'll see that they are not loud or obnoxious at all.  Although rated for small aquariums (up to 3 gallons), I found on a betta forum that these are perfect for bettas in larger environments as the flow is adjustable, and as one user indicated, at full flow each of these filters is capable of handling a full 5 gallons without being \\"too much\\" for a betta.  This seems to be the case: the flow is quite strong while all the way on, and I'll probably turn them down once the bettas are housed in the tanks after cycling, since 2 bettas per 10 gallons is a bit understocked and shouldn't require heavy filtration anyhow.   If using in a betta tank/bowl smaller than 5 gallons, I would definitely use at a lower setting, maybe half flow. Also, replacement pads are only available online from what I've found, so get a pack of them when you order the filter(s) so you're not waiting around when it comes time to rinse/swap out your media.

product_title: Thomas Laboratories Organic Diatomaceous Earth Powder, 3-Pound
review_headline: Got rid of the bed bugs
review_body: I have had 2 bed bug situations, my first one was over 3 years ago living in an apartment here in Denver. I moved in with my family and they came with me. My mom bought this miracle product as we didn't have enough money to cover a professional. Between this and steaming all items in my room (and neem oil, taping around the bed, etc...) we got rid of them. My mom recently replaced the carpet in my old room and found the dead ones under the carpet. Gross. A couple of years ago my husband and I went to a concert in Boulder and I woke up with a huge insanely itchy bite on my face. I knew then and there it was a bed bug. I looked, and it was in my clothing that I luckily left in the bathroom... We lived in an apartment that took care of bug issues so after washing all of our clothes in piping hot water and having them spray I didn't get another bite. Now that I own a home I am very cautious about what I bring into my house and where I shop. Any bite gets me a little ocd about checking to make sure I don't have any hitchers again. Needless to say I believe in this stuff. It works. Steam, dust, clean.

product_title: Taste of the Wild Cat Food
review_body: When my kitten started on regular food, I bought all the expensive stuff.  The cat was vomiting, and her coat was full of loose hair and dander no matter how much I brushed her.  I gave her tubes of oils and gels without any relief.  I started to do some research on causes of these conditions, and it turns out that simply put.... Cat's need protein and almost all these big name pet foods, and specialty pet foods were mostly corn and fillers.  A little \\"Mom and Pop\\" pet store first showed me this product, and within 3 days you could see remarkable improvement in her coat.  She stopped throwing up almost within 24 hours, and now she is the fluffiest softest little thing in the world.  She has so much energy, and just loves the taste.  She camps out by the bowl when feeding time approaches.  I think these other pet food companies should start doing the right thing.  I was actually very surprised how reasonable the cost was considering the ingredients.  Please,....if you love your pet, you need to do the right thing and give them a quality food like this one.

product_title: Dog Silencer Pro Ultimate Pack
review_headline: If you have to run it by battery, don't bother
review_body: I broke down and bought this because the barking of my neighbors two dogs just has me at my wits end.  All day long they bark, especially a small, new yappy one.  My neighbor actually told me that her dog trainer recommended that she not keep it, as it was too aggressive around children, but she set out to\\"prove him wrong\\". All I know is that it barks all day long.  We live in a rural area, have 3 acres, but we can hear them loud and clear and our driveway runs right next to their fenced in yard. The dog barks and lunges at the fence when we walk up the driveway, try to get the mail or paper, etc. So, I bought the Dog Silencer Pro, since clearly they are never going to do anything about the barking. They don't even call the dog when it is barking maniacally, I just don't get people who let their dogs bark!!!! The reviews were all good and I had high hopes. However, because of the distance from our house, I could not power it by  electric cord, so I opted to power it by  the 9 volt battery. I placed it under a dense fir tree right next to the fence.  Well, the battery lasts an average of 3 days. Also, the way the tab that the battery clicks into is constructed, it is almost impossible to get it in and out of the battery compartment and get the old one off and the new one on. I can't even tell if it has worked at all, because the battery life is so short!!!  I am spending a fortune on batteries.  If I had known this, I would not have spent the money. product_title: ARENERO AUTOMATICO para GATOS LITTER ROBOT II modelo SKYLIGHT BUBBLE
review_body: I was very against purchasing a 350.00 \\"robot\\" for cat litter.  We have 5 cats and until a year ago, our house never smelled bad.  Unfortunately, as our cats have aged (they are now all 14), they began going \\"other\\" places.  Two of the cats began to go in front of the boxes (we have 5 litter boxes) and one cat began to go on the couch....Yuk.  I will admit that we did not clean the boxes as quickly as we should have, but in 14 years, it had never really been a problem.  We finally did figure out what went wrong.  I started to work outside the home and it turns out the dog began to lay at the bottom of the stair case, thereby preventing even the most daring cat to use the basement litter.  Hmmm...what to do.  We decided to bring the litter upstairs and put it in the hall bathroom.  So...how could we prevent terrible smells, litter tracking, and fit five boxes?  I started searching.  Our maybes landed on the Litter Robot, the Toilet thingy, and the Roll Around to Clean one.  We decided on the robot and it has now been 8 months...so I feel comfortable in what I am writing.  It is the best.  All of the cats have returned to the litter.  The litter is never clumpy and bumpy when they get in.  We are using far less litter than before.  The smell is a 2 out of 10 in the same room as the robot.  Bonus...it is a real party trick and we amaze all of our friends with it.    Minuses:  If you let the tray fill for too long, when the globe spins, it will have streaks of \\"stuff\\" on it.  If you let the tray fill too long, \\"stuff\\" will catch and the globe will stop and the box will be unusable until you fix the situation.  SO....don't let the tray overflow!  With 5 cats, we empty the tray on Mon, Wed, Sat.  Easy enough.  I have a cat that will actually get in to use the litter while the globe is rotating....not the smartest...and the globe stops and waits until he has jumped out.  Problem is, his \\"stuff\\" does not have time to fully clump and it will get stuck in the grate as the globe rotates.  When the globe has done its job, there is \\"stuff\\" stuck in the grate hanging at the top of the globe.  When the next cat gets in, that cat leaves with bits of \\"stuff\\" on its back.  It takes no more that a little push with a piece of toilet paper for it to fall down into the litter.    I am very happy with this purchase.  I would do it again.  We were at our wits end and this was a lifesaver....or (based on some of the comments my husband was making when we were having litter problems) a cat saver.

product_title: Supreme Gerri Premium Gerbil Food
review_headline: Premium gerbil food...wish it was more readily available.
review_body:
Most commercial hamster/gerbil food is designed for HAMSTERS...and will contain a mix of sunflower seeds, peanuts...millet...oats...etc. Your gerbils have an instinct to gorge on high fat foods and will eat out all of the sunflower seeds, peanuts...and high-fat seeds first...and will only eat the millet, oats and green pellets when everything better is gone. If you feed your gerbils \\"hamster food\\" daily...you'll soon have plump gerbils.

(Hamsters on the other hand...are hoarders...and will hide a portion of high fat foods in their nest for \\"later\\" consumption which rarely happens.)

Gerri Premium Gerbil Food is actually formulated for gerbils...not hamsters...leaving out the high fat sunflower seeds and peanuts. (You CAN still feed sunflower seeds as treats...don't get me wrong...but they shouldn't be included in the \\"regular\\" food. You wouldn't serve dessert to your kids with dinner and expect them to eat their dinner first!!)

I believe the food is manufactured in the UK. I've only been able to get my hands on a couple of bags...which I thought were excellent in quality. What a relief not having to spend an hour picking sunflower seeds and peanuts out of the mix!

product_title: WHISKAS Purrfectly Wet Cat Food Pouches
review_headline: Purrfectly Chicken NOT!  Purrfectly Mystery Meat is better

product_title: Nylabone Dura Chew Textured Toy, X-Large
review_body:
Although I've been buying Nylabones for my dogs for many years, I only recently realized that Amazon carried them for a better price than Petco or PetSmart so I now order all our Nylabones strictly from here. Nylabones help curb destructive chewing, ease boredom, and clean teeth.

Like ANY toy, Nylabones carry a risk if not used properly. There is no such thing a completely, 100% safe toy.
With that said, I've never had a problem with Nylabones, nor do I know anyone who has. It's ALL about being responsible and knowing your dog. (When it all comes down to it, they can be quite child like. They need YOU to use YOUR head.)

Make sure you're buying the appropriate size for your dog. (Don't buy one that's too small, simply because it's cheaper.) If you're using a bone that's too small it will greatly increase the chance of your dog biting off pieces that can be harmful.
If your dog is an aggressive chewer, then don't leave them alone for extended periods with any toy. Nylabones included.

Be safe and smart!! Your dogs depend on you!

product_title: Marshall Pet Products Pet Deluxe Play Pen, Small
review_body: I inherited my late sister's ferrets and although I love animals, I wasn't happy with the usual ferret alternatives:  keep them caged up, give them the run of a limited area (which I tried but which promptly became a hygiene nightmare) or give them the run of the house and be careful of treading in ferret poop.  For readers who are voluntary ferret parents, I completely understand the appeal and I \\"get\\" that I was undereducated, unprepared, not particularly enthusiastic and probably ill-informed about ferret care.  But even I could see that the largest big-dog cage available wasn't adequate for such active little guys, but giving them unfettered access to any free space meant signing up for intensive poo-cleaning duties.  I tried giving them the run of the house but could never find them when it was time to put them back in the spare bathroom where they ran free.  I really struggled with the idea of paying $75 for this collection of wire panels, but it really did solve the problem.  I set it up in a tiled, air-conditioned sunroom in about 5 minutes flat - it is absolutely foolproof.  The brackets connecting the panels are metal and appear very sturdy.  There are plastic latches to connect the last 2 panels into a circle and they might be the first pieces that fail, but they are pretty heavy and could in a pinch be replaced with twist ties or wire.  The little guys, who could climb onto a 4\\" bathroom counter, couldn't climb their way out of this contraption.  They seemed to feel more free without a top to cage them in and it was easier for me to step in and give them attention.  My cats never jumped inside (it's a pretty tall wall to jump or even step into from the ground) but they could nuzzle and bat through the outside, which the ferrets seemed to enjoy.  Luckily, a more ferret-aware friend adopted the two little guys but she still found this to be a useful tool in introducing them to her own ferret, since they could interact without being able to attack each other.  I've fostered a number of small animals over the years and would give this an enthusiastic thumbs-up for rodents (are ferrets and gerbils rodents?  Anyway, for that sort of animal) and even for small dogs.  This product is a little like the anchor - so simple it seems incredible that no one has thought of it before or that one would need to pay for it, but so incredibly effective that it's worth it!

review_body:

product_title: Drinkwell Original Pet Fountain
review_headline: Cat is HAPPY.  I'm ok with it.  Filter cost is a little high.
review_body: Cat (Lily) loves it.  She drinks tons more water since I have gotten it.    The cleaning can take a while but once done it last for two weeks or more.  I think the reason is I have a water softner and that helps to keep the \\"scale\\" and buildup at bay.  My sister has the same product and she has EXTREME hard water and her drinkwell looks awful due to scale and deposit that WILL NOT come off-no matter how often it is cleaned and scrubbed.  The motor is VERY HARD to \\"turn\\" to get it out of the bottom to clean it.  The first 3 times I had to have my husband get it out for me and he had to use a butter knife to get the thing to move out--but I understand why it has to be tight (otherwise there might be a leak) so I am ok with that.   I have had mine now for a year and so far have had NO PROBLEMS. It still works good and no loss of power.   Cost of filters are a little high so I try to make one work for quite a while before i change it.  One filter can usually last three months for me -as long as I clean it once every two week and rinse filter really well each time.  I have my sister's cat staying now for over two weeks and this original drinkwell is just not big enough for both.  I have to add water DAILY.  Scared to leave both cats for more than an 8 hour period due to not having enough water.  I am thinking of getting a Drinkwell Big Dog  to make sure I can leave for at least a 24 hour period.  Overall, I am very happy with this product just wish water capacity was more.  Even with just one cat I have to add water every other day-so the bottom line is--it is just not big enough.  Oh -the sound as others has mentioned -is slight.  I have it sitting on a rug (bought for $4 at discount store) and it muffles the sound slightly.  The sound of water hitting the water is peaceful to me.  It is right next to the living room and we have had NO problems with the sound at all.

review_headline: for the dog who needs some correction but not a lot
review_body: Prong collars work by simulating the pinch/bite of another dog to your dog's neck, but sometimes that pinch is a bit more than you need for a sensitive pup.  The comfort tips are just the thing in that situation.    NOTE: if your dog is leery of the collar when you put it on, or he squeals or whines when corrected by the collar, you may have an overly sensitive drama queen dog...but normally a dog isn't afraid of the collar and it doesn't cause pain.  Such behavior actually suggests a different problem than lack of comfort . So, first thing, you should make certain that the collar is fitted properly.  There should be only one to two inches of slack to the collar when it is on the dog.  Too much slack makes the correction too harsh.  I found this out the hard way.  Also be sure you do NOT put the collar on over his head!  (If you have it the proper size, you can't anyway.)  I use a prong collar with a clip; but you can separate the links to put it on the dog as well.  And be sure you aren't pulling hard on the leash.  If you correct the dog, a gentle tug should be sufficient; in general, the dog corrects himself when he lunges against the collar.

product_title: Tape Worm Tabs Feline (Praziquantel) 23 mg, 3 Tablets
review_headline: one way to worm for tapes
review_body: Tapeworms are easiest to prevent if you know their lifecycle.  Tapes are caused by cats ingesting fleas  usually from prey that they have eaten like a mouse or rat.  They could also ingest a flea from grooming themselves if they have fleas.  So, in addition to getting rid of the tapes you must also get rid of the fleas if possible.  Tapes are not passed from cat to cat unless the fleas are passed.  Any new pet should be treated for fleas before it is introduced to another pet so the fleas are not passed.     PRaziquantel is one way to worm for tapes.  It is very effective as long as you can get the cat to eat it which is best accomplished by putting it in chicken baby food or some treat the cat REALLY likes.  Also, the cat needs to be isolated so that they get all the medicine especially if there are multiple cats in the house.  The BEST way is to go to a vet you have a client-patient relationship with and get topical Profender.  It is amazing and is great especially for cats that are difficult to treat orally.

product_title: Pioneer Pet Raindrop Stainless Steel Pet Drinking Fountain
review_body: So far, so good! The Pioneer Pet fountain has been just as advertised. It is very quiet and easy to assemble; I barely had to look at the instructions! My two cats took to it right away, and they are definitely drinking more water than before. I like the small number of parts as this makes things easy to clean. I find the flow works well at the lowest setting. The only concern I have is the way the power cord is routed through the case. There is no grommet or other protection or strain relief, and the cord runs under water. Once the warranty expires, I will install a grommet, and may figure a way to route the cord above water. Also, although the bottom pan and upper cover are stainless steel, the pump and pump/filter housing are plastic. Water constantly contacts this plastic, so the claims of the water staying cleaner is true, but exagerated. It would be nice if the pump housing was also stainless steel. Overall, I have been impressed with the quality and especially the quietness! I have a competing plastic fountain that hums and is starting to get mineral build-up. Not so with the Pioneer Pet fountain! (I still use both of them.) Also, a low-water auto shutoff would be nice, but I've yet to find a fountain that has one.

product_title: Pioneer Pet SmartCat The Ultimate Scratching Post
review_headline: Certainly the Ultimate Cat Scratching Post
review_body:
This is the third Ultimate Scratching Post that I have purchased for my cats. They love it! I now have three cats - thus, I have three scratching posts.

One of my cats likes to sit on the top of the post. She now weighs close to 18 pounds. The post is strong and stable enough to easily support her.

All three cats seem to like the sisal scratching surface over any other type used in scratching posts - and it is long lasting. The height of the post makes it easy for them to simply reach up and stretch if they don't feel like scratching.

This is the first time that I received the scratching post minus something that should have been included in shipping. The base is made of two particle board pieces that are held together with two dowels. The base is then screwed to the scratching post. The dowels and screws usually are in a little plastic bag taped to the post for shipping. I called the manufacturing company the day that I received the package and realized that I didn't get the dowels and screws - their number is on the box. Their customer service person was great. She promptly put the package in the mail. I received it two days later. She also put a little toy in the package for my cats, which was a nice touch.

product_title: Marineland Light Timer 24 Hour Grounded
review_body: This is a simple all-mechanical device that nonetheless fulfills its mission quite nicely. To use it, one first sets the current time. The entire face works as the clock and completes a full circle every 24 hours. On the edge are 96 tabs, one for each quarter hour. If a tab is pressed into the down position, the timer will leave the power on during the corresponding 15 minutes, so theoretically this timer can turn an appliance on and off 48 cycles in a day.    I use this timer to control [[ASIN:B0001XLSGQ Hydrofarm JSV4 4-Foot Jump Start T5 Grow Light System]]. It works well after a straightforward set-up process. My only complaint is about the pass-through switch that can turn off the timer and leave the power on all the time. Somehow, the manufacturer decides to associate the position when the switch covers up the clock symbol and displays a straight line (presumably for \\"pass-through\\") with having the timer function on, and vice versa. This seems to me just totally counter-intuitive.
