it barely opened up after 4 months of play...cheaper and a little more durable for a smaller dog.

The pro is that it is probably quite durable for goldens and other similar dogs
that do not chew through wood, tile grout, walls, and so on. Considering what my Shiba CAN chew up...it did
last longer than my dry wall and grout...so better to chew Polly than the 'wall'y.

UPDATE:
I eventually bought my Shiba the same toy. She loved playing with that pig although I had to sew it a dozen times. It lasted till this year (5/30/2014). I increased the stars by one for how long it lasted in the amount she played with it. I got my money's worth with this toy. She is now 4 years old and 17 lbs. She still loves to play with it because she uses it to practice her playing skills to use it on a real dog...we watched her do the same tactics to our friend's dog as they play together (it's just cute and funny). She did eventually gut the toy so it became lighter...but with some repairs using button thread...it lasted 3 years. Not too bad! Thanks Tuffy for a durable toy.

product_title: Thundershirt, Gray - Small
review_body: I could not believe this product actually worked.   Our dog freaks out when it storms. And she stayed calm this time. Amazing product.

product_title: Tetra Whisper Power Filter
review_headline: Good filter: not quite as quiet as I would have liked.
review_body: The filter keeps the tank nice and clean (when I remember to change the Bio-Bag). it is in my daughters room and it does bother her some nights. I was hoping for a silent filter but it is audible. It has gotten to the point of white noise in the house now. It is much quieter than the filter I had when I was a kid.

product_title: Plastec Industries SS008 Super Saucer Protective Plant Saucer (Single Saucer)
review_body: These saucers are strong enough that you can pick up the plant by the saucer. Not flimsy at all. They arrived on time in fine condition.

product_title: WHISKAS Catmilk Drink for Cats & Kittens
review_headline: My loud mouth cat loves it.
review_body:
My Cat is coming up on his 13th year and suddenly when we are home he never stops yowling. There is nothing wrong with him medically, he just began demanding an insane amount of attention (he already gets more attention than most children) and begs for food even when he is not hungry because he wants you to come in the kitchen and pay attention to him. So as much as I love incessant meowing while I am trying to read, type, talk or think.....

Anywho we didn't want to reward the yowling with treats or feeding him at times other than his normal meals but ignoring the behavior as per the vet and other people instructed simply did not work. After months of his crying we chalked it up to old age and wound up just giving him treats and snacks of his wet food so we could have a phone conversation without the person on the other line thinking we were killing our animal. He mostly ignored the extra food and would gobble up the treats but we knew it wasn't a perma fix. So we tried the cat milk. He loves it. Laps it up like me at a $2 martini happy hour. It appears to have a soothing effect on him because he stops meowing for a while after he gets it. Plus we feed him premium food and he was still a little flaky. (I think due to the dry heat in our home) The cat milk seems to help with the flakiness and his coat seems smoother. I would definitely limit it to a small serving once a day, I gave him a leetle too much when I first got it and I paid for it the next day when I was scooping the box. Other than the one incident it actually seems to help his poop. cheers!

product_title: Planet Dog Orbee-Tuff Bulb with Treat Spot
review_body: One of my dogs eventually chewed the base off, but this is still a fairly tough toy. It's just the right size for medium to smallish dogs and it bounces very unpredictably. Very chew worthy!

product_title: Armarkat Cave Shape Pet Cat Beds for Cats and Small Dogs-Waterproof and Skid-Free Base
review_body: My cats love this.  Got it for my \\"old cat,\\" who is 13 this summer, to use as a refuge from the two younger ones.  All the cats love it.  It is private, warm, and soft.  Now how to clean the damn thing?

product_title: Kakadu Pet Nylon Shell And Fleece Lined Dog Coat With Reflective Stripe
review_body: This jacket is a perfect fit and provides more warmth than other dog jackets since the velcro underneath covers more than just a small strip.  I was hoping it would've had a thicker fleece lining, but my dog is still always warm after a long walk in the cold!

product_title: KattySaks - The Kitty Litter Box Cover - Le Dresser
review_body: So far so good. It is really cute and fits the litter box. Just hope my finicky cats take to it.

product_title: Purina Friskies Prime Filets Variety Pack Wet Cat Food - 24-5.5 oz. Cans
review_body: I have used the Subscribe and Save twice for the Prime Filet Friskies quite happily.  I looked today, and the purchase price is now DOUBLE, making each can OVER A DOLLAR--$32 +/- per case of 24.  This is truly poor ethics/business practice on the part of Amazon.  I am incredibly disappointed and I hope this serves as fair warning to those who have yet to notice the 125% jump in price since last month.

product_title: Catit Style Scratcher with Catnip
review_headline: Cats loved the catnip as much as the scratching board
review_body: The catnip that came with this is POWERFUL.    I put a little bit in the scratching board and it drove the cats nuts.  I put the rest of the catnip in a ziplock bag and put it on a high shelf.  When we came home the next day there was a destroyed ziplock bag and catnip ALL over the bathroom.    After that was cleaned up, the cats knocked over the trash to get to the empty catnip back...what IS this stuff from???

product_title: Green Cow Rawhide Dog Bones, Natural Chips, 5-Pound Bag
review_body: This is a nice big bag, well-priced, of flat rawhides.  If that's what your dog likes, these are perfect.  I'd given my dogs rawhide bones and twists before and they like them...but for some reason these flat rawhides aren't nearly as popular with them.  I have to put some peanut butter on them to get them to chew on them for any amount of time.  It's going to take us a really long time to get through this bag.

product_title: Ceva Feliway Plug-In Diffuser Refill for Cats
review_body: For what ever reason, one of our cats started marking every corner of our bedroom.  He has been on the scitish side for quite some time.  Within 2 days of plugging in the first feliway.....he settled down, and went to the box.  Can't thank feliway enough.

product_title: Purina Friskies Flaked Wet Cat Food, 5.5 Ounce, Pack of 24
review_headline: GREAT  FOOD FOR MY WONDERFUL TNR PROGRAM
review_body: Awhile back I decided to set an example and fix 80 cats in my neighborhood. At first the feeding cleaning and care of all those cats was overwhelming and very expensive. A few years into the program I thought I might have to stop due to health and old age, but I was shopping on Amazon and saw cat food. WOW, There it was pages of Friskies canned catfood on sale and shipped using SUPER SAVER. I now have 60 cats and adore the great karma they put out. Thanks to Amazon I get wonderful prices and don't have to lug hundreds of pounds of food home each week.If you are taking care of ferals or have only one indoor kitty you MUST check out the huge range of flavors and friskie products in the grocery section of Amazon you will be delightfully surprised :-)

product_title: Premier Bark Avenue Dog Leash
review_body: The Specifications were a lie.  The leash was not leather.  It appeared to be more Krap from Communist China.  It was returned immediately.  I went down to Rusty's in Los Angeles and bought a high quality leather leash.

product_title: Rockys Choice Premium Odor Free 12" THICK Bully Sticks - 3 Pack
review_body: Our dog, who weighs 10 pounds, just loves these \\"big\\" bully sticks.  They do not smell and last a long time.  Also, rawhide is not good for dogs so this is a great alternative.

product_title: K&H Manufacturing Bolster Couch
review_headline: Great Dog Bed at a Low Price
review_body: Can't beat this for the price.  My dog (45 lbs, 7 month old yellow lab/golden retriever mix) jumped in as soon as we took it out of the box and has loved it ever since.  Because we don't know how big our dog is going to get, we did not want to spend a ton of money on a bed that might be outgrown.  So we went for the cheaper option, but we do not regret it because this is great and is also big enough that my dog might grow into it.    Firm, not too soft, we throw in a fleece blanket and it is perfect.  Would definitely recommend this.

product_title: Dispoz-A-Scoop Bags 96 Pk
review_body: I just love these Dispoz-A-Scoops.  They are easy to use, keep my hands clean, and I am able to control the smell for the rest of the walk by closing the bag.  With the brown color of the bag, you can't see what's inside so no one gets offended by what I am carrying.  I have 2 beagles and some trips they fill it up, so if you have larger dogs I would suggest carrying 2 scoops.  I usually get the 96 count box, which fits in my cabinet very convienently and is still cost effective to ship because they are light.  I was very happy with the fast shipping too!  Will buy these again - Thanks Amazon!

product_title: Rogz Utility Large 3/4-Inch Reflective Fanbelt Obedience Half-Check Dog Collar
review_body: I have used the larger rogz martingale collar for my 90-lb. German Shepherd for several years.  It is an excellent \\"light-training\\" collar which gives me more control on leash than the flat collar.  These are very good quality & very durable.  I had been unable to find them at local stores or, through online searches & am very pleased to find them on Amazon.  I highly recommend when used properly.

product_title: Replacement Bulb
review_body: Very pleased with the seller, they were very prompt in getting the product to me.  It came in packaged correctly and in excellent shape. I have been dealing with Amazon for a long time and have never been disapointed, they under promise and over deliver every time.

product_title: Snuggle Safe Pet Bed Microwave Heating Pad
review_headline: SnuggleSafe Pet Heating Pad is great!
review_body: I bought one of these and was so pleased with it, I bought another one so I could use them in shifts.  They hold the heat very well and keep my kitty's bed warm for as much as 10-12 hours.  I put it under a soft fleece blanket in his \\"tent bed\\" and he loves it.

product_title: Remington Soft-Sided Collapsible Kennel, Green
review_body: My American Bulldog's crate was falling apart and I wanted a craite that was really sturdy - he weighs 125 lbs!  The construction is very good - solid.

product_title: Ferrera Farms 6 Inch Regular Bully Stick, 7-Count bag (Pack of 2)
review_headline: amazing product & well worth the price
review_body: My 14 pound Maltese gets half-stick every other day and she loves it! It takes her a long long time to finish which means she's cleaning her teeth all the while. I wish these come in thinner strips as some are so thick that a smaller dog abandons before finishing. I save these and give to my neighbor's mid-size beagle.

product_title: Diggers Rawhide Twists
review_headline: The best raw hide chews I have found
review_body: I love this brand of chews for my Shih Tzu. They do not come apart easily so she really just chews on one for hours. Other brands that I have purchased in the past break apart and she chokes on them. Some other brands she actually tries to swallow whole, but not with these. She just chews on them and bites off little pieces at a time. I will not give her any other raw hide chews. These are the best.

product_title: Bitch Pills - 180 Tabs
review_body: These pills where recomended to me by another breeder to give to a expectant female dog they seem to help her coat and appitite I would recommend them I wont know final outcome until she whelps hopefuly a healthy litter. Lewis

product_title: Pink Parrot® Beak Tweakers® 10" Hanging Lantern for Birds
review_body: My Grey Amazon loved this toy. It lasted about a week. I buy him lots of toys to fight those bored moments. This toy kept his mind busy. I'll be back for more in the near future.

product_title: Vibran-Sea Narrow Eel Grass Silk-Style Aquarium Plant
review_body: Looks good in my 2.5 gallon tank. My betta seems to like it so far. It is very soft and looks very realistic. The weighted base does what it should, sinks the plant. In my tank the plant reaches up to the top so I can easily move it around when I need to.

product_title: Purina Fancy Feast Classic Gourmet Variety Pack Wet Cat Food - (24) 3 oz. Cans
review_headline: My cat is no longer diabetic thanks to Fancy Feast!!!
review_body: My cat was diagnosed with feline diabetes and put on insulin injections twice a day. The vet tried to sell us perscription cat food that was very expensive. When I researched it online, TONS of people said that simply feeding their cats Fancy Feast (classic variety) cured their cat's feline diabetes.  Sure enough, after only 1 month on Fancy Feast (plus injections), my cat was able to stop the injections and only continue his special diet of Fancy Feast.  He eats only Fancy Feast now is no longer dependent on the insulin!!! That was easy!

product_title: Laguna Aeration Kit for Ponds
review_body: This pump works great. It is larger than it appears in the pic. I'd say its about 9 inches long, and about 3.5 inches high. Maybe 4 inches thick. I have a 2200 gallon koi pond and this pump makes plenty of air for it. It produces a lot of bubbles. And if you have somewhere to put it, then you can't even hear it run. I just ran a long airline, and I never even hear this pump. It is also pretty power efficient. It doesn't come with an air stone though, for actually making the bubbles. You are going to need one of the larger airstones because this pump flows a lot more air than some of the smaller ones. I would recommend the big 5 inch circular one from petsmart or someplace like that. And you need to let the stone soak for a long time before using it, just like the package says. Or else it won't make bubbles near as well. Learned that from personal experience. All in all, this pump has served me very well. I would certainly not hesitate to buy another one. It has lasted fine in the freezing cold, and in the punishing texas heat.

product_title: Pioneer Pet SmartCat Peek-A-Prize Toy Box with 2 Toys
review_body: My cats may be diff than others, but they were never excited with this box full of holes.  They are so bored with it that they don't even play with it when I put treats inside.  As I say, it could be my cats but it was not worth the price or trouble.

product_title: 2 Cosequin Cats, 160 Count
review_headline: Cosequin has extended the life of my cat ...
review_body: Cosequin is most often used for arthritis relief and it works well.  However, we give it to our cat to protect the lining of her bladder.  Because of a congenital defect (extra vein to her liver), she is more susceptible to bladder stones.  Having had surgery twice already to remove those stones, since she has been on Cosequin, we have seen no recurrence.  She is also on a prescription food and between the two of them, we have seen no blood in her urine for quite some time.  She's happy, her energy has returned, and we only make those trips to the vet for annual shots.  Most people will put Cosequin on their cat's food ... ours won't touch it, but swallows a capsule daily with little trouble.  Thank you Amazon!

product_title: Doggles Over the Head Dog Harness
review_body: The dog collar fit my dog well, but he chewed thru the material, suggest something a little stronger.  He chewed thru in last than 5 minutes.  Will keep shopping aound for something more durable for a huskie/shepard.

product_title: QT Dog All Natural Chew Toy
review_body: I LOVE THIS CHEW.  We have a 7 month old Doberman who loves to chew.  Rawhides and other chew items don't digest well with her, but she loves to chew this and I haven't seen any negative digestive issues.  Plus it lasts MUCH longer than rawhides.

product_title: Cat Playpen Model 130
review_body: This worked out perfect for our recovering cat who had a urinary tract infection. We needed to keep him away from 2 other cats until he felt better.  The cable ties are a must for this crate to keep it secure. Thank you to the person who wrote that in their review. We had room for a hooded litter box, a skinny scratcher, water and food bowls on the bottom.

product_title: K&H Manufacturing Cuddle Cube
review_body:
As soon as I got the dog beds out, my two Jack Russells jumped on them and settled right in!! Originally,I was going to get the small beds but decided to get the medium-sized ones instead. I'm really glad that I did because it gives them a lot more room to snuggle and burrow in.
They LOVE their beds and so do I!! :-)

product_title: Flexi Classic All-Belt Retractable BELT Leash for Dogs up to 44 lbs. (16 ft.), Color: RED
review_body: Everyone in the family loves the new retractable leash.  The dog loves it because he can be more than 6 feet away to do his business!  Bought one for the car too.  Good deal for the money.

product_title: Tunze Turbelle® Stream 2 Pump 6065 (New Generation with Titanium Alloy Shaft)
review_body: I went with a new Tunze because my last one was durable and very powerful.  This specific pump does not create enought flow for my 165 gallon tank.  I am sure it would be great in a smaller tank.  It is quiet.

product_title: Carib Sea Instant Aquarium Peace River 20lb
review_body: I never heard of this until I bought it on Amazon.  I didn't believe it did everything it says but....my water is so clear I feel like I have a real visitor worthy aquarium.  My turtles are so calm now(I have red eared sliders) and every time I clean the tank, the gravel seems like it re-conditions the water time and time again.  It is really a good buy.

product_title: PetSafe Drinkwell Platinum Pet Fountain
review_body: This is a great product.  I have three cats, one in particular was ALWAYS jumping up onto the counters and bathroom sink for a drink of water.  When I brought this item home, he took to it right away as did my female.  Both of them like to drink from the running fountain itself while my other male preferred to drink from the well.  After about two weeks, he also started drinking from the fountain.  Now I don't have as much of a problem with the cats up on the counter.  I have tried other types of fountains and they can be very loud, so much that my female was afraid of them.  The Drinkwell Platinum is very quiet and adjustable, only a light humming sound.  You can barely even hear the water hitting the base especially when you have it adjusted to low.  It holds a LOT of water and even still, I have to fill it every 3-4 days because my kitties are drinking so much more than before.  The unit is also heavy when full which is good as one of my males was forever pushing the water bowl around the kitchen and making a mess...now he can't move it!  As for cleaning the unit...it can be a bit of a process but it is not difficult to do.  A small price to pay for the health of my cats.  I have read that some people find this unit to be messy when they turn the fillable canister over and connect it to the base but I have found that if you turn it as soon as you screw on the bottom piece, right over the sink and carry it to the base that way (maybe with a small dishcloth under for slight drippng), it is very simple to connect...no mess.

product_title: Feline Pine Scoop Cat Litter, 10.1-Pound Box
review_body: Although I admire the resourcefulness, ingenuity and marketing prowess behind this assuredly environmentally- and health-friendly cat litter, I can't recommend it for most households. Why? Because it doesn't hide urine/feces smells very well at all and is dreadful at clumping ability. Clumps are always like a wet slurry of ick, bound loosely together and, like a disagreeable couple, seemingly aching to break up regardless of the fallout.    Although I used this cat litter for over a year now, I tried Swheat Scoop from the local grocery store and liked its smell-containment and clumping abilities much more. Although I can verify that occasionally you'll get a box with live beetles in it, keeping it outdoors negates that drawback and effectively crushes all of its competition in the traits we cat owners so desperately seek in an environmentally friendly cat litter product.

product_title: Iams Tartar Treats Small for Dogs
review_body: Unfortunately our doxie was given these 4 different occasions.  A few hours after eating one  (each time) the dog vomited.  We tried the extra times because we wanted to determine if it was  these or something else.  We came to the conclusion it had to be these items. Don't know if your dog  will react the same way but we wanted to caution just in case.  Sorry to say.

product_title: Petmate Fool-A-Bug Pet Bowl Jumbo (Assorted Colors - Jumbo (10x10x3.5'') )
review_body: I loved these dishes when I first bought them for my outdoor ferals.  No ants and it save me $$, no more wasting food.  One year later, and they don't work as well anymore.  Tiny little ants keep finding their way into the bowls and now I'm wasting $$ again throwing out the food.  I'm on the hunt again to find a really good ant free bowl.

product_title: Guardian Gear Fleece Car Seat Cover Black Pawprnt
review_body:
I have a Jeep Grand Cherokee with leather seats and this doggie blanket looks nice in the back.

Pros: Keeps the leather clean and scratch free. It doesn't fall down when driving. Easily flips over the seat to the back so that passengers can sit on the seat.

Cons:
Doesn't secure well to the seat. I wish I could find a way to secure it to the back of the seat better. Right now because of how the seats are, it can only be tied down to the top middle of the seat back and secured to the seat pull tabs on the left and right. If I try to tie it down to the seat cushion it ejects the dog from the seat. There is no way to really keep the back bottom of the blanket secured down to the back of the seat cushion. The leather in the GC is slippery so the base slides all over.

I still really like the blanket but just haven't found a good way to secure it down yet. It would probably work better in other cars/SUV's.

product_title: Weazel Ball - The Weasel Rolls with Ball
review_headline: New Design, Great Toy for Pets!
review_body:
I just wanted to clarify, I received this toy recently for my yorkie, and it now has a turn off/on switch on the outside of the ball. I haven't had any experience with it opening up, and my pet has played with it for hours. I do think it would be better for cats as it is somewhat slow.
It is VERY entertaining and life-like though. We had a low stepping stool on the floor, and the weasel ball would constantly weave in and out under and through the stool. The tail would hide underneath while it was caught under the stool and flutter back and forth. It caused my dog endless amounts of furry and excitement! It's a little slow for her though, and without constant supervision she could tear the weasel from ball since it is attached through a plastic t-wire similar to clothing tags in the top of the ball.
Other than that, I think it's a GREAT toy for the price! Definitely for cats and puppies, for larger dogs, just needs supervision.

product_title: HomeoPet Dog & Cat Leaks No More
review_headline: Did not work, seemed to make things worse
review_body: I took my dog off Proin and tried this product which had no apparent effect.  She leaked worse than ever.  I have an aging Belgian Mallinois.

product_title: Solvit HoundAbout Pet Bicycle Trailer
review_body: I purchased this trailer based on the many customer reviews of the product.  It is a great product.  It was easy to put together, all the parts fitted perfectly.  The instruction guide is a little vague, but if you go to the Solvit website, they have a video on how to set it up.  Our dog LOVES it.  We have a difficult time getting her out of it when the ride is over.  She will go out and get in it to take a nap, when I'm not around.  We took it on vacation with us, and it packs up to a good size to put in the car.  You do notice the extra weight when going up hills, but the rest of the time you hardly notice that you are pulling it.  Do purchase the extra hitch, as it makes it easier to switch bikes.

product_title: Vet Solutions Swimmers Ear Astringent, 4 oz.
review_body: I have been using this product for years and when I switched vets they did not use the product and I was very disappointed. But I searched it online and found I could buy it myself. Great stuff! Use it for cleaning up an ear infection, swimmers ear and any infections in cracks and crevices on my lab. Works like a charm. I just saturate a cotton ball with it and it is not so intimidating to my lab Buster. He loves the cool feeling and the smell takes away any odors the infection may have caused. A must to have around the house for pet problems. Even my cats let me clean their ears with it.  Donna/Sarasota Fl [[ASIN:B00076HULE Vet Solutions Swimmers Ear Astringent, 4 oz.]]

product_title: Now! Dry Dog Food for Dogs
review_body: I have decided that I want to provide the best quality food to my animals.  My dog loves this food, and hasn't had any digestive problems since moving to it.  Also does wonders for her coat.  Love this product.

product_title: American River Choke-Free Dog Harness - Rainbow Ombre
review_body:
I bought this for my miniature schnauzer, for \\"formal\\" occasions, such as thanksgiving dinner with my husband's family. Everybody loved it! My dog didn't seem to mind it so much, every once in a while when the tie became crooked he would scratch at it, but for the most part he was able to run around no problem.
I like that there are three ties, and the velco makes it easy to change them.

product_title: PetAlive Thyro-Pet, 59 ml
review_body: My pom's thyro was at 1.1 Suppose to be between 1 - 4, So I thought I'd try this, after a month I took her back to vet and had it checked again, It was at .04, Now she has to be on thyro medication for the rest of her life. Vet said to not use anymore.

product_title: GREENIES Original TEENIE Dog Dental Chews Dog Treats
review_body: This was an awesome deal!  I will absolutely continue to buy these through Amazon, now I have 2 dogs and it would have been getting really costly at the old place I purchased them from.  Thank you!!

product_title: Smokehouse 100-Percent Natural Dog Treats
review_body: My 2 boxers loved these bones. The only negative is that the bones don't last long. My dogs ate them up in 1 day....better stock up!

product_title: Flush Puppies Doodie Bags, Flushable & Certified Compostable, 4 Refill Rolls (40 Bags)
review_body: I like these poop bags because you can flush the waste.  Toss the bag in the toilet and let it soften a bit.  After a little while flush it down.  Be careful of where you keep the bags... They really do soften and become sticky if exposed to rain for too long.  I live where it rains a lot, but haven't had any problems since I keep the waste in a \\"poop pac\\" (a hard shelled bag made for carrying poop discretely [...]).  I wish I could buy the bags locally for convenience and for reducing petroleum used in shipping.  Anyway, they're great bags!

product_title: EMSON DIV. OF E. MISHON PetZoom 8140 Sonic Pet Trainer
review_body: My dogs' barking days are OVER!  We borrowed one of these from a friend.  It worked so well I just ordered one to keep.  We have two dachshunds who love to bark at anything and everything.  Within about two days of using the Pet Zoom we saw a marked decrease in the barking.  We had the borrowed Pet Zoom for a couple of weeks and loved the results.  It's been a few months now without the device and my girls have resumed their old habit so I've ordered one for our household.  I don't expect to have to use it much.  I think you have to keep in mind that all dogs are different and the same training method doesn't work for all.  This worked wonders for our house and I definitely recommend giving it a try.  It is low cost, humane and worked really well for us.

product_title: DAZER II Ultrasonic Dog Deterrent
review_body: I don´t sure if product is good or not....i believe is working, but with any dogs i think is not working....

product_title: K&H Outdoor Heated Kitty Camper, Measures 14 by 20 Inches
review_body: This is the perfect thing to keep an outdoor kitty safe and warm!  We are having temperatures as low as 10 degrees outside, but every time our little kitty comes out of his camper, he is toasty warm.  It is a well thought out product with 2 openings and thick furry lining.  An earlier reveiw says that it sags in the middle, but that seems to have been modified.  My camper came with a rod that you thread through the top to hold it up perfectly.  We have one happy little camper on our front portch!

product_title: Blue Buffalo BLUE Senior Dog Chicken & Brown Rice
review_body: I am not one to usually write reviews, and I usually never have a bad experiance on what I purchse.   I'm not writing this to \\"slam\\" the Blue Buffalo company,and can't prove that the food I purchased was 100% responsible for my experiance,but here is what happened. I have fed my dog the same food for years. Dog is healthy with no issues. She is getting older and I did some research and decided to get her on a better brand AND figured it was time to switch to \\"senior\\" food. I followed the directions and slowly started to mix \\"Buffalo\\" with her old food to get her adjusted. Within a few days she started acting odd and had blood in her urine. Took her to the vet, and he said that he has seen this type of food cause the urine to be too acidic and cause an infection. He told me to STOP feeding her \\"Buffalo\\" and to go back to old brand. After 1 day of not feeding it to her, and the first day on her round of pills, she is much butter and no more blood in her urine.  Like I said... could be totally unrelated, but seems obvious that the problem started within 3 days of feeding this to her, and the problem stopped (per advice of vet) when I stopped feeding it to her.  I am writing this to inform you, in case you have the same issue and to hopefully save someone the expense of a vet bill and all the hassle my purchase caused me.

product_title: KollerCraft Repitat Mangrove Swamp Reptile Habitat
review_body: No turtle should live in this or any other plastic \\"lagoon.\\". Turtles are expensive to maintain in proper and humane conditions. Please do not subject a baby turtle to this death trap. The most popular pet turtle, the Red Eared Slider, requires at least 10 gallons of water per inch of shell length, filtration for 3x the size of the tank, proper water and basking temperatures, and a UVB bulb.

product_title: Cesar Millan Medium Black Illusion Collar
review_body: I found the collar to be a little on the bulky side. I have a 50lb Boxer, the medium size fit her but it just looked huge and obtrusive on her little neck. She actually sort of looked uncomfortable turning her head. Aside from looks, the collar worked at staying high on the neck and having control of the dog from that point. I just didn't feel like it ever made her re-think walking infront. she didn't really understand why she was getting yanked around by the head. She's not a huge puller but does like to walk a few steps in front and after a week of using it I returned it. I think if you have a dog that maybe over powers you, this might be a good tool to keep the dog under control, but this is not a quick fix to the pulling problem. When it comes down to it, putting time in to train the dog correctly will get a much better response. I am a fan of Cesar Milan and I use his tips of being the pack leader, but the walk has been a tough one to conquer. I gave it 3 stars because it is well made and a good idea in theory but it just wasn't necessary for my dog, especially at 50 bucks a pop!

product_title: KONG Tug Toy
review_body: Many other reviewers note that this toy is quickly destroyed by powerful chewers.  Realize that this is NOT a chew toy.  It's made for playing tug-of-war between a human and a dog.  Do not leave this toy with your dog to play with unsupervised.  It's going to have a hard time playing tug-of-war alone and will just chew it up instead.    I read the dangers of playing tug-of-war with a dog.  Rope toys specifically can be harmful as the threads of a rope will get stuck in a dog's teeth and when pulled on can cause damage.  This toy aims to solve that by using a rubber grip instead.  It's a bit harder for a dog to really sink their teeth into so less potential for teeth to suffer from the stress of pulling.  This works so long as the dog only bites the black rubber ends.    While you can't see it from the photos, the back of the red plastic portion is not solid.  It is semi-hollow grid which allows it to be flexible.  That may not be the best description but to put it harshly, they are the ideal size for dog teeth to latch into.  This very design defeats the reason I went with this tug toy over a rope one.    My dog won't bite the black ends as he knows he can get a much better grip by biting the red plastic that could cause harm to his teeth.  Perhaps I should let him chew it up instead.

product_title: Seachem Purigen
review_headline: Does what it says it does
review_body:
Seachem Purigen is a good product if you have ammonia, nitrite, nitrate problems. I have a dwarf shrimp farming business and I use this in two of my tanks because shrimp are more sensitive to water quality than fish. I definitely keep the nitrogenous compounds at nearly 0 in the water with this product. As far as the claims for this product go, I have to say they are accurate. Using this in an eheim classic I have 0/0/0 of the nitrogenous compounds.

So why did I give this four stars? Well, I have no proof of this but it seems as if purigen does take a small amount of nutrients out of the water as well. My evidence is that the tanks I use this in, the shrimp do not seem to reproduce and thrive as well as the tanks I do not use this in (shrimp use nutrients in the water column).

I would definitely recommend this product to fish keepers and anyone that has problems with nitrogenous compounds, but for shrimp keepers I would recommend using an additional nutrient source when using purigen.

product_title: Super Pet My First Home for Rabbits
review_body: As someone who rescues rabbits, I can tell you this is a terrible environment for your rabbit. Your rabbit needs much more space. It is easier and cheaper to get an excersize pen and litterbox train your rabbit. No need for expensive bedding, which can cause resperatory problems in rabbits. If you rescue a rabbit, they are litterbox trained already and spayed/neutered (ALWAYS SPAY OR NUETER YOUR RABBIT. Doing so can extend its lifespan from 4-5 years to 8-11 years and cut down on aggression and other unwanted behaviors). You shouldn't give them this food either. They need unlimited timothy hay, timothy hay pellets every day (about a 1/4 cup for a 5 pound rabbit), and a mix of fresh greens daily. That's it. Check out a book called The House Rabbit Handbook by Harriman. This should be your ultimate resource. Don't buy into vitamin drops and other items. You don't need them if they are getting the greens and hay they need. And PLEASE, DO NOT BUY A RABBIT FOR EASTER. Most rabbits purchased for Easter are abandoned or ignored. About 80% die due to neglect. Remember rabbits are animals that will live 8-11 years and are a real responsibility. Please adopt. There are so many unwanted rabbits out there. [[ASIN:0940920174 House Rabbit Handbook: How To Live With An Urban Rabbit]]

review_body: IMPOSSIBLE TO ASSEMBLE ! The prongs aren't long enough to grasp the wires.  Had to find clips to hold it together and we couldn't find black ones, so it looks terrible.  There were only two prongs manufactured into the sides.  Two of the prongs on the side broke off when attempting to connect them to the back.  and if they had been long enough to hold, they wouldn't have been close enought together.  Total waste of money !

product_title: Kaytee Crittertrail Loop D Loop Accessory Kit
review_body:
The main component works well. When adding the second section the item becomes very top heavy and tilts. Hamster has started using it as his sleeping area.
Use the second component with the bubble as an exercise ring. Turn it different directions to make it challenging.

product_title: Flexi USA FLEX8006 Dog Leash Classic Long Red Lrg
review_headline: Not as Good as the Corded Leash
review_body: I purchased this item as a replacement for a 9 year old corded, 26-foot Flexi-leash, which was starting to catch. I am disappointed with the new tape model. The tape twists constantly while the dog is walking, and even retracts that way, meaning I have to pull it all the way out, unkink it, and then retract again. Overall the leash is not as sturdy as my older model. Also, they have changed the design of the locking mechanism, and it is more awkward to use. The cap covering the stitches at the end of the leash came loose the first day I had the leash. The quality of this leash is not very good compared to the older, corded model and I am disappointed with my purchase.

product_title: Aviator Bird Harness and Leash - Size: Large - Color: Blue
review_body: Not sure how to rate the use of this product, as i have not used it yet.  The product came as described and packaged nicely with a DVD packed full of information.  I have an older Blue and Gold. The harness has been hanging on her outside of the cage perch for a little over a month now.  She refuses to get on that perch, and will lunge at it when she is on her \\"T\\" stand just outside her cage door.  She shy's away from it when I try to introduce her to it.  I am afraid to lose her trust and to lose a finger, so there it will sit for another month or two, I may end up having to use it as a toy and buy another for use. Oh well, these are the things we must endure when having an older bird.   I gave it 5 stars for delivery, packaging, construction of the harness and the informational DVD that came with the harness.

product_title: Da Bird Single 3 Foot Pole Cat Toy with 2 Extra Guinea Feather Refills
review_headline: Great toy that is still improving.
review_body: we have been buying this toy for our cat for about two years.  The entire family has a great time playing with the cat using this toy.  When we first started buying it the wand was in two pieces.  Our cat would pull it apart and eventually we wouldn't be able to find both pieces.  Thus we had to keep buying.  Then they started making the wand in one piece.  What an improvement.  Unfortunately then they made the string out of something that would just wind up into little knots.  So you could play about 3 minutes before taking a 5 minute break to unwind.  Now they have gone back to the original string and are still making the wand one piece.  It is absolutlely terrific.

product_title: FURminator deShedding Tool for Cats
review_body: Use this on my long haired cat.  Works really well.  More hair removal than most other products I've used.  The plastic lever that is supposed to push the hair off could work better though.  Otherwise, love it so far.

product_title: Four Paws Keep Off Granular Outdoor Dog and Cat Repellent,2 Lbs(0.91Kgs)
review_body: Doesn't seem to work for very long and I'm questionable about it's effectiveness. I bought the granular and liquid versions and my puppy (3 months) old doesn't seem phased by this other than immediately after applying the product.  I've tried other brands which seem to last longer and to be more effective.

product_title: Dog Harnesses- Puppia
review_headline: Great Harness for a Large Purse Dog
review_body:
I was excited to order these, because it's has been difficult to find a harness that's comfortable for my dogs. After I ordered these, friends on Facebook (I should have asked them first) warned me that Large doesn't mean Large. They were right. I have two dogs that I thought were medium in size (65 pounds each) cattle dog mix. An extra large wouldn't fit my dogs. I was really disappointed.

I may have missed this in the description, but these are definitely for small dogs; the term \\"large\\" is misleading. Here's a link to a picture of my dogs so that you can see their size ([...]) - if your dog is this size or larger, this isn't the harness for you.

I'm giving this 3 stars, because, although they didn't work for my dogs, if I were to find a size large enough, I would buy them.

product_title: Pet Gear AT3 All-Terrain Pet Stroller for cats and dogs up to 60-pounds,  Blue Sky
review_body: We bought the AT3 for my wonderful cocker spaniel.If I want to take him to the mall it is awsome!The only problem is the front wheel.If it is not exactly at the right angle it is very easy to topple over.We were crossing the street in Palm Beach when the stroller turned over!If I had known it was so easy to get off balance I would have been extremely cautious.Other than that it is awsome.It is very nice looking stroller.My cocker spaniel looks exactly like the one in your advertisement.He weighs about 30 lbs.I can not see a 60 lb dog in this carrier as you advertise!

product_title: CitiKitty "As Seen on Shark Tank" Cat Toilet Training Kit
review_body: I bought this product to train my two 6 year old Tonkinese cats.  I knew there was a possibility of failure, but I had no idea just how dramatic the failure would be.  My cats have never had a single accident outside of their two litter boxes but resorted to relieving themselves in their beds after over 24 hours of refusing to get anywhere near the product that was carefully installed on two toilets.  The toilets we chose were right next to where their litter boxes had been, and we had already been using a flushable wheat litter so there was no adjustment there.  I believe that the extreme flimsiness of the product terrified them each time my husband or I placed them on the device (probably 20+ times in 24 hours).  I would have never purchased this item if I had seen it in stores because the extreme flimsiness was far worse than I had imagined even after reading prior negative reviews.  I feel very fortunate that both cats immediately went right back to using their litter boxes and would never recommend or even give away the two kits we purchased.  Beware!!

product_title: Red Dingo Dog Lead, Large, Yellow
review_headline: yellow dog lead is a good one
review_body: The lead is durable, colour hasn't faded and the clasp is strong, looks great too. My only suggestion is that the handle needs to be stronger as it is a large dog lead and the length is too long - I know it's adjustable but when there is a 60kg dog on the end u can't adjust much.

product_title: KONG Cat Zoom Groom Brush
review_body: I have used one of these Kong ZoomGrooms on my 17+ year old kitty for several years.  She loves it.  She is a torbie and has medium length hair.  When I aquired two long hair kitties (4 months old) I ordered one for them.  Unfortunately it does not do as well on them.  They have a fuzzy undercoat and this seems to stick to it and it pulls.  Perhaps when they are older it will work better if some of the kitten fuzz is gone.

product_title: Halo Holistic Wet Cat Food
review_body: I was surprised to find that the canned Halo cat food is low in protein - even lower than Science Diet wet KD for cats.  And my cat refuses to eat the Science Diet food anyway.  She loves this (turkey) and also the chicken and salmon.

product_title: Melafix Fish Remedy
review_body: I purchase this all of the time for my fish. It's a natural remedy but costly and this seller is very reasonably priced.

product_title: Capstar Blue - 6 count for Dogs and Cats 2 - 25 lbs
review_body: I have 2 Chis and I find myself having to apply this stuff about once every 2 -3 weeks. I am going to try a different product next time.

product_title: Pioneer Pet Big Max Ceramic Drinking Fountain
review_headline: Terrific kitty water fountain, easy on the eyes too!
review_body: I love this product! it is nice to look at, easy to clean and works great for getting our 2 cats to drink more water! one of the cats, a 5 yr old male, was recently diagnosed with FIC, so the primary prescription is to get him to drink more water. This fountain is working great for that purpose. The water seems fresher, and the bowl is more at a natural height so the cats do not have to stoop down as much, as they did with the older water cannister version we had on the floor. I've only had to clean it about once every 2 weeks, and it is very easy to disassemble and clean. It's nice looking in our house too- like a naturalist relatation fountain. The only thing we had to get used to, was the sound of the motor for the pump. It's similar to that of a small fish tank pump. Not loud at all, but if you are not used to any sound of this nature, it takes about a week or so to get used to it. Eventually your brain just sort of \\"filters it out\\" into the background, along with street traffic noise, etc.

product_title: Omega Paw Tricky Treat Ball
review_headline: Not much better than using a food bowl
review_body:
The hole is much too large for most kibbled dog food. I bought this as a replacement for a lost feeding ball looks the same as the one in the picture. They are not the same. The hole in this new ball is much larger. It used to take Rusty about ten minutes to empty his old ball, but only about a quick minute for this one.

The whole point is for the treat ball to be \\"tricky\\", as in this ball's name. There's no trick and no fun in this one.

product_title: Cat Dancer - Cat Charmer Wand Teaser Toy
review_headline: One of my cats is ADDICTED to this toy.
review_body: Like, disturbingly so. It's a little scary. She and her sister, both 3 years old, are enamored by it. Even one of my 10-year-old cats gets into it from time to time.

product_title: Hi-Tor Neo Diet For Cats 5.5-oz cans
review_body: Like others, I found my cats initially interested, but they quickly (a couple of tries) decided that Hi-Tor Neo wasn't for them. For my two kitties with late-stage renal failure, I am working my way through some other commercial cat food options that don't advertise themselves as renal diets, but that have phosphorus and protein levels comparable to those of Neo-tor (which is a little higher than prescription renal diets). There is very valuable updated diet information available at [...] if you are looking for information on the protein and phosphorus content of cat foods (The site provides breakdowns for both canned and dry cat foods). I have found that they prefer the Organix flavors listed there, which have comparably low protein and even lower phosphorus. It is a little more expensive, but you can buy it by the can at local stores to try it-- I've never seen Hi-Tor Neo in a store.

product_title: Dogbed4less Gel Infused Cooling Memory Foam Dog Bed for Small, Medium to XL Large Pet, Waterproof Liner with Durable Washable Canvas Cover and Extra External Case
review_body: This is the best dog bed I have ever purchased.  Romy just loves it.  It is very easy to keep clean, just take the cover off and throw it in the washer.  Well worth the money.

product_title: Drinkwell 360 Pet Fountain
review_body: Sent it back. The clamps are very difficult to attach and remove for cleaning. The drink bowl is too narrow for kitties that want to drink from the bowl.  The water comes out far too quickly in a thick stream for kitties that like drippy style drinking and nearly makes then choke. Small pups may use it but larger dogs splash too much from the very narrow bowl canal.  My cats wouldn't use it. Waste of money!

review_body: This was a total nightmare.  There were not enough screws and the holes in the boards were not drilled in the proper places.  It has been a real pain going from hardware store to hardware store to try to find the right screws to fit.  NEVER AGAIN!

product_title: Outward Hound Kyjen  Egg Babies Turtle Plush Dog Toys Squeak Toy Dog Puzzle, Large
review_body: My puppy loves all his toys and this toy has 6 toys for the price of 1. (I paid 8 bucks). The eggs however are too big for my puppy. He can put it in his mouth, but can't squeak it. I think it's worth the money, however, my puppy does not get the eggs out through the opening though and just plays with the toys separately. I guess it is a dog's toy not a puppy's toy. product_title: MidWest Homes for Pets Foldable Metal Exercise Pen / Pet Playpen, 8 Panels Each
review_headline: Not quite as nice as the Petco version

product_title: Whisper In-Tank Filter 3i for 1 - 3 gallon aquariums (25846)
review_headline: It does the job well for the price.
review_body: This filter does the job. I have had this filter for more than 10 months and after buying a stronger air pump it works great. The water is clear, no odor, and it acts as a beading ground for my snails. Now I do use it as a supplemental filter because the stock filter on my Fluval Chi is kind of a joke. product_title: SENSE-ible No-Pull Dog Harness - Black Medium
review_body: This harness makes it possible to walk my spaz-tastic maniac of a border collie. However after three years, one of the plastic spokes of the fastener broke off, and now I have to replace the whole thing. My suggestion is to look locally to see if you can get it cheaper. product_title: Nylabone Frisbee - Small
review_headline: Cute little frisbee for a puppy or small dog
review_body: [[ASIN:B0002ASMBW Nylabone Frisbee - Durable Flying Disc 4 1/2\\"]]  I bought this for my Shiba Inu puppy and it is the right size for him, even now at 16 weeks old, he still plays fetch with it and it is durable.  This is a hard plastic toy.

product_title: Ceva Feliway Plug-In Diffuser Refill for Cats
review_body: I have 3 cats and two are well behaved but the third is nicknamed Mr Trouble.  He does things like picking on the other cats and getting into the trash (and anything else he shouldn't) plus waking me in the night with meows and pawing.  However as long as I have these plug-ins running he is much, much better behaved and the change is right away.  The plug-ins don't seem to affect the other two but they have a much sweeter nature naturally.  The product is a bit expensive and the first time I got six and plugged them in to every room.  For just 30 days that is a hefty cost for me.  So I let them run out and put up with the poor behavior for a while.  Finally I ordered again but this time I put one in the room Mr Trouble spends his time all day (while I'm at work) and the other in the livingroom.  It seems to work just as well and this way this supply will last me three months which is much more manageable.  I have friends who have tried the product too and as you will read it seems to work great for many but doesn't work for every cat.  Not surprising really since every cat, like every human, is different.  But if you have behavior problems see your vet first and make certain your cat is healthy (I had mine checked by the vet first).  After that I'd highly recommend trying this product.  It makes a big difference in our household where we all are more peaceful and happier now.

product_title: Taste of the Wild Canned Dog Food
review_headline: Fantastic quality grain free product at good price
review_body:
I've done hours and hours of homework on high quality, grain-free dog foods. From product analysis, kcal analysis, ingredients, customer reviews, professional reviews, company recalls - all of it... I have become a mini-expert in the field.

I was pushed into becoming an expert because my yellow Lab kept having seizures and I couldn't figure out the source. I finally learned it was her food, which was the most expensive store bought brand my local Sams Warehouse carries. I thought I was giving her the best, it looked fresh and rich, but it turns out it was just absolutely terrible food. My black Lab also had terrible skin allergies, to the point where I would get a small rash on my skin if he laid next to me on the couch for more than 5 minutes at a time. I had no clue it was because of the food. But it was!

Since having that epiphany and learning so much about dog food, I've always made sure to feed them the highest quality grain free food I can buy. This Taste of the Wild (TOTW) fits the bill very nicely, and they love it. Since switching to a grain free diet, the yellow lab has not had any more seizures in over a year, and the black lab has the silkiest coat you've ever seen and his skin allergies are completely gone.

They are on 2/3rds dry and 1/3rd wet combination. Contrary to what I had previously been raised to believe, a wet diet is not bad for dogs but in fact is superior! I use the combination to save money while providing them the best I can.

Before deciding on TOTW, I had also tried Blue Buffalo, Wellness Core, and Orijen. Briefly: they are all good foods, but my labs were happiest on TOTW and my wallet is also happiest on TOTW. I also believe TOTW has a better formulation for them and their life style (some of the products, like Orijen, are simply too rich for the average household dog, despite being made of the best ingredients available).

Enter TOTW. The dry food is dark and rich, withno sign of crumbling. The kibble is a good average size. The wet food has nice chunks of meat and the right amount of gravy. I use the wet food as a topper to mix the 2/3rd dry and 1/3rd wet together for their meals. I use one whole can of wet per meal with my pack, which is convinient so I don't have to store it in the refrigerator - btw, never store canned dog food in the fridge in the original aluminum container!

I still wish I could find a less expensive product with the same quality, but in the mean time, TOTW is the best choice for my pack.

review_body: This is the first product I have purchased of the Plato brand that was a disappointment. Kangaroo never again!

product_title: Bindaboo Pet Gates - 3.5 Gate extension, black
review_body: These extensions are great.  Although, I have read that you can go up to about 12 feet in span, I have also read that the span is limited to about 6 feet.   Not sure what the real story is but for a wider doorway or hallway, this is great.  See my other Bindaboo gate reviews.

product_title: Outward Hound Squeaker Matz

She absolutely loves to run around squeaking her head off.  This Christmas she got the Gator and likes it just as much.  It appears to be equally well constructed.  Plush puppies are great dog toys.

product_title: Hartz Dura Play Ball for Medium to Large dogs (Colors may vary)…

review_body: My dog loves this medium sized toy. She loves to play fetch and doesn't chew up the flexa foam toys. I wish Hartz would make more of them. I would buy one of every of them. Great toy keep making them Hartz, I don't know what I'm gonna do, or for that matter my dog is going to do if you quit making them. Good job Hartz!!!!

product_title: Pet Zone Cozy Cottage Durable Plastic Dog House
review_body: My dogs love 'em, I love 'em, They're gr-r great! BTW, I bought 3.

product_title: Skip-Flea and Tick Shampoo Cat Coconut Berry 18-Ounce
review_headline: STAY AWAY! my indoor cat of 9yrs got horroble rash fur fell out

product_title: Wysong Call of the Wild Dog Food Supplements
review_headline: makes a homecooked diet simple and great
review_body: I think that this product is wonderful!      My dog and cats love the taste of it.  I would never be able to provide the same level of nutrition to my pets by using only my own ingredients.  This enhances the nutrtional level of my pets' meals considerably.  And it is so easy to use.  I often add some fresh vegetables, blueberries, and a very small amount of liver too, instead of just boneless meat or fish, but that's optional because all of those things are already included in Call of the Wild.  All you really have to do is add one teaspoon of Call of the Wild to every 3 ounces of fresh meat, stir it up, and serve. It's that simple to give your pet a fresh food complete and balanced stellar diet.    I used to think that the best kibbles like Orijen, Nature's Variety Instinct, etc, were okay for my dog.  Call of the Wild with fresh meat or fish is a far beter diet for my dog.  What a comfort it is to know that my pets are getting the nutrients of a natural diet: raw meats, organs, connective tissues, vitamins, minerals, fruits, vegetables, fiber, fats, antioxidents etc. -- about everthing that they'd get from eating natural prey and other natural foods.  And this is not expensive.  It's very convenient and uncomplicated.    I use Call of the Wild for most of the pets' meals (and sometimes I also feed Stella and Chewey's freeze dried raw.)    My dog devours the homecooked meats with this stuff on it. I would not be able to provide the same level of nutriton without this product.    I very highly recommend this product for homecooked pet meals.    You should also get a food scale to weigh the meat, so you can add the correct amount of Call of the Wild.  Use measuring spoons, too.  The only other thing you need is fish oil with natural vitamin E for days that you don't feed sardines or wild salmon.     I cannot see myself ever going back to feeding kibble again, not even the best of them like Orijen or Nature's Variety Instinct that I used for a long time.  I am very convinced that fresh meat with Call of the Wild + occasional Stella and Chewy's freeze dried raw meals is a far better diet for my dog than when I fed the best grain free kibbles.     It's worked out great for feeding my two cats and extraordinarily active German Shepherd dog.

product_title: MidWest iCrate Single Door & Double Door Folding Metal Dog Crates
review_body: The cage works wonderfully for traveling, it even fit in my suitcase which was very nice for the plane ride.  The tray comes out and there is plenty of space inside.  I think it work really nice, just need to watch your fingers when collapsing it.

product_title: KONG Genius Mike Dog Toy, Colors vary
review_headline: Great way to slow down fast eaters
review_body: I currently own two of these Kong Genius Mike Dog Toys and I love them.  I have found the Mike dog toys to be both durable and a great aid in slowing down my dog when he's eating his meals.  I give my labradoodle all of his meals via the Mike toy.  In advance of feeding my dog, I fill the Mike dog toy with his kibble and then  \\"seal\\" both ends with a very small amount of wet dog food.  I then put the dog toy into the freezer; the frozen ends of the Mike toy slow my dog down that much more when it comes time for him to eat.  I honestly have no complaints at all about this toy and it really does force my dog to eat more slowly which is a lot better for his health.

product_title: Groomaster Black & Gold Designer Grooming Shears for Pets,  6.5" Curved with Ball-Tip
review_body: These scissors are so sharp that I have to pay attention when using them with my dogs.  Easy to hold when using.  Selling point for me was the curved ends for trimming around my dog's eyes and ears.  I am just a beginner in grooming my own pets and had no idea what I would need for the job.  The price was alright it was a bit more for me to spend not knowing if they would meet my needs.  Bottom line good scissors for trimming my pets and very sharp blades.

product_title: Ideal Pet Products Ruff-Weather Pet Door with Telescoping Frame
review_body: Love these door they keep the heat in and cold out. I have 2 real big ones for my 3 great danes. Really recommend them to all of the people wanting a good sturdy doggy door.

product_title: Precision Pet Ultimate Exercise Pen
review_body: My Chihuahua had puppies and I needed something in a hurry to contain them when they got too big for the whelping box....The only place I had to put them was in my craft room so the pen was perfect to keep them contained and from keeping them from getting into things... product_title: Omega Paw Tricky Treat Ball
review_body:

Sheri

product_title: IncrediBubbles
review_body: These bubbles are so much fun.  My dog loves them.  The best part is that they don't pop as soon as you blow them.  The bad side about that is that they will stick to thinks and leave soap marks, but they are easily cleaned.  I love them.

product_title: Roll n Clean Self Cleaning Litter Box
review_body:

product_title: Zack & Zoey Polyester/Cotton Basic Dog Hoodie
