product_title: PetSafe Yard & Park Rechargeable Dog Training Collar with Tone and Static Correction, Waterproof, Up to 400 Yards
review_body: well i looked at many products and took a shot at this one.  i've owned it for about a month and it works flawlessly.  my dog responded to the stimulation very quickly and our walks are much improved.  he used to bolt off running at other dogs and wouldn't listen and there were times he would ignore my commands.  NOW, he gets it!  after one month he will come on command and sit at my feet (most of the time)...this thing WORKS!    FRANK

product_title: FURminator FURejector deShedding Tool for Dogs
review_headline: Every time I use this I'm amazed ...
review_body: I'm amazed at how much hair this thing removes from my thick coated lab. It does wonders, and the dogs seem to love it. I would point out however that it really only works for dogs with thick (or wavy) hair. On dogs with what I'd call normal coats, it's not very effective since it targets the undercoat.

product_title: SHERPA SPORT DUFFLE Dog Cat Animal Pet Carrier Bag & Tote. Airline/Subway/Rail Approved. Size-Medium Color-Red w/ Reflective Sliver Trim
review_body: I used this when I moved to Germany. It fit perfect under the seat on the plane. I have a Chihuahua and she was very comfortable on the 8 hr flight.

product_title: Fluval Underwater Filter
review_body: I purchased and recommend the U3..    The U1 out of the U series ( U1, U2, U3, U4 ) is the only one who does not have a carbon insert.    This ONLY has a sponge, if you do not have carbon. I will assure you it is not cleaning your water, it is simply catching debris.     In some instances this filter may work for you, but for the average customer... look at the U2.

product_title: MidWest Deluxe Bolster Pet Bed for Dogs & Cats
review_body: Seemed a little light on the cushioning on hardwood floors. When cleaning stacked two together and seems to give just enough extra padding. An earlier reviewer suggested cutting a dense exercise mat to fit under the bed for use in a crate. Would also work on hardwood floors and I might do that instead of stacking.

product_title: Advantage Once-A-Month Topical Flea Treatment for Cats
review_body: I was very happy to find this product for my cat at such a great price.  Can't say that my cat is happy about it, though.

product_title: Purina Friskies Savory Shreds Wet Cat Food - 24-5.5 oz. Cans
review_body: I love this program with Amazon.  I have many subscriptions for catfood.  The only problem I have with it, is the prices are changing CONSTANTLY/daily.  Seriously, I have to monitor my account almost every day.  The prices jump around from $9/case to $17/case ALL THE TIME.  I did not understand that part when I signed up for subscribe and save.  In the beginning, I ended up paying $17/case a few times (becuz I was not watching to see what the price was on my shipment day).  I can get it at WalMart for $10-$11/case.  I figured, subscribing meant locking in the price, and that is not the case with this program.  Now I watch them alot and I am just cancelling and re-activating everything all the time.  I will only do this if it is cheaper for me than I pay at WalMart.  I have lots of cats and I also feed strays, so I need to save money on catfood whenever possible.

product_title: Chicken Soup for the Dog Lover's Soul Dry Dog Food for Adult Dog, Large Breed Chicken Flavor, 35 Pound Bag
review_headline: Rated highly by website review..... great price too
review_body:
[...]

What's good about this food.... Awesome meat content, no fillers or by-prodcuts, quality grains, flaxseed, many fruits and veggies.

Ingredients:

Chicken, turkey, chicken meal, ocean fish meal, cracked pearled barley, whole grain brown rice, oatmeal, millet, white rice, chicken fat (preserved with mixed tocopherols), potatoes, egg product, tomato pomace, duck, salmon, flaxseed, natural chicken flavor, choline chloride, dried chicory root, kelp, carrots, peas, apples, tomatoes, blueberries, spinach, dried skim milk, cranberry powder, rosemary extract, parsley flake, yucca schidigera extract, L-carnitine, Enterococcus faecieum, Lactobacillus casei, Lactobacillus acidophilus, Saccharomyces cerevesiae fermentation solubles, dried Aspergillus oryzae fermentation extract, vitamin E supplement, iron proteinate, zinc proteinate, copper proteinate, ferrous sulfate, zinc sulfate, copper sulfate, potassium iodide, thiamine mononitrate, manganese proteinate, manganous oxide, ascorbic acid, vitamin A supplement, biotin, calcium pantothenate, manganese sulfate, sodium selenite, pyridoxine hydrochloride (vitamin B6), vitamin B12 supplement, riboflavin, vitamin D supplement, folic acid.

Review:
This is their rating...
The thing I love about the Chicken Soup foods are that they have their priorities in order (meat first) and that they throw an entire garden's worth of fruits and veggies into the food. It's quite the eclectic list of ingredients here...

First, they have 4 meat products to start the product, which is among the best you will see anywhere. The grains they use afterwards are the types we like to see, such as rice and oatmeal. There aren't any cheap fillers like corn, soy or wheat.

There are potatoes for a high-quality carb source, and eggs for further protein. Duck and salmon are somewhat far down the list, but they only add to the variety of meat sources in this food. Plus, look at the fruits and veggies: carrots, peas, apples, tomatoes, blueberries and spinach. It's hard to beat that.

All of this in a food that is VERY reasonably priced!berries and spinach. It's hard to beat that. All of this in a food that is VERY reasonably priced!

product_title: Cadet Retriever Rolls Rawhide 10"
review_body: My 12 lbs. Min Pins and 25 lbs. Jack Russell love these bones.    PROS:    1. Noticeably fresh (zip-lock package)  2. Durable (even when moist)  3. No residue  4. Inexpensive    For the above reasons I immediately noticed that my dogs never lost interest in them (to this day) and that they paced themselves much better on them compared to other rawhides... they frequently lose interest in other rawhide brands or binge eat them because they're so weak - NOT the case with Cadet... Anyway, I imagine these  10 inch rolls are ideal for dogs under 60 lbs - any larger and you may not notice the same difference i have.

product_title: Litter Champ 3-Pack Refill, Green
review_body: What a great way to discard the litter and only have to use 1 bag a week.  Great product as well as price

product_title: Go Pet Club Cat Tree Condo House, 32W x 25L x 47.5H Inches, Beige
review_body: We bought this as a Christmas gift.  It's very sturdy and the kitty likes it.  It was easy to put together and a nice neutral color.  I've purchased other towers for less, but not quite as nice as this one.....

product_title: Petmate Take Two Adjustable Lead with Cushioned Handle - Black - 1"
review_body:
This is my second leash that has a coupler where I can walk both my dogs together on the same lead. The first one I bought was in 2007 and it lasted a long time considering how hard my dogs can pull on the leash. The part that swivels broke, but the rest of the leash stayed in tact. I thought the leash was pretty durable considering I used it everyday and walked my dogs two times a day. They range in weight from 70 lbs to 90 lbs and the leash held up through all the walks and pulls.

It didn't fray during the three years and we still use the old one. My husband walks them with the old leash and when I walk the dogs I use the new one. The padded grip of the leash where you hold onto it as you walk is fantastic. It's easy on the hands and makes walking them more pleasant. The width of the leash is 1 inch and I like that it is wider. I bought one from PetSmart that was a smaller width before I found this leash and I didn't like it. The fabric frayed and I didn't like the small width.

The main reason I love this leash so much is the ability to have both dogs on one leash. Trying to juggle two dogs with separate leashes or leads, this can be frustrating, because the leashes get tangled. With this leash, you don't have to worry about getting tangled and the dogs walk right next to each other with no problems.

I will use this leash forever!!

product_title: Crazy K Farm Avian Haven Hut Green Large 15 inch x 12 inch x 7 inch
review_body:
I purchased this item so that our Yellow Nape Amazon parrot, Max, would have a place to retreat to and perch in for the night. It arrived packed flat (it is constructed of sewn felt with Velcro straps for attaching to the cage), and had to be ironed in order to maintain its' boxy shape. While there is a perch access hole located opposite the arched front opening, when used, the hight of the perch was too high to allow clearance for Max's head when perched inside the large size hut (billed as the appropriate size for Amazons). The Velcro fasteners proved to be another challenge with the single top front one not providing the necessary support to keep the sides of the hut from sagging and semi-collapsing. Two possible solutions for this problem are to either install a box frame work (possibly of stiff wire) or simply replace the top center front Velcro with two, one at each top front corner.
As Max is very inquisitive and loves boxes and exploring small dark spaces, it didn't take long before he was inside his new Haven Hut and snuggling up to it's fleece lined rear wall. I have provided a heated Thermo Perch (Max is an older bird and suffers somewhat from arthritis) for him to perch on and he seems to be happy using the Hut overnight for sleeping since I lowered the perch to just below the level of the Hut's open bottom.
I would recommend the Avian Haven Hut (available in three sizes) for anyone wanting to provide privacy (or just a place to hide) for their bird especially if they do not cover the cage at night, or there is a likelihood of drafts.

product_title: KONG Cat Zoom Groom Brush
review_headline: the only brush my cats can stand
review_body: I also have a slicker brush and the furminator. Now I love the furminator but my cats don't like it. They also do not care for the slicker brush. They get excited to be brushed with the ZoomGroom. They also like to chew it up when I'm not looking so I'm on my 2nd one. So, the ZoomGroom might not remove all the loose hair but it's better than them running away from the other 2 brushes. I now buy ZoomGroom for other cat owners.

product_title: RapidBath Deluxe Dog Bathing System
review_body: This is a great item.  I have a English Springer Spaniel who loves mud & rain. I hooked the Rapid Bath  up to my hose & if her paws are dirty, I just click it on & her paws are clean in less than 2 minutes.

product_title: Tuffy Jr's Fish Dog Toy
review_headline: Dog hasn't checked through it yet!!
review_body: My dog liked his new toy (didn't love it though!) He's a 20 lb poodle mix and this size was perfect for him. He has started to tear some of the edges but hasn't chewed through the toy yet. So far, so good...might have to get another one and throw out all the cheap toys!

product_title: Outward Hound Hide-A-Squirrel and Puzzle Plush Squeaking Toys for Dogs
review_body: This product had so much potential! My dog liked playing with it and was nosing his way in to get to the bees. The problem came after he got to them! He started working on bee #1 and by the end of the day he had chewed through all three! He is a pretty dedicated chewer so I don't know how an average chewer would do with this. He still plays with the bee hive and carries it all around the house! :)

product_title: Kong Classic Dog Toy
review_headline: The Kong gets a perfect "eight ears up" rating.
review_body:
The short review: Buy it, your dogs will love it.

The detailed review:
My house and yard is home to four rescued dogs of various sizes and temperaments. Trying to find something all will enjoy and can be used both inside and outside has been an impossible task. I took a chance and ordered one Kong in hopes at least one would use it. Opening the package released a strong, rubbery smell which, thankfully, diminished over several days. Initially, none of the four dogs had any remote interest in the toy other than a quick sniff when it was bounced across the floor. Once loaded with treats it was another story entirely. It took a few days of repeated use but now if any of them see me holding the Kong they sit eagerly and fully alert until the Kong is filled with treats and placed on the floor or given to one of them. It is indeed a hit and currently the most desired toy in the house. All enjoy it with treats inside but my two chewers will chew on it just for the joy of chewing, treats or not.

The large Kong is more approiately sized for my larger two dogs, 65 and 85 lbs. However, my Australian Kelpie at 30 lbs., the smallest dog and most aggressive chewer, has no problems getting the small end of the large Kong in his mouth and going to his spot to gnaw on it at his leisure. After 3 weeks of continuous use the Kong has held up well and other than a few tooth marks is undamaged. Immediately after finishing this review I'm ordering 3 more of various sizes so each dog can have his or her own.

All four dogs rate this \\"two ears up\\" for a total rating of eight, their highest possible rating. Wish I'd purchased these sooner.

product_title: Marineland Eclipse Seamless Desktop Corner Aquarium, 5-Gallon
review_body: I purchased this aquarium a month ago.  The aquarium itself seems nice, the filter however is very cheap and poorly made.  It stopped working after two weeks of use.  I have had several other aquariums before and know filters can be quirky and often need to be repaired, but this was clearly broken.  I had to rush out to find another filter so that my fish wouldn't die.  Once I found a filter, I quickly discovered the tank is designed to only fit the filter it comes with.  I had to completely take the top of the tank apart to make a filter even fit.  I will not be buying this product or brand again.

product_title: FURminator Large Yellow deShedding Tool with 4-Inch Edge
review_headline: Didn't know my dog had so much hair!
review_body:
This tool is great! My dog has dense under layer of hair. I don't think the fur-rejector would be much help, because hair is not in the least difficult to remove from tool.
To be effective it needs to be used often.

product_title: Bionaire Odor Grabber Litter Box
review_body: I have three cats and only one litter box so it is used heavily. I've had it for about two weeks now and am very happy with it.   The pan is large so the cats don't feel cramped. The power cord is nice and long so you're pretty sure to have an outlet close enough to put it wherever you want. The assembly was easy enough although i had to manouver the parts a bit to get it to all snap together. The filter works wonders to filter out odors. When i come home now i don't smell the tell tale catbox odor anymore. The fan is quiet enough although i would not recomend having it in your bedroom or living room. Ours is in the hall and when the house is quiet it's only a faint whisper. The filter strength indicator lights are very helpful to let you know when it needs to be changed.   At first i wasn't planning to use the scooper that comes with it however the curved edge of the scooper works better to get clumps stuck to the sides of the pan better than my old square edged scoop. Two of my cats were a little nervous about the hum of the fan at first but got over it quickly and used it the very first day.   If you are looking for a litter box that will handle the odors but don't want to drop a couple hundred dollars on a self cleaning box, this is the perfect solution.  Highly recommended!

product_title: KONG Wobbler Treat Dispensing Dog Toy
review_body: This entertained my lab but she was able to unscrew it and chew pieces so it wouldn't reconnect. Overall I like this treat toy but will buy another making sure to put it back together as soon as she unscrews it.

product_title: Purina Fancy Feast Medleys Tuscany Collection Gourmet Wet Cat Food Variety Pack- (24) 3 oz. Cans
review_body: My cats all love this cat food.  I have been giving it to them for seven years and they always like it.  It is so easy to have AMazon.com deliver the food on schedule.  That way I don't have to worry about running out.

product_title: Cat Mate Elite I.D. Disc Cat Flap with Timer Control - White
review_headline: Great Design, Excellent Product - Very Racoon Proof
review_body: We have had two of these CatMate doors for about a year now for our 3 cats.  One cat can't be in the house due to spraying incidents, so I have 1 pet door to the outside allowing all cats into the garage (where their food is) or out, the other pet door on the inside door to the house is programmed to exclude the miscreant.  This has solved an otherwise intractable problem.  These doors have performed flawlessly and amazingly - and I have yet to change a battery even though they are used probably at least a dozen times each day.  We have a lot of raccoons in the neighborhood and we have had no problems - looking at the design, there is no way a raccoon could defeat the locking mechanism (unless they tailgated a cat in, but it would have to be quick, as the door self-locks only a few seconds after the cat transits), two pins raise up well into the flap.  It took a little while to train out cats to use the CatMate - when one would go to the front door wanting out, I would just carry it to the pet door and \\"stuff\\" it out... same thing if one was at the front door wanting in, I would carry it to the pet door and \\"stuff\\" it in.  lol.  Within a week they were all using the doors.  Also very nice when going on vacation they can be free to do as they wish (as cats prefer).  No regrets buying this product - it was well worth the money.  We love it!

product_title: Litter Box Enclosure
review_headline: Kitties loved using the litter box enclosure!
review_body: The litter box enclosure was exactly as advertised. I love the inside, it has a spill proof almost like plastic on the inside that makes it very easy to clean up. My cat goes in there does his thing, and it really helps to keep the odor down. It's very easy to clean, just take the top off and pull the litter box out. Well worth the money, thanks New Cat Condos!

product_title: OUT! Stain and Odor Remover, 24 oz.
review_body: I have 2 boxer puppies who are not fully house trained yet....so whenever they have an accident I just spray it on the spot, let it set a few minutes...then I scrub the spot up. Pretty easy and effective, the odor is gone! Love this product!

product_title: CATMANDOO Bonito Flakes
review_headline: Best stuff ever - yes, Kitty Crack
review_body: A new pet supply store opened in my area a few weeks ago, they gave me a free sample of this stuff, and told me if I bought some I could return any unsed portion if my cats did not like it. They know what they are doing, I went back and told them this is Kitty Crack. My 1.5 year old male has started refusing to eat unless I put some of this in his food. He races me to the kitchen when I go to it for anything, hoping I'll give him some more Kitty Crack. The six month old kittens gobble it up too. The 4 oz bag is less expensive than the 1 oz container, so I'll be ordering from Amazon a lot. I can only hope my male gets tired of it :)

product_title: Frontline Plus Flea and Tick Control for Dogs and Puppies 8 weeks or older, 45 to 88 lbs, 3-Doses
review_headline: Doesn't work the full 30 days on my dog.
review_body: I have used Frontline Plus on all my dogs for years. It works great on my toy poodle and bichon; who are indoor 22/7.   Now for my other dog a pitbull mix.. he gets ticks 3 weeks after I put in the application. I thought the ticks were suppose to die when they bit the dogs skin, but these ticks don't die! they feed on his blood :,( it gets bad. He stays outside 16 hours a day. I dont know why front line doesn't work with him. It works great with my other dogs.

product_title: Karen Pryor, Training Treat Pouch
review_body: This is a well thought-out bag and is comfortable to use but the execution leaves much to be desired. The velcro on both of mine started coming loose after a month. Also the strap stitching doesn't look very solid (there's only a single line of it instead of either a zig-zag or a cross) and the cut ends started unraveling immediately and needed to be sealed with a flame. Both problems are easy to fix but I don't think that I should have to be dealing with them. My Premier treat pouch is still in one piece, although I don't like it as much as this one. Don't get this bag unless you are handy with a needle and thread.

product_title: Merry Pet Tropical Island with Cushion - Small Bamboo Pet Bed
review_body: A cute bed for sure, I would just like to point out that I found it locally in the pet section of Publix supermarket for $25 cheaper.

product_title: Flexi Classic Retractable Cord/Tape Lead
review_body: Great product that does exactly what it claims! Strong and comfortable - the recoil mechanism works flawlessly. The extra long lead (26')lets our dog feel free and we all enjoy our hikes more.

product_title: Exotic Environments Forgotten Ruins Aquarium Ornament
review_body: Since this is a PRODUCT review, I decided to rate it based on the product, itself.  It's a very nice item, and would have looked even better in my daughter's little fish tank.  I guess the reason I did not give it five stars is because the manufacturer has to take a little blame for a product that breaks so easily during shipment.      The first time I received this item, one of the back corners on the bottom was completely broken off.  I decided to do an exchange.  When the second one arrived, the OTHER back corner was completely shattered.  These failed transactions are a combination of poor packaging (Amazon), careless handling (USPS), and bad construction (manufacturer).    I will not be taking a third chance on this product, and I really regret that my daughter will not get to enjoy it in her fish tank.  If you're willing to risk the chance that it might arrive intact, I would probably recommend the product because I think that, compared to pet stores, the price of this item is very good.  But if you don't have to patience to deal with products arriving damaged, I recommend going to your local pet shop and spending the extra $5 or $10 for a comparable item.    I hope this helps.

product_title: Outward Hound Kyjen   Designer Pet Saver Life Jacket, Orange
review_body: This life jacket in a size small works great for my King Charles Spaniel when we go canoeing.  He doesn't seem to mind it or find it uncomfortable and it definitely helps him to float and keep his head above the water.  Can't beat it for the price (these things are fifty bucks at REI!).

product_title: Domestic Pet Beds Luxury Corner Pet Bed Winner
review_body: The bed is quite nice and well constructed, however it is far from dark chocolate in color.  it's more of a silvery charcoal.  there is also no way to remove and wash the cover for the bed pad (the bed frame cover is removable).  i find that strange since it's the cover that needs to be washed, not the frame.  2 big caveats in my book, but a nice bed overall.

product_title: Andis 2-Speed Detachable Plus Pet Clipper
review_body: Spectacular performance for a great price. I'm completely satisfied with this purchase. I've tried several clippers over the years in a similar price range and this is the best by leaps and bounds.

product_title: MidWest Deluxe Bolster Pet Bed for Dogs & Cats
review_body: Our golden loves this comfy bed. It is easy to throw into the washing machine and it is practically dry when you take it out. We have found other dog beds to be too large to wash at home in our large capacity machine. This is the perfect size for small or medium size dog. We expect our pup to be enjoying this comfy fleece though adulthood at 75-80 pounds. It is also great to put onto the seat of your car if you are strapping your dog in with a harness. This protects your seat from dirt or slobber...and, again, it is so easy to throw into the washing machine. Perfect size for crate.

product_title: The Tick Key
review_body: So far I have removed about 25 ticks from my dog with this and every one came off cleanly with no tick parts left in the dog.   Plus it's made in the USA.  Update: Since my review I cleanly removed a deer tick nymph, (which is very small), off of myself with the Tick Key.

product_title: MidWest Quiet Time Pet Bed Deluxe Black Fur Pet Mat
review_body: This mat fit perfectly in my large dog's kennel.  Washed in washing machine very nicely as well.  I think my dog liked this mat so much that he ate it.  It was good while it lasted!

product_title: PetSafe SlimCat Interactive Toy and Food Dispenser
review_headline: Broke after a while, but good and cheap enough to buy again
review_body: My cat really liked it.  She didn't really run around with it, but at least rolled it around.  I kept it from her sometimes because she learned that she can get more food out if she bangs in on the wall, which can be kind of annoying.  The part that controls the size of the holes broke after a while, so now food just falls out.  I'll give it another go and buy one more.

product_title: Pet Stages Catnip Two Toss
review_body: My cat loves chasing these things around.  I used to live in a small apartment, so I had to work her out every day.  These were her favorite toys to run after and jump for, even when she was a kitten.  I love the look of them, and all the Pet Stages fabric toys... They make such cool looking toys for cats.

product_title: IRIS Neat 'n Dry Premium Pet Training Pads, Regular, 17.5" x 23.5"
review_body: I read the reviews and thought i would try something new.  I have a shitzu and he is about 10 pds.  The pad does not hold the pea and is extremely small.  I will go back to the previous pads I was using..

product_title: Tail Teaser Dog Toys Squeak Toy Exercise Training Toy with Replacement Squeaker by Outward Hound, Colors may vary
review_body: My first review, but I had to mention how much our Cavalier King Charles Spaniel, Mouse, loves this toy!  He was a bit intimidated by it for the first three or four minutes, being as it was almost as big as him, but once he got going, there was no stopping him!  I'm not sure how it would hold up with a bigger or more aggresive breed, but it does seem well-made, and even comes with an extra toy animal in case the first one wears out or you just want a change.  On a side note, it arrived in a HUGE box!  It was comical...my husband asked what the heck I had ordered, and when I said I could only remember ordering a dog toy, we both doubted that was what was in there.  Sure enough, it was our Kyjen \\"fishing pole\\".  I bought it intending it to be used only by hubby (he has a bad back that makes bending difficult sometimes), but if I'm a bit too stiff and sore to play, this is a God-send!  I can sit in a chair, play with Mouse, and wait for him to tire himself out chasing it!  I know the price seems high for a dog toy, but it's worth every penny!

product_title: Skyscraper Cat Tree
review_body: Hi! I recieved my kitty tower yesterday.  As previous reviews have said the directions were a bit difficult to follow, as it was just a picture, but I knew that going into it from previous reviews.  It took me about an hour and a half to put it together by myself for the most part.  I did have to kind of plug and play with some of the pieces as they are hard to tell apart and not labeled.  That being said, once I got it together and positioned where it was going to stay, it would not budge.  I put it a bit to close to our patio door and had trouble with the verticals and tried to scoot it just a few inches and it would not budge.  Very sturdy!  My ceilings are only 8 foot, so we left out the top posts, and just used the \\"legs\\" that were supposed to \\"connect\\" it to the ceiling without the top.  I had in my head that the top part would be similar to a tension rod, and it was not.  It just uses a screw and a wingnut to snuggle it to the ceiling.  The cubby holes are a bit on the smaller size for larger cats, aas well as the little bed.  I will probable end up removing the pole that the bed sits on and just put the bed right on that platform so my kitty can fit in it.  The triangle shaped cubby on the bottom part is a very good size though, even for a larger cat.  My larger kitty is about 17 lbs, so he may not be your average kitty :)  The ladder also was a pain and I did not even get it attatched yet.  It does not seem to have the correct holes drilled in the lower platform, but again I knew that might be an issue going in for previous reviews.  It is not a major concern for me as I dont think my kitties will use them anyway, but i may try to mess with it enough to get them working in the future.  All in all, Awsome product for the price!  Well worth it!!

product_title: Armarkat Round or Oval Shape Pet Cat Bed for Cats and Small Dogs
review_body: I bought this bed for my 10 pound cat.  She fits in it well with room to spread out, or in case she gets bigger.  Seems like you could also use it for a small dog.  The bed quality seems to be good and the padding is nice.  I ordered the brown and cream color and I like it.

product_title: Zanies Cheese Wedge Display Boxes, 60 Furry Mice Toys for Cats
review_body: By these. My cat adores these. They're her favorite toy. She plays with them on her own (tosses them around in her hand and carries them around in her mouth), but she LOVES it when we throw them across the room! By far her favorite.

product_title: Downtown Pet Supply PUPPY PADS - Dog Wee Wee Housebreaking Disposable Training Pads
review_headline: Best Pads I've Tried So Far!
review_body: I feel like I am on a never ending quest for the right pads for my 2 Yorkies.  Nothing ever seems to work that great.  For years we were using the Arm and Hammer pads and when they switched from blue to white, they suddenly became just plain terrible.  So I decided to try these... They worked great.  They absorbed very well and the urine didn't spread.  For the first time in a long time, the dogs didn't get any mess on their feet.  The only negative is the size.  I wish they were the 24 x 24 inch size.    Not sure why they are no longer available.. please Amazon, bring them back!

product_title: Tuffy Mega Dog Toys
review_body: We have 2 labs and every time we buy toys they are destroyed within a few minutes. About a year ago we got a Tuff's Mega Ring and to this day they still have it. Yes, it is starting to get a hole in the ring but they are very rough with it. Well worth the purchase.

product_title: Halo Liv-A-Littles Holistic Freeze Dried Dog Treats and Cat Treats, Wild Salmon, 1.6 OZ of Freeze Dried Wild Salmon
review_body: They are highly addictive and may lead to bad behavior. If you enjoy your cat jumping on the counter every time you enter the kitchen, get these!

product_title: Bags On Board Retractable Leash with Built-in Bag Dispenser
review_body: leash works well, retracts with ease.  my dog was chewing his hemp leash, but this is no longer a problem since this leash is so thin. bags can be difficult to tear off but well worth the convenience.

product_title: Zoo Med Floating Betta Log
review_headline: Creative item that betta really enjoys
review_body:
The floating betta log appears to be made of some kind of resin, and the main flaw with it is that every couple of months it sinks to the bottom. I just take it out for a few days to let it dry up, and it them floats again. Betta really likes this object and frequently rests inside it. He makes bubble nests in the hole at the top. Last time I put it in his tank after a drying session, he swam right in and stayed there even though the filter was spinning it around. It was hilarious.

product_title: Ergo Auto Pet Waterer
review_headline: Buy the medium, the large tank develops cracks
review_body: We had purchased this as a set with the feeder and the waterer seemed to work ok.  However, after a few months, the plastic on the tank for the waterer cracked and dumped all of the water onto our hardwood floors.  We were able to get the manufacturer to warranty the tank but we talked them into sending us the medium tank instead of the large and we haven't had a problem since (over 1 year ago).  I think the problem is that the plastic on the tank will fatigue (similar to metal fatigue) and eventually crack.  The medium size tank doesn't flex nearly as much and it dosn't seem to be as big of a problem.  I would highly recommend getting the medium waterer instead of the large to prevent this issue.    As far as use, the water would start to smell after a day or two after filling until I started washing the parts (except the tank) in the dishwasher and I put bleach in the dishwasher to disenfect the components.  I also wash out the tank with a little bit of bleach and then rinse it several times to get the bleach out.  This works pretty well and I don't get a foul odor anymore.  I have a 40 lb. puppy and a 80 lb. adult dog and they empty a medium tank in about 5-6 days.  I also put the filter in the dishwasher with the rest of the components and I can usually get two tankfuls out of a filter before it clogs up.  Plan on buying a lot of filters.  Amazon has the best price on the filters.

product_title: Carlson Extra Wide Pet Gate, with small pet door
review_body:
I have a 9-month-old border collie and two 5-year-old cats. It goes without saying that one member of this trio is more excited about 'PLAY!' than the other two. This gate is absolutely perfect. We have a back room that has become the cats' safe place with all their toys food and litter. We also use it as a multi-purpose room, game room, etc.

The door on this gate is very easy to use once you figure it out the first time. It swings open easily and allows a person through without removing the gate or needing to step over. The animal gate can be shut if necessary, but we leave it open all the time for the cats.

The pet door is just a hair larger than I'd like, and the dog can actually force her way through when she really wants to. To restrict the space a little more I use a large zip-tie to cut the opening size in half.

The gate is difficult to set up, requiring you to hold everything together while you tighten it all up, so you might want some help getting it all up. Once set, though, it secures pretty snugly and solidly to the walls. The dog can knock this over if she does a flying jump into it (which she has), but at that point she was going to bust through a door or wall anyways. The gate doesn't fall over from normal use (opening and shutting the person door).

Despite the fact that it doesn't keep the dog out 100% of the time I recommend this pretty highly. If you've got a animals that's bullrushing or hurdling this gate then you'll need something a bit bigger and possibly permanently mounted, but this works great as a deterrent that still leaves access for the cats. It's relatively inexpensive and pretty durable. I have also found that it looks a lot nicer (and more sturdy) in person than it does in the product pictures.

product_title: Pioneer Pet Big Max Ceramic Drinking Fountain
review_headline: Easiest to clean pet fountain for sure
review_body:
This is one almost-perfect pet fountain! To compare, I currently have a [[ASIN:B0015Z3RYK Cat It Fresh and Clear Small Drinking Fountain - Cat It 50053]] and a [[ASIN:B0009EXMES Petmate Deluxe Fresh Flow Pet Fountain Medium, White]] as well as a contraption using an in-tank aquarium filter and a ceramic casserole dish. All are currently being used by cats. I got the Big Max for our dog and a dog we started fostering.

This fountain is basically two ceramic pieces, the bowl and the riser where the fountain emanates. A triangular plastic case with suction feet houses the similarly shaped filter and a pump, both hidden from view under the riser. Aesthetically this item does not look like it's for your pets but rather like an elegant desktop fountain. It's very quiet, with just faint bubbling noises. There are so few parts it's a breeze to clean compared to my Petmate Fresh Flow with all its pieces and sharp nooks and crannies. You'll still want a little brush to clean out the pump though, of course.

I have a few bones to pick. First, I wish they offered it in white ceramic; that way stray lint and dog spit wouldn't show up as much. Second, I do end up having to clean it every other day because dog spit seems to persistently collect under the riser and float on the surface of the water, which is unattractive. So, in my situation the small filter may not be adequate. One thing I've done with the other fountains is to use additional homemade filters to keep the water extra clean. I use aquarium filtering material and sew it up into little pillows stuffed with activated charcoal. These pillows go into the water holding tanks and I find I can actually go 2-4 weeks without having to clean the fountains out.

UPDATE (3 weeks later): I made the filter pillow and found it didn't work well hidden underneath the riser. I took out the Pioneer filter to try to increase the water throughput. IMHO, the filter is too small and the pump is undersized for the amount of water the fountain holds. The filter pillow now just floats around in the bowl and keeps the water clean enough for about a week. I'm considering rigging the unit with a slightly larger pump and not using the the plastic case (which could eventually harbor bacteria).

UPDATE (4 months later): I swapped out the underpowered pump for a slightly higher powered version to get more water moving. This also meant I was able to lose the plastic housing for the pump and filter. I cut a small length of PVC tubing to go from the pump to the riser opening. Finally, I put a small ceramic egg cup over the riser hole so the water doesn't spurt out in a big fountain. With the increased GPM of the new pump, the bowl had to be shimmed in the back so the water flows to the front. The filter pillow I use can be hidden underneath the riser. The bowl still requires cleaning every 1-2 weeks, and it is still very much a pain to get the pump lined up with the riser hole. review_headline: Great item, but be prepared to wait a long time for your order to arrive
review_body: My 10 year-old Pharaoh Hound has recently become incontinent.  After trying different types of childrens diapers (with no success), I stumbled upon these piddle pants while searching the web for solutions.  I ordered a pair of denim XXL and after waiting 3 weeks for them to arrive, was very pleased with the way they are working out. To remedy this issue, I ordered two more pair.  I have a trip planned and a friend will be staying at my house to watch my dog, so the other two pair are desperately needed in order for it to be easier for my friend to care for my dog.  I ordered the additional two pair of pants plenty of time in advance of my trip (1/24/11) and even sent the company an e-mail politely requesting that the pants arrive before 2/12/11.  I was told they would be here well before 2/12/11.    However, today is 2/12 and no pants.  I e-mailed the company to obtain an order status and was told that they shipped me the pants a few days ago and they were returned to them because they forgot to add postage.  So they re-shipped them yesterday which means I will not receive them in time for my trip and if I'm lucky, they will get here some time in March - more than a month after I ordered them.    I don't know if this is a real company or just someone sewing these items from their home and calling themself a company, but it is a bit ridiculous to have to wait more than a week or two to receive something ordered from the internet.  Plus, these pants help dogs either in heat or that are incontinent, so we don't have the luxury of waiting weeks and weeks for this product to arrive.  The item itself is really good so what a shame that they can't get their act together as far as processing and shipping their items in a timely fashion.

product_title: Qpets Petself Electronic Feeder (up to 45 Cups) with LCD display
review_headline: Decent size, some good ideas, but unreliable
review_body: I bought the Qpets electronic self feeder, and was initially happy with it.  Programming isn't exactly child's play, but it doesn't take a rocket scientist either, and the single page instructions are easy to follow.    The main problem is that I couldn't trust the electronics controlling the delivery mechanism.  I came home one night, and the bowl was empty with the cats looking at me with an annoyed expression on their faces.  I went to the machine to see what was wrong, moved the machine, and it immediately started dispensing product, despite it not being the programmed time for dispensing.    This happened on a second occasion, then a third time I came home and it appeared to be working properly.  There was enough food in the bowl to indicate that it had delivered on schedule.  Then, about 1 hour after scheduled delivery, my cat went up to the feeder for a snack, and it immediately started dispensing food again.    If the electronics were reliable, this would be a good feeder.  The construction of the control panel is a little ropey, and it pops and cracks mechanically as you press the buttons, but it works as intended.  The hopper is a good size (rather than the silly 4 cup capacity of those $150 feeders), and the lid securely locks to prevent access by hungry pets.  The dispensing mechanism is a simple barrel dispenser, so there is no way for cats to get at the food via the dispenser port.    IF the electronics could reliably dispense the food, it would be the ideal feeder.  As it is, unfortunately, I can't trust it to deliver the required amount of food as programmed.

product_title: Just for Cat Urine Destroyer Cat Remover
review_headline: Worked OK for awhile but a different product worked better for my cats
review_body:
My cats had been having a peeing party in the basement and I didn't know it, so there were lots of old, dried urine stains everywhere. This product got out *most* of the stains and eliminated the odor. Other products did not touch the stains, and this still worked despite the warning on the label to use Nature's Miracle first. There are a couple stains that are literally orange; this product did not completely eliminate the stain, but the odor is gone and the stain is significantly lightened. If this product is used right away or on stains that are normal yellow color and not too orange or amber, it is perfect. If you have alot of stains, large stains, or arthritic hands, do yourself a favor and go to Home Depot and buy a cheap hand held pump sprayer.

[EDIT]Since this review I have soured a little on Nature's Miracle products. They turned my carpet blue in one spot and I can't get that stain out no matter what I throw at it. Now it is possible that perhaps I had used another cleaner in that area like a year before I used the Nature's Miracle. And since they say all over the bottle to not use it after other cleaners have been used, it's possible there was some sort of chemical reaction between the two cleaners that caused the blue stain. But like I said, I'm not even 100% sure if I ever used anything else in this other spot, or maybe the previous owner of the house did? Either way it had to have been years since any other cleaners were there. So while on the one hand I can't really complain to the company about it because I can't guarantee there were never any other chemicals there, on the other hand I feel it's a little silly that this would happen anyway. I've been using all manner of different chemical cleaners on my carpets at my various houses and apartments over the years, and never had one turn my carpet blue.

I also didn't like how much $$ I was spending on the products (ungodly expensive) and the constant exposure to chemicals. I've since moved to using a combination of vinegar, baking soda, and elbow grease, and also my Hoover steam cleaner (which I just use hot water in to rinse and then suck out the vinegar.) It's a little more work to get the stains out, but I think my results have been just as good. When I'm done I spray the areas with Woolite Pet, which has something in it which is supposed to prevent re-soiling, and it seems to work. If I find an area my cats particularly love, I cover it with aluminum foil for awhile to \\"break\\" them of the habit. The Woolite cleaner also works pretty good by itself if I have a fresh spot or a small spot and I don't feel like messing with the vinegar and baking soda.

[EDIT 2 - 12/31/13] I have decided to update this review again after revisiting the discussion and agreeing with Brendan that I should be more objective. My conclusion after reading countless reviews and trying almost every product on the market is that these cleaners are all actually probably equally good, but you have to find the one that works best for YOUR cats. *Your* cat's urine is slightly different than *my* cat's urine, owing to concentration (which is related to how much water is drank), pH (owing to diet and other factors), etc. So while for my cats Nature's Miracle wasn't the best product (though still good, at least initially), you may find Nature's Miracle works best for your cats. It did seem that Nature's Miracle worked really well in the beginning for me then later didn't work as well. Thinking about it now, I did change my cat's diet and I do wonder if the diet change altered their urine to a point where Nature's Miracle wasn't as effective. I don't remember for sure if the diet change was around the same time as its drop-off in efficacy, but I think it's a reasonable theory, at least.

product_title: Armarkat Cat Tree Model
review_body: Thank you to the other reviewers for the very detailed feedback on the stability of this enormous cat tree, as well as the ease of assembly and the overall high quality of the carpets and the sisal posts. I bought this and it arrived the day before I was leaving for a TEN DAY vacation. I was a nervous wreck that my cats would be bored and destroy the house. I have 3 Bengal cats - 2 are 6 years old (twins) and my other Bengal is an 11 month old - all are EXTREMELY active. I had some \\"cat conflict\\" happening and it was recommended to me to immediately provide much more vertical space, with multiple entry points, which would reduce conflict. The tree I had before was not like this, and they would literally have to jump on and over each other to get on/off the tree. This tree absolutely saved everyone! While I was on vacation, I was able to watch my cats over my IP Camera pointed at the tree. Nearly every time I logged on to see them, they were on the tree playing, sleeping, or just hanging out. No fighting. One of the other reviewers highly recommended adding the \\"Amazing Purr Pad\\" as a cat bed inside the two little houses. I did this and my Alpha cat (boy) simply LOVED it and would not sleep anywhere else. Unfortunately, the fabric of the Purr Pad was too tempting for my little cat. He still eats inanimate objects wherever he can find them. So by the 3rd day, he had torn up and tried to eat the Purr Pad - so my cat sitter had to remove it, much to the dismay of my Alpha boy. I will experiment now with other \\"less edible\\" options. Also I must point out that the assembly was SO easy. It took me about 30 minutes, and I am a very petite. I did this alone with no help. One thing I have noticed is that when all 3 are jumping on/off it at the same time, it will wobble (Bengals are BIG CATS) so if you have big cats, make sure the space you install this into has a wall it can rest against. That keeps it sturdy during even the most violent playtimes! Finally - what really soldme on this Tree was this. I spoke to someone at Petco after I had just ordered it from Amazon (I didn't know they had this exact model, right in the store!). They told me that all the parts, i.e. the perches, the sisal posts, etc. are COMPLETELY replaceable. You can go to the Amarkat website if you have one tattered Sisal post, and they will sell you just that part. Talk about customer service! Well I was able to have a fantastic vacation, and the cats had a much happier and more stable home environment, so everybody wins. I would recommend this exact model (and I researched them ALL!). Save your kitties, save your sanity, and get this Tree!

product_title: Purina ONE Healthy Kitten Formula Dry Cat Food
review_headline: Awesome way to buy cat food!
review_body: My 2 cats are little piggys and they eat a lot so I have to buy large amounts of cat food. But I hate buying the super big bags because I only have the 2 cats. By the time I get to the bottom of the BIG bag it's stale and I don't like stale food, so why would my cats? Also, it keeps the bugs down because the open bag is small and it's not just sitting there. I also priced the big bags compared to the bulk lot of smaller ones here and this was surprisingly cheaper. I'm going to be buying this way from now on.

product_title: Scotch-Brite FurFighter Hair Remover Kit 849SK
review_body: I have a Lab (dog) and a Maine Coon (long hair cat), and they both shed a lot.  Their hair is coarse and fine and vacuming only does so much.  I've tired many products and this is one of my favorites. Everyone I've recommended it to loves it as well. I've used it on throw pillows, comforters, and throw rugs and the pet hair comes off easily.  I also use it on pet beds and pet blankets, if you use it before washing these items it prevents the pet hair from clogging up or sticking to the walls of the washer and dryer or transferring hair to items in other loads of laundry. I have tried it on car upholstry and it works very well.  My furniture is mostly leather or wood so I honestly can't say how if works on sofas and chairs.

product_title: Mister Max Original Scent Anti Icky Poo Odor Remover, Gallon Size
review_body: I have used anti-icky poo for years - told about it by a vet.  It takes out the cat urine scent that other products leave behind.  You have to keep the area moist for a substantial period of time, can't remember how long, in order for it to get rid of the odor completely.  They now have more products - don't know about those, just the original one.  I'm back here on Amazon to order more.

product_title: IRIS Airtight Food Storage Container
review_body: These are exactly as described. Snap top & casters. Easy maneuverability. They would be great for holding several various smaller bags of treats & kibble to keep them fresh.   I wouldn't pour to the rim from huge bag of kibble. I think that would be too much solid weight for the casters.

product_title: Zoo Med Mini Deep Dome Lamp Fixture with 5.5-Inch Dome, Black
review_headline: Nice Fixture...but be careful with Ceramic Heat Emitters
review_body: After buying this fixture I read on some other websites that although its ceramic socket is rated to 100 Watts, the manufacturer says not to use ceramic heat emitters (and it says this on the box too...but not on Amazon!).  Supposedly because its a small deep fixture and the heat could build up too much and go back into the wires.  Dang it, because thats what I bought 3 of them for.  I know someone who uses a 60 Watt ceramic heat emitter in this, like I wanted to do, so I carefully went ahead.  The temperature with my temp gun measured at the bell never got hotter than the bell of the fixture I have a 100 Watt Mercury Vapor Bulb in (these things get hot!), about 145 F in a 65 F house, and after a week of use I feel pretty secure that its not going to cause any problems.  I wouldn't recommend putting more than a 60 Watt heat emitter in there though.  Nice look (matches well with my regular size deep dome fixtures), love the secure hanging hook (unlike those stupid clamp on ones), and they also work awesome with the ZooMed clamp on covers (5.5 inch...I use these with heat emitters) and the lamp stands (which you really need so you can vertically adjust the bulb to get the right temperature...you can't use dimmers/thermostats on Mercury Vapor Bulbs, and it wears out a bulb fast if you use it on a heat emitter...plus its just another thing that can fail and then maybe overheat your reptile).  Only reason I give it a 4 not a 5 is the surface scratches easily (1 of mine actually came scratched), has a lip at the bottom that catches dust pretty bad (but I think they need it like this to use the clamp on covers), and they come with these stupid safety stickers on the surface that take forever to get all the adhesive off.  I think this is a very safe product and highly recommend it for use with light bulbs up to 100 Watts and Ceramic Heat Emitters up to 60 Watts.

product_title: Ocluvet Eye Drops (15 ml)
review_headline: My 17 year old Bichon can see!
review_body: I began using the eye drops only two weeks ago and already my 17 year Bichon's eye sight has improved to where he no longer jumps at shadows, no more jumping when I go to rub his body. He is running again on his walks. And he is back to watching my gestures and looking into my eyes. I am excited to see what the next weeks will bring to his vision. Even if it does not imporve any more then it is today I am completely satisfied.  I am telling every dog owner I know or don't know about this product!

product_title: Contech StayAway Motion-Activated Pet Deterrent
review_body: We bought this to keep our cats off the kitchen counter.  I was unsure how this would work, as we have an \\"open\\" kitchen, so the possibilities for catching us rather than the cats was very high.  Nonetheless, we set it up, and watched.  Our youngest cat hit the floor and scrabbled around the corner as fast as she could!  Our more laid back, older one, simply jumped down.  It only took a week or so, and switching it back and forth between counters-they have learned not to go there.  It is so nice not to have to worry about food left on the counter...  Kudos to Contech for a great product!

product_title: OurPets IQ Treat Ball Interactive Food Dispensing Dog Toy
review_body: This has been great for our 8 month old lab puppy.  She figured out how it works pretty quickly, but I'm happy to say that it still takes her quite a long time to empty it.  This requires a little patience since she doesn't eat all of the food that spills out, due to sheer enthusiasm for the game.  I'm hoping she'll be a little more interested in cleaning up all of the food as she gets used to it.  All in all, a great product.

product_title: Novartis Program 409.8mg for Large Dogs (46-90 lbs) 6 Tablets 6 Month Protection
review_body: I was disappointed in this product because it was a capsule . I tried to mix the powder with their food but my cats wouldn't touch it. I tried to force feed the capsule, but that wasn't happening either . I feel I wasted my money. I suppose it would work if I could get it down them.It would have been better IF i had known it was a pill or a capsule first.

product_title: JW Pet SkidStop Slow Feed Pet Bowl ( Blue/ White )
review_body: I have a Boxer that was taking down his food in under a minute and then often times he would throw it right back up.  This bowl has eliminated that issue and it takes him about 10 minutes now to eat a serving of dry dog food.  I highly recommend this bowl if you have a dog that eats too fast.

product_title: ASL Solutions Foam (Styro/EPS) Insulated Dog Palace
review_body: This dog house is solid when put together! Easy assembly, strong and durable. I would highly recommend this dog house to anyone with a medium to large size dog. It keeps the dog nice and warm too. I live in a very cold climate (think 20 below ZERO!) and my short haired beagle does just fine spending the night outside in her dog house.

product_title: Vittles Vault 40-Pound Stackable
review_body: My mistake.  I purchased the item without reading the fine print.  I purchased two vaults to hold bird seed.  The squirrels first ate through the lid.  After I placed ceramic barriers on the lids, they ate through the side of the vault.  Only took them two days to discover the seed in the vaults and make quick work of entry.

product_title: Beefeaters Rawhide Dog Treat Stix 12In Xtra Thick
review_body: These chews last a while even with my mastiffs, who are 150 and 200lbs.They are big enough that I don't worry about them eating them whole.I wish more companies made large chew items, big dog like to chew too. The only problem I have noticed with these chews is that they gave my dogs really bad gas, but at least the dogs are not chewing on my shoes;)

product_title: Zuke's Mini Naturals Dog Treats
review_body: Zuke's is a great natural mini treat. They are the perfect size for training. Since they are a soft treat, you can easily break them into smaller pieces if you want. (Our trainer uses them in class, too.) So far, Amazon.com has the most reasonable price!

product_title: PetSafe Premium Cat Fence Extra Receiver
review_headline: Finally, something that will keep my mean cat away from the nice cat!
review_body: We have 3 cats.  1 male and two female.  All are fixed.  We brought \\"baby kitty\\" into the fold about 2 years ago.  Lily, our other female cat hated her instantly.  Lily isn't very friendly with anyone but proceeded to torture \\"baby kitty\\".  I tried everything.  I even bought canned air that sprayed her when she went upstairs.  The final straw was when Lily caused \\"baby kitty\\" to bleed pretty badly.  I found this collar and all is well in our home.  I wish the batteries were a little cheaper, but I'd pay anything for the fact I don't have kitty fights anymore!

product_title: Pet Tabs Plus Advanced Formula Vitamin Supplement
review_headline: Sorbitol is not good for dogs
review_body: I have not used this product, so obviously I can't vouch for its efficacy.  However, the ingredient list includes sorbitol, a sugar alcohol that is bad for dogs.  It affects blood sugar for dogs and can cause sudden drops in blood sugar and liver problems.  Just a heads up.

product_title: LitterMaid Elite Mega Automatic Self-Cleaning Litter Box
review_body: WOW!!! I was skeptical about this purchase for it was costly. But worth every penny. Noise level is quiet,  Oliver (orange tabby) loves it. Has an digital timmer on back to time when you want it to clean. The blades slide out for easy cleaning. It's easy to put together with simple instructions. Good quality and made strudy to last. Love it. Also purchased a tent cover to keep litter inside.

product_title: MidWest iCrate Single Door & Double Door Folding Metal Dog Crates
review_body: This crate is a good option, good quality, and good price. I like the fact that you could re-size the crate to fit your dog as it grows from a puppy. I would recommend the crate with the 2 doors though, since you can fit another pet from the other side if you're camping or traveling. That is the best option.

product_title: Ware River Pet Puppy Wee Wee Pads 28"x30" 50/box USA MADE
review_body: My puppy got used to pads very easy and this is a cheap box and a good way to train your puppy while she gets all her shots and I can take her outside.

product_title: Taste of the Wild Cat Food
review_body: I have a Bengal and this is her second favorite food. If I can't get her [[ASIN:B001BOVE54 Wellness CORE Grain-Free, Fish and Fowl Adult Cat and Kitten Food, 12-Pound Bag]] or want to change it up a bit I get this. Having a grain free diet for cats is really important to their overall health and especially so for Bengals. I highly recommend all varieties of this brand.      My one possible negative comment is that the food is very hard. Young or old cats may not be able to crunch it up properly.

product_title: OdoBan Pet Solid Odor Absorber & Air Freshener, 8 Ounce
review_body: This product does a good job of absorbing odors to the point where I forget to clean the cat box.  It's scent is not overpowering but when placed next to the litter box, it seems to help out a lot.

product_title: K&H Thermo-Kitty Heated Cat Bed
review_body: I purchased this bed for my 16 year-old kitty who is suffering from breast cancer. She loves it and spends most her time there. It is warm, secure, and soft. She clearly prefers it over several other beds from which she can choose. It's a wonderful product. all I could wish for is an on and off switch and perhaps the ability to regulate the temperature.

product_title: Totally Ferret Turkey Venison Lamb Food 30lb
review_body: I was worried when the usual brand was discontinued, and began my search for a new diet food fast! Three bags later I found Totally Ferret Vension Lamb Formula... My ferrets love this food, they will not eat anything else other than this stuff. It has all the proper nutrition and ingredients. I highly recommend this for your little ones! I hope you have as good of results as I did, hope my review helps!

product_title: Karen Pryor i-Click Dog Training Clicker, 3 Clickers
review_headline: Too quiet, can find with your own logo
review_body: I bought a few on Amazon.  They are better than the \\"box-type clicker,\\" because they are easier to hold in the hand, they fit nicely.  However, I much prefer the Starmark clickers, because these are too quiet unless you're in a silent room.  I also saw them online where you can get your own logo, so you don't have to have them say \\"karen pryor\\"

product_title: Petmate Infinity Elite UV Light Purifying Pet Fountain for Cats, 125-Ounce
review_body: After a few weeks this unit became very slimy and smelled like algea.  And after 3 or 4 months the motor died. After the unit died I read the reviews listed on PetSmarts page (I bought the unit in the store) and several people had the same issue I did.  Unfortunate waste of 60 bucks or so...

product_title: Angels' Eyes Tear-Stain Eliminator for Dogs and Cats, Beef Flavor, 120 Grams Bottle
review_headline: IT REALLY WORKED oo white Maltapoo
review_body: This is the only product we found that actually works. In fact we used 3X per week until stains disappeared (about 3 weeks), then stopped using it completely.  It's was 2 years before we needed another 2 wwek treatment and have never needed it again.   Amazing

product_title: Kitty Shelf Model KS-1
review_body: I brought this for a different purpose. I wanted something to hold a box fan in a window. This worked perfectly. I brought two.

product_title: Groovypets® Remote Dog Training Shock Collar Trainer / Rechargeable Dog Collar for No Bark Obedience Behavioral Training
review_body: These collars have made life in our apartment exponentially better. Our two dogs (a black lab mix and a basset/beagle  mix) used to bark at any noise that they heard in the hallway. This chaos would occur several times a day. If a delivery man rang our doorbell, the dogs' reactions were even worse. Now, thanks to these collars, they've learned to stay calm and ignore all of these triggers. The collars were also incredibly useful in training them when sharing the elevator with other people, as this activity often made them agitated. Now, they've learned to stay relaxed. We've been able to accomplish this almost exclusively with the vibration setting and have reserved the low shock option for the rare situation that is more extreme. We never use the high shock setting.    The collars have been phenomenal and, save for one incident when one of the collars needed to be reset, have worked perfectly. Even then, the customer service (I contacted the manufacturer through Amazon) was quick and useful.    Ideally, I'd love to be able to turn off the remote to ensure that the dogs are never accidentally given a shock.     The collars need to be charged once a week, which is fine. We quickly saw that as the pattern and now plan for it to keep them charged whenever we need them.    I can't recommend these collars highly enough so long as you use them along with verbal commands and training techniques so that your dogs learn to understand what behaviors you'd like from them.

product_title: PETCO Assorted Balls for Cats Super Value Pack
review_body: Firstly the lattice ball toys in this pack are incredibly dangerous.  See my full review at the product page here: [[ASIN:B000633ROW PETCO Lattice Ball with Bell Cat Toys]].  Needless to say if you do buy this for some reason, throw those away immediately.      As for the rest of the toys, the solid plastic balls won't stand up to serious play by a juvenile or adult cat.  For my kitten they were fine, but inevitably you can't have just one cat playing with a toy.  If you have hard floors or even walls (!) your cats will end up breaking these.  While they won't shatter into tiny pieces like the lattice toys they're still worthless.  Once they break they're done for and that means you're out another toy.      The larger latticed toys (not the thin woven) will shatter into pieces if knocked into a wall or chewed on by a determined cat.  Just like the lattice balls they end up becoming dangerous just for this fact.  They're fun for the short amount of time that they last, but they aren't worth the worry of your cat getting hurt.      In fact, the only decent toy in this entire assortment is the foam ball, but it isn't as well made as other brands.  If your cat does the \\"Om nom nom\\" while laying on their side with claws dug in you're going to end up with tiny pieces of foam all over your floor.  I don't care how \\"safe\\" it is by comparison, I don't want my tiny terrors eating foam, nor do I want to be constantly sweeping and vaccuuming.      Ultimately these toys are unsafe for anything other than a small kitten, cheaply made, poorly constructed, and far more hassle than they are worth.

product_title: Aspen Pet Lebistro Programmable Food Dispenser
review_body: Cat used to trip me up whenever she was hungry, now she knows it's not me doing the feeding and doesn't run in and out of my feet.     Makes weekend trips MUCH easier and prevents the cat from eating a few days of food the first day.    5lbs is bigger than I thought it would be, but it lasts about a month at 3/4cup food/day.

product_title: Adams Plus Flea & Tick Shampoo with IGR 12oz
review_body: I used advantage before and ran out a while back. The dogs are scratching way too much now and the shampoo just didn't cut it so I ran to the store... Not much choice there. Picked Adams drops... Two weeks later .. The dogs are worse!!!! Does not work at all as far as I am concerned....

product_title: PEDIGREE DENTASTIX Original Large Treats for Dogs - 15.6 oz. 18 Count
review_body: Well, Petco vs. Petsmart aside, these are really good at cleaning my Pom's teeth and she doesn't react poorly to them like some other treats she's had designed for oral care.  I don't expect anything like this to eliminate the need for a teeth cleaning, which Poms need at least annually...but the teeth look much better after only one package of 24.

product_title: HDP Car Harness Dog Safety Seat Belt Gear Travel System
review_body: This is so neat and easy to put on my little schnazer dog, and i feel she is safe in the back seat with the harness on.  Good one. Thank you.

product_title: Multipet Look Whos Talking Lobster 7.5"
review_body: If you need a sturdy squeaky toy that doesn't make a loud noise but your dog will love it anyway, this is the toy to get! Ruffy just loves the bright red color, carrying it around by the legs & trying to figure out what that gurgling bubbling noise is.

product_title: Floating Pond TURTLE - LARGE 12"
review_body: bought one for my daughter and liked it so much i had to get one for my pond.  very real like
