review_body:
My Lab enjoys the IntelliBone. She carries it around the house, with and without the rings. She just got this for Christmas, and after a few days has gotten the hang of taking some of the rings off, though she seems to prefer playing with the rings as \\"toss and fetch\\" toys.

**Update: Although my dog truly enjoyed playing with this toy, the seams ripped easily. I had to sew them together a number of times. Little by little, the pieces have ended up in the trash. I don't know if I would recommend the \\"IntelliBone\\". The dog liked it, but it didn't hold up very well.

product_title: Nature's Miracle Just for Cats Stain & Odor Remover
review_body: This was great! My cats decided to pee on my couch and chairs as punishment for the new dog. I thought that they were ruined! I tried a few other products, but they didn't work. I dumped this onto the sofa and within two weeks, the odor was gone. I did have to wait the whole two weeks for the odor to completely disappear, but it was worth it.

product_title: Snuggle Safe Pet Bed Microwave Heating Pad
review_headline: More than just a pet heating pad
review_body: This is our third snugglesafe pet heater. We started out with one for our geriatric cat (19 yrs). By necessity we found out it keeps pots warm on the buffet (fully washed and sanitized, of course). Hubby then wanted one of his own to keep his feet warm while on the computer and now we are purchasing a third for a friend as a gift. Keeps the heat for 10 hours easy. For the cat we had to wrap it in a towel when adding it to her bed as it was too hot - but 10 hours later we pulled the towel off and it was still warm enough for her. Stopped her from waking us up at 4 in the morning because she was cold. Love it! And I should mention our first snugglesafe is about 5 yrs old and still going strong after being heated almost every night during the 5 months of winter. Highly recommended.

product_title: Crazy Corn Cooked Bird Food - Kung Fu Yum 3 Lbs.
review_body: I have ordered this product several times.  I add water, cook up a batch in only six minutes, let it cool, then take Tsp or Tbls scoops out, freeze them on a tray. As soon as they are frozen, I put them in a freezer bag and take one or two out every day.  I pop it into the microwave for 20 - 30 seconds, add fruits, veggies, sprouts, etc to it and my parrots love it.  I call it \\"yum yum\\" and they come-a-running. :-)  GREAT PRODUCT !!

product_title: West Paw Zogoflex Hurley Durable Dog Bone Chew Toy for Aggressive Chewers, 100% Guaranteed Tough, It Floats!, Made in USA, for Strong Chewers
review_body: The bone lasted a few months but once he got it going he was able to pull little pieces off and eat them. They say they will replace it but I can't figure out who to email.

product_title: Soft Claws Nail Caps for Cats & Kittens
review_headline: If you're tired of always getting clawed by your cat..
review_body: Buy these things, they work perfectly. No more digging their claws into me or scratching the furniture, these things are great.

product_title: The Tick Key
review_body: I found myself down in Ulster County, NY which is a tick haven. 2 golden retrievers and a bunch of ticks don't mix. Without any tick protection and or a tick remover, I ended up at a pet store looking at options. They were out of the style I had at home, the one that is like a pair of small plastic diagonal cutters with a magnifier. They had a tick spoon with a little slot and this aluminum key looking thingy called the \\"tick Key\\". Both same price. I asked the clerk which one and she said they sell a ton of the tick keys. So I bought one.    Over the course of the next 4 days I had to pull about 5 embedded ticks off my dogs and let me tell you, this thing is the ticket. You simply move the dog's hair aside as much as possible, slide the slot down over the ticks body as close to the skin as you can, and then pull to the side in a steady fashion. Don't rip the tick out, just keep steady pressure until it lets go. Worked perfect every time. The narrowing slot applies pinching pressure and the steady sideways tug makes them give way. The key itself is light, durable, and easy to store since it is flat.    I ended up buying 3 more. One for home and one for each vehicle, along with one for my in-laws. Great product!

product_title: Super Pet My First Home for Rabbits
review_body: The cage was mostly what it was advertised to be.  The only problem was one of the hook was crushed so it could not open or connect to the part to set up the cage.  I really really had to use many tools to get it to sort of fit together.  Another strange thing though I'm not sure if it's just because of my rabbit, but he ate part of the tray.  He really got to parts of it and I thought this wasn't supposed to happen.  Overall though, it's been a good cage.  It a nice size for my bunnies, came quickly, and is pretty sturdy.  I especially enjoy the top opening and how the bars do not wear too much though he chews on them.  Thank you.

product_title: IRIS Airtight Pet Food Storage Container Combo
review_body: this container saved my back,holds tons of food keeps it dry. Its great just what they say it is.  I do wish it came with a food scoop, other than that great!

product_title: Petite Cuisine for Cats
review_body: `I was very pleased to see this product online.  I always bought Baby Girls canned food at Food Lion and now they no longer carry it at the local store.  Every cat and kitten who has had the pleasure of trying it loves it.  NOT gummy or looks like mystery meat.  Great product.

product_title: Zanies Squawking Nubby Ball Purple
review_body: Our dog wore out her special ball.  Being a somewhat neurotic rescued pup, she needed the security of her special toy.  What a wonderful find when a friend showed me this product.  What a total disappointment when I opened the package and saw the shoddy workmanship!  The stitching was loose and the product literally fell apart before I gave it to the pup.  Needless to say, I do NOT recommend this to pet owners who are concerned for their animal's well-being as it could easily be chewed into pieces and the filling could be swallowed.

product_title: IRIS Pet Playpen with Door, 24-Inch
review_headline: Perfect for a small dog or puppy
review_body: We bought this to house our new Maltese/Poodle mix puppy (just over 7# fully grown).  She was very reluctant to use the cage crate we purchased for her. Her shipping kennel was her favorite place, but obviously not a long-term solution for a growing puppy.  This pen allowed us a place to put her kennel in plus all of her favorite toys and give her plenty of space to roam around.  The openness of the design gives her a great view without the feeling of being shut in, and the pen provides her \\"safe place\\" to go.    As she grew, the pen wasn't tall enough to keep our \\"escape artist\\" in.  However, that was easily solved with a few bucks worth of heavy plastic netting and some zip ties to hold it on the top.  So, I think those who've complained about its height need to realize a) puppies will jump out of ANYTHING if they can, and b) it's fairly easy and cheap to solve the problem.  Also, as the puppy grew we replaced her shipping kennel with a nice, comfortable, doggy bed.  Now that she's nearly fully-grown and housebroken, she's just put in the pen at night.    The best part about this is its portability.  When we travel to see our kids and grandkids, the pen is easily taken down and set up again, and takes up very little space in our car or RV.

product_title: Marineland Single Bright LED Light
review_body: Compare next to 1 watt led's and its very subpar.It will light up a 75 gallon tank but barely,nothing to get excited about.Also should note that the 17,000 hour life span of these .06 watt led's is less than half of the lifespan of the 1 watt led's @ 50,000 hours.I would probably pony up the extra cheddar and buy the double brite's next time,they are 1 watt led's @ 50,000 hour lifespan,and would be better for displaying fish.

product_title: 2-Pack PetSafe Basic Bark Control Collar
review_body: I actually bought one for myself in the hope that it would stop my snoring. Unfortunately, it does not respond to snores, only barks. However, I tried a few barks to see what the zap was like -- it resembled getting touched by someone who was shuffling in the carpet. At worst, maybe a bee sting. Certainly startling, but not abusive.

product_title: Littermaid LM980 Mega Self-Cleaning Litter Box
review_body: I had purchased one of the original Littermaid Self-Cleaning Litter Boxes when they were first introduced and still being manufactured in the United States (it is now \\"imported\\").  It was excellent and survived two cats for about 7 years.  It was convenient and allowed me to go away for the weekend without worrying about asking someone to empty the boys' box. I frequently recommended the Littermaid to other cat owners and raved about the convenience for me AND the cats.      I was confused when friends tried it and told me they had returned the Littermaid, that it didn't work well for them.  When the original Littermaid died, I knew that I would replace it with the \\"newer, improved\\" model. I suddenly understood why friends to whom I had recommended the Littermaid had returned the ones they purchased.  What a waste of money!    The new Littermaid was different right out of the package.  The construction is lighter weight and flimsy.  The motor was louder and seemed to strain going through the litter.  The rake has been redesigned and not only does not clean as well, but allows material to get stuck on the rake.  Within six months of use from the two cats that used the same previous model for seven years, the new one died.  I was able to recycle it through an e-waste pickup in my neighborhood.    I am back to a traditional cat box and traditional litter.  Not as convenient, but also not as frustrating!      I would not recommend this product to any cat owner!

product_title: PetSafe SSSCAT Spray
review_body: Bought two of these. Neither will stay on the can they came with or the other can.

product_title: BestPet Posh Pet Stroller
review_body: Great stroller. Fairly easy to store. Easily accommodates my 2 dogs; one weighs 6 lb. and the other is 16 lb. Probably not great for a much heavier load. Very stylish and great value for the price. Arrived promptly!!

product_title: Purina Busy Bone Chewbone Treats - 10ct 35oz
review_body: My 30 lb. male corgi nearly died from eating this. The thing broke in half and became lodged across the roof of his mouth and in his teeth at the back of his mouth. It took over a hour with a pair of channel locks to get it dislodged from his mouth. It was the small/medium size bone. Purina makes a lot of good dog products but this is not one of them. I called Purina and reported the lot number and what had happened. I just dont want anyone else's dog to choke on this thing.

product_title: TetraMin Tropical Crisps
review_body: I started using this product shortly after changing the lamp in my aquarium. When the water clouded, I immediately blamed the lamp thinking that it was causing algae to bloom. I switched to a lower intensity lamp, same thing. I tried massive frequent water changes only to have the tank cloud within a couple of days. I turned the tank light off completely, for a week. Same thing. This went on for weeks.    Then I realized that the food could have something to do with it. I purchased some Tetramin flake food, the good old standby. Between that and a water change the tank was crystal clear in a matter of days. It has remained so for three weeks now.

product_title: Petmate 25-Inch Burrow Bed, Navy Blue
review_body: Nice bed, well made, soft and comfortable poly fill.  Too small for my Westie and my Cairn Terrier. Would be OK for a cat or SMALL dog.  The 25 inches is not the inside, it is the outside.   If your animal is longer than about 20 inches they won't be able to stretch out.

product_title: Dean and Tyler Nocturne Dog Leash, Black 6-Feet by 1/2-Inch Width With Stainless Steel Hardware.
review_body: Leash is actually only 7/16 inch instead of 8/16. You should think it does not make a difference, but for using it on big dogs, it does! Snaps are smaller than I expected. Shipping is overpriced with $8.91 per leash. It ads up for 2/3/4 leashes. Other than that it is a pretty and good quality leather leash. It won me over by comparing prices!

product_title: Pestell Pet Products Easy Clean Scoopable Litter with Baking Soda, 40-Pound Bag

review_body: Very well made, appears able to offer good control and probable safety in an accident.  But the harness is way too large and heavy for my 11# affenpinscher.  The product includes a dog-to-seatbelt assembly connector that is handy with an alternate harness.

product_title: SIMPLE SOLUTION Stain Odor Remover for CATS DOGS (1 Gallon)
review_headline: We have two Cats and this stuff is great!
review_body: One of our cats was old, before she recently passed.  She got a bit too lazy to get into the litter box, and our younger cat had a Urinary Tract Infection, so she'd liquidate her assets throughout the house.  This stuff works just as well as Nature's Miracle, if not better, and it has a clean smell.  We were skeptical to try this stuff out, because we were pretty happy with Nature's Miracle, but this stuff works and is a lot more cost effective.  We are happily switching and sticking with this product.

product_title: ABO Gear Happy Habitat for Indoor Cats
review_body: I purchased this tent for my three indoor kitties so that they could enjoy some time outdoors.  It is very easy to put up and put down.  Nothing to put together just snap up and down.  It rolls up nicely to put into the carrying bag that it came with.  It also comes with 4 stakes to stake the corners if you put it up in the grass or on the ground.  I put it up in the house to get them used to being in it.  Then I backed the car out of the garage and put up the tent on some cardboard on the garage floor so they could see out the garage door and hear the birds and see the neighbors walking their dogs and kids.  I would recommend putting something down inside the tent for the cats to lay down on.  Mine don't prefer to lay down on the tent surface which is a type of durable netting.  By the third time in the tent, the cats laid down on a towel and just enjoyed watching what I was doing in the garage and yard.  I have put toys in there for them and a box they could crawl into.  They are really enjoying the outdoors with this tent.  My kitties are one year old and all three of them are very comfortable in the roomy tent together.  It is 74 in long and 35 inches wide, over 3 square  feet.  They have not climbed on the sides.  The only thing they want when I walk past the tent is attention.  I would highly recommend this tent.

product_title: Automatic Cat Feeder, CSF-3XL Super Feeder, 1.5 Gallon Hopper, Analog Timer, Chute Cover, Stand/Bowl. Up to 48 Daily Meals (Approximately 5 lbs food)
review_body:
Update 12/20/12:
A year and a half later and this feeder has been flawless. Love the simplicity of programming and if we want to add an extra feeding or two we just flip another of the switches on the timer. It's also been consistent enough when switching between different food that we haven't had to adjust for small variations in kibble size. Cat hears the food drop and she goes running! It holds plenty of food so we don't have to fill it often, and the clear sleeve in the feed chute lets us monitor when we need to refill it. Couldn't be more pleased with the investment.

-----------------------------------------------------
Original review:
We bought this automatic cat feeder to help preserve our sanity. Our cat is extremely \\"vocal\\" when she wants her food, and insisted on constantly waking us up at 4AM or earlier for her breakfast. After researching options, I chose the Superfeeder based on the reviews. The cheaper ones available in big box pet stores seem to have issues with reliability and protection of the food from persistent cats who stick their paws up the food chute. No such issues with the superfeeder after several weeks of use. The adjustment was very easy, and reasonably consistent with the small kibble Iams food we feed, and the timer was very easy to adjust. The product appears very well built and arrived carefully packaged and partly assembled. Instructions weren't the clearest I've seen, but had pretty good pictures. Had it up and running within 30 minutes of taking my sweet time.

We settled on a 3 times daily feeding cycle, with one in the morning, one in the evening, and one around 2AM. That way the cat gets fed periodically through the day and night, and doesn't have pent up hunger. She's also stopped coming to us, since we no longer provide the food. When she hears the feeder kick on and the food drop into the bowl, she dashes off to the office to eat. Great!

product_title: KONG Favorites Dog Toys and Treats Combo Pack (Colors Vary)
review_body: All of these toys are great!!  Since it's online you can't test out the squeakers, but I can assure you your dog will love them. product_title: Kaytee Hamster Come Along Carrier (Assorted colors)
review_body: This carrier was nice to have for the trip home after picking up my bunnies. They were comfortable with a little hay in the bottom and we could peek in at them to make sure they looked like they were doing okay. When I'm not using it to carry the bunnies, I use it to store hay!

product_title: Rockys Choice -Thick Odor Free- 6 Inch Premium Bully Sticks - 5 Pack
review_body: While these bully sticks have less odor than generic ones, each one definitely has an odor when chewed.  I estimate 50% less odor, hence three stars.  I have been fortunate enough to find actual odor free bully sticks at my local pet supply; sorry, there was no brand name.

product_title: Kyjen 2474 Dog Auto Travel Back Seat Pet Hammock Easy-Fit Seat Cover, Large, Black
review_body: This hammock is so easy to set up and take down when we are traveling without our pup. product_title: Ergo 8-Day Auto Pet Feeder
review_body: I bought one of these feeders to use during a long weekend away I programmed 3 feeds per full day over a 3 day period. I trialed before we left and all appeared to work ok. product_title: Aspen Pet Lebistro Programmable Food Dispenser
review_body: Modifications:  I changed the minimum portion size from 1/4 a cup to 1/8 a cup by duct taping styrofoam triangles in each of the four auger compartments.  The styrofoam took up half of each compartment, and I placed a cardboard shield above the covered side of the auger to prevent food from jamming between the styrofoam wedge and plastic auger wall.  After some initial adjustments, it has never jammed with my modification and now dispenses 1/8 cup every time.    I found a compatible power converter to avoid using D-cell batteries.  Petmate also sells a power converter that is not included with the feeder.    Cons:  When the power source is removed, the meal size and time selections stay the same, but the clock must be reset when power is restored.    Auger blades are made of silicone - they won't break in a jam or when your cat reaches his paw up the chute but are prone to a couple of bits slipping out occasionally if you use smaller disk-shaped cat feed instead of cross-shaped pieces.    Pros:  Interface seems intuitive, contrary to other reviewers' opinions.    My cat has not learned to put his paw up the chute.    75 meals without any problems.  Each meal time and size is customizable.    Peace of mind when working late, less whining from my cat.    While tinkering with the product to reduce the portion size, I induced jamming on a half-a-dozen occasions and the feeder did not break - it is still going strong.    As a long-term investment, worth it.

product_title: Purina Carvers with Real Chicken Roasted Slices Treats For Dogs (16-oz pouch)
review_body: All three of my pomeranians love this treat, which is getting harder to find in pet shops.  I think it is healthy for them and easy to tear apart into small bites for small dogs.

The only potential downside to some (not me), is that this gate cannot be swung closed, you must manually close this gate. Based upon this gate's design and structural integrity I expect it will last quite a long time. Well worth the money.

product_title: Everlasting Treat Ball
review_headline: Everlasting ball, but not everlasting fun
review_body: I bought the medium ball for my 5 year old lab mix as a Christmas gift. She's a hard core chewer so I was looking for something that would not be destroyed in one day... or in 10 minutes. product_title: Good Pet Stuff Company Hidden Cat Litter Box
review_headline: was hesitant to buy- SO GLAD I DID!
review_body:
I never buy anything online without a lot of thought and research. I was in between buying this, or buying one of those furniture cabinets with boxes inside. I decided on this because it was a lot less expensive and takes up less room. I've been looking at this for awhile and read a lot of reviews about it, both good and bad.

-SUPER FAST shipping from amazon. free with over $25 purchase, and it came in 2 days! I was pleasantly shocked :)

BAD: (not really bad but mentionable)

I don't ever write reviews, but thought I'd leave comments about this because I was soooo on the fence buying it, but am SOO happy I did. Hope this helps!am SOO happy I did. Hope this helps!

product_title: Nutramax Cosequin DS Double Strength Chewable Tablets - 90 Count
review_body: My dog absolutely will not eat the chewable tablets, and she isn't what I would call a finicky eater as it is extremely rare that she turns down something edible.  I offered the pill directly to her, thinking that since they were chewable she would think they were a treat, but she refused.  I then grabbed a couple of dog treats in my hand with the pill and she ate the treats but still refused the pill. I hid the pill in a beggin strip treat and that worked once.     I was able to get her to eat the pills the first couple of days by completely embedding them in peanut butter, but she caught on and started refusing peanut butter that had a pill hidden in it. I then tried hiding between two strips of cheese, which worked for another couple of days, but then she started refusing the cheese as well. I tried hiding a tablet in the middle of a meaty chunk in a larger serving of her favorite wet dog food, and she ate everything but the tablet.  I then gave up on hiding them in food, as she knew the smell and was going to refuse anything with the smell    I tried to just make her take them orally by sticking them in her mouth and holding her mouth closed and massaging her throat.  That worked once, but now she just holds the pill in her mouth until I let go then spits it out.  These tablets must be extremely awful tasting, or irritating her once she swallows them for her to react this way.      My dog is old, and I really don't want to stress her out daily by trying to force her to take a pill that she doesn't want, especially since I don't even know myself if it will help her as you have to administer them several weeks to see results.  I would suggest anyone considering buying this product to first get some samples from your veterinarian and see if it is going to be a struggle to get your dog to eat them.  I have a Jack Russell Terrier and she's pretty smart, so I can't fool her very easily.

product_title: Orijen Adult Dry Dog Food (29.7 lb)
review_headline: The best grain free dog food
review_body:
Orijen makes by far the best dog food you can buy. It's expensive but well worth it, especially when you take into account how much you will save on vet bills and the great boost it will give to your dogs overall health and well being.. It is grain free which is very important as grain is not part of a dog's normal diet and besides mostly being filler, grains can cause allergies and other issues. My 5 year old German Shepherd is on Orijen Adult and has done incredibly well on it, stunning coat, great energy, consistently firm, and virtually odor-free, poops. I also have a large male Golden who is now 13 1/2 years old and doing fantastic. He at Orijen Senior until about 3 years ago when we switched him to Orijen Senior. Other than a little arthritis in his hips and knees (to be expected) he is perfectly healthy and his last blood panel came back incredibly good. My vet says we are doing all the right things (daily walks and exercise, filtered water, Orijen Senior food) especially since large Goldens typically only live to 10 or 11. When we are out walking quite often we meet much younger goldens (6 to 8 years) that look much older than he does. It really does show what a difference diet and exercise make both in humans and in our canine companions. We have a new puppy (that we adopted from the Best Friends Animal Society) and she is on a mix of Orijen Puppy and doing great. Highly recommend Orijen Adult, Senior and Puppy.

Note:
Many years ago we fed our dogs Canidae because it was decent quality and we were financial limited. But, when the Canidae manufacturer suddenly changed their formula (added more grain and fillers) all of our dogs had bad reactions (diarrhea, vomiting, scratching, skin allergies etc). Numerous trips to the vet and lots of dollars for tests only to find out they were all having a reaction to the poor quality ingredients in their food. That was when I began researching dog food ingredients and decided to go grain-free with a company that only makes dog food. Could not be happier with my decision to spend more on Orijen. Very wise decision on my part, and my dogs are much healthy now than they have ever been.makes dog food. Could not be happier with my decision to spend more on Orijen. Very wise decision on my part, and my dogs are much healthy now than they have ever been.

review_body: It finally shut my dog up however it only worked on one of my dogs. It seems as though one dog is scared of it while the other does not mind anymore so it really depends on your dog.

product_title: FURminator deShedding Tool for Cats, 1.75-Inch Edge
review_body: This brush works. It is everything it promises to be and more. Furthermore, our two cats love it-- one will look on jealously when the other is being brushed. They purr like mad! I'm keeping this review succinct because otherwise I could just go on and on about how much I LOVE THIS BRUSH!

product_title: Coolaroo Elevated Pet Bed with Knitted Fabric
review_headline: Like it w/reservations - but did solve 4th screw assembly challenge
review_body: Just arrived and like many other 1 and 2 star raters, I had a problem getting the 4th screw in by myself.  Gave up and left a message for a friend and then went through all the low star ratings looking for the \\"secret.\\" Did not find it in rating comments but did find the following VERY helpful assembly trick buried in one of the comments.  So to save you time and/or aggravation of searching through all the ratings and comments, please see last paragraph.  I tried it and presto...that said, if I move it, the bed legs twist until I put it down and then seems to stay centered.    Other comments - I like the idea and made fairly well but my 7 month old aussie already tried to chew off the white square label in the corner (so sprayed it with apple bitter).  Not impressed with customer service - tried to call before finding tip and they close at 5pm ET - not helpful if you live in other time zones.  Second, the warranty is worthless as it ONLY covers ultra violet sun damage and then you have to prove it and pay postage.  But if I get a year out of it (Med $26.99 w S&H from another online seller) I will be happy since I bought as a training tool for my 7 month aussie - to learn to stay in his \\"place\\" longer than 5 minutes.  He has lots of beds around the house but the dog obed. teacher said raised beds are best for this.      SoCalAvAZ says: I noticed a few people mentioned they couldn't install it properly or that the bolts don't go together. I wanted to post advice for past and future buyers of the product, there is a little trick to assembling it and I don't know why the company didn't mention it in the manual but it's simple once you read it. When you install the bed there's 4 corners to bolt. Do the first 3, doesn't matter which, AND THEN TAKE THE BED, PUT IT ON IT'S SIDE AND TILT IT, ONCE YOU IT'S TITLED ON BOTH ENDS YOU WILL SEE THAT ADDING THAT 4TH BOLT IS VERY EASY. WE DISCOVERED THIS ACCIDENTALLY. THEN WHEN YOU ADD THE 4TH BOLT YOU NEED TO PLACE IT ON THE GROUNDAND PUSH DOWN ON BOTH END SO IT'S LEVEL. HOPE THAT HELPS!

product_title: Anti Icky Poo Odor Removal 2 Gallon Set
review_body: This product is amazing - the only product that I have found to remove the smell associated with cat urine.

product_title: Mutt Mitts
review_body: These bags are the perfect product for the job and makes the task a lot easier to deal with. Prior to discovering Mutt Mitt we used flimsy poo bags, which really are marketed for small'accessory' pets. My Vizsla eliminates large feces and Mutt Mitts protect you from seeing it, smelling it and worrying of getting it on your hands from tying the bag. Worth the price!

product_title: Designer's Glow-in-the-Dark 3-D Embossed Dog Collar - Pinstripes - Candy Pink, S (10"-14")
review_body: I ordered the Pink pinstripe collar and I think it looks very nice. It is well made. The collar had a strange odor and the merchant suggested washing the collar. The odor was somewhat like a new car odor, but much stronger. The odor is almost gone (after a month).  So far, I have yet to see it glow-in-the-dark.  I like the collar enough so I will keep it and buy one of those battery lights for the collar.  I like the buckle type fastener, because I find those other kind, hard to pinch together to open.

product_title: IRIS Neat 'n Dry Floor Protection and Training Pads for Puppies and Dogs
review_headline: Absorbent, good price, you won't be disappointed
review_body: This is the best xtra large training pad for the money.  There is one pad that I've found to be more absorbent (the Four Paws xtra large), but the IRIS Neat N Dry are much more economical, and close enough to the Four Paws to have become my new daily go-to pad.    I still use the the Four Paws xtra large when I'm know that I'm going to be gone from the house for a longer period; otherwise, the IRIS are my daily use pad.    I've used only the xtra large, and not sure if they are constructed differently than the smaller sized pads from this manufacturer (I've found this to be the case with 2 other manufacturers' pads).  But the xtra large are great, good price ($11 for 20 pads, in comparison to $31.99 for 40 pads from Four Paws), and never had them leak.

product_title: FURminator deShedding Tool with FURejector
review_body: This is an amazing product!  I thought the ejector button was just an unneccessary doodad.  Got the advanced model because it qualified for free shipping.  Its great!  Our animals love it.  They all want a turn and stand in line (2 goldens and a cat) waiting to be brushed.  The furejector makes for easy one handed use.  Gets out LOTS more hair than regular brushing.  Makes for LOTS less hair in the house.

product_title: Solid Gold Berry Balance for Urinary Tract Health in Cats & Dogs; Natural, Holistic Grain-Free Supplement with Antioxidant-Rich Cranberries & Blueberries
review_body: Still had to go to the vet to get some medicine and wipes.  From what I have read the supplement does work.  I have no issues with it but I am not sure if my Huskey is getting any benifit.

product_title: EliteField 48" Two Door Folding Dog Crate, 48" Long X 30" Wide X 32" High
review_body: Really like this crate! easy to put up and take down.  Well made, study construction at a great price!

product_title: Prime Bites Freeze Dried Treats
review_body: My dogs always look forward to this treat. Most dogs like chicken. You don't have to worry about storage since they are freeze dried. It's cheaper and easier than buying chicken at the store, cooking it and storing it. This is not a food, it's a treat. You can also grind up the smaller pieces and spread it on top of their regular dog food.

product_title: Paw Naturaw Natural Bison Liver Treats for Dogs and Cats, 2.6-Ounce Pouches (Pack of 4)
review_body: My dog was crazy about this product, and I love that it's so healthy for him.  The only reason I gave it four stars and not five is the usual fact that healthy foods are overpriced.

product_title: Simple Solution Washable Belly Band Male Dog Diaper
review_headline: Dog in heat, male marking?? No problem!!
review_body: I have a female in her first heat, and a male who will not leave her alone.  The wrap works wonderfully, and I coupled it with prissy pants for her..  Best purchase in the world..  I just wish the wrap didn't scrunch as much, but I haven't found a better one out there..  They can finally play together when I am around, and they are happy..

product_title: Charlee Bear Dog Trea, Liver/Cran
review_body: Nice little treats.  Afterall, it's not the size of the reward, it's the reward.  This way, she gets a few more and less calories.

product_title: MultiVet Anti-Bark Spray Collar, Scentless
review_body: We have a little Chihuahua mix that we adopted and she was a barker until we found this product. Am really wanting it for our Yorkie too but it's not quite small enough. She is only 3 lbs. It works is all I can say. Stopped her barking as soon as we put it on.

product_title: PetSafe Outdoor Ultrasonic Bark Deterrent
review_body: After reading the mixed reviews very carefully, I decided to give this a try.  I am the owner of a wonderful mixed breed dog, 27 lbs., and very barky.  The barky part is his only down side.  Wanting to be able to leave him outside for longer periods of time when the weather is nice, I've tried numerous products, all with bad results. This was to be my last resort.      If only I would have tried this first!  It works great for my little guy.  At first he was a little freaked out and came running to the door to come in the house.  Now, he has adapted very well and just doesn't bark.  Maybe, once a day, he'll bark once but then stops immediately.  And he doesn't freak out anymore.  We've had this product for just over 2 weeks, so I felt it safe to go ahead and write my review.    For small dog owners, I'd say this is a no-brainer.  I would recommend buying it here... I saw in at Menards the other day.  They sell it for $59.95!  You do the math.

product_title: PetSafe Universal Pet Bed Warmer
review_headline: Nice but stopped warming after a few months
review_body: I really liked the size of this pet bed warmer and my cat loved snoozing in his bed instead of tunneling into my bed this winter. Sadly it stopped heating after 4 months.

product_title: Outward Hound Kyjen  DG40100 Dog Agility Starter Kit with Dog Tunnel Weave Pole High Jump Obstacles, Large, Red
review_headline: DOG AGILITY STARTER KIT IS WORTH IT
review_body: THIS IS A GREAT STARTER KIT WHICH INCLUDES INSTRUCTIONS THAT REALLY HELP TO TRAIN YOUR DOG.  SOME OF MY FAVORITE IDEAS WERE TO SHRINK THE TUNNEL SO THE DOG CAN EASILY GET THRU AND GET USED TO IT SLOWLY and TO KEEP THE JUMP POLE VERY LOW AND RAISE IT AS YOUR DOG GETS USED TO JUMPING OVER IT.  THE QUALITY IS GOOD, TOO.  NOW FOR MY DOGS TO BECOME WORLD FAMOUS AGILITY PERFORMERS!!

product_title: AKC 5/8-Inch by 10-16-Inch Collar Adjustable Toy, Brown , Small
review_headline: Nice Faux Leather Collar - Classy Looking
review_body: For the most part I am very pleased with the AKC collar, leash and harness that I purchased.  The color is nice/neutral and the faux leather is stylish along with being softer than your typical nylon products.  I think it is very classy looking and looks to be made well.  My only complaint is the sizing.  I wish they would make more sizes to accommodate pets rather than trying to fit all dogs into 3 or 4 sizes.  Though they are adjustable, the excess material doubled over isn't always comfortable for a dog nor does it look nice.  As the other reviewer mentioned, the snap release is a bit difficult to use, but I thought maybe because it's still new - this is not an issue for me on the collar since I only put it on and take it off once a day though I found the same difficulty with the harness release and that is bothersome since I that goes on and off my dog each time she needs to go out.  Again I'm hoping it will work easier once it's broken in a bit:)

product_title: Litter Locker Refill Cartridge 5 pk
review_body: I have a very large cat (20 lbs). I can't  use the self-cleaning boxes due to the size of his waste. If I tried to use traditional clay litter, I would be changing the box constantly (plus it would be very smelly). Litter Locker has made the whole litter box thing much less annoying. The cat's happy, I'm happy, and the litter is always clean. Being able to buy the refills at a good price makes me even happier.

product_title: Planet Dog Orbee-Tuff Adopt Ball for Dogs
review_headline: Travis loves it and it stands up to Travis
review_body: Hi I am Travis. I am an 8 month old terrier-pit bull mix but most people say i look like a American stafford - whatever that means.  my dog play mates look past the looks and just play with me.  My mom rescued me from a shelter.    I have managed to destroy every other round object my mom gave me to play with (and some that are not round too).  This one has me stumped. Mom puts treats inside and rolls it over; sometimes she'll leave the end of a little treat bone protruding just to remind me there are treats inside. I have learned that I have to chew, bounce, throw this ball for the the treats to come out.  My mom thinks it's fun to put treats that are just slightly bigger than the holes.  And the holes.... I have managed to get my teeth into most holes in objects and tear them apart - not so with this one - it is just small enough that I can not get my teeth in it, but not too small to swallow the ball. And strong!!! I have bitten away with my big back teeth and still it remains whole.... It has kept rolling for about three months. Sure I chew on other things once in awhile but this is the one toy Mom let's me play with inside (she doesn't mind the crumbs that fall out and I don't see either).  I expect that when I do get through this one - she'll just get a new one - just to keep me challenged.... Actually I think she came here today to buy one to keep at her office; sometimes I get to go there with her too. Mom comes here to shop for me cause the price and she gets free shipping on most things! OHHHHH and I forgot - it is latex-free - YEAH - she checked with Planet Dog cause she is alergic to something in rubber toys - but it bounces just like rubber!

product_title: Large Padded Cat Window Perch : Color SPECKLED SAND : Size LARGE PERCH
review_body: Purchased 4 of them so everyone had their own.  Had to modify it a bit as my windows were a bit different but all in all, it worked out perfectly.  Study construction.  2 of my cats are usually on one perch at a time and the perches hold the weight.  Its a great product for inside cats. A great buy. product_title: FURminator Large Yellow deShedding Tool with 4-Inch Edge
review_headline: Great, but not as mind-blowing as expected
review_body: I'm pleased with this purchase, but not as blown away as I expected.    The furminator does the job better than any other brush I've tried, but it didn't remove the huge amount of fur I was expecting.  My dog is a relatively long-haired chocolate lab, and while the brush does a great job, for me it was not the miracle worker other reviews led me to believe.  It does its job well, though, and while it won't completely remove your shedding problems, it's much more thorough than anything else I've tried. product_title: All Natural Insect Spray for Pets - Natures Way Insect Spray - NO DEET - Safe for Pets, People & the Planet (8 oz.) - Made in the USA
review_body: This works as well as anything else I've tried, chemical-laden or natural, plus it has the added bonus of smelling really good (kinda reminds me of bubble gum or candy). I have a sensitivity to citronella but don't get irritated at all by this product. I like that it doesn't become a sticky mess when I rub it on my neck and face. Will definitely be purchasing again!

product_title: Marineland Eclipse Seamless Desktop Corner Aquarium, 5-Gallon
review_headline: Straight from the WE DON"T CARE HOW WE PACK OUR JUNK department
review_body: I opened the box and took the contents out. Checked that I had everything, read instructions, and then noticed the inside of the tank had a random 3 or 4 inch piece of clear tape stuck to it. Uh-oh. That can be nasty. The tape they make these days leaves a gummy film that you can't dynamite off. Maybe I should just send it back, I thought. But dope that I am, I did Net research on how to remove tape gunk. I was as careful as I could be. Here I am hours later with an ugly, scratched (and yes, as someone else pointed out, it scratches very easily) tank with a filmy blob smeared across the inside front. Thanks for the careful packing, guys.

product_title: How to Take Care of Your Cat or Kitten
review_headline: Once again a Must Have for Cat Owners of all levels.
review_body: If you know anyone that is interested in getting a cat or even is thinking about having a pet these pocket guides are really very well done. They should be included in any information pet owners purchase because you can't carry a large book around but you CAN carry these in the car, in a purse, and Oh Yeah IN A POCKET! Because they are pocket guides. Great collection of information. I have all 4.

product_title: AquaticLife Internal Mini Skimmer 115 - up to 30 gal. - 3 in x 3.25 in x 10.5 in
review_headline: AquaticLife Internal Mini Protein Skimmer 115 review
review_body: I purchased this skimmer for my 24 gallon resun dms 500. It fits well in the third slot. Skimmer took about 2 days of adjusting it, to get it producing foam. It now produces some wet dark green skim. The skimmer does the job very nicely for the price paid, and such a small volume tank. I do not have a problem with bubble since it run through the post filter sponge before being pumped back into tank. The only complaint is the air flow knob it hard to turn.

product_title: Mardel Ammonia Test Strips (Freshwater), 25ct
review_body: I've been using test strips for years.  My latest batch  are the [[ASIN:B000UWSB7C Jungle Test Strips]], but I often use the Mardel ones.  The Jungle ones test for chlorine (including chloramine), the Mardel ones don't.  Chlorine isn't a factor for me, so no big deal.    Regardless, dip, wait,  read.  Follow the directions.  No big deal.    I do confess that I reached a point where I didn't trust the strips.  No particular reason other than random doubt.  So, I bought [[ASIN:B000255NCI Freshwater Test Kit]] and [[ASIN:B000255ND2 Freshwater Hardness Test Kit]] ('cause the other didn't test hardness).  The new test kits have test tubes and droppers and stuff.  Not tough to use, but not nearly as easy as the test strips.  End result - the test strips are fine.    Still, I'm glad to have verified the results.  It took away one point of uncertainty.    I'm posting this review (slightly edited) for the Jungle strips too because I use both brands interchangeably.

product_title: Evangers Super Premium Gold Vegetarian 14 oz Dog 24 cans
review_body: We discovered our dogs had an allergy to meat, fish and eggs.  The oldest dog we had was throwing up alot after eating a meat diet. When we switched to the vegetarian Evangers dog food, the upset stomach and throwing up ceased.  We were happy to see the progress of our doggie in his return to health after a steady diet of the Evangers vegetarian canned dog food.  We are quite happy with their products.

product_title: Drinkwell Reservoir, 70 Ounce
review_headline: Leaks! Company does not respond. Would rate lower if possible.
review_body: I bought this as I have two cats and wanted to expand the capacity on the original. It always leaks when I fill it up with water and very often when I fill it less than halfway. I've written several e-mails to the company and gotten no response.

product_title: Petmate 22501 LitterLocker Plus with Microban, White/Planet Blue
review_headline: Great if you know what your doing...
review_body:
Well I've had this for two months and I have two cats. I keep it right next to the litter box and a couple times a day I scoop it out and no longer waste grocery bags or time taking it to the dumpster. By keeping the boxes so clean they won't go to the bathroom where they aren't supposed to.

It does have design flaws-it could use a handle, needs a bigger hole to put waste in, and be easier to reassemble-but I still find it completely worth it. I love that it has a place for the scoop! A nice little cozy that hides the gross scoop and you can take out and clean if you want; the scoop itself is very good quality also. It stays pretty clean but I like to take a disinfecting wipe to it and the litter box dome because you are touching it so often.

I live in a townhouse and the boxes are in the kitchen area. We can't smell the odor of the waste in the locker unless you open it or bend down fairly close to it. Because it didn't smell we actually stopped turning the knob which seals it-you use less of the bag insert this way. I still don't smell it, guests don't either, and I just fill it till the container is full. I've taken it out twice so far, and it is about half full now, and I'm still on the first cartridge it came with. If you decide to just let it fill up you just have to be careful taking it out, I tie a knot in the bag but when its that full (you may have a little hole somewhere in the bag so watch out) I just grab it and put it in a grocery bag because if it breaks on the way to the dumpster, you are screwed. So it takes a few minutes to change, and you use one grocery bag every 3 weeks, for me it is worth it. A million times better than taking it out once or twice a day.

I decided to buy the diaper genie 2 refill instead of the petmate brand to save money, I know it will work and roughly fits but I wonder if it has the same amount of plastic bag, when I find out I will update the review.

A drawback some people have is that their cat will always pee in the same place creating a mega-clump. You have to scoop before they do because the hole isn't big enough for some giant pieces. If both my cats go in the same spot it fits, if they were to go again I don't think it would. If you have that problem and can't scoop often enough to fix it, you can use an old diaper genie, they often have them at yard sales for cheap.e in the same place creating a mega-clump. You have to scoop before they do because the hole isn't big enough for some giant pieces. If both my cats go in the same spot it fits, if they were to go again I don't think it would. product_title: Virbac C.E.T. Chews - Fish Flavor
review_body: I purchased these for a number of months and gave them to my cat who suffers from gingivitis.  However, the last couple of bags I purchased, the product was yellowy and did not look or smell fresh.  I threw them out and have not ordered any more.  I think that the manufacturer needs to improve their QC.    No, I did not complain because frankly I don't have the time or the energy to fight these types of situations.  I just won't order any more.

product_title: Drinkwell Original Pet Fountain
review_body: We purchased the Drinkwell Original Pet Fountain in February 2009, and we have used it with two different cats.  It has worked perfectly and is still going strong.  It cleans great in the dishwasher.

product_title: Remote Control Dog Training Shock and 2 Vibration Collar
review_body: This does not work for the distance advertised. This only works when my do is moving slowly and at close range (less than 75 feet).  Works fine in the yard, but not in the park.

product_title: PetSafe Electronic SmartDoor, Automatic Dog and Cat Door, Collar Activated with SmartKey, Small or Large
review_body: My first petsafe door was a disaster.  It jammed all the time then finally quit.  They sent me a new one, which I installed, and it works great.  The dog can get in and out, but the cats can't.  I've had it two weeks now and it hasn't jammed once.  For anyone getting one, I really recommend the extra magnets - they seem to help quite a bit.

product_title: Ethical Beyond Tough Horseshoe Dog Toy, 7-Inch
review_body: My puppy destroyed this in a day in a half. Not worth the money I paid.

product_title: KONG Extreme Dog Toy, Black
review_headline: Loved (and holds up) to our 2 pit bulls - big chewers!
review_body: We LOVE these extreme Kong toys.  They are one of the few items that can be trusted with our two pitbull mixes (who tear apart anything else in under 20 minutes.)  A few tips, canned dog food or peanut butter can be used on the inside.  Once they get \\"good\\" at getting that out (you don't want them to get distracted/lose interest), then you stuff it the same, but then freeze it.  It takes our guys 3x as long to then get all the stuff out.  I like these because they are safe for their teeth (sterilized bones and harder bones will chip/break their teeth), and these are easy to clean (can put in dishwasher.)  Our house wouldn't be the same without several of these to rotate through!

product_title: JW Gripsoft Pet Hair Magnet
review_body: This product works real well.  But buying online was a mistake, found it cheaper in stores.  Other problem, it does not last long. The edge of the tool becomes smooth and is no longer effective.  You then need to toss and buy another.

product_title: Arm and Hammer Clumping Cat Litter, Multi-Cat Strength, 40 Pound Box
review_body: This stuff stinks before you use it - once it's in the litterbox, prepare to have to toss the whole contents by the second day.  It's pointless that it's clumping litter due to this fact...it does nothing to conceal odor.  I use Feline Fresh and it's the best out there plus it's flushable...you get what you pay for in this case.

product_title: Adams Inverted Carpet Spray 16oz
review_body: It took me few time to spray before I got rid of flees. Works good, smell little bit bad, but I expected it to be worse.

product_title: Petstages Just For Fun No Stuffing Plush Big Squeak Toy for Large Dogs
review_body: the company writes on packaging, \\"Chambers Squeek even when Punctured\\", MAYBE!!! but it just quit squeeking, no punctures. This darned thing was a waste of $$, didn't squeek for 10 minutes, and this was with a 3  1/2 month old puppy.

product_title: Feliway - Refill, 48 ml
review_body: This product does exactly what is claims.  I love Feliway and so does my 5 kitties.

product_title: Charming Medium Pumpkin Party Collar
review_body: This collar is very full and covered in large Halloween sequin type decorations.  The fall colors look great.  I have been loaning our collar to others for photos.  It comes packaged and the medium will fit easily over a toy dog's head, as well as a large cat (yes, we tried it!)  It has enough give to fit a dog that wears a 14 inch collar size.

product_title: Instant Ocean-Aquarium Systems AIOSG31 Seagarden Caulerpa Verticellata Aquarium Decorative Plant, Medium
review_headline: Looks Great!  Used for over 5 years now
review_body: This is one of the prettiest plants I have for my fish tank and I have been washing it in oxyclean and reusing it for over 5 years.  The only thing at all wrong with it is the little leave \\"pods\\" can come off their plastic \\"branches\\" but they snap back on.  I love this plant and have been looking for it to replace the one I have since over time mine has lost a few of the leaves (down the drain when cleaning, etc.)  But it does really lend a nice look to the tank and its great for the fish to hide in as it stays near the floor of the tank.  We have used it in 50 gallon tanks and currently a 10 gallon tank, and I love it. One of my favorites.

product_title: Lambert Kay Products CLK51108 Ear Rite Ingredient for Aquarium, 1-Ounce
review_headline: It helps. But imagine putting Icy Hot in your ears. Now you get the idea....
review_body: After treating the cat with this stuff, and having her run off and hide before we could get the excess out of her ears, we found the cat coming to us drooling like crazy. She was trying to get this stuff out of her ears and got it in her mouth... We managed to get it on our hands and it is hot like icy hot rub.... It certainly is cleaning the cats ears out, and she scratches far less, but it is really not a pleasant thing for her...    I guess this is what we get for taking in an orphaned cat....

product_title: PetSafe Deluxe Big Dog Trainer, PDBDT-305
review_body: Fits well.  Works great.  A few quick zaps along with a strong \\"No\\" and he behaves nicely the rest of the walk.

product_title: Mighty Dog Select Menu Seared Tenderloin Tips Flavor in Savory Sauce, 5.5-Ounce Cans (Pack of 24)
review_body: Really loves the canned dog food but it gave him the runs eventhough we are only giving him one table spoon on top of dry.

product_title: Animal Planet Round Fleece Pet Bed, 23 x 23 x 6, Pack of 2
review_headline: My cat and dog alternate between the two beds !
review_body:
