product_title: Nolvasan Otic Cleansing Solution 16oz Btl
review_body: I have poodles and this is the best ear cleaner, at the  best price. Very fast shipping.

product_title: K&H Thermo-Kitty Heated Cat Bed
review_body: I have two cats. One is a little skiddish and has not really approached but the other absolutely loves the bed. He curls up and sleeps for hours. I feel the bed and it does not feel too warm on the floor or on him and it seems to make him very happy. Glad I decided to purchase.

product_title: Cosmic Pet 4.5 Ounce Cup Catnip
review_body: My cats think that this indeed is Cosmic catnip.  Even the feral cat who slips in through the cat door to eat thinks that it is the best!

product_title: Vet's Best Sun Spray Sunscreen for Dogs, 4oz
review_body: My dog has an immune disorder and this seems to help prevent the flare ups she gets on her nose when out in the sun. We do a lot hiking during the year and she is out in the sun a lot. I feel it works for us.

product_title: Puppia Soft Dog Harness (Mesh) Purple Large
review_body: the Puppia dog harness arrived quick and its quality was just as promised. The harness is very soft and comfortable for the dog. I had gone to the actual Puppia site to look at the sizes of the harnesses and what it meant for the extra small to fit an extra small dog. I have two corgis and using the measurement I bought mediums.  If I had not found the original puppia measurements on other websites I would have been steered toward a large... Too big for my dogs. I believe that because of the stretch in the fabric and the European measurement that it is safer to go down a size than up.  Anyways, my dogs did not like the regular harness my four-year-old wouldn't even walk with one on. I have seen these harnesses before and did not know that they made them for larger dogs. The cost and shipping are excellent and I believe I received them in a day or two, perfect service.

product_title: Window Mounted Cat Door, Custom Made To Size.
review_body: Other window-mounted cat doors did not fit our windows.  This cat door was built to our specifications and is just the ticket!  The cat door is very sturdy and easy to install.  Our cat had no problem learning to use the door - no more \\"in and out\\" through the people door!  The seller was very helpful and promptly answered our questions.  We highly recommend this product and this seller.

product_title: Precision Pet SnooZZy Tuffet Pet Bed
review_body: We have had 3 dogs, small, medium, and large, using this bed for the last 8 months. We have other dog beds, but they all want to sleep on this one. The cushion is still as thick and fluffy as the day we got it, and it's the first bed we've had that they haven't been able to dig a hole in. It's taken a beating, but it's well made and the cushion, fabric and stitching are still in new condition. Unlike other dog bed product descriptions, the manufacturer didn't exaggerate the 32\\" x 32\\" size. We paired it with the 34x34 Noz2Noz Sof-Bed, to keep it off the floor, and it fits perfectly. Excellent product.

product_title: C.E.T. HEXtra Premium Chews with Chlorhexidine for Dogs, 15 Petite Chews
review_body: I have a sheltie with an underbite. These chews are one of the only chews he will chew on. Sometimes I buy the petite chews and sometimes the medium ones and I cut them apart. The petite chews look different then the medium chews. My dog seems to like them both.

product_title: FURminator Large Yellow deShedding Tool with 4-Inch Edge
review_body: I used this on a pomeranian, who loves to be groomed, a sheppard chow mix who hates to be groomed, two Mainecoon cats that hate to be combed and two short hair plain ordinary (but don't tell them) cats who love to be combed.  All six pets agreed this thing was fantastic. Even the Maincoons purred and didn't try to run off.  The Sheppard/chow wagged her tail didn't try to sit down or walk off.    The Sheppard/chow is one of those dogs that has the never ending tuffs of fur coming off her all summer long. One good combing with her and she was good for two weeks. I think it is amazing I have never found a comb like this before.   Love it five stars!

product_title: Andis Power De-Shedder
review_headline: Great if your dog is a shedder!
review_body: The Andis deshedder works GREAT!  The only reason I gave it a 4 and not a 5 is that the power part of it is not really necessary.  It works just as well for my dog with the power on as with the power off.  Perhaps for some skiddish dogs it is helpful, but if your dog already likes to be brushed save some money and get the regular deshedder without the power.  You won't be disappointed!

product_title: ProMeris for Small Dogs 11 - 22 Pounds 6 Doses USA Version / EPA Registered
review_headline: If you love your pet, do your research about this product.
review_body: I went to the vet to purchase my usual flea and tick treatment and was told by the vet that this was a better product than FLPlus because fleas and ticks were becoming resistant to the ingredients in FLPlus.  I thought, ok, the vet recommends this, so it must be a good product, plus it was cheaper so I said I'd take it.  Upon opening the container, the odor was overwhelming.  I applied the product according to directions and noticed a tick jump right off the dog.  Wow! I am thinking this stuff is awesome.  Well, the whole house smelled terribly from the odor and my children started complaining of the smell.  A little later, and both of my kids are complaining of headaches.  I opened the windows and doors to air out the house and put the dog outside as well.  I purchased this product for my perfectly healthy Bichon Frise.  About 5 hours later, and yes the house still smelled, my dog starts to throw up.  I didn't connect his throwing up to the Promeris until he continued throwing up for 3 days.  I called the vet and he basically shrugged it off and said it was just a coincidence. My dog had never thrown up like he did those 3 days and he hasn't since either.  The vet said if I was so worried to just give the dog a bath, hello, I just paid for this stuff  and now I'm supposed to wash it off?  Well, I refused to believe that my dog was just throwing up out of the blue so I got on the internet and started researching the product.  I stumbled upon quite a few others who had problems as well, some even more serious than what my dog experienced.  So, just a heads up to those who want to try this, do your research first.

product_title: Nutro Ultra Weight Management Dog Food, 15 Lb.
review_headline: Just started feeding Nutro Ultra Weight Management
review_body: I've just started feeding this on a recommendation from a friend. I foster Chihuahuas and have one that appears to gain weight just by looking at food. I don't yet know how well it's going to work since I just started it. I'm hoping it will help the little guy.

product_title: Advantage Once-A-Month Topical Flea Treatment for Cats
review_body: Amazon was $26 cheaper than the local PetSmart!  I am using this on my dog and cat, I haven't seen any ticks yet.........  and I hope not to!  Way better price tag!

product_title: PetSafe Gentle Spray Bark Collar for Dogs, Citronella, Anti-Bark Device, Water Resistant
review_headline: Lifesaver!  So glad we bought these for our two little dogs!
review_body: Our dogs would bark when anyone came to the house.  We put these on when we know someone is stopping over.  They barked once and did not bark again.  What an awesome product.  Easy to refill too.

product_title: Loving Pets Coop-Cup with Wire Hanger Pet Bowl
review_body: This is so great for my dogs. It saves on spillage and room. I highly recommend it . Not only for water but dry food also. And it fits all my cages so far. I have three. And they are all different styles and sizes. Of course my dogs appreciate it also.

product_title: Dogswell Vitality Chicken Breast Treats (15 oz)
review_body: I have to agree that I am not comfortable with treats made in China, and also find it difficult to believe in the all-natural, cage-free claims. Why not make them in the U.S.? I am trying to decide if I should keep the ones I already have or throw them away and get something I trust. The company claims they test for many dangerous chemicals and additives, but some enterprising criminal somewhere is bound to come up with something that nobody has thought to test for, imo. That's what I'm afraid of. *sigh*

product_title: All Four Paws, The Comfy Cone Pet Recovery Collar
review_body: I've always used those plastic e-collars after my dogs have had surgery.  My older dog reacted very poorly to wearing one - she hardly moved around the house and banged up everything in her path when she did.  I decided to try something different when my puppy was spayed recently.  I got this collar in X-large because of her snout (German Shepherd).  Her neck was smaller than the measurements but the velcro closure made the neck fit.  The animal hospital staff put it on her immediately after surgery and used a long piece of gauze to keep it in place. They thought the collar worked well.  My dog slept comfortably with it on. It was easy to fold the edge of the collar back when she walked around the house and yard, as well as when eating. I highly recommend this collar.  It's a great investment.

product_title: PetSafe Staywell Infrared 4-Way Locking Cat Flap, White
review_headline: Much better than the Magnetic Door
review_body: Have 4 cats, 1 of which is a \\"problem\\" cat that needs her own space. I set up a downstairs basement room for just her and added one of Staywells Magnetic cat doors which was not that successful.  The magnet that fit on the cat collar had to come up to the door just a certain way for the latch to activate and let the cat into the room, if the cat was moving fast as they are likely to do- the cats head would butt up against the door and the door wouldn't open.  As you can imagine after several times of this the cat would give up and we would have to coax/train her to try it again (yes I made sure the units batteries were strong).  The Infrared door is well worth the price over the magnetic.  It's much more sensitive about activating the door when the cat gets close to it.  No more head butts to a locked door.  Has worked great for several years now and the only problem is when the battery died it allowed the other 3 cats to gain access (dont ask me how they knew, but the pesky buggers must try on a regular basis). New batteries- Double A's lasted me over a year) and everything is back to normal.  An AC adapter would be handy but with batteries lasting so long I'll stick to them. The batteries in the collar also lasted over a year, and I only noticed they were dead when her \\"private\\" litter box wasnt getting dirty. They were cheap button batteries and easy to replace.  Came back today to order another collar for one of the other cats so it could share the room. Ours is a \\"blue\\" coded key which is 10 dollars more than the yellow key-dont ask me why.  All in all- a really good answer to a pet door that needs to be very selective on who gets in.

product_title: Zymox Otic Pet Ear Treatment with Hydrocortisone
review_body: My dog had a yeast infection in her ears when I rescued her.  The vet prescribed mometamax, which is the right thing to do.  Every time I treated my dog with mometamax, it was the same:  The symptoms would go away for a week and then come back, as it hadn't killed all the yeast.      I tried longer and longer treatments of mometamax but it always ended the same way.  By a year of doing this, I was extremely frustrated and didn't know what to do.    Then I hunted around on the internet and found Zymox.  I ordered it and treated my dog with it.  It worked!  For good!  And it costs a whole lot less than mometamax.  And you don't have to pay for an office visit!

product_title: Drinkwell 360 Pet Fountain
review_body: My cats and I love the Drinkwell 360, but I was having trouble finding a good cleaning tool for it. The reviews for the cleaning kit Drinkwell sells were pretty poor so I looked for another option. I bought a baby bottle brush that also included a nipple brush, for just $2.00. These two tools work great for getting into all spaces you need to. Now cleaning the fountain is much easier and quicker! I highly recommend giving this a try!

product_title: Petmate Booda Dome Litter Box
review_body:
I suppose it's not for everyone but it works really well for me. I use [[ASIN:B000YKD3SW Worlds Best Cat Litter 17 lb Original]] so tracking and dust aren't an issue.

My 3 cats, 12#, 13# and 14# share it and nobody has ever had an accident that didn't stay inside.

Easy to scoop out and small enough to wash.

product_title: Ginsey Pet Paw Cleaner
review_body: My wife loves it.  Puppy went out today and first thing she did was did a one foot hole, when she came to door my wife grabbed the Paw Cleaner, placed the paw in it and WOW its clean and the water, well lets just say it was dirty.

product_title: Jolly Pets Push-n-Play 14-Inch
review_body: I have two English Bulldogs, they LOVE these balls. I have 3 of them for them and they are always outside pushing them around. As others have said they are HARD! hence the word indestructible! All the other balls I have had are destoyed within a week. They have not figured out how to destroy these. Best balls ever! Not too heavy to throw, if you can get it away from your dog!

product_title: Vo-Toys Tiny Tails Mini Animal Vinyl Assorted 6 pack Dog Toy
review_body: These are my little Westie's favorite toys.  She has been playing with them for years.  Well about two years ago we could no longer find them in the pet store, so I went on line.  Found your site and ordered 10 bags so we would never run out again.  Problem with your product is that it is made with much cheaper products than the ones we used to get.  With your toy the squeaker is broken in less than a minute.  Sooooooooooooooo disappointing for my dog and myself.  She loves to play music for us with her toys and with yours the squeaker is dead before she even gets to start playing.  I will continue to order the toys for her as she knows the name of each one and adores them so, but I am also going to work hard at finding her something else of better quality to play with.

product_title: Bayer K9 Advantix II (Over 55-lbs)
review_body: After trying several over the counter & other home remedies, I ordered the Advantix as a last resort.  One application and 24 hours later, no fleas could be seen on either of my three dogs!!  Made me feel bad that they'd suffered so long while I tried so many other ways to get rid of the fleas.  Will definitely be reordering!

product_title: Soft Sided Pet Taxi - Black
review_body: I ordered 2 of this item and when it arrived I was very pleased with the product.  I needed these for airline travel and they had a large amount of ventilation on all 4 sides, zipper closed smoothly, easy access from the top or the end, fuzzy fleece like material for the bottom and a good stiff frame that still folds flat once used.  I would give this product 5 stars instead of 4 if my cat hadn't popped through and escaped up my leg during the flight.  This may have been because of my not fastening the velcro closure tight enough.) Overall I would recommend this item and purchase again if needed.

product_title: LitterMaid LME9000 Elite Mega Advanced Automatic Self-Cleaning Litter Box
review_body: I had 2 older model Littermaid boxes. They worked fine but they had a built-in design problem (planned obsolescence ?) so they only lasted a couple of years each. The power cord for the scooper would eventually break from metal fatigue at which point the scooper was dead. I bought the new model because Littermaid fixed the power problem by redesigning how the scooper worked. Unfortunately, although the power cord was fixed, the overall operation of the unit was vastly inferior to the previous models. The new scooper is supposed to slide on plastic rails but it always jams. The motor unit can't figure out when to stop backing up. The scooper itself is under powered. The older units worked fine; this new one almost never works. Save yourself the aggravation and the money. Based on my experience, I can't recommend this Littermaid product.

product_title: Exotic Environments Red Sea Hide-Away Aquarium Ornament
review_body: There's nothing wrong with the manufacturing or quality - the item seems well made and its structure is basically the same as shown in the picture.  But the colors are nothing like what is shown.  In reality, it is much darker, less kid-like.  The \\"red\\" coral on the right is really a deep purple; the \\"yellow\\" smokestack looking things are really green; the \\"light blue\\" flower like things on the left are really a dark copper/burnt orange; the small \\"purple\\" flowers are blue and yellow; the \\"light purple\\" brain-like looking things at the bottom are blue and a little purple, but much darker than in the picture; the little \\"yellow\\" flowers are red.  The remaining parts are a couple shades of deep, deep forest green.    It was for a 7 year old, so I am very disappointed.

product_title: Cat Mate Pet Fountain - 70 Fluid Oz.
review_body: Very reasonable price, quiet and my picky cat loves it.  I like the different areas that he can get a drink from.  Thank You

product_title: Holiday Basket for Small Dog
review_body: I hate to give a bad review but I bought this for my toy poodle and when I got it I couldn't believe how small it was!!  It was WAY too expensive for the little gift basket I got.  I actually returned it for a refund.  I actually ended up buying items myself and making a bigger basket for less than I spent on this one.  I would not recommend this item because you will just be throwing your money away.

product_title: Oster Hi-Velocity Stand Dryer
review_body: This dryer has multiple heat settings, but only one speed. The product description didn't say it had only one speed.

product_title: Soft Claws Blue Cat Nail Caps
review_headline: Excellent idea but not quite refined well enough
review_body: Our cats are generally very well behaved but since we got a second cat, the two play so rigorously that sometimes they damage the surrounding furniture. We were concerned about our leather couches, otherwise, everything else was fine. The covers themselves do a perfect job of really blunting the nails, they try to scratch but not even the slightest nick shows!     Application was a tricky part. The front paws are easy since you can nestle the cat between your legs as you kneel down and make a V shape out of them. The hind legs are harder and is a two person job because our cats do resist. You may have to make do with a few hind nails at a time. I tried doing them all at once and Snowy got so emotionally upset about it, so I gave him a generous treat that day.     They also fell off more quickly that I expected. Within a few days, half of them fell off, but maybe next time I'll try to trim their nails shorter so the cap fits on more snugly, there were a few nails that were still on the longer end.    And the third issue is what has been the biggest concern that some already mentioned. Maybe I did not apply the caps well enough, but one day, Snowy got his nail caught in a loop of carpet. He was so distressed and screaming his little head off. He kept yanking to get his paw away but I got it out of the carpet for him by pulling forward then back because of how the nails curve.    I am debating just getting slip covers for the couches and resuming to regular nail trimming since that is the only problem. They miss scratching their scratching posts (it is a source of leisure and exercise for them too), dislike having these put on especially if these fall off so fast anyways, and the event with getting stuck at the carpet was very scary. Oh yes, the price I find to be high. $20 for 40 and having to continuously replace those can get costly. Or, if I do try it again, I would be sure to cut their nails shorter for a more snug fit, maybe they will stay on longer then.

product_title: FURminator Large Yellow deShedding Tool with 4-Inch Edge
review_headline: Best grooming tool in the WORLD
review_body: I have a FURminator..I have purchased FURminators for my friends...This is absolutely the best tool for dogs that have a thick undercoat and even for those who don't...My husband calls it the \\"de-thatcher\\"..  Buy it..you won't regret it.  I promise.

product_title: Vet's Best Cat Hairball Relief Digestive Aid, 60 Chewable Tablets, Classic Chicken Flavor
review_headline: Works great and my cat loves it.
review_body:
Vet's Best Hairball Relief really works. My long haired Maine Coon cat was harking up furballs on a weekly basis before I started giving him this stuff. Now he just passes them. He takes it twice a day and begs for it if I forget to give it to him. I cut the tablet into quarters and just feed it to him. Combined with Iam's Hairball Formula dry food, he hasn't had a problem in months.

I like Vet's Best because it's all natural and has among other things, Psyllium, Marshmallow, Slippery Elm Bark and Papaya extract.

product_title: Zuke's Jerky Naturals Grain Free Tender Lamb Dog Treats
review_body: My Miniature Schnauzer just loves these treats! That's the best review I can give doggy treats.

product_title: Chunky Chews 8" Braided Rawhide Rings for Large Dogs
review_body: My dog LOVES to chew- she's 6 months old and is about 30lbs.  She can get through a rawhide pretty quickly- this one has lasted the longest and is perfect!  Since it takes longer for her to chew it up/eat it, her tummy doesn't get upset like it does with other rawhides that don't last very long.  I highly recommend this to anyone whose dog loves rawhide!

product_title: Vitality Dog Food
review_body: This Dogswell food is one heck of a good buy for my pups, and they like it just fine. Trouble is, what used to look like \\"stew\\" (chunks of meaty things andt recognizable vegetables) now looks like barf. It must taste the same to the dogs, though, so no complaints have been registered. This is good, since I recently received a 4 case order. It seems to be the same high quality product that Dogswell has been producing before. Just looks different, that's all. Must have been a corporate decision...I'll keep on buying it, though I wish they would go back to the old formula.

product_title: Veterinarian's Best Ear Relief Wash for Dogs - 4 oz
review_body: When I first got my dog 9 years ago, both ears were terribly infected.  I have tried other products but they did not work.  I have been using this product for 5 years now and the vet is impressed at how clean I can get her ears.    I also use the Ear Relief Dry after cleaning with this product.

product_title: Boss Pet FatHedz Dog Toy
review_headline: My 6 lb Yorkie Poo LOVES this toy!
review_body: I bought this for my 2 year old Yorkie Poo and he LOVES it.  It's practically bigger than he is, but he carries it everywhere with him, squeaking away.  Very durable as well - he hasn't chewed any holes in it and he's had it for 2+ months.

product_title: JW Pet SkidStop Slow Feed Pet Bowl ( Blue/ White )
review_headline: From a 30 second inhale to a few minutes of gulping
review_body: This bowl definitely slowed down my golden retriever puppy's eating from 30 seconds to a few minutes, and cut down on the farting, hiccuping and belching that went along with his food inhalation.  The \\"skid stop\\" is a joke, though; my dog pushes this bowl all across the kitchen floor.  Perhaps putting this bowl on a rubber mat would help?

product_title: Eco Earth for Small Animal and Insects Size: 3 Brick
review_body: I have a sulcata tortoise who has a indoor enclosure and did not want to use soil in the house; My tortoise digs and burrows into this product and loves it.

product_title: Kong Classic Dog Toy
review_body:
What a wonderful product...This toy is a great one, for that special dog in your life...Fill it with Peanut Butter, or Kong's variety of treats.

While this toy will keep your dog entertained for a bit, it still strongly advised assuming regular exercise and quality time with your pet. This toy simply serves as a mental challenge and short-term \\"baby-sitter\\" for your pet, and does not give them the proper exercise.

It is very durable, but if you have a \\"power-chewer\\" it is recommended you purchase the Black kong toy, as it's a lot more stronger and durable. It's always a good idea to have more than one available for your pet. Simply, fill, freeze, and give to your pet. Wedge it in the fence, if your pet is in a cage and it presents a bigger challenge thus keeping them occupied and not barking.

It is also recommended that you purchase the right size for your pet. I have a 8 month old GSD, and he currently used the large, however, I think he'd be a little happier with a size bigger for maximum treat capacity. Please check out Kong's size chart for an idea about what size you need... [...]

Amazon is a great place to purchase these toys from, if buying more than just the one toy. I purchased the Classic Red, the Black, and the squirrel toy and am really happy I did.

product_title: Bergan Turbo Track Cat Toy
review_headline: Poorly constructed, I am not happy
review_body: This toy was interesting to my cats, but like most posters, it falls apart just looking at it.  So sad...for the cats and for my pocketbook.  Amazon should remove this product from the website or tell the manufacturer to FIX IT so it is sturdy!  Dang, I can't afford to spend my money on J-U-N-K.  I wonder if the manufacturer reads these reviews.  I doubt it.

product_title: Merial Frontline Plus Flea and Tick Control for Dogs
review_headline: Great price on a invaluable tool
review_body: Frontline Plus is extremely easy to use and effective.  You know you are going to need this product (or Advantix) in the warm months, and you can save a bundle by ordering through Amazon rather than going to your retail store.  I know here (York, PA) I can get 6 months on Amazon for the price of 3 months at all the local pet stores (including the chains).

product_title: KONG Cat Zoom Groom Brush
review_body:
Last summer my husband's friend got us two kitties as sort of a wedding present. Having grown up with animals, we were delighted to receive such a gift. We soon found out that we got two long haired cats and hair was (and is) everywhere. We love the cats to death, but fight over \\"my suit is covered with cat hair\\" almost daily. That being said...

My mom is an recent graduate (and now employee) of one of the nation's top grooming schools. She got me a Zoom Groom from a trade show. Once I got this thing I immediately tried the product on the cats. After some uses (with a slicker brush) I already see less hair everywhere! The product does a great job of loosening up the fur/hair. Why didn't I get this sooner?

Zoom Groom isn't necessarily a brush. According to my mom's professional grooming opinion she said to use the Zoom Groom according to directions to loosen and pull up the dead hair. Then go over the cat's coat with a slicker brush to finish and \\"shine\\" the coat. Which I agree on 100%.

Zoom Groom is almost ergonomically made. It fits and feels comfortable in my hand. I think it will take some time for my cats to really enjoy the Zoom Groom, I think it feels a little strange on their skin or something...they just feel a little nervous every time I use it.

I would say the Zoom Groom is a little hard to clean and takes some time to use. But Zoom Groom is definitely worth the investment for long haired cat owners...or really any cat owner.

product_title: Iams Veterinary Formula Intestinal Low Residue Dog Food (15 lbs)
review_body: What more could you want?  This product was advertised more cheaply and in larger quantity than is available at a store near us.  I ordered, it came - quickly and in perfect shape.  Nice job, everyone!

product_title: PetSafe Gentle Spray Bark Collar for Dogs, Citronella, Anti-Bark Device, Water Resistant
review_headline: I don't know how we made it without this collar!
review_body: This collar finally ended all of my frustrations with my 2 yr old mini schnauzer!  Before I had the collar, my dog would bark uncontrollably at any person or dog she saw whenever I had her outside.  It got to where I felt like I had to hide if I saw someone walking our way so she wouldn't cause a scene.  It was so embarrassing!  This collar has helped out SO much!  The first time I put it on my dog and she barked and got sprayed, she tucked her tail and hid under the bed.  I felt really bad because she was shaking so badly.  She actually got over that incredibly quickly and I was able to take her on a nice walk that night without any barks!  She has learned that she can growl and bark very softly and it won't make the spray go off, but I'll take it.  It's nothing like the constant shrill barking she used to do!  Sometimes she will forget she has the collar on and will bark once, but the spray gets her and she immediately stops.  It's just so funny because you can tell she wants to bark so badly, but she knows she can't!  If she starts barking while she's inside, all I have to do is show her the collar and she tucks her tail and immediately stops.  This collar is unbelievable!

product_title: Pet Lookout Car Booster Seat
review_body: This is my second carseat.  I love it.  It is an updated version of my previous carseat but is made a lot more securely.  My dog loves riding in the car and this is perfect for keeping her safe and allowing her to look out the window during the ride.  I have also purchased the carseat for medium sized dogs.  The only drawback is that it comes with an inflatable plastic pillow that is inserted in the bottom.  I just put a regular bed pillow inside instead.  Now I don't have to worry about the heat affecting the level of inflation.

product_title: Vibram K9 Ball Dog Toy
review_body: I bought this ball for my 80 pound German Shepard pup who is OCD with balls! He has torn apart more balls then I can count and has had to have surgery for eating one! We were very worried about him not getting to play with his favorite toy anymore. We bought this ball and to our delight he has played with it and not destroyed it. It has held up to his powerful jaws! He takes it everywhere he goes and chews it nonstop! I would highly reccomend it!!

product_title: World's Best Cat Litter (17-lb bag)
review_body: My cat will not touch this litter. If we didn't have two boxes, he would pee all over the house rather than use it. It's made of corn and it attracts bugs, as well. I had to dump all of this litter out of his box and replace it with our usual litter. Definitely will not buy again or reccomend.

product_title: Kaytee CritterTrail 2-Level Habitat
review_body: We have two mice, one of whom is very small (even for a mouse) and an escape artist, named JJ.  We had them in a much larger modified rat cage, but had some problems with the bottom liner.  When this system unexpectedly failed, we had to go with what we could get locally.    Enter the Critter Trail 2 level.  Because the bars are only horizontals with very few verticals, a truly determined mouse can slide right between them.  The only reason we till have JJ is that every-time she gets out she goes to sit on top of the cage for a while, before climbing back in.  We might as well be keeping them free range.  We tried cover the inside of the wire portions with mesh, but it gets in the way of the plastic pieces snapping in.  we are still brainstorming other options.    We had a lot of trouble putting it togther.  the top is never going to come off, because the clip broke when I tried to latch it in, and with out the clip, it kept popping open, so we had to glue it.  We also had trouble attaching the tubes, but I just recommend checking and rechecking those before you put the animal in.  Also jumpers can almost pop the \\"petting area\\" out, so we just put a small book on top to weigh it down.    The water bottle is worthless, it drips constantly and gets watter all over the one shelf.  Luckily it is easy to slide a traditional bottle in between the bars, or give them a dish.  Or you can buy a replacement Deluxe bottle that has the traditional metal tube and ball-bearing.      On the plus side, they do seem to enjoy the trails.  we may have to try to find a way to incorporate them into the new habitat (I am going to end up building one, I think).    Over all, this might work for gerbils and hamsters, but is ill-equipped to handle mice, ad too small for rats.  Makes you wonder what the designers were thinking.

product_title: Wellness Core Grain Free Original Cat Food
review_headline: Best Dry Cat Food, Grain Free--Expensive But Worth It
review_body: My cats really love this food.  Both are indoor condo-dwellers.  The older cat (10 yrs) got really dehydrated on lower quality at foods w/meat or chicken \\"byproducts\\" and corn.  Wellness Core is expensive, but super-high quality.  No grain or byproducts.  I introduced it slowly, mixing it little @ a time w/cheap stuff. review_body: I'm a marathoner and have been using this leash for several years. Just bought another so I'll have a backup if the first one falls apart. product_title: Chuckit! The Whistler Balls
review_headline: They help my visiually impaired dog track the ball
review_body:
At first I was skeptical because my dogs are really obsessive about the orange chuckit balls and never thought we would find a better ball, but after using these balls I have to say I'm very pleased. One of our labs, Sheba, has suffered from seizures and has become partially blind. Sometimes it's difficult for her to find a ball when we throw it a long ways. (We have a fenced in acre which is essentially our dog park.) These balls really do help her to track it because they whistle when flying in the air. It's not very loud to me, but my dogs can defiantly follow the sound. These balls are harder and lighter than the orange balls and bounce better, too.

When throwing the orange balls, Sheba would bring back only about 50% of the time and our other lab would go find the ball for her and bring it back. But with these she brought the ball back 100% of the time!

So I have to give a big kudos to Chuckit for making ball time more fun for Sheba and thanks from our family!

product_title: Bags on Board Dog Waste Bag Bone Dispenser with 30 Refill Bags
review_body:
I ordered this right after we got our 4-month-old puppy. We live in Chicago and cleaning up after your dog is a must. My husband was skeptical at first (\\"why can't you just carry a bag in your pocket?\\"). But he's changed his mind. It's very handy to always have bags when we walk our dog. Whenever we go outside, we have the leash and thus we have the bags. With this product we even have bags during those early morning trips outside in our pajamas.

As for the design, it an attractive dispenser. People always ask us where we got it. The bags come out easily, but the roll doesn't unfurl willy-nilly. Yes, you will inadvertently drop the dispenser and it will get banged up a bit. (It is made of plastic after all.) But we haven't had problems with the cap popping off. The clip does seem somewhat flimsy. I imagine if it falls off, you could always replace it with a key ring and a carabiner clip.

The bags serve their purpose and don't leak. I find that they are a bit difficult to get open but my husband doesn't have a problem with it. The rolls are easy to replace, and if you didn't have the dispenser you could always stick a roll of bags in your pocket. I do wish that there were more than 15 bags per roll. We go through them fairly quickly. With that said, I recommend ordering a refill of the bags ([[ASIN:B000UCU53U Bags on Board Regular Bag Refill Pack, 120 Bags]]) along with the dispenser shown here.

product_title: Busy Bone Treats for Dogs
review_body: My mom bought these for her three dogs - a Lab puppy, an adult Catahoula, and an adult Shih Tzu.  The Shih Tzu did fine with half of the bone. As far as we know, nothing bad happened to him.  The Catahoula and Lab puppy (about 8 months old), however, both began vomiting that night.  The Catahoula got better, but the Lab puppy continued vomiting all that next day.  My mom took the puppy to her regular vet, they took x-rays and recommended she visit an emergency vet clinic because they thought there was an obstruction that needed to be cleared out.  The emergency vet clinic did surgery and found that her lymph nodes near her intestines were inflamed, which we figure thickened her intestine wall, making it difficult for food to move through.  Finally the Lab puppy is coming home today (she is doing well), but earlier my brother gave my adult Australian Shepherd a tiny (very tiny) piece of the granola bar (at that point we hadn't necessarily thought this was the cause of the vomiting and other problems) and she threw up about 4 hours later.  She has a weak stomach, so it isn't surprising that such a small amount might effect her.  However, what is shocking is that since so many dogs - do google search: \\"Purina busy bone recall\\" and it should be the first result - \\"Dog Food Review - Purina Busy Bone Dental Treat\\"; it is a hubpages website) to see more about this - have been sick from Purina busy bones that they do not recall them, change the recipe, or get rid of them all together!  (Owners have witnessed such side effects as: vomiting, diarrhea, and seizures!)    Please, please consider your dog(s) well-being before you buy this.  Even if your dog is one of the lucky ones that don't seem to be effected by this treat, who knows what undetected damage this does to your dog's health.  I also doubt anyone wants to be spending the thousands of dollars that the medical costs of this treat results in.

product_title: LitterMaid LME9000 Elite Mega Advanced Automatic Self-Cleaning Litter Box
review_body: ...I am *mostly* happy with the Littermaid Mega Elite. Over all it does what it is supposed to do, with some help from me. Much if not all of what you read in the reviews here (both positive and negative) is true. The machine is picky about how much litter is placed in it, as well as with the type of litter, which makes a huge difference. The motor does seem rather anemic at times, and it is loud--sounding as if someone is using a cordless drill--every time it runs through its cycle. And if there is too much litter in the rake's path, either coming or going, the machine will repeatedly go through its cycle trying to clear the obstacle until it gives up. You'll know this to be the case if the green power light is blinking. I do reuse the litter containers, but an inexpensive liner option for them would be nice. Because my older cat pees a lot, some of the clumps have a hard time getting under the trap door, and occasionally I'll peek into the bathroom to discover that that the trap door is not closed properly because one has gotten stuck. But that doesn't happen often. The unit is *big* and takes up quite a lot of space, but I really don't mind that; this is to be expected for a \\"Mega\\" model.    I'll reiterate two discoveries, which echo the thoughts of other reviewers as well as Littermaid's recommendations: the amount of litter and the type of litter are crucial. I switched to Arm & Hammer Super Scoop and noticed an immediate improvement over the other litter I was using. And for my machine anyway, it is much happier with the litter being nearer the lower line than the upper one, because the litter at the Full line seems to overwhelm it somewhat. (Others have said the opposite in their reviews, so your mileage may vary, as they say.)    If I could give Littermaid a wish list for the machine it would be the following: 1) a more powerful motor; 2) a \\"trap door\\" that opens wider (and perhaps a deeper receptacle?); 3) liners for the litter containers; 4) a more powerful \\"flick\\" when the rake pushes the waste into the container; 5) some sort of self-cleaning cycle for the rake; 6) an adjustable timer (perhaps being able to have the machine operate fifteen minutes after the cat uses the box, for better clumping; and 7) a clock that does not reset when the power is turned off... I do not use the sleep timer, so it's not a big deal, but why is the clock tied to the power switch?    So is the machine worth buying at all? Despite the hassles and my wish list, for now I say a qualified yes. If I could have chosen three and a half stars, I would have. The machine is not a panacea, and it is definitely not maintenance free. But the litter stays mostly very clean, cleaner than I could be able to keep it, especially being gone through the day. It is not a bad task to remove the litter receptacle and dump it, usually just once a day, into a bag for disposal. My cat adjusted to it with no drama or difficulty. It does a pretty good job of keeping the odor down. And while I do have to help it out occasionally, doing so is not bad. If you can get one for a good price, give it a try.

product_title: PetSafe Outdoor Ultrasonic Bark Deterrent
review_body: So, I have 2 older dogs that could care less, for the most part, about the world beyond their yard passing them by day to day. But then came along Molly the dauschund! I adopted Molly as a cute 6 week old pup, 9 months ago. Molly has taught me what naughty dogs are all about. She was very precious in the beginning, but then some neighbors recently moved in behind her yard that Molly never did particularly care for, and she became a compulsive barker. Even when I was out in the yard with her, she would bark at the neighbors and ignore my attempts to correct her. She just would not stop once she got wound up. Finally,  I started getting the notices on my door from animal control for Molly breaking city ordinances for disturbing the peace with her excessive barking while I was at work. I discussed options for controlling her excessive barking while I was away from home, with the animal control officers. Since Molly is under 8 pounds, a bark collar could not be used, as the collars are recommended for animals over 8 pounds only, and can atually cause injury to a smaller animal. The animal control officers told me about the Ultrasonic Birdhouse. I thought honestly, it was a waste of time and money, but there were very limited options with a small dog. So, I ordered the birdhouse through Amazon, who definately had the best deal on the web, and with free shipping! I have had the birdhouse for about 3 weeks now, and am very happy to report Molly has not gotten any more citations since the birdhouse was placed in her back yard. I can not believe this thing really worked! Now Molly goes outside and maybe gives it a test bark or 2 but she does not go ballistic anymore. I have read that the ultrasonic birdhouse works for some dogs and others, it does not phase them at all. Thank goodness it worked for Molly! If you have a \\"Molly\\", give the birdhouse an honest try, at least it is a good first step to address your dog's excessive barking, and it is non-evasive. Hey, if it workedfor Molly, this thing has potential for any dog!

product_title: Four Paws Keep Off 6oz Indoor and Outdoor Cat and Kitten Repellent
review_headline: So far---I'm planning on buying this item in BULK!
review_body: I am currently 'owned' by 9 cats and 3 dogs... I have tried MANY different products for MANY different obstacles over the years, and I have to say that I am BEYOND IMPRESSED with this product!!!    My current ongoing (10 year) battle has involved me fighting against the cats for the rights to the X-Mas tree. Last year was THE WORST--they tore off, chewed-up, and played soccer with the ornaments--and then bent and knocked down branches while attempting to 'nest' in the tree... I was officially dreading the holidays this year, and I was more than tempted to not even bother putting a tree up at all.     I finally decided (against my good judgment) to try yet again to enjoy the holiday festivities and traditions with a X-Mas tree.   I rigged it up 3-1/2ft off the ground, on a corner cabinet, and then wired it to the wall.   They got into it anyway.     I bought carpet runners, turned them over poke-side-up, and made a blockade around the tree and surrounding furniture.   They still got into it.     Finally--denying the cats my ultimate surrender--I decided to try a spray repellent (although I was leery to try it after reading quite a few negative reviews).. This was one of my last hopes..    I sprayed 'Keep Off' under, around, and behind the tree for the past two nights. It does have a weird/unpleasant odor, but the smell had disappeared by morning.      Apparently the odor is much more offensive to them than it is to me, because I am thrilled (and a little surprised) to say that it has been over 48hrs--and not ONE SINGLE ORNAMENT has been touched by the cats!!!   9 Cats .vs. 1 can of 'Keep Off' = I WIN!!!   This has never happened before!!!! My cats and I thank this incredible 'X-Mas saving spray' for giving our household a chance at a happy holiday!   I will be buying this product for the rest of their 9 lives. :)    Sincerely-  Jessica Rymarz and Our Crazy Cat House

product_title: Nylabone Dura Chew Bacon Flavored Double Action Bone Dog Chew Toy
review_body: I have a 3 year old Doberman who loves to chew.  Nylabone products are the only products he doesn't destroy.  He especially likes the double action dental ball cause it's a ball and a bone in one.  He carries it around with him where ever he goes!

product_title: Smokehouse 100% Natural Chicken Chips Dog Treats
review_body: We adopted a very large 1 year old that had little or no training.  These treats were the only way we were able to start getting her to pay attention and behave.  Without them, we would now have an untrained extremely large three year old.  We always carry some of them in our pocket and all the dogs in the neighborhood love them.

product_title: Paw Naturaw Organic Poultry Dinners for Cats and Dogs, nuggets, 32-Ounce Bags (Pack of 4)
review_body: Received quickly and very frozen.  My dog loves these and eats them frozen.  She has cancer and is 14 years old.  these and other natural foods have helped her be here this long!

product_title: Outward Hound Invincibles Plush Snake Stuffing-free Durable Dog Toy
review_body: It was definitely fun to watch my lab/shepherd mix shake this toy around and beat up on it, but it definitely isn't invincible (have yet to find an exciting dog toy that is) and one of the six squeakers was no longer functional after he had it for an hour or two.  That having been said, he's had a blast with it so far, and that's really what counts.

product_title: Drinkwell Original Pet Fountain
review_body: This product arrived quickly and it was just as described. My cat loves it and I am very pleased with it.  Great company to do business with. No problems. Definitely recommend to others!

product_title: Plato Pet Treats Organic Chicken
review_body: These are hopefully better treats than the ones with artificial color added.. The dogs all do great tricks to get them...:)) And made in the USA is a BIG plus for me...

product_title: FURminator Large Yellow deShedding Tool with 4-Inch Edge
review_body: This works great!  Much better of removing the inner coat of hair that regular brushes not seem to address as well.  I would, and have, recommended to a friend.

product_title: Explorer Double Fleece Reflective Dog Coat by Kakadu Pet
review_headline: Great winter coat, not to mention a great price!
review_body: My dog shivers in the cold weather. I saw this coat and decided for the price, it was worth a try. The coat fits true to the details on the Kakadu website (more details there than what is provided on Amazon), and the fleece is thick and warm for a dog coat. There are two velcro areas: one around the neck and a second wide one at the belly with multiple strips. They are strong fastening, despite my dog's efforts to rub or shake it off. For the price, I don't think it could be better. The color and style are true to the photo. The only negative is the lack of a slit in the coat to buckle the leash to a collar (I use a head harness, so this is not a big deal to me). I have yet to test the reflective properties.

product_title: Bergan Turbo Scratcher Cat Toy, Colors may vary
review_body:
Got a new kitten, went bonkers on buying toys. So far, this one is the biggest hit! Small kitten is crazy, and gets to go nuts chasing the ball around and around and around and around... She hasn't figured out about the scratching pad, but I'm sure she'll love that, too, when the time comes! Great purchase!!! The ball seems really sturdy/solidly made, and even my 2 year old wants to play with it!

Highly recommended!

product_title: 2 PACK Preventic Tick Collar 18" for Dogs up to 60 Lbs
review_body: Ever since I've used this collar on my dogs, ticks and fleas don't stick. Compared to name brands, you can't beat the price.

product_title: Mutt Mitt Dog Waste Pick Up Bag
review_body: This is a great product.  No muss no fuss.  You just pick it up, pull it over itself and you're done.

product_title: The Complete Scoop Free Automatic Litter Box Kit (Includes Hood & Extra Cartridge)
review_body: Purchased this, after much research, because we did not want to board our cat while we were on a week-long trip. It works exactly as advertised.    Our cat had no problem adjusting to this or back to his regular litter box (the Scoop Free is convenient but refills are too expensive to use on a regular basis). We left the cat for over a week and there were no signs of urine leakage, no odor, and the feces were thoroughly dessicated.

product_title: West Paw Design Zogoflex Dog Toy, Zisc, Colors Vary
review_headline: GREAT CHALLENGING WATER DISC FOR RETRIEVER
review_body: [[VIDEOID:mo4SZRZN362NJ4]]If you have a dog who is OK putting their head underwater, GET THIS DISC ...or get a couple. We have a 3 year old golden retriever and have tried every disc out there, and this is HANDS DOWN his favorite toy. He will leave 6 other discs sitting in the pool, but will always clear out the Zogoflex discs. The key thing is the disc's ability to  \\"SORT-OF\\" float. It floats but isn't overly buoyant, so the dog will often need to \\"bob\\" for the disc or circle til it resurfaces. It's a little more of a challenge and one my dog seems to thrive on.  It also appears to stand up well to the elements and moderate chewing - - no cracks or tears in over a year of use so far.

product_title: Best Pet Black 55" Triple-door Suitcase Style Folding Metal Dog Crate with Metal Pan - 55"(l) X 37"(w) X 45"(h)
review_headline: Big enough for an Irish Wolfhound
review_body: We were looking for something for our (almost 1 yr old) Irish Wolfhound. The size on this one is excellent. He has room to stretch out, and we think this should work for the long term. Some parts were a little bent during shipment, but nothing that wasn't fixable by hand and/or you wouldn't get after a few weeks wear and tear. Very happy with it.

product_title: Planet Dog Cozy Hemp Adjustable Collar
review_body: Bought this for my new puppy. I love the hemp leash especially - very soft on the hands. The collar is cute, quite thick though, my daughter thought it should be a winter-only collar. But it's holding up well and I like the look. We go to the beach a lot and it does hold water and sand more than a webbing-type collar. But otherwise I'm pleased.

product_title: Beefeaters Freeze Dried Chicken Liver, 21oz Tub
review_body: My pugs are picky eaters and only like the chicken liver which is hard to find.  This is a great deal.

product_title: Four Paws Cologne
review_body: this product shows 5 cans of spray, however you only get one, I would not have ordered this product if I had known this.

product_title: 2 Pack Furminator deshedding Tool for Cats (1.75" edge)
review_body: Great product at a fraction of the cost from the vet's office. We use it on the dogs and cats. Works like a miracle and reduces the cat yack tremendously. Cheap enough through Amazon to buy them and give them out as presents. See it in action at the vet's office but buy it on line. Fast ship. Great product. Thanks.

product_title: EQyss Survivor Detangler 8 oz
review_headline: Smells great, leaves hair feeling silky.
review_body: Okay, so it's really for a horse, but I have thick curly hair and it does wonders...even smells great too.  Love the Eqyuss line for me.

product_title: Kaytee Chinchilla Dust, 2.5 Lbs
review_body: I got a container of vanilla fragrant dust and he HATED it! Thia ia rgw only brand of dust bath dust he'll use!

product_title: KollerCraft TOM Mr. Cleaner Battery Operated Gravel Siphon
review_headline: Works but makes a big mess of your fish tank!
review_body: This device actually has decent suction. It had no problem picking up all the debris off the bottom of my fish tank and depositing them in to the 'sock'.  But unfortunately the fine particles of debris blew right through the cloth sock and back into the water.  After a minute of vacuuming, my whole fish tank was clouded.  The debris in my tank consisted of mostly goldfish poo, which tends to break apart easily.  If you are picking up courser debris, it might work better, but I feel that the 'sock' filter bag really does not provide adequate filtration.  Not recommended.

product_title: Outward Hound Kyjen  PP01128 Hedgehog Girl Plush Dog Toys Squeak Toy, Small, Brown
review_headline: so cute and extremely durable!!! LOVE IT !
review_body: After loving \\"Hide a squirrel\\" from Kyjen, I bought the Junior Girl Hedgehog for my boxer puppy when he was 8 weeks old. He loved it from beginning on and he still plays with it. It is made very durable.    He can squeak the hedgehog the whole day!   The face of the girl hedgehog looks so cute and is adorable. To me it is the cutest hedgehog toy I have seen so far.    I can recommend this toy to anybody!

product_title: Nekton Labs BNK207035 Bio Feather Grow For Birds 1.23 oz
review_body: Nekton is a great product! I have tried other types of bird vitamins, liquid which is added to the water, when my pet store stopped carrying Nekton, but they all spoiled way too fast and destroyed the birds drinking water. I mix Nekton fresh daily, the birds love it. Be careful not to allow any moisture into the jar or it will ruin the vitamins.

product_title: Custom Engraved Stainless Steel with Enamel Pet ID Tag - Small Dog
review_body: This dog tag is adorable! I got the PINK BUTTERFLY for my little Miniature Dachshund, Layla. The enamel is bright and pretty and the engraving is clear/defined. I ordered the SMALL (perfect size for our little 8lb dog) and only put her name and our phone #, but there is room for another line as the seller indicated in the description. BUT, I think that depends on the length of the dogs name- as the longer the name then the seller will have to drop lower on the tag to allow for more spaces. Or engrave in a smaller text. Our Layla's name fit perfectly to allow plenty of room for the phone # and probably a second #. I will be ordering other tags now that I've seen the QUALITY of these tags!!

product_title: Oscar The Octopus Dog Toy - 00785 - Bci
review_body: This is a really fun dog toy!  With all the legs, the dogs can all play with it at once.  They love this toy!

product_title: Contech StayAway Motion-Activated Pet Deterrent
review_headline: Yes it's expensive, but this works the best for keeping cats off furniture
review_body:
Yes - this is expensive, but it works. I bought this at the time along with another product that has a motion detector high pitched sound. This is clearly the superior product. I ended up keeping both (and would re-purchase both again). This one works by movement detection, the other by vibration. Initially, I set this to send a warning beep and then the puff of air (sounds like a hiss). Now I generally keep it on the warning beep only, though if the cats are getting gutsy, I turn the air puff back on for a few days and they start avoiding it again.

We already had a scat mat - which works great for the area it covers. We use it for the top of the stairs. That won't work on a large piece of furniture, because the cats learn to avoid it or walk around it. I mentioned above that I also have a vibration sensitive detector, and I use that too, but the puff of air from this is what really scares them. I rotate it on different pieces of furniture every so often with the other and they now avoid both pieces. You have to be careful how you set it, because it won't work if it falls over, and it will set off if someone walks by (but not if the UPS truck pulls up).

The refills are expensive, but I've had this for 8 or 10 months now, and I'm still on the first can. I will buy the refill when this one runs out. It's worth it.

product_title: Designer Pet Bowl Hearts & Swirls Design, Small White
review_body: This bowl has lasted me along time. I have used it outside and inside.  Sometimes it gets left out for several days.  It looks as good as the day I brought it. (must be well over a year).  The size is for one kitty. The design is so cute, nice to have it inside and outside of the bowl.  It has a handy area to help pick up the bowl.

product_title: PetSafe Outdoor Ultrasonic Bark Deterrent
review_body: Did not work with our dogs, two small Shih Tzu. I tried multiple settings and locations and nothing made any difference. The dogs still barked. Sent it back for a refund. Bought the Spray Sense Collar which works great.

product_title: PaPurr Scoopable Cat Litter 00204-18B, 18-pound bag
review_body: This litter is the best! We tried this litter while our previous cat was sick and started trying to eat the clay litter. It worked like a charm. It didn't have all the negatives of clay litters. It has the texture of regular litter, not a pellet like other environmental litters. Unlike another type we tried it did not ferment and stink. We really like that it is recycled paper and helps the environment. Thank you, Amazon for starting to carry this just in time for us getting new kitties.

product_title: Scotch-Brite FurFighter Hair Remover Kit 849SK
review_body: this does NOT work on silk/polyester blends. Be careful because it can cause smooth silky fabrics to rough up and pill. Worked ok on the couch which is just cotton, but didn't get embedded hairs and caused some hairs to become embedded. Will not buy refills and will try the pledge one next time even though that is also not reusable.

product_title: Aqua Medic AB11211 Fish Trap
review_body: This trap was used in my 55 gallon tank to catch a six-lined wrasse.  You do have to manually trip the trap, but I was able to catch the wrasse on the first attempt after 3 days.  My fish wouldnt go near it for 2 1/2 days.  This may take a while. There is a nice feeding tube you can put the food into.  Worth the buy if you need to get a fish out of your tank without clearing out all of the live rock.

product_title: Smokehouse 100-Percent Natural Meaty Porky Bone Dog Treats, 5-Pack
review_body: After about 5 minutes, my dog had one of these in 50 pieces, many of which were extremely long and sharp. It made a huge mess of greasy, burnt grissle pieces all over the floor, and I had to take it all away from him. I tried again with a second bone a few days later and had the same result. Threw the rest of the bones away...

product_title: Roll n Clean Self Cleaning Litter Box
review_body: I love this litter box. I wanted something that was easy to clean. I looked into the automatic electric ones but I didn't want my cat playing around with it and it making a bunch of noise throughout the night. I also wanted a dome so that she wouldn't flick cat litter all over the place. This is so easy to clean it amazes me. I was worried about how heavy it may be to roll over but it's no trouble at all. It uses very little litter. It's easy to remove the tray and flush right down the toilet. I have the litter box in my bathroom and find it doesn't take up too much room. I would definitely recommend this litter box. It really does make life simple.

product_title: Pet Supply Imports Anti-Spill Waterhole Small Animal Dog Dishes and Bowl
review_body: I was pleased to find this on your site. No one has them locally, It is a valuable product for us .

product_title: Advantage Once-A-Month Topical Flea Treatment for Cats
review_body: This brand seems to work the best on my two cats. They stay happy and healthy through the warmer flea season, and so do I!

product_title: Zymox Otic Pet Ear Treatment with Hydrocortisone
review_headline: LAB OWNERS, IT REALLY DOES WORK!
review_body: Forget expensive RXs and multiple trips to the vet throughout the year. If there is not a full blown infection going on (which, may require initial week of antibiotics/ear flushing before continuing on with the Zymox), once a day for a week course during bad, black build up w/foul smell (yeast) bouts, followed by a once a week thereafter for a month, and now twice monthly has yielded gunk free, skunk free ears that are white and clear of any inflammation or itching. Of course, this may need be adjusted for the dog and the amount of water exposure your pet gets (our lab does not spend much time in the water...only because there is no water around us). That said, this is an AMAZING product.  YES doggie did moan in relief the ONE TIME his ears built up (yes, you read me right, English lab who only ONCE had this ailment, thus we have been able to successfully defend against it with reqular Zymox maintenance of twice a month.  HIGHLY recommend this stuff.

product_title: Newman's Own Organics Advanced Cat Dry Formula
review_headline: No more tummy troubles for my kitty
review_body: I had a cat with irritable tummy/bowel . Not any more! Only took a week and he is all better. Yes, its expensive, but think of it this way: It saves on vet bills!

product_title: Eukanuba Adult Cuts Dinner with Chicken in Gravy Canned Dog Food
review_headline: My dachshund didn't like it for some reason
review_body: It looks and smells good for me...but not for my picky dachshund, I don't know why.

product_title: PetSafe Outdoor Ultrasonic Bark Deterrent
review_body: This product worked well the first day, but hasn't made any difference what so ever the rest of the time. My dogs still bark at the people walking by or the dog next door like it's not even making a sound. The batteries are fresh as well as I see the light lighting up \\"showing\\" that it's working. I figured that I'd give the product a week or two for the condition factor, but nothing. I was excited about this product at first, but now pretty disappointed. I am back to standing outside with my dogs monitoring them to make sure they don't annoyingly bark at anything that walks by.

product_title: Solvit Products 62283 Deluxe Bench Seat Cover Natural, Large
review_body: I've received many items thru Amazon and this is the first product that I felt compelled to review.  We (me and my golden retriever) just got back from from our daily walk in the park. It's raining today and I would rather have stayed home, but he insists, so off we go.  We drive to the park and walk around the lake and he inevitably finds some goose droppings that he just has to roll around in( Why can't those honkers stay in Canada anyway, I think we're patrolling the wrong border).  So many times he ends up wet, dirty and smells a bit. We own a '06 chevy crew cab p.u. w/leather and into the back seat he goes. This seat cover works great.  I've had it about 6 months and washed it 3 times and it's held up.  I noticed that a previous reviewer mentioned that it slid or wouldn't stay in place over leather. We have not had that problem. Our 1st seat cover was a flimsy nylon-type material which did not last long. This product easily gets 5 stars from us.                                               Michael T. and Sangio

product_title: Grriggles 7-Inch Cotton Camo Rope Knot Dog Toy, Large
review_body:
When the Grriggles Camo Rope knot arrived it didn't seem as tight as I was hoping.
With in 10 minutes my boxer - pitbull had part of it unraveled; however he had it over another month before he had it taken apart completely. I feel it was worth the money. Good quality Ropes with knots last about 2 to 3 weeks, with that said this rope knot held up very well.

product_title: Kitty City Hideaway by Sportpet
review_body: Got this for my cat just for the scratching post to keep her off the lamps and our legs!  It's helped, but as previously mentioned this one alone she pulls over a lot when climbing the post.  Still love it though, because even on its side she would go to it.  She even learned it was hers and will now run to it when she's in trouble! Definately worth getting and building off of (I'm on my way to review the Sleepy Corner next.)

product_title: KONG Extreme Dog Toy, Black
review_body: We bought the large Kong Extreme for our 9 month lab who is a chewer.  We have to take the regular Kong away from him after the treat is gone from it or he will destroy it.  I gave this one to him with no treat in it at all to test its strength and it didn't last 20 minutes.  He had the end chewed off and it was thrown away.  He only weighs 49 pounds but we might have to buy the largest size and see it that lasts longer. Otherwise it is a good product if you don't have a chew monster.

product_title: Pet Head, Poof! Magical Deodorizing Spray 15.2 oz.
review_body: I bought this for our stinky beagle and we love it.  It is not super strong smelling just very pleasant.  It really works I can't believe it.  It does contain some baking soda so I am sure this helps in absorbing and neutralizing odors.  I would highly recommend it.  It is so nice to be able to cuddle with my buddy again!

product_title: Wellness Complete Health Natural Dry Dog Food
review_body: I have a mini schnauzer and I have been feeding her puppy wellness until she was one which is when i got her this one. She likes it a lot and i think she is happy and healthy!

product_title: Car Rear Full Seat Hammock Cover 63"L x 57"W Black Custom slits for seat belt
review_body:
This works great in my Subaru Outback. I use it whether my rear seats or down or not and it fits very well. I use it while I am hauling random items (Wood, Snowboard, ski's, Snowshoe's, computer equipment, etc.) and it does a great job. Very durable and several places to put bungee cords. The headrest pieces really make this a fantastic product as they fit perfect on my car perfectly.

Cons:

The Black Lab (Koa) slides around a bit due to the slippery surface but it really protects my interior from the times he has been out playing in the mud, salt water, or even rolling in seaweed :)

Not waterproof. I knew this from the beginning but my issue is snowmelt. If snow melts off my snowboard it penetrates right through. I found out the hard way when I pulled off the cover to clean it and discovered some mold growing underneath it.

product_title: sWheat Scoop Multi-Cat All-Natural Clumping Cat Litter
review_body: Low on dust, clumps well, and flushable.  I have two cats that share a box and this litter keeps the odors almost unnoticeable without the use of nasty perfumes and chemicals - which means safe for the septic and it can be composted for use in non-edible gardens!  Good for the environment in your house and outside.  My new favorite litter, and more importantly, the cats seem to appreciate it too.

product_title: OUT! Diaper Garments
review_body: Maggie will be 15 years old in June, and had taken to peeing on the carpet during the night at least once a week.  I got really tired of carpet-cleaning, and one night she slept right next to our bed - when she got up, the wet spot was spread out, so I thought she had leaked without even getting up.  We tried different things that worked for awhile, like pulling her water before 7 pm and encouraging her to wake me up to go outside - but the latter was too much torture for me.  So I ordered these pants, and took the advice about using Poise pads for humans in them.  I went to Rite-Aid, where I never shop, lest someone think the pads were for me.  LOL.  Anyway, they had both Poise pads and their own cheaper brand version of them.  I asked myself if Maggie would care if I didn't get the brand name, and decided she wouldn't.  They fit perfectly in the garment, and the pants fit the dog perfectly.  She weighs around 35 pounds and there was only one size to choose from, Medium.  We thought she might chew the pants off or be uncomfortable, but she just walked funny for about 3 minutes and then was perfectly happy.  She gnaws on her leg or toenails, but leaves the pants alone.  She has no problem moving or curling up in her bed.  The pants are easy to get on by putting the tail in the hole first.  The straps come up in front of the back legs on the belly, and they velcro on to the top on her back end.  She has not peed in the pants, so I can't say how that would be, but I am thrilled that I don't have to clean the carpet.  She's been wearing them every night for a couple of weeks.  We still pull the water by 7:30 pm, but if we should forget, we are safe.  I intend to order another pair when they are back in stock.  They are a genius invention and also look pretty cool.  :)

product_title: Vetoquinol Epakitin Pet Antioxidant Nutritional Supplements, 300gm
review_headline: Product Labeled for Use Under Veterinary Guidance Only
review_body: This is a wonderful product in cases of renal disease. However, it is expressly labeled \\"For Use by or on the Order of a Licensed Veterinarian\\", which implies that use without such guidance, as Amazon is encouraging and/or allowing by permitting its sale on line to any person desiring it, can result in negative side effects.  I am dismayed, as a practicing veterinarian and longtime supporter of Amazon, that such business is permitted by this great company.

product_title: Frontline Plus Flea and Tick protection for Cats - 6 Pack
review_body: I wasted my money.  I've used Frontline in the past and it has worked fine.  This time the fleas thought it was dinner.  They just multiplied.  My poor cats were miserable.  Had to wait 30 more days and spend another $70.00 on Advantage which is working much better.

product_title: FURminator Large Yellow deShedding Tool with 4-Inch Edge
review_body: I wish I found this product earlier! My dog is a lab mix, with very fine straight hair. She has terrible shedding problems when she is patted or if she is inquisitive about something. I never thought a brush would work since her hair is fairly straight and fine. I WAS WRONG! This FURMINATOR never stops finding hair to brush. On Lucy, most of her loose hair is towards her rear, I'm not sure why. So that's where I brush her the most. When you see a big glob of hair you know its working.    The only improvement I can attest to, is if they added some sort of hair collector, so I wouldn't have to pull the hair off the brush after every swipe. After I pull the hair and let it go into the wind, my dog tries to catch it. It's cute but annoying. Other than that its a fantastic product.     Don't think twice, it will catch all kinds of hair!

product_title: ARIO 2 COLOR Aquarium Aerator
review_headline: Nice aerator creates nice atmosphere, clogs up easily
review_body: This aerator is lovely, the blue light creates a cool atmosphere during the night and it does not seem to bother the fish. If you have a big aquarium and your fish enjoy currents you need something else as well or another aerator. Try placing it facing diagonally not just face up, that helps in avoiding clogging up so fast.

product_title: Litter Robot LRII Automatic Self-Cleaning Litter Box
review_body: great product.  Cats love it.  easy to assemble and clean.  would highly recommend.

product_title: Purina Beneful Prepared Meals Wet Dog Food - 10oz. Tub, Pack of 8
review_body: Despite the appearance of the food being almost good enough for a person to eat, this is NOT a quality dog food. The ingredient list tells all.  Wheat, corn, and soy are among the most difficult ingredients for dogs to digest and lead to allergies that will lead to more frequent vet visits. Meat By-products are about as low quality a meat ingredient you can get. The quality is inconsistent between batches. What does the manufacturer have to hide when they aren't confident enough to list the specific sources of this \\"meat\\"? Please do your dog a favor and look at more nutritional and healthy foods on the market. Your dog's health and well being is on the line when you feed them a terrible diet.

product_title: LitterMaid LM500 Automated Litter Box
review_body: After going through two of these in 4 years, I can honestly say I regret buying them.  I have now decided to purchase the Litter Robot, and I am confident that it will impress me.    The Littermaid has a fine line of what is too much litter and what is not enough.  If you fill it slightly above  the red line that says \\"add litter\\", the rake will not go all the way through its cycle.  If you have even slightly less than the line, the urine clumps in a shallow pool to the bottom of the box, which cause a line of clumped gunky litter that the rake cannot get through.  Not to mention having to touch the dirty waste receptacle to empty it.  It is also very difficult to clean.     I cannot wait for my Litter Robot to arrive next week...will be manually scooping from the broken Littermaid until then.

product_title: Vita-Gravy Salmon Cat, 8 oz.
review_body: I have four cats and have been using this product for years.  It seems to work for them.

product_title: Plastic Foldable Pet Dog Cat Travel Water Drinking Feeder Bottle Bowl
review_body: When I ordered the Handi Drink, I had recently purchased a Gulpy from a local store as a gift.  It was a great success, and Sam, the recipient, loves it.  When I decided to buy a Gulpy for my dog, the only one available on Amazon was $24 (it is now priced much, much lower) so I ordered the Handi Drink.  It is not nearly as easy to use as the Gulpy.  The Gulpy water bottle swings up and you squeeze the bottle to squirt the water into the water tray.  The Handi Drink bottle is separate and must be removed from the water tray and then be placed into a notch in the water tray.  Also, it is difficult to get the water out of the Handi Drink...I never did make it work well.  I tossed the Handi Drink and went back to the store and bought a Gulpy!

product_title: Solid Gold S.E.P. (Stop Eating Poop) 3.5oz
review_body: We used it for one week and the problem has stopped.  It has been two weeks off and we are still okay.

product_title: Pill Pockets for Cats Salmon 45ct
review_headline: My cat won't eat them anymore
review_body: These used to be amazing, but they changed for the formula a while back and now my cat won't eat either flavor. Very disappointed.

product_title: DRINKWELL Platinum Premium Filters 12 Pack
review_body: Bought the fountain? Go the extra mile to be sure the water stays fresh smelling & clean!

product_title: Dechra Dentee Stars and Chews Dent Acetic Pet Treats for Large Dogs, 12-Ounce
review_headline: She waits for one of these everyday
review_body: My puppy, now 6 months old, has been receiving one of these everyday since she was 4 months old. She loves these things and I am not sure why.  She will toss it in the air for 3-5 minutes and stalk it like it was catnip.  It is the highlight of her day.  When she was 4 months old, it took 10 minutes to finish, now it takes about 2.  Still, to find a treat that makes a dog happy, really happy, is rare. Also her breath is neutral and her teeth are clean after eating these so I guess they work?      I bought 10 bags last round for 120 treats.  I will do it again but I'll wait for them to be in the >$6 per bag range first.

product_title: Bergan Turbo Scratcher Cat Toy, Colors may vary
review_headline: Why does the ball come out so easily?
review_body: I would give this 4 or five stars if the ball wasn't so easily removed from the track by my cat. The first time I just popped it back in. The second time, he rolled it away somewhere. We haven't found it yet, so, two days after purchasing, the item has lost half its functionality. I'm sure we will find it but really-- why make the ball so easy to pull out of the track?

product_title: Nina Ottosson's Interactive Dog Toy
review_body: Very nice interactive puzzle. Even though my German Shepherd figured it out within seconds she still enjoying looking for the treats.

product_title: Glitzy Sheen Double-row Embellished Rhinestone Dog Collar - Large (14"-18"), Scarlet Red
review_body: It's a beautiful little collar. I only have a small complaint, a couple of the little rhinestones are not sparkly, they're just black.  But, there are so many rhinestones that you really don't notice it.

product_title: Petstages Comfort Cat Water Dish
review_body:
I have probably tried 5 or 6 different kinds of cat food dishes and my cats seem to leave a lot of food in the bottom of all of them, or refuse to eat the food altogether, yet if I serve the food on a plate, they eat every bit but make a big mess off the edge of the plate. Then I saw this uniquely designed dish. I bought both the water and food bowl like this to use as food dishes for my cats. According to the label, the premise behind these bowls is that they are designed to be shallow for wet food, the food doesn't get stuck in the corners at the bottom, and the low profile doesn't disturb the cat's sensitive whiskers as they eat (the vet told me that many cats will refuse food in deeper bowls because it brushes their whiskers and the owner assumes they don't like the food, when the bowl is really the problem.)

Wow! The cats eat every drop of food from these dishes with no mess. My husband laughed and said the dishes were so clean after they ate that we didn't even need to wash them. He suggested we donate the dozens of other cat dishes we've tried to a shelter and buy more of these. I bought a dozen from a few different stores. They are very hard to find, and one store called the manufacturer who told us thet they just can't make enough to keep up with the demand! The price reflected here ($8+) is a LOT more than I found in the pet stores, but that may be due to the supply/demand issue. I bought mine for $3 to $4 each, so shop around for a good price. If you're like me and you use a water fountain, you can still buy the water dish for food if it's all you can find in stock, as they are almost exactly the same except the water bowl is slightly deeper.

Pros: sturdy, well-made, heavy-duty rubbery plastic doesn't scratch or ding from metal utensils; non-skid base; VERY easy to clean and dishwasher safe; stackable and require minimal storage space due to the low profile; cats love them.

Cons: price based on low availability (?); colors are not very attractive, no color selection available; they are not listed as microwave safe (and I have not tried it, so do so at your own risk).

Bottom line: These will last for a long time. I would highly recommend them.ve, no color selection available; they are not listed as microwave safe (and I have not tried it, so do so at your own risk). Bottom line: These will last for a long time. I would highly recommend them.
