review_body: The cats All really enjoy this cat tree ....... BUT the hanging toys are junk and have been torn off by them in a matter of two days. I also was not satisfied with the instructions was not specific and in centimeters. I also was giving the wrong connection pieces but thankfully i was able to secure it myself. Would i recommend it to others .... No!! Dont by it off the internet just because its cheaper!

product_title: PetSafe Simply Clean Self-Cleaning Cat Litter Box, Automatic, Works with Clumping Cat Litter
review_headline: not as good as I thought but works okay
review_body: It still leaves some small poopies behind,can get those with scooper I guess, but you don't have to change the litter as often. The smell is a lot better because of the clumping litter takes most of the waste and puts it in the trash can which is covered in the back. The motor is very quiet and cannot hear it running like other self cleaning cat machines. Cat took to it right away with no problem, but pan isn't deep enough and kicks alot of it out when digging. Maybe putting a rubbermain container over it would be good idea.  Update, I just checked on the litter box because it is making loud motor noise and machine is not working. The motor is very hot also which worries me if i wasn't home and that happened.

product_title: Petco Pyramid Cat Bed in Black & Brown
review_body: I purchased this cat bed for my dog since she's a tiny little Mini Pinscher. She loves to get inside of things and sleep in them, so I hoped this would work. Well, she loves it more than I had hoped for. Now she won't even sleep in her other beds. When it's warm outside, she jumps on top of it to flatten it into a bed and when it's cold, she gets inside for shelter and warmth. Who would have thought SHE would have known to use its durability like that... AMAZING! I simply love this and would definitely purchase this as a gift for someone who has a small little dog. Thanks seller!!!

product_title: Whisker Lickins Tender Moments Crab Flavor Cat Treats, 5.7-Ounce Canisters (Pack of 10)
review_body: I have 2 active cats who just love this treat. As a matter of fact they love all of the Whisker Lickins' product.

product_title: Tuffy Ocean Creature Crab
review_body: I bought this lobster 30 minutes ago from Wag n' Wash. The ladies there all recommended it as the toughest plush toy. One said that her three dogs have had an octopus for three years! I was so excited to bring home to our Black Lab. Unfortunately, thirty minutes later, it's gone. no face, no stuffing. product_title: Tidy Cats Litter
review_body: I have two male cats (9 and 10 yrs old).  I only use Tidy Cats because it is the best deodorizer for their litter boxes (3).

product_title: Guardian Gear Beach Cabana Blue
review_body: This item is as described and came quickly.  Set up was easy...folding it back up took a bit of time.  But my real complaint is that it ripped almost immediately where the poles go in.  So, poles sticking out where they should be in = a bunch of garbage, which is where it is at.

product_title: Armarkat Cat tree Furniture Condo, Height -50-Inch to 60-Inch
review_body:
I got this for my cat Pavel for his 2nd birthday. He definitely likes it and is enjoying a nap on it right now.

It's solid/stable and easy to put together. The covering is soft and not just generic carpeting which you get on a lot of cat trees. The posts are all covered in sisal which is great.

product_title: Cosequin Bonelets, Hip Joint Support Plus Supplement, Dogs 90 ea
review_headline: My 9 year old dog has the flexibility and energy of a puppy!
review_body: Cosequin Plus is the best option I have found to relieve the pain of arthritis in my Golden Retriever. Almost three years ago Digger could barely get up from laying down. I can't remember how long it took for me to notice his improvement, however, it wasn't long and it was unbelievable! He gets Cosequin Plus every day and is now as flexible and playful as a puppy. Now that he can move freely without pain, he has more energy, is happier and now has overall good health (better movement allowed him to also shed some unwanted weight).

product_title: Hunter Baltimore Ravens Adjustable Pet Collar, X-Small
review_body: The description of this product is inadequate.  I made sure I didn't order a product that said \\"x-small\\" in the description and I ended up receiving an extra small collar anyway.  There is no description of size for this product.

product_title: Chicken Soup for the Dog Lover's Soul Dry Dog Food for Adult Dog, Large Breed Chicken Flavor, 35 Pound Bag
review_body: After years of watching my older miniature schnauzer, Cosmo, suffer very bad itching, especially along the back, and starting to see the younger one get it too, it was truly a blessing to find this product which pretty much brought an end to their itching.    I've almost forgotten the sound of the chair hitting the table as Cosmo steps back and forth with his back under the chair's lower horizontal wood planks -scratching all of his hair off, and eventually his skin, but I still have pictures of the bloody red patches.  Thank you, Chicken Soup, for making a healthy natural product that doesn't give my dogs terrible skin reactions.

product_title: Lean Treats for Dogs (4oz) 10 Pack
review_body: We have a new puppy, and our Vet was using these treats as she was examining her, I noticed how attentive she was and obsessed she was with them. I purchased a package from her before leaving, and it has been the best purchase I ever made, in one week, our puppy learned to \\"sit\\" on command, and she will do whatever to get her treat. It is comforting I am giving her something that is not only enjoyable for her, but healthy.. she goes crazy when I get the package and can't get enough of them.. I will never be without them.

product_title: Angels' Eyes Tear-Stain Eliminator for Dogs and Cats, Beef Flavor, 120 Grams Bottle
review_body: I haven't tried it yet since our Vet said to wait until adult teeth come in, but so far, all of the Vets we have talked with and all of the pet stores (even the ones who don't carry Angel Eyes) say it is the best for removing tear stains.  We haven't found any topical treatment that works but really want to avoid trimming our Coton's face to get rid of the stains.  I would say by reputation that Angel Eyes is the only thing to try for tear stains.

product_title: Purina ONE Sensitive Systems Dry Cat Food
review_headline: Purina One Sensitive - great for a cat with digestion trouble
review_body: We recently took in a cat that could not keep any food down.  She would throw up multiple times a day, usually within an hour or so of eating.  We thought she may be overeating, so we limited how much food we gave her, we tried to spread out the food to force her to breath and chew between pieces.  We tried many different foods, including multiple foods recommended by the vet.  After a lot of money spent on vet visits and tests, with the vet finding nothing wrong with her, I saw this food and figured trying a food for sensitive systems couldn't hurt.      We'd already tried other Purina One formulas without success, so we weren't particularly optimistic, but hopeful.  Our cat has been eating this for about two or three weeks now and she has not thrown up at all.  I love this food, it was hard to watch her throw up so much, and, frankly, it wasn't pleasant cleaning it up so frequently.  I'm glad I found this and fully recommend it to anyone with a cat with similar problems keeping food down.

product_title: Kurgo Wander Dog Backpack
review_body: This backpack is made very well and is very sturdy. It can pretty much fit an average sized water bottle, poopy bags, and a cell phone on each side...so not too much, but enough to weigh the dog down a little so she'll work a bit on walks. When ever I used go for walks with my Dalmatian, she would pull me like crazy! But whenever I put this on her with a water bottle on each side, keys on one side and my cell phone on the other she doesn't pull half as much! It's great. One thing, and I knew this before purchasing this backpack, is that if you don't have weight evenly distributed on both side of the dog, one side will sag a little lower than the other and make the dog a little off balance. It's important to keep it even or it will seriously bug you to death to have to keep straightening the thing. Instead of water bottles, I sometimes use a new parmesean bottle on each side just to keep the weight even. That is the one and only complaint I have about this backpack, but if you read this review then you can be aware of this issue before you buy it and just plan to distribute the weight evenly. Overall, this is an awesome buy! I love it, my dog loves it..it's just a nice and well made doggy backpack :)

product_title: FURminator Large Yellow deShedding Tool with 4-Inch Edge
review_body: The Furminator was recommended by friends that have shepherds like we do and know the shedding that goes with them.  Our dog LOVES to be brushed by the Furminator and it is the most productive tool we have purchased.  We have a short haired mix dog also and it works just as well on her as it does on our shepherd.  Amazing.  The company that I purchased it from got it to me so fast that a co-worker asked me to order one for him and I had it back to him in less than 5 days!  Would not hesitate to purchase from this seller again.  Thank you!  PS the price was less than half of what it would be in our local pet store or even the big box stores!

product_title: PetSafe Drinkwell Platinum Pet Fountain
review_body: My cat loves this fountain.  I saw the video of cats drinking from the water stream and wasn't sure if my cat would do this.  It took her a while to get used to it, but she drinks more water than she used to and she does drink straight from the stream.  My cat was always fascinated with running water and she is fascinated with the drinkwell.  Setup was very easy and the fountain is quality made. It works perfectly. product_title: B6203 Ivory Pet Furniture Tower cat tree condo 6 level
review_body: This is my first tree house.  The whole thing was so easy to put together.  They label all pieces and diagram how to put it together.  (it's not complicated like some of the Ikea ones)  I would not use the toy at all because it tears apart easily and could become hazardous to your cat.  My cat loves this tree house.  She is drawn to it to do her scratching and she loves to lay up on the top perches.  It doesn't wobble even close to what I thought it would, especially since she is a rather large cat, not really heavy just tall and long.  In some of the pet stores I have been in, the trees tend to shake really easy, not this one.  She doesn't even notice the wobble.  I put a different hanging toy in the spot and she loves to jump up and play with it.  She can jump from the floor to the top in one swoop which is cool when I spot her doing it.  I would buy from this company again.  Glad I took action and made my not so little kitty purr!

product_title: Cat Zoom Groom

review_body: This stuff does work.It almost has too when it contains that much mineral oil.But my cat hates it.I tried diff flavors and he hated all of them.I did force some on the cat for 3 days.It was not easy to do.But I got results.

product_title: Phycox Canine Joint Support Soft Chews
review_body: My 9 year old Labrador developed hip problems and no longer ran, jumped, etc.  My vet recommended Phycox.  She LOVES the Phycox soft chews and looks forward to getting them each day. She's now back to her old self, climbing on furniture, running around, doing stairs with no problem.  I'm not sure what in Phycox is so effective but I'm definitely a believer.

product_title: Roll n Clean Self Cleaning Litter Box

Also, worth mentioning, the option to roll this large contraption is fine if you have the room for it, but if space is tight, rolling this big boy around may be more trouble than the alternative.  I gave it a shot for a few months and then gave it to the Salvation Army.

review_body:
I second every single word Elyse wrote in her review except that my dog is a she not a he. It's uncanny how similar our experience with the product is, our dogs must be kindred spirits! :)

This is excellent stuff, gets my veryyy difficult dog eating. Highly recommended.

product_title: Bergan Comfort Carrier Soft-Sided Pet Carrier
review_body: I did lots of research online and in person before buying this carrier for my 8-lb. cat. I'd purchased another one because it was cheap ($15 or so), and learned the hard way that a flimsy, too-big carrier is actually worse than none at all. Advantages of this product: you can soothe the animal with a gentle hand via a zip-open access, the carrier has a soft, relatively stiff base that keeps your pet stable when carried, there's lots of ventilation, the carrier opens at both ends, and the product is well-constructed and sturdy. Small size is perfect for airline carry-on. (Don't know about the other sizes.) I'd read in another review that cats are more comfortable in a carrier on the small size rather than too roomy; now that I've gone both ways, I know that's true. Tip: two weeks prior to the trip I unzipped the carrier and placed it near her food dish so she'd become accustomed to it. I put a few kibbles inside, which she approached warily and finally ate. Getting her into the carrier on travel day was MUCH less traumatic than any previous trip, and being able to pet her reassuringly en route made a big difference. (BTW, I also purchased the \\"Come with me kitty\\" harness and leash for extra control in case she struggled while being removed and replaced for the airport security check. It worked well as a precautionary measure, but I sure can't imagine walking a cat with it.)

product_title: HomeAgain Microchip Implant Kit for Administration by Veterinarian
review_body: We microchipped our dog through our vet about 4 years ago.  Some of the reviews on here are inaccurate.  You pay a one-time fee to Home Again to activate your membership.  You are not required to pay every year to keep your pet in their system.  As long as you keep your contact information up-to-date, they will contact you if your pet is located.  They have a separate option that you can subscribe to annually that provides additional measures for you to locate your pet if they are lost or stolen, such as printing lost fliers with your pet's photo.  I've always been very pleased with their customer service as well.  They are very professional and knowledgeable.

product_title: IRIS Pet Playpen with Door, 24-Inch
review_body: I have small breed puppies and this puppy pen is perfect. It is easy to clean, light weight, easy to assemble and fold to store. They always look neat and clean. I purchased four and would absolutely buy more. Price is very reasonable.

product_title: PetSafe Interior 2-Way Locking Cat Door, White
review_body:
We used to keep the cellar door ajar so the cats could get to their litter box, but that meant the kitchen always was drafty. (Cold draft is good for beer, but bad for houses.)

You've got to teach the cats how to use it:

* Cut the hole through the door, but do not install the PetSafe Cat Flap. This lets the cats understand there's a new way to get to the cellar.

* After a few days, put the Cat Flap on the hole. Our cats scratched at it, so we showed them how to push the flap.

* If you have more than one cat, expect to see them playing on each side of the flap. Sometimes it's like [[ASIN:B00005BY8V Rock 'Em Sock 'Em Robots]] Kitties.

It took a couple of days from start to finish, but they figured it out. And the kitchen is a lot less drafty now.

product_title: Domestic Pet Pet Products Here And There Home And Traveler Familiar
review_body: I am a hamster breeder of Russian dwarf hamsters and I have five different 'Here and There' cages from Penn-Plax. One is the economy and it is a good price but my hamsters like the larger versions. I have two small, one medium, and one large. My favorite is this one, I call it the medium size. It is a well built cage, easy to clean, my hamsters love climbing the bubble tube up to the top level. It is easy to detach the carrier on the top. I have tried several other brands even a ten gallon tank and the 'Here and There' cages are the best on the market. You won't go wrong buying this one for your fist hamster. It holds 4 or 5 easily, but I suggest no more then 4 Russian dwarf hamsters. Other breeds are solitary and you cannot put more then one in a cage.

product_title: PetSafe Busy Buddy Kibble Nibble Meal Dispensing Dog Toy
review_body: We have a 3 year old, 60 lb boxer lab mix. He destroys almost every toy we give him but he has had this for about 2 years now.  We use this toy to feed him kibble and it takes him about an hour to finish each time.  The toy does get really gross from rolling around on the floor covered in drool.  However, it's pretty easy to wash it with the rest of the dishes.  I agree that its very noisy on hardwood floors, but I haven't found a quieter way for our dog to use up this much energy so I still give it five stars.

product_title: IRIS Exercise Panel Pet Playpen with Door - 34 Inch
review_body: Great product. Only improvement would be how the panels are connected together. The long pins make it hard to quickly take a panel out or in.

product_title: PetSafe Easy-Fit Replacement Flap
review_headline: best value around for this replacement flap

product_title: IRIS Open Top Cat Litter Box Kit with Shield and Scoop
review_headline: Large enough for my BIG Maine Coon Cat
review_body: Finally found a big enough covered cat litter box for my 12 pound cat. And no she isn't obese.. They are known as the gentle giants, but the other standard litter box (which I have), althought fine it didn't quite work for her.. Glad I found this extra large one.

product_title: Zymox Otic Pet Ear Treatment with Hydrocortisone
review_body: I have a year old Golden Retriever that I adopted in December.  In January I took him to the vet because he had brown gunk in both his ears.  She diagnosed it as a bad yeast infection in both ears, ulcerated in one ear.  I love my vet - she doesn't immediately rush into antibiotics - she'll try something homeopathic when she can.  She told me that she also has a Golden who has allergies & had ear infections.  She read about Zymox & used it on her dog & said it really worked well. She gave me the Zymox with Hydrocortisone, told me to fill his ears with it, massage the ears & let him shake, then wipe the ears to make sure the pina was clean.  She told me to use it every day for 2 weeks, but that because it was so bad one course would probably not be enough.  We went back to see her after using it for 2 weeks.  Couldn't believe how good the ears looked - the ulcers were gone & so was most of the brown gunk.  She told me to keep using it for another  2 weeks to make sure the yeast infection was gone. The treatment was a success!!!  It's been about 4 weeks & his ears still look great.  I also purchased the Zymox Ear Cleaner since I figured my pooch was going to be a problem child & would need it too.  Used it once so far & his ears are still clean.    We will be spending part of the summer on a lake (or in it!) & I will not be without the Zymox.  It is a miracle worker.  I told a friend whose dogs have ear problems that have cost her a small fortune about it.  She was also quite pleased with it.  Zymox is a lot cheaper than going to the vet every month!

product_title: MidWest iCrate Single-Door Home Training and Travel Series
review_body: This crate is great for the price. I looked around some of the stores in my area and they were wwwaaaayy over priced! I have a JRT(jack russsle terrier) and as we all know they are very CRAZY dogs. lol. When she is in trouble this crate works great and also when we are not home. The only problem I have with the crate is the tray on the bottom slides out very easily. My dog is able to push it out every time she is in the crate...most of the time its just when she is trying to move around. The tray just slides out. But we solved that problem by using the divider that comes with the crate and putting it over the door wich makes the tray unable to slide out when she is inside.

review_body: My dog Rylee LOVES this bed!! He usually wasn't to keen on dog beds because he would have rather been in MY bed, but now if I want him to come cuddle with me at night I have to call him onto my bed. He will still come, he just gets up with a \\"sigh\\" as if he was so comfortable where he was.     The quality is a good fleece material and the color really helps to masquerade his shedding hair.

product_title: Oster Gentle Paws Premium Nail Grinder for Dogs and Cats
review_headline: Poor quality; doesn't work at all for cats
review_body: Just received this today, and I'm going to be returning it tonight.    The back-of-box copy claims it's \\"for all breeds of dogs and cats\\", but the guard, even on the smallest setting, holds a cat's claws too far away from the wheel to make contact, let alone be useful. It might work for a dog's straighter nails, but our cat's claws don't come close to touching the wheel.    It's far noisier and has far more vibration than my similarly-sized cordless Dremel tool. Piercing noise and vibration are absolutely *not* what you want around a skittish dog or cat.    The final straw? The switch on the unit we received was faulty (it worked at speed 1, but not speed 2).

review_headline: Great for dogs who chew their beds
review_body: We purchased 2 Large Coolaroos for our Weimarners because one was chewing the plush bed we bought him.  This bed has ceased all chewing, leaves no mess, and is attractive.  It also allows our large dogs to be elevated off the floor when they sleep.    The bed is easy to put together, especially if you follow the advice of past reviewers, making sure to not tighten the screws until all are in place.

product_title: Phycox Canine Joint Support Soft Chews
review_headline: Good supplement for our Rottweiler/Shepherd mix
review_body:
Our six-year-old 93-lb Rottweiler/Shepherd mix dog started taking PhyCox Soft Chews on Oct 26 because we noticed she had started walking with a limp in her left hind leg. We were concerned that her hip displasia was becoming worse.

The first tub of chews has not removed the limp, but we found out why at her semi-annual vet exam yesterday: Her left cranial cruciate ligament was torn. The limp was not from her hip at all. She will require surgery in a week's time, but our vet fully supported our decision to give our dog the PhyCox supplements. He said they will promote and safeguard her joint health in the long term, so he told us not to stop.

The second tub arrived yesterday. Our dog enjoys the \\"treats\\" every day. We are happy with the price and quality of these chews.

review_body: Just about the best clippers for horse people.  Takes a charge quickly and holds it long enough to do the job.  Uses different brands of blades so finding blades is never a problem.  Powerful motor.  Blades are easy to change.

product_title: Denta Clean Fresh Mint Tooth Paste for Dogs
review_headline: Better Toothpaste Than Most...But Not My First Choice
review_body:
Denta Clean toothpaste products are some of the best out there for dogs. Gilligan has been using this brand for years after trying, unsuccessfully, the chicken flavor toothpastes from other brands when I first began brushing his teeth. I mean, really? Who would think that chicken flavored foaming paste would NOT make even a dog gag? Gilligan would literally vomit after I brushed his teeth with those other toothpastes, but not the Denta Clean ones. I've tried all three (the Herbal, the Tartar Control, and the Mint Gel) and even though the Herbal one is by far the best, this Mint Gel one is okay too. The thing I am not thrilled about is the ingredients on this one (the ingredients used in the Herbal toothpaste are far more natural.) For those of you out there who need to know, here are the ingredients listed on the Mint Gel toothpaste: water, sorbitol, hydrated silica, glycerin, cellulose gum, \\"flavor\\" (??), sodium saccharin, potassium sorbate, methylparaben, propylparaben, coenzyme Q10, blue 1.

Not that this is a bad product, but had I been able to read the ingredients list before purchasing, I definitely would have paid the extra dollar and bought the Herbal version instead, which has far more natural ingredients (i.e. rosemary and peppermint extracts) and less of the industrial chemical sounding ingredients.

review_headline: Didn't live up to the hype
review_body: After much research, I decided to purchase the Cat Mate Pet Fountain.  It had received outstanding reviews and I was unhappy with my previous fountains.  I used the fountain for one week and was cleaning it.  After the cleaning, the fountain would no longer work.  After several tries I called the seller and explained my problem. After about 10 days I contacted the seller and was advised I would receive my full refund.  I subsequently purchased the original Drinkwell from Amazon.  I am still awaiting its arrival.

product_title: Pioneer Pet Raindrop Stainless Steel Pet Drinking Fountain
review_body: Just set this up and was very impressed with how quiet it is. By that, I mean I don't hear any pump noise what-so-ever. We tried a Petmate fountain some time back and it made considerable noise that our cats never got used to. I'll have to wait and see if the cats take to this or not, but noise is certainly not a deterrent.    The unit was very simple to get up-and-running. I don't think this would be as good a fountain for dogs as I think that while drinking from the odd shaped opening, a dogs snout would easily dislodge the top part of the fountain.    Another thing I'll be interested to see is whether this fountain gets scummy like all the others do. It has a replaceable filter, but so do the others and that hasn't prevented the scum in-and-of itself. I'll post back after a few weeks or if something noteworthy occurs.

product_title: Pet Parade Dog Repeller and Training Aid
review_headline: Worked great on one dog, not much on the next
review_body: Our small dog is not a constant, yapping barker. However, once she sees a cat, she will bark for a long time. This quiets her instantly. We don't abuse it, just when she seems to be getting in a red zone of barking. Most of the time now she stops barking as soon as I pick it up, without pushing the button.  An even bigger, unexpected benefit is when we tap the repeller, she comes immediately. Now when she is hot on the trail of a "critter" on her late night bathroom break, we just tap the button and she comes instantly. When she occasionally darts out the front door and heads for the street, we tap the button and she's back in a flash. I don't know if other dogs react the same but our dog does.  UPDATE 10/16/15 The dog we originally bought this product for passed away last year. We recently adopted a 3 yr old min pin/chi mix female. Not much of a barker normally, but a real "critter" chasing dog, won't come in the house once she's hot on the trail of something interesting. I thought maybe the "clicker" as we call it would work on her. No such luck. Oh she heard it because she turned around and looked at me the first few times I used it but then turned around and went her merry way. Occasionally she will respond by coming inside when I click it, but it is infrequent that it works when she is really in the "zone".  Several years ago I bought one for my mother's 2 yappy dogs. They haven't stopped barking altogether, but they do respond to the clicker.  They have become so well trained with the clicker that when she picks up the tv remote and points it at them, they stop barking.   I know from experience this works on some dogs but not on others. It was definitely worth a try with our first dog. Money well spent  Update 8/23/15: This turned out to be an excellent training tool for us. Our dog originally would not come when called. Once we used this a few times, just a light tap, and called her she would come. After a few times, we didn'teven need to use the repeller, she would come when called. It also stopped her from darting out the front door every time it was opened. A true success story for us. We're using ours to train a new dog. Hopefully we'll have the same success as with our previous pet.  I have recommended this to friends, some it worked for,  some not so much. The size of the dog didn't seem to matter much--more the level of excitement of the dog.  I've bought 2 of these inexpensive gems, one to keep at the front door and one at the back door. They have save us a lot of time getting the dog back in the house. Before you try something more expensive, give this a try.  5/27/13 UPDATE: After 2 1/2 yrs this gem is still going strong. I've given them as gifts to various family and friends. Worked on some dogs, not so well on a couple. My mother had the best results with her 2 dogs. All she has to do now after training them with the repeller is to point the tv channel changer toward the dogs and they immediately stop barking and lay on the floor!

I took him to the vet and she said most likely a food allergy and to put him on Wellness single protein canned food.  It's worked great... he loves it and rarely throws up anymore aside from the occasional hairball.  His sister will only eat dry food so I switched her to Wellness dry and she loves it as well.

review_body: We have a Husky/Shepherd mix and we had tried so many products to no avail.  Our vet recommended this and it was a miracle for her.  She was shedding so bad, we could not let her in the house at all, and we had to vaccuum our garage constantly. Now it is just normal shedding for the summer.  I am so thankful for this product and would recommend to everyone who had a dog with a shedding problem.    Donna Craig

product_title: Swoop Pooper Scooper for Large Dogs
review_body: I have physical disabilities which make bending over to scoop the poop quite difficult & painful. Living in the city & walking two large dogs, I have been looking for something easy & efficient to use....not a huge rake or jaws that would be not only difficult to carry but also had to be cleaned after each use. Overall, the concept is good. It takes a bit of practice to get everything in one scoop. If the grass is tall or a little long, it is more difficult to get everything at one time. I do take my dogs to the beach & find that it works ok in the sand. Too bad the claw part is not metal...I think that metal would give a better scoop. I use a roll-a-tor (walker) to walk. I like that I can hang the swooper from the handle. Not much bending for me which is a plus. Having two dogs I still have to carry extra bags to hold the \\"filled\\" bags while we walk. The idea of just popping it into the trash is great if you only need to use one bag. I have also used regular poop bags in place of the ones that come with the Swoop Pooper & they seem to work just as well. I think it could also be improved if you could carry extra bags in the handle.  Overall, I am satisfied until I can find something that is even more efficient for my needs.

product_title: PetSafe 6-Volt Lithium Battery (2 Batteries per Pack)
review_headline: Pet Safe Batteries for Remote Trainer for Dog
review_body: I actually bought these batteries because I was selling my Pet Safe Small Dog Remote Trainer and wanted to give them something that the person could immediately see worked.      Personally, I would have preferred a holder that allowed me to change the battery itself, not the entire cap...that makes it very expensive and therefore stars get removed for that design alone.  It isn't a cost effective method that should be used by a manufacturer.  I had the PetSafe outdoor fence and they had a receiver that you inserted a CR 2032 battery.....this appears to be the same battery, you just have to pay a lot more to get the entire cap for the remote trainer.  Good for PetSafe money making, bad for the customer.    Fortunately, this is for a remote dog/cat trainer and hopefully you don't need to use it for very long, so you won't have to pay the additional costs for very long.     It isn't a matter of recommending this item...if you have this item, I know of no other way to make it functional then to buy these batteries/caps....I wouldn't recommend PetSafe for that reason...aside from the fact that in the Southern States, they no longer service here...I know, lightning hit my fence and killed it...and to bad for me...I replaced the system and not with another PetSafe ... or there sister company Invisible ...both owned by the same parent company.

Also, when using any clippers with speed you on any hair job should have many blades not just one. Amatuers use caution and be safe.

product_title: Urine Off UV Urine Finder Black Light
review_body: This light is very weak and small.  I know exactly where my cat urinated and shined it there and it didn't glow pale yellow like it was supposed to.  You are better off using your nose this light doesn't work.

product_title: Cholodin Tablets 50 Tabs
review_body: Our girl is 13+ yrs old.  She is a boxer/bullmastif and started displaying muscular difficulties.  Our Vet suggested giving this to her and she has enjoyed fantastic improvement.  I feel that she will be with us with a good quality of life as long as this suppliment is fed to her!

product_title: IRIS Exercise Panel Pet Playpen with Door - 34 Inch
review_body: This pet pen is fantastic.  So easy to put together and move around.  Works great for my 5 pound cockapoo!  Very sturdy and convenient - for use inside or outside.  I love it!

product_title: NEW! Brown Pug Christmas Ornament Cup of Tea
review_body: This is a must for all pug lovers! It's the perfect size, ideal for any size tree. The detail is very nice, & the colours are just what you'd expect. An ideal gift for anyone.

product_title: Hartz Fish'N Fun Cat Toy (Colors Vary)
review_body: I have a couple of large male Siberian cats.  One of them is completely nuts over this fish (the other is intimidated by the older one's obsession with this fish, and stays out of the way!).  I keep having to buy more because he loves it so much he wears them out.  He has even growled at me when I've tried to take it from him at the end of a play session!  As long as this toy is available, I'll keep buying it when he wears it out.

product_title: Kong Dog Goodie Bone Red
review_body: I love Kong merchandise, but am a little disappointed in this particular product (LARGE/RED Goodie Bone).  The reason is that it's a big, beefy, thick bone that really seems targeted towards dogs with powerful jaws.  I have a medium-sized Vizsla that is a moderately enthusiastic chewer, but by no means above average.  The large, red Kong lasted 7 or 8 minutes with him, then split near the goodie holes on both ends.  I always supervise him with toys, and immediately noticed when he pulled off a chunk of rubber about the size of a bon-bon so as to prevent him from eating it.    There must be a considerable difference between the red rubber of this product and the black rubber of the Kong Extreme, because the medium-sized Extreme usually lasts 2-3 weeks with the same dog.  I think the red version is best suited to gentle chewers.

product_title: Pioneer Pet SmartCat The Ultimate Scratching Post
review_headline: Fabulous constuction, cats love it - I bought 3
review_body: I got one of these at a pet store. As I took the post out of the box one of my cats attacked it - I had to put her in another room so that I could assemble it. Very easy to put together, a couple of dowels and a few screws (it is also easy to take apart). I have one in the living room and I take one when I go up to the lake. It is a nice height so the kitties can stretch and get a really good work out. The top is a bit small and slippery but it is a favorite spot for my cats to lounge.    I went to the pet store to buy a second post and couldn't find one. I ordered two from Amazon and I'm storing one in the box just in case SmartCat ever discontinues this product.    I highly recommend this to any cat lover.

product_title: GATSBY LEATHER COMPANY 283988 Nylon Halter Black, Horse
review_body: The hardware on this halter is so chintzy I don't even want to put it on my horses for fear one spook will cause the metal to snap and expose sharp edges.  Sure, it's inexpensive, but it's also useless.

product_title: Magnador 13 in. x 19 3/4 in.
review_body: the dog door is everything the company offered.  it installed easily and is working well.  i've had trouble before with the flexible flaps in the cold,  they can crack and break.  this is my second magnador i've purchased and the first one is still going strong after 2 winters.  no problems in the cold weather

product_title: Halloween Dog Convict Costume "Prisoner" Small 8-11 Lbs
review_body: My little Havanese pup is about 8-8 1/2 pounds and she looks adorable in this costume!  Since it goes around her body, and not over her head she doesn't seem to mind it so much, and it helps make a better fit, too.  The ball and chain is so cute (though too big for her leg!) and the hat is adorable. The price was wonderful, too.

product_title: Coolaroo Steel-Framed Pet Bed, Cadet Blue, Medium
review_body: The coolaroo is a good idea, however my border collie will not stay on it without me standing by her. She likes the ground or garage floor better I guess.  She will lay on it while I pet her and thinks she will get more attention laying on it...smart dog because she usually does.  Seems like it would be cooler for her if she would stay on the coolaroo. It was a little challenging to put together. Sorry I can't tell you more than that.

product_title: Capstar Blue - 6 count for Dogs and Cats 2 - 25 lbs
review_body: I rely on this product every flea season.  It gives my pets comfort by killing the fleas instantly (within 30 minutes) and then follow up with the monthly flea treatment.

product_title: Wellness Complete Health Natural Grain Free Wet Canned Cat Food Pate Recipe
review_headline: Cats love the food, but no pull-tab top, and dented cans.
review_body: I appreciate being able to buy this larger, more economical size from Amazon.  However, I didn't examine the picture closely enough, because I was surprised to see that the cans were not pull-tab and I had to dig out a can opener.  Inconvenient, especially since I feed my cats in the laundry room in the basement, not in our tiny kitchen.  Five or six of the cans were dented (I ordered a total of 24), a couple pretty severely.  I'm not sure what the box went through with the shippers, but even the cans need better padding!

product_title: Pet Memory Stones, Memorial Headstone, Small with Customizable Photo Frame
review_body: Heavier than I expected. I made a mistake and printed the wrong date on the picture, so I had to pull it apart, replace the picture and re-glue it with silicone, and it sealed up very well.

product_title: Zenies Colorful Bone Shaped Squeak Toy for Dog - Green -
review_body: I bought two of these for my great pyrenees/boarder collie puppy. He had the stuffing out of the first one in about an hour.  The second one followed rather quickly.  He does love carrying them around .... so if you don't mind stuffing being trailed all over the house ..............

product_title: Novartis Capstar Flea Treatment Green Tabs for Dogs 25 Pounds or Over, 6 Tablets
review_body:
After an extended drought, followed by excessive spring rains, we've had fleas on top of fleas this summer. To complicate matters, I have a 126 pound, plush-coated, Shiloh Shepherd, with plenty of room for fleas to create uncomfortable mischief. And, he's an 'inside' dog, too. Hello, fleas!

I hate chemicals, but fleas are a potential risk factor as well, so I had to eliminate, or control them. I did not want my dog to develop flea allergies, or nasty tapeworms. So, I decided to give the product a try. I was amazed at its effectiveness. Within half an hour, I could see fleas wanting to escape the dog, by crawling to the surface of the coat.

Be warned, that your pet may appear agitated, and may whine and scratch excessively, as those fleas are in chaotic motion. At first, I thought my dog might be having a bad reaction to the chemicals, but it was simply the fleas squirming and dying off. He had no other observable side effects to the product. After the Capstar had done its magic, the poor boy slept so comfortably, making up for lost zzzzz's from the itching.

I followed the Capstar with Advantage, and only moderate environmental control. I now have a relaxed, contented Shiloh. I will never be without Capstar for those epidemic outbreaks.

product_title: Fizzion Pet Stain & Odor Remover, 32-Ounce Bottle w/ 2-Pack Refill
review_headline: This is an absolutely amazing product!  It works great on everything!
review_body: I have used this product on several things such as pet stains and odors, a pre-spotter for your laundry ( pet, and kids clothes and bedding), as well as cleaning the upholstery on your furniture! This is also a great product in the way of our environment.  You get to reuse the same bottle, and simply purchase refills.  Just add water....  So Smart!  An all round great buy!

product_title: Instinctive Choice Premium Canned Cat Food 24-3 oz. cans
review_body: My cat loves this stuff...she also likes the dry food...I plan on purchasing this for my cat forever. I feed her half a can twice a day and leave dry out always for grazing. My cat is an indoor cat and this food is made with grass in it to help your cats digestive system. It\\"s also not very expensive..I buy dog food from our local vet  and it is pretty pricey. It costs just as much to buy food at walmart and its not as healthy for your cat...I'm a fan

product_title: MidWest Life Stages Heavy-Duty Folding Metal Dog Crates; Single Door & Double Door Dog Crates w/ Divider Panel, Floor Protecting “Roller” Feet & Leak-Proof Plastic Pan
review_body: The crate is exactly as described and for the price, it's pretty good.  Also since it can be folded quickly and easily it's great for travel.

product_title: Optimex Anti-Tear Stain (4oz /114 g)
review_body: I was so tired of trying to keep my dog's face clean. Those brown tear stains were driving me crazy.  My groomer recommended Optimex, so I gave it a try.  It really worked.  I did have to put it on a little canned food each time I used it, cause the little guy wouldn't eat it on the dry food only.  Small price to pay for a clean, white face.

product_title: molly mutt dog bed duvet
review_body: I got this with the stuff sack because my dog has a tendency to chew, and we wanted to avoid a big mess.  We've been pleasantly surprised that she hasn't chewed on this one, and it's held up very well for approx 2-3 months and a washing.  I used the bed outside for a while with cedar chips as stuffing, but my dog (black lab 6-month old puppy) didn't really like it (too hard?  too smelly?).  It did OK in the rain, but we decided to wash it, change out the stuffing and bring it inside when my dog chewed an old bed.  The stuff sack made this an easy process, and I recommend getting it just to make it easier to wash and stuff.

product_title: Oster Gentle Paws Premium Nail Grinder for Dogs and Cats
review_headline: Don't buy this piece of crap
review_body: This thing is totally worthless. The batteries run down very quickly. The sander bands slip up and down. After attempting to use it, you will need a pipe wrench to unscrew the cover to attempt to secure the sander band that quickly slips off and down the roller like a pair of socks that are too big. Worthless!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!! Ripoff!!!!!!!!!!!!!111

product_title: Andis UltraEdge Super 2-Speed Detachable Blade Clipper, Professional Animal Grooming, AGC2
review_body: I bought these clippers originally because I got tired of paying almost $50 every time I got my yorkie-poo, Marley groomed.  I also purchased the Andis 4FC blade to go along with it.  I was surprised when I received the clippers because the box said \\"Cattle Clippers\\"!  When I turned the clippers on, I was expecting the sound of the clippers I use to cut my husband's hair, but these were SO quiet!  Marley can be slightly skittish, and I expected him to have a hard time at first.  He didn't even seem to mind the fact that I was clipping his hair.  The clippers cut through his hair so easily (and I say hair because that's what he actually has...which makes it slightly more difficult to clip him than if he had fur).  I am very impressed with the clippers, however I do wish I had known that they came with a \\"blocking blade\\" instead of a #10 blade.  I would have purchased a #10 separately at the same time had I known this.  I'm still not entirely sure what to do with the blocking blade (or what it's exact function is supposed to be) and I don't quite think it's fair to use Marley as my guinea pig to see exactly how short this blade cuts...so I will have to do a bit more research on this particular blade before I make Marley pay that price.  I will also say that the clippers did get hot on the blade and when the heat began to increase, Marley began to get a bit jumpy.  I suppose any time that metal moves against metal that is a normal occurence.  I took a break, set the blade down on the tile to cool and clipped his face with the scissors in the meantime.  Overall, a great set of clippers.  I am optimistic that they will prove over time that the price that I paid for them was well worth it!

product_title: Zoo Med Wood Tortoise House
review_headline: Nice new home for our Russian Tortoise
review_body: We just got the new tortoise house yesterday. My 12-yr-old son put it together all by himself in about an hour, said it was pretty easy. We just got our Russian tortoise 5 days ago and she was in a temporary habitat. She seems to be adjusting fine to the new home, we moved her in this morning and she's discovered the dark, covered part of the house. She's about 4-5 months old so she has lots of space. The heat lamp and UVB lamp are clamped to the top screen, and plenty of room for her water/soaking dish and food dishes. The Tortoise House was just as we expected it to be and looks like it will be a very suitable home for our Russian tortoise.

product_title: PetSafe SlimCat Interactive Toy and Food Dispenser
review_body: My cat was a consistent binge and barfer.  He would scoff his food down in seconds and hurl it back up.  I tried expensive automatic food dispensers which he would break into and eat all of the food.  This little ball dispenses food slowly, locks closed, and locks in the size of the holes that food is allowed to escape from.  It now take him 20 minutes to complete a meal and he hasn't thrown-up since.  I just love it and it was a great price!

product_title: PortaPet Deluxe PenaPet Portable Dog Pen
review_body: We have a small puppy, 2-3 pounds, who loves to play in this!  He still sleeps in a crate, his choice, but adores walking through this and taking a nap.  It folds easily and packs in the pouch so we take it when we travel.  Can't be too careful in another persons home when house training is going on...  We believe he will not out grow this even if he gets to be more than 10 pounds.    Chuy is a Rat-Cha so he likes to dig  ALL  the time!  yes, he chews on everything!  This play pen has held up well.  We tell children who love to do puppy play... that when Chuy gets into his play area he is in a safe zone and just talk to him.  No touching!  He seems to have figured this out already and loves the power it gives him.    Pro:  There is a place to hang a water bottle so he cannot get to it and spill.  I place dry chow on the flooring.  He can have it without the screen roof or the heavy floor.  Easy, easy easy!  (folding it is a bit of an IQ test I am sad to admit!)    Con:  There is a stretchy web strap that keeps it collapsed.  This dog found it quickly so he can pull the playpen about easily.  (It has loops to stake it when outside though.)    Great buy!  Multiple useage!

product_title: Super Pet My First Home Complete Starter Kit
review_body: This product is perfect!!! My 10 year old daughter has been saving up to purchase a new friend (guinea pig), so as a Christmas gift, I purchased this for her so that she could have it set up, and ready for her new friend's arrival. WOW! Were we impressed. Everything that comes with this cage is of great quality, the cage itself is wonderful. It is very large, and has PLENTY of room for more than 1 guinea pig (I think it would be nice for any small pet, even smaller rabbits). We brought home her new friend, a baby guinea pig, last night, and the cage, with all the accessories, is perfect. He has more than enough room to grow, as well as plenty of room to exercise. There's enough room to add a friend, if we decide to in the future. I am extremely happy with the purchase. It could not have been better, or cheaper, if we purchased everything separately. I couldn't have chosen better quality accessories, ie. food, bedding, treats, etc. I think anyone who purchases this cage would not be disappointed. For a guinea pig, it is absolutely \\"perfect\\"! I also read that some are having problems with the water bottle \\"dripping\\", ours did at first, until I angled it back more, kinda like at a 45 degree angle to the cage, instead of straight up, and down... that did it. It hasn't dripped since. So, if you are looking for the perfect cage, and accessories for your new, (or old) family member, this is it... WE LOVE IT! (as well as our newest family member).

product_title: Pioneer Pet SmartCat The Ultimate Scratching Post
review_body: This is a great scratching post - my cat loves it, it looks good, it's well made and the price is very reasonable - exactly what I was looking for.

product_title: K9 Advantix Flea Control for Dogs
review_body: I've used this product before and have been very pleased with the results. When it came time for me to re-order, I found Amazon.com had the best reasonable pricing for this product.

product_title: Cat Craft 12400301GRCOM  Three Tier Floor-to-Ceiling Cat Tree, Grey
review_body: if your cat doesn't love hanging out on this multi-tiered kitty perch, then something is wrong with your cat!

product_title: Kaytee Small Animal Top Fill Water Bottle
review_body: I too wish I still had my receipt for these water bottles.  I bought two and within 2 days they both fell apart.  The clip does not hold it up and the spout and metal ball came out--on both bottles!  Do not waste your money!!

product_title: FURminator Medium Yellow Deshedding Tool with 2-2/3-Inch Edge
review_body: This has got to be one of the best inventions for dog grooming. I have a beagle and although she has a short coat she does shed with the approach of warmer weather. The Furminator does a wonderful job of getting out that loose fur, and she seems to enjoy it.

product_title: The Tick Key
review_body: The tick season has been bad this year. We have a few outdoor cats and trying to hold them down, to remove a tick, is almost impossible. I purchased this on a whim. I almost expected something so simple not to work. Well, I am glad I was wrong. This works great!     One of our cats had a tick on her eyelid. I had tried all day to get it off. Luckily, this little gadget arrived in the mail the next day. I held it in my hand as the cat rubbed against it and POP the tick came off (head and all) as easy as that. The cat didn't even notice. The tick stayed in the gadget so I didn't have to touch the tick at all. The tick remover is metal so I could use a lighter on the tick without damaging the product.     I love that I can keep this on my keychain so that I can find it easily. I have had this on my keychain for almost a year and it is not damaged. The metal is pretty thick so I don't have to worry about bending it when I bang my keys into anything. I plan to order a few more as gifts.

product_title: Hagen Fluval 3 Plus Internal Filter, 185 GPH
review_body: This pump was not designed by anyone with any knowledge of how water moves. Due to poor design water will only flow through a tiny amount of the sponge. The waste collection ability of this pump is terrible. To give an example of how poorly the water flow is designed, you could probably shorten this pumps sponge container by two thirds and get the same filtering ability. It has been 3 weeks and the bottom four fifths of the sponge in my pump is pristine white as no waste has touched it.    I am very disappointed as I paid a premium for this pump thinking it would be better quality. It is outperformed by a 5 year old pump half the size that I had previously.    It is easy to remove the sponges for cleaning and the pump itself is relatively quiet for its size. The water volume is good. However as its primary function is supposed to be removal of fish waste I give this rip off pump one star.

product_title: BestPet Plaid 3-Wheel Pet Stroller, Classic Pink
review_body: This stroller arrived quickly, was easy to set up and is wonderful to use.  My 6 lb Yorkies loves riding in it.  It also has plenty of storage for my garage door opener, doggie bags, soft drinks, purse and dog leashes.  I was pleased to find a rain cover included too. I would recommend this product to anyone with a small (under 10 lbs) older dog who may tire on a long walk.  It is also quite attractive.  My dogs are known as the neighborhood Yuppies now.

product_title: Our Pet's Big Dog Feeder Diner (Black 16" Tall)
review_body: Mother came to stay from out of country and purchased this as a gift for us before leaving. Our 9 month old baby was constantly in our on the floor dog dishes, either splashing up to his elbows or stuffing dog food in his mouth before trying to make a quick escape. Plus our mastiff's big lips would hold pieces of dog food when eating that would drop off onto the floor, and he made huge messes when drinking. Well, all that is over now. This does everything that is listed in the description and more. The lip around the edge prevents water from going onto the floor and will collect in the excellent designed extra space under the dishes till you're ready to remove. The edge around the unit is large enough that the majority of the falling dog food stays on the platform. Also the legs are hollow and capped so that you're able to fill them with sand to weight the unit. This product is large, our mastiff still bends to drink/eat but suitable for large lab / retriever. Initially,we never would have purchased this for ourselves, but now having experienced the benefits we would not now live without it. The difference it has made in our day to day living is amazing and if it needed to be replaced I would gladly pay double the $70 and be satisfied. Can't say enough about this, just overall excellent, completely exceeded expectations.

product_title: Planet Dog Orbee-Tuff Glow for Good Dog Toys
review_body: I bought three balls that I think were under this name, a year or so ago. They are 3 1/4\\", which is what he needs, because he is a large Standard Poodle. He started tearing up the Planet Dog tennis balls by the seams, but these don't have seams, and so far so good.    So I ordered 6 of them to give him for this Christmas. When they arrived, they were too small for me to give him--they are now 2 1/2\\" instead of 3 1/4\\". The smaller size could get caught in a large dog's throat and result in death.     Amazon is fantastic, and is accepting my order back for refund. Please note, these balls are only 2 1/2\\" in diameter. Fine for smaller dogs. Not safe for big dogs.    Now I have to figure out what balls to get for my dear one for Christmas. Oy!

product_title: PetSafe Pawz Away Pet Barriers with Adjustable Range, Pet Proofing for Cats and Dogs, Static Stimulation
review_headline: Works very well for CATS too!
review_body: We have 4 cats - 3 are nibblers and one is a Tubby, who lives for food.  He will eat all four of the cats food before the other three get a chance to eat.  We tried everything, even the Elite electronic cat door with the microchip collars.  That worked well for about a month, until he figured out he could wait outside the door for one of the cats to come through, and then sneak through behind them.  Then we found this unit.  We mounted it about three feet up centered on the door.  In two days he learned to stay away from the door.  Because cats have such thick fur, it didn't zap him every time, but it did enough that he figured it out.  I actually saw him get zapped a few times (I had tried it on my wrist - It is irritating, but not painful), and he was startled and jumped back.  He soon figured out that the beep meant he was too close and stayed back.  We then unscrewed and removed the shock posts so it no longer shocks him, but it is still just as effective with just the beep now.

product_title: PetSafe Deluxe In-Ground Fence, PRF-304W
review_body: This is a whole lot more affordable than a conventional fence.  I found it easy to set up also.  This web site  does not let you down. I got much better service from here than from PetSafe. Within a day of asking for an exchange Amazon had already mailed the replacement and everything is working once again. PetSafe wanted the item returned and would review the return within 48 hours of receiving it....how am I keeping the dog in the yard while I wait for the review?! Not so funny how a company that sells pet products and is called PetSafe cares much less than Amazon about replacing a defective product like the in-ground fence. That's why I buy from this sight. In less than 60 days it has stopped working. The open loop signal started going off even when I cut a short piece of wire to test the transmitter to make sure the buried wire was not broken. The fuse did not burn out so I assume the electronics were defective. This is disappointing and hopefully the replacement from them will not be a problem.

product_title: Multivet Ssscat Kit Automated Cat Repellent Deterrent Spray + 6 Refills
review_body: both of my cats scat when they come in contact with this stuff.  They don't like the surprise and they don't like to be sprayed at, so it a great deterrent.

product_title: The Da Bird Super Pack (Includes 1 Da Bird Original 36" Single Pole Cat Toy, Feather Refill, Sparkly Attachment, Kitty Puff Attachment & Peacock Feather)
review_headline: Best Cat Toy I ever got
review_body: The pole is really huge which makes for thrilling chase for kitty. the attachments are very high quality and it even comes with a real peacock feather!   Perfect if your can is indoors only. They get bored easily and never get to have the fund of catching animals. Nina never had this much fun in her life. I believe even the laziest cat in the world would play with this toy. It is expensive but you get what you pay for. Makes more sense than buying a bunch of cheap toys that kitty won't care about.   Nina is totally hooked. she even likes this better than the laser pointer, which is saying a lot about this toy.

product_title: PetSafe Drinkwell Platinum Pet Fountain
review_headline: Works great, but keep it CLEAN
review_body: I purchased a Drinkwell Platinum fountain in July 2009 and it worked great for about 6 months.  Then it began spilling water all over the floor.  I contacted the manufacturer, which replied promptly to my e-mail with several suggestions.  Despite regular cleaning, I had not been careful enough, apparently.  Because after a thorough cleaning, it is working perfectly again.  So BEWARE.  You must clean this regularly or risk a wet floor.  But the manufacturer's customer service is pretty spectacular.

product_title: Halo Spot's Stew for Dogs Wholesome Beef Recipe Canned Dog Food (12/13-oz Cans)
review_body: My Golden Retriever has a tendency to pile on the pounds, so we watch her diet carefully.  She gets two cups of Canidae dry food each day and is usually happy with that.  But this winter she was sick and stopped eating, so the vet suggested adding a very small amount of canned food to the dry.  That worked, but it meant having to store a can of dogfood in my refrigerator between feedings, and heating it up for about 6 seconds so that I could mix it into the dry food.  Most canned dog food turns into a cold chunk when it is refrigerated.  When heated it gives off a nasty odor that I don't like.  Spot's Stew looks and smells like human stew, even when it is heated.  It has enough \\"gravy\\" that it mixes easily with the dry food.  I like that because I don't have to add very many extra calories.  It only takes a few tablespoons to send my Goldon into doggy heaven.  Spot's Stew is not readily available, however.  My local \\"natural food\\" store used to carry it, but no more, so I have begun purchasing from Amazon.

product_title: Surf Shack Litter Box Cover
review_headline: High quality construction (I like this design best for gifts if you don't know what the persons home looks like)
review_body: This review was actually for this design, I think it's the safest bet to match most home decor:  So you cover your existing litter box with this by first setting the rectangular support board on top and then draping the fabric cover over it. Very simple to set up.    I saw all three designs up close at a pet product expo. I think it is an ingenious concept and definitely one of those things you get to talk about when people see it in your house. I helped someone pick one out as a gift and we decided on the earth toned surf shack as it would match the decor of her brothers living room.    The thing that was really surprising was the quality of the fabric and construction. I can't say I have actually washed one several times yet to see how the printed fabric holds up but I'm confident they will last for many years. I have a lot of experience with sewing and garment construction and this is expensive fabric and quality printing. Even the label was the expensive woven type.    It's always more fun to buy presents for people's pets and they tend to enjoy them more, and this is perfect for anyone who has a cat. It comes flat, the size of the top, with the fabric cover folded around the support board. Easy to wrap it and stick a bow on it.

product_title: 2 PACK Cosequin for Cats 80 count (160 CAPSULES)
review_body: My two 16-year old cats have stiff joints.  The vet recommended the Cosequin capsules.  I sprinkle one capsule a day on their dry cat food.  They do not seem to notice it. It really works.  The cats move much more easily now.  I also give them [[ASIN:B000RI3RVE Nu-Cat]] vitamin pills, which makes their fur better.

product_title: CFA Seagull Flying Wand Cat Toy
review_headline: Fun playing with me and on their own
review_body: My three cats had different reactions to this toy. One was afraid and ran away. One thought it the best toy ever and played for over 30 minutes with it. The third cat drags the toy around the house and plays a few minutes with me. She tolerates playing with me. The toy loses its feathers which I expected but every other part is sturdy and good. Great toy and price.

product_title: UGODOG Indoor Dog Potty
review_headline: Great if you get your dog used to it
review_body:
I bought this for my chowchow/lab mix puppy (2 months of age).

For some background, I trained my puppy not to go to the bathroom indoors for the first week of owning her. She picked it up very quickly as she was raised by the foster family to only goto the bathroom on grass. I work full time, but I took 2 weeks off for my new puppy to properly train her. I started with crate training for the first week, which doubled as housebreaking. I trained her to use a bell on the door to indicate when she had to goto the bathroom, and began to give her more free roam of the tile area of my house. I was very pleased that she was so willing to only go to the bathroom outside, but realized that sometimes I may not be able to make it home in time during lunch, and wanted to train her to use the UGODOG during the day. After she was relatively housebroken, during the day I decided to let her use my spare bathroom as her home, and put her crate in one end, food in one corner and the UGODOG in another corner away from her food/sleeping area.

I initially had trouble getting her to use it. I bought puppy treatment pads to try and speed up the process, and I read that the pads have a scent that attract puppies to urinate on them. All that ended up happening was my puppy treated the UGODOG like an enemy, and would growl and pounce away from it. I then took the pads out and tried using nothing but the grate. product_title: Oral Hygiene Kit with Dual Action Toothbrush
review_headline: I don't blame my cats for not liking it....but it's good for them
review_body: Growing up my family always talked about how pets didn't need their teeth brushed because they wouldn't get it in the wild. However, as I grew older I realized how short-sided this opinion was. Although accurate, it doesn't take in consideration that wild cats also don't eat kibble packed with sticky grains that cause tartar. For the record, my family's cats ended up toothless in their old age.    I have two cat. One is a five-year old male that I've fed kibble all his life until I recently. I never brushed his teeth. His breath became outrageously bad. I took him to the vet and they were able to lift his lip high enough that I could see the angry red line that indicates gum disease. Although his breath has improved with a raw food diet, I think he's in pain because my kitten crunches down the bony food with her baby teeth better than my male cat, even though five is still young. I'm taking him in for a dental cleaning in January.     So, I'm very happy this product exists. It's also cheaper on Amazon than at local pet stores. I like that there's two options for brushes, even though the cats don't like either. The little blue one that goes on the finger is a little too big for a kitten's mouth but fits a cat's perfectly. The brush is more difficult to use with a struggling cat. The toothpaste stinks. I wish it at least stank like something the cats found savory but they like the paste less than just the bare brush. I took a star off for that, plus there's no ingredient list.    If your cat has gum disease or plaque, this doesn't take the place of a dental cleaning (preferably non-anesthetic) just as it doesn't for human teeth, but this is a great tool for dental hygiene maintenance.

product_title: Amber Technology Tossa K, 1 oz
review_body:
This product shipped quickly and arrived on time. The dosage in the package is a bit confusing: dosages are give by drop size/animal weight. The dropper does not have any graduations that would make it easier to determine if enough medicine is being given. The dropper is glass so it is not possible to put the medicine directly into the dog's mouth as they might bite at it as it is no doubt bitter (it smelled bitter to me). A plastic syringe might be a good thing to add.

They package insert states that it is important not to overdose the animal--that is probably wise given that one of the main ingredients is EtOH (ethanol) and dogs cannot readily metabolize alcohol so too much of this medicine might cause liver problems.

My little dog had what, based on all the information I could find, was kennel cough, a highly contagious upper respiratory infection. The poor little guy was coughing in the most gut wrenching way. I followed the dosage instructions but found that he was avoiding the medicine if I put it into his dog-food. I ended up using a plastic syringe and just mixing it with a bit of milk and squirting it into his mouth. He didn't like it too much, but at least he got the dosages.

It didn't work. Kennel cough will usually clear up in about two weeks in an otherwise healthy animal, he is still hacking away two and one half months later. The Vet said he might have some type of doggie asthma (he is eleven years old) so the only thing to do is monitor his symptoms and give him an antihistamine twice a day.

Other reviewers gave this product high marks as it cleared up the Kennel Cough, well, Kennel Cough will resolve itself within two weeks so it might be a placebo effect or just time.

The company that makes this product does a decent job with the instructions inside the box, they are clear and the warnings about overdosing are straightforward. I doubt I'd buy product from this company again. It says it is 'Organic' with what I suppose it an attempt to be 'natural'. Well, Arsenic is 'natural' and it is very deadly, so... As with other OTC medicines, caveat emptor and make sure to do the homework first.empt to be 'natural'. Well, Arsenic is 'natural' and it is very deadly, so... As with other OTC medicines, caveat emptor and make sure to do the homework first.
