With the crystals, you never knew that the litterbox was full, unlike so many others that start smelling if not cleaned every day. That is what decided us on this box. Rake slowly once a day and box stays clean. Cat likes it too!

I almost bought the auto, but thought that was a lot to spend on a kitten. Glad I stayed with the manual one. It is so easy.

product_title: Li'l Pals® Bristle Brush
review_body: Although the brush is small it not only works great on my maltese but is also very effective for my westies. This is a soft brush and is best used if there are no snarls or matting.

product_title: KONG Flyer Dog Toy
review_body: My dog isn't a heavy chewer & the 1st one we bought a few mos ago held up fine.  That's why I bought a back-up, but half the rim was chewed off in a couple of days. Can't tell if the quality is inferior to the 1st one, or if he just likes this one better!  Still, he prefers these over any of the others.

product_title: Nu Cat-Chewable Supplement
review_body: My cat is about 12 years old. He is so much better when on a daily vitamin supplement. These  are comprehensive and at a great price! I will purchase these in the future to keep my older feline  fit and happy.

product_title: K-Ii Enterprises Pet-Agree Dog Training Aid Ultrasonic
review_headline: Worked for my little yappy dogs!!
review_body:
This is honestly the best money I have ever spent! I have had issues with my Chihuahua and Pug for the past 6 years. The incessant barking drove me absolutely insane. Anyone walking past our house...my dogs were barking, anyone knocks at our door...my dogs were barking, anyone makes a sudden noise...my dogs were barking. It was to the point where I felt completely hopeless and really started to hate my dogs. We tried everything and nothing we could do would stop them. It was so frusterating!
Then I came upon this and I actually hestitated for months to buy it. I had it in my \\"cart\\" but didn't purchase it until I was finally at a breaking point and ready to give my dogs away.
As soon as the first bark comes out of their mouths I grab the Pet Agree and say a firm NO, with a quick click of the button...and oh yes, they hear it! Again...they bark and I immediately follow it with a firm NO and a click. My dogs are stubborn so if they're really excited it typically takes a couple times to get them to stop. But it is way better than listening to the shrill bark of a chihuahua for 15 minutes straight. Sometimes I don't even have to click, they now know what it is and they will just look at me picking it up and stop barking.
They are getting better every day and there are days that go by that we don't need to use it at all. I can honestly say life is better since I bought this product!!!!!! Thank you Pet Agree!!!

product_title: The GoodLife Recipe Salmon - 6 lb
review_body: i guess it is a matter of your cat's personal preference.  My cat, however, will not eat this for some reason.  Strange.  She used to eat royal canin from her previous owner.  I have been feeding her 9 lives dry cat food which she eats pretty well.  I've given her a trial of the purina one smartblends and she'll prefer that over 9 lives (but still eats both).  So tried this goodlife salmon version since it is one of the grocery store brands that has 2nd highest protein content and is all natural.  well, she'd rather starve than eat this....she'll eat the stale 9 lives over this.  :(  i sniffed this brand and it smells quite different from 9 lives and purina one....it reminds me of the cat food i used to feed my first cat back in 1989.  Weird, i know but it really does remind me of such.  Again, maybe this is just my cat, but just a heads up on this.  this isnt a purina brand but is manufactured by Mars corporation (yea, same company that makes Mars chocolate bars).

product_title: Mardel 5-in-1 Test Strips (Freshwater/Saltwater)
review_headline: Great for a while, but they expire too fast
review_body: These strips are easy to use, but I didn't notice that they only have a limited shelf life and the following season they were inaccurate. I checked and they'd expired.  The 100 count is probably more than you'll use in one year.  But it you're aware of this they do save a lot of time.  But the price is high for one season of testing.

product_title: 2 Pack Medium Yellow Furminator deshedding Tool (2.75" edge)
review_body: The best dog hair remover ever.  I purchased these on the recommendation from my dog trainer, Sit Means Sit! They are  unbelievable hair removal. My Austrialian Shepard, Jack, loves it.  I remove tons of hair daily. I also bought these for my son's two dogs.  They also love sitting to get their hair removed. Thanks for a great product!!!!  Five great stars. Pat in Maui.

product_title: Bag Clipper (1-pack)
review_body: very handy when walking the dog in common neighborhood areas, especially on long walks with no good access to trash cans! easy to clip to leash and bag clips on easily as well.  velcro attachment is nice if you have more than one leash!

product_title: Papillon Canister Set, Porcelain by Rosalinde
review_body: I really love my Papillon canister set. The only thing I would change about it is the coloring of the Papillons. They are a bit too light. I would have liked them better if they had been darker in color. The color is a grayish and I would have preferred black so it would show up better. Otherwise, I am very pleased with the set.

product_title: Neater Feeder Deluxe Dog (All Sizes) - The Mess Proof Elevated Bowls No Slip Non Tip Double Diner Stainless Steel Food Dish with Stand
review_body: We have a mix of a White German Shepherd and Lab. When he would drink, water would fly all over the place. this was starting to ruin the bottom of the our cabinets. Since we purchased the Needer Feeder no water has ever hit the floor again. I would recommend this product to anyone with a dogs that slops water on the floor.

product_title: Oster Professional Pet Grooming Undercoat Rake, 18 Teeth Medium/Fine
review_body: I ordered this as last resort for grooming our domestic long-haired cat.  This is one tool that Sable tolerates; I groom while she grazes on her cat-grass and purrs.  This tool removes some of the undercoat so there are fewer \\"knots\\" in her fur which makes everyone happy.

product_title: Coleman Bandit Dog Toy (Small)
review_body: My Cavalier puppy likes to play with this, even though it's bigger than he is. But, when he accidentally \\"squeaks\\" the body, he freaks out, because it's a weird groaning sound rather than a squeak. The tail squeaks like normal, though, so he likes that. Overall, I wouldn't buy it again, but he still plays with it until he accidentally gets the groan.

product_title: 2-Pack PetSafe Basic Bark Control Collar
review_body: We had great hopes for this collar for our constantly barking boxer.  It did not work at all!  The battery is fine, as we can rub it against a VERY rough surface and it will beep and work but it does not respond to our dog's bark at all.  It is no where near sensitive enough.  Given the other reviews, I think it must be defective and we are contacting the company for a replacement.

product_title: Aquarium Pharmaceuticals PimaFix 16oz
review_body: I would give this product more than 5 stars if I could!! I have saved my fish, especially my Bushy Nose Pleco, so many times with this medication. It works great alone & even better in combination WITH MelaFix! When using both at the same time it treats a WIDE range of diseases. I love that it doesn't change the color of the water or stain my tank (just makes a lot of foam bubbles at the top of the water), it doesn't mess with your biological filter, & is all natural which is really important for my Pleco/algae eater, you can't give them just any type of medication because they have no scales. The 16oz. bottle goes a long way too...you can definitely get 2-3 weeks worth of treatments out of it. I usually put a cap full in my tank when adding new fish (which isn't often). I do not to use it too often so that my fish do not become immune to it.

product_title: Solvit PupSTEP Plus Pet Stairs
review_body: Our 6 year old Cavalier (19 lbs.) had no problem learning to use the steps and now uses them regularly without hesitation.  They are a bit noisy and do tend to slowely slide away from the bed.  So it does need to be checked and realigned but I would definitely make the purchase again.  The price is right for the product.

product_title: Hartz Oinkies Pig skin Twists with Chicken, 3-Inch, 15-Pack
review_body: My three dogs love these. I usually give each of them one when our puppy displays the need to chew. He is teething and these have been great!! It also occupies the three of them for a long while as well as calming them down. They love all of the flavors!

product_title: SportDOG Rechargeable Bark Control Collar
review_body: The dog collar works well. Significantly decreased my puppy's barking without any adverse reactions. Product was shipped quickly. I'm satisfied with this purchase and would recommend it to someone with a dog that doesn't respond to other anti-barking methods.

product_title: Invisible Fence Compatible R21, R22, R51 and Microlite Dog Collar Battery
review_body: I was very impressed with the quick response to my purchase.  I got an email confirmation from Amazon and another one from the vendor.  The batteries arrived right away!  Very helpful for my last-minute inventory style!!

product_title: LAZY PET Kitty Cat Window Perch
review_headline: A taste of the great outdoors
review_body: Many people like myself have indoor cats, but that doesn't mean that the cat can't enjoy at least the feeling of the great outdoors.  This perch is well made and, apparently, very comfortable, as \\"His Majesty\\" goes to it on a regular basis so that he can keep track of all the birds and squirrels in the neighborhood and let them know what he thinks of them being on his property.  One of the nicest features of this perch is that it can be easily moved from window to window and leaves no marks to indicate where it has been.

product_title: K&H Manufacturing Extreme Weather Kitty Pad Black 12.5" x 18.5" 40W
review_body: Our \\"garage cat\\" absolutely loves the warmth this pad provides. She prefers not to be in the house where it is warm, so this was an alternative and I am delighted with her response. No more worries about her being cold!

product_title: Stewart Freeze Dried Treats for Dogs
review_headline: Great liver treats-extra benefits for white dogs
review_body: These treats are 100% beef liver--nothing else. You can't ask for anything healthier than that! Just don't overfeed them. They're treats, not food. Remember that. Your dog would prefer you forget that distinction, because he will love them that much. If you have a small white dog you are probably familiar with the red eye stains. Most people don't know that adding liver to their diet every day will get rid of that ugly stain. Don't exceed the recommended amount. The stain that's already there won't go away, it will have to grow out and be trimmed away by your groomer. But in a few weeks you should notice that white hair is growing in at the base of the old stains.

product_title: Pet Tag Classic No Bark Collar, Red, Small.
review_body: It did nothing at all.. it vibrated a little bit but my dog did not stop barking

product_title: Lafeber's Premium Daily Diet Pellets for Cockatiels
review_body: my cockatiels got major diarrhea from this. it seems to work best mixed half with birdseed.

product_title: Friskies Dental Diet for Cats
review_body: The only dried food my cat will eat, and she needs something like this to control the plaque she gets when eating her favorite food, wet cat food.  What the ____ is Purina thinking by stopping producing it?!!!!  Friskies Dental Diet has a rather mild odor whereas any other dry food designed for dental health (large kibble) smells more strongly (even rank!) than wet cat food ever smells.  I'm sure that's a large part of my cat's reluctance to even taste other dry foods.

product_title: KONG Refillable Catnip Cat Toy
review_body: I only bought this because I saw it on slickdeals and it was $3 at the time.  I really didn't even know what it was, but I figured it would be something for the cats to play with.  When it arrived I wasn't that impressed by it, but I turned it over to the kitties and let them go at it.  Orwell could care less about it, but it quickly became Angus' favorite toy.  He loves this thing and plays with it everyday.  Loves to toss it in the air and bat it around!  Good mouser practice!

product_title: Forever Litter Tray Highest Quality ScoopFree Reusable Tray Since 2005. Best Design, Durability and Ease of Use From the Original Innovators - ON SALE!
review_headline: Forever Litter Tray replacement  for Disposable Cartridges
review_body: Got the original with the tray pieces glued together. It began to fall apart. Got this molded single piece and liked it so much, we got a second one as a substitute and alternate between the two.

product_title: Simple Solution Washable Reusable Female Dog Diapers
review_headline: We are very happy with our washable doggie diaper
review_body: Our lab mix is 13 and began to have accidents in the house.  She was getting up 4 or more times a night and if we didn't hear her she would pee in our living room.  Since we got the washable diaper, we have no accidents and she actually has begun to get back on her old schedule which she was off of for over a month.  We use absorbent pads in the diaper which allows us to not have to wash the diaper as much.  We have had such good results, we purchased a second to have on hand if needed.

product_title: R/C Vibrating Training Collar - Black
review_headline: Supplyer Great responce, Manufacture very Poor
review_body: Supplier was great quick responces and helpful. Product was defective , but Manufacture failed to answer repeated phone messages.  Have gone to different manufacture, would think twice about Pet Zip for anything.

product_title: FURminator Large Yellow deShedding Tool with 4-Inch Edge
review_body: It is rough and I can't say the dogs like it like a normal brush but it definitely takes the fur off.

product_title: K&H Cool Bed III Cooling Dog Bed
review_body: I have two small dogs that share the medium size one.  We live in So. California and have a covered tile patio and it can get warm at times and this seems to keep them from panting excessively on really hot days. It is a little difficult to handle tho if you have to move it once it is filled with water.

product_title: Four Paws Magic Coat Love Glove, Cat Brush Glove
review_body:
This is a well made product with a soft rubberized pad on the palm and another smaller one on the thumb. There are 100+ or so small 1/4 inch nubs sticking out of these pads. The glove itself is a sturdy flexible nylon mesh material. There is a elastic wrist band with a adjustable velcro strap. I have a fairly large hand and the glove is a perfect fit. If you have a smaller hand the slack can be taken up by the velcro strap. Check out my photos under Customer Images on the product page.

I use this in tandem with my [[ASIN:B0002Y1RBU Cat Zoom Groom - Assorted Colors]] brush. The Cat Zoom seems to work better getting the deep down hair out. And this one cleans up after that brush and gets most of the loose hair that's left.

This glove will clean up fairly easy if there is a lot of hair on it. All you have to do is start peeling one end, and the rest will peel off in one sheet of hair. A bit harder if there is only a small amount of hair on the glove. It can be washed off with a hose outside, that worked for me.

Forgot to mention, Kitty loves it. He even comes back for seconds which is unusual for him. Our new little girl shelter kitten \\"Baby\\" loves it also.

product_title: Oster Professional Nail Grinder Kit (Corded)
review_body: The Oster nail grinder is great.  We use it for our dog's nails and it does a fabulous job.  Worth the money.

product_title: ROYAL CANIN FELINE HEALTH NUTRITION Indoor Adult dry cat food
review_headline: Newest Type Dry Food for Persian Cats
review_body: I have recently gotten a Persian Cat from a Breeder.  She is 6 yrs. old and I noticed she was not eating well.  She was skin and bones when I got her. They indeed have an eating problem in picking up the dry food.     Cat food manufacturers are now selling food that is made specifically for Persians.  This food is flatter & almond shaped and has a texture that is easier for Persians to eat. [[ASIN:B000HALT80 Royal Canin Dry Cat Food, Indoor Mature 27 Formula, 5.5-Pound Bag]] [[ASIN:B00068K5UQ Royal Canin Dry Cat Food, Indoor Adult 27 Formula, 15-Pound Bag]][[ASIN:B0010748DM Royal Canin Dry Cat Food, Indoor Light 40 Formula, 15-Pound Bag]]  Royal Canin is one of these manufacturers. I'm grateful!    It has made all the difference in her eating habits now.  What a difference.  Amazon is the only place I have found it for the least amount of money.  Charli

product_title: Sentry Natural Defense Flea & Tick Spray For Cats & Kittens
review_body: **********EXTREMELY IMPORTANT**************    THIS PRODUCT'S MAIN INGREDIENT IS PEPPERMINT OIL.    THE ASPCA WARNS THAT PEPPERMINT IS POISONOUS TO CATS     **********EXTREMELY IMPORTANT**************    From the ASPCA's web site: (google ASPCA and peppermint for source - Amazon does not allow hyperlinks)    \\"If ingested, the peppermint plant and its oil could indeed potentially cause harm to your cat. Cats are especially sensitive to peppermint oil, and effects such as gastrointestinal upset, central nervous system depression and even liver damage could occur if ingested in significant quantities. I am not talking some minor irritation.  I am simply floored that the manufacturer could be this stupid to put something like this on the market.

product_title: Pet Scale
review_body: We bought this scale after adopting a Tuxedo cat named Petey from the Humane Society. Because Petey lost his front left leg because of dog attack, it was essential that we maintain his weight.     The scale is manual and basically does it job. My only complaint is that it needs frequent recalibration zeroing out. The manufacturer does point out that there can be a 4oz variance in the readings so I give them credit for honesty.    I understand from my doctor's nurse that their electronic scales get out of wack by as much as 6 pounds and they have a technician recalibrate them every six months so I guess it's better to have the ability to do it oneself.

product_title: Havahart Wireless Radial Shaped Dog Fence System
review_body:
We live out in a rural neighborhood, with about 3/4 of an acre. Fencing the whole property would be very expensive, not to mention labor-intensive and not-so-attractive. My 14 year-old and my husband had this thing up and running in less than an hour, and I hung the center unit in the laundry room one one existing nail that was already there for a picture. Nothing to install:))) The hardest thing to do was put in the battery and put it on the dog! We have two dogs, but the newest one, an unaltered stray, has been wandering into our neighbor's garage and eating the cat food! We really just didn't want him going over there or across to the neighbor's yard to potty, and this did the trick. We did have to put on the prongs for long-haired dogs (Baxter is probably a medium-hair) and turn it up to high, but after a few times of associating the beep with the buzz, he learned not to even approach the flagged area (we just flagged the area around the driveway and the path toward our neighbor's house). We also flagged the area that leads from our backyard to a pasture where I walk for exercise. When I walk, I take the collar off of Baxter and pat my leg and tell him to come on and he trusts me and comes with me. The collar is made out of rubber/plastic material very similar to a sports watch and is easy to take on and off. There are lots of holes and lots of length, an it looks like it would fit a variety of sizes, though if your dog is very large or very small, I advise measuring and perhaps calling the company for verification. I had the same problem with not screwing the battery lid on tightly and lost one of the batteries:( so don't make the same mistake I did. I'm not sure how successful this would be for an extremely willful dog of large size, but for our medium-sized, easy going Corgi mix, it has been a lifesaver!

In summary:

Nearly no assembly or installation required. Can you install a battery in a flashlight? Yep? Then you're good. (Yay! No digging or wiring!)

Unobstrusive base-unit was easy to place on the wall, and seems to send a fine signal out of our brick home.

The collar is kind of bulky around the receiving unit, but doesn't seem to bother our dog, and it is easy-on, easy-off.

The shock is a sufficient with the associated tone to teach the dog the perimeter quickly.

No way you'll need 14 days to teach your dog the perimeter. Ours was golden in less than one day.

Only con: Seems like the battery caps could be a little better marked, or designed, but I know better now to double check the battery cap.

UPDATE 2/7/2011: So, Baxter has since shimmied out of the collar somewhere and I can't find it anywhere! So, we still have the transmitter unit, but no receiver collar, and for $150 per collar, I doubt we will be replacing it.ging or wiring!) review_body: This muzzle is good, but my dog's nose is too long and rubs against the end of it. He also has a roman nose, and his nose rubs against the top of it. product_title: Allerpet Cat Dander Remover, 12 oz
review_headline: Love it - Here's how to make application easier for your cat
review_body:
This product really works - hallelujah!

To apply it, I pour a few tablespoons of it into a pyrex dish, and microwave it for maybe 10 seconds, until quite warm. I then dip a washcloth into it, which cools it a bit more. The cloth is wet but not dripping.

When I rub it on my cat (after getting a good grip on the scruff of his neck), he's not aware of being damp at first, because a very warm wet cloth doesn't make him feel cold during the initial contact. Because my applying it this way is much less unpleasant for him, it's much less unpleasant for me!

product_title: BLUE Life Protection Formula Adult Dry Dog Food
review_body: My four Great Pyrenees require a smaller amount of this food twice a day.  They seem to enjoy it.

product_title: Guardian Gear Pet Rain Pet Jacket - Blue
review_body: This is super cute! Its a lot nicer than I expected it to be. I got the blue with the gray stripe and it is cute! Ordered this as a gift for Christmas, so I have no clue how the sizing is, but it looks about right, so we'll see! But I highly rate this!

product_title: GlycoFlex 3 Hip and Joint Support for Dogs, 120 Chewable Tablets
review_body:
I have a 120 pound Malamute, 8 years old. Had occasional limping problems.

We had him on Trader Joe's glucosamine tablets for dogs, but ran out while he was staying at the kennel. Our fault. But his limp was hugely noticeable when we returned from our trip and picked him up from the kennel - which caused us to freak out and buy the hugely popular Glyco-Flex III Stage III. We thought that giving him something super powerful would be better for him.

The package says that it should start working 4-6 weeks. We gave him the recommended dose according to his size. After the 2nd week he got worse. 3rd week he was lame a couple of days. He went into the lake as he usually does but could not pull himself out. We freaked some more but thought that he just needed to get the glyco flex in his system properly to work. But on the exact day that marked week 4, we gave up. He was worse off than when he was not taking anything.

We put him back on the trader joe's glucosamine, and he's gotten muuuuch better. In fact, we gave him a big dose to help offset the Glyco-Flex damage, and he no longer limps. It took about a week when he started playing and jumping and chasing the ball. He had not done that in quite some time.

I don't doubt at all that Glyco-Flex helps other dogs. But for my dog in particular, it was killing him. Thank god we had the sense to not make him go through week 5 and 6 of torture.

product_title: Omega Paw Self-Cleaning Litter Box, Green and Beige
review_body:
I have had this for almost a year now and I love it.
It takes all the hassle out of changing the cat box and gives purpose to all the plastic Kroger bags I have around my house. I use kroger brand clumping cat litter and their deodorizer and have no problems with it.

product_title: Marshall Pet Products Hide-N-Sleep Alligator Ferret Hideaway
review_body: See latest update on 09/10/2014 for justification of one star.     My ferret absolutely loves this alligator.  After a minute or two investigating the outside, she climbed in and I've barely seen her since.  After waiting for almost 20 minutes for her to come out, I took a peek and she was curled up ready to go to sleep.  When I awoke in the morning, I came downstairs to see that she had come out, but only to pull her toys and food bowl right next to the mouth so she can eat and play without having to come out!  I would highly recommend this item to anyone with a ferret.    UPDATE: 09/01/2010 - To this day, the alligator remains my ferret's favorite bed / toy.  Although she has 3 other beds to choose from, most mornings I find her sleeping in the alligator.  And after the addition of a second ferret to my family, I was very surprised to see that not only do they both fit inside, they both choose to sleep in it together.  It's very durable despite them using it as a toy in addition to a bed, I can't find a single stitch that has come loose, including the bell inside.    UPDATE: 06/20/2012 - After using up the last of my previous order, I re-ordered more of these alligators.  Unfortunately, the quality has dropped significantly.  The shell of the alligator is much thinner than with previous ones, and there is no longer a bell inside.  The shell is so thin that the alligator will collapse on itself from being folded in the packaging for so long, and I usually find it laying on it's side.  I doubt I will be ordering any more of these as there are many other alternatives that are not so cheap.  Lowering my rating from a 5 to a 3.     UPDATE: 09/10/2014 - Despite my displeasure with the degrading quality of this item in my last update, I decided to buy more since my ferrets absolutely love these.  However, this was a big mistake.  I wouldn't have thought it was possible, but the quality of these has gotten even worse, and I would advise anyone considering these to stay away.  The shell, although declining in quality for a while, was at least a single layer of fabric.  This is no longer the case.  There is an outer shell and a very thin inner shell.  The problem is that the inner shell is not properly secured to the outer one, allow it to be completely turned inside out.  In less than a minute, my ferrets turn it inside out, sometimes getting stuck in the fabric.  Even without getting stuck, the alligator once turned inside out is completely useless.  I have no confidence that they won't someday get stuck when I'm not there, and have decided to get rid of the alligators.  It's very upsetting that a company would take such a great product and turn it into junk, and I'm now stuck trying to find a suitable replacement.

product_title: Rechargeable remote dog training shock and vibration collar for 2 dogs
review_body:
Simple to use, cheap. Works pretty well for our 2 shih tzus. My issues are minor:
- No separate vibrate buttons (ie it vibrates both collars)
- It's great that it's rechargeable (we were paying $$$ for the proprietary batteries for the previous collar) but for our dogs, it lasts a little less than a week (with us removing the collars at night too to preserve the power)(the collars are motion sensitive)
- Doesn't fit small dogs well. Our dogs are 13 lbs. I had to trim the collar and resew the buckle

Overall we're pretty happy with this.

product_title: Flourite Black Sand, 7 kg / 15.4 lbs
review_body: This product is excellent, and good for plants that root in the substrate. The packaging was satisfactory, and once finished cleaning it, it looks amazing.    Beware, though the product directions are very misleading. My tank was a cloudy mess after adding this, and a quick google search of this product showed me my folly. This is by the far the dustiest of sand substrates out there for aquariums.    I took the advice of said website, I put my entire bag in a pillowcase, ran the hose through it for about 30 minutes until the water was clear, and now it looks great.    If you live in a small apartment or don't have access to a workspace, beware this can get messy, id select a different substrate.

product_title: Ceva Sante Animale Senilife (30 Caps)
review_body: Senilife has made my 17 year old westie more aware of his surroundings.  We have had an issue of him getting lost in the yard and house.  But after having him on Senilife for about 6 weeks he started to become more aware and started playing with his girlfriend stuffed dog some of which he hadn't done in 6 months.  This product has been a good alternative to the expensive precription meds that were recommend.

product_title: Synergy Anti-Allergen Mousse For Cats & Kittens
review_body: My boyfriend bought this for me when we adopted our cat. She is a long haired 3 year old cat who sheds constantly and has ALOT of Dandruff. This mousse made her smell better, made her coat shiny, and seemed to get a handle on the dander. My cat does NOT like being wet at all so she has run off to hide while I've been working the mousse into her coat, which will cause the mousse to dry thickly. A quick brushing once she comes out of hiding has fixed that problem, though. I think the trick is to only use a pump or too and distribute it evenly.

product_title: PetSafe Healthy Pet Water Station, Dog and Cat Water System with Stainless Steel Bowl, Medium, 128 oz.
review_body: While the whole concept of this product is wonderful, the bowl is very small.  Every time my dogs drank out of this, I had a puddle of water on the floor.  This product is know outside in my back yard because it is the only place that it doesn't matter if the water is on the floor.  I wouldn't recommend this product unless you have a very tiny dog that's whole head can stay over a 4-5\\" diameter bowl.

product_title: Litter Robot LRII Automatic Self-Cleaning Litter Box
review_body: My husband bought this as a Christmas gift for me almost 2 years ago.  We LOVE it!  It has saved a lot of money on cat litter and paid for itself plus you don't have to scoop the litter anymore.  We have 4 cats and I only have to worry about it every 2 days!  Just open the drawer, tie the bag off & put a new one in then shut the door & add a little more litter to the machine.  A quick update, after 3+ years of 4 cats using our box the motor died.  We emailed customer service & had a call back within 12 hrs (we sent it late at night & they called at lunchtime the next day), they tried to help troubleshoot the problem but a dead motor is a dead motor.  We love ours so much we are ordering a new one!

product_title: Virbac Keratolux Shampoo 16 oz
review_headline: Dont pay high prices from your vet
review_body: My girlfriends dog had a sever break out and we were given this product by her vet. It was half the size and 2.5 times more in price. I google the product and found it here on amazon, the bottle was twice the size and only a fraction of the price. I was upset with our vet because of the price lol. But Im very pleased with this product and the price.

product_title: Petmate 25-Inch Burrow Bed, Navy Blue
review_body: I was excited to find this bed. My Westie (12lbs) loves to sleep under the covers and burrow. The quality was very good but the fabric on top was too small. He could not burrow in the bed because the fabric wouldn't even cover his head. I returned the item disappointed.

product_title: Small 24" Bagel Donut Dog Cat Pet Bed - Black Sherpa
review_body: My 9 lb puppy loves this bed.  Full grown he will be about 20 lbs and the bed will still fit him perfectly as there is some extra room now.  From the moment it came out of the box he has been laying in it! I love it! The inside lining is super soft and the base around seems pretty sturdy!

product_title: Moody Pet Fling-Ama-String Cat Toy
review_body: Batteries go dead in about 15 minutes of play time..It takes 3 AA.. Cats do love it, but I'm going broke buying batteries for the thing. The toy needs a better or stronger battery possible 9 volt.. when this breaks I will not buy another. Unfortunate for the cats since they do love it. The string is frayed also.. It gets stuck inside of the machine and quits working.. I have to pull it out and it starts again.

product_title: Catit Fresh & Clear Small Drinking Fountain
review_body: Our cats LOVE this drinking fountain, plus it is much easier to clean than the previous fountain we had.  Great product, great price!

product_title: Molly and Friends Three-Tier Scratching Post Furniture
review_headline: Very well made and loved by my cats!
review_body: This cat tree is so sturdy that even my dog sized cats can't tip it over! It's pricey but it's still a bargain. So few things are made to last these days. I can definitely appreciate the nice craftsmanship of this piece. The cat tunnel on the 2nd tier is thick, sturdy, and immovable! Nothing wobbles on this unit! It came already put together. That is a definite plus! It is a big cat tree, though. 24\\" x 24\\" and 74lbs is bigger than you think!

product_title: AlphaTRAK 2 Test Strips
review_body: This item that we ordered at amazon has been a blessing. We ordered the item for our diabetic dog and it helps us to keep a record of her glucose levels so that we know if we need to change the amount of insulin that we give to her.It also was the best price.  Thanks amazon.com

product_title: Solvit Front Seat Net Pet Barrier
review_body: We use this for a long distance trip last weekend, our dog would try to look  around the sides of it, but never tried to get over the seats. This was used  in the cargo area of a suv (third row seating area) to keep him from the back  seats where our kids sit. Really happy with this barrier, and glad I didn't  spend anymore money on something else. Also used it to go to doggie day-care  this week without any issues.

product_title: Paw Naturaw Organic Beef Marrow Bones for Dogs, 24-Ounce Bags (Pack of 6)
review_body: Thank you Amazon and Paw Naturaw!  I used to give my dogs bully sticks, and thought they loved them more than anything.  Now that I am giving them Paw Naturaw bones, they ignore their bully sticks.  Their antics over their bones keep me laughing.  One day one of my dogs couldn't drop his bone even though he had to also be a good guard dog - he barked with the bone in his mouth - so funny!  Those bones are definitely like candy to a child.  My dogs are so happy and healthy thanks to Paw Naturaw!  Thank you!

product_title: FURminator deShedding Tool for Cats, 1.75-Inch Edge
review_body:
Based on the description of the product and other reviews here, I expected something that (a) wouldn't leave bleeding furrows in my arm if I tried it on myself and (b) would actually work on my cat.

I read the very meager instructions very carefully and did my best to follow them, yet the thing got stuck in my cat's fur almost immediately. That upset her quite a bit and I didn't see her again for over a half hour. I was curious if it was as comfortable to her as described, so I tried it on my own forearm (as described in something I read about it, here or elsewhere). It turned out that the steel tips are VERY sharp, so much so that I accidentally cut myself with it on my first attempt. When I manage to scrape it along without actually cutting my skin it still hurt, both due to the sharp metal and my arm hairs getting caught in the teeth and pulled out by the roots instead of being cut as they should have been.

So, this thing might be great for pets with very tough skins (rhinos, elephants, water buffalo, etc.) for for a little kitty cat? No way.

I considered trying to return it but there were a few reasons why I didn't bother: (1) The normal product return shipping label that is ALWAYS on Amazon receipts had been removed prior to shipping. (2) The packaging it was shipped in was just a folded sheet of cardboard taped shut that was destroyed during opening. (3) Because I'm a Prime member, it was supposed to be shipped 2nd day, but it was shipped USPS Prime which ended up taking nine days which resulted in Amazon giving me a refund (because Amazon is great!) when I contacted them about it after eight days (and they didn't take it back when I told them it arrived the next day, either!) So, in the end it cost me nothing to discover that this didn't work and toss it in the trash.

FWIW, I bought this from Online Megastore through Amazon, in case that isn't obvious.

product_title: Petmate 22501 LitterLocker Plus with Microban, White/Planet Blue
review_body: My husband and I recently moved from a large house to a small two bedroom apartment..with THREE CATS!!  I was very concerned about keeping up with the smell and having to run to the trash every day, maybe twice in one day, but then a friend told me about LITTERLOCKER.  It sounded like a good idea and I bought one and boy, am I glad I did!! I LOVE THIS PODUCT and tell everyone with even one cat how terrific it is.  I have used only one refill in the month since I have been here and I throw out the old smelly litter ONCE a week!! That is with THREE CATS..ONCE a week!!!  I think this is the best product I have ever bought and I am so glad I listened to my friend VIcki!!  Buy one, you will not be sorry!!

product_title: Marineland 75 Watt Visi-Therm Stealth Submersible Heater
review_body: Great heather, only annoying thing, the led on top is way to bright, I had to place it so that the aquarium lid covers it, or it will keep me up at night, probably annoys my nocturnal aquarium dwellers as well. Oh and its 100% Oscar proof

product_title: Nothing Like It Designs Scent-Attract Fire Hydrant
review_body: I received the product in a rather quick amount of time.  It took a bit for the pups to realize what it was but so far it is working very well...my furniture appreciates that too.

product_title: PetSafe Deluxe Little Dog Trainer, PDT00-10867
review_headline: DON'T BUY THIS, you'll spend a fortune on batteries
review_body: The device itself works fine, but PetSafe have locked you into buying only their batteries, which are way overpriced.    Don't be a sucker!

product_title: Hartz H-Chew O Large, Colors Vary
review_headline: Dog's favorite toy -- loves more than food/water/parents
review_body: If you want your dog to be happy, buy this toy. He loves it more than most golden retreivers love those green tennis balls. he would rather play with this toy (with us, his parents -- or anyone) more than sleep, eat, drink water, or go potty. he loves it. it is indestructibe. I think he likes it because when he chews on it, it makes a squishy dirty noise, which canines love. I am a dentist and i highly recommend this toy for all your pets dental needs.

product_title: petLINENS Dog Bed Cover - Animal Print Slipcover, Leopard: 32"x6" Round Cover
review_body: I just adore these dog bed covers, they are made to last and look stylish too! I have 6 large coonhounds that snuggle in these dog beds (I have two) and they are the favorite of all the dog beds I have in the house. I have them filled with styro beads and they love that. The covers have not lost their luster and I am planning on buying more! Claudia in Virginia

product_title: Virbac C.E.T. VeggieDent Dental Chews
review_body: We are proud owners of two Dachshunds. They love these treats! We were first introduced to these CET VeggieDents by our Veterinarian when we got our puppies. He had us come in for an appointment he calls a 'puppy rap' to give you some dos and don'ts, training tips, and goody bags. These treats were in the goody bags, and the dogs have been hooked ever since. Now almost one year old our babies still love to receive these. By giving them plenty of toys and dog chews we have not had any problem with them wood remodeling (our previous Dachshund did this), shoe chewing, or eating things they aren't supposed to. These dog treats are good for our dogs, good for their teeth, and good for our home!

product_title: Designer Pet Saver Life Jacket, X-Small (Colors Vary)
review_body: Great Product! - I have a 9 lbs min pin that doesn't love the water.  He has a broad chest and slim back end.  This life jacket worked great.  It is adjustable in many ways and is able to get a good fit.  He was OK with wearing it in the boat and in the water.  After testing it out, I was able to relax in the boat like a human and with the other humans.  This is a must have for boaters.

product_title: Lucky Dog Uptown Welded Wire Kennel
review_body: This must be the best DIY assembly kennel around (I paid $199 each from Petsmart and had them ship two of them to me.) They can be configured in many ways - the gates work smoothly and even the cover tarp is cut and sewn to fit.  Whoever designed this kennel deserves an award. It is well thought out, very easy to assemble and of excellent quality.  If I had more room, I'd buy another one!

product_title: PetSafe Heated Wellness Sleeper
review_body: I bought three for our 10 year old cats.  They LOVE them.  These are bigger than our last ones so our 20lb cats fit better, we bought the medium.  Nice and soft for them.  They stay in them most of the day and night.  Thanks for a great product.

product_title: SynFlex Pet Liquid Glucosamine - Joint & Cartilage Protection
review_body: I purchased this for my cat.  The instructions state to give an animal her size 2 ounces.  This is too much for my cat.  I tried cutting it down to 1 ounce twice a day.  One ounce is too much for my cat.  She can not handle that much at one sitting.  I wish I could find a more concentrated formula to see if glucosamine will help.

product_title: Multivet Slimcat Cat Toy Ball Feeder  (Green)
review_body: My vet recommended this as part of a weight-loss program for my overweight kitty. I fill it with 1/4 cup of dry food, and give it to my cat. It's taken him a few feedings to get used to this idea and he still looks at me with a \\"Ha ha, very funny\\" when I put the ball down but once I walk away he starts working on it.    I like it because:   1) it helps him eat slower. as a diabetic cat on a weight controlled diet, he is usually really hungry around feeding time and normally scarfs his food down so quickly i worry about him choking. now he takes about 15-20 min to eat, which is great  2) it's fun to watch him :)  3) he does seem happier, and i am glad that i've found something that he can interact with more  4) it has adjustable hole sizes. good for transitioning. i started with the big openings, and intend to move to the very small openings within a week.    minor downsides:  1) is that I used to feed him a mix of wet/dry food, and this ball recommends only using dry food. My cat doesn't seem to mind the switch too much but I doubt it's like that for every cat.  2) sometimes he leaves dry food on the ground. my solution is to put him in a closed room when being fed.

product_title: Kittywalk T-Connect Unit
review_headline: Great if it's not kept under the sun
review_body: I had the kittywalk outside and the sun destroyed it within a few months. I bought it for my 2 cats so they could spend some time outside but it's definitely not weather proof. They should change the material so it lasts longer than a few months after all I spent $250 on the whole thing. Not worth it!

product_title: FURminator Medium Yellow Deshedding Tool with 2-2/3-Inch EdgeFURminator deShedding Tool
review_body: I have a medium and use it on my 40 lb dog and 2 cats. It certainly removes a lot of hair. However it is very sharp and sometimes pulls at my dogs long hair. She doesn't like it much. But it does the job.

product_title: Joint MAX Liquid For Cats
review_body: i got this becasue i can't use the sprinkle on food type since have more than one cat...and the cat that i got this for is not really that bad...so while it seems he is a bit more mobile since i started giving him this, i have no miracle stories to tell...still it seem like a decent product and the seller was great...

product_title: Meow Mix Market Select Variety Pack, 2.75-Ounce Cups (Pack of 48)
review_body: I love the easy to serve cup it comes in. You just pour it into the bowl and and it's not too much so you're not wasting any food. It's one of the better cat foods on the market.

product_title: NOZTONOZ Sof-Krate Indoor/Outdoor Pet Home
review_body: My puppy eat the zipper on my first one that i got at a local store. I wes able to get this one from Amazon for just a little more then the price of a cover.

product_title: Pet Supply Imports - Kitty Connector Tee
review_headline: My cats and I are highly impressed
review_body:
I originally purchased two of the [[ASIN:B00106ZZZ8 PETCO Blue & White Kitty Crinkle Tunnel]]s for my cats and wanted to be able to create a more elaborate tunnel structure for them so I decided to buy two of these connector tees and four matching tunnels, see ([[ASIN:B000EFMLBW Pet Supply Imports - Kitty Play Tunnel]]), instead.

They absolutely love this because they can enter the tee from three angles and explore different rooms of the house depending on where you locate the connector(s).

The connector tee is collapsible, lined, sturdy, has a larger circumferene to accommodate fat cats, and ties together nicely with other connector tees or additional tunnels to make elaborate structures for my cats. My four cats take turns sleeping and playing in the two connector tees and four tunnels I bought them.

This tee(s) with the associated tunnel(s) is the absolute best in my opinion and I certainly feel it was worth the extra money. In total I purchased two connector tees and four tunnels; however, you can tie as many of the tees or tunnels to each other as you want in various configurations to give your cats a fun-filled time.

product_title: RoundHeated 15" Cat Bed
review_body: I received a product that was not the same as what I ordered. The label on the package was what I ordered, but the item inside was different. When I contacted the company, they said they were sending a truck to pick it up and would send me the proper item immediately. I waited 2 more weeks for them to pick up the item and deliver the new one, and they never arrived. So I called again, and was told that the item listed on the internet was discontinued, so if I wanted to return the item I received, to send it back. I decided to try the item they sent, and found that the heater was constantly on. It seems to heat up the floor underneath the item more than inside the bed itself. I thought it was going to be activated by the cat lying in the bed, so only would be on if the cat was in it. When I contacted the company again to return it, they said I could return it within 4 weeks of purchase. Since I waited for the new item for so long, the 4 weeks have long passed. So I feel I am stuck with something I don't like. I would never buy from that company again, as I feel it was a bait-and-switch.

product_title: KONG Air Dog Squeaker Dog Toy
review_headline: A little sturdier and it would be perfect
review_body: My 8 month old lab is a Houdini with toys. He manages to rip apart things that I didn't know could be ripped up. On this toy, he managed to tear the tennis ball material from the bone. It's too bad, because he loved carrying it around and making it squeak. It lasted two days. If I used it exclusively as a fetch toy, it probably would have lasted a lot longer, but the pup just seemed to love it so much, I let him carry it to the car after playing and he ripped it up on the ride home. It's a good sized toy, larger than I expected. And it is sort of tough, but definitely not indestructible due to the tennis ball fabric. Sadly, I would not recommend leaving your dog alone with this toy, even though he'll probably love it.

product_title: PetSafe Drinkwell Platinum Pet Fountain
review_body: I would highly recommend this product for anyone with multiple pets.  I have two cats, a small dog, and a medium sized dog, and they all love drinking out of this fountain.  Before purchasing this, I was refilling water bowls every morning and throughout the day, and now it is so easy to just have one.  With the large tank, I refill the tank maybe once a day, and I can leave the cats for 4 days and not worry about them running out of clean water.  The product does require regular, routine cleaning, I definitely recommend taking the motor apart every week and cleaning it out with the rest of the fountain.  The first time cleaning was a bit tricky, but the instructions and illustrations were great, once you get the hang of it, it is really, really easy.  If you do not want to have to take it apart and clean it every week to make sure it is safe, do not buy this product.

product_title: Cetacea Soft Martingale Collar with Quick Release
review_body: I purchased this item for my 9 week old Shiba Inu. It is a great martingale, I absolutely love it as it gives me control of my Shiba and he responds well to it. I leave it on him and it has not been a problem. I will purchase the next size once he grows out of this one.

product_title: PetSafe Drinkwell Platinum Pet Fountain
review_headline: Gets dirty fast, hard to clean
review_body: Our cat and basset hound both love the fountain.  The wife and I don't however as it gets dirty quickly and is a pain to clean.  The filter and filtering gate do a poor job of collecting the countless crumbs from dinner that the basset hound leaves when she gets her after dinner drink.  I realize this could just be a factor of our particular dog, so take my criticism with that in mind.  In a matter of days the main spill reservoir's bottom is covered in food fragments.  To clean the unit, you have to pick it up and hope to not spill too much water on your way to the sink as you tear the whole contraption apart to clean out all the little crevices that collect grime.  Then when you mop the mess you made, you get to refill it, and try to get the wimpy pump primed so it will flow. Every week when I clean it, I get more upset at it.

product_title: FURminator deShedding Tool for Cats, 1.75-Inch Edge
review_body: I had first purchased this to groom a long-haired cat with matted fur and learned it was no good for de-matting.   I did find it was great for removing pet hair from upholstered furniture, however, so that was its main purpose until yesterday when we adopted a Siamese-mix kitty.  She probably hadn't been brushed in years and was shedding so badly that I had to change clothes three times in one day because I was so covered in cat hair.  I got out the FURminator and started stroking her gently with it.  I can't believe how much dead hair it removed.  It is very easy to let the tool bite too deeply into the coat and the kitty doesn't like that, but as long as I kept a gentle touch along the top of the hair, she thought she was being petted and I got out plenty of loose fur.  After just the first session, yielding two sizeable handfulls of hair, her coat went from feeling coarse to nice and soft.      As badly as she needed care, I think it will probably take many daily FURminator sessions to get all of the loose hair, but there is a remarkable difference already.  One note, I did see the video the company puts out and they were using the tool far more aggressively than I would recommend.  In my situation, at least, the key is being gentle and not letting it bite so deeply into the coat that you feel a resistance when pulling it.  This may involve more brushing sessions, but it won't upset the animal and will make things easier in the long run.  For the animal that does not like brushing, I can't see where they would like this any better than a regular brush, but for the animal that will tolerate it, it really does a great job.

product_title: Lentek Super Bark Free - 25 Feet Radius Coverage Area.
review_body: This item really works! We have barking dogs across the street, and when I have the Barker Breaker set out, they immediately stop barking.

product_title: Kaytee Run-About Ball
review_body: The product wasn't too bad but it really is much bigger than I expected.  I have a dwarf hamster (think furry golf ball) and this was too big for her.  I also didn't like how the opening closed shut.  The last thing I wanted to worry about was the ball coming undone and having a furry hamster loose in the house!  I had to use tape to keep it reinforced so for that reason alone I gave it 3 stars. The day after I received it I found a smaller ball in Walmart for 1/2 the cost.  (and they had the larger ones as well) I burned myself because I paid more and had to pay for shipping.  This ball is more suited for larger hamsters and guinea pigs.

product_title: Kurgo Backseat Dog Car Barrier for Cars & SUVs – Mesh Opening – Easy Installation
review_body: I put this behind the front seats in my xtended cab pickup truck.  My standard poodle just climbed right over it.  Since then, the material is tearing where the metal stays are poking through.  Might work for a small dog, but not mine.

product_title: Porch Potty Standard - with Synthetic Grass
review_body: I actually purchased this from the website directly, since its not being sold on Amazon.com at the moment.      First off, I have a female pug who is about 7 years old.  I have had her litter-box trained since she was a puppy.  I have her trained this way because of the long work hours I have to put in during the week...its not fair to her to have to hold it for 8 hours, and since I live in a condo - there is no lawn for her to go out to to use.  The litter system has work well for the most part, however I just moved into a new place, and I had to place her litter box in an unusual area, which caused a lot more of a mess.  The litter was falling down onto the peoples patio who lived below me, and she was also tracking the litter into my bedroom.  So I did some serious research on trying to find a new system for her.    One thing to consider when purchasing this system, is that it may be expensive - but you will be saving money in the long run for not having to buy bag after bag of litter.  I went through about 1 27lb bucket of clumping cat litter a month with my dog. 1 bucket costs around $8 at PetSmart...so in just litter alone, per year you are paying over $90 (thats assuming you are using cat litter, if you choose to use Dog Litter, getting an equivalent amount at PetCo will cost around $12-$20/month) .  You also have to deal with the litter getting dirty, cleaning out the box, and the mess of the litter tracking all over the place.     So after realizing that I needed to get a new system, I did some research.  There are many different systems out there that are very similiar in concept to this one...however this one has many features that most of the others dont have:    Size  Even though my dog is small (under 25lbs), she still likes to have a lot of room to move around in when shes using the bathroom.  Most systems are very much the same as a traditional sized cat litter box...which just will not work for my dog (for the litter box I used, I created my own litter box out of one of those shallow, but very long plastic containers that people generally use for storing stuff under there beds).  The PorchPotty was the only system that was the size that would work for my dog.    Cost to maintain  As I said before, I was going through 1 bucket of cat litter a month to maintain my dogs box.  Here, I pay nothing but the cost of water (which is already included in my HOA costs).    Keeping it clean  The poster above stated that when the dog goes #2, it was a pain to clean up...personally, I have not had that problem at all.  The dogs #2 does not stick to the \\"grass\\", and normal watering sends the urine and everything else down the drainage tube.  Even if you dont get the system with the sprinkler system, buying a $3 watering can at the local WalMart is all you need.    Durability  The poster above mentioned that the system seemed to be \\"springy\\"...I have not noticed this.  My dog is around 25lbs and I do not see the system give at all when she jumps on it and walks around.  The system *is* made out of plastic...but its seems very sturdy.      My dog took to the system instantly.  After setting up the drainage tube and placing the box in the right place, I gave her the command to use the bathroom, and she instantly hopped on the system, and did her stuff.  I have had the system for over a week now and there have been no \\"accidents\\" in my place...and no litter mess either!    This system is well worth the money...and I highly recommend anyone else looking at these types of systems, to do some serious research before making any decision.  The fact is, out of all the research I did on this, this was the only system that got amazing reviews one after another.  In fact, the poster above me is pretty much the only person I could find who had anything negative to say about the system.  I think that says a lot.  You wont find that same type of satisfaction with other similiar products...trust me.  This is the only system with a drainage type system...every other system involves a urine bucket that you have to clean out on a daily basis (hope you dont trip or slip), or involves using newspaper (gross), or having to buy puppy pads for the urine to absorb into (you think litter is expensive?  Puppy pads are not only much more expensive, but its pretty much like buying diapers...very non-environmentally friendly).    Again, its a great system, and well worth the time in doing a little research.  Compare other similiar products...you will be surprised.

product_title: Nathan's Famous Hot Dog Treats, All Beef, 4-Ounce Bags (Pack of 12)
review_body: I have a shorkie and she just loves these treats.  When we got her as a puppy, our Wal-mart handled these treats and she liked them from the beginning.  After she was hooked, our Wal-mart stopped handling them and Amazon is the only place that I have found. I would advise any pet owner to try them for their dog. I have gave a bag to my mother and to the neighbor for their dogs and both dogs love the treats too.

product_title: FURminator deShedding Tool for Cats, 1.75-Inch Edge
review_body: My Husband has terrible allergies.  Since using this tool, it has significantly cut down on our cat's shedding.  Plus our cat loves it. I would recommend this to anyone!

product_title: PetSafe Healthy Pet Water Station, Dog and Cat Water System with Stainless Steel Bowl, Medium, 128 oz.
review_headline: A worthy water system that needs a little tweaking.
review_body: PetSafe Healthy Pet Water Station is a good product that will filter out a lot of the water irritants (such as chlorine and fluoride) that will cause some allergic reactions in your pets.  A nice and easy to clean dish that provides clean water for your furry friends.  The only problem I have with the product is getting the water out of the container.  You have to twist and tilt back the container in order for some water to come out.  If they make an improvement to this area then it will be a must have for any pet owner.

product_title: Nature's Variety Instinct Rabbit Formula Canned Cat Food
review_headline: My cat had been sick for weeks...
review_body: My 1 year old bengal kitty had been sick for weeks, lethargic, vomiting, diarrhea, the works.  He had been tentatively diagnosed with IBD a few months prior, and we had been somewhat successful treating it with a different brand of food.  About 3 weeks ago, something set off the IBD again, and he was worse than we've ever seen him.  After nearly $400 in vet bills, we switched him to this food 3 days ago on recommendation from the breeder.  It has been AMAZING the difference.  Our kitty now has energy, has not vomited, has firm stool, he's cleaning himself again, and playing with his cousin!  Almost fully back to his old self again, and in only a few days.    I am a firm believer in this food...our other cat will be switching onto this food as well!  We had to buy the rabbit as it is the easiest protein source for cats to digest - and it IS a food they would naturally eat in the wild!  Cats with IBD often need a novel protein source, and our cat had already tried chicken, beef, fish, venison, australian brushtail, duck & lamb...all with no success.  This food has been a lifesaver for us, and our kitty LOVES it!

product_title: LitterMaid LM500 Automated Litter Box
review_body:
When this litter box is working properly it doesn't save you time, it just defers maintenance. When it is not working properly it just makes a mess.

The machine only lets you put in a shallow amount of litter or it will clog as the tines rake through it. This means you have to really watch the litter level. If it is too high the machine jams and the motor runs back and forth over and over again trying to push against a pile of litter. The trouble is, with such a shallow amount of litter [1] if your cat is in the habit of using the same place in the box everytime the litter gets REALLY shallow, and [2] even with a full load of litter, the litter does not clump when your cat has a large pee. The pee soaks to the bottom and sticks, and the litter stays slightly gummy, and sticks to the tines of the rake, and the machine jams. Yes I used premium litter. To make matters worse, my cat liked to pee right on the edge of the litter by the tines where the floor of the box ramps up and there is nearly no litter. instant mess.

If your cat's stool is soft that day, and/or your cat does not properly cover it, the poo smears and sticks all over the rake and it jams. And it is horrible to clean. I have has cat feces jammed way up under the tines on the side where the motor is.

After a while I just unplugged the litterbox and used it as a regular litterbox with a convenient container to place the poo so that it didn't stink and I would only have to make the trip out to the dumpster every week or so instead of every day. That worked fairly well, but my cat still tracked gravel everywhere so I just replaced it with a Booda Dome. [[ASIN:B0002DH8L4 Dome, Cleanstep Cat Box, Titanium]]

product_title: Nature's Variety Instinct Lamb Formula Canned Cat Food
review_body: Update:  The same cat that I wrote about below developed urine crystals while I was feeding him a combination of this food along with a little dry wellness core.  He ultimately had the PU surgery for FLUTD, but I still had to change his diet.  I first tried to just stop the dry food and keep him on this canned food, but he still did not do well.  I have since switched all 3 of my cats to Dave's canned food which is a little more that half the cost and I believe it to be of equal quality.  All 3 of my cats love the daves food except for the Chicken flavor.  For my cat with FLUTD I add a lot of water to the canned food and he is doing very well.  To be clear though, my other two cats were doing very well on the Instinct and I was reluctant to take them off of it, but they are also doing very well on Dave's and I save a lot of money going with that food.  I got my cat from a rescue organization and where I fell in love with him even though he was noticeably sick.  After three months of diarrhea, 5 different kinds of cat food(including 2 prescription diets), switching to a natural non-clay litter and almost 1,000 in vet bills with no results, I decided to give the instinct lamb a try.  The next day he had normal bowel movements and he has ever since.  He is clearly allergic to something that is in other foods.  I don't know exactly what yet, but if you need to try a hypo-allergenic food for your cat I would try this before the prescription vet foods because the ingredients are a better quality.  I would also try this one before trying the instinct venison or rabbit because they are more expensive than the lamb, and lamb is a unique enough protein source that it should work.  I actually think the rabbit one has some chicken in it;This is all lamb.  Cats with food allergies can also develop skin rashes from it which my cat also had, so if your cat has diarrhea and rashes, this might be worth a try.  Good luck :)

product_title: Fluval Clearmax Phosphate Remover Filters, 3.5 Ounces - 3-Pack
review_body:
I have used this product a few times. It is now sold and packaged in a blue box as Fluval Clearmax by Hagen.

When it was Green-X / Phos-X, the media bags were long and thin. With the new packaging they fit the canister filters much better as they are now shaped square.

The product seems to work well enough for me for my marine tank. I have to condition tap for my water changes.

It is difficult to say whether or not there is a real reduction in nitrate. My param seems to remain steady at the low end with regular water changes, but who knows what it would be if I wasn't using it at all?

I acquired fish with closed operculum gills. I wrote to Hagen to ask about the iron content to see if it would be okay for my fish because of the type of gills they have, to which they responded it contains ferric oxide; not okay to use for fish of that type.

I am having to switch to a brand that will not harm my species of fish.(Regular ChemiPure or PhosBan using ferric oxide hydroxide).

While I used this product, I had no complaints. The price was very good compared to other adsorbents and algae remained under control.

product_title: PetSafe Electronic SmartDoor, Automatic Dog and Cat Door, Collar Activated with SmartKey, Small or Large
review_headline: The rating of this door gets lower and lower everyday
review_body: I've had this door installed for about a week. My dog is already doggie door trained. She's a pretty intelligent client. However, even an intelligent dog and an adult human (that has read over and over the instruction manual) can have a hard time figuring out the automatic setting on this door. And I finally figured out why we were having such difficultly- the door only works when it wants to. The sensor isn't nearly powerful enough (on any range setting). My dog is pretty low to the ground and the key only seems to work when I point it directly at the door. Needless to say, I haven't quite trained my dog to turn and position the key just right in relation to the door- lacking thumbs and all, it would be kind of difficult for her.     Also when it does register, the door only stays unlocked for a few seconds before it locks again and resets. So if you're dog doesn't make it out of the door in time, they have to stand there for 10 seconds until the door registers the key again. I've tried to explain this to my dog, but I don't think she gets it. She just scratches on the door and when it doesn't open, pisses on the carpet.     If your dog does manage to point the key at the right angle and moves fast enough to get out of the door before it closes- the door can still get stuck in the open position. If the door is open when it attempts to lock it just freezes where ever it happens to be. Letting my cats out and defeating the purpose of having an automatic dog door in the first place. If I didn't care what animals got in or out of my house I would have bought a cheap flappy door or cut a random hole in the wall for free.    In my opinion, PetSafe has to step it up before anyone else bothers to install this door. Just house train your dog, pay a pet sitter, take your dog to work with you, or just don`t get a dog at all. All of these options are better than buying this door.    PetSafe: Just because your's is the only product on the market doesn't give you the right to suck.
