review_headline: Lick Your Chops Seafood & Brown Rice Dinner for Cats
review_body: The ingredients are wholesome, and are without by-products, but my four cats do not really like this catfood.  It is a shame because the price is reasonable, and I like the quality, but my cats and I don't argue over 'taste.'

product_title: Pet Sisal Mania Cat Toy Exerciser
review_body: I have searched high and low for a scratcher that my cat will go near.  Spent tens of dollars and this was finally THE ONE. I have also noticed that my local PETCO very rarely has it stock.  Happy scratching.

product_title: Mimio 3483 Miracle Coat Quickfinder For Cats
review_headline: You are better off buying a regular sharper nail clipper
review_body: Honestly from experience of trying to use this product many times while following directions, I don't think it is sharp enough to do a proper job. Have not had any luck and performance is erratic and you still feel like you are guessing. Needless to say, they are not sharp enough and crush the nail. It's off to the trash can.

product_title: LitterMaid LM900 Mega Self-Cleaning Litter Box
review_body: Do not purchase the Littermaid Mega!  I had previously owned two Littermaid litter boxes that had lasted 3-4 years each.  This model is so very disappointing.    -Motor is too weak to move large clumps  -The rake doesn't reach the bottom resulting in broken clumps and build up  -The rake doesn't get close enough to the waste receptacle making smaller clumps fall back in the box and get pushed back behind the rake    I purchased the \\"Mega\\" model when our last Littermaid went out because we have 2 cats now and thought that the bigger size would be better.  I wish I would have just bought the original model instead.  As mentioned earlier this model has major problems that make it more work than just having a normal $5 litter pan that you scoop every day.  If you are thinking of buying the \\"Mega\\" model I wouldn't.  I am so disgusted that I have wasted over $100 on this product.

product_title: PetSafe Gentle Spray Bark Collar for Dogs, Citronella, Anti-Bark Device, Water Resistant
review_body: The collar worked for two days, but thereafter, our dog decided to put up with the smell just so he could keep barking.

product_title: Goa 2C Dlx Cat Litter Pans
review_body: Needed a litter box that would fit in a sturdi-shelter without taking up too much of the space.   This one works well for kittens.    Also bought the 3C box for my larger adults (the 2C is a little too small for the adults).   The rim keeps the litter in during active covering activities and the rubber covered feet keep it from shifting.   Its also came in a really nice green color (forest instead of the usual bright green).

product_title: Brake-Fast Dog Food Slow Feed Bowl - Medium Blue
review_headline: Please don't slow me down...i'm a chocolate glutton
review_body: I'm a 3 year old chocolate lab, and i'm a glutton. I really miss my stainless steel dish because i could eat all my food in a matter of seconds...now it takes minutes!    Ok here's the scoop, our lab always was bloated at night after she ate. Burping and the gas, icky and stinky. Our house did smell of dog gas for the longest time...Until we got this dog bowl. It slows down her eating considerably, and the amount of gas and bloat has gone down by about 50%, which is worth it to us. The best part about, as mentioned in other reviews is how the bowl slides across the floor. We put it on our wood floors, stick some cheese in the bottom and enjoy watching the dog pushing the bowl around, eating her dog food trying to get to the cheese...It now takes minutes for her to eat, instead of seconds. Instead of taking large gobbles, she has to take small snippets. I can't recommend this thing enough, it really helped with our problem.

product_title: Smokehouse 100-Percent Natural Meaty Porky Bone Dog Treats, 5-Pack
review_body: Can't keep the doggies away from them!  We got these for our new puppy but our older dog keeps trying to steal them!!  Obviously with the five pack there are plenty to go around... but this is a GREAT way to keep a large breed teething puppy busy!  They aren't messy and they last forever.  A++++ Love These!

product_title: PetSafe Gentle Spray Bark Collar for Dogs, Citronella, Anti-Bark Device, Water Resistant
review_headline: Premier Spray Sense Anti-Bark Dog Collar
review_body: the collars are working great on my three dogs! I feel so much better knowing that I don't have to resort to a much harsher electrical alternative. One of the collars had a small leak in it and Premier sent another brand new one with no questions asked just requested the broken one back (they paid the shipping).

product_title: Petstages Orka Jack, Medium
review_headline: My Dog Didn't Care For It, So I made Peanut Butter Treat Holders Out of It
review_body: My dog loves to chew but really didn't care for this toy.  It is definitely high quality though.  I decided to cut the egg shaped ends off with a sharp knife.  They are now used to make frozen peanut butter,tahini, and plain yogurt treats for the dog.  Can be filled with about 2 Tablespoons of anything.  I usually put one teaspoon of PB inside and it takes him about 5 minutes to lick out.

product_title: PetSafe Gentle Spray Bark Collar for Dogs, Citronella, Anti-Bark Device, Water Resistant
review_headline: My whole family highly recommends this product!
review_body: We adopted a very large Alaskan Malamute, Nannuq, from a young couple who could no longer care for him. The only training he had was he would sit on command and go to his crate on command. An unlike most Alaskan Malamutes this one is a barker much to our surprise.  We hired a trainer to help us get control of him and she was the one who got us this Gentle Spray Citronella Collar.  And....it worked. Before the collar, we could not put the dog in the 12 foot by 12 foot kennel we have (and our last Alaskan Malamute was perfectly content out there watching the world go by).  This dog, Nannuq, would bark and howl.  People could hear him on the next block (and we live in the country)!  We started to use the collar and now Nannuq stays in his kennel without barking and lays on the deck without barking. Sometimes we put the collar on him and forget to turn it on and he still doesn't bark! We are so happy with this product that we just ordered from Amazon the remote gentle shock collar (which sprays a burst of citronella when the remote control is pushed).  We are hoping this will help us to keep him from stealing items on the kitchen and bathroom counters, leave my outside plants alone, and in general behave better.  Stay tuned for review!  One last thing, it is important to remember to always turn the collar to off when not in use.  The batteries will not last long if you forget to do this.

product_title: Casual Canine Plaid Blanket Coat for Dogs - Water Resistant / Fleece Lined - X-Large
review_body: Molly has worn this coat for three winters now. She is a very active dog and the coat still looks like new. The velcro is super sticky and very high quality, as is the waterproof coat material and lining. A good buy.

product_title: Tidy Cats Cat Litter, Breeze, Litter Box Kit System, 1 Kit
review_body: My mom has 5 cats & 5 litter boxes.  I bought her a Breeze starter kit as soon as I knew they existed.  We placed the Breeze box next to a \\"litter\\" box (took away all other boxes).  It was nasty for a few days, allowing the litter box to get rank, but it's the best way to make the transition.  If you refuse to clean the litter box, the kitties decide to use the clean Breeze box.  Then you simply remove the old litter pans forever!  Only took about 4-5 days for Mom's cats to get the hang of it.  Unfortunately, one of the kitties refused to use the Breeze, so she had to keep one regular litter box just for him. It's WONDERFUL to no longer have to buy 20 lbs of litter each week.  As for the poop smell...as soon as you scoop the poop away, the smell is gone.  Great invention!  Our Walmart stopped carrying supplies recently.  I sure hope Tidy Cat isn't getting ready to discontinue this system.

product_title: Outward Hound Kyjen  Egg Babies Turtle Plush Dog Toys Squeak Toy Dog Puzzle, Large
review_body: This toy is great! My dogs have pulled the eggs out of their hedgehog HUNDREDS of times and the toy is still in one piece. The squeakers in the eggs seem to last for quite a long time too. I haven't bought any other toys...we are hooked on our egg babies!

product_title: Case/12, 1# Canisters of Chicken Breast Nibbles
review_body: The title is what it is. My dogs prove that this is a five star product. They would eat them all day if they were able.

product_title: ThunderShirt Classic Dog Anxiety Jacket
review_headline: Did not work for my dog
review_body: I wanted to return it for a refund but my wife insists it may just take time. I doubt it after a couple of thunderstorms later. If it does not work for your dog return it immediately.

product_title: IRIS Airtight Pet Food Storage Container
review_body: I have 13 cats and they go through a lot of dry cat food. I bought one of these to store it in. The design is all wrong for cats because they jump up on it and it tips over very easily. After the first accident I took the wheels off. After the second accident I realized that because the bottom was narrower than the top it was prone to tipping if it wasn't full. I tried putting weights in the bottom but then it was too hard to scoop all the kibble out. After a few more accidents I gave up. A better design for cats would have a wider base.

product_title: Scat Mat Electronic Pet Training Mat
review_headline: A little pricey, but does the job very well.
review_body: Although a little pricey, this item works perfectly.  I received it today, put it in my office doorway and after only 2 attempts, my cat no longer looks at the office door.  No more ripped down wires or holes in the leather chair.  A good product.

product_title: Nature's Miracle Just for Cats Corn Cob Cat Litter
review_body: This is the best litter I have ever used.  It is practically dust free, and doesn't smell like clay litters can.  It lasts for around 3 weeks, so changing out the litter happens less often (that's for the lazy people.  Let's face it, cat people are lazy, or we would be out walking dogs).  My favorite part is that it is flushable, and clumps immediately.  I have heard complaints that its lightweight makes me sweep teh floor more often, but I think that is more a result of my cat kicking it out of the box.  I will never go back to any other cat litter.

product_title: Aspen Pet Lebistro Programmable Food Dispenser
review_body: this is a piece of junk:    1. It does not feed the proper portions. My son and I each have one and have found that it under feeds our dogs.    2. It is not made well. The food well is lightweight plastic, and the lid and well do not having screw on locking mechanisms. One half turn is supposed to hold it tight.  It doesn't.    3.  After one month, it's now making horrible noises and not feeding at all.

product_title: (Price/2)Kaytee Snix Snax Hamster/gerbil 4oz
review_body: This is one of the few hamster treats out there that are good that aren't sweet (e.g yogurt dipped chips, etc.). Our hamster likes almost everything in here. Recommended!

product_title: Wysong Maintenance Dog Food Case, 32-Pound
review_body: Once I started using Wysong my dog stopped having ear and other infections which had been occuring on an almost monthly basis.  As an added bonus her coat became much softer and shiner.  She's been healthy for several years on Wysong.  The extra money I've spent on the food has been very cost effective.

product_title: Richell Pet Food Keeper, Clear with Blue Lid
review_headline: Dry Dog food keeper - Great value for the price
review_body: This bin is great for it's price. It is slender, so it fits in tight spots, but holds the next to large bag of Iams without a problem !

product_title: Petlou Long Legs & Sily Sound Off Durable Squeaker Dog Toys - Durable Fabric - Tough and Reliable For Aggressive Chewers
review_body: My dog loves her flamingo and carries it around with her. It gets a little gross after awhile but it washes very well so I toss it in the washer and it's as good as new.

product_title: FURminator Medium Yellow Deshedding Tool with 2-2/3-Inch EdgeFURminator deShedding Tool
review_body: Before buying this product our Jack Russell Terrier was a shedding nightmare.  It was so bad that we were reluctant to even touch our dog, because every time we did there was a massive explosion of hair everywhere. The FURminator does a wonderful job of stripping off all the dead hair and our dog loves all the extra attention.  We never thought we'd ever allow our JRT on the furniture, but after using the FURminator he can sleep wherever he wants and we cuddle with him no matter what clothes we're wearing (even black clothes).  The FURminator is a wonderful product and I highly recommend it to anyone with heavy shedding breeds.

product_title: ADAPTIL (DAP) Collar - Dog Appeasing Pheromone
review_headline: Did not work for my dog
review_body: This product may work for some dogs, but it had NO affect at all on my dog. She is a rescue dog with some issues, so I ended up putting her on medication for separation anxiety after I exhausted all options including this. It may work for others, but if the dogs issues are more than mild, probably wont.

product_title: Massivore Delite Aquarium Fish Food - 2.2 lb.
review_body: I have an 16 year old Polypterus ornatipinnis (Ornate bircher)- Happy and healthy!  I tried all kinds of food live, frozen etc., for the first year, growth was minimal until I started using Hikari's carnivore and then massivore.  Excellent price for this product, shipping is a bit excessive.

product_title: Purina Fancy Feast Grilled Gourmet Variety Pack Wet Cat Food - (24) 3 oz. Cans
review_headline: Fancy Feast Gourmet Cat Food 3-Flavor Grilled Varieties
review_body: Cats enjoy every can without hesitation and it arrives on time before we run out of food.  [...]

product_title: Outward Hound Hide-A-Squirrel and Puzzle Plush Squeaking Toys for Dogs
review_body: This is an excellent toy for most dogs. I say most because it is probably not ideal for dogs who are bent on the destruction of every toy they get :) My dog is a one and a half year old 45 lb border collie mix, and this is one of her favorite toys. She loved the Hide-A-Squirrel toy also until my sister's lab destroyed that one. I hide this toy from my sister's dog when he comes to visit, but Lacey has it out all day long and she plays with it a lot, sometimes even roughly, and both the bird house and birds are still fully intact (much to my shock--she typically tries, and succeeds, to tear out the squeaker in all squeaky toys). The nice thing is, this is a toy that she enjoys playing with by herself even after she has \\"solved\\" it by getting all the birds out, but it's also something we can play with together. My hands are small enough that I can reach in through one hole of the bird house, grab a bird, and make it peek out the other hole, squeak it, then pull it back in before she can get it. It's a very fun game for her, but she figured out a while back that it's me doing it so she goes back and forth between trying to get the bird and yipping at me :) This is definitely one of the best toys I've ever gotten for her, and I highly recommend it to anyone whose dog does not destroy everything in sight. This is a sturdy toy, but it's still plush, and plush is not for every dog.

product_title: Omega Paw Self-Cleaning Litter Box, Regular, Taupe
review_body: Not only is this the best litter box available, the price makes it the best VALUE litter box by far. Look no further, if you have come across this box, order this box.

product_title: FURminator Large Yellow deShedding Tool with 4-Inch Edge
review_body: This product is the best dog brush I've ever used and I have used a lot.

product_title: DAZER II Ultrasonic Dog Deterrent
review_body: I first heard about the Dazer from a friend who got one and recommended it to me as a way of deterring nuisance-dog barking.  A neighbor has three mutts that annoyingly yap for long periods throughout the day, without being stopped or disciplined by their owner... so I bought the Dazer in a near-desperate attempt to remedy the situation before having to take more drastic action like reporting the neighbor to the local Humane Society.     I have to say, I was initially skeptical that it would do the trick but from the first time I used it, I noticed that the dogs stopped their barking almost immediately.  I've used the Dazer consistently for almost two weeks, and knock on wood, I've noticed a big change in the amount of barking that comes from next door - the dogs actually don't yap like how they used to! Sure, they still bark on occasion... but definitely not for long periods like before. THANK YOU very much to whoever invented this great product - you're a God-send.

product_title: KONG Chipmunk Catnip Toy, Cat Toy, Brown
review_body: The chipmunk is cute, but the catnip doesn't seem to be very effective.  My cats treat it almost like a kitten and groom it!  Maybe if it had some fresher catnip it would be more of a toy for them.  But they seem to enjoy it anyway.

product_title: Virbac C.E.T. Enzymatic Oral Hygiene Chews for Cats
review_body: The seller sent the product promptly. The cat very happily gobbles it down. (She only gets one a day and she is a food-oriented cat). She eats it so fast, I don't see what good it does her mouth. I began using C.E.T. Enzymatic toothpaste on the advice of the vet. Different vet recommended the C.E.T Enzymatic chews for dogs (for my dogs to chew on). I thought I would see if the cat likes them since it is so difficult to brush a cat's teeth. Time will tell whether or not they keep her teeth clean. My other cats never used these, never had their teeth cleaned and had beautiful healthy teeth and gums until they passed at age 17.

product_title: Swheat Scoop Natural Wheat Litter
review_body: I've used Swheat Scoop for a few months now, and I like it much better than the clay-based litters I used to use.  I live in a small 1-bedroom apartment and when I was using the clay-based clumping litter, I and my guests could definitely tell from the litter smell that permeated my apartment that I had a cat, no matter how much I scooped it.  As soon as I changed to Swheat Scoop, the litter box smell that greeted me everyday when I came home from work disappeared.  As long as I scoop the box everyday, I can't smell it.  However, if I don't scoop for a couple of days and the litter gets too saturated to dry, it does start to smell of ammonia.    I also chose Swheat Scoop because of the ability to flush it.  I usually leave it to soak for a few minutes before I flush, but even when I don't soak it, I haven't had any problems.     I also appreciate the fact that there's no dust, but as other reviewers have mentioned, the litter does tend to track a lot.  Right now I don't have a mat and I need to vacuum regularly to keep the area clean.

product_title: Frontline Plus Flea and Tick Control for Dogs, 23-44 lbs. 6 MO. SUPPLY
review_headline: Item was just as advertised and cheaper than at the store.
review_body: Frontline is great for dogs but pricey if bought at the store. We have been using it for awhile and were just looking for a less expensive option. It's great that we can still use Frontline and get a better price.

product_title: Natures Miracle Odor & Stain Laundry Detergent
review_headline: If you have or work with animals...you NEED this!
review_body: I work at Skydance Pet Lodge and Spa, and I have three (sometimes) four dogs and a cat.  Doing wash with this product is amazing!  I wash my jeans and logo shirt as well as all bedding material in this and there is no fading.  It's worth every penny and I'll never be without it again.  Even if you just want to try it for the allergy aspect...you will always want to keep some on hand.  Doing sheets and bedspreads, if your pet sleeps with you, is another good reason to give it a try!

product_title: Set of 6 Miracle Coat Grooming Shears
review_body: I purchased these shears to groom my own dogs at home.  I was disappointed with them right away. They weren't very sharp, and one of them fell completely apart.  I was pretty irritated and contacted the seller for a refund.  The seller was great, apologetic and very helpful. He paid for my return shipping and everything went smoothly.  Great seller, not so great shears.

product_title: FURminator deShedding Tool for Cats, 1.75-Inch Edge
review_headline: A must have for all cat/dog owners
review_body: I have two cats - one with short hair and the other with medium to long hair. We also have hardwoods throughout the main living area of the house and cat hair just floats EVERYWHERE. The final piece that convinced us to do something about the floating hair is a baby who will be crawling soon and I\\"m sure trying to eat the cute floating tufts of cat hair.    Enter the FURminator. It's made quite a difference, and my cats love it. One of the cats doesn't even like to be petted, but will tolerate the furminator. We've only used it for about a week so I'm not 100% sure of its overall effectiveness, but I do know that when I pet the cats hair no longer flies off them as it once did.    Sure, it's much more expensive than your typical cat brush, but in just three combings the FURminator pulls more hair off than with 30 minutes of combing with a traditional cat brush. You'd be a fool not to get one.

product_title: Ceva Feliway Plug-In Diffuser for Cats
review_body: I bought this product based on my vet's recommendation to try it.  We took in a stray cat that had an absolutely wonderful personality with people, but REALLY disliked other cats (we have 2 other cats).  When we tried to introduce him to our other cats, he attacked, hissing and growling the whole time.  We did not notice any kind of effect from this product on either the stray cat or our other cats.  We had the stray cat separated in one room in the house with the diffuser and plugged another one in for our other 2 cats.  We ended up having to give the stray cat away to a cat rescue organization to have it placed in a home with no other cats.  We had had him for over a month and spent money to have him spayed, vaccinated, and bathed.  We were very heartbroken at having to give him up.  I would not recommend this product, but others have indicated that it worked for them.  Suffice it to say, it doesn't always work!

product_title: Frontline Plus Flea and Tick Control for Cats and Kittens, 6 MO. SUPPLY
review_body: Frontline is the one product we have found works quite well for out cats. Our cats are indoor/outdoor cats and we have no trouble with fleas or ticks when we use Frontline as directed. When we need it, I search the Internet for the best price. This time, Amazon had the best price.

product_title: Snoozer OS Lookout I, NO Drawer, Burgundy SL Cover
review_body: I have 2 Italian Greyhounds; one is still a puppy.  They both love the seat and often will be in it at the same time.  We ended up purchasing another so that both dogs could have their own.  It's really nice because they can ride in comfort laying down and having the windows open (and getting air vs. laying on the seat), and still be able to see outside.  I can feed them treats and keep their car toys right be them.  Great product and it arrived a day early.

product_title: Legs Out Carrier Medium for pets over 10 lbs.
review_body: Bought this for my snub-nosed Frenchie who has trouble keeping up with my 3 Bostons who all go on hikes with me. The Frenchie usually holds her own on the neighborhood walks of up to 2 miles so beyond those distances and over more complex terrain, this carrier has been helpful in giving her a lift so she can finish hikes without risking stroke or other negative health issues.     The carrier has 4 reinforced tabs which are adjustable. I got the small-sized carrier since my Frenchie is 11-13lbs and broad chested. The length fits her perfectly for being a small dog and the small-sized carrier I would say is certainly true to size. However I would have purchased a medium for a broad chested dog as she is because the tabs just don't offer more than about 1.5 on each side to widen the opening for her. The carrier comes up to about neck level and the arms extend thru just about 2\\" or so below the upper opening of the carrier so she is snug and secure. I plan to bring the carrier to my local cobbler who also reattaches nylon harness straps on camping and paddling storage gear, etc. to see if he can make a modification. This is a great value -- I read here that some owners wanted a carrier where their dogs legs could extend out and not be squished and this one offers that. My dog doesn't have a tail so you may want to remember long tailed dogs might have an issue if sitting on their tail in the carrier -- if it's not adjusted to avoid being pinched.

product_title: Mange Treatment Spray for Mange Mites
review_body: I applied this product to our two hamsters that were badly infected with mites. They had lost most of their fur and were constantly scratching. After about a week of applying this spray to their fur about three times a day, they were like new! This is a great product and I would recommend it for hamsters.

product_title: Lentek 6-Day Automatic Pet Dish
review_body: Great for helping my pom to lose a few pounds.  Works just like it should.  Would reccomend to anyone with a 20 lb or under dog.

product_title: PetSafe Deluxe Big Dog Trainer, PDBDT-305
review_body: So far my husband and I are pleased with the results of this product. Before using it my English Bulldog had some behavioral issues, i.e. jumping on people, peeing on his bed, not minding in general.  Most of the time we only have to use the tone correction button for him, which usually does the trick. Our dog's behavioral issues are much better than before using the collar, and I would reccommend this product to others.

product_title: FURminator deShedding Shampoo for Dogs and Cats, 16 Ounces
review_body: I love our two Golden Retrievers, but keeping up with the shedding is a never-ending battle.  I purchased the large FURminator as well as the FURminator deShedding Shampoo.  The FURminator did the best job of pulling out the undercoat I have ever seen as well as doing it with the least amount of effort I've ever used.  Terrific invention.  The FURminator deShedding Shampoo is unbelievable. It is a coconut base shampoo with plant proteins, herbal extracts, Vitamin E, Omega 3 & 6 fatty acids, aloe vera and plant extracts. From what I can tell, it seems to be formulated with all natural ingredients. The directions say to leave it on for 5-10 minutes before rinsing. I was not thrilled with the prospect of trying to keep shampoo-lathered dogs from shaking lather all over the bathroom while this stuff sat for that amount of time, but both of them did really well. First off, the shampoo smells incredible. The dogs even seemed to like it. Secondly, among the herbal extracts are Calendula, Chamomile and Kava which may explain why they were so calm during their 10 minute wait. Last, but not least, they both looked absolutely beautiful and smelled fantastic when I was finished.      I highly recommend both of these products.

product_title: Loofa Dog - 18 Inches
review_headline: puppy loves it, great for the price
review_body: Our puppy loves this toy. It is currently among his top favorites. The material is surely not meant to outlast serious ripping attempts, but this has not been a problem for us. Great for the price.

product_title: Advantage - Blue Box for Dogs over 55 pounds - 6 pack
review_body: I have 4 dogs and Advantage has always worked best at keeping us flea free.   There are a lot of new flea products that are supposed to everything but  I have found advantage to work the best for fleas.

product_title: Gentle Leader Head Dog Collar
review_body: We bought this for our new adopted little girl, Gina. She's got anger issues and constantly barks and lunges/snaps at passerby's when we walk her. After the first walk, she learned that she could no longer pull and lunge at people the way she used to... it curbed her barking by about 80%!!!! i didn't think it would affect the barking, mainly we got it to teach her not to lunge/snap at people...  We also have the gentle leader body harness for our other dog, which works amazingly as well! I definitely recommend these products!

product_title: FURminator Large Yellow deShedding Tool with 4-Inch Edge
review_body: this is the 6th brush I've tried in a year.  My neighbor had the smaller version and let me try it. Amazon had it the cheapest.  My dog's coat feels like a puppies coat again!

product_title: Dingo Rawhide Bones - LARGE DINGO BONE (7 1/2” - 8") - 3 PACK - VALUE BAG!
review_body: The dingo bones are all pretty good, but it seems that the larger ones are pretty thin. I think the smaller ones lasted longer for our puppy.

product_title: ColorBurst Forals Foxtail Flame Red Medium
review_body: This is certainly a beautiful red.  I am glad this accent plant stood upright as some of the fox tails are wimpy and fall over very easily.  You would love this in your aquarium, it's a wonderful addition with its vibrant color.

product_title: KONG Material Dog - Dr. Noys' Dog Toy
review_body: I have two dogs that love to chew, a dachshund and a pit mix. They love their stuffed toys. Most only last a day before they are torn to shreds. These kong stuffed toys have lasted over a month. Worth every penny!

product_title: Pill Gun
review_body: My cat takes a pill every other day and another twice a day for 5 days a month.  I could not survive without this product.  I bought this one to replace another I had purchased 15 years ago!

product_title: CET Chews for Cats 96ct Fish
review_body: Excellent service and price.  Virbac ships quickly and always has the items in stock.  Cat Chews are highly recommended for both dental support and taste for cats.

product_title: K&H Manufacturing Pet Bed Warmer Tan
review_body: I use this in a cat bed made by Whisker city and my cat seems to love the heated bed. It is a good idea to buy a bed where the bottom has a zippered removable washable cover. I put the warmer inside the bottom cover and it works great.

product_title: Stewart Fiber Formula Cat Treats - 2.1 oz - Case of 12 Pouches
review_body: All of my cats love these treats.  One of them has refused every other treat we've tried (she doesn't even like most human foods), but she will eat these.

product_title: Purr-fect Paws Litter Mat
review_headline: Litter Mat Works, But It Is A Bit Expensive ...
review_body: Looked around for a litter mat for a while, but everything I found was small. I finally found the Purr-fect Paws Litter Mat. It is huge and does the job pretty decently. Naturally, it does not catch everything, but it does a better job than the smaller mats that I have tried. product_title: Canidae Dry Dog Food for All Life Stages, Chicken, Turkey, Lamb, and Fish, 30-Pound
review_headline: Another bad reaction. Why risk it?
review_body: We adopted Penelope, a 6 mo. old min pin hound mix, a couple weeks ago. We decided to switch her from Purina Pro Plan w/ Shredded Chicken to a premium food. After reading many conflicting reviews on this site and elsewhere, we decided to try Canidae. My sister feeds Canidae with great results and, at our local pet store, it is the cheapest of the premium foods by a narrow margin.    We mixed only a little Canidae into Penny's kibble. My guess is about 6-8 pieces or 1/12 of her total breakfast/dinner. We watched her very closely. Within a day, we noticed some changes. First of all, she lost a little focus in training, seeming a bit more confused than usual. No biggie. She also sneezed a few times (she has never sneezed before). More importantly, though, we noticed that she started to nibble and chew on her feet. This continued sporadically for another day and half. It wasn't constant or serious. She didn't seem agitated and she didn't bite her feet to the point of redness or bleeding. Still, it was VERY clear that this was caused by the change in diet (nothing else in her routine changed) and this was only with 12-16 pieces of Canidae per day. Having read the reviews of Canidae's new formula, we had known that this might happen. We made the decision to switch right away.    After a lot of research, we decided to try Solid Gold Hund-N-Flocken for Puppies. We mixed in the Solid Gold at the same proportions as the Canidae. The nibbling stopped immediately. No sneezing, either. Her focus seems to have improved as well, though I can't completely credit that to the food because puppies have on and off days. Still, it is clear that the more serious allergy problems have been resolved.    If you've done any research on dog foods at all, you already know that finding the right food requires you to go beyond the ingredient list. Some foods just don't work with some dogs, however good they look on paper. Indeed, I am convinced after many hours of reading reviews that NO food works for ALL dogs. That said, it is clear that many, many more people have had problems with the new Canidae formula than they have with other premium or super-premium brands. Who knows why (Canidae claims the new formula has no changes that could account for allergies), and who cares? Feel free to try Canidae for your dog, but watch him or her very closely. Or, better yet, do what I wish I did, and just start with a different brand. There is nothing special about the Canidae ingredients list, so why risk it?

review_headline: Great seat cover, but doesn't fit all cars
review_body: I've had this cover for about a year now and love it! It is easy to get off and on, washes well, and stays firmly in place even when one of my dogs goes through his extensive scratching routine before laying down. There are even slits to pull the seatbelts through so people could sit on it without having to move it, though mine is usually too disgusting for that to happen!    Another reviewer said it doesn't work with leather seats-- I have leather seats and it works fine. However, my SUV (Saturn VUE) bench seat is well elevated so the elastic straps and hooks on the cover are not impeded in any way. I did switch the cover to my husband's car once (a Chrysler 300M) and it didn't work well at all. There was no space between the bench seat and the floor, so the straps had nothing to hang on to, and there was nothing to hook the hooks on. Because of that, the bottom of the cover slid all over the place and was only marginally better than having nothing at all. My husband's car also has leather seats, so maybe this is the situation in which the other reviewer found having cloth seats helped.    In the end, the fact it only works well in one of our cars is the reason I gave it four stars instead of five, but I would still buy it again.

review_headline: Feed this to your cat and it'll be strong and healthy.
review_body: My cat has been eating this since I found her when she was 2 weeks old. She was 9 ounces, a little scrawny feral kitten. Four years later, she is now a 15-pound muscle cat, and she has never (really! No kidding!) never hacked up a single furball. This food keeps her coat sleek and she is robust and vigorous. She is the first cat I've owned who absolutely does not shed. My vet remarks on how well she's doing and how far she's come, and I attribute it to the love and care...and all the good food. My vet also has told me how important a good diet is for proper brain development and although I cannot claim that Fromm's food made my cat any smarter,  it's reasonable to think she has benefited in lots of essential ways. I highly recommend it, and although it is admittedly pricey, it's well worth it. It's much better than anything else I've tried. She ate some of the most expensive supermarket brand for approximately 30 days once, and I could see the difference in the quality of her coat right away. She started shedding, for one thing, something I've never had with Fromm's. I like that it's manufactured by a company who is dedicated to producing a high-quality nutritionally superior pet food. Love your cat? Want a healthy cat? Feed it this food. End of story.

product_title: ANGELS' Eyes Tear-Stain Remover for Dogs, 240 Grams - BEEF
review_body: It works. Period. Yes, it's expensive, but it's the only product out there that really, truly gets rid of tear stains.     I adopted a stray St. Bernard that had horrible tear stains on her face. I tried just about every product on the market (including topical products that had to be applied three times a day), and nothing seemed to help. I read the great reviews for Angel Eyes, but couldn't find any information about using it on a 120+ lb. dog - only small dogs like Maltese Terriers. I finally decided to just go for it.    When the product arrived, I had to make an educated guess on how much to give my dog, since the label didn't give dosing information for something the size of a St. Bernard. I ended up using about 4x the largest amount shown on the label, divided up into two doses per day. Within two weeks, I began to see a difference. Not only were the tear stains disappearing, but my Saint's eyes were less drippy (which is why they were stained in the first place).     I've been using Angel Eyes ever since (approximately one year) - no more stains. Once the stains were gone, I was able to cut back to a much lower dose (approximately 1 tsp. three x/week). An added side benefit: her ears are much less prone to itchy red yeast problems.    I highly recommend this product. I can't say enough good things about it. IT WORKS.

Each had a bowl of their own but they would wolf down the food as fast as they could like they were racing and then about 15 minutes later they would vomit. I was sick of cleaning the messes so I ordered each of them a medium Brake Fast Bowl and the problem is solved. They eat much slower now and keep the food down! We are spending less on food as we don't have to buy it as often now. I would recommend this bowl to anyone who has aggressive eaters. It works! Even if you have \\"smart\\" dogs that \\"learn\\" how to eat around the pegs faster, by the time he learns he should be conditioned to eating slower. Much of the time now both of my dogs will eat out of just one of the dishes and leaves the other full for later.

product_title: Automatic Cat Feeder Csf-3xl Combo with 1.5 Gal. Hopper, Bowl and Timer (No Stand)
review_body: I bought this after seeing reviews of the version that does not have the 1.5 gallon hopper(see Automatic Cat Feeder-CSF-3 Super Feeder W/basic Timer on Amazon for over 20 reviews). It works great, but make sure you set the adjustment for the amount of food that is dispensed before you get it installed with food in it, as you can not change the adjustment with food in it. There is also an adjustment for the length of time that the food is dispensed as well as the width of the opening. The timer that comes with it is not that hot, but works. Its problem is that it is easy to hit the levers for the time settings, especially when you are plugging the timer in. I replaced it with a digital timer from Home Depot made by GE for about $16.98. It's a 7 day programmable, model 15079 (with two outlets). They also have a single outlet model (15089) that is $14.98, which I would have gotten if they had any in stock. These have 20 on and 20 off settings that can be set to the exact minute. It also has the advantage of being able to force the food dispenser to dispense food twice in a matter of a couple of minutes as opposed to the original timer's minimum of 60 minutes. If you have lots of animals to feed you may want that feature. The minimum time between food settings on the CSF-3 dispenser is 2 minutes. For some reason, they have a switch that sets this minimum time to either 1-2 minutes or 30-60 minutes (mine came set to 1-2 minutes). The dispenser works in the cold also. It's been near 10 degrees F for the last week here at night and not above freezing during the day.

product_title: Dogswell Happy Heart Chicken Breast, Flax Seed & Taurine, 3-Count 16-Ounce Bags
review_body: My dog loves these chicken breast treats from Dogswell for their delicious flavor.  I like them because there are no fillers or preservatives.  It's just quality chicken breast.  From what I understand, PETA approves of this product since the chickens are cage free.

product_title: PetSafe Outdoor Ultrasonic Bark Deterrent
review_body:
I wish you could see how funny my dogs acted the first time they got a load of this thing. I put in the batteries and tested it as instructed and my dogs reacted right away. I will say right up front that I am using this indoors. I cannot imagine what could be different about the outdoor vs the indoor unit but I didn't know that a unit designed specifically for indoor use was available until after I received this one. When it worked so well I was not going to exchange it.
It took a few days for them to figure out what was going on but they finally got the message. I have an 80lb collie and a 8lb Maltese. What a difference.
Yes, this device works as described. I am an audiologist (hearing specialist). In reading the reviews from others who have not had success with this device I would speculate that perhaps those dogs do not have normal acuity at the frequency used by this device. The normal range of hearing for a human is 20Hz to 20,000Hz. I don't know what the normal range for a dog is but presumably it's higher than that of people and the device uses a frequency in that range. If the dog's hearing is not normal in that specific frequency range then the device won't work. So I suggest that if your dog's hearing is normal for a dog then this device should work. Unfortunately there's only one way to find out and that's to try it.

product_title: Urine Off UV Urine Finder Black Light
review_body: The product does not look like the picture, in the sense of having that writting and I have to push down on the battery for it to turn on and so its a little less than ok. Does the job for finding small spots, thats why its compact and cheap

product_title: PetSafe Deluxe Big Dog Trainer, PDBDT-305
review_body: The collar only works sometimes. I checked the connections with the neon lamp and it is lighting up but my dog is not feeling a charge 80-90% of the time even when it's set at 8 or 9.  I switched to the longer probs and it still isn't working as promised.  My next option is to shave his neck and try to improve contact that way. I noticed that the button sometimes sticks in the charge position and if it happens to be the time that the dog is actually feeling the charge he jumps several times becasue of the continued shock before I realize the button is stuck. If shaving his neck works and I can \\"zap\\" him using a 5 or 6 I will say the collar is worth it but if I must crank it up to 8 or 9 and really cause considerable discomfort I won't recommend it.

product_title: Bum Genius Odor Remover
review_body: My husband had banished our daughter's cloth diaper pail to the garage because it was a bit stinky. This product took care of the problem!

product_title: Secure Dog Barking System
review_body: Though the character of the bark is lacking in impressive realism, the fact that it performs with progressive \\"urgency\\" seems to make it a potentially worthwhile deterrent when the premises are NOT occupied. However, it is prone to activation when there is movement by household occupants.

product_title: Jones Natural Chews Pumpers 1 per pack
review_body: Four dogs.  They were hard pressed to keep these away from the cats.  Had to break one up for the cats so the dogs could eat theirs. These are hard chews and I had to use a hammer to break it up for the cats.      Larger dogs will go through these pretty fast, but they are worth the pleasure I know they had munching on them. My smaller guys chewed 5-10 minutes.    For a long chew, the Tendons are one of the best, but I will order these again since all my fuzzy friends flipped over them...    That should say it all.     Company shipped promptly and product arrived in perfect condition.  Pumpers individually shrink wrapped.

product_title: SynergyLabs Groomer’s Blend Shampoo/Conditioner
review_headline: Synergy Groomer's Blend Ultra White Shampoo
review_body: Nice results, fragrance, feel and brightening of fur/hair.  The dog loves the water but the cat was a different story. I had to hold her down, but she never has liked being bathed by others. ;-> Try it, you'll like it.

product_title: Cl Heat Emitter For Birds 60W
review_body: Please note that this is a bulb only.  You will need a lamp to go along with it.

product_title: PetSafe Busy Buddy Tug-A-Jug Meal Dispensing Dog Toy
review_body: My 10 month old Lab needed some brain toys, and this seemed like an ideal option. There is a problem to solve, and the reward is food - what could be better for a Lab? The problem is that she is a chewer, and though she did figure out pretty readily how to get the food out, she was way more interested in chewing on the rope. When I removed the rope - which also made it way easier to get the food out - she then thought it would be more gratifying to chew her way to the food, rather than rise to the intellectual challenge of tipping the bottle and dispensing a treat.     And oh yes, this thing is loud when it hits the floor or cabinets in the kitchen, etc. Pretty durable, considering all she wants to do is chew it and it's not intended as a chew toy - but she has only spent maybe two hours with it total.

product_title: Feliway - Refill, 48 ml
review_body: I spent nearly $100 purchasing this item with refills.  After the first month, seeing that they do not work as described, all of the items were put in the trash.  I wasted alot of money for nothing, and then spent more money having my carpets and furniture cleaned.  I would NOT recommend this product.

product_title: Ware Pop Up Playpen
review_body: I got this to use at summer agility trials because on a warm day there's lots of room to stretch out, and although my 3 year old Cardigan Corgi is used to and stays in a soft crate, he got out of this the first time I used it. However, after only the one escape, he stayed in without protest. It has plenty of room for 2 of my corgis (would be a bit of a squeeze for all 3)and it's certainly easier to set up than a soft crate, packs as small and is as light to carry.  I'd have given it 5 stars except for the break out.

product_title: Hartz Crunch n Clean Dog Biscuit
review_body:
My dog loves these new Hartz dog biscuits with DentaShield.

The front of the box really boasts all the dental advantages pretty obviously, so I will just speak for my dog in that he loves the taste and chews them up really fast and it's something he looks forward to.

Since it has it's benefits and he likes them, I'll continue getting these as well as Greenies which are also good for teeth.

product_title: - Nr Healthy Skin Venison/rice Dog 40lb
review_body: love the food for my chocolate lab. she eats it up quickly. doesnt have that awful smell when you open the bag. i would definitely recommend this food especially if your dog has any allergies. my # 1 choice

review_body: I've had this pump for 2 years now and it's still going strong. I've never needed to replace the impeller, unlike the Rio 800 which needs to be replaced once or twice a year. product_title: Pet Strobe
review_body: This light did not work from the begining and then just fell apart...literally. Don't waste your money!

product_title: PetSafe Gentle Spray Bark Collar for Dogs, Citronella, Anti-Bark Device, Water Resistant
review_body: This collar is amazing.  It shipped quickly.  After about a month I still have not had any problems.  It is easy to use, comes with a battery, and my puppy has stopped barking at everything.  It detects even growls and little quiet barks.  My dog is not instantly more calm and chilled out with this collar on.

product_title: Marshall Small Animal Playpen Mat/Cover
review_body: I saw a post on how these could be dangerous for rabbits and wanted to add my 2 cents.  I also have one that my 2 rabbits are currently housed in and yes, they get out!  They've gotten out about 4 times in about 3 weeks.  They also chew the matt/cover.  I will be purchasing them something else to live in.  Be very careful!

product_title: Aspen Pet Lebistro Programmable Food Dispenser
review_headline: This cat feeder works great for me . . .
review_body: I have owned this pet feeder for about six months now, so I decided to write a review.  We purchased this feeder for our cats before a two week vacation.  We feed our cats twice a day, but we only wanted to pay a pet sitter to come once per day.  The sitter reported it worked flawlessly the entire time.  I have used it since then for weekend trips with no problems.    Here are some technical details.  I wasn't sure about the battery life, so they were replaced the Friday before we left last Christmas.  The same batteries are still powering the unit.  It is currently set to only feed 1/4 cup at noon (the minimum amount possible).  Programming is easy.  If you can program a digital watch, you can program this unit.  In fact it appears if you assemble the unit, put batteries in, turn it on, set the time, it will automatically feed 1/2 cup at 6 a.m. and 1/2 cup at 6 p.m. without any further programming.    I checked the portions by scooping the food into a measuring cup and found that it dispenses very close to the 1/2 cup setting.  What I have found is that setting the unit to the minimum amount (1/4 cup) is not very accurate.  The little plastic flaps may only dispense 1/8 cup one feeding and the quarter cup plus the remaining amount the next feeding.  Apparently my cats are too fat and dumb to figure out how to get the remaining food out of the dispenser chute.    All in all, this feeder has met my expectations.  The issue with inaccuracy in dispensing the minimum amount of food is not worth me knocking a star off the rating.  Our cat food is small (1/4\\"), which may contribute to this small issue.

product_title: TrueBlue Super Easy Ear Wipes, 50 Count
review_body: I absolutely LOVE TrueBlue ear wipes!  So easy & gentle and they don't leave behind any cotton fibers.  I use these on my Labrador Retriever and he always wags his tail when we're done!  Great for travel and dog shows too - highly recommended! :)

product_title: C.E.T. Enzymatic Oral Hygiene Chews, Extra-Large Dogs, 15 Chews
review_headline: Regardless of the coating - this is still RAWHIDE
review_body: I purchased based on reviews here and elsewhere about all the wonderful things these chews accomplished on dogs teeth and the price per unit was so much less than the \\"Greenies\\" I have been using. Upon receipt I immediately noticed that these are just large rawhide strips with a coating on them. They are not even particularly thick rawhide. Rawhide in any form is very dangerous and you must monitor your dog very closely when they are chewing on these. My Great Dane is not a \\"swallow whole\\" kind of eater - he tries to chew up even the tiniest training treats before swallowing them, BUT with rawhide strips like these he will chew on the whole piece until it eventually becomes soft, then swallow it. Whole. Then choke it back up, chew some more and swallow it whole again. Repeat until it goes down and stays down. This is not healthy and not very safe and I always have to be poised to remove the offending chunk of soft wet rawhide from his throat as he gags it up. He does love these chews but I have not seen any wonderful changes in his teeth so far with 2 weeks of daily use so it will not be worth the trouble or risk of choking for me to buy more once this bag is gone. I now wish I had gotten the smaller quantity bag so I could be done with these sooner!  Edited to add that I finally finished the whole bag and still didnt see any big changes to his teeth or gums. Also, the coating comes off on his white legs and my carpet and they make his breath smell weird (not fresh, kind of medicine like). I will never buy these again.

product_title: Nutro Natural Choice Complete Care Indoor Senior Chicken and Lamb Formula Canned Cat Food
review_body: I have been using this product for several years and my 3 senior cats do very well with this as breakfast and the hard food for the rest of the day.  My complaint is about Nutro raising the price at my local PetsSmart $.22 cents over the past couple of months.  Now the Clarksville, TN PetsSmart has informed me that they will no long carry this product.  I am currently on the hunt for a compatable Senior Indoor Soft Cat Food for my cats, I cannot by products from companies like this any longer.  Donna

product_title: CSF-3 Cat Super Feeder with Analog Timer, Chute Cover, Stand and Bowl, Automatic Pet Feeder for up to 48 Daily Meals 4 3/4 Cups Capacity Optionally Expandable
review_body: Love this feeder! Works like a charm. I like the analog timer too - it means that even if the power goes out for a bit, the cat will still get fed when it comes back on.     Truth be told, the thing we love most about this feeder is our cat's interactions with it. She's completely stopped harassing us for food, and now sits and quietly watches the feeder when it's feeding time. She's figured out that the timer has something to do with getting her food, and as it gets closer to feeding time she'll actually sit and stare at the timer! I don't know if it's a sound or visual based cue for her, but she definitely knows the timer triggers the machine.

product_title: Carlson Extra Wide Pet Gate, with small pet door
review_body: This product is an easy set up item.It holds nicely in a doorway or hall entrance.  The only problem is that a very small dog will slip thru the area where the gate closes.  It is attractive and blends in with white or beige walls.

product_title: Joint MAX TRIPLE Strength SOFT CHEWS 120 CHEWS
review_headline: Works on More Than One Level
review_body:
I have been feeding joint support soft chews of various varities to my Greyhounds for quite some time now. Some of my hounds have refused to eat them so I crumble them up over their food. Joint MAX TS Soft Chews has been the first soft chews my hounds have eaten like a treat. The chews arrive plastic wrapped in a plastic container and they are nice and moist, easy to break apart. They stay that way as long as you keep wrapping them back the way they came. If you don't keep them wrapped up they loose their moisture and get to be like little charcoal brickettes. Fortunately they make it easy to keep them nicely wrapped. There is instruction on the side of the container specifing how many chews your dog needs in a day, it depends on size and condition of the dog.

I break mine apart and put in my hound's medication, then smoosh it back over the pill. He eats it right down and I am glad to have found an easy way to 'pill' my dog while giving him something that helps his joints. When you first start giving any joint support product it can take a few weeks or even a couple of months to see any difference in the dog's movement. Again depends on condition of the dog to begin with and what else he/she has going on. I think it helps my Greyhounds, they have that long spine and thin long leg and neck thing going on. I think it has helped their movements stay younger even when they were getting older.

product_title: Notes from the Grooming Table ~ Pro Dog Grooming Book
review_body: This book is really the best. I have been grooming for about 4 years now and it really helps as a reference to differenciate between similar breed clips. It really explains how to do every aspect of the groom. I would definately recomend this book to anyone.

product_title: ANGELS' Eyes Tear-Stain Remover for Dogs, 240 Grams - BEEF
review_body: We have been using Angels Eyes for approx. 6 months.  My dogs eyes look just like he came from the groomers.  Not one bit of brown goop coming out of his eyes.  The cost is a tad bit pricy but.... I did find it cheapest here at amazon.com other than going to Angelseyes.com.  Highly recommended!

product_title: SD FELINE LIGHT ADULT 20-LB BAG
review_body: I am continually surprised that this food is rated as one of the best out there.  Look at the ingredients.  Cats are obligate carnivores, they require meat, not corn, not wheat, not brewer's rice, not \\"powdered cellulose\\" or \\"soybean mill run.\\"  None of the rest of these awful ingredients.  Where is the meat in this food?      Please do your research & investigate the ingredients in any pet food you plan to purchase.  Your pet's health depends on your knowledge!

product_title: Bamboo Quick Control 6-Foot Leash with Seat Belt Latch Orange
review_body: Works great! The latch is ideal for keeping a dog in one area of the car.  Works great as a leash as well.

product_title: Bergan Turbo Track Cat Toy
review_body: The connectors are bit odd when it comes to assembly and some of the edges don't quite line up causing the ball to stop. I picked up a second one at the local store to \\"mix-n-match\\" the pieces until the ball ran smoothly. Over all it was a hit with the cats and I already had the Star Chaser so I switched the ball for even more fun. Luckily you can purchase more balls because I think the light up version was more entertaining. My kitten played until she literally fell asleep over the track. This is a great toy and I love the way you can change the lay out but they could have done a better job on the quality of the pieces. It would be a perfect buy if it was around $10 but if they plan to keep the higher price they need to improve the quality of the pieces. The only thing that made it worth while was how much fun the cats had playing with it.

product_title: Solid Gold Just A Wee Bit Adult Small Breed (Bison) Dry Dog Food, 4 lbs.
review_headline: This food was too good - dog went on a diet!
review_body: Our Yorkie was on Canidae since the day she came home from the rescue, but recently Canidae switched their formula and the new formula did not agree with her.  The Solid Gold Wee Bit came highly recommended from several trusted sources, so we switched.    Because the new formula of Canidae wasn't working for her, we switched her cold turkey to the Solid Gold.  Normally I like to switch gradually, mixing in a larger percentage of the new food with the old each day until they are completely switched over.  This normally prevents upset stomach and loose stools but we were unfortunately already there.  :-(    Our Yorkie took to the new food immediately, and the loose stools stopped within one day.  She loves this food, so much she was eating too much and had to be put on a restricted diet.    There have been no negative affects from this food (aside from some weight gain).  Her coat looks great and her energy level is high.  5 stars!

product_title: K&H Manufacturing Lectro-Soft Outdoor Heated Bed with FREE Cover
review_body: I didn't expect this \\"bed\\" to instead be a large, stiff, crinkly heating pad!  I could not get it to inflate very well and even with the cover on it, it is not something that my dogs' considered comfortable.  They, in fact, tried it and quickly moved off of it!  I should not have purchased this sight unseen.  I am disappointed.

product_title: Ceva Feliway Plug-In Diffuser Refill for Cats
review_body: This is an incredible product for cat owners; keeps cats from spraying, scratching due to the fact that it keeps them calm and secure.  Both of my cats are playful and rambunkscious but no longer destructive nor do they feel threated, thus not territorial.  I would highly recommend this product

product_title: Wellness CORE Natural Grain Free Dry Dog Food
review_headline: Excellent food, and my dog LOVES it
review_body: What can I say? This dog food is one of the best, among the relatively short list of dog foods on dogfoodanalysis.com receiving their maximum rating of 6 stars. The ingredients are top tier and carefully chosen with your dog's well-being in mind. And apparently it's also delicious, because my dog LOVES it! When I set her food bowl down, she drools on the floor if I wait even just a few seconds to tell her she can eat. She had never ever done this before, and she started doing it the day I started mixing it into her food and has done it since.     Plus, it's great for her. I'm not even halfway through this bag and already her coat is improving! I transitioned slowly from her old food and she has had no negative reactions to it whatsoever. If your dog tolerates this food (all dogs are different of course), you can be confident they will thrive on it. Oh and lastly, Wellness is more readily available than most other holistic grain-free foods, which is very convenient--I buy mine at Petco.

product_title: Innotek UltraSmart 2-Dog Remote Trainer, 300YDS
review_body: A friend told me she paid $250 for her remote trainer, and it's a rather chunky box on a collar. These are great because they are streamlined and work very well. Just putting the collar on is a great deterrent. Plus, the one controller separately activates each of the two collars with the push of a button. Great for my two pits.

product_title: Marineland Eclipse Acrylic Aquarium System
review_body: I bought this tank for my single male Betta, despite the fact that some people say that the current from the filter is too strong for a Betta. Two months after I moved Squall into his new home, he's doing great and loves the current coming out of the filter. He uses the water flow for exercise by swimming against it, then dives to rest. I fit two plants, two statues and a hollow treasure chest in there to provide some scenery. He likes to sleep in the chest and on the leaves, as well as lay against the statues.     The Bio-Wheel filter that removes ammonia proved to be more resilient than I thought, as I had to treat a case of fin rot with antibiotics. Afterwards, I was concerned that I had, literally, killed his filter. But, two weeks later, it was showing bacterial growth, proving that it was still working.     I would recommend this to anyone who wants to find a nice home for a single Betta that is relatively low maintenance and plenty of room for both decorations and the fish.

product_title: Nutri-Vet Hip & Joint Chewable Tablets for Dogs
review_headline: My 7-year-old jumps around like a puppy
review_body:
I gave this to my 7-year-old Shar-Pei mix because he was walking funny from time to time. So I thought he might need some type of supplement to strengthen his hip and joint.
It must have worked because at the moment he is wrestling with a puppy, and he has a huge grin on his face!

product_title: 6 PACK Restor-A-Flex (720 tablets)
review_body: I purchased a six month supply of Restor-A-Flex only to discover upon receipt that the product expiration date was only 30 days away.  I immediately returned the product and now understand that Amazon sells at a small discount merchandise that shortly will not be saleable at any price.

product_title: Pet Supply Imports - Tickler W/Ping Pong Ball 20"
review_body: I have four kitties, and they all seem to enjoy this toy. We have had it for a little over a month, and it seems to be holding up well.

product_title: KONG Air Dog Squeaker Dog Toy
review_body: This toy is great for small dogs... But my dogs had it tore up within hours.. Not good for dogs that ruin toys quickly.

product_title: KONG Cat Wubba, Cat Toy (Colors Vary)
review_headline: My cats loved this Cmas gift!
review_body: I purchased this for my two cats for Christmas.  I was going to wait until Santa could bring it, but one of them immediately hopped onto the table where I was inspecting my purchases.  Colby grabbed the wubba in his mouth, jumped down, dropped onto his side and instantly began biting and kicking it with his hind legs.  So comical!  Soon, the other cat was watching and waiting his turn.  He reacted in the same manner.  They love this toy!!  I am going to order the larger version as soon as I find enough goodies to equal $25 or more for free shipping.

product_title: GoPetClub Cat Furniture Tree Condo Scratcher Post Pet House F2029
review_body: I just got this two days ago and it came in very sturdy box within another sturdy box. It was delivered to my porch and I brought it upstars to my second floor rental in pieces as can't lift the 70 lbs.I am very pleased and my cats have taken to it. One cat is 10 lbs and the other 13 lbs. I bought is so the lighter cat could have a perch to get up from the heavier cat who is a little bit of a bully. No funny odd smells came out of the box or the condo.     I would have given 5 stars if the holes were all drilled correctly. The \\"ladder to nowhere\\" I think is part of the support and rather than leave it off I determined to try to attach it even though only one screw and hole lined up. One screw hole is right at the edge of the cubby and the other screw hole ended up underneath the cubby. Had I know that before I put it all together I could have drilled a different hole that worked. One screw is not enough to make the ladder stable. There is nothing to secure the ladder to the bottom - only two separate screws to each top part. I had to take some short nails and toenail in about 4 small nails to secure the one side. Also the directions are visual and it really took some spacial thinking to get the thing right. Some of the fabric obscures the drilled holes and I stabbed myself trying to open up one of them and left a bit of blood on the wood to show for the effort :).    For the price, size and overall I think it's a good deal. I have a smaller condo by a different manufacturer and I like this brand better.

product_title: Purrfect Leather Bouncer - Cat Toy
review_body: I ordered the Purrfect Leather Bouncer - Cat Toy for my cat and the item that was shipped to me is NOT the item that is shown in the picture for this item on Amazon.com.  I was very disappointed when my order arrived.  The picture on Amazon.com needs to be updated to accurately reflect the item that is being shipped to customers.

product_title: Free Range Moo! Supreme Bully Stick Dog Chew Treat
review_body: We have three dogs and think the Bully Sticks are so much better than the rawhide chews. We love these Bully Sticks because they don't have the horrible odor that is present after your dogs start chewing them like regular Bully Sticks. They are worth the price.

product_title: Soft Crate/Carrier Small Pink 20"Lx14"Wx14"H up to 15Lb
review_body: We bought this for a friend when she got her cat.  The cat just loves it.  She will hang out in the crate during the day and often takes her toys inside.  The cat doens not mind going in the car as she can see her \\"mom\\" driving the car.  It is big and roomy.  In the car the seat belt is wraped through the handels to keep the carier from going airborn in an accident.    I did not see a choice of pink on the web page when I orderd the it.  So I was surprised when it came and was bright pink.  Luckely the cat is a girl and my friend is a girly girl and does not mind bright pink.

product_title: Aran 2 Double-Door Pet Carrier
review_body: I was a little disappointed in the top loading feature.  There is not push lock on top like there is on the front.  You basically pull the grill until it clicks which could be a problem if the cat is not too happy with being put in there.  Otherwise, it is basically a good roomy carrier.  The instructions could have been a little better.

product_title: Frontline Plus for Large dogs 45-88 Lbs (Six Dose)
review_body:
Our 2 puppies got it this year and, as far as I can tell, they are bug-free so far. I can't say whether this is because of Frontline or because there are no fleas in surroundings but, until evidence to the contrary emerges, I will give Frontline the credit.

The makers claim that Frontline Plus kills all fleas and prevents re-infestation for up to one month. For 'paralysis tick' protection, bi-weekly application is recommended but results are not guaranteed.

The product comes in a number of 'pipettes' that contain an oily-sticky liquid that is applied on the back of the dog's neck's, on the skin (must part the coat until the skin is visible). The makers recommend monthly applications.

I found it easy to treat the dogs. Given the relatively high price of this product, I've been using one pipette for our 2 puppies. As they are now big, this may no longer be an option but I can see how this option could be a money saver for anyone who has 2 'not so large' dogs.

I am taking one star away because of the ridiculously high price.

product_title: IRIS Neat 'n Dry Premium Pet Training Pads, Regular, 17.5" x 23.5"
review_headline: Extend the Life of Your Large IRIS Neat 'n Dry Floor Protection
review_body: I have medium and large IRIS floor protection holding devices, and use all IRIS's products religiously. I usually put down a clean large on the bottom, then a clean medium over it. I actually thought I was buying the 17\\" by 23\\" (medium size), so was a bit disappointed when I got the 17\\" by 17\\" (small).  That being said, they are still serve a great need.    My two yorkies can be a bit persnickety and will sometimes use the floor if there is one pee on the large pad, so I simply place the small one on top of the soiled area resulting in the yorkies making better use of the large pad.  Sometimes they pee on the little one again (must be the area they like to pee in), so I just replace it with another small pad.  The small pads are excellent in extending the life and use of the large floor protection pads.

product_title: Ceva Feliway Plug-In Diffuser for Cats
review_body: I've always believed that if something sounds too good to be true then it probably isn't true, but after finally getting tired of our two 4 year old sibling cats constant fighting and more recently, the neutered male spraying, I decided to risk a few bucks and I ordered one defuser for the first floor and one for the second floor.  The final straw that pushed me into trying the Feliway was 5 relatives coming to spend 5 days and 4 nights at our house.  Jackson and Kiri are two people cats and any other people coming into the house causes them to hide under the bed as long as we have guests.  The defusers showed up about the same time as our guests, and while I was probably rude, I installed the two defusers before I even offered our guests a drink. Well, the cats still hid under the bed, but instead of staying there shaking, when either my wife or myself were in the bedroom they came out and were more calm than I have ever seen them.  OK, one day  is one thing, but after 5 days there were no fights (at least between my cats.)  When my company left, they left us with two new cats - calm, quiet, affectionate and so far, no fights, and no marking.  Now I'm not one to believe in miracles and I am sure that sooner or later one cat will bump into the other and a fight will start, but after 6 days my wife and I are stunned by how effective the Feliway seems to be.  My fingers are crossed that it's effect will continue.

product_title: PetSafe Easy Walk Harness
review_body: Our dog tends to run after rabbits & squirrels, and the traditional collar we had was strangling him.  Based on previous reviews we decided to give this a try.    We bought the Large size for our 50 lb. Terrier/ Ridgeback mix.  Although the company web site recommended the Medium-Large size, Amazon only had Medium and Large sizes so we just went with the Large, which covered the size of our dog at the bottom of the range.  Turned out that the harness fit nicely around our dog's body and chest after adjusting the three straps.  Although it took a little getting used to putting it on him, we were able to get the hang of it just a couple of days.    The first day we used it our dog stopped pulling right away.  The front loop gently steered him to the side, which immediately had the effect of giving him subtle feedback that he wasn't supposed to be running.  It has been an absolute pleasure to take our dog out for walks now.    The only complaint is that the front martingale loop tends to loosen towards the side that you walk the dog.  So if you happen to switch sides during a walk the loop starts to sag a bit low on the dog's chest.  This has not been too big a deal for us as the harness fits nicely on our dog and that it is fairly easy to readjust on the fly.

product_title: PetSafe Heated Wellness Sleeper
review_body: I have a little five pound chihuahua who is getting older and is starting to develop arthritis. I purchased the bed, because he was having a hard time getting up on those cold mornings.When we first received the bed I noticed that there were not any indicators (\\"on\\" light, dial or label) which showed that it was turned on. The plug to the wall outlet was the only reference, which could potentially be a hazard if it was left on all day. When we first plugged it in, we didn't notice any heat radiating from the bed, however the instructions detailed putting a blanket over the bed to trap some of the heat, once we did that we did notice the warming effects of the bed.   Anytime my Chi hops into bed, and sits there for any length of time, he does get warm, not too warm but just warm enough. His mobility has definitely improved. I would recommend this bed, with a cautionary note to keep an eye on whether it is plugged in or not.

product_title: Dogswell Happy Hips for Dogs
review_headline: Great treat for your precious critters!
review_body: Dogswell has continued to live up to its stellar reputation with these additive free, wholesome treats for dogs.  I give all of my four footed babies these treats and it adds to an organic diet already rich in good food.  I have yet to meet any pup who doesn't love these treats both for the chewy, crunchy needs that dogs need, but also for the total nutrition it provides.  If you are worried about the latest pet food recalls from China, these treats have never had to be recalled.

product_title: World's Best 00098 Cat Litter, Clumping Formula
review_body: I loved Swheat, but thought I'd check out the more-expensive alternative:  World's Best corn litter.    Both are a natural resource that supports our farmers.    The Swheat actually forms clumps that are as hard as rocks.  World's Best Corn Litter had slightly softer clumps.    The Swheat had an inert smell when new....but also never did start to smell for the 4 weeks it was in my two-cat's box.  World's Best Corn Litter has a yucky sour corn smell when new....and after just 3 days...it began to stink in the litter box.  And yes, I'm at home all day so I scoop twice a day, sometimes more.  Imagine how it would smell if it wasn't scooped very often, like so many cat owners do.    Swheat was $8.99 for a big box at Walmart.  World best Corn Litter was $20 for a comparable size    Swheat wins!

product_title: Lentek Bark Free Dog Training Device
review_body: I had a neighbor that would put their dog outside.  Of course it was anytime I wanted to relax/sleep.  I gave it some time before ordering this product, but desperately needed quite.  The dog would bark consistently without much pause, if only for seconds distracted by a leaf or something.  It was obvious the dog just wants attention from owner, but I need rest.  I tracked this item daily in anticipation to use it.  Finally the day came and I immediately tested it, on the far end of the house so as not to annoy family or my dog.  Ok so the audible tone works (OUCH), and even the \\"inaudible\\" is somewhat audible.  Now I couldn't wait to install and test.  Of course I pointed it towards their yard and plugged in.  I haven't seen that dog since! :)

product_title: Dogswell Vitality for Dogs, Lamb & Sweet Potato Stew Recipe, 13-Ounce Cans (Pack of 12)
review_body: Only gave it four stars because I can only judge by reading the label and if the dogs like it! The dogs seem to enjoy it very much! It seems to be a good grade dog food!

product_title: GoGo Pet Products High Epoxy Exercise Pen with Door for Dogs, 24-Inch, Black
review_body: The product was exactly how the seller described it and the shipping was fast and thorough tracking was available. The product has great quality workmanship. This is my second purchase from this seller and I would definitely do business with again in the future.

product_title: Chris Christensen Wood Pin Brush 20mm Small 7.5 inches
review_body: Just got a new Havanese puppy who hated to be brushed with usual brushes. This wooden brush with wood bristles is so comfortable for my little pet. Gives her a good massage and very gentle on her coat, makes her hair shine! This is my second brush order... my husband has curly hair and used this brush before our pet and he wants this one for his golf bag, it feels so good on human heads too!!

product_title: FURminator Medium Yellow Deshedding Tool with 2-2/3-Inch Edge
review_headline: the furminator performance on my cat and dog
