And it works even better on my calico cat  THe medium size was just right for both a large dog and medium size cat.

product_title: Isle of Dogs Coature No. 33 Coarse Coat Dog Shampoo for wire or crisp coats, 8.4 oz
review_body: After trying recommendation after recommendation on dog shampoos, I finally found one product that I absolutely love. No. 33 Coarse Coat works the best for my show Bearded Collie. It doesn't change the texture of his coat, but still leaves him clean. It has a fresh scent that's not too over-powering. His hair is healthy and has unbelievable shine.

product_title: Wee Cleaner - Pet Urine Odor Remover for Cat and Dog Urine (32-ounce bottle)
review_headline: Unbelievable at how well it works !
review_body: I have to say I thought this would be just another waste of money, but I WAS wrong!  This absolutely got rid of cat urine smell after only one use!  I've tried every product available for 16 years and this is the only one that works.  I have a 16 year old cat that has had behavior problems since he was 6 mths old and ate a shoestring that tore in intestines and he had 2 surgeries for it.  He has been urinating on various spots in my house for years.  We've tore up carpet, cleaned carpet and nothing worked until I brought Wee Cleaner.  I'm thinking of investing in the company!  What a great product!  If it gets rid of cat urine, it can get rid of anything!

product_title: Ultra Paws Durable Dog Boot Small Red
review_headline: Good quality but takes time for dog to get used to
review_body: I bought these boots to protect my dog from salted, snowy roads. She has only worn them once so far. Although she hated them and stumbled and slipped several times until she learned to adjust her gait, she managed to walk 2 miles with me and learned to walk in them like a champ. The boots stayed on the entire time, even though she stopped to try to get them off periodically. She did manage to unhook one of the Velcro straps. I had to brush the snow off to get it to stick again, but then it was OK the rest of the walk. Once home when I took the boots off my dog, she ran off and sulked. I expect that it will take her some time and conditioning to get used to them. I would definitely recommend these boots for quality and protection. Ease of use probably depends on the temperament of the dog and the owner's patience.

product_title: FURminator Medium Yellow Deshedding Tool with 2-2/3-Inch Edge
review_headline: Furminator all they say and more
review_body: My son saw an ad a couple years ago for the furminator brush and wanted me to get one for our shed-like-crazy lab and border collie. It looks like you could stuff a pillow with all the hair on the ground after brushing outside, and there is so much less dog hair in the house. I will never be without this tool again.

product_title: White Dogs Rule Collar Bowl
review_body: Replaced the one that broke, love the bowl!  Very cute, need to get a tag w/ my dog's name on it.

product_title: Doggles Cast of Characters Dog Toy

product_title: Richell Wood Easy-Lock Pet Gate, Mahogany Finish

product_title: K&H Manufacturing Thermo-Kitty Cabin

product_title: Petmate Ultra Bubbler Watering System, Medium, Peacock Blue
review_body: MY CATS LOVE THIS WATER BOWL AND SO DO I. GREAT PRICE, I DIDN'T PAY SHIPPING AND IT ARRIVED THE NEXT DAY. product_title: PetSafe Busy Buddy Tug-A-Jug Meal Dispensing Dog Toy
review_headline: Wish they hadn't changed this toy
review_body: I originally purchased this item back in March of last year.  It worked out great with my yellow lab in dispensing a meal a day.  This version of the toy had an actual rope coming out of the jug.  After about half a year, the rope wore through, but given the low price of the toy, I was satisfied with 6 months of heavy use and recommended it to friends.    I then purchased a replacement end of last year.  Unfortunately, the manufacturers had changed the toy so now it's a rubber rope in place of the original fiber one.  This toy lasted about 15 minutes before my dog had completely chewed through it, making the toy nearly useless.    5 stars for the original version, 1 for new and unimproved.

product_title: Evolution Peticure Elite  Rotary Nail File, 9.6 Volt
review_headline: An as-seen-on-TV items that actually works!
review_body:
PROS: Quality construction, rechargeable, easy to use, fairly quiet, actually works! After clipping my dog's nails, they would be jagged and razor sharp, resulting in bloody gashes on our arms and legs when we played with him. This solves that problem!

CONS: The guard is a pain. I took it off. My dog didn't like the guard for some reason. It's easier to use with the guard off and it really doesn't make a mess anyway. With the guard on the filing bands kept slipping down, causing me to stop, take the guard off, and reposition the band. The battery can only be charged for 4 hours. You have to basically set a timer so you won't overcharge it.

SUGGESTIONS: Works great but took about a week before my dog allowed me to use it on him. Treats, praise, treats praise! Don't give up. I wish the filing band was hourglass shaped, so it would round the nail easier, but oh well. Still worth it. It takes a while to get the nail as short as I want it. I do one paw a night. It's a nightly routine now.

product_title: Four Paws Fine Long Coat Dog Grooming Comb
review_body: this comb is okay but, it really didn't work for my cat.  it just doesn't grab enough hair.

product_title: Bentley's Pills Dog Bone-Shaped Pet Pill Medication Container for You or Your Pet
review_body: I'm so glad I bought this! My pet-sitters won't ever have to dig through my cabinets for medication anymore, and it's cute enough to put out on the counter-top, unlike other boring pill organizers. These would make great stocking stuffers!

product_title: Pet Shower Deluxe (Chrome)
review_body: This item really does what it is supposed to do. It was easy to install, easy to use and to store.

product_title: ANGELS' Eyes Tear-Stain Remover for Dogs, 240 Grams - BEEF
review_body: I heard great things about Angel Eyes from other owners dealing with tear stains.     I shopped around the net for Angel Eyes to get the best price possible.   I seemed that Amazon had the best price and with free shipping it seemed like the best choice.     I ordered a 240 gram bottle and received a shipment a few days later.  I was surprised to see that both protective seals were broken and the bottle was only 1/2 full. I measured the contents and it was only about 175 grams. In addition, for safety reasons I would never give my dag something that wasnt sealed.     So I submitted a replacement request and sent back the bottle.  A few days later I received a second package with THE EXACT SAME ISSUS.  Nothing sealed, 1/3 missing.  The interior seal clearly states, \\"sealed for your protection\\" yet the 2 bottles I received from Amazon were NOT sealed.     Not suprisingly I immedialtey retured the product for the second time and asked for a full refund.     It is worth the additional money to receive what I purchased and make sure it is safe for my dog.     Anyone looking into buying Angel Eyes via Amamzon...BEWARE!!!

product_title: Viralys (L-Lysine) Oral Gel For Cats, 5 oz
review_body: My vet recommended this product for my cat who has chronic FHV.  Her nose was always congested, her eyes running, and she used to sneeze constantly.  This really cleared up the symptons within a few days. She suggested half dose, or once a day, would be enough for my cat once the symptoms were gone.  That helps with the cost, and seems to work as well as the full dose.  My biggest surprise is that my cat LOVES it!  I just squeeze a small amount on a dish and she licks it right up.  So easy, and well worth the expense. Medi-Vet Animal Health has the best prices on Amazon for this product.

product_title: Kong Classic Dog Toy
review_body: 11/2 yr old choc. lab gives this a work out and it wins hands down.  And this dog is an aggressive chewer I've bought others and he goes through them but the Kongs last and they def. have bounce to each ounce.  I will only buy them as well as recommend them....

product_title: Pet Gear Bike Basket 3-in-1 Car Seat / Carrier / Bike Basket for Cats and Small Dogs, 14-inches
review_body: Afraid I really cannot rate it as of yet for it is a Christmas gift and has not been opened yet. I will review it further after the Holidays and let you know what we think of it.  But as far as the actual transaction, it was fast and thorough.  A pleasure doing business with these folks!

product_title: Panic Mouse Kitty Go Krazy
review_body: This has been our two 11 year old cats' favorite toy for years now. I highly recommend the feather replacement wands which used to come standard in the package--but I'm not sure they do now. I always track the feather wands down as they are well worth it. The cats do eventually get so in to the hunt that the wands will need to be replaced and the feathers especially appeal to their bird hunting instict i think. You can set variable speeds by turning the red knob if you want to start your cat off slower. My 2 indoor cats like it full speed and it's great stimulation for them. (I did buy another brand's version of this toy once as a second toy for my cats and neither cat would play with it so after a year i gave it away to another cat who didn't want it either.)This one's AWESOME!

product_title: PetSafe Tennis Tail Raccoon Dog Toy
review_headline: Lots of fun for my stuffed animal loving dog
review_body: This is holding up better than most stuffed animals I get for my border collie mix.  It's easier to throw, and goes farther.  But the tennis ball is very heavy, so watch out for furniture if you're throwing it inside.

product_title: Virbac C.E.T. HEXtra Premium Oral Hygiene Chews (Packaging May Vary)
review_body: These are great chews for keeping your dog's teeth clean and breath smelling nice. I do recommend using a dog toothpaste and brush every other day also. I have a Cocker Spaniel and they are notorious for having gum problems. She is going to be 12 years old in July and her teeth look pretty darn good with all the work we have done!

product_title: PARTRADE P Boot Jacks
review_body: a very functional boot remover.... 2nd one i've purchased.... so very easy to remove my cowboy boots; wouldn't be w/o one....

product_title: Solvit Products 62283 Deluxe Bench Seat Cover Natural, Large
review_body: I use this in my Infiniti G37 sedan. It works fine and stays in place when I take my 2 dogs (both 60+ lbs) to the vet every couple of weeks. I also have leather seats and do not have a problem with it moving around.    One thing to be aware of is that the \\"web straps\\" are meant to loop around the posts which are used to adjust the rear seat headrests. In my case, the headrests do not adjust and are flush with the top of the seat. As an alternative, I asked the manufacturer to send me to 2 extra \\"web straps\\" which I used with the existing straps, to attach the top of the cover to the car seat brackets on the rear deck of the car. This worked perfectly and the cover now stays in place with no problems.    All in all a great product backed by a great company who was willing to work with me to help me get the cover to fit perfectly!

product_title: Coat Handler Skin Works, 4oz jar
review_body: I'm a professional groomer. I was shaving down a very matted, older dog when I noticed the blade getting hotter than I could seem to cool it down. I was using my clippers on high to get thru the coat and repeatedly changing blades along with using Kool Lube spray to try and keep the blade cool but apparently it wasn't quite enough b/c afterward I noticed the skin on the sensitive underside of his neck was beginning to turn bright pink and red in spots along with being warm to the touch. I immediately bathed him in cool water and oatmeal shampoo. Afterward I liberally applied The Skin Works cream to the area. I checked it in 1/2 hour expecting it to be worse or at least look the same as it had but, the skin was already back to a healthy color with only minor residual pink spots. I'm sold on this product! That's the first time I've used to for this purpose, and I'm amazed at how well it worked! I feel that it totally prevented a burn from becoming worse and turning into an injury. I'm going to buy more to use on myself if I ever burn my skin at home. Whew! What a life saver.

product_title: K&H Thermo-Kitty Heated Cat Bed
review_body: before i even had the bed warmed up, my cat was making it her home.  she still sleeps part of the night in bed with me, but loves sleeping in her bed too.

product_title: PetSafe Extreme Weather Energy Efficient Pet Door, Unique 3 Flap System, White, for Dogs and Cats
review_body: This pet door is awesome.  My dog took a few days to get used to it, but after he did he uses it all of the time.  It works great!  Even during the extreme cold days I could not feel any draft coming through this door.  It seals really good.  I wish I would have bought this door a year ago when my dog was a puppy.  Since I installed this door, no more accidents inside!

product_title: PetAg Mirra Coat
review_body: We raised and show Irish Setters and this product is used to make a food supplement that gives them beautiful coats. Have used this product for many years and love it!

product_title: Molly and Friends Two-Tier Scratching Post Furniture
review_body: Tabby's Hide-Away arrived today. I must say, the packaging was iffy, but the contents were intact. It's very sturdy. My cat is still checking it out, but I think it's going to be a hit. Plus, it's just so darned cute. Kind of silly, but that's what attracted me in the first place. I like silly. Looks like something I might make, if I wanted to deal with finding appropriate materials, attaching carpet and sisal. Which I certainly do not. Best left to the experts. I think Molly & Friends is the best maker of cat furniture out there. I expect many years of happy play for my cat. I would have liked more color options, although the beige does fit in with my boring, generic apartment carpet.

product_title: CSF-3 Cat Super Feeder with Analog Timer, Chute Cover, Stand and Bowl, Automatic Pet Feeder for up to 48 Daily Meals 4 3/4 Cups Capacity Optionally Expandable
review_body: This feeder has made my life far, far easier. While expensive, it was worth every penny. The assembly and programming for the manual timer was easy--took about 15 minutes.     My cat has ripped every other cat feeder we've had to pieces within a week or so. She used to beg for food incessantly. We're now feeding her four times a day and have been able to get a decent night's sleep--my girlfriend and I live in a smallish apartment and the cat used to be unbelievably loud when screaming for food at night.    She does rake around in the feeder opening for extra food, but I'm surprised other reviewers have mentioned their cat actually got at the stored food in the feeder, as it's quite well protected. The only food my cat can actually get to is the few pieces that have been caught in the passage leading out of the feeder--not to the actual store itself above. Her paws can't reach that far.      Overall a great product.

product_title: FURminator Medium Yellow Deshedding Tool with 2-2/3-Inch EdgeFURminator deShedding Tool
review_body: The Furminator has made my life incredibly easier.  I have a short-haired Red Heeler mutt who sheds an absolutely ridiculous amount of fur.  RIDICULOUS.  It was affecting my relationship with my slightly-OCD man, b/c although we brushed him daily, swept 4Xweek, and changed the air filters regularly, it felt like I was trying to grow a carpet for my hardwood floors.      Then my sister let me borrow her Furminator.  The beast weighs about 40 lbs...very lanky and athletic.  The first treatment, I pulled off about two cups of fur.  That's 16 ounces by volume.  To put it in perspective, that is bigger than a can of soda (by 1/3).  So the next day I tried again and pulled off about 1 cup.  He really looked like he lost weight.    I promptly bought this one from Amazon.    It has been about a month now since the Furminator blessed my life.  I sweep twice a week instead of four times.  When the beast shakes or people give him a good scratch-down, little furballs don't erupt from his coat.  Although the \\"Cedar\\" microfiber dusting mop helps (from Target, but there are tons on the market), I give the ol' Furminator a lot of credit for my new ability to walk around in socks without looking like Big Foot.      I Furminate him almost every day, and I still usually pull off about 1/4 cup of fur if I really get into it.  That's 1/4 cup of fur we don't have sticking to our clothes or hiding under the couch.  I've already given one of these away, and I plan to give more.      BIG fan.

product_title: Roll n Clean Self Cleaning Litter Box
review_body: this is the eiest litter box to clean. You could do it everyday it is so easy. It is larger than a normal box, but I would find room for this for the ease of cleaning it!

product_title: Cat Zoom Groom - Assorted Colors
review_body:
A friend sent it, or I would never have believed the publicity. No clue why it doesn't pull their fur and hurt, but it's all true--the catties LUV it to death. Middle cat even sits pointedly on the ottoman next to it, giving it a rub with the pincushions now and then to indicate his willingness to be brushed, and brushed, and...

Be dressed in disposables when you groom the gang, because there will be surplus fur like you've never seen, floating out of cat coats like zero-gravity. On our first flight, I got a canteloupe-sized furball out of one smooth-haired cat; the next day, another almost as large from the same cat. He should be naked by now, but nope, status quo. The only negative report comes from the Cow Cat, who does not allow anyone to make decisions about her location, position or grooming, but even she tends to close her eyes and relax for a minute, before she remembers to be outraged and jets away. Try it. Just TRY it!

product_title: Richell Wood Easy-Lock Pet Gate, Mahogany Finish
review_body: I love this gate.  It is clean, polished and so much better than using a baby gate to keep the dogs out of rooms I prefer they not go in. This is well worth the money.  It opens easy and is very easy to set up and take down.

product_title: FURminator Medium Yellow Deshedding Tool with 2-2/3-Inch Edge
review_body: What a help for the constant shedding of 2 German Shepherds (aka German \\"Shedders\\")!  I ordered this smaller version for our neighbor who tried our furminator and loved it for his shih tzu.  Highly recommend this tool.

product_title: Bag Clipper (1-pack)
review_headline: Simple little device that keeps the poop away
review_body: I love this little clipper.  I think it's a simple little device that holds poop in the little clipper.  I can't tell you how many times I've been tempted to a) leave the poop where it is because I don't want to carry the doo, or b) walk straight into someone's backyard to dump the poop.  But because of this little device, I'm able to carry the poop without actually touching the bag, until I find a trash can.  I see that some of the other reviewers say they had a hard time clipping the bag onto the clipper.  I have not had such issues. However, I do use one of those doggy poop bags and not a supermarket bag to pick up after my dog, so that may be an issue of size.  I think this device is great for someone who wants to be a responsible dog walker.

product_title: H20 Animal Hydration Flow Automatic Waterer
review_body: Although this bowl is advertised as stainless steel, it is actually just a chrome-dipped metal bowl. I'm a recent buyer, so I can't attest to longevity, but don't believe that you'll be getting an actual stainless watering bowl for such a small price. Regardless, for the convenience this bowl provides, one should not be too awfully upset that it needs to be replaced every so often. I mean, do you buy a garden hose or sprayer and expect it to last for more than a couple of years?

product_title: Multipet Curly Pets Dog Toy, Monkey
review_body: This is the only animal toy that my puppy hasn't chewed or ripped apart yet. Iv'e had it three months and my puppy still plays with it, although the squeker did break after about a couple of weeks... and its gone through the wash a few times (i haven't put it in the dryer though)    i'd recommmend it for anyone with a puppy or smaller dog (i have a black lab but shes not a 'power chewer')

product_title: OUT! Natural Pet Stain and Odor Remover, 32-Fluid Ounce
review_body: this is the best product I have found for removal of doggie stains and odors.

product_title: KONG Cat Hugga Wubba, Cat Toy (Colors Vary)
review_body: This toy was recently purchased for Christmas but my cats showed no interest in it after the first couple of minutes so it's going in the pile to be donated.  I really thought they would like it because of the texture but boy was I wrong. Oh well, perhaps by donating it some other cats may find it amusing.

product_title: SentryPRO XFC Flea and Tick Squeeze-On for Dogs
review_body: This is what I wrote to the Sentry Company:  Let me start by stating how angry and frustrated I am with your company for distributing this poisonous product and to add to that, there was no warning label to prepare us for any side effects. We applied the medication and went to work. Hours later we returned home to a whimpering, crying, tortured dog. He had defecated in his area, something that he was trained very well not to do, and never does. I can only imagine that he was in so much pain and anguish that he eventually lost control of his bowel and bladder. He had not touched his food or water. He had chewed and clawed the door to pieces. Mind you, he is a normally a calm, 9 lb., Shih Tzu lap dog and has never destroyed a thing in his life, ever! Nowhere on your box, label, or leaflet was there mention of any possible side effects, especially side effects as grave as excruciating pain at the area where the product was applied! My dog was essentially tortured for 9 straight hours without us there. For the following 24 hours, my dog laid twitching and crying on the bed as my husband rubbed his neck while chanting \\"I'm sorry, I'm so sorry\\" over and over.  We didn't sleep at all that night and day. We took turns rubbing his neck, which seemed to soothe the pain just a bit and we ended up bathing him with dishwashing soap 5 times. We felt so helpless. I truly thought our dog, our baby, was going to die. My husband and I felt guilty for inadvertently abusing our dog, but it is your company that should feel guilty. You knowingly distributed this toxic product without a warning label. It is your responsibility to disclose the whole truth about your product to the consumers. My dog has gradually gotten better since then, but he is NOT the same as he once was. He has maintained his compulsion to chew and claw the door, something that he has never done before using Sentry. He also has an uncontrollable body twitch now and I just pray that he has not suffered any permanent neurological damage. It has been a week and countless baths and he still shakes his head and paws at his neck where the medication was applied. Other long-term effects have yet to be seen. After reading up on this product, I found out that it is a neurotoxin and I can look forward to cancer, neurologic problems, weigh loss, organ damage ect.

product_title: Pampered Pet Jogging Stroller for Small Dogs and Cats
review_headline: Safe for taking my bunny out and about!
review_body: I bought this stroller for my 4 pound lop-eared bunny. We have it in the pink color since she is a girl. It came in the mail very quickly, took a few minutes to assemble, and looks so adorable! I can fit the bunny in it plus two of her blankets, a ziplock with timothy hay, and a toy all in the top. I keep my cellphone in the compartment on the handlebar with cups when going on walks, and store extra bunny things in the basket underneath. She loves to ride in it around the neighborhood, to the vet, or to other animal events. The downsides are that the stroller is hard to control because of the front wheel twisting, the cup holder is hard to snap on when first assembling, and the stroller is to tall for my bunny to jump in/out of on her own. It would be great if they sold a weather shield to go with this, because my bunny loves walks all year round! :] I also like that I can fold the stroller up small enough to fit in the car with most of her stuff still in it. People do think I'm strange to have a bunny stroller, though.

product_title: Multi Pet Boingo Ball 5in Large Rubber Dog or Bird Toy
review_body: Our dog is neurotically obsessed with this toy. She literally wakes up in the middle of the night, and forces us to wake up so she can go out of the bedroom to get this ball. We sometimes have to put it on a shelf because she will not stop playing with it. Although it's less annoying than a squeaky toy, it does get annoying when the dog has played with it for more than 2 hours at a time. All in all...GREAT TOY!

product_title: KONG Flyer Dog Toy
review_body: I bought this frisbee when my [[ASIN:B000084E5B Nylabone Rainbow Frisbee for Large Dogs (Assorted Colors) (assorted colors - 9'' diameter (for Large dogs))]] went missing. The Nylabone had lasted for about six months with no problems.    By the time my yellow lab/german shepherd mix brought the Kong Flyer back ON THE FIRST THROW, he had chewed a hole in it.    This product cannot be returned based on what your dog does to it -- it is \\"not a chew toy,\\" and so neither Kong, nor Amazon holds any responsibility for holes, etc. due to chewing.    If your dog chews on his or her frisbee, I strongly recommend NOT buying the Kong Flyer. It is wimpy wimpy wimpy, and anything but \\"chew proof\\" or \\"indestructible.\\"

product_title: Greenies Dental Chews - 27 ounce Box - Teenie - 96 count
review_body: I give these to my dog to help with her minor tartar problems. She LOVES them and they definitely do the job.     One of my favorite things about them is that they are sturdy and coated enough that I can freeze them--I put one in a small plastic bag (snack bag folded in half) full of water and freeze it for a few hours. Then my dog has to lick and crunch up the ice to get to the treat, which keeps her busy AND gets her more fluids. Most dog treats tend to dissolve and become mushy when you do this with them, but these guys definitely hold up.

product_title: Coleman Pet Toy
review_body: I purchased several Coleman dog toys recently and they are all very high quality, sturdy and safe.  I was so impressed that I will continue to buy only Coleman toys.

product_title: Bamboo Cat Toids Breath Mints for Cats
review_body:
DogToids and CatToids, a \\"ferociously flavorful\\" breath mint for our four-legged friends, is touted as the new breath mint hot on the market. While they may look like your Altoids, don't confuse the two brands... as these two companies had to duke it out in litigation back in 2007 about trademarks, marketing, and all that good stuff. Thankfully, all is resolved. The great news is the containers are so cute, you're unlikely to confuse the tins and accidentally pop in a liver, beef, or salmon-flavored treat for yourself.

These China-made tins are colorful and very easy to open (thanks to a \\"Press\\" design). On the back of the container, the company describes what a \\"Toid\\" is - a smart marketing gimmick to avoid any association with Altoids. They describe Toids as being \\"short for Topographical Identifications\\" which are \\"used in mapping systems to identify ever surface down to speed bumps.\\" They then state how these [PetToids] help \\"map out and help freshen all of the crevices and surfaces within your [pet's] mouth.\\" I found this to be a bit of a stretch for using the word \\"toid,\\" but I give them credit for creativity. As for the American-made breath mint itself: I was pleasantly surprised to see how cute the shapes were (bone shaped for dogs, cat shaped for cats), but quickly realized my cats wouldn't touch the CatToids. Not only is the CatToid treat itself too big for cats, but it's just not appealing - cats prefer that propylene glycol-filled soft treat, and these CatToids are quite hard - in fact, they remind me of a big, odd-shaped, liver-reeking pill that's hard to swallow. One of my fat cats who eats everything (even his Heartgard monthly pill), wouldn't touch them. That said, the DogToids are very palatable! JP, my pit bull, stood ready to hoover up any leftover CatToids, and rapidly ate his own while chewing it with glee. JP is my true test for treats, as he's extremely picky, so this was a good sign.

Overall, these breath mints make cute treats for your pet, but I wouldn't necessarily buy them for breath freshening properties. In the DogToid, parsley leaf is the 5th out of 8 ingredients (remember, products are listed in the order of amount), so it's unlikely to have a breath-freshening effect compared to the way you might chew on a fresh, raw parsley leaf. For the CatToid, parsley leaf is the 7th out of 9 ingredients - again, making it less likely to have an effect on breath. Kudos to the company Bamboo for adding taurine, an important essential amino acid necessary in a cat's diet (for those crazy people who might make CatToids their permanent primary diet). Bamboo also uses chlorophyll in the CatToid, which is the green pigment in most plants, and recently was made popular in the dental treat \\"Greenies.\\" As the last ingredient however, it's unlikely to help with bad breath (especially when it's used in such a small amount). So in summary, cute tin (not kid- or pet-proof, so be careful!), decent palatability, and unlikely to truly wipe away bad breath compared to teeth brushing and dental cleanings, but if you don't mind your dog having meat-flavored breath, go for it.r pet, but I wouldn't necessarily buy them for breath freshening properties. product_title: Frontline Plus Flea and Tick Control for Cats and Kittens, 6 MO. SUPPLY
review_headline: Save $ by purchasing on amazon.com rather than from vet
review_body: I have two cats and they LOVE being outside.  With that means keeping them safe and comfortable by not having fleas and ticks.  I have left the vet (whom I think the world of by the way) and have spent $150 on just Frontline.  A friend of mine told me she buys online and would not be able to have her pets if she had to buy Frontline from the vet.  I made my first purchase last month and if I had been doing this all these years, I'd have a LOT more money in my pocket (or savings) or whatever.  Sorry that the economy had to bottom out before I wised up.

product_title: NOZTONOZ Sof-Krate Indoor/Outdoor Pet Home
review_body: We love this crate...so do our Poms. We bought one and loved it, so we had to get another. The recommendation about dogs being housebroken is true, so keep that in mind.

product_title: Angels' Eyes Tear-Stain Eliminator for Dogs and Cats, Beef Flavor, 120 Grams Bottle
review_body: I read the reviews for this product off of the Angel Eyes website. It works awesome. I have a cream Frenchie who  started to get the horrible red eye stains. After 3 weeks of using it the eye stains started to disappear. Very easy to use, just sprinkle on the food once a day.

product_title: PETaPOTTY Original
review_headline: Provides a good spot for doing their business, but clean up is hard
review_body: I got a pet a potty for my two dogs when I moved into an apartment.  It stays out on the terrace.  Training the dogs to use it took about a week.  There were a few accidents, but we treated it like housebreaking (taking them out often and guiding them onto the potty, saying \\"potty!\\" and giving praise for using it) and they caught on pretty quick.  It has been great to have a place for them to use the bathroom without always having to take them for a walk.      My big beef comes with clean-up.  In short, it's really hard to clean.  If you have a garden hose it probably wouldn't be too bad, but otherwise it's just tough.  The drainage into the pan isn't too great, so the grass stays soggy with urine.  The pan itself is too big to pick up easily, so for a while we were using a plastic cup to scoop from the pan into a bucket which we then threw into the toilet.  The worst is when it rains, because the whole thing fills up.  We just bought a cheap water hand pump from Amazon and that has made it a lot easier.  Knowing what I know now, I probably would have gone with something like the pooch porch, which is easier to clean.

product_title: Richell Wood Freestanding Pet Gate
review_body: The fact that this is a free standing gate makes it very versatile.  I purchased both the small and the large so I can move them around and use them in different areas.  The height is perfect for small dogs, especially when placed on areas without carpeting (they can't launch off of hardwood floors easily).  The height also makes them easy to step over.  I always get positive comments about the appearance when guests visit.  They look like furniture.

product_title: PetSafe Simply Clean Self-Cleaning Cat Litter Box, Automatic, Works with Clumping Cat Litter
review_headline: Pet safe Litter Box - mostly good, but learning to use it
review_body: The petsafe continuous clean litter box works very well if everything is set up exactly right, but I'm still learning how to ensure everything is optimal.  It's very important to have the litter up to the line, and type of litter matters, ie. Arm and Hammer Superscoop works better than Arm and Hammer multicat.  It seems to break the clumps into tiny pieces sometimes, making it hard to keep the litter clean.  I scoop it once per day to try to get all lumps out.    Positives:  The two cats, one young and one old, took to it without any problem, and seem to like it.  There is very little spillage of litter or missing the box (which happened with my old litter box).  Also, it runs very quietly, and is not too unattractive in an open location (my only option).    In summary, I like it, but wish it was more consistent in clumping the litter. There is a definite learning curve.  I am going to try other brands of clumping litter to see if there is one that works best.  Generally, I recommend this unit.  I am able to avoid constant scooping of the litter box, which was my goal in getting this one.

product_title: Neck's Best Thing Collar
review_body: I was very unhappy with this product.  Although easy to use, it most certainly did not do the job.  Ended up giving it to the animal shelter

product_title: Hylox Soft Chews
review_headline: We have our dog back again!
review_body: This product shipped and arrived as expected from [...].  Most importantly [[ASIN:B001AIU182 Hylox Soft Chews (120 ct)]] is working as claimed.  We have an 8 year old German Shepard who had become slower and did not get up so fast.  Last October (2009) we began treating after this product was recommended by our vet.  The results are unbelievable!  Even after a few days we could see it beginning to work.  This is clearly making a strong positive difference.  We have our dog back again!  She gets up and runs and plays like when she was 2.  She loves the chews and thinks they are candy.  I am very picky about what products I use and my Vet is even more careful about recommending anything.  There are other joint supplements but this one has a different combination of active ingredients that cannot be found in stores.  I have no reservation recommending this product.

product_title: Armarkat Dog Cat Pet Bed Mat House Bag 34*28 D01FSL-M
review_body: We bought this cage for my son's hamster. The cage was easy to build and the little guy seemed to enjoy it. We never had a problem with this cage. It was used the entire lifetime of our hamster. Although our beloved hamster is no longer with us his cage is still very livable.   We still have the cage so if my son ever decides he is ready for another hamster we will have the equipment to house another small friend.

product_title: Cat Mate C50 Automatic Pet Feeder
review_body: we've just purchased another \\"cat mate c50\\" after having the same product for 17 years.  we got our first one after our first cat was diagnosed with feline diabetes and needed regularly spaced, specific amounts of food.  it worked flawlessly.  between the \\"cat mate\\" feedings and the medical help, the cat lived another 12 years.      when we got out current cat five years ago, we continued to use the \\"cat mate\\" hoping the feeding pattern would keep her on the healthy side of life.  only recently has age caught up with the unit, thus the purchase of a new one.      I would highly recommend the unit, though taping in the battery is a must (as another reviewer had mentioned) and I would only recommend using it with dry food.

product_title: Hyper Gnaws Dog Toys FLYING DISC - Hyper Gnaws Dog Toys
review_body: These dog toys are made from soft woven cloth.  From the pictures and name \\"Hyper Gnaws\\", we thought it would be a much heavier material, perhaps canvas. Our 9-month old lab ripped a hole in the cloth within 5 minutes.  The weave seems to make it easier to destroy.  So these toys are banned in our house and will be given to someone with a less hyper friend.

product_title: Charming Pet Products Jeff. E. Coli Squeaky Latex Dog Toy
review_body: The product was okay, but it took two weeks to get to me, when I was supposed to get it in two days. They shouldn't advertise something saying it was in stock when it wasn't.  I think the company should have discounted it, or thrown in an extra goody to make up for their mistake - that would be good customer service.

product_title: Fun Dog Toys: Zanies Barnyard Grunters: Sheep
review_body: Sheep size is great but feel the shipping is too high (costs more to ship than the product) and since my dog chews the squeak out of toy soon after he gets the toy maybe manufacturing one without the squeak would be a good idea!

product_title: Outward Hound Kyjen   Urban Adventure Dog Backpack, Colors Vary
review_body: This is an excellent back-pack for my cocker spaniel/Cav. King Charles dog.  This is the only back pack that I found that is the right size for her.  Not too big, not too small. It has plenty of pockets with zippers and velcro. Very sturdy I might add too!  VERY easy to put on her.  I DEFINITELY recommend this to the med/small size dog. A+++++!

product_title: Eco Natural MOO! Select Odor Free Bully Stick
review_body: Excellent product!  I've brought home different bully sticks and these are by far the best.  They do not smell, they do not stain and my dog loves them!  Seller was excellent and shipped quick.  Thank you.

product_title: Purina Fancy Feast Classic Gourmet Variety Pack Wet Cat Food - (24) 3 oz. Cans
review_body: At $16.49 a case, that's $.68 a can. NOT a deal. Even if you sign up to have this product delivered regularly for $14.02, that's still $.58 a can, which is still no bargain. PetsMart sells this product for $.53 if you have a PetPerks card; Walmart sells it for $.53 period. If you live in an area that has no Walmart or PetsMart, I suggest shopping around a bit -- there's bound to be a better deal somewhere on the Internet.

product_title: Omega Paw Self-Cleaning Litter Box, Green and Beige
review_headline: Yes, I'm writing a review...for a cat box....
review_body: So, this is, oh, the 4th litter box we've been through for our wonderful, but stinky, cat. We did the regular sort (litter gets kicked everywhere), the big enclosed sort (too big and heavy to clean easily, and it takes up too much space to be such a pain), and the kind from Walmart that has the 3 layers you have to sift through and then dump back into itself (same problem as the enclosed one, but even dustier). Finally, I did a little Amazon research back in January for automated cat boxes, and I discovered that no, a motorized box that scoops *for* me was NOT the answer to the problem, but that this box just might be.    So, in order for the Omega Paw to work, you do have to have the right amount of good clumping litter (we like Fresh Step Lavender Valley because it smells great and actually stays clumped). Too little, and the bottom gets dirty, but too much, and the litter won't fit into the side compartment and will instead end up in the side tray. You also need to actually roll the box on a daily basis, or--at least with *our* dear little friend--the litter gets too filled up with clumps in the smallish space left for him to do his thing in. BUT this box is so easy to clean, that we're actually better about doing it every day than we've ever been before.     Conclusion: We love this box, if it is possible to love a litter box. Yeah, we said it.

product_title: FURminator Medium Yellow Deshedding Tool with 2-2/3-Inch Edge
review_body: We have two dogs and I was tired of not being able to sit down so I wouldn't be covered in hair.  They both sit still when you brush them.  It's something fun to do while watching tv and they get a shiny coat.

product_title: Metal Brake-Fast Dog Food Bowl (Medium)
review_body: After my lab mix ate the plastic version of this bowl, I upgraded to this metal one.  Heavy and so far indestructible.  I only wish it came in large, although would probably be too heavy to manage.

product_title: Oster Replacement Grooming Bands for Oster Nail Grinder and Gentle Paws Rotating Nail Trimmer
review_headline: No more issue's w/ dog nails
review_body: Love this product! With five dogs and three that will not sit still for the nail clipper , this grinder was the best purchase I have made for my dogs.  After brushing and bath time, the nails are done using the grinder, no more problems and safe! Just give your dog the time to get use to the noise , I have one large shy dog that hates anything new and she was the first one to allow me to work on her nails. Cheaper than bringing the dogs to the groomer or vet's and less stressfull. I save 55 dollars a month on this tool.

product_title: DVM Resources SynoviG3 Soft Chews, 240 Chews
review_body: Product was shipped quickly, but since ordering I have learned that the product has been discontinued by the manufacturer because the FDA did not approve it. They have a replacement product instead.

product_title: Hartz Maximum Protection Puppy Pads, 80 Count
review_body: The Hartz product is the best on the market according to my dog and she should know she goes through about four a day and they absorb very well. The other day I asked the dog if I should order some more pads and she barked \\"you betcha big guy!\\". If an interested party is thinking about ordering Hartz puppy pads and are not sure if there worth the money or not, let me tell you between the price, prompt delivery and they do the job as advertise.

product_title: Aspen Pet Lebistro Programmable Food Dispenser
review_body: I bought this product for my cat to be fed on a schedule for when we went on vacation.  I unfortunetly procrastinated on buying it and only got it a week before we left for our trip.  Of course, with our luck, we got one that didn't work!  However, the reason I give this product a 4 star rating is because Petmate gives an automatic 1 year warranty.  All I had to do was send in the lid a letter of what's wrong and a copy of my receipt. (paid $2.50 to ship)  Ten days later, they sent me a whole new machine!  We've had it about 2 weeks and it works great!  I wish we could have used it while we were gone instead of having someone come in and check on her, but it taught me not to procrastinate!  I would recommend this product.

product_title: GREENIES Original Regular Size Dog Dental Chews Dog Treats
review_body: I bought these as a treat for my dog and he started vomiting about an hour later.  I thought it was something specific to that dog but when I tried giving them to my other two dogs- they both got sick too.  I think they eat them like a treat rather than chewing on them and then they block their digestive tract.  Whatever is going on, I wouldn't purchase them unless you don't mind dog vomit.

product_title: Petmate Kennel Water Cup, White
review_body:
I purchased this for my 6mo old MinPin while I was at work - she gets separation anxiety and will destroy everything when someone goes outside for even a split second.

It did not even last 1 day, her normal thrashing around in her crate broke the cheap plastic in half and snapped it right off the cage.

If you have a low energy, elderly pup this may last you a week, otherwise it won't last an hour.

product_title: Petnation Port-A-Crate E2 Indoor/Outdoor Pet Home
review_body: Very easy to break down and put together and folds flat.  Lightweight but very sturdy canvas.  The door is made of netting but it is fairly sturdy as well (our dog did paw at it to no avail).  We shopped around and this is a great value.  Our dog was already crate trained so he hasn't tried to get out of it - there is certainly a dog somewhere that could (it's not a hard crate).

product_title: KONG Tug Toy
review_body: Do NOT buy this toy. We have a 60 lb lab who loves tug of war. He immediately went to work chewing this toy and was able to chew thru not only the flimsy red plastic but also the rubber, so much so that after 3 days when he played TOW with me, the toy broke in half and snapped back and hit him in the eye with such force that his eye swelled shut. The vet said he suffered ocular trauma and it cost us over $500 in vet bills and we weren't sure his eye would ever recover. Contacted Kong, they said they had never heard any complaints about this toy and were completely apathetic to my situation. Normally a huge fan of Kong products but this one is substandard and caused my normally very happy lab huge amounts of pain and suffering. AVOID THIS TOY FOR YOUR DOGS SAFETY!!!

product_title: Outward Hound Hide-A-Squirrel and Puzzle Plush Squeaking Toys for Dogs
review_body: Our 9 month old lab loves the squirrels but doesn't understand how to play with them when they're inside the stump.  He just likes gathering the squirrels and keeping them in one spot.

product_title: Meaty Bone Training Dog Treats
review_body: i have three dogs that love them nine ten eleven years old but i can not find them in any store any more pet smart does not have them no more

product_title: FURminator Large Yellow deShedding Tool with 4-Inch Edge
review_body: Oh my goodness, the furminator changed my life. My wife used to nag me all the time over our dogs fur all over the place. This thing seriously decreased My dogs shedding about 90%. Go buy one. It will be the best $20 you ever spend.

product_title: Party Pooch Fashion CHRISTMAS Pet TuTu! 4 sizes available! For Dog or Cat! (Extra Small 8")
review_body: This tutu for pets loses all the bone charms.  I wouldn't recommend.  Choking hazard for puppy.

product_title: Marineland Eclipse 3 Filtration and Illumination System
review_body: Great system.  Wish that the lights were a higher wattage (34 w combined) & that the replacement cartridges could be rinsed & refilled.

product_title: K&H Manufacturing Lectro-Soft Outdoor Heated Bed with FREE Cover
review_body: When the mat first arrived I thought, this is weird, but then after following the instructions for set up, I thought it was pretty cool.  Only problem was, after use for about a month, the mat lost it's heat, and the foam pad inside kept shifting, twisting and bunching up. product_title: Rena SmartHeater Aquarium Heater, 50W
review_body: I recently got the Rena Smartheater after a couple episodes of burnt fish from my old, conventional glass tube heater.     No, they were literally burnt to a crisp, but certain types of fish like to rest on available perches in any given tank.  Even if your tank is well planted with many available hiding places and good sized leaves like mine is, chances are your fish at some point will come to \\"rest\\" on or in the space between the heater and the glass side of the tank that the heater is adhered to.      Bettas and loaches in particular like to take a rest from the filter current, especially if they can do so near the top of the tank to grab air now and again.      I could see spots where the fish received these burns and I felt bad as soon as I realized that these burns must be coming from their contact with the heater.    And though the most inexpensive way to heat a small 5-20 gallon tank is to use the cheap, standard glass tube stick-on-side heaters, I don't like them for this reason alone.    I researched on the internet and found that the Rena appears to be just about the only hang-on-side aquarium tank heater that does not have an exposed heat source on which fish can burn themselves.  It seems to heat by some sort of internal heat convection in which water is drawn up through the slats on the bottom and expelled gently, imperceptibly through the top.  The top hole itself glows red when the heater is on and shuts off when the heater is not actively heating to show you that it is working.    It seems to do the job well, keeping my tank's temperature apparently stable.  And it is built quite robustly, with better build quality and more solidness than the glass tube heaters that I have previously tried.    Fish burning themselves on an exposed heating element is not as uncommon as you would think.  The Rena heaters aren't inexpensive, but they do the job safely, which is reason enough to recommend it.

product_title: Carefresh Natural Premium Soft Pet Bedding, 60- Liter
review_body:
I got a sample of Carefresh Colors from the petstore when I bought the Hamster cage kit and loved it. I've owned guinea pigs, rats and hamsters before but had never used Carefresh Colors. I was impressed with its softness and its ability to absorb fluids and odors.

It was time for me to buy some more bedding and I thought Carefresh was pretty much the same as Carefresh Colors, except that Carefresh was less colorful. Out of the bag, I was a little disappointed, because the bedding was not as soft and fluffy as Carefresh Colors. It has more the texture of something I might expect if maybe I wet a bunch of newspaper, wadded it up, let it dry and then shredded what was left. It's rough and dry.

My hamsters don't seem to mind the change. They shred the Carefresh to make it fluffier for the little corner they like to burrow in. It's just as absorbent as the Carefresh Colors and controls odors just as well. The cage smells nice and fresh. Although it's not as pretty as Carefresh Colors, there is an advantage to it being a drab grey, the feces don't show.

If softness and bright color is important to you and your small pet, get Carefresh Colors. If hiding the feces is more important, regular Carefresh is best. If you are looking for absorbance and odor control, they both work equally well.

_____________

UPDATE: I did not like the first batch of Carefresh, which I based this review on. However, my second batch of Carefresh from a different is a lot nicer. It's softer and lighter in color.

Although I still prefer the softness of the Colors, regular Carefresh does have advantages. The hamsters like to clean their cage of poop. When they see it, they throw it outside the cage. With the Colors, there's poop everywhere. They don't seem to see poop as well with the regular Carefresh, so I don't get so much poop all over outside the cage.

review_headline: Sherpa All-In-One Backpack Pet Carrier, Medium, Black: GREAT VALUE
review_body: I'm really impressed by this carrier. Because I live in NYC, it's important to me to be able to carry my 11.5-lb cat to and from the vet comfortably. I was looking for a bag that had the following features:    1. I wanted to be able to carry Cat on my back- he's just too heavy to schlep on buses and subways and all over town in a plastic carrier  2. is small enough to fit under most airplane seats  3. is large enough for Cat to lie down and turn around in  4. has pockets for my necessities so I don't have to carry around a purse  5. can be rolled like a suitcase    This product meets the first four requirements. I would have liked to be able to roll this bag around but it's not a deal-breaker for me. I like how easily the straps can be converted into shoulder straps- they're not detachable and cross at the top of the bag; all you have to do is pull both straps up and it's instantly a shoulder bag. I do wish the straps were set a wee bit closer together; they seem like they were designed with football players in mind. This bag also comes with a waist strap, which I didn't get with mine.     It would have been nice if the ventilation panels had privacy flaps. Not because of any privacy concerns but because it's extremely cold and windy in the winter, and roll-up flaps like the ones found on other Sherpa carriers would go a long way toward keeping Cat warm. The ventilation panels themselves are made of plastic-rubberized mesh and seem quite sturdy, though I can't truly speak on its durability as Cat is very placid and doesn't scratch at his carrier. One end of this bag is the all-mesh entrance/exit and unzips all the way down. The mesh on the other end takes up the top half the panel and can be folded down and locked into place, allowing your pet to stick its head out.     Amazon's description says that this all-in-one backpack carrier has three zippered compartments but there are really only two. There is a small zippered pocket below the half-mesh panel, a zipped medium-sized compartment on the front, and a large open pocket on the back.    I know that if I'd spent more money, I probably could have gotten everything I wanted in a pet carrier, but because I neither travel with Cat nor take him out on the town except to go to the vet, this bag is really excellent value for what I paid for it. I'm very happy with it.

product_title: BioPet DNA Breed Identification Kit
review_body: I have been rescueing pit bulls for about 20 years,and have been selling diagnostics(Lab equipment)for about the same time.Recently I purchased 4 of these so called breed tests from BioPet Vet Lab.There data base is only for AKC breeds,and pitbulls are not recognized by the AKC,I expected no match to be found.With the assistance of my DVM,we ran a test on a confiscated fighting dog I named \\"SweetPea\\", she is great with humans ,but like most pits she is very dog agressive,and after dealing with this breed for 20 years I assure you there is NO AKC blood here !Imagine my surprise that not only did we get back results ,but that this dog has 7 AKC breeds in it.I showed the results to my vet,which said she is a mix of Yorkshire terrier,border collie,and saint bernard to name a few.He laughed and asked if I wanted to do a little experiment,which was to run the same dogs DNA with a different name,with my vet as the owner so BioPet would not know what we were doing.The results for \\"doe5557\\"aka \\"sweetPea\\" came back as a different mix of AKC blood,this time instead of Rottweiler being in the mix,Rhodesian Ridgeback was in there, and the various levels of how much of each breed was also different.In lab speak testing accurracy is based on reproducability, with PCR (the technology used here)there is to much variability to be precise enough to tell what is in your dog! The first test result was flawed,and even though it was wrong the results of the second test should have been the same as the first.When \\"sweetPea\\" was confiscated from a local fighting ring she was pregnant,and had 8 beautiful pitbull puppies,one of which I decided should stay with us,I named him \\"Bubba\\",who with my DVM's help we decided to test.His test came up with another AKC mix,with 7 breeds that they DON'T share,when I showed the results to my vet He said; A)this was genetically impossible B)get your money back !Even though they say complete satisfaction or you can retest on them or get your money back,after3 requests,I'm not holding my breath. My advice is to save the $60.00 and go get you dog a bunch of treats and toys!The technology they are using is outdated and Humans convicted of crimes using this type of testing have been overturned , unfortunatly there are no regulations on the claims they are making for this test as it is animal testing,not human.

product_title: Litter Robot LRII Automatic Self-Cleaning Litter Box
review_headline: Fantastic!!! Plus - how I trained my 10 yo skiddish cats to use it!
review_body: This product is FANTASTIC! I absolutely adore it! I've had it for almost three months now, no jams, no issues. I just need to remember to add litter and change bags every 3-4 days, and that's with two LARGE cats!!!  One of them used to urinate elsewhere whenever the litter box was not perfectly clean, and that is completely resolved now!!!    The tricky bit - HOW TO GET YOUR CATS TO USE IT!! Especially if they're older and kinda paranoid, like one of mine...    They actually started using it fairly quickly with it off, but then after it was on once, they wouldn't go anywhere near it. So here's what I did:    - Stage 1 (3-5 days roughly): Lean top module of lunar lander, I mean litter robot, on wall. Clean it yourself. You can skip that stage if your cats are willing to go in even when it's mounted on the base.    - Stage 2 (3~5 days roughly): Put module on base, but DO NOT TURN IT ON. Clean it yourself.    - Stage 3 (as long as it takes - 5 days for me): Get your cat's absolutely favorite treats. I used smoked turkey breast. Something they go absolutely crazy wild for. Get LOTS of it. Sit next to the LR, call the cats, and manually start a cycle (turning it on starts a cycle). As the cycle goes on, keep offering them treats. Repeat this 2-3 times a day, until the cats show only very mild interest in the LR, and are MUCH more interested in the treats. While this is going on, KEEP LR OFF at all times, unless you are there handing out treats. This creates the association LR ON = good stuff is happening...    - Stage 4 (final - you're done!): The cats care only about the treats and don't pay attention to the LR. Turn it on, leave it on, and you're good to go! Enjoy your new found freedom :)

product_title: Guardian Gear Terylene Dog Training Treat Bag, Blue
review_headline: One of the Best Dog Treat Bags!
review_body: First of all this a dedicated TREAT BAG, not a purse or fanny pack so don't expect to carry more than the essentials in it.  Cell phones, wallets and dog toys fit better in large pockets, that's what they're for. Or use a fanny pack--especially if you're a sport enthusiast--and need to have the extra storage space.     The zipper pouch in the hidden back of the treat bag is good for basic ID, an ATM/credit card or paper money.    The front velcro pocket is good for a small ball, but not much else.  I buy the box of plastic one size fits all gloves for picking up dog poop in my backyard (the gloves make sure I pick it ALL up) and I stuff some of these in the velcro pocket to pick up any mess my dog makes.  Turn inside out and you have a poop pick up or a slobbery ball holder you can tie off and place in your pocket without much worry of an inappropriate wet mark on your pants/shorts.    I use a short clip-on key ring for my basic key set (house door,car door/ignition and mail key) and they fit nicely on the key ring attached to the treat bag when I have no pockets or my pockets are full.    Now to the meat of the item, this is a good grade of material that you will expect to use for some time.  Not thin plastic like you might find on other products (*cough*Outward Hound*cough*).  The item says it's water resistant and I'd believe it.  Resistant not proof.  It has the velcro pouch and a thin open area where the main pouch is so the water will go inside that if it's pouring or submersed. Just like is says, the main pouch has a stay-open spring hinge top that snaps shut to keep treats securely stored.  It's a little stiff, and I like it that way.  It'll stay open enough to dole out several quick treats or shut with the flick of your hand--great for when you bend over and don't want all the treats to fall out.  (WD-40 or some other all-use hinge oil should keep the hinges in good working order and help your bag last over time.)    This comes with a soft belt, but I use aleather man's belt and it fits just fine on that.  The belt loops fit perfectly and the clip between them has a lip on it that helps it to hold onto my leather belt.  I've never used it without my belt, so I don't know how well it does just clipped to the top of your pants.    I'm the envy of my dog training instructor.  I'm getting one for her as a thank you gift.  (No way I'm giving her mine!!!)

review_body: Bought this crate in the medium size to crate train our Golden Retriever puppy and glad we found it on sale. I really like the \\"other door\\", the garage-type door. I also like the open-ness of the crate and like to think the puppy appreciates it too. It has the open-ness of the normal wire crates yet more sturdy and attractive. The floor is easy to clean up even though it isn't a pull-out tray like some of the others.     Set-up and tear-down is easy enough. I like the clasps and fasteners. I really doubt a dog could work their way out of this crate. Although one side does depend on plastic clasps to keep it from folding, the side will not entirely collapse when the other three sides are properly fastened.     I doubt this crate will be big enough for our Golden when she is full grown unless she takes on the small frame of her mother. And it isn't the recommended size for the breed but we aren't planning on using the crate her entire life anyway. It will definitely work nicely throughout puppy-hood. I was surprised to find such a low price on this crate at a local pet superstore so we went with it over the other available models. review_headline: Nice, warm bed for cats that want to be cozy
review_body: This is the second Thermo-Kitty bed I've gotten, and I like it.  More importantly, so does my cat. review_body: My 7 year old Sheltie \\"Mattie\\" started having seizures back in October 2008 whereas she just had the one, but as time went on she had another one in April 2009 then she didn't have anymore until July 2009 and then she was having them once every two weeks for six weeks. review_body: This product is great. I have a multi-cat household, and it really does help to create a calming atmosphere. It worked beautifully.  When I put the puppy in from the top and started zipping, he would lie down to see out the screen sides. product_title: KONG Dental Dog Toy
review_body: This product is great my pet really enjoys it and it a great way for him to get exercise.  It doesn't seem to get damamged being outside or with him chewing on it all the time.

review_body:
I purchased this crate after searching for months. The price was the best and we needed a crate that would fit in our small laundry room but would be attractive looking and not scratch our limestone tile floor. We had a gold, metal crate that was scratching the floor and it was not a decorating asset, to say the least.

Our 95 lb., 4 year old black lab loves his new crate. It is his domain and he loves it. Also, I have to lock him up, since he insists on sitting on our white living room sofa! I would probably recommend ordering the extra large if your dog is over 110 lbs and is truly big. Our black lab is in phenomenal shape. He is all muscle and not an inch of fat. Something to think about if your have an older dog, or a dog that is arthritic or overweight. This is the 411 on this beautiful crate!

product_title: PetSafe Gentle Leader Head Collar with Training DVD
review_headline: Not for every dog, but it may be right for you
review_body:
I have used this particular head collar on four different dogs with mixed results. Please note that all dogs were slowly and carefully desensitized to the Gentle Leader head collar, as directed by trainers and the training materials included with the head collar.

- The first was a dog-reactive dog.
The collar did discourage pulling under low stress conditions and made pulling less painful. It allowed for greater control of the dog. However, if the dog was not kept soundly distracted he would return to fussing over the nose strap. He became so frustrated by the collar that he would rub his face on the concrete, claw at the nose strap, and come away bleeding. I returned to desensitizing him to the collar, assuming I had not given him enough time to adjust. I found myself spending more time training him to accept the collar than working on modifying his unwanted behaviors.
- The second dog was a fearful dog.
The dog would completely shut down whenever he wore the collar away from his safe zone. We spent more time trying to desensitize him to wearing the collar outside of his safe zone. Because he would shut down and stop responding we could not get any results.
- The third dog was a confident, social dog.
This particular dog had pulled his whole life. To my knowledge, no one had attempted to discourage the pulling behavior. I noticed improvement as soon as we left the yard. It didn't just lessen the pulling, it stopped it.
- The fourth was an untrained and social puppy.
Not accustomed to rules or boundaries, the puppy was constantly testing the limits of the collar. If he was not properly engaged in training he would return to pawing at the nose strap, hindering training. Distraction caused by the nose strap was lessened by padding the nose strap with faux fur. He was doing fairly well on the collar and with training. One day, another puppy approached and he began that endearing puppy wiggle, wagging his tail so hard his whole body shook. Without warning, he lunged forward. Despite being on a short leash, he hit the end of the leash hard enough that the collar jerked his head sideways. He let out an ear-shattering yelp and acted subdued thereafter. For safety reasons, we discontinued the use of the head collar.

Pros:
- Gives greater control to the dog handler, regardless of the dog's size and the handler's strength.
- Lessens or eliminates the pain and discomfort the handler experiences when dogs do pull.
- Discourages pulling.
- Can be used with either traditional punishment based training or progressive reward based training.
- Will not choke the dog when used with nose strap

Cons:
- Requires time for dogs to become accustomed to this training tool.
- Requires careful adjustment of straps -- improper fit impedes training.
- Can rub hair off and/or cause irritation if worn or fitted improperly.
- Capable of injuring a dog that lunges or does \\"zoomies\\" while worn and leashed.
- May cause fearful dogs to shut down and inhibit behavior change.
- May exacerbate reactive or aggressive dogs' unwanted behavior.
- The nose strap may irritate the dog, requiring padding to be sewn on by owner.
- The nose strap is not durable and can be easily destroyed by chewers.
- Dogs CAN learn to ignore the head collar and pull anyway, meaning you will still need to teach the dog how to walk with you.
- Short-muzzled dogs may find it easy to remove the nose strap.
- Results vary.

For successful training, I recommend developing mutual respect and trust with your dog. With mutual respect and trust there isn't anything you can't accomplish with your dog.

If I can teach my dog to walk nicely with me, ANYONE can. Don't give up!lunged forward. product_title: Bamboo QuadBrush Ultimate Cat Toothbrush with Holder - Assorted Colors
review_headline: Great as an idea, poor in practice
review_body: I bought this brush a few weeks after my boyfriend and I adopted our cat.  She was 2 years old when we adopted her, had grown up on the streets, and probably had never had any silly human try to brush her teeth.  However, given the prevalence of dental disease in domestic cats, I was determined to try to brush her teeth regularly.  But she was my first cat, and admittedly, I was scared to brush her teeth.    Therefore, I bought this toothbrush because I liked the idea that I might be able to brush lots of teeth surfaces as quickly as possible (and therefore avoid being bitten).  But in practice, I now have better experience brushing her teeth (very quickly; less than 30 seconds), with a baby human's toothbrush or a conventional cat toothbrush when she falls asleep on the couch.  The problem with this toothbrush is that it's too large for my cat's mouth, and distresses her more than necessary.  With a smaller conventional cat brush, however, I can get a quick brushing in while she is asleep, and she only fidgets a little bit before she falls back asleep.     Granted, the effectiveness of this brush may vary according to your cat's size;  my cat is on the smaller side(skinny 9lb girl), and the brush is just too much for her.

product_title: Paw Pads Self Adhesive Traction Pads - 2 Sheets (4 Paws Each) - Large
review_body: My dog was fine with the pads - he did not try to chew them off or anything.  They helped to add a bit more traction to his step during a period of sickness whan he was VERY unstable on his feet.  However, they did come off, one by one over time. I suppose going outside in the rain, mud, snow, etc.  loosened the adhesive.  If I needed them for long term use, I would plan on one set per week.

review_body: Bought at Walmart for similar price, seemed like a great deal for a cool looking toy.  My 11 month old black lab-mix tore the fabric in seconds. review_body:

review_body: I have tried nearly every litter system on the market, from basic to high-tech, and the Breeze system is just the best and easiest I've ever used. They LOVE digging in the large pebble-sized pellets -- thank goodness for the elevated frame that surrounds the box or I'd be sweeping up the bathroom three times a day.  I use about one and one-half bags of the pellets rather than the recommended single bag when I fill the box and this seems to work better for our two large and enthusiastic felines.

The instructions are very easy to understand and are printed right on the units. But if you have a litter locker, you already know how easy it is. I heartily recommend this product.

product_title: Bamboo CatFisher Rod and Reel
review_body:

review_body:

product_title: Pet Promise Daily Health, Nutrition for Adult Dogs

review_body:
My cats have never had more energy or a healthier coat!

product_title: Precious Cat Ultra Scoop 18#
review_body:
It was an emergency when I had to find another brand litter. My husband couldn't breath at night! So I bought the dust-free pine pellet kind litter after reading reviews. Fantastic! It ended up I had to steam clean the carpet 3 times because my kittens were frightened by the pine shape/smell and decided not to touch it!! They made a mess overnight! So I had to drive back to petsmart to get something else. A lot of those clay litter advertise dust-free are not true, I believe. After a research I decided to try Dr. Elsay's Precious Cat litter. Now I know that was one of the best decisions I've ever made in my life!
1. NO DUST!
I did try to mess around with the litter but there's no dust flying around and completely no dust stays on the side of the plastic box like other clay litter always do. My kittens like to play in and out the litter box but the litter stayed within 1 feet outside of the boxes. It's been 3 days and my kittens haven't yet brought any litter onto my sofa or bed.
2. NO SMELL!
It doesn't contain any cover-up scent but holds the smell almost 100%. No urine smell at all! The litter clumps hard as rock and won't break up when I scoop them up.
3. CATS LOVE IT!
My kittens are used to dirt-like litter so they started using it within seconds!
So here's some advice: if you want to swich to a no dust brand and your cats are used to dirt-like litter, don't risk trying anything else! This litter is the best!
For the price?
This is CHEAPER than Arm&hammer's which I've been buying for $14 for 30 lbs. Dr. Elsey's Precious is only $15 for 40 lbs if you get it from petsmart!!
I will never use anything else any more. THIS IS IT!

product_title: LitterMaid LM900 Mega Self-Cleaning Litter Box
review_headline: Almost the best thing since sliced bread
review_body:
I have to confess to being a little perplexed by some of the negative reviews of this product, but I suppose it depends a bit upon what you expect of it. I just bought our 3rd LitterMaid and couldn't be happier. I know some people might say, \\"why have you had to buy 3 of them?\\" But, well, they just don't last forever. But, we've found we usually get about 4 - 4 1/2 years out of them. My feeling is, anything like that with working parts, moving litter, dealing with the dust, and operating on average of probably a dozen times or more a day (we have 2 cats) ..., well, it's just going to wear out after awhile. The first one was pretty expensive, I'll admit, but the prices have gone down steadily over the years, and the price on Amazon was especially good. I sort of figure if I get 4 more years out of this one, it'll average out to $25/year. And, frankly, that's cheap for not having to scoop the litter myself, every day.

And, I'd like to add that I have tried competitors. After the first LitterMaid died I tried the Purrforma, which was brand new at the time and touted as being a huge improvement over the LitterMaid. But, we found it to be a dismal failure. The LitterMaid consistently does its job much better. We've found if you use the premium clumping litter it calls for and don't over fill (half way between the 2 red fill lines is perfect for us), we don't have any problems at all. By comparison, we found in our 2 weeks with the Purrforma, we seemed to be dealing with it getting stuck and scooping the litter ourselves as much as, if not more than the thing actually worked. We returned it and got our second LitterMaid, instead (which lasted another 4+ years.) With the LitterMaid, we maybe have to attend to it being stuck once a week (and that's usually because the 2 cats have used it one right after another before it's had time to cycle, and even that only causes it to get clogged very occasionally.)

Finally, I understand and agree that the disposable litter trays are a bit expensive but, again, for us, we've just found it's worth it. And, we've found they go on sale fairly frequently. Plus, I consistently find them on sale much cheaper online than I ever find them in stores. On many of the pet supply websites, and sometimes on Amazon, if you buy a certain dollar amount of product you get free shipping. And, frankly, it's not hard to justify buying enough of the litter trays alone to get the free shipping, since they ARE disposable, after all. I figure we spend about another $5.00 - $7.00 per week for the permium litter and litter trays we go through and, again, that's with 2 cats (who are 14 and have kidney disease which makes them use the litterbox about twice as much as younger, healthier cats.)

Anyway, for my money, the LitterMaid Mega is just about the best thing since sliced bread for an indoor cat owner. Hope this review helps anyone else who might be looking or on the fence. Most of the moisture they get comes from their food soo it makes sence to have a soft moisture rich food like this.

product_title: Omega Paw Self-Cleaning Litter Box, Large
review_body: Very quick delivery, easy to put together and easy to use. My cat and I both love it.  No more liter on the floor and so easy to operate. I had a bit of doubt on how this thing would work but as the instructions say just roll it over and back and the waste falls into the drawer and is easy to get rid of, also make the liter last a lot longer.

product_title: Feliway Electric Diffuser (48 mL)
review_body:
I cannot express enough how much I love this product. I have a male cat who was neutered late, and he still wants to mark his territory, even though he can no longer 'spray.' Unaware that his spraying mechanism is gone, he just goes around lifting his tail and peeing on everything.

Until the Comfort Zone is plugged in, that is. It works! He doesn't try to mark anything near the plug-in! These things have saved me SO much time and money - I don't have to go around cleaning all my walls and carpets anymore. I LOVE Comfort Zone!

product_title: KONG Air KONG Q-Tease Dog Toy
review_body: My golden retriever has had this toy for 5 days now--remarkably she has not chewed through it yet!!! This has lasted longer than any other chew toy she has ever had! She loves the different squeaks it makes and has a wonderful time tossing it around. I absolutely recommend this for other heavy chewers that like squeaky toys.

product_title: Lambert Kay Fresh 'n Clean Cologne Drops (0.5-oz bottle - floral scented)
review_body: I purchased 2 different bottle @.05oz. each, which comes to 10ozs. according to my calculations, the product was shipped regular mail, I live in Pa. as is the same state it was shipped from, it was received in a minella envelope, I was charged $7.02 for shipping, my products totaled $7.98, I checked with my post office, it should not have been anymore then $1.65, they don't have to worry about me for a reorder, I ordered the same day from Florda 16oz.bottle of shampoo, the shipping rate was $5.95, what wrong with this picture???
