product_title: Vo-Toys Plastic Canary Bird Nest Assorted Colors
review_body: Excellent product. After trying several types of nest and finding my canaries rejecting or abondoning them, I was so happy to find that all of the hens settle down to nest on this cute little nest. Thanks

product_title: Pedigree Little Champions Grilled Cuts in Sauce With Beef
review_body: again, glad to see that this product is still available to buy in single pouches, as they have totally disappeared from my area completely. highly recommended as they have a vast supply of dog and cat food.

product_title: SHED-STOP for Cats (24 oz)
review_headline: Great product, wished it came in dry form again
review_body:
I love this product esp the dog version...I was doubtful but it indeed work as intended. The cat version seems to do as well..but my cat still refuses to eat his food if mixed with it. I have to give it to him via dropper..fun.
He doesn't have hairball issues when I am good and forcing him to take it and there is a noticable reduction of fur around the house.

product_title: The Antser Ant-Proof Barrier
review_body:
We had such a problem with ants getting into the catfood bowls. The poor cats had to gobble their food down or risk having it overrun with ants.

Then I got the antser. You fill the bottom with a little soapy water, replace the top, and place it where the pets eat. Two cat food bowls fit on top of one easily. Since we have been using thw antser, we have had NO ants in the cat dishes (it's been well over a year). We check the water in the summer, but otherwise we don't do anything.

If you have a problem with ants getting into your pet's food, I cannot urge you more to get this product.

product_title: PetSafe Squeeze Meeze Dog Toy
review_headline: Mom's boston terrier is nuts for this lizard!
review_body: I bought this little guy for my mom's boston terrier puppy and it is now her favorite toy.  The boston chewed through it pretty quickly, but loves it nonetheless.

product_title: LitterMaid LME5500 Automatic Litter Box
review_body: I bought this product because I was going on vacation.  I tried it and it does not sweep out the litter like it should.  When it the sweeper starts and reaches the halfway point it sounds as though the motor is going to die.  The comb goes right through the clumb or stool most of the time.  I used the recommended litter Littermaid suggest and it just does not work.  I emailed littermaid about this and I have not received a response back. (1 month ago)  I suggest do not buy this product.  I went back to the old fashion way which works the best.  Do Not Waste Your Hard Earned Money.

product_title: Sportpet Pop Open Cat Play Cubes, 2 Pack
review_body: I purchased a similar cube at Target for my cat.  She absolutely loves the cube and uses her imagination so many ways for it.  She will hide her toys inside the cube and then pounce all over it.  I highly recommend it for any kitten!

product_title: Welactin Natural Salmon Oil - high potency for dogs - 250 ml
review_body: I have a young dog that has seizures and congenital liver problems. Besides medications, he needed a home cooked diet to get the right levels of proteins, avoid salts, etc. Welactin Natural Salmon Oil is part of his dietary recipe. I am so thankful they make this quality product ! Finding it on Amazon.com made it quick and easy to obtain and at a great price ! Thank you !

product_title: Good Pet Stuff Pavlov's Cat Scratch Feeder Interactive Treat and Food Dispenser
review_body: This is a clever device.  All studies show that cats train better through rewards and not punishments, which is why I bought this.  It really only took my cat a day to learn to use this scratching post.  My problem is that he has learned to push the outer tube up so that it falls on the lever and drops food.  He also has a tendency to bite it instead of scratch it to get food.  I have yet to see him actually scratch it.  I think this product needs to be a bit taller for it to really be used as a scratching post, but it's a great idea, and if you really work with your cat you may be able to get him to use it as it ought to be. The fact that you can fill the bottom with litter or sand to keep it stable also really helps.

product_title: World's Best 00631 Cat Litter, Multiple Cat Clumping Formula
review_headline: Amazing.. and not smelly at all!
review_body: I don't know if some of these reviews are for the \\"regular\\" World's Best instead of the Extra Strength or what... but I have been using World's Best Extra Strength cat litter for my two Maine Coons ever since we got the cats 10 months ago. One of the breeders recommended it.  It is not smelly at all!  There is no dust, no smell (other than right after the cat poops, but that happens when people use the bathroom, too!), and it clumps really well.    The 34lb bags are a good size to fill two litter boxes and replenish the boxes for a few weeks before I feel like I should completely replace the litter.    We went on a short vacation once (2 days) and wanted to leave the cats with extra litter.  Since this stuff is so expensive, we filled the extra litter box with some of the cheaper, clay-based litter.  That stuff was awful!  It smelled, the clumps fell apart more, and it was just nasty after a few days.  That's when I was convinced that this really is the world's best litter.    Anyway, one thing that I did hear from one breeder: Some cats are allergic to the corn-based litters.  So if you buy this stuff and your cat starts acting funny (scratching a lot, etc.), he or she could be allergic to it.  Fortunately for me, both of my cats love this stuff.

product_title: Advantage Once-A-Month Topical Flea Treatment for Cats
review_headline: Doesn't work as well as Frontline
review_body: If you're cat is an indoor cat, yes this product will work well for you. But if your cats go outside like mine, FORGET IT! Yes Advantage kills fleas that are on your pet immediately. But it does not keep them flea free for 30 days, like they advertise. I've tried Advantage on my cats a few times. The fleas that were on my cats did die within 12 hours. But within ONE WEEK they were biting and scratching again like before. I'm picking fleas off of them after only a week and a half. If the product wasn't so expensive, it might be worth the money. But don't waste your money, because it only works well for a few days. Frontline works a lot better.

product_title: ExquisiCat Jumbo Drawstring Liners 30 ct
review_body: Before I made this purchase, I checked and double checked the size I needed. Unfortunately, I have not been able to use these because they don't fit. I can't send them back since the box has been openned, so I'll just keep them until my cat gets a new litter box.

product_title: Rattling Fur Mice - 12 pack
review_body: These fur mice are my cat's favorite toy.  KV Vet Supply sent them right away and they even arrived sooner than expected.

product_title: PetSafe Indoor Ultrasonic Bark Control, Up to 25 ft. Range, No Collar Needed, Anti-Bark
review_body: The only thing that I find wrong is that small dogs do not stop barking when you press the button or if it is close by them, a least mine doesn't  but my other dog which is big does.

product_title: Mendota Dog Walker
review_body: I love this leash! It is light weight but strong and easy to put on my dog. It slips on easily and seems to be just about ideal. My dog is a 45 lb standard schnauzer. The leash keeps his crazy energy under control. I like how soft the material is on his neck and on my hands. It's the kind of leash one could keep an extra in the car, home, cottage, etc.

product_title: Hartz UltraGuard Flea & Tick Drops For Dogs
review_body: This product absolutely does not work. I put it on my dogs and it did not make one bit of difference with their flea problem. It is worth it to spend the extra money on Advantage, that one actually works, and works well I might add.

product_title: Musher's Secret Pet Paw Protection Wax
review_body: Item works very well when it stays on....just have bratty puppies who keep trying to lick it off!!  Product is very messy to put on and by the time I get to my third dog...I'm a mess :)

product_title: Musher's Secret Pet Paw Protection Wax
review_headline: Musher's Secret  saves snowy days for my dog!
review_body: I discovered Musher's Secret many years ago, at a pet store in my area that went out of business.  I haven't been able to find it since, but then I thought to try the Internet.  I was SO pleased to find it listed and was able to order it from Amazon, which had the lowest price for it.      It saves my dog a lot of pain, as she's a border collie with hairy feet. New soft snow forms solid snowballs between her toes without Musher's Secret, and she used to come limping home from our walks, stopping every few steps to try to bite the snowballs out from between her toes.  Now that we're able to use Musher's Secret again, she's ready and willing to \\"mush on\\" as long as I'm willing to walk through the snow with her. (And it doesn't make any marks on the rugs, when she comes back in the house!)    Thank you, thank you.    Border Collie Fan

product_title: Yeowww! Catnip Toy, Yellow Banana
review_headline: Do your kitty a favor, pick one up today!
review_body: All the kitties in my family go crazy for these bananas!  The catnip is of excellent quality and the toy is filled with just catnip, no extra fillers, as I understand.  We have tried similar toys, but the cats would go so crazy they would eventually break them open and the additional filling inside would make them sick.  These bananas are hands down the best toys we have come across!

product_title: Penn Plax Bird Activity Center, Small
review_body: The play yard looks o.k., but my bird doesn't even look at it.  It's been sitting unused since I received it.

product_title: Penn-Plax Princess Castle Home, Large
review_headline: Not for multi pet owners! Our cat broke it open in minutes when unattended.
review_body:
We have a cat that tried to get the mouse. When we were outside, he crashed the entire princess habitat to the floor from a low table. It broke open, but there is a special floor that created a basement like living area- that save Mousie's life!
(Mousie hid inside, frozen in fear.) Mousie now lives in a 10 gallon glass tank with a screen lid. If you don't have a cat- this would be a 5 star item. It's cute, colorful, and worth the money, IF you don't have other pets to bump it around.

product_title: Super Pet CritterTrail Xtreme wheel
review_headline: great pet toy, quick to get smelly and dirty
review_body: This is a great pet toy-but it gets really smelly quickly. It is a nice wheel, and easily cleaned, but I found a silent spinner wheel both quieter and easy to clean. However, when the small animal is running it is entertaining to watch them actually go somewhere-around the radius under their own power.

product_title: NAVY - XX-LARGE - 3-in-1 All-Terrain Dog Jacket
review_body: We ordered XXL, seemed more like a large, didn't fit at all. These run extremely small so be careful.

product_title: MidWest iCrate Single Door & Double Door Folding Metal Dog Crates
review_body: We are very happy with our dog crate.  It arrived in a timely manner and it provides a secure home for our dog.

product_title: Nilodor Natural Touch Bio-Enzymatic Stain and Odor Eliminator
review_headline: Pricey, medium learning curve, worth it
review_body: My main problem with the Rainbow is how it it sold.  You have to let the salesperson into your home and they have that darn referral program.  But with all that it can do, you really need a presentation.  We bought our Rainbow on the spot and have never regretted that decision.  We have 2 big, shedding dogs.  I have bought the most privey Hoovers and Bissels but none would get rid of that dog smell or fur.  The Rainbow purifies the air (also deodorises) as it vacuums.  Powerful suction allows you to clean fans, blinds etc. effortlessly.  We also have the carpet and floor cleaner.  Although more cumbersome than an upright, it does a better job than others that I have tried - even the commercial Rug Doctors.  This machine is not for people looking for ease of use.  But if you want deep down cleaning, nothing else compares.  Tip:  when emptying out the canister, sift it so that only the dirty water goes into the toilet.  Dump the rest of the clumped dirt and hair into a trash can.  We bought our whole system for $1800 and it is still doing a wonderful job.  You can also use the Rainbow to blow inflatable pools up and as a small wetvac.

product_title: Zoo Med Deluxe Shovel Scooper
review_body: I use Fresh Step Premium Scoopable Clumping Cat Litter - which won't filter through this scooper.  The mesh is too tight.  On top of that, the scooper is cheaply made - a disapointment compared to the picture.  I'm throwing it out and buying something else.

product_title: Zoo Med ReptiSafe Water Conditioner, 8.75 oz
review_body: I add this to the unfiltered water .. in  time the water will get clean. i' ve been using this for over 5 years. (turtle and fish tanks) Works great.. But i do recommend on buying the 640z based on the price.. but its still a great product ..

product_title: 55 ct Gridlock Housebreaking 24" x 24" Wee Wee pads
review_body: I have bought a lot of varied pads with varied prices; I find most are flimsier than I want.  We have 2 Chis and 1 Shih Tzu, the Shi Tzu, in particular likes to tear the corners for play I guess...she actually respects these and doesn't try that with them.  These lay nicely, are so much better constructed and don't leak all the way through as many do.  Just wish my local stores carried them as the shipping costs are a bit hefty but when I weigh the cost against the 50 for 13.99 at Wally World, the cost for an excellent product is not too bad (I buy 100 at a time), actually 200 last time as I saved shipping costs by doing so.

product_title: Egg Babies - Platypus
review_headline: So cute and my dog loves it
review_body: My puppy loves this thing....it's a good size and he loves squeeking the \\"eggs\\" that are hidden in the pouch on the Platypus.  The \\"eggs\\" are decent size, so you don't have to worry that they are too small for a dog to play with...that was one of my initial concerns.  It's really cute too.

product_title: FURminator deShedding Tool for Cats, 1.75-Inch Edge
review_headline: Best cat tool I ever bought!
review_body: The FURminator really works! Wish I had owned one years ago!  I recommend using it outdoors, as the fur really flys!

product_title: Cosmic Rainbow Balls
review_body: my cat loves these spongy foam balls, she loves them because she can bite into them when she's roams around the house.

product_title: Hartz 4-Inch Curls, Flavor Infused, Pack of 6
review_body: For $23, you get two packages of curls.  They run about $6.50 per package at my local grocery.  When I complained, I was sent two more packages, so this was a better deal, but still not what I would expect from Amazon.  The listing is vague as to what you get and I'm not sure whether I was supposed to get more than one package in the first place.  However, my dog loves them.  I will buy them locally from now on, or at least until Amazon gets a better listing and better price.

product_title: Fish Cycline (Tetracycline 250 mg) 100 Caps
review_body:
Tired of $75 to ??? (Where is the limit?) doctor's visits to get an antibiotic for an infection? If you are savvy enough to know when you have what, you may want to know that the exact same antibiotic is available to dope your fish tank and retard the growth of unhealthy bacteria. And you won't go to the pharmacy and pay $50 to $100 for 30 to 50 caplets. This is a bottle of 100 caplets for less than $28 or, at least it was when I reordered from the vet supply house that ships it.

(Where I also found 100 - 500mg caps for the same price.)

Amoxcillin is also available at a comparable price.

product_title: Royal Canin Feline Breed Nutrition Persian 30 Formula Dry Cat Food (15-lb bag)
review_headline: Great if you have multliple cats!
review_body: I have 3 Persians and this is the best product I have found.  Easy for them to eat, digest (one has a sensitive stomach) and good at controlling hairballs.    Purchasing online in the 15lb bag is also the most economical, provided you divide and re-seal the product so it doesn't go stale (easily redone with zip-top bags or airtight containers).  My Persians, like most, are finicky and will not eat stale food.

product_title: JW Pet Company Clean Cup Feeder and Water Cup Bird Accessory
review_headline: A must have for all bird owners!
review_body: I have four finches.  They are two Bengalese/society finches and two zebra finches.  The zebra finches are the more active and messier of my birds.  This feeder greatly reduces the mess that they normly make because when they fly up to the perch part to gain access to the food, husks/hulls do not scatter everywhere.  The finches like grabbing food and taking it to the highest perch sometimes, so I have the feeders up high enough where they don't feel so inclined to moved around.  The small feeders are small enough where they can't hide in it or soil the food.  I don't put water in them because finches love taking baths.  On another note, they love hiding behind it from one another.  The finch version of hide and go see...it's really funny.

product_title: API FILSTAR XP FILTER SIZE L Aquarium Canister Filter 1-Count Box
review_headline: Don't buy Company won't back it up.
review_body: Product damages floors and carpet. Leaks. Mars the company that makes this bad filter does not back up product. Look at a different filter. Trust me.

product_title: Handpainted Ceramic Dishware Black 12.5 X 16.5"" PlaceMat
review_body: I had purchased this item thinking it was going to include all 3 items (dish, placemat, and cookie jar). Instead, I ended up paying $11 for a placemat and was told when I called that there was an option between the 3 items. Nothing on the page stated that.

product_title: Bergan Comfort Carrier Soft-Sided Pet Carrier
review_body: I LOVE the Bergan carrier.  I bought the Small size and it is perfect for my little guy.  The fleece lining is removeable for washing and velcro on the bottom which keeps it secure to the bottom of the carrier.      The small size is the perfect size, it fits in shopping carts, bike baskets, etc..so the little guy can accompany almost anywhere!      I only wish I thought ahead and bought one size larger because my guy will most likely grow out of it.

product_title: Fresh N Clean Flea Shamp 18 Oz
review_body: We live on a lake in the woods and own 8 dogs, 5 of which are labs and love to swim. Because of that they are always needing baths. Lambert Kay Fresh n Clean Shampoo is the only pet shampoo we have used for the past 10 years. It leaves your pet extremely shiney and soft not to mention the great fragrance that stays on the pet for 2 weeks even after they've been swimming. Our dogs don't have fleas, but we still use the Fresh n Clean Flea and Tick Shampoo as a preventative. I don't ever plan on switching! Try it, you won't regret it.

product_title: Pro Ball Go-Frrr Slingshot-Action Dog Fetch Toy
review_body: My dog loves chasing this toy--and it saves my arm...great piece, great price.  The design makes it easy to throw or even \\"shoot\\" (like a sling shot almost) long distances--helps me wear out my puppy!  I wish it would last a little longer (the rope part rips after weeks of rough play), but Thor is very rough with it.  Will definitely order again!

product_title: DermaPet Eicosaderm 8 oz (230 ml)
review_headline: Great product for a great price
review_body: I originally got this product through my vet but paid twice what I paid at Amazon.com. This is a great product if your dog tends to get dry skin like mine do. It makes their skin less dry and their coats shiny and soft.

product_title: Snuggle Safe Pet Bed Microwave Heating Pad
review_body: The Snuggle Safe is easy to use and a life saver during these very cold nights we've had.  My puppy hasn't even tried to chew on it and he seems to enjoy the heat through his pillow.  It stays warm through the night.  It is a better than expected product!

product_title: LitterMaid LM900 Mega Self-Cleaning Litter Box
review_body: we love our litter maid !!! at first we had problems with it because we were using the wrong litter but since we started using the right one we have no problems with it , even the smell is gone .

product_title: Drinkwell Original Pet Fountain
review_headline: Cats love it, I like it
review_body: My 4 kitties all give it two paws up, especially the younger ones who are fascinated by running water. They do seem to drink more, which is what I was hoping for. I agree with others that the motor is less than perfect. Mine sometimes doesn't pump initially, but it'll work if I unplug it and plug it back in. If the motor is noisy (we have a tile floor) it usually helps to unplug it briefly and/or shift its position slightly. I tried a folded towel as someone suggested and it helped but it was one more thing to clean. Speaking of cleaning, I give it a rinse-out once or twice a week and it's been fine. So although there's room for improvement I've been satisfied with it, and my cats certainly are!

product_title: Zanies Hugsters Pink/Blue
review_body: My dog had both bears torn apart in a matter of hours...    But they are cute..

product_title: PetSafe Gentle Spray Bark Collar for Dogs, Citronella, Anti-Bark Device, Water Resistant
review_headline: We love it!!!! Our beagle doesn't....
review_body: Being that my wife and I have tried all of the tricks and training techniques to keep our little beagle from barking so much. We had almost given up. While online one day I thought I would see if there were any products that were a safe and humane way to train your dog. After a couple of hours of searching, I found a couple of different collars, one being a shock collars which I was completely opposed to and the citronella collar. I was a little skeptical at first, but after some research and reading a couple of independent studies I found this collar was more effective than the other collars. So I bought it. After a short two day wait, I received it in the mail. I put it on our dog and after two sprays of citronella he understood that barking is what set it off. Since then it has been peace and quiet. I still put the collar on him, but I haven't had to turn it on it quite some time.

product_title: Handi Drink Portable Dog Water Small (17 oz)
review_headline: Not handy to use - buy the Gulpy pet dispenser instead
review_body: I have this pet water dispenser and I found it to be a nuisance while out in the park with my dog. In order to use it you have to un-clip the bottom, pull the water bottle out, push it into the top opening and then begin squeezing the water bottle to dispense the water. Also, the water comes out in very small increments. I used it twice and gave up.    I found the Gulpy pet water dispenser by New Angle to be far superior to the Handi-Drink version. You just pull up the water bottle and begin squeezing the bottle and your dog is drinking water in seconds. The water comes out much easier than the Handi-Drink and the Gulpy is far more convenient. I have never found the Gulpy pet water dispenser on Amazon but if you Google it you can find other places that sell it. I also just recently found it at my local REI store.     I have purchased several Gulpy's to keep in both cars and to give to friends. In my opinion, this one is far better than the Handi-Drink, if only for ease of use.

product_title: KONG Daddy Pompom Legs Catnip Toy, Brown/Black
review_body: my cat doesn't seem to be too interested in it at all unless I play with it with him. I guess it's good for the \\"bonding\\" process, but he seems to enjoy the other canip toys that he can destroy easily or cat crazies (especially his version of hockey in the bath tub).

product_title: Fish Food Small Pellets Semi Floating 36% Protein Ten Pounds
review_body: Quality Products. Cheap Price. Very much satisfied.  Fish love it. They are waiting feeding time in the morning.

product_title: Pet Ag DogSure (11 oz)
review_body: This is the product for dogs who have eating problems and eat irregular. Dogsure is given to my GSD in the AM. Max is 3yrs and underweight. With Dogsure he seems hungrier in the PM. He has put weight on and his coat shines. Many times he gets one can and a can of water. Prices start at $3.00 and increase to $8.00 per can. Amazon price is below average.

product_title: Angels' Eyes Tear-Stain Eliminator for Dogs and Cats, Beef Flavor, 120 Grams Bottle
review_body: This is a great product! I am very happy I purchased it. I was skeptical even though I saw the   before and afters, but it really works. I have had my Bishon/Havanese dog on it for 1 1/2 months now and really  see it working. Thanks to the creator of this wonderful product.    Deborah Reed

product_title: Pretty Bird Daily Select Mini 20 Lb
review_body: I have fed this to my Zebra and Society Finches for several years and have been very happy with this product!  Pellet foods leave much less mess in the cage than seed products and provide all the nutrients my birds need whether they are breeding, raising young or not.  I still give my birds fresh fruits and vegetables daily, but it is not necessary with this pellet food.  Just beware that they will poop green . . . . .

product_title: Dog Dress - Parisian Pet Sundress - Small
review_body: Absolutely the cutest little fashion dress for the stylin' dog!  It is darling on and my little yorkiechon thinks shes a little Princess. Got that right! Great seller and decent prices!

product_title: Self-Cleaning Litter Box from Omega Paw Large 19.5L x 22"W x 20"H (9" diameter opening)"
review_body: I have had the Omega box for about 3 weeks now and so far so good.  I happen to have a cat that likes to use the bathroom close to the edge of the box, so I still have to loosen that away from the side before I roll it.  It works better than I expected and I love not having to deal with scooping.

product_title: Brake-Fast Dog Food Slow Feed Bowl - Medium Blue
review_body: My choc. lab is a very \\"aggressive\\" eater and would finish a cup and a half of food in under 30 seconds.  I would have to stay in the kitchen and watch or when he was done with his food he'd wander over to his brother's bowl and a fight would/could insue.    I decided to try this bowl based on the claims that it would slow his eating.  It indeed works and slows the dog's eating to a reasonable pace.    I am disappointed by the quality of the bowl.  It is very lightweight and my dogs seem to think it's a toy due to how easy it is for them to move it around.  This means I have to pick the bowl up after each meal or they'll rip it apart.      This bowl scoots around too much to be useful by itself.  Aggressive eaters will move it unless it's on a piece of carpet with a rubber backing or similar no-skid surface.

product_title: FURminator Large Yellow deShedding Tool with 4-Inch Edge
review_headline: FURminator Large Yellow deShedding Tool with 4-inch edge
review_body: This product works very well in pulling out undercoat and eliminating a lot of the top hard coat that is ready to come out. The directions say to lightly go over the coat and it is important to do just that! I have cairn terriers and it works well on their necks, back, haunches and sides. I still have to do some hand stripping but the FURminator helped reduced the time I spent stripping. It does cut coat so anyone who wants to show their dog for conformation will have to be careful.

product_title: Bags on Board Bone Dispenser with 30 Refill Bags, Red
review_headline: Bags on Board Doggie Waste Dispenser Pack
review_body:
Convenient to use because the dispenser attaches to any leash, ensuring that you won't forget to take a bag along with you everytime you go out.

The dispenser is contructed thusly:

-- The bone-shaped dispenser's end cap screws shut (as opposed to just pushing shut) which prevents the cap from coming off and having the roll of bags unravel on the ground.

-- There are two holes on either side of the bone-shaped dispenser. One hole allows the bags to come out, and the other hole is for your thumb to hold the roll so you won't dispense more than one bag at a time.

The only negative thing I can say about the bags is that you really have to yank to get the bags to tear off, but this is a minor detail. I'm just glad that the bags are biodegradable.

This bone-shaped dispenser comes in various colors so you can match it with the rest of your dog's accessories, which is another plus.

product_title: IMS Trading Dog Treat Rawhide Bone 24 Inch (White)
review_body: Ordered several 22\\" to 24\\" rawhide bones for my dag for the holidays and shipment was prompt... Even a ribbon on the bones for my Champ!!!

product_title: GoodBye Odor for Small Animals, 8-Ounce
review_body: I have been using this product in my rabbits water for about a year now, and it works great.  Her litter box used to smell horrible because of the odor of her urine.  Since I began putting this in the water, the odor has stopped.  She has seemed happier as well, drinking a lot, and not getting UTI's. I don't know how it works, I'm just glad it does.

product_title: KONG Air Dog Squeaker Dog Toy
review_body: My dogs still love this toy but, like many have stated, the squeaker broke and my yellow lab has managed to bite numerous holes though each end making it likely that I will be throwing it away soon to prevent him from choking.

product_title: Meow Mix Go Fish Moist Cat Treats (6.25-oz pouch)
review_body: My cat says these are fantastic. They are the only dry food she will eat.

product_title: PetSafe Gentle Spray Bark Collar for Dogs, Citronella, Anti-Bark Device, Water Resistant
review_body: This collar is working really well for my Yorkie.  I put in on him at night so that he won't bark because we live in an apt. complex.  He has learned not to bark when the collar is on.  Only down side is that he figured out how loud he can wine and grumble without setting it off.  Overall I think it's a wonderful alternative to the shocking kind that I just couldn't bear to put on him.

product_title: Triple Crown Easy Glider Max Frisbee for Dogs (Multicolor - 11'' diameter, 180 grams)
review_body: My Black Lab loved this frisbee and I can hardly get it away from her to toss it. It is about 3 inches thict on the outer rim, so she likes to teethe on it in the back of her mouth. Maggie is six years old and and it is one of her favorite toys. A dogs teeth will leave marks,but it does not tear in any way.  It is heaver than a normal frisbee and is best for throws of 50 feet or less. I definately would reccomend this purchase.

product_title: Kitty Kaviar - 2 Pack (.5oz cans)
review_body: Our cats love this product!! We have four cats, two of which have very sensitive stomachs and special dietary needs. They come running from their hiding places, naps, etc. when they hear the sound of the plastic lid being removed. This is a great product.

product_title: Everlasting Treats - Large - 2 pack Barbeque
review_body: The treats were shipped on time, and as described. The dog loves them, all three flavors and they last longer than other treats.

product_title: PetSafe ScoopFree Self Cleaning Litter Box
review_body: I researched the auto-cleaning cat litter boxes before making this purchase, and I'm very happy with Scoop Free.  I purchased it 6 weeks ago, and the first cartridge lasted 1 month (1 cat).  Once in a while I have to push the button to re-set the rake, as my curious cat disrupts the automatic operation periodically.  I think this will change over time.  The cartridges at $15 each are a good value for the ease of use and time savings.  I also would recommend the hood/cover to reduce litter scatter.  I'll update if there are any problems.

product_title: San Francisco Bay Brand Freeze Dried Betta Food 1g (Vial)
review_body:
fish liked them uptil he got frozen ones.
make sure you are not allergic to them before you purchase them. i discovered i was and they made me itch!
the betta loved them though

product_title: Fat Cat, Inc. Doggy Hoots Terrible Nasty Scaries Big Mean Kitty (14.5''x15'' dog toy - Big Mean Kitty)
review_body:
Collie Owner, I'm sorry yours came apart so quickly, but if you'd read the little \\"story book\\" on the inside of the back cover, it clearly says, \\"Don't Be A Poop, Cut Off The Loop\\".

For everyone else, I must say I absolutely LOVE this toy! (and so does my Boston Terrier, Hopper). I'd bought him many stuffed toys, only to have it destroyed within 5 minutes. This toy has held up for over a week so far, and trust me, we've played tug of war with it a LOT, and he likes to shake his head back and forth and beat himself to death with it. <giggle> I will definitely buy more of these!

product_title: Aspen pet Cool Flow Pet Fountain
review_body: It has taken our kitty 2 months to accept to use the fountain, but he has finally begun drnking from it, so be patient. He was still expecting to be able to drink from the water tap and has finally given up. The sound of the trickling water finished by seducing him. Good product.

product_title: PHOENIX Eye Irrigating Solution, 4-Ounce
review_body:
Over a month ago one of my dogs, who loves sneaking into the trash and knocking the can over, got into a huge mess after someone threw away an old bottle of red pepper. When he knocked the can over the hot pepper popped in his eyes. When we noticed the problem we began flushing his eyes out with water until he was okay, or so we thought. Only one of his eyes returned to normal soon after the rinse but the other eye was badly red and swelling. We continued the water rinse on that eye and even tried human eye drops, nothing seemed to help. So I looked online for something to take away the redness and swelling. That's when I came across this product. I squirted it into his eyes twice a day for three days and decided to wait it out to see what happens. On the fourth day (Today) I've noticed that his eye is quickly returning to normal, the swelling has gone down, the redness is gone and he doesn't close it up anymore like he was before. So I say it worked great and fast!

So if one of your babies run into something unfortunate like one of mine did then try this stuff!

product_title: Clevercat Jumbo Liners for Clevercat Top Entry Litter Box, 10-Pack
review_body: My male cats looove this box-like litter box.  The Clever Cat litter liners are another story.  They should be made of thicker plastic like the Jonny Cat liners.  Also they should be cut to be boxier so that all four corners match the four corners of the box.  This will make so much easier to pour the litter and I'm sure it would be more comfortable for the cats.

product_title: FURminator Small Blue deShedding Tool with 1.75-Inch Edge
review_body:
We have a 4 year old Shiba Inu. She sheds her coat about twice a year. The FURminator really does a nice job at removing the loose hair. It works much better than the standard metal toothed rake.

The videos on the FURminator website are not an exaggeration.

product_title: CaribSea Purple Up Algae Accelerator, 16-Ounce
review_body: I have a reef tank, but i'm just not sure if this product works.  It does increase the calcium levels in the tank simply because it is a solution of pulverized argonite or other calcium compound.  I had great success with a part a&b solution.  My father uses it and likes it but it does leave the argonite residue on everything, and it has harden in the sump so when it is disturbed, white flakes shoot out the return.

product_title: Super Pet CritterTrail Outhouse
review_body: This little triangular box is meant to be a litter box for hamsters.  But our dwarf campbell hamsters like us to put fine sand or dust in the box so they can roll around in the sand. The sand or dust is sold for ferrets at most pet stores. Rolling in the sand or dust may be something that only dwarf hamsters do, we don't know about other breeds. We keep the box -- which we call the sandbox -- permanently attached to the cage with a tube.  Sometimes the hamsters like to hide in there to eat their treats. The fact that the box is transparent makes it easy to watch them and it is a lot of fun.

product_title: LitterMaid LM500 Automated Litter Box
review_body: What a piece of junk!  The first one I bought was broken right out of the box.  It is as if Littermaid tried to design a product to expose you to as much used cat litter as possible.  The rake almost always clumps up with wet clay and cat waste, so you have to manually pic the rake clean and scoop out the box.  On the rare occasion the rake doesnt  clog, some of the used litter misses the recepticle all together and is dumped on the floor.  For the price of the recepticles, which you will need to change every few days, you could buy a silver plated cat box after a few months.   When changing the recepticle, the edges often get caught on the tabs and it "flicks" used bits of litter right in your face!  After two months of trying to make this product work, its going in the trash!

product_title: MEDIUM - RED - Bamboo Quick Control Collar
review_body: The handle built into the collar is great -- especially for 50 lb. 4 month old Alaskan Malamute puppies -- but if one dog gets to chewing on the other dogs collar the collar is RUINED!!!    They run a little small in size -- I would order 1 size up next time.    All in all I think the collar is an awesome idea -- it just needs to be a little sturdier for the bigger dogs.

product_title: FURminator deShedding Tool for Cats, 1.75-Inch Edge
review_body: The cats love it!  It's easy to use.  Is great for long or short hair cats.

product_title: PETCO Rubber Ring Dog Toy
review_body: My dog loves it, her favorite toy. Practically indestructable, a great tug-o-war toy. This is my second one, lasts about a year before little chunks of rubber start falling off on the carpet. Then it makes a great outside toy and seems to last forever.

product_title: Wee Cleaner - Pet Urine Odor Remover for Cat and Dog Urine (32-ounce bottle)
review_body: This worked very well.  We used this on a small accident by our new puppy.  The odor is gone and has not reappeared (3 weeks later).  We will probably try the larger size next time to keep some on hand.

product_title: Evolution Cat Food 20lb Bag
review_body: Both our cats absolutely love Evolution kibble. We mix it up with Red Star nutritional yeast and water and they love it even more. They've actually torn open the bag to get to it, and when they hear me getting it ready they come running. It's vegan, so it contains no slaughterhouse by-products, euthanasia solution, carcinogens, or dead animals. Yay!

product_title: Bags on Board Dog Waste Bag Bone Dispenser with 30 Refill Bags
review_body: the bags on board bone dispenser is so cute and compact, i attach it to my leash.  it is well made and easy to refill.

product_title: Petmate LeBistro Portion-Control Automatic Pet Feeder, Black, 4.2 Pounds
review_body: Works great! I had no trouble programming it. Dog unfazed by it after only a day (he tried to break in the first day)  Only drawbacks: Bowl would be easier to clean if detachable; also you cannot change the portion sizes for each feeding (we like to give a smaller serving at night,..)

product_title: Solvit Sta-Put Bench Pet Seat Cover - Standard - 56L x 47W in.
review_body: This product was delivered in a timely manner, and it was just what I wanted for my car.  It appears to be well made and of sturdy material. The only thing I didn't like about it is that it was a little dirty. Just a few white spots on it.  No big thing. I just would've liked it a little cleaner since it was new.

product_title: Dd
review_body: We have a seven year old Lab. that is mellow except when walking on a leash. We hoped that this collar would help.  It does not. For all other aspects of dog obedience we have taken her to school and have followed Cesars' rules.  Our dog does not leave the property, comes when called, waits, does not jump, and is a pleasure to be part of our family. But when it comes to the leash this collar does not work with her.

product_title: SSScat - The Ultimat Cat Control System
review_body: Not only does this product work well.  It gave us a few laughs as we watched our kitties scamper away from it.

product_title: C.E.T. Flavored Toothpaste for Dogs and Cats (2.5-oz (70-gm) tube - Vanilla Mint Flavor)
review_headline: A must for all loving dog owners.
review_body: Brushing your dogs teeth from a young age will help them live longer.  It has something to do the plaque build-up on the teeth causing bacteria which results in heart damage.  (Ask a vet for a proper explanation...)  If you start with short sessions, your dog will get used to the whole process, and my fourteen year old German Shepard likes the mint flavor in the toothpaste.  Use a soft toothbrush so you don't hurt their gums.  Nowadays, cheap four dollar electric toothbrushes are available and I've found they work well.  This brand of toothpaste has had the best flavor and best results at removing tartar of all the kinds I've tried.  Great product and this is a better price than the vet, even with shipping...

product_title: Buddy Bowl Spill Proof Water Bowl for Small, Medium and Large Dogs and Full Grown Cats, Spill Proof Water Bowl, Spill Proof Dog Water Bowl - 64 oz.
review_body: This is a great product!  I bought it because my one-year old son wouldn't stop putting all his toys in the dog bowl or just dumping it out onto the floor.  He can still put some toys in it but the opening keeps out his bigger toys and the design keeps him from dumping out all the water.  I couldn't be happier with this product.  The only downside is that it's hard to get the top off of it to clean it out.  That shouldn't be a problem for most people as it won't need much cleaning.  Again... my son likes to take the dog food and put it in there so I have to clean it out about once a day!

product_title: IRIS Neat 'n Dry Premium Pet Training Pads, Regular, 17.5" x 23.5"
review_body: This pads soak up everything and leave nothing behind.  They seem to dry out quickly for another pee stop.  I've used these for my cat that seems to have taken to urinating out the front of the litter box.  She doesn't shred these or twist them up into a ball.

product_title: Planet Dog Orbee Ball - Large
review_body: I own bloodhounds which are aggressive chewers. We have NO toys other than these Planet Dog balls. My most aggressive chewer can pick off some of the outer \\"earth\\" desing but cannot destroy the ball. It's GREAT for the aggressive chewer.

product_title: Iqube - Large
review_body: It is fun and teaches coordination for dogs.  My dog gets a ball out and squeaks it in victory, then moves on to the next.  It is light weight, but durable.

product_title: Pet Promise, Natural Cat Food, Chicken Formula
review_body: I have 3 cats who are very picky! My 4 year old, Bill, only likes dry food. Phoenix, who is 1, did only like organic canned chicken and of course dry cat food, and Gloria, Phoenix's sister only liked 1 variety of fancy feast, a food I feel is not one I want my pets to eat. After trying this, I found that they ALL love it! I don't mind paying shipping if they will eat a quality premium food like this. thanks to Amazon for offering this!  They now eat Pet Promise in both canned and dry. Nutro indooor formula, and Royal Canin Fit and Beautiful dry foods.

product_title: Flex Rake ''The Jaw'' One Handed Black Pooper Scooper (26'' pooper scooper)
review_body: I've been using this for about 3 years.  Works great and saves you from getting close to the poop.  The reason for 3 stars is that it does tend to break, especially in the winter when the plastic freezes and cracks.  Wish they would make a metal version.

product_title: Marchioro (Bill - F) Deluxe Enclosed Litter Pan with Door - Large (large - 19.75x15.75x16.5 - model (1-F))

I've had as many as 5 cats at once, that used 2 boxes with no problems  THE BEST!!!!!!

product_title: Prevue Hendryx Select Dometop Cage
review_body: I usually get \\"Wellness\\" Puppy Food for my chihuahuas and decided to try Innova since it had the same ingredients. Although Innova has the same ingredients, they did something different because this product has a more appetizing aroma and my chihuahuas seem to prefer it to Wellness. Innova has a more \\"cooked\\" rather than  \\"gamey\\" odor, which makes it easier for me to tolerate and appeals to my dogs. I highly recommend it.

product_title: Bamboo Combat Big Kahuna Dog Toy
review_headline: Pathetic excuse for a dog toy
review_body: Yes, you heard me. In the description it says that it is built to withstand 'rigorous' dog play. product_title: Friskies Dental Diet for Cats
review_headline: My cats forced me to the Internet to find it!
review_body: When the last shop in my area stopped carrying Dental Diet, and the dish where it usually was placed sat empty, my kitties mourned. Another cat poaches from next door whenever he can.  And my other 2 cats will never have dental work done again, I have sworn (unless an emergence like an abscess,) because   (a) they suffer so after the anesthesia and  (b) the Dental Diet rollies really do work. review_body: This dish is not extra heavy. The dish only weighs 7.5 oz.  I thought this would keep my cat from sliding his water across the floor and spilling it, but it didn't. I was very disappointed with the dish for this purpose.

product_title: Kong Wubba Puppy

review_body: This is such a great buy!!!  I was wondering if I should buy this or more expensive one.  This is inexpensive and does the job!!!  If you are like me wondering which one to get, I highly recommend this one.

review_body: Cute, effective, sturdy..just the right size.  Holds all our dog toys and the second holds all of our kids  stuffed animals!  RS

product_title: CatGenie-Self Washing, Self Flushing Cat Box
review_body: I tried the Cat Genie for 2 weeks.  With one cat (Ragdoll) the unit only operated without clogging once!  I tried a number of fixes suggested by the customer service but none worked.  The unit will stop in mid cycle and leave a bowl full of water...not a usable solution for someone who travels.  I ended up spending more time and effort fixing the clog (not an enjoyable job) than I ever would have scooping it out myself.  I am going back to the litter robot.  Great product if you have a cat with short hair or enjoy playing endlessly in foul-smelling water.  The unit does not have a sensor and only runs based on a timer...if your cat is not on a schedule you will end up running the unit needlessly.  Good idea...didn't work for me.

product_title: Chomp Yip Yap Breath Fresheners for Dogs (1.4-oz tin)
review_headline: Finally, I breath freshener that REALLY works!!
review_body:
I bought a trial pack of Yip Yaps, thinking it was just another -Treat-
but, when I gave them to my dogs they REALLY work! They have a very distinct odor! They smell like rosemary and mint. It would make a GREAT room freshener! They smell WONDERFUL! Everytime I open, or even pick up the tin, my Oliver goes bonkers! He LOVES these, and he is VERY picky!
I just had to order a case! The funny thing is, he gets right in my face and gives me a BIG yawn, to tell me he has bad breath, he knows I will give him a Yip Yap! He even picks out the one he wants. I open the tin and hold it to him and \\"picks\\" the one he wants. I can't even pick up the tin without him perking his ears up and begging and asking for one. I have NEVER found anything that he likes like this, ( except steak ). I will have to make sure I keep these wonderful fresheners on hand from now on! But as soon as you open the tin container, you will smell the herbs and mint. They alsmost smell good enough to eat yourself, of course I don't want to fight my dogs for them! I think I would lose!

product_title: Nature's Earth Feline Pine Scoop Cat Litter (11-lb bag)
review_body:
Due to a severe bladder infection, one of my cats began using the carpet on our stairs instead of her box. Concurrently, she also developed a substrate preference for carpet, rather than cat litter. We've battled this problem for two loooong years. My vet finally suggested switching litters. I happened across Feline Pine Scoop and bought it, along with two other litters. I was going to try each one and see if any worked. I tried this one first and returned the other two bags! It has been the answer to our prayers. It is one of those things that seems too good to be true, but actually IS.

First off, no yucky dust, no funky fragrance. It smells like the lumber dept at the hardware store! The clumps stick together like nothing I've ever used before (and I've used some super premium brands, too). It is cheaper in the long run over traditional clumping litter. And best of all, BOTH OF MY CATS LOVE IT. No more weeping over funky carpet!

There are a couple of cons: First, it's hard to find around here. Petsmart just discontinued it (but if I have to have the stuff shipped to my house by the truckload, I'll happily do it). Second, it takes a little longer to sift when cleaning. Finally, it controls odor so well that I'll admit to forgetting that we even have litter boxes that need to be changed every so often! ;)

All in all, a terrific product. I'm thoroughly impressed.

product_title: Angels' Eyes Tear-Stain Eliminator for Dogs and Cats, Beef Flavor, 120 Grams Bottle
review_body: After three weeks, our dogs tearing had lessened and lightened considerably.  I will start cutting back to three times and week and see if the results are the same.  I recommend this product.

product_title: Natural Balance Roll - 3.5 pounds Beef
review_body: I have been feeding my dogs Natural Balance for 10 years.  They love it and it has proven to make them healthier.

product_title: Oster 078108-100-000 Hot Water on Demand Pet Washer
review_body: Great Product for a good price.  All sent as ordered.

product_title: PetSafe Gentle Spray Bark Collar for Dogs, Citronella, Anti-Bark Device, Water Resistant
review_body: This collar did nothing to stop this dog from barking, infact, I think she enjoyed the citrus smell.

product_title: Bayer K9 Advantix II (Over 55-lbs)
review_body: Without this stuff, the mosquitoes literally SWARM around my dog. With it, they pretty much stay away for up to 4 weeks after application. I guess it works on fleas and ticks too since she's never had any of those obnoxious parasites either. The only reason I gave it 4 instead of 5 stars is that after application, the fur can be a little matted for a couple of days. Looks kinda weird and can be dangerous to touch if you don't wash your hands right away. Side note: My dog is 68 pounds but I've been using the 55+ lb version of Advantix since she was 50 pounds. I called the company back when my dog was smaller and told them the mosquito protection wasn't working too well and they told me to go the next size up. Once I did, I didn't have any more problems. And yes, they assured me it was safe to do so in our case but I would definitely contact the company or your vet before you use more than the recommended dosage.

product_title: FortiFlora CANINE Nutritional Supplement by Purina - Box of
review_body: This is a great product to keep the intestines healthy especially if your animal has to be on long-term antibiotics or other medications that would affect the normal flora in the stomach and intestines. I highly recommend it.

product_title: KONG Extreme Black Goodie Bone Dog Toy
review_body:
A little background is in order: Our two dogs are 18lbs and 50lbs. Both of them are absolute power chewers. They inhale bite size treats without even chewing. Nylabones don't stand a chance. Rawhides are practically swallowed whole. Plush toys are ripped apart before your eyes. One of them actually ate an entire pair of gym shorts. These dogs are chewing machines, what can I say. They do their work so fast that nothing keeps them occupied for more than 3-5 minutes!

However, as much as they have decimated any toy we have thrown at them, their Kongs have survived for months without showing a single sign of the abuse they've endured. What's more, not only are these toys super-durable, they are the dogs' favourite toys- hands down!

For these bone-shaped Kongs, there is a hole all the way through each end -denoted by the little jagged edges you see in the picture. The hole itself is sort of star-shaped, which is why the side view looks like a serrated, \\"jagged\\" edge. The edges are designed to hold a treat inside. Have no fear, though, the edges are tough- the dogs haven't been able to chew them up.

We've had the best luck using flat, stick-like rawhides with the Kong. We break them into a bundle of pieces slightly longer than the hole, then stuff them in tightly. Inside the Kong bone, the treats last about 20-30 minutes while by themselves they lasted only seconds. Best of all, after the treats have finally been exhausted, the dogs continue to gnaw on them, as though searching for one more tasty morsel. This keeps them happy for another 10 or 15 minutes.

I cannot stress enough how tough these Kongs are. If you don't like the bone shape, try the [[ASIN:B0002AR0II Kong Extreme Large Dog Toy, Black]] with a little peanut butter inside. (For even longer lasting fun, throw the Kongs in the freezer after you've stuffed in the peanut butter. It's like a Puppy Popsicle!)

At around $10 these toys are a steal. I would have gladly paid $20 or $30 on account of the fact that they are so durable. If you own a power chewer, try a Kong!n account of the fact that they are so durable. If you own a power chewer, try a Kong!

product_title: Wellness Complete Health Natural Dry Dog Food
review_body: We adopted a mix breed that was approx 1 year old. His coat was coarse, dry and skin was flaky. He was licking his feet and shaking his head. Tried several brands and found that duck and lamb make him extremely gassy with a really rude odor.  He loves the fish and sweet potato, his coat is like velvet now in just a couple short months.  No more shedding or flaking and NO RUDE ODOROUS GAS problem. Highly recommend.

product_title: Zymox Otic Clinic Size (Hydrocortisone 1.0% Enzymatic Solution) - 8 fl. oz (236
review_body: Before I found Zymox My dog had chronic ear infections that caused him horrible pain everyday. When used regularly my dogs ears stay clean and healthy. The stuff the vet kept giving me made his ears worse, I am so glad I found this product.

product_title: Gourmet Hand-Dipped Yogurt Dog Treats, 2 in. Minibites - Tub of 48
review_body: My dog loves these treats.  I have also shared them with family for their dogs and have had them rave about how much their dogs like them.  Even sent the order info to one person so they can place an order.

product_title: The Critterbug - Laser Light Pet Toy
review_body: I recently purchased this item from my fourteen year old female tabby, TippyToes.  Boy, does she sure love it!  She doesn't even seem to mind that I'm actually in control of it. product_title: API FILSTAR XP FILTER SIZE L Aquarium Canister Filter 1-Count Box
review_headline: Rena XP series are excellent filters
review_body:
The Rena XP series filters are the best bargain in the canister filter market. Eheims may have more bells and whistles and Magnums may be more well known, but Rena XP's occupy the best bang for your buck slot.
I've used my XP2 now for a year and a half on a moderately stocked 65 gallon with excellent success. I don't clean the filter as often as I should and I don't do water changes every week like some say is essential. Still, the XP2 keeps the water clean enough to raise and house 5 large discus, 4 large clown loaches and assorted other cleanup crew. While this product page is for the XP3 and I've commented on the XP2, I have also used the XP3. In fact, it's replacing my XP2 on the 65gallon and the XP2 is moving to my 29gallon. The 29 currently is serviced by a Magnum HOT with biowheel (which in turn is moving to the 20gallon).
Servicing the filters couldn't be easier - lift the center handle and away you go. Like I said, I don't service it monthly, but when I do, it's simple and straight-forward. The baskets are generous in size and hold a lot of filter medium. I was fortunate and got a large service \\"kit\\" on sale one day. It had 10 or so filter pads, plus bags of charcoal and other media. That has sufficed for the past 18 months.
If you know about discus, you know how finicky they are about water quality. The fact that the XP2 services them for a couple of months at a time between cleanings says a lot about the filter.
Just get one! At the price, you can't beat it.

product_title: PetSafe ScoopFree Self Cleaning Litter Box
review_body: I had just returned another self cleaning box when I got this one. (see littermaid elite-awful!!!) Anyway, this little box is great! I got the hood for it because that is what my cats are used to. It was so easy to put together and set up! And no nasty clumps of urine and poo to deal with. The clumping litter is great in a regular box, but in a self cleaning box (The Mega Elite uses the clumping litter) the rake just breaks the clumps apart and leaves little \\"stinklets\\" in the \\"clean\\" litter. This box is a better design too. Not heavy like some of the others. While the litter cartridges can be a bit heavy, I don't think it is excessive. The price right now may be high for some people, but for now, I think it will be worth it to me. Especially if I can get two times the life out of one cartridge. I read someone's post about using press n seal on the bottom of the cartridge to make it last a bit longer. I will try this with the next one and see how it goes. However, the bottom of the cartridges are covered in some type of plastic, which might be okay. It does not appear to be waxy as some have discussed. Perhaps they have made them better already? This box is not noisy at all. If anyone thinks it is, get the box I mentioned above. This box was so much quieter! I hope you all read the posts first! Don't make the same mistake I did by not researching first. I just got so excited about the idea of a self cleaning box, I went right out and got one. I did stand there and look at the 3 they offered for a long time before deciding. I just decided wrong the first time! Good luck to all of you, and take care!  UPDATE!! The Press and Seal did not work. The rake picked it up and balled it up in the litter. What a mess! Maybe I did not do it right, but I even taped the corners so it would stick better. No way! I am having to change the cartridge once a week because I have two cats who are always in the box it seems. I have been emptying it out and adding new crystals. I just ordered the Scoop Free Forever Cartridge based on someone's posting. I had just ordered the 3 pack refill cartridges, but when I saw the forever cartridge, I cancelled my order and got this instead! I can't wait! Most people may not want to clean the tray, but really the mess just slides right out because the crystals are silica and they soak up moisture. There may be a little residue, but it is a much easier cleanup than clumping litter! Then you put in new crystals (4 to 4.5 pounds by the way). It is important to get the right amount and depth for the box to work right. Until my forever cartridge comes in, I will refill the old ones. But I think the forever cartridge will be the answer to the expense of this box!!!  Update again! Just got my forever pan and it is exactly as promised! He guarantees the product too! You have nothing to lose. He is very nice and will personally answer any questions you have. He is sold out right now, but keep searching for \\"forever tray\\" or \\"scoop free forever tray\\". He is making more so keep looking! Best of luck!

product_title: The Cat in the Hat
review_headline: Just Read It ... Don't Try to Understand!
review_body:
If you approach Seuss's \\"Cat in the Hat\\" looking to be told a story worthy of the Modern Library's #1 book of the 20th Century, then you will most likely be disappointed. But if you throw aside your expectations of what makes a book great and just read the words as you would the people, places, sights and sounds that trigger your thoughts during the course of a normal day, then you will be amazed.
In \\"Cat,\\" Theodor Seuss Geisel uses his superhuman vocabulary and literary knowledge to relate a day in the life of a couple children and the animals and things with whom they interact. Seuss's words are abnormally sophisticated, yet one never gets the feeling he is simply showing off. While his writing style is often referred to as stream-of-consciousness, it is clear that every word is appropriately placed and deeply thought out. As \\"Cat\\" meanders along through its day, the objects that enter the periphery of the protagonists triggers emotions and thoughts that lead to: poems, songs, theological and political discussions, laughing, shouting, incoherent noises, etc. The novel ranges from sublime to aggravating, but that is only because it is so true to its form. How many times in a normal day, if we were to stop and ruminate upon what we were just thinking, would we then think, \\"What was that?\\" But then it's quickly on to the next interaction destined to spark different emotions, thoughts, ideas, etc...
It is impossible to sum this book up. It follows no plot or pattern other than that it is simply 1 day. Two people, a cat, a goldfish, and two things... 1 day.
Reading this book reminded me at times of the Simpsons episode where Homer is seen watching an episode of David Lynch's Twin Peaks. \\"Brilliant!\\" Homer remarks, but then quietly to himself, \\"I have no idea what is going on here.\\" While I often found myself in Homer's predicament while reading Cat, I was always able to appreciate Seuss's writing, even if the individual words were all I understood. For that reason, I plan on reading this book again several years from now to see what life has taught me that might expand my understanding of Seuss's beautiful day.hat reason, I plan on reading this book again several years from now to see what life has taught me that might expand my understanding of Seuss's beautiful day.

product_title: PetSafe ScoopFree Self Cleaning Litter Box
review_body:
I replaced my old, broken LitterMaid with a new Scoop Free Self-Cleaning Litter Box 2 months ago, and I've been really impressed with how well it works - it really is pretty much maintenance-free (aside from stiring around the crystals periodically). I think the motor is a little bit quieter than the LitterMaid, and it doesn't seem to get stuck the way the LitterMaid often did. The litter tray replacement cartridges are expensive and so far I have not seen them in any local stores so I order from Amazon (free shipping). Also, I change the litter tray more frequently than it says you have to. I think it says for one cat you can let it go a month - no way! I change mine about every 10-14 days.

Surprisingly, my older cat adapted to the crystal litter right away, however my younger cat won't have anything to do with the new box. I tried all of the tips in the Scoop Free instruction book to entice her to try out the new box (mixing clumping sand litter in with the crystals, letting her regular litter box get really dirty so she's forced to try out the new (clean) box, etc.), but she's still not interested. I think she doesn't like the \\"crunchy\\" noise the crystals make when she steps into the box. Oh well - my older cat, who is very picky about having a clean litter box, loves it, so I'm happy with my purchase.

product_title: Drinkwell Original Pet Fountain
review_body: I have two 18 pound cats and a 13 pound dog/puppy.  One of the cats loves drinking out of the faucet, so much that he's sitting at the door waiting for us to wake up in the morning so we can turn the faucet on in the bathroom!    After setting up the product (piece of cake, just make sure you put the filter in the right way, which the instructions show you!), I filled it up to the brim with water and turned it on.  The humming noise is about as loud as a typical Homedics fountain pump product -- almost relaxing, and not as loud as most people seem to think.    The cats got used to the fountain rather quickly, but the puppy took a few days to appreciate it.  Now both cats and the puppy are drinking from the fountain and not the bowl!  The trickling sound of the fountain is louder than the pump noise, if that calms anyone's fears about how \\"loud\\" this fountain is.    I found that by turning the little switch on the right down by the bowl base, the water level can reach a lower level before it starts making noise.  I generally add about 8 ounces of water a day, because all 3 pets drink quite a bit.  I'm going to buy the extra canister to hold twice as much water.  I was gone camping for three days, and it was still running fine when I got back home.    In terms of cleaning, I've had this product for nearly a month and am thinking about cleaning it now.  As with any running water product, there's a film forming at the water level of the bowl.  Once a month maintenance on this product, versus cleaning it every other day like I used to with a typical bowl, is fine with me!    Great product, and not a bad price, either.

I Started him off with the recommended DAILY amount for his weight,age, etc.  i have since gone down to 4 times a week as they recommend after 4 months of daily use.  Well for some time now the stains have ALL DISAPPEARED and Cavaliers are NOT to have their coat or hair cut in ANY FASHION so I didn't have to ever have them cut away.  His eyes are beautiful now and the white hair where the stains were originally located is white as can be. I am ordering my 2nd 120 gr bottle now.  Please note that even though your dogs stains will be removed by Angels eyes, if you STOP IT, THEY WILL RETURN! review_body: I don't hate this product, because the less hair the better in general.    BUT BUT BUT!!! The tools' sharp edged \\"blade\\", the manufacturer actually calls it a blade, cuts out hair to thin it.  So, yes, you get off mounds of hair, but it might be hair you want to keep on the dog...you know, for a nice looking coat.  I will continue to use it sparingly (I think anyway), but only because my dog has a really thick coat and thinning isn't necessarily bad.  JUST KEEP IN MIND THAT YOUR'E THINNING/CUTTING good, bad, dead, live, over, under-coat, everything.  After using it, you'll clearly see that your dog's coat isn't as fluffy and looks thinner, and it's not just because you removed dead and undercoat!      I've done nothing scientific, but that's what I think is happening with this tool.    I won't recommend it to friends without cautioning them about this, and telling them not to get mad at me if their dog's coats look meek and thin after use.

I thought maybe I just over filled it and next time filled it less but still got the same problem. Gravity would do it's job and too much kibble would just come pouring outta the feeder spout that it'd end up over flowing the dish and end up piled up around the dish. So I started putting a place mat underneath and every time I see it piled up I'd just pick up the place mat and pour the excess back into the Le Bistro. product_title: Omega Paw Tricky Treat Ball
review_headline: Best Toy Yet for my Medium-Sized Chewer
review_body: My sweet little Cocker Spaniel LOVES to eat, and I mean virtually anything that crosses his path.  I learned quickly to keep any and all leather products and minty or food smelling items behind closed doors and up high on a shelf after losing shoes, belts, wallets, several packs of gum, and whatever else happened to be near the gum (you should see the looks I get at the grocery store when I pull out my tooth-marked credit cards).      His hunting, eating, and destroying was insatiable. Stuffed animals were ripped to shreds in 2 minutes flat (eyeballs first), and even though he loves that, we get tired of picking up all the 'snow' from their insides.  Edible bones lasted and equally short amount of time; rawhides bought me maybe 2 more minutes, but made him throw up, and he even tore Nylabones to shreds.  He was not remotely interested in the Kong or anything that required fetching.  Cow hooves were the only thing that kept him occupied, but they stink to high heaven and left his feet disgustingly dirty.  Finally, a friend bought me the Tricky Treat Ball, and my hungry little buddy was thrilled.    He loves rolling the ball around & soon figured out if he bounced it hard against a wall, he could get the hard-to-reach last bits out.  The large size works great for our Cocker because it's too big for him to easily chew, although he is lazy and sometimes lays down with it and starts gnawing away and sticking his tongue down to hole just to get the flavor, crazy mutt!  That's when we have to take it away b/c he has actually gotten a bit of the tough plastic off.  Like any toy, he gets bored of it if we give it to him too often, so we need to find something else.      If your dog sounds like mine, this might be just the thing for him.

product_title: LitterMaid LME9000 Elite Mega Advanced Automatic Self-Cleaning Litter Box
review_headline: Is it worth the extra cost over the LM900 .. you decide
review_body: All I can say is I am sorry one of the household's two LM900 gave up after 3 years+.  I had hoped this NEW & IMPROVED?! LME9000 was worth the extra cost. Unlike the LM900 which picked up the waste and dumped it into the receptacle, this one sweeps it in ... most of the time. I also find the receptacle door blocked open much more than the older version.  The receptacle is much easier to remove for cleaning and replacement ... once you have the combination.  The metal tines do not clean the entire box, but instead push some of clumps back to the starting position to be locked away until they are separately cleaned out by hand.  The drive motor might be more quiet, but the mechanics behind the cleaner tines is clunky and very loud.  All in all, I do not think I will be looking for another 9000 when the other LM900 4 years+ old, finally gives up.

product_title: Aspen pet Cool Flow Pet Fountain
review_headline: Cheap knock-off of an innovative product.  To be avoided.
review_body:
I bought one of these several months ago. It was great for about two weeks, and since then it's been nothing but trouble.

To begin with, the filter is essentially worthless. It has a few small, loosely packed granules of activated charcoal in a big bag made of white fuzzy filter material that doesn't even reliably collect the algae that inevitably form in the thing. The filters don't last months, as the instructions claim -- more like a week or two until they're hopelessly contaminated with algae and have to be discarded lest they cause the whole bowl to gunk up.

Oh, did I mention the algae? This thing is just full of nooks and crannies that get splashed with water -- but don't stay wet or have continual flow over them -- perfect for breeding the icky green stuff. It's nearly impossible to clean it well enough to stop the growth once it starts; all you can really do is slow it down enough that -- if you're lucky -- it won't make the water taste bad or (worse) make your pets sick. In fact, we thought we'd sanitized the entire thing using bleach (no easy feat, and *not* something that should be necessary) only to see the algae regrow twice before we figured out that it was even inside the pump, which we had to disassemble into 3 pieces to clean -- well, clean, more or less. I'm not going to dump bleach into the pump, it has metal parts.

I pin the blame for this one on the crummy filter, first and foremost, and on the product design that creates dark, damp, hard-to-clean surfaces everywhere. Oh, and did I mention that the filters are hard to find? Big chain pet stores are happy to sell you this water bowl (I assume they make more margin than on the Drinkwell, which was the original product in this category) but can't be bothered to stock the filters. There are aquarium filters in similar sizes -- those would actually even do some good, unlike the Petmate filters -- but the cheap pump won't generate enough pressure to give a decent flow rate through them. Nice.

Don't make the mistake I did. Buy a Drinkwell, not the house-brand knockoff (this product) even if it's on sale.

* The filters don't last very long and the material of which they're made begins to \\"shed,\\" so to speak, thereby falling apart enough to have their fibers in the water.

* The pump doesn't last long, period. I'm on my second pump--the first one lasted only a couple months--which itself now crapped out after a month.

* Mold will build up inside the unit very quickly.

* If the water level gets too low, it becomes noisy.

Believe me, you'll love this at first but get very frustrated with it soon enough.

product_title: Jolly Ball Toy - 8"
review_headline: Dog LOVES this and it's tough
review_body:
These balls are great. My German Shepherd was 1st given the Tug-n-Toss by my aunt, a 6\\" size. She LOVED it from the start. Then, when she destroyed it, we saw there were 8\\". That is ideal for her. We also tried the 10\\". My dog goes crazy if you say \\"Jolly Ball\\"!

Basically, the ball is ideal. It is tough yet not so tough she can't puncture it with her teeth (no, she doesn't use the handle - that's for us). However, it's a tough ball enough that the shape doesn't change (no \\"deflate\\"), and its bouyancy doesn't much change! It's still a very bouncy ball for a long time of abuse (it's just light enough for bounciness). My dog puts lots of punctures in the ball AND she squeezes it, but it always goes back to shape. Until it's so punctured it starts to \\"bubble\\" on 1 area on the center line.

The 8\\" lasts about 3 mos or so for us before it is in bad enough shape that the dog starts using it as a chew toy (big hole). It gets ALOT of abuse. And the dog LOVES its bounciness and toughness (she likes to squeeze), so it's all worth it. If you get your ideal size, and your dog is like ours in personality, he should like it if you play with him.

review_body: If you're looking for a dog shampoo that really cleans, relieves itching and leaves the coat and hair soft and \\"glowing\\" this is the product. product_title: Lentek Super Bark Free Pro Series Dog Training Device
review_headline: not waterproof but seems to work at times
review_body: I have an aggressive set of dogs on the other side of my iron fence, otherwise known as Holly and the Dog of Death.
